title_en: Navigation method and navigation system
abstract_en: The method involves coding traffic information to traffic message (3), and transmitting the message to a set of receivers (1) by a radio transmitter (9). The message is decoded in the receivers, and two escape routes are independently computed to an original computed route by a navigation system (5) depending on the respective message. Additional information such as driving route, time of travel, points of interest along the escape routes is determined by the navigation system, and the computed escape routes are outputted audibly or visually in the receiver side. An independent claim is also included for a device for implementing a road user navigating method.

title_en: System and method for providing alarming notification and real-time, critical emergency information to occupants in a building or emergency designed area and evacuation guidance system to and in the emergency exit route
abstract_en: The system method described herein could guide people around urban environments indoor and outdoor, provide accurate update and real time emergency notification and information to the building occupants or to the emergency designated area to his cellular phone, We have focused on the task of providing a real time emergency information and navigation along the emergency exit route, The information will be received directly and will display on the existing cellular phone as Bluetooth application

title_en: Laser guidance emergency navigation method and system
abstract_en: The present invention provides a method and a system for guiding people in an emergency. More specifically, the present invention provides a method and system using a laser for guiding people away from an area of danger, and for guiding emergency personal to an area of danger. The system includes a pair of dissimilar visible laser beams generated by at least one laser emitting device. The system also includes an invisible laser for rescue personnel. The visible dissimilar laser beams are generated substantially parallel to each other to direct evacuees away from an area of danger via the shortest and safest route in the event of an emergency.

title_en: Navigation system
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To realize a navigation system for avoiding dangerous places which are predicted in disaster occurrence without extra costs.  <P>SOLUTION: When disaster information transmitted from a disaster information center is received in disaster occurrence (step S10), the determination whether a self-vehicle is located in a disaster occurrence area is made (step S20) and then a nearest evacuation site is specified at a target place when the vehicle is located in the disaster occurrence area. Then, the dangerous places predicted by the disaster is specified based on the topographic data in map data (step S50); an avoidance route that avoids the dangerous places to reach the target place is searched (step S60); and the self-vehicle is introduced (step S70).  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2007,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Methods and systems for controlling directional sounders for route guidance
abstract_en: A plurality of directional sounders located in a region being monitored can be synchronously and sequentially activated in various patterns to establish an audibly defined exit route from the region. Emitted audio, from a respective sounder, can be different than the audio emitted by other activated sounders to provide a path and direction for evacuation to individuals in the vicinity of the exit route.

title_en: Information providing device for vehicle
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an information providing device for a vehicle, capable of providing a route suitable for moving on foot to own house or an evacuation place.  <P>SOLUTION: This information providing device has a disaster information receiving means for receiving disaster information, a navigation means for outputting own vehicle position and map information in the vicinity of the own vehicle position, and a route search means for searching a destination serving as the evacuation place based on the own vehicle position, and for searching and providing a route from the own vehicle position to the destination, when receiving the disaster information by the disaster information receiving means.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2008,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Navigation apparatus
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a navigation apparatus capable of making users cope with the locations of facilities which the user should preferentially be headed for, in disaster appropriately respond to the disaster.  <P>SOLUTION: A facility icon 32, indicating a family restaurant and a facility icon 33 indicating a parking lot which are displayed and set land marks, are displayed in a map on a map screen (a) prior to the reception of disaster information. When disaster information, communicated from a disaster information center at the time of the occurrence of disasters, is received, a facility icon 34 indicating hospitals, disaster-related facilities; a facility icon 35 indicating convenience stores; and a facility icon 36 indicating evacuation sites are displayed on a map on a map screen (b).  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2008,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Long afterglow single-end explosion prevention fluorescent lamp
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a long-persistence single-capped explosion-proof fluorescent tube. The inner surface of a transparent glass tube is provided with a conductive coating and an afterglow coating. Electrode cable at either end of the lamp tube is provided with an elastic conductive strip which is in contact with the conductive coating which extends to lamp filament at the other end. The lamp tube first discharge between the filament and the conductive coating, and thus forces the filaments at both ends to discharge so that the entire lamp is lit without any starter, therefore though the discharge is completed in the lamp the tube is endowed with fine explosion-proof property. As an afterglow coating comprising long persistence fluorescent phosphors is coated at the inner wall of the transparent glass tube, the tube can release the absorbed light energy slowly and give off long afterglow when the light is turned off, functioning as the real-time navigation and guidance for the operating workers in the blackout. The utility model is endowed with a plurality of functions, such as lighting, explosion prevention, and navigation salvage and evacuation function under emergencies to minimize casualties caused by sudden accidents. Therefore, the utility model is applicable in particular to the lighting of coal mining and other underground mining, and thus the light is an energy-saving product.

title_en: Navigation device and method for guiding evacuation route
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To immediately notify the driver of the relation between the current position and evacuation route, when encountering vehicle accident, or the like, inside a tunnel.  <P>SOLUTION: An arithmetic processing part 1 of a navigation device, including a storage device 3 storing map data containing tunnel information, in which the position of emergency exit provided to each tunnel is associated includes a means for calculating the current position; a display means for displaying an image that indicates the current position on a map, by using the calculated current position and the map data; and a means for determining the entrance of a vehicle into the tunnel and its exit from the tunnel by using the calculated current position and the map data. When a prescribed operation is accepted from the user, during the period of time since it is determined that the vehicle has entered the tunnel, until the vehicle exits therefrom; the display means displays evacuation route guidance that includes the data that indicates the current position and the distance, and the direction from the current position, to the emergency exit by using the current position and the tunnel data.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2008,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Subway station and tunnel fire disaster prevention system capable of guiding passengers emergency exit
title_ko: 승객 대피경로 안내기능을 갖는 지하철 역사 및 터널화재방재 시스템
abstract_en: A subway station and a tunnel fire disaster prevention system having a passenger emergency exit guide function are provided to minimize the choke of passengers in a tunnel by removing smoke and choking gas caused by a fire in the tunnel. A tunnel fire disaster prevention system having a passenger emergency exit guide function includes a central processing unit(210), a data storage unit(220), a data communication unit(230) and a display unit(240). The central processing unit(210) calculates a smoke prediction path, a passenger exit and a smoke ejection path when a fire occurs in a tunnel, and controls the operation of a ventilator and fire-fighting equipment according to the passenger exit and the smoke ejection path. The data storage unit(220) stores the data processed in the central processing unit(210). The data communication unit(230) transmits and receives data between the tunnel fire disaster prevention system, and a power facility, a signal facility, a communication facility, the ventilator, and the fire-fighting equipment. The display unit(240) displays the state of various facilities installed in the tunnel.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 터널 화재방재시스템에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 선로에서 화재가 발생시 이를 감지하고 화재발생정보를 이용하여 화재로 인한 연기의 예상진행경로를 계산하고 계산된 경로에 따라 유도등 및 환풍기의 동작을 제어하는 화재방재 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
     본 발명은 터널 내의 화재 발생시 연기 예상진행경로를 계산하고 승객대피경로 및 연기배출경로를 계산하여, 상기 승객대피경로 및 연기배출경로에 따라 상기 환기설비 및 소방설비의 동작을 제어하는 중앙처리장치; 상기 중앙처리장치에서 처리되는 데이터를 저장하는 데이터 저장부; 상기 터널화재방재시스템과 중앙사령실시스템 간의 데이터 교환 및 상기 터널화재방재시스템과 상기 전력설비, 신호설비, 통신설비, 환기설비 및 소방설비 간의 데이터 교환을 위한 데이터 통신부; 및 상기 터널에 설치되는 각종 설비들의 상태를 보여주는 디스플레이부;를 포함하는 터널 화재방재시스템을 개시한다. 
       
     화재방재, 연기, 환풍기, 유도등, 시나리오, 시뮬레이션

title_en: Navigation device
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a navigation device for performing route guidance only in cases where the route guidance is necessary.  <P>SOLUTION: In regard to respective escape routes from an object intersection existing within a prescribed distance ahead of one's own vehicle, estimated necessary time periods to arrive at a destination are severally calculated (step S30) to compare an estimated necessary time period on a straight-advance escape route from the object intersection with estimated necessary time periods on escape routes other than the straight-advance escape route (step S60). If differences between the necessary time period on the straight-advance escape route and the necessary time periods on the escape routes other than the straight-advance escape route are equal to or larger than a reference value Th1, it is determined that route guidance is necessary at the object intersection and a recommended traveling direction at the object intersection is indicated to perform route guidance (steps S80 and S90).  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2008,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Navigation device
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To retrieve a refuge place around a present place and a recommended evacuation route when receiving emergency broadcast, and to guide quickly the most suitable refuge place and the most suitable route from the present place to the refuge place.  <P>SOLUTION: The navigation device 10 includes a map database 111, a road database 112, a refuge place database 114, and an emergency-time action control means 107, and a route storage means 116. When a broadcast receiving means 102 receives the emergency broadcast, the emergency-time action control means 107 operates an emergency time operation mode, searches for the refuge place reachable in the shortest time from the current position and the evacuation route to the refuge place, on reference to the refuge place and the route stored in the route storage means 116 when current position information positioned by a positioning means 105 is a spot stored in the route storage means 116, and to the refuge place database 114 when the current position is different from the spot, and displays the evacuation route together with map information on a display means 103.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2008,JPO&INPIT
assignees: SANYO ELECTRIC CO;SANYO CONSUMER ELECTRONICS CO

title_en: Evacuation guiding system and evacuation guiding method
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide victims with evacuation information reliably and quickly even when the many cellphones are used to cause saturation in a disaster area.  <P>SOLUTION: An evacuation guiding system comprises a route guidance server 1 for creating an evacuation route map and disaster-related information, and a plurality of access points 2-1 to 2n installed in a living space in connection with the route guidance server 1 via a dedicated network 4. The route guidance server 1 sends the evacuation route map and the like to the plurality of access points 2-1 to 2-n, and the plurality of access points 2-1 to 2-n receive and store the evacuation route map and the like sent from the route guidance server 1, and when a victim's cellphone 3 exists in the service area, send the stored evacuation route map and the like to the cellphone 3. The cellphone 3 acquires the evacuation route map and the like from the access points 2-1 to 2-n without direct communication with the route guidance server 1.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

title_en: In-vehicle route guiding apparatus
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To carry out rapid evacuation behavior, after occurrence of an earthquake.  <P>SOLUTION: An in-vehicle navigation apparatus 1 is provided, which determines whether there is a possibility for own vehicle potentially suffers from a disaster at the current position, based on earthquake information acquired from an earthquake processing center 13, immediately after detecting a P-wave reaching an observing station, specifies a safe zone that can avert the disaster due to the occurrence of the earthquake, based on disaster prevention map information acquired from the earthquake processing center 13 and representing an area surrounding the current position, and performs a route guidance by searching a route, from the current position up to the specified safe zone, when a determination is made such that own vehicle potentially suffers from the disaster at the current position. The evacuation behavior can start with a time difference (preliminary tremor continuing period), between an elapsed time from the occurrence of earthquake waves (P-wave and S-wave) at the earthquake source, up to the arrival of the P-wave at the observing station, and an elapsed time up to the arrival of the S-wave at the observation station.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Vehicle-mounted navigation apparatus and route guidance method
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide guidance at a circular intersection so that a driver intuitively recognizes in which direction a branch route to be an escape route exists, and to prevent a route deviation at the circular intersection.  <P>SOLUTION: When one's own vehicle passes through a circular intersection as an intersection at which guidance is provided, a route line L indicating a travel route of one's own vehicle and a direction indicating mark N indicating a branch route to be an escape route for one's own vehicle out of a plurality of branch routes constituting the circular intersection are superimposed with each other, and are displayed on an enlarged picture of the circular intersection of a display 7.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Sensor node for home network system
title_ko: 홈 네트워크 시스템의 센서노드
abstract_en: A sensor node of a home network system is provided to easily change a sensor installed to the sensor node by considering surrounding or installation environment. A sensor unit(120) includes a plurality of sensor ports in which a sensor is detached and attached. The sensor unit generates a sensing signal by sensing environmental information including temperature, humidity, or brightness through the sensor. A communicator(140) transmits the sensing signal to a server of a home network system. An LED(Light Emitting Device) unit(150) includes an LED lamp.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 홈 네트워크 시스템의 센서노드에 관한 것이다. 
     본 발명이 개시하는 센서노드는, 센서가 탈부착 가능한 복수개의 센서포트를 마련하고, 센서를 통해 온도, 습도 또는 조도를 포함한 환경정보를 감지하여 감지신호를 생성하는 센서부를 구성한다. 본 발명의 센서노드는, 위 감지신호를 홈 네트워크 시스템의 서버로 송출하는 통신부와, LED부를 더 구성할 수 있다. 이때,  LED부는 통신부를 통해 서버로부터 수신한 점등신호에 따라 LED램프를 점멸시킨다. 
     본 발명에 의하면, 주변환경 또는 설치환경을 감안하여, 센서노드에 구비되는 센서를 용이하게 변경할 수 있다. 나아가 LED부를 통해 사고 발생시 대피경로 안내가 가능하다. 
       
     USN, 홈 네트워크, 센서노드, 센서 탈부착

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle vision/inertia integrated navigation method in unknown environment
abstract_en: The invention relates to an unmanned aerial vehicle vision/inertia integrated navigation method in the unknown environment. The method relates to image processing, inertial navigation calculation and filtering estimation, so that the steps of defining coordinate system, aligning the coordinate system, setting up filter equation and the like are firstly carried out before the main navigation method is implemented. The navigation process of the method comprises five steps: acquiring and pretreating image; extracting feature points by a SIFT method; matching the feature points; updating the filter equation; and carrying out the filtering estimation on the updated filter equation. The method only needs the current ground image instead of specific external information for matching, so as to be used in any environment (including underwater, shelter, canyon, underground and the like) in theory; furthermore, the method has the advantages of good sheltered property and high accuracy.

title_en: Navigation device, navigation method, navigation program, and recording medium
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To enable a user to escape from a mountain path promptly when the user wants to do so, without forcing the user to perform uneasy traveling on the mountain path.  <P>SOLUTION: A navigation device 100 includes a determination section 101, an input section 102, a search section 103, and a display section 104. The determination section 101 determines whether or not a moving body is in course of traveling on a mountain path. The input section 102 receives from the user an input representing whether the user wants to escape from the mountain path under traveling, when the moving body is determined to be on the mountain path traveling. The search section 103 searches for an escape route for escaping from the mountain path under traveling, when it receives an input of the user's intention of escaping from the mountain path under traveling. The display section 104 displays information on the escape route.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Pedestrian navigation apparatus
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a pedestrian navigation apparatus to provide a guiding path for pedestrian to shade and take shelter. The apparatus comprises a CPU unit, a map database, a GPS unit, a touch-screen, a CMMB unit, a sun orientation calculation unit and a voice horn. The map database memorizes road information suitable for pedestrian walking, building information around the road and treeinformation around the road for shading or sheltering rain; The CPU unit acquires the weather information based on the CMMB unit. If the current season is summer, the weather is sunny and the subscriber selects the shading path calculation mode, the CPU unit acquires the sun orientation information on the current position in dependence on the sun orientation calculation unit and figures out the walking guiding path suitable for shading. If the weather is rainy and the subscriber selects the shading and rain sheltering path calculation mode, the CPU unit figures out the walking guiding path suitable for rain sheltering.

title_en: Shelter course guidance system and shelter course guidance method using the same
title_ko: 대피 경로 안내 시스템 및 이를 이용한 대피 경로 안내 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A shelter guidance system and a shelter path guiding method using the same are provided to change a shelter route appropriately according to whether fire is on progress or extinguished. CONSTITUTION: A plurality of sensor nodes(300) measure environmental elements in a location, and transmits the measured environmental parameter value. A central controller(500) decides whether the fire break out within a section from the environmental parameter value. A shelter route to an emergency exit is selected from the section where the fire occurs. A control command for indicating the selected shelter route in the guide object place is generated. A shelter route direction instructing lamp(100) flickers a direction notice according to a control command. The shelter route is guided.
abstract_ko:
본 발명의 대피 경로 안내 시스템은 복수 개의 구역으로 분획된 안내 대상 장소에 대피 경로를 안내하며, 상기 복수 개의 구역 내에 각각 하나 이상 구비되며, 상기 구역 내에서 환경 요소를 측정하고, 측정된 환경 요소 값을 전송하는 복수 개의 센서 노드; 상기 환경 요소 값으로부터 상기 구역 내에서의 화재 발생 여부를 판단하고, 화재가 발생한 구역으로부터 비상구로의 상기 대피 경로를 선정하고, 상기 선정된 대피 경로를 상기 안내 대상 장소 내에서 표시하기 위한 제어 명령을 생성하여 전달하는 중앙 제어부; 및 상기 복수 개의 구역 중 일부 이상의 구역에 설치되며, 상기 제어 명령에 따라 한 방향 이상의 방향 지시표지를 점등하여 상기 대피경로를 안내하는 하나 이상의 대피경로 방향 지시등;을 포함한다.  
       
     대피 경로 안내

title_en: Exhaust emission control system
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To optimally execute discharge elimination of PM (forcible regeneration) of an exhaust emission control unit 10 by sufficiently utilizing functions of a navigation system.  <P>SOLUTION: When accumulation quantity of PM exceeds a predetermined quantity, this system judges based on information of a navigation system if a route in which forcible regeneration of DPF 31 can be done exists in a travel direction of a vehicle on a present travel route, and the system sets an evacuation travel route on which forcible regeneration can be done by the navigation system and guides the same if no route on which forcible regeneration can be done exists.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Pass through for improved response time
abstract_en: Method and systems of improving the response of public safety personnel to or evacuation from a desired location are provided. In addition to path information obtained through traditional sources, information is used to determine the optimal route for emergency personnel to an emergency situation and for aiding emergency personnel to route people from the situation. The information may also be used to automatically prioritize vehicles and personnel to optimize response time. Further, the information may also be used to in situations in which it is advantageous for the vehicle or personnel to be tactically positioned in nearby locations rather than at the incident scene. Although the descriptions below will primarily focus on routes to a particular location, similar methods can be used for evacuations from the location. The optimal route may use historical information stored in a database local or remote to the dispatcher and/or real-time information updated during the emergency situation.

title_en: Route guidance apparatus, system, program and method
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To guide sufferers or the like to appropriate evacuation routes in the event of an emergency such as disasters.  <P>SOLUTION: The route guidance apparatus is provided with: a route information storage unit which stores route identification information, route information including pieces of identification information on route guidance apparatus arranged on both ends of the route, respectively by every route between the adjacent route guidance apparatus in two or more route guidance apparatus which are arranged on the refuge route and connected to each other via a communication line; a route state storage unit which stores the route identification information, a route state including presence of the occurrence of a communication failure by every route between the adjacent route guidance apparatus; a communication control unit which determines whether or not communication is possible with the other adjacent route guidance apparatus to store the presence of the occurrence of the communication failure by every route of the other route guidance apparatus adjacent to the route guidance apparatus; and a route calculation unit which excludes a route which is recorded that there is the communication failure in the route state storage unit to calculate the refuge route from a location where the route guidance apparatus is arranged to the nearest evacuation site.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Double-antenna GPS/INS combined navigator
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a double-antenna GPS/INS combined navigator which comprises a GPS navigation module, an inertial navigation module, a data computation and fusion module, a data output and display module and a power supply module, wherein the GPS navigation module comprises two GPS antennas, two GPS receivers and a GPS data computation processor; the inertial navigation module comprises an inertial measurement unit IMU, an acquisition board and an INS data computation processor; and the data computation and fusion module shares the same INS data computation processor with the inertial navigation module. The navigator adopts the most advanced satellite navigation and positioning technology, inertial measurement technology, carrier phase measurement technology and DSP embedded design technology, overcomes the defect of a single device, has the advantages of stronger applicability, higher measurement accuracy, better dynamic performance and higher reliability, and not only can output accurate azimuth angles, position, speed and time, but also can accurately output transverse rolling angles and pitch angles. In addition, when a GPS signal is sheltered or the quality is lowered, the accurate data still can be output through the keeping of the inertial measurement unit.
assignees: XI AN STARPRO M & C TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Navigation method and device during personnel evacuation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a navigation method during personnel evacuation, which comprises the following steps of: acquiring navigation paths from every grid to exits in an architectural drawing; acquiring grids corresponding to positions of evacuation objects in the architectural drawing, and commanding the evacuation objects to update the positions thereof according to the navigation paths of the grids; judging whether all the evacuation objects finish the evacuation, if so, ending the procedure; and otherwise, performing the last step. The navigation method can automatically guide the evacuation objects to evacuate in a building by providing the navigation paths for each evacuation object. An algorithm of the navigation paths of the method is based on the gridding of the architectural drawing to approximate the navigation for evacuating people to the navigation of the grids, so the navigation method greatly improves the operating efficiency of a navigation algorithm under the premise of hardly influencing the path accuracy, and has the characteristics of simplicity, accuracy and high efficiency. Because the gridding is fixed and unchanged for a special architectural drawing, the navigation paths are also fixed, and only one computation is needed in operation. The invention also discloses a navigation device during the personnel evacuation.

title_en: Emergency and traffic alert system
abstract_en: Systems and methods are disclosed for providing event notification to navigational applications. More specifically, the disclosed systems and methods provide emergency and non-emergency event information to users such that the event information is displayed to the user of a navigation application. For example, the location of an emergency event, such as a car accident or a fire is displayed on a personal navigation device. Furthermore, the real-time location of emergency vehicles responding to the event can be displayed on the navigation application. This provides additional information to drivers to help avoid traffic situations and clear the route for emergency vehicles. The disclosed systems and methods may also be employed to provide non-emergency information to users, such as parade or marathon information and routes, snow routes, evacuation routes, and traffic signal outages.

title_en: Route guidance system for evacuation from karaoke box
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a route guidance system for emergency capable of suitably guiding routes from respective present locations to an emergency exit and appropriately guiding the evacuation of Karaoke users even inside a building like a labyrinth wherein Karaoke rooms of the similar appearance are successively provided and it is hard to find a mark in a Karaoke box (Karaoke establishment), when an emergency situation such as a fire or an earthquake occurs.  <P>SOLUTION: In the system, a remote controller capable of bidirectionally communicating with a Karaoke device is used, each Karaoke device transmits evacuation route information from the Karaoke room to the emergency exit to the remote controller when the Karaoke device receives emergency information from a disaster alarm, and control is executed so as to update and display a received evacuation route map when the remote controller receives new evacuation route information from the closest Karaoke device.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Evacuation guidance system, evacuation guidance method, evacuation guidance server, portable information terminal, and evacuation guidance program for the portable information terminal
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To reliably notify a user when emergency evacuation is needed due to tsunami or the like, and quickly guide the user to a safe evacuation area.  <P>SOLUTION: A disaster information delivery server 5 delivers information on a disaster which requires emergency evacuation. A cellular phone terminal 1 detects a current position of the terminal on receipt of the disaster information delivered from the server 5, transmits the current position information to an evacuation guidance server 2, and executes navigation processing for evacuating the user of the terminal by evacuation route information transmitted thereafter from the server 2. The server 2 creates evacuation route information for the user of the portable information terminal 1 based on the information on the disaster which requires emergency evacuation, the current position information received from the terminal 1, and map information on surroundings of the current position of the terminal 2, and transmits the information to the terminal 1.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2011,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Sensor network-based indoor emergency navigation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sensor network-based indoor emergency navigation method. The method comprises the following steps of: arranging a sensor node at an indoor scene, arranging a detection node on a corridor and arranging guide nodes on an intersection and an exit; transmitting detected information of the personnel number to the guide node by using the detection node and calculating the average speed of indoor personnel walking through each corridor and further calculating a weight w by using the guide node; establishing a sensor network diagram G=(V, E, w); if the change value of the average speed of the indoor personnel walking through each corridor is more than a set threshold or a weight update pack transmitted by a neighboring node is received, updating the weight w by using the guide node; and adjusting a target node of the guide node according to the update of the weight w in the diagram G and guiding the indoor personnel to evacuate along an optimal path. Indoor navigation is modeled into a dynamical network diagram, personnel evacuation is described as the movement of network fluid and a shortest path in a network is maintained dynamically so as to realize personnel evacuation with the shortest time.

title_en: Telephone switching system for emergency call
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a telephone switching system for emergency call capable of immediately communicating with an emergency information center by using a cellular phone even though a caller evacuates from a vehicle after making an emergency call to the emergency information center once, when conducting telephone communication to the emergency information center by using the dedicated vehicle telephone in case of emergency.  <P>SOLUTION: The dedicated vehicle telephone for conducting communication with the emergency information center in case of emergency and in-vehicle information equipment such as a head unit and navigation device are connected, and a cellular phone number possessed by a driver is stored in the in-vehicle information equipment. When communication with the emergency information center by using the in-vehicle telephone is conducted and evacuation to the outside of the vehicle by the driver is detected, the stored cellular phone number is transmitted to the dedicated vehicle telephone and transmitted again to the emergency information center from the dedicated vehicle telephone. After this, the emergency information center calls the cellular phone having the cellular phone number to guide. When the vehicle information equipment is wirelessly connected with the cellular phone, the disconnection of the wireless connection detects the evacuation to the outside of the vehicle.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2011,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Navigation system
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a navigation system aimed at improving the usability.SOLUTION: The navigation system includes its body case 1; a display section 2 prepared on the body case 1; a speaker 3; a control section 9 connected with both the display section 2 and the speaker 3; and an actual location detection section 13 and a weather information reception section 11 both connected with the control section 9, wherein the control section 9 is composed to connect with a weather analysis and prediction section 12 predicting weather change at the actual location, based on the weather information received at the weather information reception section 11, while to annunciate any evacuation areas at least at one of the display section 2 and speaker 3, when weather deterioration is predicted in the weather analysis and prediction section 12.

title_en: Integrated traffic-management method and system thereof
title_ko: 통합교통관리 방법 및 그 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An integrated traffic managing method and a system thereof are provided to efficiently and optimally perform integrated traffic management. CONSTITUTION: A basic network and end point data collecting unit(210) collects data about a basic network and an end point from a national traffic database. A reference network data collecting unit(220) collects a reference network by a navigation and a new address business standard node/link. A transportation, bicycle, and pedestrian network data collecting unit(230) collects transportation, bicycle, and pedestrian network data. A reference end point data collecting unit(240) collects reference end point data.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 통합교통관리 방법 및 그 시스템에 관한 것으로, 발명은 도로 및 교통수요유발시설 건설에 따른 신규 네트워크 및 기종점 데이터를 기존 네트워크 및 기종점 데이터에 갱신하여 수요를 분석함으로서 요일별, 시간대별 교통수요를 예측하고 이를 통해 통합교통관리를 보다 효율적이며 최적한 상태로 수행할 수 있도록 한다. 또한 실시간으로 수집한 교통량, 속도 등 교통기초데이터와 사고 및 공사 등 이벤트 데이터를 실시간으로 반영한 시뮬레이션 분석을 통해 도출된 대안별 교통영향을 바탕으로 ; 고정식, 감응식 및 연동식 교통신호체계를 구축하고, 이용자에게 교통예측정보를 제공하며, 대중교통 최적노선을 구축함으로서  불필요한 교통정체 현상을 배제하고, 교통영향평가, 환경영향평가, 보행로 및 자전거로 운영방안, 긴급대피효과 분석을 통해 안전과 효율성 측면의 도시내 교통계획의 타당성을 분석함으로서 쾌적하고 효율적인 통행환경 구축과 동시에 교통정체 발생을 억제하여 소음, 탄소 배출을 최소화할 수 있도록 한 것이다.

title_en: Evacuate route guiding system using location-based information and evacuating method thereof
title_ko: 위치기반정보를 이용한 대피경로안내시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An evacuate route system and method using location based information are provided to help escaping people to rapidly evacuate by guiding an evacuate route using the location based information of a mobile communications terminal. CONSTITUTION: An emergency evacuate situation sensing server(100) senses the emergency evacuate situation of a building and creates evacuate situation information. An RFID/USN(Radio Frequency Identification/Ubiquitous Sensor Network)(200) creates the location based information of a mobile communications terminal(500) of escaping people which are located in the inner side of the building when creating the evacuate situation information. An evacuate route information providing server(300) receives the evacuate situation information and the location based information and creates evacuate route information in order to evacuate the escaping people to emergency exit while avoiding an evacuate situation generation spot. The evacuate route information providing server transmits the evacuate route information to the mobile communications terminal through the RFID/USN.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 의하면, 건물의 응급대피상황을 감지하고 이에 따른 응급대피상황정보를 생성하는 응급대피상황감지서버; 상기 응급대피상황감지서버로부터 응급대피상황정보 생성시 건물 내부에 위치하는 대피자들의 이동통신단말기의 위치기반정보를 생성하는 RFID/USN; 상기 응급대피상황정보와 상기 위치기반정보를 수신하여 이동통신단말기를 사용하는 대피자들이 현재위치로부터 대피상황발생지점을 회피하면서 비상구까지 안전하게 대피하도록 하는 대피경로정보를 생성하여 상기 RFID/USN을 통하여 이동통신단말기에 전송하는 대피경로정보제공서버; 및 상기 응급대피상황정보와 상기 위치기반정보 및 대피경로정보를 수신하고 이를 외부의 응급구조센터에 전송하여 구조대원으로 하여금 상기 건물에 출동하면서 건물의 구조와 대피상황발생지점 및 대피를 요하는 대피자들의 현재위치를 인지하도록 하는 응급상황외부알림서버를 포함하는 위치기반정보를 이용한 대피경로안내시스템이 제공된다.

title_en: Emergency sound recognition lighting type raised letters block and evacuation course guidance method using the same
title_ko: 비상 벨소리 인식 발광형 점자보도블럭 및 이를 이용한 대피 경로 안내방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An emergency ring tone recognizing luminous brallie sidewalk block and an escape route guide method using the same are provided to inform an emergency situation and to automatically guide an emergency route by emitting lights after sensing a warning tone. CONSTITUTION: An emergency ring tone recognizing luminous brallie sidewalk block comprises a lighting-emitting unit(110), a protrusion, a sensor(130), a memory unit(140), a controller(150), and a power supply unit(160). The lighting-emitting unit is composed of LEDs(111). The protrusion, made of a transparent material, provides a brallie pattern on the upper side of the brallie sidewalk block and passes the light of the lighting-emitting unit to outside. The sensor senses ambient sounds. The memory unit stores specific sound wave information about an emergency ring tone. The controller determines the matching between sound wave information about ambient sound and the specific sound wave information and generates a lighting signal in case of matching in order to turn the lighting-emitting unit on. The power supply unit is connected to an external power supply.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 비상 벨소리 인식 발광형 점자보도블럭 및 이를 이용한 대피 경로 안내방법에 관한 것으로, 보다 구체적으로는 화재 등의 위급상황 시 비상 벨이 울리면 이를 감지하고 자동으로 발광하여 시야 확보가 어려운 공간에서 대피 경로를 안내할 수 있는 비상 벨소리 인식 발광형 점자보도블럭 및 이를 이용한 대피 경로 안내방법에 관한 것이다. 
따라서, 본 발명은 화재 등의 위급상황 시 별도의 조작 없이도 비상벨이 울리면 그 즉시 발광부가 점등될 수 있다. 
또한, 점자보도블럭 간의 통신을 통해 넓은 공간에 복수 개가 분포/설치된 비상 벨소리 인식 발광형 점자보도블럭 중 어느 하나라도 비상 벨 울림소리를 감지하면 대피 경로를 따라 설치된 모든 발광형 점자보도블럭이 동시에 발광하여 대피 경로를 안내할 수 있다. 
즉, 어두운 지하 내지 실내 공간에서 화재 등의 위급상황 시 조명 역할은 물론 비상구 내지 출구로 향하는 대피 경로를 표시하여 대피자들이 어두운 공간에서 헤매지 않고 효과적으로 대피할 수 있다.

title_en: Disaster victim evacuation management system using GPU (Global Processing Unit) technology and automobile GPS (Global Positioning System) navigation system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster victim evacuation management system using a GPU (Global Processing Unit) technology and an automobile GPS (Global Positioning System) navigation system, in particular a disaster victim evacuation management system for marine storm surge disasters. The system mainly consists of a central control platform, databases and an automobile GPS navigation system, wherein the central control platform comprises a monitoring system and a data processing module, the monitoring system is used for displaying road traffic information and the position information of disaster rescue vehicles and sending vehicle driving command information, and the data processing module utilizes the databases and a GPU to calculate and select optimal evacuation paths; one database is used for storing a storm surge disaster risk map, and one database is used for storing an electronic map; and the automobile GPS navigation system is used for accurately locating disaster rescue vehicles and commanding the disaster rescue vehicles in real time. The system is mainly used for the evacuation management of disaster victims. The driving routines of the disaster rescue vehicles from a disaster site to settling places are dynamically monitored and commanded according to the real-time traffic condition of roads during storm surge disasters so as to enable the disaster victims to be quickly and safely evacuated to all settling places.

title_en: Navigation system with emergency evacuation mode
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a "navigation system with emergency evacuation mode" that informs a driver of information on the position of a vehicle etc., when a rescue worker etc., moves the vehicle to another place after the driver takes refuge in emergency without locking the doors with a vehicle key inserted in case of occurrence of a nearby large-scale disaster during driving of the vehicle.SOLUTION: In the state in which the driver takes refuge without locking the doors with the key inserted after operation in emergency refuge mode is started automatically or manually on detecting the large disaster occurring in the vicinity by receiving disaster information, the current position and movement track of the vehicle are transmitted to a previously registered mobile phone on detecting the engine being started thereafter. In this case, damage information on the vehicle by an impact sensor, the remaining amount of fuel, and further an image of an in-cabin imaging camera when the camera is mounted may be transmitted.

title_en: Tsunami evacuation navigation system, method for the same and program
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide meticulous evacuation directions using detailed digital elevation data by obtaining and analyzing necessary information for each evacuee during a period between an occurrence of an earthquake and an arrival of a tsunami.SOLUTION: A tsunami evacuation navigation system, which presents a method for evacuating from a tsunami, comprises: user information acquisition means which acquires at least a current position of a user who needs to evacuate; tsunami information acquisition means which acquires tsunami information relevant to a height and an arrival time of an incoming tsunami; map elevation data acquisition means which acquires map data showing a map of an area around the user as well as elevation data of points on the map; determination means which, using the tsunami information, the map elevation data as well as position information, determines an evacuation place and an evacuation route; and presentation means which presents the determined evacuation place as well as the evacuation route.

title_en: Route guidance display system
abstract_en: In hospitals, enterprises, and special venues of various types, etc., it is desirable to put into effect a route guidance display system which has high visibility and can easily be set up. The route guidance display system of the present invention comprises: a destination input device for inputting the destination of a visitor visiting the facility; a guidance display device for guiding the visitor; an abnormality detection device installed in a predetermined location of the facility; and a control device for controlling emission of light by the guidance display device. The guidance display device comprises a plurality of light-emitting elements that are arranged in alignment, and is installed in a predetermined location of the facility. Guidance is displayed to the visitor by means of the lit location of the plurality of light-emitting elements being changed in accordance with control performed by the control device to visually create a flow of light. Under normal conditions, the control device can display the destination to the visitor by performing guidance display on a predetermined guidance display device. Under abnormal conditions, the control device discontinues guidance display even if guidance display was being performed under normal conditions, determines an evacuation route in accordance with the installation location of the abnormality detection device, etc. that has detected an abnormality, and displays the evacuation route on the guidance display device.

title_en: Rescue support system, rescue request device, portable terminal, navigation device, rescue support method, and rescue support program
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a recue support system for grasping information about a person in need of rescue and providing the information to victims being evacuated so as to support a victim capable of rescue in working as a rescuer and reduce the number of casualties in an entire disaster area.SOLUTION: There is provided a rescue support system that comprises: first acquisition means which acquires a rescue request signal and current location information of a person in need of rescue; second acquisition means which acquires current location information of an evacuee who is to be evacuated; determination means which determines the evacuee's evacuation site and evacuation route; first presentation means which presents the determined evacuation site and evacuation route to the evacuee; and second presentation means which presents information about the person in need of rescue on the evacuation route to the evacuee.

title_en: Evacuation map display device and evacuation map display program
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To allow a user to quickly evacuate by supporting selection of detours according to the disaster situation.SOLUTION: An evacuation map display device 4 comprises: position measurement means 70 for periodically measuring the current position of the evacuation map display device 4; registration means 40 for receiving road information on road closures or disaster information so as to register them in storage means 10 and 20, respectively; determination means 40 for determining whether or not there is a place closed to traffic by comparing the road information or disaster information registered in the storage means 10 and 20 with the current time; generating means 40 for obtaining map information including the current position and closed places from map information storage means 30 when there is any closed place, and then generating an evacuation map in which the current position and the closed places are set on the map information; and display means 50 for displaying the evacuation map.

title_en: Terminal and exit course guide system using that terminal and method thereof
title_ko: 대피 경로 안내 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An evacuation route guiding system and method are provided to inform people of the safest evacuation route at a current position when there is a fire or an emergency situation. CONSTITUTION: An evacuation route guiding system comprises a storing unit(110), a first controller(120), and a communications unit(130). The storing unit stores the location of a sensor unit, the location of a terminal, the type of the terminal, and route information. The communications unit transmits and receives information between the terminal and the sensor unit. The first controller creates information for guiding an evacuation route at the current position in reference to the information of the storing unit when a fire sensing signal is received from the sensor unit through the communications unit. The first controller transmits the information for guiding the evacuation route to each terminal.
abstract_ko: 대피경로 안내 시스템이 개시된다. 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 대피경로안내시스템은 센서부의 위치, 상기 단말기의 위치, 상기 단말기의 종류 및 통로 정보를 저장하는 저장부; 상기 단말기 및 센서부와 정보를 송수신하기 위한 통신부; 상기 통신부를 통해 상기 센서부로부터 화재감지신호가 수신되면, 상기 저장부를 참조하여 상기 단말기의 위치에서 외부로 대피하는 경로를 안내하기 위한 정보를 생성하여 상기 각 단말기로 송신하는 제1 제어부를 포함한다.

title_en: Coal mine underground worker navigation system based on low power consumption local area network protocol
abstract_en: The utility model provides a coal mine underground worker navigation system based on a low power consumption local area network protocol, belonging to a coal mine worker management system. The navigation system comprises an information collection system, a computer terminal and a handheld terminal system. The information collection system comprises an internal battery power supply, a roadway coordinate information module, a gas sensor, a temperature sensor, a wind speed sensor and a low power consumption local area network protocol wireless receiving-transmitting module. The internal battery power supply is respectively connected with the roadway coordinate information module, the gas sensor, the temperature sensor, the wind speed sensor and the low power consumption local area network protocol wireless receiving-transmitting module, and supplies power to the roadway coordinate information module, the gas sensor, the temperature sensor, the wind speed sensor and the low power consumption local area network protocol wireless receiving-transmitting module. Each sensor is electrically connected with the low power consumption local area network protocol wireless receiving-transmitting module; and the computer terminal is respectively connected with a wireless receiver and a power source. The coal mine underground worker navigation system provided by the utility model can be used for navigating workers in a mine coal well, thereby reducing difficulties in worker evacuation and hedge when an accident happens; and the system can carry out management and accident hedge of the on-duty workers in the mine coal well, so as to effectively manage the workers in the mine coal well.

title_en: Emergency and traffic alert system
abstract_en: Systems and methods are disclosed for providing event notification to navigational applications and devices. An event notification system determines whether to send application information to a navigation application or device based upon the proximity of the device to the event. In other embodiments, the event notification system sends all event information to the device and the device determines whether or not to display the information based upon the proximity of the event to the device. User interfaces for displaying event information to a user are also disclosed. Finally, system and methods are disclosed for providing disaster related information to service providers who, in turn, send the disaster information to users of personal navigation devices. For example, information provided may include evacuation routes, shelter locations, disaster recovery centers, hospitals, points of distribution, economic recovery locations, etc.

title_en: Laneway navigator
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a laneway navigator used in a mine. The navigator comprises electronic tags distributed in a laneway, and a handheld terminal. The handheld terminal comprises a power supply, a location identifier, a display device, a memory, and a controller. The power supply is electrically connected with the location identifier, the display device and the controller. The controller is connected with the location identifier, the display device and the memory. The location identifier mainly includes an RFID card reader, and radio frequency identification is realized between the RFID card reader and the electronic tags. The laneway navigator has advantages of low cost, good real-time performance, and easy implementation. Moreover, a built-in expert knowledge database is provided, escape routes of all kinds of mine disasters are comprised, and the escape routes are played in an animation manner, so escape route navigation is realized and security of underground operation is improved.

title_en: Navigation device, guidance method, guidance program, and disaster prevention system
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a disaster prevention system and a device which minimize human damage in natural disaster including a tsunami, with a relatively small budget.SOLUTION: A navigation device comprises: location detection means for detecting a current location; storage means for storing evacuation information in which pieces of information concerning evacuation places in emergency are compiled; reception means for receiving emergency information; calculation means for performing first calculation processing for obtaining the optimum evacuation place among a plurality of evacuation places included in the evacuation information based on the emergency information and the current location; and display means for displaying the obtained optimum evacuation place. A disaster prevention system comprises the navigation device and a disaster information management center for generating the emergency information about disaster to transmit the emergency information to the navigation device. With the disaster prevention system, a user of the navigation device can take an unperturbed evacuation action in occurrence of disaster.

title_en: Mine well navigation life-saving system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a mine navigation life-saving system. The system comprises a main engine which is located on the well, wherein the main engine comprises a first wireless transmitting and receiving part, a display part, a first input part, a first storage part and a first central processing unit (CPU); the first wireless transmitting and receiving part is installed in a tunnel; an electronic tag is also installed in the tunnel; an anti-explosion mobile phone comprises a second wireless transmitting and receiving part, a temperature sensor, an analog-to-digital conversion module, a gas sensor, a second storage part, a second CPU, a reader, an audio and video input device, an audio and video compression module, a second input part and an audio and video output device; and the reader and the electronic tag can perform radio frequency identification; the main engine and the anti-explosion mobile phone are connected through the first wireless transmitting and receiving part and the second wireless transmitting and receiving part. According to the system, problems of positioning of workers and navigation are solved, the gas density and the underground ambient temperature can be detected, the underground condition can be transmitted to the aboveground part, and prevention of mine disasters, tunnel navigation and sheltering and relief are guaranteed reliably.

title_en: Tsunami evacuation navigation system, method for the same and program
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide meticulous evacuation directions using elevation data by obtaining and analyzing necessary information for each evacuee during a period between an occurrence of an earthquake and an arrival of a tsunami.SOLUTION: A tsunami evacuation navigation system, which presents a method for evacuating from a tsunami, comprises: user information acquisition means which acquires a current position of a user who needs to evacuate; tsunami information acquisition means which acquires tsunami information relevant to an incoming tsunami; map elevation data acquisition means which acquires map elevation data showing a map of an area around the user as well as elevation data of points on the map; determination means which, using the tsunami information, the map elevation data and the current position, determines an evacuation place as well as an evacuation route and also determines a timing to get out of a vehicle to evacuate on foot as well as a walking route after getting out of the vehicle; and display means which displays a message urging a passenger inside the vehicle to get out of the vehicle and walk.

title_en: Navigation device and narrow street search method
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a "navigation device and narrow street search method" for searching for a narrow street on which a shelter and an oncoming vehicle are easily discovered, and it is comparatively easy to travel when a guide route including the narrow street is searched for.SOLUTION: A navigation device is provided with: a visual field goodness calculation part 11 which calculates a visual field goodness degree representing an un-obstructed view when a vehicle travels on the narrow street based on road data representing a road of the narrow street and house shape data representing buildings facing the narrow street when the narrow street is included in a route to be searched for; and a cost setting part 12 which sets costs to road data of the narrow street according to the calculated visual field goodness, so that a narrow street with a high visual field goodness degree is preferentially searched for by setting costs smaller than those of a narrow street with a low visual field goodness degree to the narrow street with the high visual field goodness degree.

title_en: Positioning and navigation system based on indoor illumination
abstract_en: The invention relates to a positioning and navigation system based on indoor illumination and belongs to the technical field of indoor positioning and navigation. The positioning and navigation system comprises a control computer, an emitting component, a receiving component and a plurality of portable devices, wherein the emitting component consists of an information loading circuit, an LED (Light Emitting Diode) driving circuit and an LED light source, and the receiving component is formed in a manner that a convex lens, a photoelectric receiver, a filter amplifying shaping circuit and a demodulation decoder are connected. The control computer sends accessorial service information and a control command to the emitting component, the receiving component decodes the accessorial service information together with ID (identity card) address information of an LED and sends the accessorial service information and the ID address information to the portable devices to be displayed, wherein the photoelectric receiver adopts a light path receiving scheme in which the convex lens and a photoelectric detection PD array are cooperated and is convenient for precisely determining geographic position of a user. The accessorial service information includes scene and border switching information, navigation map refreshing information and urgent evacuation information. According to the positioning and navigation system based on the indoor illumination, the deficiencies that specific devices are required to be mounted and use regions are limited in the conventional systems are broken through.

title_en: System and method for remotely and intelligently recognizing road vehicle jam
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and method for intelligently recognizing a road vehicle jam condition in real time. The system is mainly composed of a vehicle-mounted global position system (GPS) positioner, a vehicle location information acquiring transmitter, a wireless mobile communication network, a central processing computer, a road section geographical position coordinate data base, an urban electronic traffic map and information processing management software. Jam information obtained by means the system and method can be used for a GPS, and when the vehicle jam occurs on a preset navigation route, the GPS timely and automatically changes the navigation route, guides vehicles to an unobstructed route, automatically shunts the vehicles and prevents the vehicles from being unobstructed. A traffic management department can timely know and master the vehicle running situation through the system and method so as to timely take a traffic evacuation strategy.

title_en: Alarm system of steering gear room for vessels
title_ko: 선박 조타실의 경보 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An alarm system for a steering gear room is provided to send out the state of emergency and location by operating the NUC(Not Under Command) light and DGPS(Digital Global Positioning System). CONSTITUTION: An NUC control panel(100) controls the NUC which is a light displayed by a vessel unable to maneuver. A navigation light control panel(200) controls the navigation light of a vessel displaying the orientation of the vessel at night. A relay board(210) for a steering gear room is included in the navigation light control panel, and relays a signal. An uninterrupted power supply(110) supplies accumulated 220V power to the NUC control panel when the 220V common power supply from a generator in a vessel is interrupted. A lighting junction box(300) reduces loss and noise of the signal transmitted from the NUC control panel, and is used for organizing wiring. The lighting junction box receives a signal from the NUC control panel by way of the relay board, and transmits the received signal. An NUC light(400) is turned on by receiving a signal from the lighting junction box.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 선박 조타실의 경보 시스템에 관한 것이다.  
본 발명의 목적은 해상에서 선박이 운항 중 해적이 침입하였을 경우 선원들이 성채(Citadel) 구역인 조타실(Steering Gear Room)로 대피하기 전 발전기(Generator)를 오프하여 배의 전원을 차단하고, 성채 구역에서 문을 잠그고 무정전 전원장치(UPS;uninterrupted power supply)를 사용하여 NUC(Not Under Command) 라이트 및 DGPS(Digital Global Positioning System)를 작동시킴으로써 외부에 위험 상태 및 위치를 알릴 수 있는 선박 조타실의 경보 시스템을 제공하는데 그 목적이 있다.  
상기 목적을 달성하기 위한 본 발명은 시스템은 해적들과 같은 해상 강도들이 선박에 침입했을 때 강도들로 하여금 선박을 조종하지 못하게 하고 선박의 비상상황을 외부로 알리기 위한 선박 조타실의 경보 시스템으로서, 운전이 자유롭지 못한 선박이 표시하는 등화인 운전 부자유 등화(NUC)를 제어하는 NUC 제어 패널(Not Under Command Control Panel); 밤에 항해하는 배가 진행 방향을 나타내기 위하여 켜는 등으로서 마스트등, 현등(舷燈), 선미등 따위의 선박의 항해등을 제어하는 항해등 제어 패널(Navigation Light Control Pannel); 상기 항해등 제어 패널에 포함되며 신호를 중계하는 조타실용의 릴레이보드; 선내의 발전기로부터 공급되는 220V 상용전원이 차단된 비상의 경우 축적된 220V의 전력을 상기 NUC 패널에 공급하는 무정전 전원공급장치(Uninterrupted Power Supply); 상기 NUC 제어 패널 상의 표시용의 LED를 온시키기 위한 DC 24V 전원을 NUC 제어 패널로 공급하는 DC 24V 전원; 상기 NUC 제어 패널로부터 공급되는 신호의 손실 및 잡음과 같은 노이즈를 줄여주고 또한 배선을 정리하는데 사용되며, 상기 NUC 제어 패널로부터 상기 릴레이보드를 거쳐 신호를 수신하고 상기 수신된 신호를 전송하는 라이팅 정션 박스; 상기 라이팅 정션 박스로부터 신호를 수신하여 온되는 NUC 라이트; 및 상기 무정전 전원공급장치로부터 전원을 공급받아 선박 외부로 선박의 위치정보를 제공하는 DGPS를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 선박 조타실의 경보 시스템을 제시한다.

title_en: Method for finding optimal traffic route under disastrous environments
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for finding an optimal traffic route under disastrous environments. The method includes: establishing a road traffic network topological graph taking cities as nodes and roads connecting the cities as arcs according to the graph theory and actual traffic geographic information, wherein the actual traffic geographic information includes length, degree of reliability and capability of intercity roads; when a certain area in the road traffic network topological graph is in a disaster, calculating disaster situation of each road in the road traffic network topological graph according to area and strength of the disaster, and updating the length, the degree of reliability and the capacity of the roads according the disaster situations; utilizing the network algorithm to extract m feasible routes from a node O to a target node D from the disaster area; and choosing the optimal route from the m routes according to the updated length, degree of reliability and capacity of the roads. By adopting the method, an effective auxiliary decision-making basis can be provided for evacuation guiding and rescue directing under the disastrous environments.

title_en: Forest fire monitoring and emergency command system based unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: A forest fire monitoring and emergency command system based an unmanned aerial vehicle is compose of the unmanned aerial vehicle, a ground station and a command center. Adopted as a data collection tool, the unmanned aerial vehicle, carrying with aerial photography equipment, satellite navigation and positioning equipment, inertial measurement equipment and the like, performs itinerating monitoring on monitoring areas; the ground station sends operation and control instructions to the unmanned aerial vehicle and receives data returned by the unmanned aerial vehicle in a real-time manner, and forwards the data to the command center; the command center processes and identifies aerial photography data to obtain potential fire points and ignited fire points, performs spread simulation and situation analysis, issues information such as fire early warning signals, fire dynamic situation and disaster situation statistical results, performs visualized analysis on personnel evacuation paths, and formulates fire fighting and rescue schemes as well as personnel and material scheduling strategies. The forest fire monitoring and emergency command system based the unmanned aerial vehicle is advantageous in high processing efficiency, low cost and the like.

title_en: Intelligent building fire alarm personnel evacuation dynamic route indicating system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent building fire alarm personnel evacuation dynamic route indicating system. The system comprises a control unit and a work unit. The work unit is used for collecting temperature information, smoke information and opening-and-closing state information of a safety door through a sensor module, sending the collected information to the control unit and providing indicating information on an indicating board according to command information of the control unit or providing voice indicating information in a voiced mode. The control unit is used for receiving the information collected by the sensor from the work unit, judging whether a fire disaster happens, computing escape routes again if the fire disaster happens and enabling the work unit to indicate on the indicating board according to the escape routes which are obtained by recomputation.

title_en: Evacuation display pole as "visible guide post" and evacuation route guidance system
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To protect people's lives when evacuating to safer places upon occurrence of an earth quake particularly in the nighttime or in power failure.SOLUTION: A topmost portion of a pole main body 1 is provided with solar battery module power generation means 2 and wind power generation means 3. Further, the lower portion of the interior of the main body is provided with a battery which stores power generated by the generation means. The pole main body 1 is formed with a transparent display part 5 and a support part 6. Further, the transparent display part 5 is provided with an upper display part 10 and a lower display part 11 in a divided manner. The upper display part 10 is provided in such a manner to be displayed with blinking of evacuation illumination (basic color is red-based and the like), and the lower display part 11 is provided in such a manner to be displayed with blinking of information illumination (basic color is blue-based and the like). This lower display part 11 allows people to confirm, as information, an evacuation place name display 16, a direction arrow display 15, and a display such as an address, a direction, and those in a foreign language. Further, the interior of the transparent display part 5 is provided with a support pipe made of a material such as metal or resin system.

title_en: Method for providing route guide using augmented reality and mobile terminal using this method
title_ko: 증강현실을 이용한 경로 안내 방법 및 이를 이용하는 이동 단말기
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An augmented reality-using path guiding method and a mobile device using the same are provided to effectively evacuate a user during an emergency such as a natural disaster. CONSTITUTION: A wireless communication unit (110) identifies the location of a mobile device. The wireless communication unit obtains necessary information to escape from an emergency. A control unit (180) launches an emergency evacuation application. The control unit generates an AR (Augmented Reality) content including the necessary information to escape from an emergency regarding the mobile device's current location. A display unit (150) displays the AR contents in a camera view mode. [Reference numerals] (110) Wireless communication unit; (111) Broadcast reception unit; (112) Telecommunication module; (113) Wireless internet module; (114) Short-distance communication module; (115) Location information module; (120) A/V input unit; (121) Camera; (122) Mic; (130) User input unit; (140) Sensing unit; (150) Output unit; (151) Display unit; (152) Sound output unit; (153) Alarm unit; (154) Haptic module; (160) Memory; (170) Interface unit; (180) Control unit; (181) Multimedia module; (190) Power supply
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 증강현실을 이용한 경로 안내 방법 및 이동 단말기에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명은 비상탈출 어플리케이션을 실행하는 단계, 단말기가 위치하는 지역을 확인하는 단계, 상기 확인된 지역에 대한 비상탈출 경로정보가 존재하는지 판단하는 단계, 상기 비상탈출 경로정보를 포함하여 증강현실(AR: Augmented reality)콘텐츠를 생성하는 단계, 상기 생성된 증강현실 콘텐츠를 카메라뷰 모드에서 디스플레이하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: Fire disaster escaping navigational system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of fire disaster escaping navigational system.Current method is mainly for the evacuation of crowd, not enough to the consideration of individuality, easily causes these evitable injures and deaths when fire.In the present invention, locating infrastructure is made up of multiple location navigation unit, location navigation cell distribution people must through passage and corner.Described navigation, protection terminal by locating, navigation module and protection module form, location, navigation module comprise voice module, radio-frequency module, MCU, RSS reading unit.Protection module comprises crash helmet, anti-poison respirator, safety goggles, and crash helmet is not injured by a crashing object by falling object in order to protect personnel, and protective mask and safety goggles are then used for making personnel from the injury of smog.Terminal provided by the invention can protect personnel to a certain extent not by the damage of smog, falling object; Terminal provides dynamic positioning service, enables personnel still can find fire exit when being unfamiliar with landform and escape smoothly.

title_en: Indoor emergency path navigation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an indoor emergency path navigation method. The indoor emergency path navigation method comprises the steps of: deploying detecting nodes in an indoor scene corridor, deploying guide nodes at an intersection and an exit part; acquiring indoor scene nodes and path information through the detecting nodes and the guide nodes; acquiring position information of a starting point of a person and a dangerous point through the detecting nodes; building a path network diagram and storing by adopting a adjacency list data structure; determining a transferring target point of the person; limiting a search area within a rectangular area which takes the connecting line of the starting point and the target point as a diagonal to calculate the shortest path; expanding the search area to the minimum ellipse which comprises the rectangular area and takes the starting point and the target point as the two focal points and calculating the shortest path in the minimum ellipse; and according to the results of calculation, obtaining the shortest path. The indoor emergency path navigation method can be used for meeting the needs of emergency evacuation and navigation in emergency in public indoor spaces with large scales, complex spatial distribution and various types of people, such as hospitals, and is capable of reducing the time-space complexity, and improving the efficiency.

title_en: Apparatus and method for preventing collision between vessels
abstract_en: Disclosed herein are an apparatus and method for preventing a collision between vessels. The apparatus includes a position information processing unit, an expected collision route calculation unit, an escape route calculation unit, and a control unit. The position information processing unit collects information about the position of a reference vessel using a mobile terminal and receives information about a counterpart vessel from a user. The expected collision route calculation unit calculates an expected collision route based on the information. The escape route calculation unit calculates escape routes if the possibility of a collision is above a set value. The control unit provides the escape routes, compares changes in actually measured positions of the vessels with the escape routes, and manages navigation on the results of the comparison between changes in the actually measured positions of the vessels and the escape routes.

title_en: Fire escape navigation system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a fire escape navigation system. The prior art focuses on the crowd evacuation and considers individual insufficiently, and avoidable casualties are easy to occur when a fire occurs. A positioning infrastructure of the fire escape navigation system is composed of a plurality of positioning navigation units. The positioning navigation units are distributed in passages and corners where people must pass through. A navigation and protection terminal is composed of a positioning navigation module and a protection module. The positioning navigation module comprises a voice module, a radio frequency module, an MCU (microprogrammed control unit) and a RSS (real simple syndication) reading unit. The protection module comprises a safety helmet, an anti-poison respirator and a goggle. The safety helmet is used for protect people from injuring by falling objects, and the anti-poison respirator and the goggle are used for preventing people from injuring by smoke. By the aid of the terminal the fire escape navigation system, people can be protected from injuring from the smoke and the falling objects to some extent; the terminal provides dynamic positioning services, and accordingly people can find safe exits and escape successfully even though are unfamiliar with forms.

title_en: Navigation device
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a navigation device that enables emergency evacuation to be performed properly.SOLUTION: When obtaining hazard information from hazard information obtaining means 16, a control unit 8 causes evacuation behavior at a current position detected by position detection means 9 to be displayed on a display unit 7. Thus, for example, even when a current position is in a hazardous area, display of the display unit 7 is confirmed to enable proper emergency evacuation at the current position.

title_en: Portable movement support device
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a portable movement support device using the augmented reality technology, for normally functioning as a pacemaker and a portable navigation system for the walking or the like, and when disaster or the like happens, functioning as a portable navigation system for evacuation guidance.SOLUTION: The portable movement support device composed of a portable terminal or an optical see-through HMD or the like includes: display means for displaying a guide such as an electronic pet or the like to lead a user, and additionally a lead for linking the user and the guide, superposing them on real space; user movement speed detection means; guide movement speed determination means for determining assumed movement speed of the guide in real space, according to the heart rate or the like of the user; and changing means for changing the size or a position for displaying the guide. The device may further include means for determining the amount of bending of the lead. The user can intuitively recognize and adjust his/her own movement speed, by moving so as to follow the guide.

title_en: Emergency path navigating system and method thereof
title_ko: 비상경로 안내 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The objective of the present invention is to provide a system and a method thereof which grasp the location of a terminal in an indoor structure where it is impossible to use GPS and generate emergency path information according to the location of the terminal and real-time field situation information and enable a user to be evacuated to a safe shelter by informing the terminal of the emergency path information. For the objective, an emergency path navigating system during emergency situation includes: a tag storing tag information; a number of relay units performing network access as having inherent identification information; a terminal which receives the tag information by tagging with the tag, and generates an emergency message including the tag information or the inherent identification information of the relay unit by using the inherent identification information of the relay unit and then transmits the emergency message to a server; and the server which receives the emergency message transmitted from the terminal and generates emergency path information corresponding to the emergency message and then transmits the emergency path information to the terminal. [Reference numerals] (200) Terminal;(300) Relay unit;(400) Server;(500) Emergency center
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 GPS 를 이용하지 못하는 실내 구조에서 단말의 위치를 파악하고 단말의 위치와 실시간 현장상황정보에 따른 비상경로정보를 생성하고 이를 단말로 알려주어 안전한 대피장소로 대피할 수 있게 하는 시스템 및 그 방법을 제공하는 것이 목적이다. 이를 위해서, 태그정보를 저장하고 있는 태그:와 고유식별정보를 가지며 네트워크 접속을 수행하는 다수의 중계장치;와 상기 태그와 태깅하여 상기 태그정보를 수신하고 상기 중계장치의 고유식별정보를 이용하여 상기 태그정보 또는 상기 중계장치의 고유식별정보가 포함된 응급메시지를 생성하고 이를 서버로 전송하고 그 결과를 수신하여 디스플레이하는 단말; 및 상기 단말로부터 전송되는 응급메시지를 수신하고 응급메시지에 해당하는 비상경로정보를 생성하여 상기 단말로 전송하는 서버;를 포함하는 응급 상황시 비상경로 안내 시스템이 제공된다.

title_en: inertial navigation technology simulation test system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to inertial navigation technology simulation test system, comprise and carry car, shelter, aim at analogue means, onboard measure system, GPS repeater system and electric power system, described shelter comprises air-conditioning equipment, cabinet for vehicle, worktable and seat, described aligning analogue means comprises turntable and rotating platform control system, described onboard measure system comprises industrial computer, PCI Mezzanine Card, apparatus for monitoring power supply and testing system software program, described testing system software program is based on LabVIEW platform, utilize carry car advancing and the rotation of vehicle-mounted rotating table provides real running environment for inertial navigation to be measured, equipment under test is arranged on vehicle-mounted rotating table, the emulation of ground moving and space flight is realized by the motion of carrying car, by the accurate control of vehicle-mounted three-axle table, realize accurately Attitude Simulation, electric power system provides uninterrupted power supply for experimental facilities in parking, startup, driving conditions, test benchmark is obtained by test control system, pumping signal is provided, Real-time Collection analyzes navigation data, provides test result.

title_en: Classroom management system based on Internet of Things
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a classroom management system based on thing networking comprises host computer, zigBee controller and classroom node. The upper computer is connected with the ZigBee controller through a serial port; the ZigBee coordinator is connected with the classroom nodes through no signal.
