title_en: Wireless Intelligence augmented reality fire control monitored control system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wireless Intelligence augmented reality fire control monitored control system, the purpose provides that a network transmission stable performance is reliable, system capacity variable, information acquisition directly quick's control fire extinguishing system, including main basic unit's network and the main last layer network of forming by the wireless sensor node of forming by trunk gateway, public network basic station and server, the wireless sensor node comprises sensor and linkage fire -fighting equipment, can carry out remote radio communication between each wireless sensor node and form from organizing the teletransmission network, still include the smart mobile phone that carries out short distance radio communication with the wireless sensor node, virtual superimpose that the smart mobile phone will acquire through the augmented reality module makes various information ( navigation information, monitoring point state information, cartographic information ) demonstration more directly perceived to the real control scene images in. The utility model discloses can realize parameter setting, personnel location, escape route navigation, patrol and examine check card, coordinated control carries out the fire control multiple functions such as calamity of going out.

title_en: Indoor escape navigation system and method
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of indoor escape air navigation aid, it is applied in electronic equipment, the method includes: the multiple information generator communication connection around Connection Step, with electronic equipment, and receives positional information and the plane graph of affiliated floor of this information generator from each information generator；Positioning step, when receiving the positional information of alarm of fire and fire, determines electronic equipment position between floors according to the intensity of the positional information of each information generator and electronic equipment with the communication connection of each information generator；Calculation procedure, calculates optimal escape route according to the plane graph of electronic equipment position, the position of fire and residing floor between floors；And navigation step, guide user to flee from building in the way of default.Present invention also offers a kind of indoor escape navigation system.
assignees: FUTAIHUA IND (SHENZHEN) CO LTD;HON HAI PREC IND CO LTD

title_en: Navigation based safety equipment information of inside tunnel providing apparatus
title_ko: 내비게이션 기반의 터널 안 안전설비정보 제공장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to navigation-based tunnel safety equipment information providing device. According to the present invention, the navigation-based tunnel safety equipment information providing device is to provide safety equipment information on safety equipment provided inside a tunnel to a passenger of a vehicle passing through the tunnel to quickly cope with safety accidents occurring in the tunnel, and is configured to comprise: a tunnel location information storage medium; a safety equipment information storage medium; a safety equipment information transmitting means; and a user terminal.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 내비게이션 기반의 터널 안 안전설비정보 제공장치에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 차량이 특정 터널의 내부로 진입할 때 해당 차량 내에 존재하는 내비게이션 기능을 가진 사용자 단말기를 통해 차량의 승차자에게 터널에 구비된 각종 안전설비에 대한 정보를 차량의 위치정보를 기준으로 하여 제공함으로써 터널의 내부에서 발생하는 크고 작은 안전사고로부터 신속한 대처 및 대피를 가능하게 하는 내비게이션 기반의 터널 안 안전설비정보 제공장치에 관한 것이다.   
본 발명에 따르면, 터널의 내부에 마련된 안전설비에 관한 안전설비정보를 상기 터널을 통과하는 차량의 승차자에게 제공하기 위한 것으로, 상기 터널의 진입지점과 진출지점을 한 쌍으로 하는 상기 터널의 위치정보가 저장되는 터널위치정보 저장매체; 상기 터널에 대한 상기 안전설비정보가 저장되는 안전설비정보 저장매체; 상기 터널의 내부에 설치되고 상기 터널의 진입지점과 진출지점을 포함하는 통신반경 내에서 무선네트워크를 구축하여 상기 안전설비정보 저장매체에 저장된 상기 안전설비정보를 무선으로 송출하는 안전설비정보 송출수단; 및 상기 차량의 내부에 위치되어 내비게이션 기능을 수행하는 것으로 상기 차량의 위치정보가 상기 진입지점을 진입한 이후부터 상기 진출지점을 진출하기 이전까지 상기 안전설비정보 송출수단과 무선 통신하면서 상기 안전설비정보를 수신받아 상기 안전설비정보 송출수단을 통해 감지되는 상기 터널 내부에서의 상기 차량의 위치정보를 기준으로 출력하여 상기 차량의 승차자에게 제공하는 사용자 단말기;를 포함하여 구성되는 것을 특징으로 하는 내비게이션 기반의 터널 안 안전설비정보 제공장치를 기술적 요지로 한다.

title_en: Apparatus for alerting fire alarm
title_ko: 화재 경보 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to, as a fire alarm system, an apparatus for transmitting a fire alarm to a user and an emergency rescue center when a fire breaks out in a residence space. The fire alarm system according to an embodiment of the present invention may include: a fire detector which generates a fire detection value showing a fire state value by detecting a fire as installed in each residence space, and transmits a fire detected amount and a photographing command message together to a camera, when the fire detected amount exceeds an established threshold value; the camera which is installed in every residence space while forming a pair with the fire detector, and photographs a surrounding image and then transmits the photographed surrounding image and the fire detected amount together to a fire alarm server when the photographing command message is received from the fire detector; and the fire alarm server which is connected to the camera installed in each residence space through wired or wireless communication, and transmits the surrounding image photographed due to fire detection and position information of the living space where the fire is detected, to a fire prevention center server and a user terminal, and performs escape route guidance and fire fighting in accordance with the received fire detected amount.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재 경보 장치로서, 각 거주 공간에 화재 발생시에 긴급 구조 센터와 사용자에게 화재 경보를 전송하는 장치에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 실시 형태는, 각 거주 공간마다 설치되어 화재를 감지하여 화재 상태값을 나타내는 화재 감지값을 생성하며, 상기 화재 감지량이 설정된 임계치를 초과한 경우 촬영 명령 메시지와 함께 화재 감지량을 카메라에 송신하는 화재 감지기; 화재 감지기와 쌍을 이루어 거주 공간마다 설치되며, 상기 화재 감지기로부터 상기 촬영 명령 메시지를 수신하면 주변 영상을 촬영하여 화재 감지량과 함께 화재 경보 서버로 전송하는 카메라; 및 각 거주 공간에 설치된 카메라와 유선 또는 무선 통신하여 연결되어, 화재 감지로 인해 촬영되는 주변 영상 및 화재 감지된 거주 공간의 위치 정보를 화재 방재 센터 서버 및 사용자 단말기에 전송하며, 수신한 화재 감지량에 따른 대피 경로 안내 및 화재 진화를 수행하는 화재 경보 서버;를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Evacuation path guidance system
title_ko: 대피 경로 안내 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an evacuation path guidance system. The evacuation path guidance system includes: at least a guidance terminal outputting a voice output comment guiding an evacuation alarm by being installed on a wall of a building or lighting an LED in a direction of guiding the evacuation path; a server receiving and storing a blueprint of the building and generating the evacuation path in accordance with the stored blueprint of the building, wherein the server also individually designates and stores the direction of guiding the evacuation path and the voice output comment to be output in the at least a guidance terminal in accordance with the generated evacuation path; and a control terminal outputting an evacuation situation by mapping the evacuation path generated in accordance with the blueprint of the building by the server on the blueprint of the building and controlling the direction of guiding the evacuation path and the voice output comment to be output from the at least a guidance terminal. Therefore, the evacuation guidance system outputs the voice comment and the evacuation direction in accordance with the evacuation path predetermined in accordance with an area in which fire breaks out, so the evacuation guidance system can smoothly guide the evacuation path. The evacuation guidance system can guide the evacuation path corrected in accordance with the evacuation path predetermined in a fire situation and can actively guide the evacuation path.
abstract_ko: 본발명은 대피 경로 안내 시스템에 관한 것으로, 건물의 벽에 설치되어 대피 경보를 안내하는 음성출력 멘트를 출력하거나 대피 경로를 안내하는 방향을 LED로 점등하는 적어도 하나의 안내 단말, 상기 건물의 설계 도면을 전달받아 저장하고 있고, 저장된 상기 건물의 설계 도면에 따라 대피 경로를 생성하며, 생성된 상기 대피 경로에 따라 상기 적어도 하나의 안내 단말에서 출력할 음성출력 멘트와 대피 경로를 안내할 방향을 각각 지정하여 저장하는 서버, 그리고 상기 서버가 상기 건물의 설계 도면에 따라 생성한 상기 대피 경로를 상기 건물의 설계 도면에 매핑하여 대피 상황을 출력하고, 상기 적어도 하나의 안내 단말에서 출력할 음성출력 멘트와 대피 경로를 안내할 방향을 제어하는 관제 및 제어 단말을 포함한다. 이로 인해, 화재 발생 시 화재가 발생한 구역에 대응하여 설정된 대피 경로에 따라 음성멘트와 대피방향을 출력하므로, 원활한 대피 경로 안내가 가능하고, 변화하는 화재 상황에서도 설정된 대피 경로에 따라 수정된 대피 경로 안내가 가능하여 적응적인 대피 경로 안내가 가능하다는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Terminal and Exit course guide system using that terminal and method thereof
title_ko: 실내 대피경로 안내 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and a method for guiding to an indoor evacuation route The system includes: a map server which receives map information, stores the same in a database, and generates a disaster evacuation graph based on the map information; a route server which receives the disaster evacuation graph from the map server and generates an evacuation route based on position information of a user terminal; and the user terminal which transmits, to the route server, position-related information received through communications with a beacon for position determination installed inside a building, receives the evacuation route generated by the route server, and displays the evacuation route on a screen. According to the present invention, the system partitions an arbitrary area around a beacon, which is installed in a building to determine a position, not displaying all space areas for rendering disaster evacuation graphs as peak points, reduces the graphs in scale by connecting the arbitrary area with edges, updates properties of the edges in the arbitrary area if the properties of the edges are changed according to change in position information of a user terminal. Thus, it is possible to reduce an operation time for route search. In addition, the evacuation route is calculated by using a graph wherein weights of the properties of each of the edges are updated, and it is possible to reduce an average evacuation time of people in a different space, or reconfigure a route for the people not to gather in a specific space. Accordingly, the system facilitates guidance to a more effective route in real time without an operation load for the router search.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 실내 대피경로 안내 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세하게는 지도정보를 수신하여 데이터베이스에 저장하고, 상기 지도정보를 기초로 하여 재난대피 그래프를 생성하는 맵서버와, 상기 맵서버에서 생성된 재난대피 그래프를 전송받고, 사용자 단말의 측위정보에 기초한 대피경로를 생성하는 경로서버와, 건물내 설치된 측위용 비컨과 통신을 통해 수신한 측위관련 정보를 상기 경로서버로 전송하며, 상기 경로서버에서 생성된 대피경로를 전송받아 화면으로 디스플레이되는 사용자 단말을 포함하여 제공된다. 
상기와 같은 본 발명에 따르면, 재난대피 그래프를 구성하기 위한 모든 공간영역을 정점으로 표현하지 않고, 건물내 설치된 측위용 비컨을 중심으로 하는 임의 영역을 구획하고, 임의 영역을 간선으로 연결하여 그래프의 규모를 축소시키고, 임의 영역내의 사용자 단말 위치정보 변화에 따라 간선 속성값이 변경될 경우 임의 영역내의 간선 속성값만 갱신되도록 하여, 경로탐색 연산시간을 줄일 수 있는 효과가 있다. 
또한, 각 간선마다 속성값 가중치가 갱신된 그래프를 이용하여 대피경로가 산출되도록 하여 서로 다른 공간내에 있는 사람들의 평균 대피시간을 줄이거나, 특정 공간으로 사람들이 많이 몰리지 않도록 경로를 재구성할 수 있어, 경로탐색 연산부하 없이 실시간으로 보다 효과적인 경로안내가 이루어지도록 하는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Moduled induction lights with Induction display system and using the same
title_ko: 대피 경로 유도등 및 이를 이용한 대피 경로 유도 시스템
abstract_en: An evacuation route guidance light comprises: an LED guidance module having a waterproof structure, and including a plurality of LED modules and a plurality of panels for diffusing light of the LED modules therein to guide people to an evacuation route in a building; a housing having an elastic panel on a back side and an open front side; and a cover frame having an open back side, and an internal space formed by combination of the open back side and the front side of the housing to receive the LED guidance module and prevent it from moving. Since the waterproof function of the LED guidance module prevents water intrusion, the LED guidance module may be safely used for a long time. In addition, when the LED guidance module is replaced, replacement of the LED module can be easily performed by checking whether a new LED guidance module provides guidance to a preset evacuation route in the building. Moreover, the LED guidance module provides an optimal evacuation route of the building, which is calculated by a control server, thereby rapidly providing the optimal evacuation route to users in the building in case of emergency.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예의 대피 경로 유도등은, 방수 구조를 갖도록 마련되고, 내부에 복수의 LED 모듈과 상기 LED 모듈의 빛이 확산되도록 하는 복수의 패널이 구비되어 시설물 내부의 대피 경로가 안내되도록 하는 LED 유도 모듈; 후면(後面)에 탄성 패널이 구비되고, 전면(前面)이 개방되도록 마련된 하우징; 및 후면(後面)이 개방되고, 상기 하우징의 전면과 상기 개방된 후면이 결합됨으로써 형성된 내부 공간에 상기 LED 유도 모듈이 수용되어, 상기 수용된 LED 유도 모듈의 유동이 방지되도록 하는 커버 프레임;을 포함한다. 이에 의해, LED 유도 모듈의 방수 기능에 의해 물이 침입하지 못하게 됨으로써, LED 유도 모듈을 안전하게 장기간 동안 사용할 수 있다. 그리고 LED 유도 모듈의 교체 시에, LED 유도 모듈이 기설정된 시설물의 대피 경로로 안내하고 있는지 여부를 확인함으로써, 용이하게 LED 유도 모듈을 교체할 수 있다. 또한, LED 유도 모듈이 관제 서버로부터 산출된 시설물의 최적의 대피 경로로 유도를 안내함으로써, 비상시에 시설물 내부의 사용자에게 신속히 최적의 대피 경로를 안내할 수 있다.

title_en: Auto quality measurement and safety solution providing device using ble beacon and method thereof
title_ko: Ble 비콘을 이용한 자동 품질 측정 및 안전 솔루션 제공 장치 및 이의 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus and method for automatic quality measurement and safety solution provision using BLE beacons, and more particularly to an apparatus and method for automatic quality measurement and safety solution provision using BLE beacons, which can remotely manage an elevator and a ship through installation of BLE beacons in the elevator and the ship, and which can provide a function for a maritime safety solution via a screen of a control terminal device when quality of a wireless network is measured, thereby providing guidance on an evacuation path in an emergency and a location of rescue equipment. According to an embodiment of the present invention, an apparatus for automatic quality measurement and safety solution provision using BLE beacons comprises: a control terminal device which automatically measures quality of a wireless network through scanning of BLE beacons and which provides a function for a safety solution via a display screen unit during the measurement of the quality; and a management server which stores and manages data on the measurement of the quality transmitted by the control terminal device. The apparatus and method for automatic quality measurement and safety solution provision using BLE beacons according to the present invention can remotely manage quality of a wireless network of an elevator and a ship through installation of the BLE beacons in the elevator and the ship, provide the function for a maritime safety solution via a screen of the control terminal device when the quality of the wireless network is measured, and operate a function for guidance on an emergency evacuation path based on a mobile phone and set slopes of the BLE beacons in an emergency, thereby providing an advantage of provision of convenience to a user.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 BLE 비콘을 이용한 자동 품질 측정 및 안전 솔루션 제공 장치 및 이의 방법에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 승강기 및 선박에 BLE 비콘을 설치하여 승강기 및 선박을 원격으로 관리할 수 있고, 무선망의 품질 측정시 제어 단말 장치의 화면에는 해상 안전 솔루션 기능을 제공하여 위급 상황시 비상 탈출 경로 안내 및 구난 장비 위치를 제공할 수 있는 BLE 비콘을 이용한 자동 품질 측정 및 안전 솔루션 제공 장치 및 이의 방법에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따르면, BLE 비콘을 스캔하여 자동으로 무선망의 품질 측정을 수행하고, 상기 품질 측정시 화면 표시부에 안전 솔루션 기능을 제공하는 제어 단말 장치 및 상기 제어 단말 장치로부터 전송되는 상기 품질 측정 데이터를 저장 및 관리하는 관리 서버를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 본 발명에 의한 BLE 비콘을 이용한 자동 품질 측정 및 안전 솔루션 제공 장치 및 이의 방법은 승강기 및 선박에 BLE 비콘을 설치하여 승강기 및 선박의 무선망의 품질을 원격으로 관리할 수 있고, 무선망의 품질 측정시 제어 단말 장치의 화면에는 해상 안전 솔루션 기능을 제공할 수 있으며, 위급 상황 발생시 휴대폰 및 BLE 비콘의 설정된 기울기에 따라 비상 탈출 경로 안내 기능이 동작하여 사용자에게 편의성을 제공할 수 있는 장점이 있다.

title_en: Geological disaster group monitoring and prevention method and platform for achieving method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a geological disaster group monitoring and prevention method and a platform for achieving the method. The method comprises the steps of acquiring position information of a vector map and a grid map of a disaster region where a public user is located when a geological disaster danger happens; acquiring and uploading data of the disaster region to a geological disaster server by the public user; pushing geological disaster danger information to the public user in a disaster region range by a mobile network after the information is reported by government or a geological disaster monitoring person, and taking a corresponding emergency plan; inquiring a route to the nearest evacuation site on a map when push information is received by the public user in the disaster region range, and performing real-time navigation; performing analysis and processing by the government or the geological disaster monitoring person according to data information reported by the public user, generating a disaster evaluation report according to the data information, reporting the disaster evaluation report to a central system of the geological disaster server, and inputting the disaster evaluation report in a database.

title_en: Indoor emergency navigation method, device and system based on TC-OFDM positioning technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses an indoor emergency navigation method, an indoor emergency navigation device and an indoor emergency navigation system based on a TC-OFDM positioning technology, and relates to the technical field of navigation. An escape route can be accurately planned for escape people when fire disaster occurs. The method comprises the steps: receiving an escape route request transmitted by terminal equipment, wherein the escape route request comprises terminal position information corresponding to the terminal equipment; acquiring different escape route information corresponding to the terminal position information; calculating route weighting values corresponding to different escape route information according to crowd position information, fire disaster parameter information and people fall-down mark information which are acquired from a preset database and correspond to different escape route information; determining peak information corresponding to the optimal escape route information according to the route weighting values and transmitting the peak information to the terminal equipment. The method, the device and the system are mainly applicable to emergency navigation.

title_en: Wireless smart augmented reality fire-fighting monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wireless smart augmented reality fire-fighting monitoring system, and aims at providing a fire-fighting monitoring system of which the network transmission performance is stable and reliable, the system capacity is variable and information acquisition is fast and visual. The system comprises a basic network which is mainly composed of wireless sensor nodes and an upper network which is mainly composed of a relay gateway, a public network base station and a server. The wireless sensor nodes are composed of sensors and linkage fire-fighting equipment. All the wireless sensor nodes can perform long-distance wireless communication to form a self-organizing remote network. The system also comprises a smart mobile phone which performs short-distance wireless communication with the wireless sensor nodes. The smart mobile phone superposes the acquired virtual information to a real monitoring scene image through an augmented reality module so that various types of information (navigation information, monitoring point state information and map information) is enabled to be more visually displayed. Multiple functions of parameter setting, personnel positioning, escape route navigation, inspection punching and linkage control for performing fire-fighting and disaster destroying can be realized by the wireless smart augmented reality fire-fighting monitoring system.

title_en: Evacuation route guiding system

abstract_ko: 재난 대피 경로 안내 시스템이 제공된다. 재난 위험 지역에 위치한 이용자를 재난 안전 지역으로 안내할 수 있는 재난 대피 경로 안내 시스템으로서, 재난 상황 정보를 포함하는 재난 정보와 기상 상황 정보를 포함하는 기상 정보를 수집하여 저장하는 저장부, 상기 저장부에 수집된 정보를 종합하여 대피 경로를 생성하는 제어부, 및 상기 제어부에 생성된 대피 경로를 상기 이용자에게 보여주는 표시부를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: The monitoring system of subway station evacuation guiding based on threedimensional model
abstract_en: The invention discloses the monitoring system of the subway station evacuation guiding based on threedimensional model, including indoor BIM three-dimensional simulations system, site monitoring system, monitor terminal and virtual display terminal；The virtual display terminal includes display module, locating module and electrical compass module, for showing the three-dimensional navigation information and obtaining location information.Pass through the visualization of 3 d model of locus in three-dimensional simulation system constructing subway station, user current location and fire location are added in visualization of 3 d model by the location information that is obtained according to virtual display terminal, the monitoring information of site monitoring system, and the emergency exit shape guidance information sent according to monitor terminal is into three-dimensional navigation information.The present invention for people provides it is a kind of visualize, the strong navigation system of presence, user can be given and fast and accurately safe escape guiding and monitored, be conducive to improving rescue and efficiency of escaping.

title_en: Evacuation system and method for evacuating trapped personnel
abstract_en: System and method for generating a dynamic route map for a person trapped in an enclosed space and for enabling quick evacuation of the person is disclosed. When a request for evacuation is made by the person, the evacuation system locates the person based on the RFID person identifier tag and localizes the location of the person with respect to plurality of RFID floor tags and plurality of self-identifying RFID reader antenna tags. Further, condition of the floor is assessed by comparing the RSSI readings of the plurality of RFID floor tags and the RSSI readings of the plurality of self-identifying RFID reader antenna tags and the environmental information with pre-defined baseline RSSI readings of the plurality of RFID floor tags, RSSI readings of the plurality of self-identifying RFID reader antenna tags and an environmental threshold. A dynamic floor map is generated by collecting the RSSI readings from the plurality of RFID floor tags, self-identifying RFID reader antenna tags. Subsequently, the condition of the rest of the floors is assessed by analyzing the environmental information from plurality of environmental sensors and assessing the working condition of RFID tags deployed at each floor. Finally, generating a dynamic route map such that emergency rescue operators can reach out to the trapped person in least amount of time.

title_en: A kind of indoor fire alarm evacuation method
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a kind of indoor fire alarm evacuation method, including：Receive the alarm trigger command that alarm node is sent.Wake command is sent to all alarm nodes so that All Alerts node is risen to server at once sends detection information in real time.The real time weight information of all interior wirings is obtained according to real-time detection information.Receive the real-time position information of mobile terminal.According to normality weight information and real time weight information, the real-time optimal evacuation route of generation real time position to any gateway, i.e., the normality weight and real time weight sum passed through when from real time position to any gateway interior wiring maximum in real time.According to the id information of mobile terminal, optimal evacuation route is sent in real time to mobile terminal.It can be seen that, it is not only using the evacuation route that provides of the present invention most short, is also safest, the local algorithm used compared to existing evacuation strategy, uses the algorithm of real-time path planning, can adapt to the condition of a fire complicated and changeable, practicality is stronger, can improve the efficiency of fire evacuation.

title_en: Emergency evacuation path guide system in building using by smart-phone and the control method thereof
title_ko: 스마트 기기를 이용한 건물내 피난경로 안내 시스템 및 그 제어방법
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 스마트 기기를 이용한 건물내 피난경로 안내 시스템 및 그 제어방법에 관한 것으로, 특정 건물의 실내 구성원들이 휴대하는 다수 대의 스마트 기기를 매개로 네트워크망을 구축한 후 해당 건물내 설치된 블루투스 리더기 및 RFID 능동태그의 RSSI 분석 기술을 기반으로 구성원들의 위치를 정확히 판단하여 빠른 탈출 및 대피 경로를 안내할 수 있도록 한 스마트 기기를 이용한 건물내 피난경로 안내 시스템 및 그 제어방법을 제공함에 그 목적이 있다. 
이를 위해, 본 발명에 따른 스마트 기기를 이용한 건물내 피난경로 안내 시스템은, 건물내 일정 지점에 고정 설치되는 다수 개의 블루투스 리더기 및 RFID 태그와; 건물내 구성원들이 각각 휴대하는 것으로, 상호 ad-hoc 방식 네트워크망이 구축된 상태에서, 소정 블루투스 리더기 및 RFID 태그와의 RSSI 신호를 순간적인 가속도 센서 값과 함께 네트워크망을 통해 서버 측으로 전송함과 아울러, 상기 서버로부터 수신되는 긴급상황에 대처하기 위한 안내정보를 출력시키는 스마트 기기 및; 상기 네트워크망과 연계되어, 소정 스마트 기기로부터 전송된 RSSI 신호 및 가속도 센서 값을 통해 구성원의 위치를 인식 및 분석한 후, 최적의 피난 위치 및 경로를 생성하여 구성원의 스마트 기기 측으로 전송하는 서버;를 포함하여 구성된다.

title_en: Bus evacuation path planning method based on reversible lane and intersection conflict elimination
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bus evacuation path planning method based on reversible lane and intersection conflict elimination, which specifically comprises the steps of obtaining road network information in an evacuation area range, dividing roads into evacuation main roads and evacuation branch roads, and constructing a node-arc network model of an evacuation area; based on the setting mode of the reversible lane, establishing a constraint condition for the public traffic flow to pass on the evacuation main road; eliminating the intersection conflict points of the public traffic flows in different directions at the road intersections, and establishing the conflict elimination constraint conditions of the public traffic flows at the intersections; establishing a bus evacuation route planning model based on reversible lane and intersection conflict elimination by taking the shortest total travel distance of all evacuated people as a target function; and (4) solving the model by selecting a genetic algorithm to obtain an optimal bus evacuation path planning scheme. The method of the invention can greatly reduce the delay of the public transport vehicles at the road sections and the intersections, shorten the round-trip evacuation cycle time of the public transport vehicles and improve the evacuation efficiency of the public transport vehicles.

title_en: A kind of safe emergency advance warning management system in scientific and technological park
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of safe emergency advance warning management system in scientific and technological park, including safe early warning terminal, mobile terminal, monitoring terminal, the safe early warning terminal is connected with the mobile terminal signal, and the safe early warning terminal is connected with the monitoring terminal signal；The monitoring terminal is distributed in each corner of scientific and technological park, it is impossible to safe dead angle be present, all personnel into garden are equipped with the mobile terminal.Beneficial effect is：Fire can be monitored by temperature sensor and Smoke Sensor, alarmed when a fire by alarm, and send the specific generation point of fire to safe early warning terminal by wireless communication device, while controller opening controlling valve realizes automatic water jetting；People can accurately know that the relative position of point occurs for self-position and fire by the navigation module and display module of mobile terminal, be easy to people to carry out planning rational escape route, prevent people from rushing fire by mistake and point occurs, ensure the life security of people.

title_en: System and method for providing optimal path upon fire occurrence
title_ko: 화재 발생 시 최적경로 제공 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are a system for providing an optimal path when a fire occurs and an apparatus thereof. The system for providing an optimal path when a fire occurs includes a fire information collecting unit for collecting fire information on the occurrence of the fire and environment information on buildings, a cost function calculating unit which gives a weight to a moving path node of building map information based on the fire information, calculates a repulsive force index for each node of the building map information according to a location and a relative distance of the fire, and calculates a cost function using the weight and the repulsive force index for each node which is calculated, and an optimal path estimating unit which estimates the optimal path based on the result of the calculated cost function in the moving path node. The building map information is obtained from a building database generated based on a classified feature node and the moving path node. The optimal path estimating unit estimates the optimal path using the minimum moving path node in which the sum of the calculated cost function is a minimum value. Accordingly, the present invention can provide a safe escape route.
abstract_ko: 화재 발생 시 최적경로 제공 시스템 및 그 방법이 개시된다.  화재 발생 시 최적경로 제공 시스템은 화재 발생에 따른 화재 정보 및 건물에 대한 환경 정보를 수집하는 화재 정보 수집부, 상기 화재 정보에 기초하여 건물 맵 정보의 이동경로 노드에 가중치를 부여하고, 화재의 발생 위치 및 상대거리에 따른 상기 건물 맵 정보의 노드별 척력지수를 연산하며, 상기 연산된 노드별 척력지수 및 상기 가중치를 이용하여 비용함수를 연산하는 비용함수 연산부 및 상기 이동경로 노드에서의 상기 연산된 비용함수의 결과에 기초하여 최적경로를 추정하는 최적경로 추정부를 포함하고, 상기 건물 맵 정보는 상기 이동경로 노드 및 분류되는 특징 노드에 기초하여 생성된 건물 데이터베이스로부터 획득되며, 상기 최적경로 추정부는 상기 연산된 비용함수의 합계가 최소값인 최소 이동경로 노드를 이용하여 상기 최적경로를 추정한 것이다.

title_en: A kind of construction safety based on unmanned plane is maked an inspection tour and early warning system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of construction safety tour based on unmanned plane and early warning system,It is related to unmanned plane applied technical field,Including unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) control center and Construction control center,The unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) control center includes head,Flight control center and automated navigation system,And head,Flight control center and automated navigation system electrical connection,The head includes video camera and loudspeaker,And video camera and loudspeaker are electrically connected with head,The flight control center includes anticollision module and signal transceiver,And anticollision module and signal transceiver are electrically connected with flight control center,The Construction control center includes control unit and processing unit,The present invention replaces manual patrol construction site,Check for construction safety problem,And in case of emergency response alarm,Notice rescue command center in time,Pass on rescue instruction and evacuation personnel,Efficiency high,Remote emergency rescue command can be achieved.

title_en: The processing method and equipment of fire-fighting evacuation figure
abstract_en: The present invention relates to disaster processing technology field, more particularly to a kind of processing method and equipment of fire-fighting evacuation figure, with the guiding user's evacuation of more intuitive auxiliary information.The inventive method includes：Obtain fire-fighting evacuation figure；Identify the mark in the fire-fighting evacuation figure；The user's location information obtained according to recognition result and in real time carries out evacuation path planning to the user；The fire-fighting evacuation figure is disassembled according to recognition result, and the evacuation path planned widen highlighting in the fire-fighting evacuation figure reconfigured.

title_en: Navigation methods and systems in a kind of vehicle shelter
abstract_en: The invention discloses navigation methods and systems in a kind of vehicle shelter, wherein method includes：Start timing when vehicle enters blindage, obtain traveling duration；The operating range that vehicle travels in blindage is calculated with respect to the current speed relatively of blindage according to traveling duration and vehicle, the comprehensive blindage length data obtained in advance, shows the positional information that vehicle is located in blindage.Position of the vehicle in the blindage of the shielded signals such as tunnel can be accurately indicated by car-mounted computer, after vehicle drives into blindage, by simple timing and test the speed, the comprehensive blindage length information to prestore can accurately obtain the position that vehicle is located in blindage by the computer of in-car, and the positional information is fed back into driver and crew, the method does not rely on line navigation system excessively, so still being capable of normal work under the shielding of blindage, blindage is efficiently solved to cause to drive blindness, unknown the problem of causing discomfort of road conditions to driver.

title_en: A kind of intelligent helmet and its rescue air navigation aid for being rescued in building
abstract_en: A kind of intelligent helmet and its rescue air navigation aid for being rescued in building proposed by the present invention, belongs to fire-fighting evacuation field.The device includes：The helmet, CPU processor, memory cell, gravity sensor, gyroscope, horizontal acceleration sensor, earth magnetism flowmeter sensor, common camera, depth camera, microphone, speech player, battery and holographic eyeglass；In use, key point is demarcated in a model after the threedimensional model of building is established in the preparatory stage and generates the communication information of each key point；In rescue navigation stage, after user determines starting point and destination, guide arrow to guide by the path planning shown on holographic eyeglass and arrive at.The present invention can be that user provides accurate positioning in building, and guiding is provided when being rescued in building and causes rescue personnel quickly to reach emergency place, there is very strong practical value.

title_en: A kind of navigation object determines method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of navigation object to determine method and device, and this method includes：In navigation procedure, the distance between navigation object current location shelter nearest with guidance path front is calculated；When the distance is equal to or less than the first distance threshold, gather the ambient parameter value of the navigation object, monitor the changing value of the ambient parameter value, and when it is determined that the changing value is more than or equal to preset threshold value, determine that the navigation object drives into the shelter, for solving not determining whether navigation object drives into the technical problem of shelter in the prior art.

title_en: Evacuate path planning and command system
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of evacuation path planning system, including main control module and multiple picture pick-up devices, the main control module include memory cell, image identification unit and path-calculating element；The plurality of picture pick-up device shoots at least a portion region of the coverage, and by image transmission to the main control module；The image identification unit, judge whether that the condition of a fire occurs, generate condition of a fire information, and the condition of a fire information and picture pick-up device positional information corresponding with the condition of a fire information are sent to the path-calculating element；There is the road information on the road in the coverage in the memory cell, the path-calculating element evacuates routing information according to the road information, the condition of a fire information and the picture pick-up device positional information calculation.Evacuation path planning system proposed by the present invention, it is automatic to monitor the condition of a fire and export optimal evacuation route in time.

title_en: System and method for providing 3-dimension path upon fire occurrence
title_ko: 화재 발생에 따른 3차원 경로 제공 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are a system for providing a 3D path according to a fire occurrence and a method thereof. The system for providing a 3D path according to a fire occurrence includes a fire information collection unit for collecting fire information according to the fire occurrence, an optimal path calculation unit for calculating an optimal path from an escape route algorithm and building map information based on the fire information, and a 3D path providing unit for providing escape path coordinates by three-dimensionally expressing the escape path coordinates according to the optimal path through an expressing device included in a building. The building map information is acquired from a building database generated based on a moving path node and a classified feature node. The optimal path calculation unit gives a weight to the moving path node of the building map information based on the fire occurrence and operates a repulsion index for each node of the building map information, thereby calculating the optimal path from the escape path algorithm to calculate a cost function. Accordingly, an evacuator can quickly escape from a fire point.
abstract_ko: 화재 발생에 따른 3차원 경로 제공 시스템 및 그 방법이 개시된다.  화재 발생에 따른 화재 정보를 수집하는 화재 정보 수집부, 상기 화재 정보에 기초하여 탈출경로 알고리즘 및 건물 맵 정보로부터 최적 경로를 산출하는 최적 경로 산출부 및 상기 최적 경로에 따른 탈출 경로 좌표를 건물 내부에 포함된 표출장치를 통해 3차원으로 표출하여 제공하는 3차원 경로 제공부를 포함하고, 상기 건물 맵 정보는 이동경로 노드 및 분류되는 특징 노드에 기초하여 생성된 건물 데이터베이스로부터 획득되며, 상기 최적 경로 산출부는 상기 화재 발생에 기초하여 상기 건물 맵 정보의 이동경로 노드에 가중치를 부여하고, 상기 건물 맵 정보의 노드별 척력지수를 연산하여 비용함수를 산출하는 상기 탈출경로 알고리즘으로부터 상기 최적 경로를 산출한다.

title_en: Evacuation guiding apparatus for visually handicapped person
title_ko: 시각장애인을 위한 피난 유도 장치
abstract_en: An evacuation guiding apparatus for a visually handicapped person according to a first aspect of the present invention comprises: a fire sensing unit arranged in a facility to sense an occurrence of a fire; a plurality of smoke sensing units arranged in the facility to sense an amount of smoke generated by the fire after the occurrence of the fire is sensed by the fire sensing unit; a plurality of units for sensing the number of persons arranged in corridors connected to a fire exit of the facility to sense the number of persons passing the corridors; a transmission unit wirelessly outputting signals corresponding to sensing results by the fire sensing unit, the smoke sensing unit and the person sensing units; a main body worn on a wrist of the visually handicapped person by a band; a receiving unit arranged in the main body to receive signals from the transmission unit; a warning unit, if the receiving unit receives a fire situation, informing the visually handicapped person of the fire situation; and a path guiding unit arranged in the main body to inform the visually handicapped person of an evacuation path. The present invention is able to sense the occurrence of the fire and inform the handicapped person of the evacuation path where the amount of smoke is small and the number of moving persons is small, is configured in a smart watch, which is a type to be worn on the wrist of the visually handicapped person to inform the visually handicapped person of fire through sound signals, band pressure, and vibration when the fire occurs, and is able to inform the visually handicapped person of a safe evacuation path through the sound signals and tactile signals on the evacuation path when the fire occurs.
abstract_ko:
본 발명의 제1 측면에 의하면, 본 발명은, 시설물에 배치되어 화재 발생을 감지하는 화재 감지부; 상기 시설물에 복수로 배치되어 상기 화재 감지부에 의해 화재 발생이 감지된 후, 화재에 의해 발생된 연기의 양을 감지하는 연기 감지부; 상기 시설물의 비상구로 연결되는 복도에 복수로 배치되어 상기 복도를 지나는 인원의 수를 감지하는 인원 감지부; 상기 화재 감지부, 상기 연기 감지부 및 상기 인원 감지부에서 감지 결과에해당하는 신호를 무선으로 출력하는 송신부; 시각장애인의 손목에 밴드에 의해 착용되는 본체; 상시 본체에 배치되어 상기 송신부가 송신하는 신호를 수신하는 수신부; 상기 수신부에 의해 화재 상황이 수신되면, 이를 시각장애인에게 알려주는 경보부; 및 상기 본체에 배치되어 상기 시각장애인의 피난 경로를 알려주는 경로 안내부를 포함하는 시각장애인을 위한 피난 유도 장치를 제공한다.  
본 발명은, 화재 발생 시 이를 감지하여 연기 발생량이 적고 이동 인원수가 적은 대피 경로를 장애인에게 알려줄 수 있고, 시각장애인의 손목에 채워지는 스마트 워치 형태로 이루어져 화재 발생 시 음향 신호, 밴드 압박, 진동을 통해 시각장애인에게 화재를 알려주고 안전한 대피 경로를 알려줄 수 있으며, 화재 발생 시 대피 경로상에서 음향 신호 및 촉각 신호를 통해 시각 장애인에게 안전한 대피 경로를 알려줄 수 있다.

title_en: Providing information to support sailing clearway device and method thereof
title_ko: 대피 항로 보조 정보 제공 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: Provided are an apparatus for providing evacuation route aiding information and a method thereof. The apparatus for providing evacuation route aiding information according to an embodiment of the present invention for a ship in voyage comprises: a ship risk calculation unit for calculating a vessel risk, which is a risk caused by an accident such as flooding or fire in the ship; an incident response method generating unit for generating an incident response method for the ship using the ship risk; and an evacuation route related information generating unit for generating an evacuation route and evacuation route navigation assistance information for the incident response method.
abstract_ko: 대피 항로 보조 정보 제공 장치 및 방법이 제공된다. 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 대피 항로 보조 정보 제공 장치는, 항해 중인 선박에 있어서, 상기 선박에서 발생한 침수 또는 화재 등의 사고에 의해 발생하는 위험도인 선박 위험도를 산출하는 선박 위험도 산출부; 상기 선박 위험도를 이용하여 상기 선박의 사고 대응 방법을 생성하는 사고 대응 방법 생성부; 및 상기 사고 대응 방법에 대한 대피 항로 및 대피 항로 항해 보조 정보를 생성하는 대피 항로 관련 정보 생성부;를 포함한다.

title_en: Positioning navigation method for shielding space
abstract_en: The invention provides a positioning navigation method for a shielded space, wherein the shielded space is provided with a set channel, and an identification unit is arranged along the channel, and the method comprises the following steps: in the process that the travelers travel along the channel, the camera shoots a picture in front of the travel; determining the largest identification unit in the photo, and identifying the identification of the identification unit; determining the installation position of the identification unit in the shielded space by using a map of the shielded space through identification; the position of the traveler in the sheltered space is determined. The invention also provides a continuous navigation method for the non-shielded space and the shielded space. According to the positioning navigation method for the shielded space and the continuous navigation method for the non-shielded space and the shielded space, provided by the invention, the installation position of the identification unit in the shielded space is determined through the identified identifier, so that the position of a traveler in the shielded space is further determined, and external communication is not needed in the navigation process.

title_en: RFID and IMU-based rapid navigation method in rescue environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapid navigation method based on RFID and IMU in a rescue environment, which comprises the following steps: s1, constructing RFID beacons by the first entrants and recording track information of the RFID beacons to form a beacon map; s2, the subsequent entrants navigate according to the beacon map and by combining with a navigation device with an IMU (inertial measurement Unit), so as to realize the convergence with the first entrants; all entrants navigate through the beacon map in conjunction with a navigation device having an IMU to effect evacuation. According to the invention, the navigation device with the IMU is used for recording the approximate path of the personnel entering the navigation device firstly, and the RFID beacon is arranged at the turning position of the path, so that the personnel entering the navigation device subsequently can correct the navigation path of the navigation device with the IMU conveniently, the personnel entering the navigation device subsequently can find the personnel entering the navigation device previously quickly, the personnel in the navigation device can evacuate quickly, the detention time of the personnel in the rescue environment is reduced, and the rescue risk is reduced.

title_en: A kind of underground positioning navigation method and system based on power tunnel environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of underground positioning navigation method and system based on power tunnel environment, this method includes establishing electric power tunnel model according to monitoring device installation site in electric power tunnel basic condition and electric power tunnel；Mobile terminal is interacted with it apart from nearest monitoring device bluetooth connection row information of going forward side by side, and passes through the monitoring device upload information to server；Server carries out personnel positioning and/or navigation according to installation site of the monitoring device in electric power tunnel model.When encountering emergency case in tunnel, staff can operate in mobile terminal, the tunnel geographic model that system has built up before, a rational evacuation route is cooked up according to staff position, carry out underground navigation, worker safety is assisted to recede from danger zone, to ensure subterranean tunnel staff's personal safety.
assignees: SHANDONG KANGWEI COMMUNICATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Lightweight Web3D fire disaster escapings paths planning method based on parallel iACO and system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of lightweight Web3D fire disaster escapings paths planning method and system based on parallel iACO, the described method comprises the following steps：1) light-weight technologg is carried out to the life cycle BIM data of acquisition, establishes lightweight contextual data；2) the flue gas dynamic sprawling data in calculating instrument acquisition scene are generated based on flue gas；3) the barrier data for interfering crowd evacuation escape are obtained based on the lightweight contextual data and flue gas dynamic sprawling data；4) using first ant group algorithm, the barrier data are based on, planning obtains the optimal best-effort path of each intelligent body role in scene.Compared with prior art, the present invention solves the np hard problem of the multiple agent optimum path planning in large scale scene in real time, can be that the intelligent body role in each scene plans an optimal best-effort path.

title_en: System and method for providing evacuation route
title_ko: 대피 경로 안내 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: A system and a method for guiding an evacuation route are disclosed. According to the present invention, the system for guiding an evacuation route comprises: a beacon arranged in a building, and sensing whether a user is positioned inside the building; a fire sensor arranged in the building, and generating sensing information by measuring information related to a fire accident; a management server for generating, on a pre-stored internal drawing of the building, guidance information reflecting a fire occurring zone and an evacuation route based on the sensing information when the fire accident occurs while analyzing the sensing information received from the first sensor to determine whether the fire accident occurs; and a user terminal for displaying the internal drawing reflecting the fire occurring zone and the evacuation route as image information by executing a pre-installed application when the guidance information is received.
abstract_ko: 대피 경로 안내 시스템 및 방법이 개시된다. 본 발명에 따른 대피 경로 안내 시스템은, 건물 내부에 배치되어 사용자가 상기 건물 내부에 위치하는지 여부를 감지하는 비콘, 상기 건물 내부에 배치되어 화재사고와 관련된 정보를 측정하여 센싱정보를 생성하는 화재감지센서, 상기 화재감지센서로부터 수신된 상기 센싱정보를 분석하여 화재 발생여부를 판단하되, 화재사고가 발생한 것으로 판단되는 경우 미리 저장된 상기 건물의 내부도면에 상기 센싱정보를 기초로 화재발생구역 및 대피 경로가 반영된 안내정보를 생성하는 관리서버 및 상기 안내정보를 수신하면 미리 설치된 애플리케이션을 실행하여 상기 화재발생구역 및 상기 대피 경로가 반영된 상기 내부도면을 화상정보로 표시하는 사용자 단말을 포함한다.
assignees: KIM YOUNG BAE;CHOI JUN HYUK;KIM JOO EUN;KIM WOON SU;KIM JEONG HO

title_en: Evacuation Path Navigation System And Method On Resilience Maximizing
title_ko: 회복탄력성을 극대화하는 대피 경로 안내 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an evacuation path navigation system capable of maximizing resilience and a method thereof. According to the present invention, the system comprises a database unit which stores an electronic map including link or node information defining types of pedestrians who can move; and a path search unit which searches for an evacuation path comprising links and nodes through which a type of a pedestrian, which a user belongs to, can move. According to the present invention, the evacuation path navigation system capable of maximizing resilience has a merit of guiding each user or each user group to an optimal evacuation path in accordance with the type of walking capability of a person to evacuate, a merit of searching for an evacuation path again and providing guidance when evacuation through a relevant path is dangerous since the state of a link or a node included in the searched evacuation path has changed, and a merit of supporting a user, who has difficulty in independent escape, to escape while receiving help from others or cooperating with others by generating a group of people to escape.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 회복탄력성을 극대화하는 대피 경로 안내 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 본 발명에 따른 시스템은, 이동 가능한 보행자 유형이 정의되어 있는 링크 또는 노드 정보를 포함하는 전자 지도를 저장하는 데이터베이스부, 그리고 사용자가 속하는 보행자 유형이 이동 가능한 링크 및 노드로 구성되는 대피 경로를 탐색하는 경로 탐색부를 포함한다. 본 발명에 의하면, 대피자의 보행 능력 유형에 맞추어 사용자 또는 사용자 그룹별로 최적의 대피 경로를 안내할 수 있는 장점이 있다. 또한 탐색된 대피 경로에 포함된 링크 또는 노드의 상태가 변경되어, 해당 경로로 계속 대피하는 것이 위험한 경우 대피 경로를 재탐색하여 안내할 수 있는 장점이 있다. 또한 대피자 그룹을 생성하여 독자적으로 대피가 어려운 사용자가 타인의 도움을 받거나 함께 협력하면서 대피할 수 있게 지원할 수 있는 장점이 있다.

title_en: A kind of memory method for path navigation based on individual soldier's Intelligent visible glasses
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of memory method for path navigation based on individual soldier's Intelligent visible glasses, include the following steps：One, the building interior planogram data of command centre's transmission is received, the key element in data is extracted, is plotted on Intelligent visible glasses with block diagram form；Two, the location information of real-time reception inertial navigation set transmission, and the data received are saved in local data base；Three, according to inertial navigation location information, Intelligent visible spectacle plane schematic diagram is simultaneously switched to the layer by floor where judging individual soldier, matches coordinate relationship, map location point and progress path where drawing individual soldier；Four, judge whether be currently the state of withdrawing.The present invention is using Intelligent visible glasses as platform, comprehensive utilization inertial navigation technology, network transmission technology, can provide evacuation route for fire-fighting individual soldier in the case where dense smoke visibility is low and navigate, its is assisted safety quick to withdraw the scene of a fire.
assignees: 28TH RES INST CHINA ELECTRONICS TECH GROUP CORP

title_en: Intelligent transportation indicates navigation system when a kind of waterlogging
abstract_en: The utility model is related to intelligent transportation when a kind of waterlogging to indicate navigation system, belong to technical field of intelligent traffic.Including Level monitor, the network platform and traffic indicating equipment.The Level monitor is made of water-level alarm trigger and wireless transmission facility；The traffic indicating equipment includes：Signal receiver, LED indication screen, audible-visual annunciator.Whether alarm height is reached by above-mentioned Level monitor monitoring water level, if reaching alarm height, water level alarm is triggered, and sends out signal by being wirelessly transferred facility, the network platform will carry out road conditions to analyze and guide road vehicle by traffic indicating equipment after receiving waterlogging information.The utility model is simple in structure, intelligence is automatic, by the real time water level monitoring to easy ponding point, can guide evacuation to surrounding vehicles in time, effectively reduce traffic congestion and accident when waterlogging.

title_en: A kind of dynamic creation method, system, the electric terminal of crowd's emergencyevacuationroute
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of dynamic creation method, system, the electric terminal of crowd's emergencyevacuationroute, the method includes：Step S1 collects environment, demographic data using the distributed computing network disposed in place；Step S2, using the reverse strand method decision optimal path of decentralization；Step S3, personnel pass through the optimal route that step S2 is determined according to instruction successively, and in personnel's implementation procedure, according to disaster spreading in personnel's real time position and current environment and involve range, condition of road surface, density of personnel real time modifying, update evacuation route, until personnel reach evacuation target area；The present invention solves low, big to the network load of the Centroid problem of prior art real-time.
assignees: SHANGHAI RES CT WIRELESS COMM;FUZHOU INTERNET OF THINGS OPEN LAB CO LTD

title_en: Data-driven wisdom crowd evacuating system based on Raspberry Pi and evacuation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of data-driven wisdom crowd evacuating system and evacuation method based on Raspberry Pi, at least two are arranged in the Raspberry Pi controller in crowd evacuation scene, it is configured as sensor node, receive the monitoring instruction that remote control terminal is sent, open listening mode, acquisition crowd's information, and it is sent to remote control terminal；Remote control terminal, it is configured as sending to Raspberry Pi controller and monitors instruction, and receive crowd's information of Raspberry Pi controller transmission, crowd evacuation emulation platform is imported to be emulated, and Scene Semantics is combined to carry out crowd movement's calculating, evacuation path is obtained, is combined obtained evacuation path and model of place to obtain crowd evacuation emulation simulation drawing.The present invention is by arranging that Raspberry Pi controller can be quickly obtained real-time crowd's information, and the real time information and global path navigation obtained using relative velocity obstruction method calculates crowd movement, quick crowd evacuation emulation is realized, to solve the problems, such as that public safety provides timely decision support.

title_en: Crowd guidance system using power line carrier communication
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To rapidly perform evacuation guidance in the case of emergency by allowing flow flickering to be clearly recognized as route guidance while simplifying wiring of a power line.SOLUTION: A control device 41 and a lighting fitting group G1 composed of multiple lighting fittings Ga arranged along a passage are connected to a power line 21. The control device 41 outputs a lighting control signal to the multiple lighting fittings Ga through the power line 21 so that lighting modes of the multiple lighting fittings Ga are selectable from a mode for normal guidance or evacuation guidance. Each one of the multiple lighting fittings Ga has a control section RC for controlling changeover of lighting modes of light emission parts 28 on the basis of a lighting control signal superimposed on the power line 21. In the lighting mode for the normal guidance, the multiple lighting fittings Ga are flickered by flowing in a predetermined movement direction (e.g., a direction of viewing order and a one-way direction, etc.). In the lighting mode for the evacuation guidance, the multiple lighting fittings Ga are flickered by flowing so as to perform guidance toward an escape door.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Fire monitoring system guiding evacuation route in case of fire and method thereof
title_ko: 화재 발생시 대피 경로를 안내하는 화재감시시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are a fire monitoring system capable of guiding an escape route according to a fire occurrence position and an escape route guiding method. The fire monitoring system according to the present invention comprises: a plurality of transmitters for detecting whether fire occurs to output a signal regarding whether fire occurs to a receiver; a plurality of guidance lamps including beacon communications modules; and receiver. The receiver may comprise: a storage unit for storing information on regions where the transmitters are installed and information on an escape route when fire occurs according to each region where each of the transmitters is installed; a communications unit for receiving a fire occurrence signal from the transmitters, and transmitting and receiving data to and from the beacon communications modules included in the guidance lamps; and a control unit for determining a region where a transmitter that has output a fire occurrence signal is installed through the storage unit, reading escape route information according to a region where fire occurs when the communications unit receives the fire occurrence signal from any one transmitter, and controlling the information on the escape route to be transmitted to a mobile communications terminal according to the escape route information.
abstract_ko: 본 명세서는 화재 발생 위치에 따라 대피 경로를 안내할 수 있는 화재감시시스템 및 대피 경로 안내 방법을 개시한다. 본 명세서에 따른 화재감시시스템은 화재 발생 여부를 감지하여 수신기에게 화재 발생 여부에 대한 신호를 출력하는 복수의 발신기; 비콘 통신 모듈을 포함하는 복수의 유도등; 및 수신기를 포함하는 화재감시시스템으로서, 상기 수신기는 상기 복수의 발신기가 설치된 구역에 대한 정보 및 상기 발신기가 설치된 각 구역에 따라 화재가 발생했을 때 대피 경로에 대한 정보를 저장하는 저장부; 상기 복수의 발신기로부터 화재 발생 신호를 수신하고, 상기 복수의 유도등에 포함된 비콘 통신 모듈과 데이터를 송수신하는 통신부; 및 상기 통신부를 어느 하나의 발신기로부터 화재 발생 신호를 수신할 때, 상기 저장부를 통해 상기 화재 발생 신호를 출력한 발신기가 설치된 구역 판별 및 화재가 발생한 구역에 따른 대피 경로 정보를 판독하고, 상기 대피 경로 정보에 따라 이동 통신 단말에게 대피 경로에 대한 정보를 전송하도록 제어하는 제어부;를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: System and method for barrier evacuation and path planning in autonomous vehicle
abstract_en: Provide the system and method for controlling vehicle.Paths planning method for vehicle includes the first path established for the first vehicle, and sensing data associated with the behavior of one or more preceding vehicles observed near the first vehicle is then received at the first vehicle.This method further includes that the amendment path for deviating from first path is established based on sensing data, is then classified using the first vehicle of processor pair barrier observed when it is along amendment route.

title_en: Smart type fire detector
title_ko: 스마트형 화재 감지기
abstract_en: A smart fire detector according to the present invention compises a sensing unit sensing at least one fire elements; a control unit for analyzing signals sensed by the sensing unit to determine whether a fire has occurred and outputting a fire signal when at least one of the fire elements is determined to be a fire; an image portion for capturing an image of a region where a fire element has been sensed in response to the fire signal and extracting an image and a photograph of high-resolution snapshot from the captured image; a notification unit for outputting a fire warning and a quick evacuation route guidance sound in response to the fire signal; and a power supply unit for supplying an emergency power when the power supply is cut off due to the occurrence of the fire. The fire element includes any one of heat, smoke, gas, fine dust. The control unit includes a communication unit for transmitting the image and photograph of high-resolution snapshot extracted through the image unit to a control center, and a determining unit for comparing and analyzing a measured value of the fire elements sensed by the sensing unit with a predetermined reference value. The determining unit determines that a fire has occurred when the measured value of the fire elements exceeds a predetermined reference value. Accordingly, the present invention enables a fire occurrance notification by a fire type-specific analysis thereby securing the reliability of fire monitoring and alarm.
abstract_ko:
본 발명에 따른 스마트형 화재 감지기는, 하나 이상의 화재 요소를 감지하는 감지부; 감지부로부터 감지된 감지 신호들을 상호 분석하여 화재의 발생 여부를 판단하고 화재 요소들 중 하나 이상을 화재 발생으로 판단하는 경우 화재 신호를 출력하는 제어부; 화재 신호에 따라 화재 요소가 감지된 영역의 영상을 촬영하고, 촬영된 영상에서 고해상도의 스냅샷의 영상과 사진을 추출하는 영상부; 화재 신호에 따라 화재 경고 및 화재에 따른 빠른 대피로 안내음을 출력하는 알림부; 및, 상기 화재 발생으로 인해 전원 공급이 차단되었을 때 비상전원을 공급하는 전원부;를 포함하며, 화재 요소는, 열, 연기, 가스, 미세먼지 중 어느 하나를 포함하고, 제어부는, 영상부를 통해 추출된 고해상도의 스냅샷의 영상과 사진을 관제센터로 전송하기 위한 통신부; 및, 감지부로부터 감지된 화재 요소들의 측정값과 미리 설정된 기준값을 비교 분석하는 판단부;를 더 포함하며, 판단부는, 화재 요소들의 측정값이 미리 설정된 기준값을 초과하는 경우 화재가 발생하였다고 판단한다. 
이에 따라서, 본 발명은 감지의 유형별 분석을 통해 화재뿐만 아니라 감지 유형별 알림이 가능하여 화재 감시 및 경보에 대한 신뢰성을 확보할 수 있다.

title_en: Emergency evacuation safety facility structure to be installed on ship
title_ko: 선박설치용 비상대피안전시설구조물
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an emergency evacuation safety facility structure to be installed on a ship and is advantageous in that, when an emergency situation occurs (for example, when a ship collides with a reef, a culvert, or a maritime structure during navigation or mooring, when the ship is stranded, when a fire occurs, or when gas explosion occurs), the cabin crew, passengers, and the like can be safely evacuated to buoyant bodies provided inside frames provided on both side surfaces of the ship, the buoyant bodies can not only decrease the sinking rate of the ship, but can also safely protect side surfaces of the ship from a collision with another ship, and it is unnecessary to construct the ship in a double hull structure, in order to prevent the ship from sinking, which has the problems of a high risk of technical defects, a high level of operation difficulty, and increased construction costs.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 선박설치용 비상대피안전시설구조물에 관한 것으로서, 선박이 운항 중 또는 정박 중에 암초, 암거 또는 해상 구조물 등에 충돌하거나 좌초 및 화재발생, 가스폭발 등의 비상상황이 발생한 경우 승무원, 탑승객 등이 선박의 양측면에 구비되는 프레임의 내측에 구비된 부력체로 안전하게 대피할 수 있을 뿐만 아니라 상기 부력체를 통해 선박의 침몰속도를 지연시킬 수 있음은 물론 선박의 측면을 다른 선박과의 충돌로부터 안전하게 보호할 수 있고, 나아가 선박의 침몰방지를 위해 선박을 기술적결함 발생우려가 높으면서 작업이 어렵고 건조 비용이 증가하는 문제점이 있는 이중 선주 구조로 건조할 필요가 없는 효과가 있다.
assignees: YOO BYONG CHUL;KIM JEONG HEE;JIN FENGHE

title_en: Fire alarm system using water flow detection in fire pipe
title_ko: 소방배관 내 유수감지를 이용한 화재경보시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire alarm system using water flow detection in a fire pipe, navigation applications for an evacuation installed in mobile terminals which all the persons inside and PCs provided in a ship or a service store which many persons use are executed according to a fire sensing signal according to the water flow detection in a water pipe of a fire extinguishing facility by a water flow detection device through remote control. The shortest path to an exit is guided. A visual guide means and an audible guide means installed in the exit are operated by an infrared signal transmitted from the mobile terminal, thereby more quickly and safely performing the evacuation.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 소방배관 내 유수감지를 이용한 화재경보시스템에 관한 것으로, 유수감지장치에 의한 소화설비의 급수관 내의 유수감지에 따른 화재감지신호에 따라 많은 사람들이 이용하는 접객업소 또는 선박에 비치된 피씨와 모든 장내 인원이 휴대하는 모바일 단말기에 설치된 대피용 내비게이션 앱이 원격제어에 의하여 실행되고, 비상구까지의 최단경로를 안내하도록 하고, 모바일 단말기에서 송출되는 적외선신호에 의해 비상구에 설치된 시각적 안내수단과 청각적 안내수단이 작동하도록 함으로써 보다 신속하고 안전하게 대피할 수 있도록 한 것이다.

title_en: Naval vessel intelligent emergency evacuation indicates system
abstract_en: A kind of naval vessel intelligent emergency evacuation instruction system, belongs to naval vessel emergency evacuation technical field.It is characterized by comprising control host and several zone controllers, the control host include industrial personal computer and with the display of industry control mechatronics, power conversion module, the control host is communicated to connect by RS485 communication bus and several zone controllers, each zone controller connects multiple lamps and lanterns further through CAN bus, the lamps and lanterns indicate personnel's evacuation direction by the directional arrow on surface as standard main channel outlet blinker.Advantage：It is versatile, integrated level is high, can allow ship's staff each random areas occur fire after can be withdrawn by the guidance of vision according to a certain optimal route.

title_en: System And Method For Evacuation Path Navigation Through Evacuees Group Generation
title_ko: 대피자 그룹 생성을 통한 대피 경로 안내 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for guiding an evacuation path through evacuee group generation and a method thereof, which can guide an optimal evacuation path for each user or user group according to a walking ability type. According to the present invention, the system comprises: a database part storing an electronic map including link or node information on which a movable pedestrian type is defined; a path searching part searching for the evacuation path composed of the link and the node in which the pedestrian type, to which a user belongs, can be movable; an information collecting part collecting link or node state information included in the electronic map; and a control part reflecting the collecting state information and changing the movable pedestrian type of the link or the node. The control part groups a plurality of users within a predetermined range when a disaster occurs to generate an evacuee group. The path searching part reflects the link or the node in which the movable pedestrian type is changed, re-searches for the evacuation path, searches for the evacuation path composed of the link and the node in which the pedestrian type, to which the evacuee group belongs, can be movable when the evacuee group composed of the plurality of users is generated, and provides the same evacuation path to the user belonging to the evacuee group.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 대피자 그룹 생성을 통한 대피 경로 안내 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것이다. 본 발명에 따른 시스템은, 이동 가능한 보행자 유형이 정의되어 있는 링크 또는 노드 정보를 포함하는 전자 지도를 저장하는 데이터베이스부, 사용자가 속하는 보행자 유형이 이동 가능한 링크 및 노드로 구성되는 대피 경로를 탐색하는 경로 탐색부, 전자 지도에 포함되는 링크 또는 노드의 상태 정보를 수집하는 정보 수집부, 그리고 수집된 상태 정보를 반영하여 링크 또는 노드의 이동 가능한 보행자 유형을 변경하는 제어부를 포함한다. 제어부는 재난 발생 시 미리 정해진 범위 내에 있는 복수의 사용자를 그룹핑하여 대피자 그룹을 생성한다. 경로 탐색부는, 이동 가능한 보행자 유형이 변경된 링크 또는 노드를 반영하여 대피 경로를 재탐색하며, 복수의 사용자로 이루어진 대피자 그룹이 생성된 경우, 대피자 그룹이 속하는 보행자 유형이 이동 가능한 링크 및 노드로 구성되는 대피 경로를 탐색하고, 대피자 그룹에 속하는 사용자에게 동일한 대피 경로를 제공한다.

title_en: Real-time route guidance system using public transportation information
title_ko: 대중교통 정보를 이용한 실시간 길안내 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a real-time navigation system using public transportation information, capable of reducing a time required for reaching a destination. According to the present invention, the real-time navigation system using public transportation information comprises a user terminal and an information providing server. The user terminal comprises: a location setting unit to input departure and destination information; a route selection unit to select one or more pieces of route information reaching a destination, and to transmit a reservation request signal to reserve a ticket when an express bus, a train, and an airplane incapable of getting thereon in real-time are included in the route information; a navigation information popup unit to pop up location information and transit location information of mass transportation during moving to the destination; and a virtual reality (VR) interlocking unit interlocking with a VR substrate to realize output of pop-up or navigation information in the navigation information popup unit. The information providing server comprises: an optimal route providing unit to generate and transmit the route information about the shortest time, transit, and expense for reaching to the destination from a starting point, and to transmit a signal for using a taxi; a reservation processing unit to perform a reservation in accordance with transmission of the reservation request signal; an evacuation guide unit to provide location information about a hospital or a shelter when an emergency situation occurs in the current location of the user terminal; and a server control unit to transmit and receive the signal to and from the user terminal, and to control operation of all components of the information providing server.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 대중교통 정보를 이용한 실시간 길안내 시스템에 관한 것으로, 출발지 정보 및 목적지 정보를 입력하는 위치 설정부와; 상기 목적지까지 도착하는 적어도 하나 이상의 경로 정보를 선택하고, 상기 경로정보에 실시간 탑승이 불가능한 고속버스, 기차, 비행기가 포함된 경우 이에 대한 예매가 가능하도록 예매 신청신호를 전송하는 경로 선택부와; 상기 목적지까지의 이동시 대중교통의 위치 정보 및 환승 위치 정보를 실시간 팝업하는 안내정보 팝업부와; VR 시스템과 연동하여 상기 안내정보 팝업부에서 출력되는 팝업이나, 상기 경로 정보의 출력이 이루어지도록 하는 VR 연동부;를 포함하는 사용자 단말; 및 대중교통 정보와 보행자 도로 정보를 병합하여 출발지에서 목적지까지 도착하기 위한 최단 시간, 최소환승, 최소 비용에 대한 경로 정보를 생성 및 전송하고, 택시 이용 여부에 대한 신호를 전송하는 최적 경로 제공부와; 상기 예매 신청신호의 전송 여부에 따라 예매를 수행하는 예매 처리부와; 상기 사용자 단말이 현재 위치에서 비상 상황이 발생하는 경우, 병원이나 대피소 위치 정보를 제공하는 대피 안내부와; 상기 사용자 단말과의 신호 송수신이 이루어지며, 정보 제공서버의 모든 구성요소들의 구동 여부를 제어하는 서버 제어부;로 이루어지는 정보 제공서버를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: A kind of evacuation for rescue in firefighting bootstrap technique, system, storage medium and mobile terminal
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of evacuation for rescue in firefighting bootstrap technique, system, storage medium and mobile terminal, the method includes：Mobile terminal is connect with indoor bluetooth equipment is preset in, and obtains the current location of mobile terminal in real time；When fire alarm occurs, the mobile terminal instructs depending on the user's operation, starts preset engine map, obtains the map datum of the interior space；The mobile terminal starts navigation feature, plans Evacuation route automatically according to the indoor map data of acquisition, evades fire occurrence point and barrier in real time.By the present invention in that being positioned with bluetooth equipment to user, when fire occurs, the position of personnel can be accurately obtained, carries out path planning by obtaining indoor map data, it provides apart from most short and safest evacuation and rescue path, to reach the purpose of real-time emergency management and rescue.

title_en: A kind of moving area calibration-type guide to visitors robot
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of moving area calibration-type guide to visitors robots, including robot body and at least one set of wireless terminal；The wireless terminal is provided with bluetooth headset；The robot body includes running gear, navigation positional device, speech sound eeplaining device, bluetooth transmission means and storage device；The wireless terminal and the bluetooth transmission means bluetooth connection；The navigation positional device is used for pre-set navigational route, light emitting module including light emitting control module and on the robot body, the light emitting module is electrically connected with the light emitting control module, the light emitting control module is used to that corresponding region of the light emitting module around the robot body to be driven to carry out light according to the navigation routine and shows；The speech sound eeplaining device is for explaining showpiece；The storage device is for storing showpiece explanation data.This moving area calibration-type guide to visitors robot, can reduce the evacuation of guide to visitors robot, move guide to visitors robot efficiently.

title_en: Exit route guidance system and method for escaping indoor fire based on indoor LBS
title_ko: 실내 측위 기술을 바탕으로 하는 화재시 탈출로 안내를 위한 음성유도시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention provides a system for guiding an escape route in case of fire based on indoor positioning and an operation method thereof. The system comprises: a route guidance engine receiving route guidance data from a route search server and generating route information; a terminal correction engine correcting a path and current positioning coordinates; a UI/UX module providing information to a user and receiving user input; a spatial information visualization engine graphically processing a current space; and a user alarm unit alarming the user according to a control command from the route guidance engine.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 경로 탐색 서버로부터 경로안내 데이터를 수신하여 경로정보를 생성하는 경로안내 엔진, 경로 및 현재의 측위 좌표를 보정하는 단말 보정 엔진, 사용자에게 정보를 제공하고 사용자 입력을 수신하는 UI/UX 모듈, 현재의 공간을 그래픽 처리하는 공간정보 가시화 엔진, 상기 경로안내 엔진으로부터의 제어명령에 따라 사용자에게 경보하는 사용자 경보부를 포함하는 실내측위 기반의 화재 탈출로 안내 시스템 및 그 운용 방법을 제공한다.

title_en: Techniques for indoor navigation with emergency assistance via light-based communication
abstract_en: Techniques are disclosed for enhancing indoor navigation using light-based communication (LCom). In some embodiments, an LCom-enabled luminaire configured as described herein may include access to a sensor configured to detect a given hazardous condition. In response to detection of a hazard, the LCom-enabled luminaire may adjust its light output, transmit an LCom signal, or both, in accordance with some embodiments. A given LCom signal may include data that may be utilized by a recipient computing device, for example, in providing emergency evacuation routing or other indoor navigation with hazard avoidance, emergency assistance, or both. In a network of such luminaires, data distribution via inter-luminaire communication may be provided, in accordance with some embodiments, via an optical interface or other wired or wireless communication means. In some cases, the network may include a luminaire that is not LCom-enabled yet still configured for inter-luminaire communication.

title_en: Evacuation route navigation system based on toxic gas diffusion influence
abstract_en: The invention relates to an evacuation path navigation system based on toxic gas diffusion influence, which comprises a toxic gas leakage data acquisition terminal, a toxic gas diffusion simulation calculation module, an evacuation path calculation module, a path navigation terminal and an information transmission module. The toxic gas leakage data acquisition terminal transmits the acquired toxic gas related data to the toxic gas diffusion analog computation module for resolving, determines an optimal evacuation path from the set point to the placement point, and transmits the optimal evacuation path to the path navigation display terminal, so that the safe and efficient evacuation of people is assisted. The evacuation path navigation system considers the disaster risk and the change of the path, can provide dynamic transfer path decision support for the transfer of the disaster-stricken people, reduces the disaster risk and casualties of people, and avoids blind transfer and disordered evacuation.
assignees: CHINA ACADEMY OF BUILDING RES CO LTD;UNIV BEIJING JIAOTONG

title_en: Comprehensive positioning method and positioning label
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive positioning method, which divides a positioning area into an outdoor open area, an indoor severely-shielded area and other areas; when the outdoor open area is available, GPS positioning is adopted, and the outdoor open area is uploaded to a server through GPRS communication; when the area is an indoor severely sheltered area, shielding an abnormal value by inertial navigation positioning and combining geomagnetic positioning, and uploading the abnormal value to a server through GPRS communication; when other areas, UWB positioning is employed. The invention combines a UWB positioning module, an inertial navigation positioning module, a geomagnetic positioning module and a GPS positioning module, and can realize high-precision positioning in complex application scenes.

title_en: The efficient anti-method of deepwater drilling platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of efficient anti-methods of deepwater drilling platform, comprising the following steps: S1, defines anti-mode of the platform under two kinds of positioning states；S2, the clear security area Fang Tai；The calculating of S3, clear T-time；The classification of the evacuating people of S4, clearly anti-；S5, navigation evacuation route selection；S6, platform cannot avoid movement routine selection when Typhoon Tracks completely.The present invention summarizes anti-emergence program of deepwater drilling platform, simultaneously in view of the anti-activity duration of deepwater drilling platform is long, it is easy to be influenced by the real-time movement speed of typhoon, complex situations are easy to happen during meeting with typhoon for deepwater drilling and propose a kind of countermeasure, this method is easy to operate, be easily mastered, can reduce deepwater drilling meet with typhoon during complex situations incidence, can be widely applied in deep water field of oil drilling.
assignees: CHINA NAT OFFSHORE OIL CORP;ZHANJIANG BRANCH OF CHINA NAT OFFSHORE OIL CORPORATION

title_en: Method, apparatus and computer-readable medium for monitoring of conventional market using the three-dimensional map
title_ko: 3차원 안전 지도를 이용한 재래 시장 모니터링 및 관리 방법, 장치 및 컴퓨터-판독가능 매체
abstract_en: A monitoring and managing method of a conventional market using a three-dimensional safe map according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: a level setting step of setting a risk level with respect to at least one store which constitutes a conventional market from a regulations grade of a framework, wall materials and structure of a conventional market which are received to a user terminal; an evacuation route searching step of searching a route from a location of a user terminal to an evacuation point on the basis of one information among risk level information of a conventional market, attribute information of a route and environmental information when an ignition predicted point is entered though an input means of a user terminal; and an evacuation route providing step of outputting and providing an evacuation route which is selected by an input means of a user terminal among at least one evacuation route which is searched in an evacuation route searching step in a simulation screen of a user terminal. Accordingly, each risk level is set at a plurality of stores which are included in a conventional market and integrated management can be possible, and thus prompt action and management can be performed even if an unexpected accident occurs in a conventional market.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시 예에 따른 3차원 안전 지도를 이용한 재래 시장 모니터링 및 관리 방법은, 유저 단말에 수신되는 재래 시장의 골조, 벽재 재질 및 구조에 대한 법규 등급으로부터, 재래 시장을 구성하는 적어도 하나의 상점에 대한 위험 레벨을 설정하는 위험 레벨 설정 단계; 유저 단말의 입력 수단을 통해 발화 예상 지점이 입력될 시, 재래 시장의 위험 레벨 정보, 이동 경로의 속성 정보 및 환경 정보 중 적어도 어느 하나의 정보를 기준으로 유저 단말의 위치로부터 탈출 지점까지의 대피 경로를 탐색하는 대피 경로 탐색 단계; 및 대피 경로 탐색 단계에서 탐색된 적어도 하나의 대피 경로 중 유저 단말의 입력 수단에 의해 선택된 대피 경로를 유저 단말에 시뮬레이션 화면으로 출력하여 제공하는 대피 경로 제공 단계;를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 이에 따라 재래 시장에 포함된 복수의 상점들에 각각 위험 레벨을 설정하여 통합적으로 관리할 수 있게 되어 재래 시장 내에 예기치 못한 사고가 발생하더라도 즉각적으로 대응 및 관리할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: The evacuation path guiding system influenced based on toxic gas diffusion
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a kind of toxic gas diffusions to evacuate path guiding system, it includes toxic gas leakage data collection station, toxic gas diffusion simulator, evacuation path resolving module, path navigation terminal and information transmission modular, the toxic gas leakage data collection station includes poisonous gas detecting instrument and information transmission modular a, and the toxic gas diffusion simulator resolves module with the evacuation path and connected by information transmission modular b.The evacuation path guiding system of the utility model considers the disaster-stricken risk and its variation in path, can shift for disaster-stricken crowd and provide dynamic transfer path decision support, reduces the disaster-stricken risk of personnel and injures and deaths, avoids blindly shifting and unordered evacuation.
