title_en: A kind of emergency for high-speed railway platform dredges emulation mode and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of emergency for high-speed railway platform to dredge emulation mode and system, its navigation grid by dividing the environmental map Optimized triangulations of high speed platform, the Calculation of Safety Distance of outlet according to fire and high speed platform can be with exporting and count all available outlets, functional value can be expended with the outlet of outlet to plan the optimal outlet of each passenger of high speed platform by further calculating, according to optimal outlet and navigation grid based on environmental map Optimized triangulations plan passenger to optimal outlet optimal path, velocity vector of passenger whether can be collided and adjusted with this between detection passenger, the optimal path and velocity vector of high speed platform passenger is obtained with this, to obtain the simulation result of the high speed platform evacuation situation after fire occurs, and high-speed rail platform evacuation egress scheme is worked out according to simulation result.

title_en: Air navigation aid, device, robot and the storage medium of unmanned machine people
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses air navigation aid, device, robot and the storage mediums of unmanned machine people, belong to field of navigation technology, wherein, which comprises obtain target location information and obtain the current location information of unpiloted current robot；Corresponding navigation information is determined according to the current location information of target location information and current robot, wherein navigation information is included at least from the current location of current robot to the run routing information of target position；Obtain the obstacle information that impact detector corresponding with each driving path detects；The corresponding barrier of unpiloted current robot evacuation is controlled according to navigation information and obstacle information and drives to target position.The solution of the present invention can be realized and be precisely controlled to unmanned machine people, be accurately controlled each barrier of the unmanned machine people identification when driving in path, and be effectively shielded from each barrier.

title_en: The adaptive emergency evacuation navigation system of large scale business synthesis

title_en: Roadside device, communication system, and pedestrian assistance method
abstract_en: A pedestrian terminal (1) transmits a message including pedestrian information from an ITS communication unit (12) to a roadside machine, the roadside machine (5) stores the pedestrian information included in the message as passage history information in a storage unit (34) when receiving the message transmitted from the pedestrian terminal (1) by an ITS communication unit (31), and a control unit (33) generates route guidance information (pedestrian assistance information) relating to an evacuation route at the time of occurrence of a disaster, particularly detects persons who need assistance such as elderly persons and who have a large number of dangerous actions, generates route guidance information for these persons, and transmits the message including the route guidance information to a pedestrian terminal (1) in the vicinity, based on the passage history information of the storage unit (34).

title_en: The intelligent evacuation system and method for Commercial Complex

title_en: Vehicle navigation device based on Beidou navigation

title_en: Indoor evacuation route guidance system

abstract_en: Disclosed is a guidance system of an indoor evacuation route which comprises: a disaster alarm server receiving disaster-related information from a sensor installed indoors to determine whether the disaster has occurred and generating evacuation route information, based on a plan view corresponding to current location information of a user terminal and the disaster-related information to transmit the evacuation route information to the user terminal; and a user terminal receiving and outputting the evacuation route information.
abstract_ko: 실내 대피 경로 안내 시스템이 개시되며, 상기 실내 대피 경로 안내 시스템은 실내에 설치된 센서로부터 재난 연관 정보를 수신하여 재난 발생 여부를 판단하고, 사용자 단말의 현재 위치 정보에 대응하는 평면도 및 상기 재난 연관 정보를 기초로 하여 대피 경로 정보를 생성하여 사용자 단말로 송신하는 재난 경보 서버; 및 상기 대피 경로 정보를 수신하여 출력하는 사용자 단말을 포함한다.

title_en: A kind of rescue route guidance method and system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to rescue route guidance method, its implementation is as follows: being respectively provided with multiple fountain heads right above all channels in building and adjusts the adjusted device in fountain head direction；Whole fire area is built in sensor acquisition, preferably goes out best escape route according to fire area and building internal channel distribution situation from the background；All fountain heads work in Background control fire area and in adjacent domain, and according to best escape route, it controls adjusted device adjusting fountain head water spraying direction and is directed toward；When fire occurs, after backstage obtains actual fire region by sensor, best escape route is formulated according to fire area and building internal channel distribution situation, and the water spraying direction that adjusted device adjusts fountain head is controlled, fountain head sprays slanting water column, not only reduces the temperature of passage area, help to reduce open fire, the flue dust etc. on channel, direction guide is provided simultaneously, trapped person is helped quickly to withdraw conflagration area, improves reliability and safety.

title_en: Evacuation route guidance system and evacuation route guidance method
abstract_en: To provide a technique which can guide an evacuation route by a simple configuration.SOLUTION: An evacuation route guidance system 1 comprises a plurality of evacuation route guiding devices 5 installed in a passageway 2 passable in both directions spaced apart up to an exit. The evacuation route guiding device 5 installed at an end generates an exit signal as a route signal in a specific cycle and transmits the exit signal to the adjacent evacuation route guiding devices 5. The evacuation route guiding device 5 installed midway includes: a communication control unit for transferring the exit signal received from one evacuation route guiding device to the other evacuation route guiding device, and transferring the exit signal received from the other evacuation route guiding device to the one evacuation route guiding device 5; and a guidance control unit for notifying, on the basis of the received exit signal, a first evacuation direction that is a passage direction in which the one evacuation route guiding device 5 is installed, and notifying, on the basis of the received exit signal, a second evacuation direction that is a passage direction in which the other evacuation route guiding device is installed.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: A kind of interior crowd evacuation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of indoor crowd evacuation method, this method includes model of place initialization: according to the plan view of the construction venue where pedestrian, plan view being carried out to divide generation cellular space by meshing rule, and initialize cellular space；Pedestrian evacuates step: on the basis of being determined that cellular state updates rule, the cellular for allowing each pedestrian to occupy, according to regular carry out state update, and records the position of pedestrian in each time step until that all pedestrians flee from is out of the venue in discrete time step；Path planning: according to the operation result of model and the identity of pedestrian, route planning information is provided to each pedestrian, it is guided to flee from venue；The present invention considers various factors, so that the efficiency of crowd evacuation can be improved by this method when disaster occurs, avoid it is crowded, meanwhile, a path planning can be provided for everyone using this method, it guides everyone to leave building or venue, and avoids generating collision with other people.

title_en: Route planning method and system based on combination of safety evacuation signs and reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a route planning method and system based on combination of safety evacuation signs and reinforcement learning. The path planning method comprises the steps of establishing and rasterizing a two-dimensional simulation scene model, and initializing obstacles, intelligent agents and safety evacuation indication marks in the two-dimensional simulation scene model; the route planning is carried out by combining the safe evacuation indicator and the Q-Learning algorithm, and the specific process is as follows: initializing the Q value corresponding to each agent in the Q value table to be 0; acquiring the state information of each intelligent agent at the current moment, calculating corresponding rewards, and selecting actions with large corresponding Q values to move each intelligent agent; calculating the instant reward of each agent moving to a new position, updating the Q value table, judging whether the Q value table is converged, and if so, obtaining an optimal path sequence; otherwise, receiving and summarizing the input environment information and the corresponding state, the action made, the obtained reward and the output environment information sent by each intelligent agent, distributing the summarized information to each intelligent agent, and continuously moving each intelligent agent.

title_en: A kind of indoor three-dimensional expression model towards fire disaster emergency evacuation
abstract_en: The invention belongs to geospatial information system technical fields, a kind of indoor three-dimensional expression model towards fire disaster emergency evacuation are provided, to provide model support for inside fire emergency evacuation path planning.The present invention includes: position data module, semantic data module, intensity of a fire parameter module, position data module includes absolute position indoor location abstract class, indoor location element, semantic data module includes entrance, unitary space, unitary space boundary, barrier and fire fighting device, the intensity of a fire parameter module includes the intensity of a fire parameter of entrance and unitary space, and three modules of association construct complete model.The present invention fully considers the factor that emergency evacuation is influenced under Fire Conditions: building location information, building semantic feature information and intensity of a fire parameter information, intelligence, safe and efficient fire constraint information are provided for user, to reduce the loss of fire bring to greatest extent.

title_en: Navigation method and device for personnel evacuation path
abstract_en: The application provides a personnel evacuation path navigation method and a device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: under the condition that a fire is detected, determining a simulation scene which is most similar to the fire scene from preset simulation scenes as an optimal simulation scene, determining escape paths of all simulation personnel corresponding to the optimal simulation scene according to a preset corresponding relation to serve as navigation paths of the fire scene, determining escape paths of all real personnel in the fire scene according to the navigation paths of the fire scene, and informing all real personnel of the escape paths of all real personnel. When real people escape according to the escape route sent by the application, casualty conditions in a fire scene can be effectively reduced.

title_en: Disaster escape route guidance system
abstract_en: To accurately estimate a route for safe escape of a plurality of escapees from a building at the time of a disaster.SOLUTION: When a communication terminal of each escapee receives a signal from any of transmitters, it transmits transmitter ID of the transmitter to a management server. The management server receives the transmitter ID from each communication terminal, stores the received transmitter ID in a memory in association with the reception time, converts the time history of multiple pieces of transmission ID stored in the memory into time history of a plurality of spatial coordinate values representing installation positions of the corresponding transmitters for each escapee, estimates escape routes A, B, and C of each escapee from the time history of the plurality of spatial coordinate values for each escapee, and estimates part locally common to each other of the plurality of escape routes estimated to be individually used by the plurality of escapees as a success escape route commonly used by the escapees.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 13

title_en: A kind of indoor and outdoor evacuation emulation method that actual situation combines
abstract_en: The invention discloses the indoor and outdoor evacuation emulation methods that a kind of actual situation combines, the present invention is specifically includes the following steps: S1, the subject area studied according to evacuation, S2, it is positioned by the sensor built in mobile phone, outdoor application GPS and inertial navigation sensors auxiliary positioning, S3, after obtaining position, it is associated with virtual emulation space and real space by position, the present invention relates to geospatial information system technical fields.The indoor and outdoor evacuation emulation method that the actual situation combines, it overcomes merely using the untrue defect of result brought by virtual evacuation emulation, it solves to reproduce the difficulty that disaster influences in real scene, and the experience for participating in evacuation personnel augmented reality is given by virtual reality fusion, have both evacuation emulation result using the high-efficient characteristic of magnanimity emulation body and using the data reliability of true personnel, invention can be applied in the evacuation effectiveness analysis for various indoor and outdoor complex scenes, and during formulation emergency preplan.

title_en: The system helps people(users) escape from a place occurred disaster such as fire with many network devices, sensors and application(or software). They gather all information for a disaster and location of people(users) then transmit them into the server. Now, the server calculates and analyzes them and make the safest path toward safety places(or exits) and transmits the path to the people(users) as a navigation information and controls all extinguish devices.
title_ko: WiFi 및 Bluetooth등의 여러 네트워크 장치들과 다양한 센서 및 Application(또는 소프트웨어)을 사용하여, 화재등의 사고가 발생한 경우, 사용자의 위치, 사고발생의 위치 및 현재 상황등의 정보를 입수, 서버에 전송하고, 서버는 사용자와 대피장소(또는 출구)간의 가장 안전한 경로를 생성하여, 사용자에게 네비게이션 정보로 전송하고, 이와 동시에 사고장소에 설치된 소화장치를 동작시켜 스스로 소화하는 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a self-extinguished system, in case of an accident such as a fire, by figuring out a precise location of the accident, collecting precise information such as a current situation or the like, transmitting the information to a user and a management server, figuring out a current location of the user and calculating and transmitting a route for evacuating the location of the accident by using various network devices and sensors.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은, 
여러종류의 네트워크장치와 센서들을 사용하여, 화재와 같은 사고발생 시, 정확한 사고발생위치를 파악하고 현재상황등의 정확한 정보를 수집하여 사용자 및 관리 
서버에 전달하고, 사용자의 현재 위치를 파악하여 사고 발생지역을 가장 안전하게 대피할 수 있도록 경로를 계산하여 전송하고, 이와 동시에 스스로 화재를 진압하는 시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Fire safety management system using mobile system
title_ko: 모바일 시스템을 이용한 소방 화재 안전관리 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a firefighting fire safety management system using a mobile system, which installs an evacuation navigation application on the PC in a hospitality or vessel used by many people and a mobile terminal carried by all on-site personnel, terminates the application executed on the PC and the mobile terminal when the fire occurs and executes an evacuation navigation application to guide the shortest path to the emergency exit at the same time, and operates a visual guiding means and an auditory guiding means installed in the emergency exit by an infrared signal transmitted from the mobile terminal, thereby allowing people to evacuate faster and safer.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 모바일 시스템을 이용한 소방 화재 안전관리 시스템에 관한 것으로, 많은 사람들이 이용하는 접객업소 또는 선박에 비치된 피씨와 모든 장내 인원이 휴대하는 모바일 단말기에 대피용 내비게이션 앱을 설치하고, 화재 발생시 피씨와 모바일 단말기에서 실행 중인 앱을 종료시킴과 동시에 대피용 내비게이션 앱이 실행되어 비상구까지의 최단경로를 안내하도록 하고, 모바일 단말기에서 송출되는 적외선신호에 의해 비상구에 설치된 시각적 안내수단과 청각적 안내수단이 작동하도록 함으로써 보다 신속하고 안전하게 대피할 수 있도록 한 것이다.

title_en: Indoor emergency evacuation navigation system
abstract_en: The utility model provides an indoor emergency evacuation navigation system, which comprises a plurality of fire-fighting equipments distributed in the building, wherein the fire-fighting equipments are provided with a beacon device (beacon), the fire-fighting equipments are provided with a battery or are electrically connected with an emergency generator, and an application program and building map data are stored in the mobile electronic device of personnel; when the building has an emergency and the power is cut off, the fire-fighting equipment can supply power to drive the beacon device to operate, so that the beacon device continuously plays a beacon signal in a non-power-off mode, personnel can receive each beacon signal through the mobile electronic device, the application program calculates a positioning signal according to the beacon signal, the screen of the mobile electronic device displays map data and maps the positioning signal on the map data of the screen, and therefore the relative position of the personnel between the indoor part and the exit of the building is positioned, and the personnel are helped to escape.

title_en: Adaptive heuristics based load balancing method and evacuation guiding system
title_ko: 적응형 휴리스틱기반 부하 분산 방법 및 대피 유도 장치
abstract_en: Disclosed are an adaptive heuristic-based load balancing method and an evacuation guidance device. According to one embodiment of the present invention, the load balancing method performed in the evacuation guidance device comprises the steps of: calculating an evaluation function based on sensing data collected from each node; generating an evacuation route in accordance with the calculated evaluation function; and re-discovering the evacuation route by applying load balancing considering risk factors included in the sensing data.
abstract_ko: 적응형 휴리스틱기반 부하 분산 방법 및 대피 유도 장치가 개시된다.  일 실시예에 따른 대피 유도 장치에서 수행되는 부하 분산 방법은, 각 노드에서 수집된 센싱 데이터에 기반하여 평가함수를 계산하는 단계; 상기 계산된 평가함수에 따른 대피 경로를 생성하는 단계; 및 상기 센싱 데이터에 포함된 위험인자를 고려한 부하 분산을 적용하여 대피 경로를 재탐색하는 단계를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Server and fire disaster escaping method
abstract_en: A kind of server and fire disaster escaping method this method comprises: the server receives environmental parameter, and judge in monitored environment according to the environmental parameter with the presence or absence of danger；When dangerous in the monitored environment, the server receives all dangerous location informations in the monitored environment, and indicates all danger zones in the electronic map in the monitored environment according to all dangerous location informations；And the nearest exit marking in the position outside all danger zones from the mobile communication terminal is extra exit also in the electronic map by the server, it and by the shortest path planning without any danger zone between the position of the mobile communication terminal and the extra exit is best escape route, and sending has the electronic map of the best escape route and all danger zones to the mobile communication terminal.Implement the present invention, can be convenient user and flee danger region as early as possible.
assignees: SHENZHEN FUTAIHONG PREC IND CO;CHIUN MAI COMMUNICATION SYSTEMS INC

title_en: Trackside automatic driving vehicle Position Fixing Navigation System and single, multiple vehicle positioning and navigation methods
abstract_en: Trackside automatic driving vehicle Position Fixing Navigation System and single, multiple vehicle positioning and navigation methods, belong to Vehicular automatic driving field.Area more than the shelters such as existing building or harbour has that automatic Pilot navigation system signal transmission performance is poor, navigation error is big using global positioning satellite (GNSS) and inertial navigation technology.Trackside automatic driving vehicle Position Fixing Navigation System and single, multiple vehicle positioning and navigation methods, navigation system includes one group of trackside positioning navigation unit and one group of vehicle mounted guidance unit, one group of trackside positioning navigation unit is arranged in roadside, the effective search coverage overlapping of generation between every two adjacent trackside positioning navigation unit, each vehicle mounted guidance unit is arranged on the vehicle of a progress automatic Pilot, and each vehicle mounted guidance unit in each trackside positioning navigation unit and effective search coverage carries out communication interaction.

title_en: Based on evacuation path planing method in the fireman room for improving A* algorithm
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of based on evacuation path planing method in the fireman room for improving A* algorithm, belong to indoor Path Planning Technique field, it include: that and fireman's maximum is set can establish actual cost function and estimate cost function according to fireman at a distance from extra exit by radius；Heuristic searching function is established according to actual cost function and estimate cost function；The time is used according to air respiratorresuscitator, adds weight into heuristic searching function；Air respiratorresuscitator is used into time normalization；Normalization data is attached in heuristic searching function as weight, and selection of the dynamic adjustment with tradeoff algorithm in terms of accuracy and directionality obtains the A* algorithmic formula under dynamic tradeoffs.The present invention is using the air respiratorresuscitator time as the dynamic tradeoffs method of weight, so that programme path can be according to actual use situation, dynamic, which updates, withdraws programme path, while guaranteeing route validity, tradeoff is carried out in terms of the accuracy of route and directionality and dynamic adjusts.

title_en: Internet of vehicles emergency communication method, device and system
abstract_en: The invention provides an emergency communication method, a device and a system for Internet of vehicles, wherein the method comprises the following steps: monitoring the communication state of the return link; starting an emergency communication mode when the communication of the return link is interrupted; format conversion is carried out on first communication data sent by each Internet of vehicles terminal and second communication data sent by a central node according to a preset communication data protocol, and corresponding first emergency communication data and second emergency communication data are generated; and sending the first emergency communication data to the central node through a preset satellite communication link, and sending the second emergency communication data to each Internet of vehicles terminal through an Internet of vehicles communication link. The normal communication between the central node and the vehicles in the communication interruption area is ensured through a satellite communication mode, and then communication links between the vehicles in the disaster area, roadside equipment and the outside can be established rapidly, so that the outside can know the distribution situation of the vehicles or personnel in the disaster area rapidly, and send information such as disaster relief scheduling instructions and evacuation path planning schemes to the vehicles or personnel in the disaster area.

title_en: A kind of the personnel's refuge apparatus and method of floating production of hydrocarbons platform
abstract_en: A kind of the personnel's refuge apparatus and method of floating production of hydrocarbons platform, floating production of hydrocarbons platform is divided into separable two parts, what a part was located at stem or stern can navigational equipment, another part is floating production of hydrocarbons main platform body part, including various technical modules, and it is equipped with control room and living area on two parts, while point is occurred according to accident, personnel's evacuation route is effectively planned and indicator light is shown；This method takes refuge for floating production of hydrocarbons platform personnel and provides a kind of efficient solution, the rapidity and safety that the personnel of greatly improving take refuge, avoid accident there is a phenomenon where when personnel take refuge and cause confusion and secondary injury, by way of separating floating production of hydrocarbons platform, the life security of staff is not only ensured, during waiting for rescue, the living problem of staff has also been ensured, to reduce causality loss.
assignees: TIANJIN UNIV MARINE TECHNOLOGY RESEARCH INSTITUTE

title_en: Emergency fire evacuation guidance system
title_ko: 화재 대피 경로 안내 시스템
abstract_en: Provided is a fire evacuation route guidance system. The fire evacuation route guidance system comprises: a number of fire detectors placed inside the building to detect a fire; a plurality of light sources disposed inside the building and guiding an evacuation route when a fire occurs; and a controller receiving a fire location from at least one fire detector located at a fire occurrence point, selecting an optimal evacuation route among preset evacuation routes in accordance with the fire location, and activating the light sources located in the selected evacuation route.
abstract_ko: 화재 대피 경로 안내 시스템이 제공된다. 화재 대피 경로 안내 시스템은 건물 내부에 배치되어 화재를 검출하는 다수의 화재 감지기들, 상기 건물 내부에 배치되며, 화재 시 대피 경로를 안내하는 다수의 광원들, 및 화재 발생 지점에 위치한 적어도 하나의 화재 감지기로부터 화재 위치를 수신하며, 상기 화재 위치에 따라 기설정된 대피 경로들 중 최적 대피 경로가 선택되고, 상기 선택된 대피 경로에 위치한 광원들을 작동시키는 제어기를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Route or travel by vehicle analysis method, device, server and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of route or travel by vehicle analysis method, device, server and computer readable storage mediums, this method comprises: receiving the information of the travel route of the first vehicle；It gives notice information to travel route by corresponding second vehicle in region, notification information is for notifying the second vehicle to avoid the first vehicle；The response message of the second vehicle is received, response message indicates whether the second vehicle avoids the first vehicle；The first vehicle whether is avoided according to the second vehicle, notifies whether the first route or travel by vehicle is feasible.According to the technique and scheme of the present invention, it is not passively to adjust travel route according to congestion in road situation, but according to the travel route of automobile navigation, evacuation notice is issued to other vehicles along the line, with road improvement jam situation.

title_en: Method for actively guiding emergency evacuation route
title_ko: 능동적 긴급 대피 경로 안내 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for actively guiding an emergency evacuation route, which informs a dangerous section, which is recognized when an evacuation circumstance arises, to a smart device carried by a person in a management area such that the smart device may generate an evacuation route avoiding the dangerous section and guide along the evacuation route. Furthermore, the dangerous section which is not recognized or is additionally generated is found corresponding to the moving route of the smart device before being shared by all smart devices in the management area through remote support. Therefore, the amount of communication data and the communication cycle of the smart devices are minimized to solve the problem of data traffic in the evacuation circumstance, thereby allowing everyone in the management area to safely evacuate. To this end, an evacuation guiding application is installed in a smart device (40) entering a management area (1). Then, an evacuation route map and a beacon arrangement map in the management area (1) are stored therein. In addition, when an evacuation circumstance arises in the management area, a dangerous section is relayed by a server (30) such that the smart device may self-generate an evacuation route avoiding the dangerous section before guiding. Not only that, when the smart device deviates from the evacuation route, the deviation location is added as a dangerous section before being relayed.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 대피 상황이 발생할 시에 알게 된 위험 구역을 관리 영역 내의 사람이 휴대한 스마트 기기에게 알려서, 스마트 기기 자체에서 위험 구역을 회피한 대피 경로를 생성하고 대피 경로를 따라 안내하며, 알지 못하였거나 추가 발생한 위험 구역을 스마트 기기의 이동 경로에 따라 찾아내어 관리 영역 내의 모든 스마트 기기가 공유하도록 원격 지원함으로써, 스마트 기기의 통신 데이터량 및 통신 주기를 최소화하여 대피 상황 시의 데이터 트래픽 문제를 해결하면서, 관리 영역 내 모든 사람이 안전하게 대피하게 하는 능동적 긴급 대피 경로 안내 방법에 관한 것으로서, 관리 영역(1)에 진입하는 스마트 기기(40)에게 대피 안내 애플리케이션을 설치하고, 관리 영역(1)의 대피 통로맵 및 비콘 배치맵을 저장하게 하며, 이후, 관리 영역에서 대피 상황이 발생할 시에 위험 구역을 서버(30)에서 중계하여, 위험 구역을 회피하는 대피 경로를 자체 생성한 후 안내하게 하고, 대피 경로를 이탈할 시에 이탈 위치를 위험 구역으로 추가하여 중계한다.
assignees: NOW AND FUTURE TECH CO LTD

title_en: MSC-based marine personnel emergency escape path planning method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of evaluation of ship personnel evacuation capacity, and particularly relates to a marine personnel emergency escape path planning method based on an MSC (Mobile switching center). On the basis of the shortest path, the number of personnel on the path, namely the crowding degree problem, is comprehensively considered, the evacuation time factor is checked and judged, and the optimal evacuation route is finally planned, so that the evacuation capacity of ship personnel can be evaluated in the early design stage, the optimal evacuation route for emergency escape of personnel is planned, and the method has great theoretical value and social significance for designing the ship, setting emergency situations, making evacuation plans and even promoting the safety of the shipping industry.

title_en: LORA-based intelligent evacuation method for commercial complex
abstract_en: the invention discloses a commercial complex intelligent evacuation method based on LORA, which comprises the following steps: firstly, arranging a commercial complex intelligent evacuation system; secondly, collecting fire information; thirdly, judging whether a fire disaster occurs in the commercial comprehensive body; fourthly, generating a road network; fifthly, determining an optimal evacuation path; sixthly, the commercial complex intelligent evacuation system assists people evacuation; and seventhly, updating the road network until all the personnel are safely evacuated. The invention utilizes the LORA technology to have the advantages of long transmission distance, simple networking and low price, constructs a commercial complex intelligent evacuation system, combines a load balance principle during evacuation path planning, takes the region with personnel as a target group, generates the fastest safe evacuation path according to the fire scene information, simultaneously utilizes a fire information monitoring module to accurately acquire the internal information of the fire scene, optimizes and updates a road network and the optimal evacuation path, realizes the uniform distribution of the quantity of personnel at each safe exit, improves the utilization rate of each safe exit and accelerates the evacuation speed of the personnel from personnel distribution.

title_en: Airport terminal environment autonomous inspection vehicle monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an airport terminal building environment autonomous patrol vehicle monitoring system which comprises a monitoring analysis server, a patrol vehicle, a main control driving module, a navigation positioning drawing module, a WiFi communication module and an environment monitoring module, wherein the main control driving module, the navigation positioning drawing module, the WiFi communication module and the environment monitoring module are arranged on the patrol vehicle. The invention realizes the functions of real-time environment monitoring of the airport terminal, emergency early warning, passenger evacuation, feedback control of a heating and ventilation system or a broadcasting system and the like, and high-efficiency adjustment of airport operation management, and the like, and improves the safety of the terminal and the traveling comfort of passengers. Compared with the traditional manual inspection method, the number of airport safety guarantee personnel is greatly reduced, and the environment monitoring quality and the operation and maintenance work efficiency are improved.

title_en: Path planning method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a path planning method, a path planning device, computer equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of security and protection. The method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining a time sequence map of a specified area at a first moment, conducting N-round updating on position points where planning objects are located according to the time sequence map of the first moment, obtaining time sequence maps of N moments after the first moment, enabling the time sequence map of the ith moment in the N moments to be based on the time sequence map of the (i-1) -th moment, enabling the position points where the planning objects are located to move towards an exit of the specified area in sequence according to occupation information of the position points in the specified area, and obtaining paths where the planning objects reach the exit of the specified area according to the time sequence maps of the N moments. According to the scheme, the situation that two or more individuals reach a certain position at the same time according to the optimal path and are blocked mutually so as to cause congestion can be avoided, the accuracy of path planning is improved, and the crowd evacuation efficiency is improved.

title_en: Intelligent safety monitoring system based on big data calculation
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent safety monitoring system based on big data calculation, which comprises a data processing module, and a people flow detection module, a smoke detection module, a temperature detection module, an escape navigation module, a mobile display module, a mobile positioning module and a voice output module which are connected with the data processing module, wherein the escape navigation module, the mobile display module, the mobile positioning module and the voice output module are all taken by a user by taking a portable terminal as a carrier. The invention is based on big data calculation and processing, can effectively improve the escape rate, can analyze a better escape route in real time according to the surrounding conditions during the waiting rescue time, and can help the masses escape from the fire scene at the first time, thereby greatly reducing the workload of fire fighters, improving the rescue quality and fully ensuring the life safety of the masses.
assignees: MAANSHAN WENDING NETWORK TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Navigation receiving system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a navigation receiving system, this navigation receiving system includes: the system comprises a differential data acquisition module, an inertia measurement module and a global satellite navigation module; the differential data acquisition module and the inertia measurement module are connected and are electrically connected with the global satellite navigation system; the differential data acquisition module is used for acquiring the real-time reference station differential data and transmitting the real-time reference station differential data to the global satellite navigation module; the inertia measurement module is used for measuring the attitude information of the vehicle to be measured and transmitting the attitude information to the global satellite navigation module; the global satellite navigation module is used for receiving satellite positioning data and acquiring the position information of the detected vehicle according to the real-time reference station differential data, the attitude information and the satellite positioning data. The embodiment of the utility model provides a navigation receiving system has realized carrying out the function of accurate positioning in the weak region of global satellite positioning signal or sheltering from the environment.
assignees: SHANGHAI HUACE NAVIGATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Evacuation route guidance system in a building based on augmented reality
title_ko: 증강현실 기반 건물 내 피난경로 안내 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an augmented reality (AR)-based evacuation route guidance system for guiding evacuation routes using AR in various disaster sites such as fire and earthquake in indoor and outdoor environments such as subways and buildings. According to the present invention, a route guidance method in a mobile terminal comprises the steps of: executing an evacuation route guidance application; identifying a building where a terminal is located; determining whether evacuation route information for the identified building exists; generating AR content including the evacuation route information; and displaying the generated AR content in a camera view mode. Accordingly, a building structure and shape of the target building can be synthesized and expressed in real time on the terminal to a terminal user, and an evacuation route guidance sign can be displayed at the same time as the fastest evacuation route so that the user can safely and quickly escape from the disaster site.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 지하철, 건물 등의 실내·실외 환경에서 화재·지진 등 각종 재난 현장에서 증강 현실(AR)을 이용하여 피난 경로를 안내하는 증강현실 기반 피난 경로 안내 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명은 피난경로 안내 어플리케이션을 실행하는 단계, 단말기가 위치하는 건물을 확인하는 단계, 상기 확인된 건물에 대한 피난경로 정보가 존재하는지 판단하는 단계, 상기 피난경로 정보를 포함하여 증강현실(AR) 콘텐츠를 생성하는 단계, 상기 생성된 증강현실 콘텐츠를 카메라뷰 모드에서 디스플레이하는 단계를 포함한다. 
따라서 단말기 사용자에게 실시간으로 해당 대상 건물 내의 건물 구조와 형태를 단말기에 실시간으로 합성하여 구현하고 가장 빠른 탈출로 길 안내 표시를 동시에 표출시켜 재난 현장에서 안전하고 신속히 탈출을 할 수 있게 한다.

title_en: System for controlling evacuation route guidance with smart direction indicator light using beacon and method thereof
title_ko: 양방향 비콘의 위치 기반을 이용한 스마트 방향 지시 유도등을 구비하는 대피 경로 유도 제어 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for controlling evacuation route guidance providing smart direction indicating guidance light based on a location of a bidirectional beacon, and to a method thereof. The system for controlling evacuation route guidance uses a location of a bidirectional beacon installed in multiple types of smart direction indicating guidance to switch an evacuation direction to provide an optimal evacuation route when an emergency situation occurs. The system for controlling evacuation route guidance may provide an optimal evacuation route for a situation of an emergency evacuee by interlocking with a bidirectional beacon of the smart direction indicating guidance light and a smartphone of the emergency evacuee. According to the present invention, when the emergency situation occurs, the evacuation direction of the smart direction indicating guidance light is provided to guide a safe evacuation route, thereby providing the optimal emergency evacuation route in accordance with a location, movements, and moving speed of the emergency evacuee.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 양방향 비콘의 위치 기반을 이용한 스마트 방향 지시 유도등을 구비하는 대피 경로 유도 제어 시스템 및 그 방법에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 대피 경로 유도 제어 시스템은 복수 개의 스마트 방향 지시 유도들에 설치된 양방향 비콘의 위치 기반을 이용하여 비상 상황 발생 시, 최적의 대피 경로를 제공하도록 대피 방향을 절환한다. 또 본 발명의 대피 경로 유도 제어 시스템은 스마트 방향 지시 유도등의 양방향 비콘과 비상 대피자의 스마트 폰과 연동해서 비상 대피자의 상황에 맞는 최적의 대피 경로를 제공할 수 있다. 본 발명에 의하면, 비상 상황 발생 시, 스마트 방향 지시 유도등의 대피 방향을 제공하여 안전한 대피 경로를 가이드하도록 함으로써, 비상 대피자의 위치, 이동 여부 및 이동 속도 등의 상황에 따라 최적의 비상 대피 경로를 제공할 수 있다.

title_en: Portable side slope monitoring radar emergency rescue car
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mobile slope monitoring radar emergency rescue vehicle, which comprises a carrying system, an electric control system, a radar system, an air conditioning system, a video monitoring system, a meteorological monitoring system and a lightning protection system; the carrying system comprises a trailer chassis, and a shelter is arranged on the trailer chassis; the electric control system comprises a direct current power supply system and an alternating current power supply system, and the air conditioning system comprises a small 1P split air conditioner and a fuel heater; the lightning protection system comprises a direct lightning protection system, an induction lightning protection system and a grounding system. The intelligent control system further comprises a vibration reduction system, a Beidou navigation system, a wireless communication system, a remote control system, an electric leveling system, a commercial power input port, an oil filling port, a ventilation shutter, a solar panel, a pedaling step, a guy rope and a ground drill rod, a folding top-climbing ladder and the like. The wireless monitoring system has the functions of flexible movement, simple installation, rapid deployment, wireless communication and the like, can be suitable for slope landslide monitoring and emergency rescue, and can continuously work for 20 days in the field without an external power supply.

title_en: Indoor navigation car based on laser SLAM
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an indoor navigation car based on laser SLAM, including vehicle chassis, four mecanum wheels, chassis driving system, laser SLAM navigation and the DC power supply system who is used for the power supply, chassis driving system includes driver chip and microcontroller, mecanum wheel distributes with two a set of modes vehicle chassis both sides, microcontroller, driver chip and mecanum wheel connect gradually, laser SLAM navigation includes laser radar and miniature PC, laser radar sets up vehicle chassis's top is and do not shelter from in the side at least, DC power supply system connects respectively microcontroller's the power source interface who connects electric pin and miniature PC, the utility model discloses combine X86 framework and embedded system, can improve the continuation of the journey of system greatly.

title_en: Disaster escape route guidance system and disaster escape route guidance method
abstract_en: To provide a disaster escape route guidance system that accurately estimates a route for escape from a building at the time of a disaster.SOLUTION: A plurality of transmitters that transmit specific transmitter ID are discretely installed in a building having a plurality of floors. When a communication terminal of an escapee from the building receives a signal from any of the transmitters, it transmits transmitter ID of the signal to a server. The server estimates an escape route actually used by each escapee from a time history of the transmitter ID, estimates a common part of a plurality of escape routes estimated to be individually used by a plurality of escapees for each floor as a success escape route common to the escapees, estimates the level of escape difficulty from the building for each success escape route by calculating movement speed of each of the plurality of escapees along the same success escape route, generates escape guidance information on the basis of the success escape routes and the level of escape difficulty, and distributes the information to communication terminals of a plurality of other escapees.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 18

title_en: Source-of-sound based navigation for a visually-impaired user
abstract_en: User devices, methods, and computer-readable media are described for providing source-of-sound based navigation to a visually-impaired user. A sound detected at a user device of a visually-impaired user is categorized and an approximate location of a source of the sound is determined. A contextual analysis is performed based on the determined sound category such that the results of the contextual analysis indicate whether the visually-impaired user should be directed towards or away from the location of the sound source. An evacuation path is determined in those scenarios in which the user should be directed away from the detected sound and a tactile representation of the evacuation path is generated on a display of the visually-impaired user's device. A navigation path is determined in those scenarios in which the user should be directed towards the detected sound and a corresponding tactile representation thereof is generated.

title_en: Indoor evacuation auxiliary system based on ZigBee technology
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an indoor emergency management technology, in particular to an indoor evacuation auxiliary system based on ZigBee technology, which comprises a plurality of infrared opposite-emitting sensors, a disaster sensing sensor and LED lamps which are respectively arranged indoors, a ZigBee sensor network and a central control platform; the ZigBee sensor network comprises a coordinator node, a routing node and a plurality of terminal nodes; the infrared correlation sensors, the disaster sensing sensors and the LED lamps are respectively connected with terminal nodes and are accessed into coordinator nodes through different routing nodes, and the coordinator nodes are connected with the central control platform. The system has comprehensive integrated functions, and can realize indoor fire monitoring, evacuation path planning, evacuation scheme design and implementation of the evacuation scheme; the cost is low, the ZigBee nodes are easy to distribute indoors, and the deployment pressure is low; the ZigBee has a small size, and is provided with an independent power supply, so that normal use in special environments such as indoor fire and the like can be guaranteed.

title_en: Device for lighting emergency lead lamp
title_ko: 비상유도등 점등 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a device for turning on an emergency exit sign, which receives an operating signal by a reception device of the emergency exit sign and automatically turns on the emergency exit sign made of LEDs when a warning device for sounding a warning operates. Since a light emitting unit of the emergency exit sign is turned on immediately when the warning device operates by mounting a transmission device of the emergency exit sign, which transmits a wireless transmission signal for turning on the emergency exit sign at the same time as the warning device operates to a warning device assembly and mounting the reception device of the emergency exit sign, which receives the signal of the reception device of the emergency exit sign and turns on the light emitting unit of the emergency exit sign, to the warning device assembly, the auditory warning by the warning device and visual exit route guidance by the emergency exit sign may be simultaneously made.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 경보를 울리기 위한 경종기를 작동하면, 그 작동 신호를 비상유도등 수신장치에서 수신하여 LED로 이루어진 비상유도등이 자동으로 점등되도록 한 비상유도등 점등 장치에 관한 것이다. 
즉, 본 발명은 경종기 어셈블리에 경종기 작동과 동시에 비상유도등을 점등하라는 무선송신신호를 전송하는 비상등 송신장치를 장착하고, 비상유도등 어셈블리에 비상등 송신장치의 신호를 수신하여 비상유도등 발광부를 점등시키는 비상유도등 수신장치를 장착하여, 경종기의 작동시 곧바로 비상등 발광부가 점등되도록 함으로써, 경종기에 의한 청각적 경고와 비상유도등에 의한 시각적 대피통로 안내가 동시에 이루어질 수 있도록 한 비상유도등 점등 장치를 제공하고자 한 것이다.

title_en: Positioning and navigation system for roadside automatic driving vehicle
abstract_en: Roadside automated driving vehicle positioning navigation belongs to vehicle automated driving field. In areas with a large number of shelters such as existing large buildings or wharfs, the problems of poor signal transmission performance and large navigation error of an automatic driving navigation system exist by using Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) and inertial navigation technology. A roadside automatic driving vehicle positioning and navigation system comprises a group of roadside positioning and navigation units and a group of vehicle-mounted navigation units, wherein the group of roadside positioning and navigation units are arranged on the roadside, effective detection areas generated between every two adjacent roadside positioning and navigation units are overlapped, each vehicle-mounted navigation unit is arranged on a vehicle for automatic driving, and each roadside positioning and navigation unit is in communication interaction with each vehicle-mounted navigation unit in the effective detection areas.

title_en: Digital simulation map based on graphic coding, navigation system and navigation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital simulation map based on graphic coding, which comprises a map covering roads in a place, and is characterized by further comprising graphic coding devices, wherein one graphic coding device is respectively arranged at each end point of the roads in the place, and the information carried by the graphic coding devices comprises: a place ID for uniquely identifying a place; the graphic code ID is used for uniquely identifying the graphic code device in the site; the channel information is used for defining whether a channel exists in the corresponding direction; and adjacent figure coding information for defining the ID and distance of the adjacent figure coding device on the road corresponding to the direction. Meanwhile, the invention also provides a navigation system and a navigation method using the map. The invention can provide the functions of accurate positioning, active navigation and evacuation guidance for pedestrians without depending on a communication network in specific laminated and staggered indoor and outdoor complex three-dimensional spaces, and has high positioning precision and clear road direction identification.

title_en: Indoor intelligent evacuation route guidance display equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides an indoor intelligent evacuation route guidance display device, which comprises a control module, a storage module and a display module, wherein the control module comprises an interface unit and a processing unit, the interface unit is connected with the storage module and the display module, the processing unit comprises an external network access module and an evacuation route module, the external network access module acquires and evaluates the monitoring data of all sensors near the guidance display device from the external network, the evacuation route module is operated if a fire alarm occurs, the evacuation route module calls a relevant three-dimensional map in a building from the storage module, calculates an optimal evacuation route by combining the monitoring data analysis of the sensors and finally displays the optimal evacuation route on the display module, the display module can also simultaneously display the information of the position of fire fighting equipment, a call-for-help button, an alarm button and the like for the trapped people to reference and escape, meanwhile, the display module can play the audio and video file of the fire safety knowledge when no fire occurs, and the popularization work of fire fighting is started.

title_en: System, method, and program for specifying route for conveying supplies to evacuation site
abstract_en: [Problem] This invention relates to the Internet of things (IoT) and to the technical field described by, for example, International Patent Classification (IPC) G06Q. This invention addresses the problem of specifying the optimal route for conveying supplies to an evacuation site in a disaster. [Solution] A server 10 analyzes a disaster state after acquiring disaster information 18A (step S1), analyzes a transit state after acquiring traffic information 18B (step S2), and analyzes a population state after acquiring mobile terminal position information 18C (step S3). The server 10 specifies a route 22 for conveying supplies to the evacuation site on the basis of the analyzed disaster state, transit state, and population state. Further, the server 10 analyzes an attribute state after acquiring attribute information 18D from the mobile terminals 80 of evacuees (step S4) and determines what supply contents 24 to convey. The supply conveyance route 22 and supply contents 24 are presented to a user terminal 92 of a local government or country 90 (step S5).

title_en: Unmanned ship navigation positioning and communication device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an unmanned ship navigation location and communication device, including installation shell and location communication device, the outlet has been seted up to the lower terminal surface of installation shell, and the upper end corner of installation shell all through connection has the regulation pole, all seted up the regulation hole on adjusting pole and the installation shell, and the upper end fixedly connected with of adjusting the pole shelters from the canopy, the inside front side rotation of installation shell is connected with the threaded rod, and the right-hand member welded connection of threaded rod has the crank, the inside rear side fixedly connected with slide bar of installation shell, and all overlap on slide bar and the threaded rod and establish and be connected with the regulating block, the upper end fixedly connected with of regulating block supports the clamp splice, the equal welded connection of lower extreme corner of installation shell has the installation bottom block, the equal threaded connection in both ends has the screw cap around the dead lever. This unmanned ship navigation location and communication device conveniently carries out waterproof rain-proof processing, and the stable installation of also being convenient for simultaneously is fixed, avoids appearing the phenomenon that drops, influences the use.

title_en: Method and system for guiding an emergency evacuation route using a non-powered aisle guide light
title_ko: 무전원 통로 유도등을 이용한 비상 대피로 안내 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed are an emergency evacuation route guiding method using a non-powered passage guidance lamp and a system thereof. The emergency evacuation route guiding system using a non-powered passage guidance lamp includes: a non-powered passage guidance lamp receiving a radio frequency (RF) signal and emitting a light-emitting diode (LED) with no power to induce to guide an evacuation route; an RF signal generation device remotely supplying energy by transmitting the RF signal to the non-powered passage guidance lamp; and an emergency evacuation route guidance server transmitting a control signal through a wireless network to the RF signal generation device.
abstract_ko: 무전원 통로 유도등을 이용한 비상 대피로 안내 방법 및 시스템이 개시된다. 무전원 통로 유도등을 이용한 비상 대피로 안내 시스템은, RF(Radio Frequency) 신호를 수신하여 무전원으로 LED(Light-Emitting Diode)를 발광시켜 대피로를 지시하는 무전원 통로 유도등, 상기 무전원 통로 유도등에 RF 신호를 송신하여 원격으로 에너지를 공급하는 RF 신호 발생 장치 및 상기 RF 신호 발생 장치에 무선 네트워크를 통해 제어 신호를 전송하는 비상 대피로 안내 서버를 포함한다.

title_en: Emergency evacuation guidance system and method using sound
title_ko: 사운드를 이용한 비상 대피로 안내 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed is an emergency evacuation route guidance method, as a method for guiding an emergency evacuation route to a user in a building through a guide server interworking with at least one terminal module disposed at regular intervals in the building, which includes the steps of: guiding an evacuation direction at each speaker position through at least one speaker included in the terminal module according to a disaster situation; receiving a conversation mode triggering signal from the user and operating by switching to a conversation mode that performs two-way communication between the corresponding speaker and the user; determining whether a physically disabled person requiring evacuation assistance has occurred from a user input in the conversation mode, and when the physically disabled person requiring evacuation assistance occurs, switching the operation mode of the guide server to a support mode for collecting applicants who support the physically challenged who need evacuation support.
abstract_ko: 건물 내에 일정한 간격을 두고 배치되는 적어도 하나의 단말 모듈과 연동하는 안내 서버가 건물 내 사용자에게 비상 대피로를 안내하는 방법으로서, 재난 상황 발생에 따라 상기 단말 모듈이 포함하는 적어도 하나의 스피커를 통해 각 스피커 위치에서의 대피 방향을 안내하는 단계; 사용자로부터 대화 모드 트리거링 신호를 수신하고 해당 스피커 및 사용자 간의 양방향 통신을 수행하는 대화 모드로 전환하여 동작하는 단계; 상기 대화 모드에서의 사용자 입력으로부터 대피 지원이 필요한 신체약자가 발생하였는지 판단하고, 상기 대피 지원이 필요한 신체약자가 발생한 경우 상기 안내 서버의 동작 모드를 대피 지원이 필요한 신체약자를 지원하는 지원자를 모집하는 지원 모드로 전환하는 단계를 포함하는 비상 대피로 안내 방법이 개시된다.

title_en: Intelligent building management system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent building management system based on the Internet of things, which comprises a data acquisition system and a safety evacuation system; the data acquisition module is used for acquiring, storing, analyzing and processing information and data in the building, and the data transmission module is used for transmitting the data in the system through wireless signals; the method comprises the following steps of carrying out primary detection on abnormal conditions of a building through an abnormal alarm module in a safety evacuation system, and reminding users in the building; meanwhile, the position information of the abnormal area is positioned through an abnormal positioning module, the abnormal recognition unit recognizes and analyzes the disaster level of the abnormal area, and the abnormal condition of the abnormal area in the building is controlled through a fire control module; a user in the building logs in the user APP intelligent terminal to check the optimal evacuation channel route in the building obtained by the system according to self condition analysis, and the intelligent navigation unit conducts fire-fighting navigation work on the user to help the user in the building to break away from danger in time.
assignees: HEFEI RONGZHUANG ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent building management system and method using patrol robot
abstract_en: An intelligent building management system and method using patrol robot, there are building integrated controllers, the building integrated controller is connected with building equipment management system, fire alarm linkage system, video monitoring system and patrol robot separately; the building equipment management system is responsible for collecting data including building elevators, lamplight and door access; the fire alarm linkage system is responsible for collecting data including smoke alarm, fire hydrant and alarm, and keeping communication with a fire management department; at least one patrol robot is arranged on each floor and is responsible for daily patrol and collecting image data. The patrol robot is used for patrol, the intelligent degree is high, the management is convenient, the image information of the line area is collected in real time, and the existing monitoring blind area is compensated; the patrol robot has an indoor navigation function, is used for providing help for passers-by in daily life, can intelligently provide evacuation routes when unexpected events occur, quickly and accurately guide people to evacuate, and is safe and reliable.
assignees: CHONGQING KEWEI ROBOT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Self-navigating marine buoy and marine information system
abstract_en: This self-navigating marine buoy comprises a buoy body comprising a floating body, an internal sensor, a detection unit that receives information from a GPS signal and the internal sensor, a sea search part that searches the sea, an underwater search part that searches underwater, a determination unit that creates a navigation plan for the buoy body, a propulsion part that propels the buoy body, a navigation control unit that controls the driving of the propulsion part so that the buoy body navigates according to the navigation plan, a power-generating part, a power storage part, a communication unit that communicates with the outside world, an emergency signal unit that receives a distress signal and identifies the transmitting position of the distress signal, and an evacuation chamber that accommodates survivors. The self-navigating buoy has a self-navigation mode for self-navigating to a set sea position, a fixed position mode for autonomously maintaining a fixed position at the set sea position, and a rescue mode for self-navigating to the transmitting position of a distress signal on the sea when the distress signal is received.

title_en: System and method for shortest providing evacuation route
title_ko: 최단 대피 경로 안내 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: A system for providing the shortest evacuation route includes: a beacon configured to detect whether a user is located inside a building; a fire sensor configured to generate fire information by measuring information related to a fire accident; a management server configured to determine whether a fire occurs by analyzing the fire information, generate user guiding information reflecting a fire zone and the shortest evacuation route to be given to the user if it is determined that a fire accident occurs, and generate firefighter guiding information reflecting the fire zone and the shortest evacuation route; a user terminal configured to display a drawing of the inside reflecting the fire zone and the shortest evacuation route as image information; and a firefighter terminal configured to display the drawing of the inside reflecting the fire zone and the shortest evacuation route as image information. Accordingly, the user can quickly leave a dangerous area and the firefighter can quickly evacuate the user inside the building.
abstract_ko: 최단 대피 경로 안내 시스템은, 사용자가 건물 내부에 위치하는지 여부를 감지하는 비콘; 화재사고와 관련된 정보를 측정하여 화재정보를 생성하는 화재감지센서; 화재정보를 분석하여 화재 발생여부를 판단하되, 화재사고가 발생한 것으로 판단되는 경우 사용자에게 제공하기 위한 화재발생구역 및 최단 대피 경로가 반영된 사용자 안내정보를 생성하고, 소방대원에게 제공하기 위한 화재발생구역 및 최단 진입 경로가 반영된 소방대원 안내정보를 생성하는 관리서버; 화재발생구역 및 최단 대피 경로가 반영된 내부도면을 이미지 정보로 표시하는 사용자단말; 및 화재발생구역 및 최단 진입 경로가 반영된 상기 내부도면을 이미지 정보로 표시하는 소방대원 단말;을 포함할 수 있다. 이에 따라, 사용자는 위험지역을 신속하게 이탈할 수 있고, 소방대원은 건물 내부에 위치한 사용자를 신속하게 대피시킬 수 있다.

title_en: Shortest shelter course guidence system using the disaster information
title_ko: 재난발생정보를 이용한 최단 대피경로 안내 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a shortest shelter course guidance system using disaster information. The shortest shelter course guidance system comprises at least one location information collecting device, at least one environment information measuring device, and a rescue and evacuation guidance server connected, through a network, to at least one rescue and evacuation guidance device. More specifically, the shortest shelter course guidance system comprises: the location information collecting device for collecting location information; and the environment information measuring device including a fire detection sensor for sensing fire information and a gas sensor for sensing gas information; and the rescue and evacuation guidance server remotely controlling the rescue and evacuation guidance device for displaying rescue and evacuation guidance information. The rescue and evacuation guidance server divides a target zone, in which a disaster is expected to occur and which includes entrances and exits, into a plurality of zones and manages the same, and visually displays and guides an exit, with a shorted evacuation course, shortest to a corresponding disaster zone when a disaster occurs in a specific zone of the target zone.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 재난발생정보를 이용한 최단 대피경로 안내 시스템에 관한 것으로, 적어도 하나의 위치정보 수집장치, 적어도 하나의 환경정보 측정장치, 적어도 하나의 구조 및 대피 안내장치와 네트워크로 연결된 구조 및 대피 안내서버를 포함하고, 위치정보를 수집하는 상기 위치정보 수집장치, 화재정보를 센싱하는 화재감지 센서, 가스정보를 센싱하는 가스 센서를 포함하는 상기 환경정보 측정장치, 구조 및 대피 안내정보를 표시하는 상기 구조 및 대피 안내장치를 원격 제어하는 상기 구조 및 대피 안내서버를 포함하며, 상기 구조 및 대피 안내서버는 재난 발생이 예상되며 출구와 입구를 포함하고 있는 대상지역을 복수개의 구역(ZONE)으로 구분하여 관리하며, 상기 대상지역의 특정 구역에서 재난이 발생된 경우, 해당 재난발생 구역으로부터 최단거리의 출구를 최단 대피경로로 시각적으로 표시하여 안내하는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: OH KYOUNG COMPUTER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Smart evacuation route guidance system based on real-time smoke and fire detection, and method for the same
title_ko: 실시간 연기 및 화염 감지에 기반한 스마트 피난로 안내 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: Provided are a smart evacuation path system based on the smoke and flame detection in real time and a method thereof. In the event of a fire in a skyscraper or large complex, the spread of smoke and the evacuation path in accordance with the smoke and flame detected in a plurality of Internet of Things (IoT) sensors installed inside are predicted in real time so as to guide an evacuation path through each of smartphone of occupants in real time. In addition, the evacuation time is determined in accordance with a location of the occupant in real time, and the evacuation path can be guided by determining the optimal evacuation path in accordance with a closed evacuation path in real time. In addition, various IoT sensors are applied to detect and predict the distribution of smoke and flames in real time so as to guide the optimal evacuation path to the occupants.
abstract_ko: 초고층건물이나 대형복합시설의 화재 발생시 내부에 다수 설치된 사물인터넷(IoT) 센서에서 감지된 연기나 화염에 따른 연기확산과 피난로를 실시간 예측하여 재실자 스마트폰 각각을 통해 피난로를 실시간 안내할 수 있고, 또한, 실시간 재실자 위치에 따라 대피시간을 결정하고, 실시간 폐쇄 피난로에 따른 최적 피난로를 결정하여 피난로를 안내할 수 있으며, 또한, 다양한 사물인터넷 센서를 적용하여 실시간으로 연기와 화염의 분포를 감지 및 예측하고 최적 피난로를 재실자에게 안내할 수 있는, 실시간 연기 및 화염 감지에 기반한 스마트 피난로 시스템 및 그 방법이 제공된다.
assignees: KOREA INST CIVIL ENG & BUILDING TECH

title_en: Indoor emergency evacuation navigation system
abstract_en: The invention provides an indoor emergency evacuation navigation system, which comprises a plurality of fire-fighting equipment distributed in a building, wherein the fire-fighting equipment is provided with a beacon device (beacon), is provided with a battery or is electrically connected with an emergency generator, and stores an application program and building map data in a mobile electronic device of personnel; when the building has an emergency and the power is cut off, the fire-fighting equipment can supply power to drive the beacon device to operate, so that the beacon device continuously plays a beacon signal in a non-power-off mode, personnel can receive each beacon signal through the mobile electronic device, the application program calculates a positioning signal according to the beacon signal, the screen of the mobile electronic device displays map data and maps the positioning signal on the map data of the screen, and therefore the relative position of the personnel between the indoor part and the exit of the building is positioned, and the personnel are helped to escape.

title_en: Novel glass fiber reinforced plastic fishery emergency rescue ship
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of the emergency tender technique and specifically relates to a novel glass steel fishery emergency rescue ship. The utility model discloses in, the hull material is the glass steel, the shell is the streamline dog-ear type, when speed reaches when certain, the hull relies on rivers power to coast the navigation, the navigational speed promotes by a wide margin, the high-speed navigation of boats and ships, carry out the law enforcement rapidly, the rescue task, this ship establishes the outer fossil fragments of tail slope and rudder support, be different from the structure of other similar high-speed ships, can strengthen the bottom structure, it maintains to sit the mounds on making things convenient for the hull, make the screw have higher efficiency and can protect paddle and rudder not receive fishing net and fishing rope winding in the navigation of fish raft district, effectively carry out the marine crowd that law enforcement business and rescue need shift, this cabin deck and cabin deck parallel and level, enlarge afterbody deck area, make things convenient for personnel's operation, the rescue, walking and evacuation.

title_en: Emergency evacuation guidance robot and method of controlling the same
title_ko: 화재 대피 유도로봇 및 이의 제어 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire evacuation guidance robot and a control method thereof. The fire evacuation guidance robot includes: a map generator that generates a map using the SLAM algorithm and measures the current coordinate based on the generated map; a route search unit searching for a route using the map; an imaging device that acquires a surrounding image; and a means of transportation. In a transport robot mode, the fire evacuation guide robot moves inside the building, and the map generator generates the map, analyzes the surrounding image acquired through the imaging device, stores the first coordinates when a person is identified, and stores the second coordinates when an emergency exit is identified. In the fire evacuation mode, the route search unit searches for an evacuation route using the current coordinates, the first coordinates, and the second coordinates, and moves along the evacuation route.
abstract_ko: SLAM 알고리즘을 이용하여 지도를 생성하고, 생성된 지도를 기준으로 현재 좌표를 측정하는 지도 생성부, 상기 지도를 이용하여 경로를 탐색하는 경로 탐색부, 주변 이미지를 획득하는 영상촬영 장치; 및 이동수단을 포함하되, 운반 로봇 모드에서는 건물 내부를 이동하며 상기 지도 생성부가 상기 지도를 생성하고, 상기 영상촬영 장치를 통해 획득한 주변 이미지를 분석하여 사람이 식별되면 제1 좌표를 저장하며, 비상구가 식별되면 제2 좌표를 저장하고, 화재 대피 모드에서는 상기 경로 탐색부가 상기 현재 좌표, 상기 제1 좌표 및 상기 제2 좌표를 이용하여 대피 경로를 탐색하고 상기 대피 경로를 따라 이동하는 화재 대피 유도 로봇.

title_en: Crowd evacuation method, device and system based on unmanned aerial vehicle group and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a crowd evacuation method, a crowd evacuation device, a crowd evacuation system and a storage medium based on an unmanned aerial vehicle group, wherein an unmanned aerial vehicle is used for coordination and cooperation to conduct evacuation guidance, and a multi-main-body reinforcement learning method is introduced to provide a path planning scheme. The multi-main-body reinforcement learning method has strong environment adaptability and self-learning capability, can provide crowd evacuation paths aiming at different actual scenes, and is combined with the efficient and convenient unmanned aerial vehicle, so that the system can rapidly evacuate crowds in a short time, can provide auxiliary decision support for managing public emergency, is suitable for crowd-intensive public activity areas, and can be applied to crowd evacuation when natural disasters such as earthquakes and tsunamis occur.

title_en: Crowd evacuation guiding method and system based on Internet of things, edge computing and indoor positioning technology and electronic terminal
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of Internet of things and indoor positioning, mainly relates to the technical field of Internet of things, edge calculation and indoor positioning, and particularly relates to a crowd evacuation guiding method and system based on the Internet of things, edge calculation and indoor positioning technologies and an electronic terminal. The evacuation guidance method includes: finding an emergency and positioning the position of the emergency, finding an emergency accident by using an Internet of things sensing and monitoring terminal deployed in a site, and positioning the position of the emergency accident according to the known position condition of the Internet of things sensing and monitoring terminal; the edge computing nodes are reversely pushed from the emergency accident occurrence positions in the covered area to the nearest exit positions along all available paths in a reverse pushing mode to generate an optimal evacuation route; and pushing the generated optimal evacuation path result to an Internet of things guidance terminal and a mobile phone of the evacuated person at the corresponding position on the path, wherein the evacuated person can evacuate through the determined optimal route according to the prompt of the Internet of things indication equipment and the mobile phone.

title_en: Exit button
title_ko: 대피버튼
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an evacuation button. It is very dangerous to install a tripod to notify the vehicle behind you when the vehicle stops due to a sudden accident or breakdown while driving. The present invention helps to evacuate to a safe area by pressing the evacuation button in case of an accident. When the evacuation button is operated, the trunk is opened, the warning lamp is turned on, and the warning lamp of the guardrail is turned on (up to 3 km behind the accident point). In addition, if the accident point is linked with the navigation, the present invention can immediately grasp the danger ahead, and the Road Traffic Safety Management Corporation can identify and control road congestion in advance, and install the guardrail in an accident-prone area first to examine the effectiveness.
abstract_ko:
주행중 갑작스런 사고나 고장으로 정차하게될 때 후방 차량에게 알리기 위해 삼각대등을 설치해야 하지만 매우 위험함 
본 발명은 사고발생시 대피버튼만 누르고 안전지역으로 대피하면됨 대피버튼을 작동하면 ①트렁크열림- 경광등 점등 ②가드레일 경광등 점등-(사고지점 후방 3KM 까지 설치된 등 까지)③사고지점이 네비게이션과 연동된다면 즉시 전방의 위험 파악가능 ④ 도로교통안전관리공단에서 도로 혼잡을 미리 제어가능 ⑤ 사고 다발지역에 먼저 설치해서 효과 검토

title_en: Emergency shelter guiding system and guiding method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of emergency, in particular to a guidance system and a guidance method for an emergency shelter. The guiding system of the terminal equipment end comprises a terminal positioning module, a disaster type module, a primary list module, an optimized list module and a route planning module. The server-side guidance system comprises an information providing module, a disaster sorting module and a recommendation list module. According to the emergency shelter guiding system and the guiding method, the selection and the path planning of the emergency shelter are carried out according to the disaster type, the user geographical position, the coverage area of the emergency shelter, the remaining containable number of people and the current road condition, the speed of the user for reaching the emergency shelter is increased, and the utilization rate of the emergency shelter can be effectively increased.
assignees: SHENZHEN URBAN PUBLIC SECURITY TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Indoor positioning navigation system and application method thereof in emergency evacuation
abstract_en: The invention provides an indoor positioning navigation system and an application method thereof in emergency evacuation. The system comprises a map drawing module, a map processing module and a map processing module, wherein the map drawing module is used for carrying out three-dimensional mapping and map drawing on the indoor space through an SLAM technology and generating a three-dimensional live-action map; the key point positioning module is used for generating key points in the three-dimensional live-action map, wherein the key points comprise emergency exits and intersection points with 2 or more paths; the route planning module is used for dynamically planning an evacuation route from each intersection to an emergency exit according to the fire occurrence position by using a preset route planning algorithm based on the three-dimensional live-action map and generating the evacuation route into dynamic navigation information; and the two-dimensional code laying module is used for generating the dynamic navigation information into a two-dimensional code and marking the position of a cross point corresponding to the two-dimensional code at one end of the two-dimensional code. The indoor positioning navigation system can dynamically plan the evacuation path according to the position of the fire, and is low in investment cost and easy to popularize.
assignees: SHENZHEN URBAN PUBLIC SECURITY TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: AGV positioning system based on ultra wide band and vision two-dimensional code navigation technology
abstract_en: The utility model provides an AGV positioning system based on ultra wide band and vision two-dimensional code navigation technique, main control unit are connected with UWB module and two-dimensional code module electricity respectively, and the UWB module sends AGV kinematic location information to main control unit, and the two-dimensional code module sends AGV observation location information to main control unit, and main control unit calculates AGV kinematic location information and AGV observation location information and fuses to according to the motion of the control drive arrangement of calculated result; the master control device is connected and communicated with the upper computer, and the result of calculation and fusion of the AGV movement position information and the AGV observation position information is transmitted to the upper computer for data detection; the driving device is electrically connected with the main control device and connected with a driving assembly of the AGV, and the main control device controls the navigation positioning and dispatching of the AGV through the driving device. The beneficial effects of the utility model are that improved because of the shortcoming that the state accumulative error that shelters from when environmental problem and time accumulation produced leads to low in positioning accuracy, avoided the wiring difficult problem that produces because of environmental problem.

title_en: RNN-based indoor crowd evacuation automatic guiding simulation method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides an automatic indoor crowd evacuation guiding simulation method and system based on an RNN (radio network), wherein the method comprises the steps of optimizing RNN (radio network node) network parameters by using a difference algorithm and taking evacuation time reduction as an optimization criterion, and establishing a relation among a real-time evacuation state, a guiding strategy and crowd evacuation time; in the evacuation process, the guidance probability among navigation points at the current moment is obtained by acquiring the distribution density information of people in each area in the evacuation process as the input of an RNN (radio network) and the network intermediate state at the front lambda moment, and a temporary moving target at the next moment is created for the pedestrian at the current moment by using a pseudo-random selection strategy based on roulette wheel so as to guide the pedestrian to evacuate and move and achieve the purpose of reducing the crowd evacuation time; the method starts from 'congestion' which is one of key factors influencing evacuation efficiency, and utilizes the RNN to establish the mapping relation between the distribution probability of the evacuated crowd and evacuation strategies, so that effective evacuation help can be effectively provided for pedestrians who are unfamiliar with scenes and can not obtain complete evacuation information, and scientific guidance on the safe evacuation plan of the crowd in the emergency room is realized.

title_en: Reciprocating type bus evacuation path planning method based on non-fixed route
