abstract_en: The invention discloses a round-trip type bus evacuation route planning method based on a non-fixed route, belonging to the field of emergency traffic evacuation and public traffic management optimization, and the method comprises the following steps: acquiring information such as a road network, evacuation demands and available buses in an evacuation area; constructing a public transport evacuation route planning model based on two main characteristics of non-fixed routes and reciprocating operation, and setting a target function to minimize the total evacuation time cost of people to be evacuated in an evacuation area; setting model constraint conditions which respectively comprise 3 aspects of node constraint, vehicle and capacity constraint and time window constraint; a double-layer solving algorithm is designed through an insertion algorithm and a border exchange algorithm, and finally a public transport emergency evacuation path planning scheme is obtained. The method disclosed by the invention is suitable for the characteristics of evacuation planning, the travel experience of people to be evacuated in the evacuation process can be effectively improved, and the stability and reliability of the public transportation evacuation scheme are improved.

title_en: Fire guidance system
title_ko: 화재 안내 시스템
abstract_en: Provided is a fire guidance system. The fire guidance system includes: a fire sensing part sensing a fire in case of a fire; an evacuee position sensing part sensing a position of an evacuee evacuating from the fire; an evacuation route guidance part providing an evacuation route designed considering at least one among information about the fire sensed by the fire sensing part and information about the position of the evacuee sensed by the evacuee position sensing part; and a temporary evacuation space providing part providing a respiration space to the evacuee evacuating from the fire. The temporary evacuation space providing part is provided on each predesignated position in a predetermined space, and is individually controlled in accordance with a fire situation including the information about the fire sensed by the fire sensing part and the information about the position of the evacuee sensed by the evacuee position sensing part. Therefore, the system is capable of controlling the directions for supplying outside air or inert gas so as to prevent fire smoke from flowing into an evacuation route.
abstract_ko: 화재가 발생된 경우, 화재를 감지하는 화재 감지부, 상기 화재로부터 대피하는 대피자의 위치를 감지하는 대피자 위치 감지부, 상기 화재 감지부에서 감지한 화재에 대한 정보 및 상기 대피자 위치 감지부에서 감지한 대피자의 위치에 대한 정보 중 적어도 하나를 고려하여 설계된 대피경로를 제공하는 대피경로 안내부, 및 상기 화재로부터 대피하는 대피자에게 호흡 공간을 제공하는 임시 대피 공간 제공부를 포함하되, 상기 임시 대피 공간 제공부는, 소정 공간에 미리 정해진 위치 별로 마련되고, 상기 화재 감지부에서 감지한 화재에 대한 정보 및 상기 대피자 위치 감지부에서 감지한 대피자의 위치에 대한 정보를 포함하는 화재 상황에 따라 개별 제어되는, 화재 안내 시스템이 제공된다.

title_en: simulator and simulation method for disaster management of skyscraper
title_ko: 초고층건물 재난관리용 시뮬레이터 및 시뮬레이션 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a simulator for disaster management of a skyscraper and a simulation method thereof. The simulator for disaster management of a skyscraper comprises: a plurality of camera modules installed at an evacuation route point where two stairs installed on different floors indoors or outdoors meet, and each generating image data by photographing an image; a central monitoring device; and an evacuation route guidance module. The central monitoring device calculates the number of people located at the corresponding evacuation route point of each floor by using the image data transmitted from the camera module. The central monitoring device determines the number of people at a first evacuation route point of a current floor related to a first preliminary evacuation door and the number of people at the first evacuation route point of the evacuation floor corresponding to the first evacuation route point of the current floor, and when the sum of the determined number of people is less than or equal to the set number of people, the first preliminary evacuation door is designated as a final evacuation door, and a plurality of evacuation guide display units related to the final evacuation door are lit and controlled. When the sum of the determined number of people exceeds the set number of people, the first evacuation route point of the evacuation floor is set as a preliminary target evacuation route point, and when there is no obstacle when moving from the current floor to the preliminary target evacuation route point, the first preliminary evacuation door is set as the final evacuation door.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 초고층건물 재난관리용 시뮬레이터 및 시뮬레이션 방법에 관한 것으로서, 상기 초고층건물 재난관리용 시뮬레이터는 실내 또는 실외의 서로 다른 층에 설치된 두 계단이 만나는 대피 경로 지점에 설치되어 있어 있고 영상을 촬영하여 영상 데이터를 생성하는 각각 생성하는 복수의 카메라 모듈,  중앙 감시 장치, 그리고  대피 경로 안내 모듈을 포함한다.  상기 중앙 감시 장치는 상기 카메라 모듈로부터 전송된 영상 데이터를 이용하여 각 층의 해당 대피 경로 지점에 위치하고 있는 사람의 인원수를 산출하고,  제1 예비 대피 출입문에 관련된 현재 층의 제1 대피 경로 지점의 인원수와 상기 현재 층의 제1 대피 경로 지점과 대응하는 대피 층의 제1 대피 경로 지점의 인원수를 판정하고, 판정된 두 인원수의 합이 설정 인원수 이하이면, 상기 제1 예비 대피 출입물을 최종 대피 출입문을 정하여, 상기 최종 대피 출입문에 관련된 복수의 대피안내 표시부를 점등 제어하고,   판정된 두 인원수의 합이 설정 인원수를 초과하면, 상기 대피 층의 상기 제1 대피 경로 지점을 예비 목표 대피 경로 지점으로 정하고, 상기 현재 층에서 상기 예비 목표 대피 경로 지점으로 이동시 장애물이 존재하지 않는 경우, 상기 제1 예비 대피 출입물을 최종 대피 출입문을 정한다.
assignees: KWANG INT CO LTD;THE CONSILIENCE KNOWLEDGE INST CKI

title_en: Multifunctional patrol guiding device based on connection orientation
abstract_en: The invention provides a connection-oriented multifunctional patrol guiding device, which is characterized in that a wireless transmission unit, a sensing unit, a storage unit, a positioning unit, a data security unit and a microprocessor are arranged; the wireless transmission unit, the induction unit, the storage unit, the positioning unit and the data secrecy unit are respectively electrically connected with the microprocessor, so that the system is convenient to use by a user, rich in functions and high in safety, and can also realize real-time navigation, real-time emergency disaster emergency and escape route planning.
assignees: WULIAN SHENZHOU NETWORK HOLDING CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent vibratory roller of independent operation of vision leading
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vision-dominated autonomous operation intelligent vibratory roller, which comprises an inertial navigation unit, a vibration unit and a vibration unit, wherein the inertial navigation unit is used for acquiring pose information of the roller; the camera is used for acquiring the compaction edge image information of the lane to be rolled; the GNSS mobile station is used for acquiring the position information of the road roller; and the computing platform is used for performing feature extraction and feature matching, front-end visual odometer optimization and rear-end optimization on two adjacent frames of compacted edge images according to the information of the compacted edge images acquired by the camera, estimating the pose information of the camera, performing Kalman filtering fusion on the estimated pose information of the camera and the pose information of the road roller acquired by the inertial navigation unit to obtain the visual positioning information of the camera, performing loop detection according to the position information of the road roller acquired by the GNSS mobile station, and performing positioning compensation on the visual positioning information of the camera. The method can accurately position in areas with poor GNSS signals, such as tunnels and shelters from obstacles, and realize high-precision navigation construction of the road roller.

title_en: Unmanned ship position accuracy judging and controlling system based on navigational speed
abstract_en: The invention relates to an unmanned ship position accuracy judging and controlling system based on navigational speed. The unmanned ship real-time position data accuracy is judged based on the speed, and when the position information at a certain moment is determined to be inaccurate, the task processing system sends a ship stopping instruction to the navigation control system, so that the task of the unmanned ship is finished. By adopting the method, when the unmanned ship is sheltered by a tall ship, complicated climate or electromagnetic interference on the sea, the position information provided by the positioning system is wrong, and the loss of the unmanned ship and even the collision danger are avoided.

title_en: System And Method For Evacuation Path Navigation Using Free Wi-Fi
title_ko: 무료 와이파이를 이용한 대피 경로 안내 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an evacuation path guidance system using free Wi-Fi and a method thereof. According to the present invention, the evacuation path guidance system using free Wi-Fi comprises: a plurality of wireless routers installed to provide a free Wi-Fi service in a prescribed space; and a management server for receiving user information from a user terminal connected to the plurality of wireless routers, receiving connection information of the user terminal from the plurality of wireless routers, and using the provided user information and the connection information of the user terminal to calculate a familiarity level for the prescribed space for each user. The management server searches and shows an evacuation path based on a user position in the prescribed space when a disaster occurs, and re-searches and shows a detour evacuation path for some users with a relatively high familiarity level of the prescribed space among users searched by the same evacuation path when the number of the users searched by the same evacuation path is higher than or equal to a predetermined reference.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 무료 와이파이를 이용한 대피 경로 안내 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것이다. 본 발명에 따른 무료 와이파이를 이용한 대피 경로 안내 시스템은 소정의 공간에서 무료 와이파이(Wi-Fi) 서비스를 제공하기 위해 설치된 복수의 무선 공유기, 그리고 복수의 무선 공유기에 접속한 사용자 단말로부터 사용자 정보를 제공받고, 복수의 무선 공유기로부터 사용자 단말의 접속 정보를 제공받으며, 제공된 사용자 정보와 사용자 단말의 접속 정보를 이용하여 사용자별로 소정의 공간에 대한 익숙도를 산출하는 관리 서버를 포함한다. 관리 서버는 재난 발생 시 소정의 공간에서의 사용자 위치를 기준으로 대피 경로를 탐색하여 안내하되, 동일한 대피 경로로 탐색된 사용자의 수가 미리 정해진 기준 이상이면, 동일한 대피 경로로 탐색된 사용자 중에서 소정의 공간에 대한 익숙도가 상대적으로 높은 사용자 일부에 우회 대피 경로를 재탐색하여 안내한다.

title_en: Building firefighting monitoring system using artificial intelligence
title_ko: Ai를 이용한 건축물 소방화재 감시 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention provides a building fire monitoring system using AI which can more accurately detect an occurrence of fire and quickly rescue life at the same time. The building fire monitoring system using AI comprises at least one CCTV and a fire monitoring server.
abstract_ko: AI를 이용한 건축물 소방화재 감시 시스템이 제공된다. AI를 이용한 건축물 소방화재 감시 시스템은, 적어도 하나의 CCTV 및 화재감시서버를 포함하는 AI를 이용한 건축물 소방화재 감시 시스템에 있어서, 적어도 하나의 CCTV는, 영상을 촬영하는 촬영부, 촬영부를 벽에 고정시키는 고정부, 촬영부와 고정부를 연결시키는 연결라인부 및 촬영부를 이동시키는 제1 연결부 및 제2 연결부를 포함하고, 제2 연결부는 고정부로부터 제1 방향으로 연장되고, 제1 연결부의 일단은 제2 연결부의 끝단으로부터 제1 방향과 교차하는 제2 방향으로 연장되고, 제1 연결부의 타단은 촬영부와 연결되며, 제1 연결부에는 제1 센서부가 배치되고, 제2 연결부에는 제2 센서부가 배치되며, 제1 센서부는, 제1 연결부의 외면을 둘러싸되 서로 이격된 제1 열감지센서 내지 제4 열감지센서와, 제1 열감지센서 내지 제4 열감지센서 사이에 각각 배치되는 제1 열전도차단막 내지 제4 열전도차단막을 포함하고, 제2 센서부는, 사람의 음성 주파수를 인식하는 음성인식센서와, GPS신호를 분석하여 위치 정보를 획득하는 GPS 센서를 포함하고, 화재감시서버는, 적어도 하나의 CCTV로부터 촬영된 영상을 전송받는 통신부와, 촬영된 영상을 딥러닝 기반 인공지능을 이용하여 화재 여부를 재판단하는 화재 판단부와, 화재 판단부가 화재가 발생된 것으로 판단하면, 통신부를 통해 관리자 단말기 및 적어도 하나의 CCTV로 화재 알림을 전송하는 화재 알림부와, 화재 알림을 전송받은 관리자 단말기로부터 화재 상황 확인 정보를 수신하는 경우 대피경로를 안내하는 대피경로 안내부와, 제2 센서부를 통하여 사람이 있을 것으로 감지된 장소의 CCTV 영상을 분석하여 건축물 내 사람 유무 및 사람의 위치를 판단하는 건축물 내 사람 유무 판단부 및 건축물 내 사람 유무 및 사람의 위치를 관리자 단말기로 전송하는 사람 위치 알림부를 포함하고, 적어도 하나의 CCTV는 마이크로 컨트롤러를 더 포함하고, 제1 열감지센서 내지 제4 열감지센서는 설정된 값을 초과하는 열이 감지되는 경우, 설정된 값을 초과하는 열이 감지되는 방향으로 상기 촬영부를 이동시키기 위한 제1 제어신호를 마이크로 컨트롤러로 전송하고, 제2 센서부는 사람이 감지되는 경우, 사람이 감지되는 방향으로 촬영부를 이동시키기 위한 제2 제어신호를 마이크로 컨트롤러로 전송한다.

title_en: Pattern generation method and device based on electronic map and navigation terminal
abstract_en: The application relates to a pattern generation method and device based on an electronic map, a navigation terminal and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: detecting the occurrence of an emergency event, and acquiring current position data and target position data; determining data of a target path connected between the current position and the target position on the electronic map according to the current position data and the target position data; determining the positions of a plurality of discrete points on the electronic map according to the data of the target path; displaying a directional pattern on the electronic map according to the position data of the plurality of discrete points; the directional pattern is directed from the current position to the target position. By adopting the method, evacuation information can be clearly transmitted, people suffering from disasters can be effectively evacuated and transferred, personal and property safety of people is prevented from being endangered by emergency accidents, and the utilization rate and the functional diversity of the electronic map are improved.

title_en: Navigation device, processing method for same, and program
abstract_en: The present invention provides a navigation device comprising: a weather information acquisition unit for acquiring weather information for the weather on a route to a destination; a shelter-setting unit for classifying the weather information acquired by the weather information acquisition unit into a level and setting a shelter associate with the level; and a guide unit for searching for a shelter set by the shelter-setting unit and guiding the user to the searched shelter.

title_en: Positioning method of MIMU/CSAC/altimeter auxiliary satellite receiver
abstract_en: The invention discloses an MIMU/CSAC/altimeter auxiliary satellite receiver positioning method. The method comprises the following steps: selecting a CPT chip atomic clock as a local clock source of a receiver, and outputting a 1PPS signal by a GNSS navigation module to tame the chip clock; constructing a state equation and a measurement equation of the integrated navigation system, and synchronizing system time; when the number of the searched stars is less than 4, predicting the clock error by using the CSAC, establishing a clock error model to predict clock error information, realizing the positioning of the receiver three stars, and assisting the acquisition and tracking of the GNSS module by using the MIMU and the CSAC; the barometric altimeter is used for initializing a correction method, the corrected measured altitude is used as a constraint condition to construct an observation equation, and pseudo-range measurement is carried out on two satellites to realize positioning calculation. The method shortens the satellite relocation time, improves the navigation positioning and time service precision, improves the positioning precision of the elevation of the receiver in a sheltering environment and the space precision factor PDOP value, and improves the continuity of the receiver.

title_en: Apparatus and method for guiding evacuation route
title_ko: 대피경로 안내장치 및 대피경로 안내방법
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, provided is an evacuation route guide device, which comprises: a fire detection sensing unit which senses whether a fire has occurred and transmits fire information through a first RF communication module; a relay unit which includes an RF communication portion for receiving the fire information by communicating with the first RF communication module, and relays the fire information through the RF communication portion; an evacuation route providing unit which includes a second RF communication module receiving the fire information by communicating with the RF communication unit, and transmits evacuation route information to the relay unit through the second RF communication module; and an evacuation route display unit which includes a third RF communication module receiving the evacuation route information relayed from the relay unit by communicating with the RF communication portion and displays an evacuation route in accordance with the evacuation route information.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 대피경로 안내장치는 화재 발생 여부를 센싱하여 제1 RF 통신 모듈을 통하여 화재정보를 전송하는 화재감지센싱부; 상기 제1 RF 통신 모듈과 통신하여 상기 화재 정보를 수신하는 RF 통신부를 포함하며, 상기 RF 통신부를 통하여 화재 정보를 중계하는 중계부; 상기 RF 통신부와 통신하여 상기 화재정보를 수신하는 제2 RF 통신 모듈을 포함하며, 상기 제2 RF 통신 모듈을 통하여 대피경로정보를 상기 중계부로 전송하는 대피경로 제공부; 및 상기 RF 통신부와 통신하여 상기 중계부로부터 중계된 상기 대피경로정보를 수신하는 제3 RF 통신 모듈을 포함하며, 상기 대피경로정보에 따라 대피 경로를 표시하는 대피경로 표시부;를 포함한다.

title_en: Crowd evacuation simulation method and system based on deep reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The method comprises the following steps of constructing a simulation environment, and constructing a simulation environment comprising different functional areas, including rooms, corridors, danger points and the like; constructing a deep reinforcement learning model, constructing a neural network conforming to a simulation environment, and compiling processing logic; step three, compiling training logic, communicating the model with the environment, enabling the model to interact with the environment, continuously correcting parameters of the model according to feedback of the environment, and finally converging to calculate the optimal escape path; according to the scheme, the problem of path planning for escape after a disaster is solved by using a deep reinforcement learning method, environment data do not need to be acquired manually, the scheme disclosed by the invention automatically interacts with the environment, and the efficiency of path planning after the disaster and the safety of the planned path are greatly improved.

title_en: Indoor positioning and/or navigation system for emergency situations
abstract_en: The invention relates to a Bluetooth Low energy mesh (BLE mesh) network (1) for providing indoor positioning and/or navigation in case of emergency, characterized in that the Bluetooth Low energy mesh network (1) comprises one or more node devices (1-1, 1-2, 1-3, 1-4, 1-m, 1-n) distributed within a building, the node devices being respectively configured as Bluetooth Low energy beacons for broadcasting respective node information, such that a mobile device (3) receiving the node information can acquire the position of the respective node device within the building and/or a preset evacuation route to a safety zone from the position of the respective node device. The invention also relates to an indoor positioning and/or navigation system for emergency situations and a system for supervising the inspection of fire fighting installations in a building.

title_en: Indoor intelligent evacuation navigation system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides an indoor intelligent evacuation navigation system and method, which comprises a fire detection subsystem, a video monitoring subsystem and an evacuation navigation subsystem, wherein the evacuation navigation subsystem comprises an escape route map, a safe exit congestion state indicator lamp, safe exit escape time, an escape direction arrow and a voice player, the escape route map is displayed by a touch high-definition liquid crystal screen and comprises space distribution of all units in a floor, indoor escape routes, personnel flow states and fire development states, the escape routes at different positions are dynamically optimized in real time according to indoor environment states under the fire condition, and the safe exit congestion states, the safe exit escape time, the personnel flow states and the fire development states are synchronously displayed on the liquid crystal screen. The invention has compact integral structure design, strong operability and high intelligent degree, can provide dynamic escape path indication for the evacuated crowd and further realize the purpose of quickly escaping from the fire scene.

title_en: Chemical industry park emergency evacuation route planning system based on pedestrian recognition device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a chemical industry park emergency evacuation route planning system based on a pedestrian recognition device; the method comprises the following steps: the system comprises an accident studying and judging module, a personnel identifying and positioning module, a path planning module and an evacuation command module. Furthermore, the accident studying and judging module and the personnel identifying and positioning module are respectively connected with a path planning module, and the path planning module is connected with an evacuation commanding module. This application can not carry extra wireless communication positioner depending on personnel, utilize the inside and peripheral video monitoring equipment in chemical industry park, the evacuation personnel's of real-time supervision position, evacuation direction, evacuation speed and people stream density, and with this prediction crowd gathering result, and according to all kinds of production accident monitoring and meteorological sensor in the chemical industry park, forecast accident development trend, avoid the calamity and plan acceptable route in advance for different regional evacuation crowds, avoid causing personnel's safety problem.

title_en: Three-dimensional indoor map multi-detail-level visualization method based on CityGML extension
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional indoor map multi-detail level visualization method based on CityGML expansion, which comprises the following specific steps of: defining elements of a three-dimensional indoor map; defining the attribute and the relation of each element of the three-dimensional indoor map; constructing a three-dimensional indoor map element model based on CityGML extension; a visual expression method of three-dimensional indoor map with multiple detail levels is provided. The three-dimensional indoor map multi-detail level visualization expression method based on the CityGML expansion not only can meet the multi-level expression requirement of the three-dimensional indoor map, but also can provide rich semantic information for application services based on the three-dimensional indoor map, such as indoor navigation, facility management, emergency evacuation and the like.

title_en: Object mixing and positioning system suitable for immersive VR operation space
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an object mixes positioning system suitable for immersive VR operation space belongs to the VR field, including mobile tag device and camera analysis system, wherein: the mobile tag device comprises a laser emitting system and an inertial navigation positioning system, wherein the laser emitting system is used for emitting multi-color cross line laser, the inertial navigation positioning system comprises a microprocessor, an integrated accelerometer and a gyroscope, and the microprocessor is used for performing action algorithm fusion on the acquired data to acquire spatial attitude and inertial reference displacement data of a tag object and transmitting the spatial attitude and inertial reference displacement data to a computer for analysis; the camera shooting analysis system comprises a camera set and projection planes, wherein the camera set is used for collecting laser projection signals projected onto the projection planes and transmitting the laser projection signals to the computer end for image analysis. The utility model discloses a hybrid location scheme that can effectively resist and shelter from suitable for little space both can realize the high accuracy, can guarantee better positioning stability and higher price/performance ratio again in practical application.

title_en: Building firefighting monitoring system using wide sprinkler
title_ko: 와이드 스프링클러를 이용한 건축물 소방화재 감시 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire-fighting system for monitoring a fire in a building using a wide sprinkler. According to the present invention, the fire-fighting system for monitoring a fire in a building using a wide sprinkler comprises at least one wide sprinkler, at least one CCTV, and a fire monitoring server, wherein the at least one wide sprinkler comprises a rail unit, a plurality of joint units, a motor unit, a plurality of sprinkler units, and a detection unit. According to the present invention, a fire can be accurately detected at an early stage.
abstract_ko: 와이드 스프링클러를 이용한 건축물 소방화재 감시 시스템이 제공된다. 와이드 스프링클러를 이용한 건축물 소방화재 감시 시스템은, 적어도 하나의 와이드 스프링클러와, 적어도 하나의 CCTV 및 화재감시서버를 포함하는 AI를 이용한 건축물 소방화재 감시 시스템에 있어서,  적어도 하나의 와이드 스프링클러는, 천장에 배치되는 레일부와,  레일부에 체결되는 복수의 관절부와,  복수의 관절부 사이에 배치되며  복수의 관절부를 이동시키는 모터부와,  복수의 관절부의 하면에 배치되며 소화수를 분사하는 복수의 스프링클러부 및  모터부에 배치되며 연기를 감지하는 감지부를 포함하고,  복수의 관절부 각각의 길이는 65cm이며,  복수의 관절부 각각의 두께는 11cm이고,  모터부는 이격되어 다수 배치되되,  모터부의 피치는 60cm 내지 210cm이며,  모터부의 두께는 13cm이고,  복수의 스프링클러부의 피치는 40cm 내지 110cm이며,  적어도 하나의 CCTV는, 영상을 촬영하는 촬영부,  촬영부를 벽에 고정시키는 고정부,  촬영부와  고정부를 연결시키는 연결라인부 및  촬영부를 이동시키는 제1 연결부 및 제2 연결부를 포함하고,  제2 연결부는 고정부로부터 제1 방향으로 연장되고,  제1 연결부의 일단은  제2 연결부의 끝단으로부터  제1 방향과 교차하는 제2 방향으로 연장되고,  제1 연결부의 타단은  촬영부와 연결되며,  제1 연결부에는 제1 센서부가 배치되고,  제2 연결부에는 제2 센서부가 배치되며,  제1 센서부는,  제1 연결부의 외면을 둘러싸되 서로 이격된 제1 열감지센서 내지 제4 열감지센서와,  제1 열감지센서 내지 제4 열감지센서 사이에 각각 배치되는 제1 열전도차단막 내지 제4 열전도차단막을 포함하고,  제2 센서부는, 사람의 음성 주파수를 인식하는 음성인식센서와, GPS신호를 분석하여 위치 정보를 획득하는 GPS 센서를 포함하고,  화재감시서버는,   적어도 하나의 CCTV로부터 촬영된 영상을 전송받는 통신부와,  촬영된 영상을 딥러닝 기반 인공지능을 이용하여 화재 여부를 재판단하는 화재 판단부와,  화재 판단부가 화재가 발생된 것으로 판단하면,  통신부를 통해 관리자 단말기,  적어도 하나의 와이드 스프링클러 및  적어도 하나의 CCTV로 화재 알림을 전송하는 화재 알림부와,  화재 알림을 전송받은  관리자 단말기로부터 화재 상황 확인 정보를 수신하는 경우 대피경로를 안내하는 대피경로 안내부와,  제2 센서부를 통하여 사람이 있을 것으로 감지된 장소의 CCTV 영상을 분석하여 건축물 내 사람 유무 및 사람의 위치를 판단하는 건축물 내 사람 유무 판단부와,  건축물 내 사람 유무 및 사람의 위치를  관리자 단말기로 전송하는 사람 위치 알림부 및  화재 알림을 전송받고, 화재 발생 위치와 인접한  와이드 스프링클러를 작동시키기 위한 와이드 스프링클러 제어신호를 생성하는 와이드 스프링클러 제어부를 포함하고,  적어도 하나의 CCTV는 마이크로 컨트롤러를 더 포함하고,  제1 열감지센서 내지 제4 열감지센서는 설정된 값을 초과하는 열이 감지되는 경우,  설정된 값을 초과하는 열이 감지되는 방향으로  촬영부를 이동시키기 위한 제1 제어신호를  마이크로 컨트롤러로 전송하고,  제2 센서부는 사람이 감지되는 경우,  사람이 감지되는 방향으로  촬영부를 이동시키기 위한 제2 제어신호를  마이크로 컨트롤러로 전송한다.

title_en: BIM-based personnel evacuation method for decoration construction of subway public area
abstract_en: The application relates to a personnel evacuation method for decoration construction of a subway public area based on BIM, which comprises an evacuation path planning method, wherein the evacuation path planning method comprises the following steps: acquiring a construction information model and a BIM model; continuously updating the BIM to obtain a reference model according to the construction progress; obtaining getting-on and getting-off coordinates and destination coordinates of passengers and vehicle group personnel; selecting a traffic path from the reference model; acquiring a driving route; screening out a safety path and a risk path from the passing paths; if yes, the risk path is determined; if not, the path is a safe path; the driving time interval of each driving route is obtained, and the safe passing time interval of each risk path is calculated according to the driving time interval; and planning the dredging paths for passengers and vehicle crew to safely reach the destination at different time intervals according to the safety paths, the risk paths and the safe passing time intervals of all the intervals of each risk path. The method and the device have the advantages that workers can conveniently conduct staff dredging before completion of a project, and the safety of construction is improved.
assignees: CHENGDU DECORATION CO LTD OF CDCEG

title_en: Portable multifunctional tour guide device based on connection orientation
abstract_en: The utility model provides a portable multifunctional patrol guiding device based on connection orientation, which is provided with a wireless transmission unit, a sensing unit, a storage unit, a positioning unit, a data security unit and a microprocessor; the wireless transmission unit, the induction unit, the storage unit, the positioning unit and the data secrecy unit are respectively electrically connected with the microprocessor, so that the system is convenient to use by a user, rich in functions and high in safety, and can also realize real-time navigation, real-time emergency disaster emergency and escape route planning.

title_en: Autonomous driving vehicle
abstract_en: To provide a technology of a vehicle or an automatic driving vehicle that helps in determining an appropriate response after an own automatic driving vehicle has a collision with other vehicles and so on by accurately grasping the abnormality of the vehicle during its evacuation.SOLUTION: An autonomous driving vehicle capable of autonomous driving to a destination autonomously travels to the destination set by a car navigation function, and automatically transmits a collision time detected by a clock unit, a collision location detected by a location detection unit, and a video acquired by a video acquisition unit immediately before and/or immediately after a collision around an own vehicle to a predetermined destination in the event that a collision detection unit detects the collision.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Mobile object evacuation path planning apparatus, method, and medium
abstract_en: There is provided an apparatus and a method that allows appropriate pulling over of a mobile object to a safe road shoulder when an emergency occurs during automated driving. A travelable region available for a vehicle to travel is set like an occupancy map based on distance information from a depth sensor. Image attribute information is generated from an image by semantic segmentation. An evacuation space is set in the travelable region based on the image attribute information that represents the situation of the road surface of the travelable region, and thus an evacuation space map is created.

title_en: Emergency evacuation lighting equipment with voice navigation function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an emergency evacuation lighting device with voice navigation, which comprises an emergency light structure, the emergency lamp structure comprises a machine body and an illuminating lamp, the machine body comprises a voice navigation broadcasting device, the machine body is electrically connected through an external power supply, the illuminating lamp is electrically connected through the machine body, the emergency lamp structure further comprises a switch and a guide main body, the side end of the switch is fixedly connected with the side end of the shell of the machine body, the upper end of the guide main body is fixedly arranged at the lower end of the switch, the switch comprises a first fixed seat, a rotating shaft seat, a knife switch, a power receiving clamp and a first push rod, wherein the side end of the first fixed seat is fixedly connected with the side wall of the shell of the machine body, the rotating shaft seat is fixedly connected with the first fixing seat into a whole, the side part of the upper end of the switch blade is rotatably arranged at the side end of the rotating shaft seat, and the power receiving clamp and the switch blade are clamped together. The utility model discloses made things convenient for emergency light inspection work, better satisfying uses needs.
assignees: SHENZHEN SHENGCE SECURITY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire scene navigation method and system based on deep learning and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire scene navigation method and system based on deep learning and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining the current position of the user by using the current environment information; inputting the current fire information into a trained deep neural network model, and predicting to obtain estimated fire information; calculating the fire variation degree according to the current fire information and the estimated fire information; if the fire change degree is larger than or equal to a preset value, re-planning the current escape path by using a heuristic search algorithm according to the current position and the estimated fire information; and displaying the current escape path and guiding the user to move. The invention solves the problem that the traditional technology can not provide real-time path navigation in a fire scene, realizes the accurate positioning of the user and the real-time selection of the optimal escape route in the fire scene, and achieves the effect of providing the real-time path navigation for the user in the fire scene.
assignees: PENG CHENG LAB;HARBIN INST TECHNOLOGY SHENZHEN

title_en: Indoor intelligent evacuation route guidance display equipment and evacuation route making method
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent indoor evacuation route guidance display device, which comprises a control module, a storage module and a display module, wherein the control module comprises an interface unit and a processing unit, the interface unit is connected with the storage module and the display module, the processing unit comprises an external network access module and an evacuation route module, the external network access module acquires monitoring data of all sensors near the guidance display device from an external network and evaluates the monitoring data, if a fire alarm occurs, the evacuation route module is operated, the evacuation route module calls a related three-dimensional graph in a building from the storage module, analyzes and calculates an optimal evacuation route by combining the monitoring data of the sensors, and finally displays the optimal evacuation route on the display module, and the display module can also simultaneously display information such as the position of fire fighting equipment, a call-for-help button, an alarm button and the like for trapped persons to reference for escaping, meanwhile, the display module can play the audio and video file of the fire safety knowledge when no fire occurs, and the popularization work of fire fighting is started.

title_en: Driving support system, driving support method, and program
abstract_en: To provide a driving support system and the like for dynamically and flexibly presenting a route for avoiding danger.SOLUTION: A navigation system 100 is a driving support system that detects the location of its own vehicle and presents a guide route from the location of its own vehicle to a destination. The driving support system includes: a peripheral vehicle information acquisition section 153; an attention vehicle detection section 154b; a route setting section 154c, which is an avoidance route setting section; and a map information acquisition section 158, which is a facility information acquisition section for acquiring facility information that is information about a facility present around the own vehicle. The avoidance route setting section searches for a shelter facility where the own vehicle temporarily shelters on the basis of the facility information, and sets an avoidance route that deviates from a travel route.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Fire escape path planning method and system based on extended A-x algorithm
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of emergency route planning, and particularly relates to a fire escape path planning method and system based on an expanded A-x algorithm, which comprises the following steps: collecting building floor data, modeling the environment of each floor, and acquiring an NxN dimensional map of each floor of the building, wherein the map comprises a free grid for identifying a passing area, an obstacle grid for representing an obstacle area and a fire grid for representing a fire area; and when a plurality of minimum cost values appear at a certain point of a map, each point with the minimum cost value is used as the next point to be expanded so as to obtain a branch with the minimum comprehensive cost value, and the branch is used as an optimal escape path. The invention is convenient to obtain the shortest escape route so as to achieve the purpose of correctly and timely evacuating people, and can greatly reduce the casualty degree in the fire by combining the intelligent escape guidance of the route planning algorithm, thereby having stronger practicability.

title_en: Indoor collaborative path planning method and system for high-rise fire-fighting multi-unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for planning an indoor collaborative path of a high-rise fire-fighting multi-unmanned aerial vehicle, aiming at overcoming the defects of low unmanned aerial vehicle path planning efficiency and low flexibility when the high-rise fire-fighting multi-unmanned aerial vehicle executes a fire-fighting task indoors, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring three-dimensional space data of an accident building by adopting a fire-fighting unmanned aerial vehicle, acquiring data of a smoke sensor and a temperature sensor of the accident building, constructing a three-dimensional space model and planning a preliminary evacuation path; planning a detection path according to the three-dimensional space model; determining the fire point position, screening the fire point on the preliminary evacuation path, and planning a fire extinguishing path; when the investigation unmanned aerial vehicle searches for trapped persons, the investigation unmanned aerial vehicle feeds back current positioning coordinate data, a converging path of the investigation unmanned aerial vehicle and the nearest fire extinguishing unmanned aerial vehicle is planned in a three-dimensional space model in a coordinated mode, and the nearest fire extinguishing unmanned aerial vehicle and the investigation unmanned aerial vehicle converge; and planning an evacuation path, and evacuating trapped people along the evacuation path by the investigation unmanned aerial vehicle and the fire extinguishing unmanned aerial vehicle.

title_en: Building interior fire emergency navigation positioning system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire emergency navigation positioning system and method in a building, wherein the system comprises handheld positioning devices, a fire emergency lamp, a first UWB transceiver and an intelligent sensor, wherein each handheld positioning device is provided with a UWB positioning tag and a second UWB transceiver; each fire-fighting emergency lamp is provided with a power supply, a display screen and a processor, a first UWB transceiver and an intelligent sensor are installed in each fire-fighting emergency lamp and are connected with the processor and the power supply, and the first UWB transceiver is used for sending corresponding signals and self positioning data to the processor when receiving UWB signals of a UWB positioning tag; the processor is used for calculating and sending positioning data and environmental data of the handheld positioning device, judging the unblocked condition of the channel and controlling the display screen to indicate an escape route according to the judgment result and the environmental data. The invention can provide the smooth condition of the internal passage of the building and the distribution condition of the trapped personnel for the fire fighters, and improve the disaster relief efficiency.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle operation system for evacuation guidance and evacuation guidance method using the same
title_ko: 대피 안내를 위한 무인 비행체 운용 시스템 및 이를 이용한 대피 안내 방법
abstract_en: An unmanned aerial vehicle operation system for evacuation guidance according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles flying within a disaster site, detecting a person through a sensor mounted therein to generate sensing data, and transmitting the generated sensing data together with the corresponding location information; and a ground control system which receives the sensing data and the location information from each of the plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles, searches for a main evacuation route, and transmits a flight control signal for evacuation route guidance to each of the plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles by using information on the searched main evacuation route.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 대피 안내를 위한 무인 비행체 운용 시스템은 재난 발생 현장 내에서 비행하며 내부에 탑재된 센서를 통해 사람을 감지하여 센싱 데이터를 생성하고, 상기 생성된 센싱 데이터를 해당 위치 정보와 함께 전송하는 복수의 무인 비행체; 및 상기 복수의 무인 비행체 각각으로부터 상기 센싱 데이터 및 상기 위치 정보를 수신하여 메인 대피 경로를 탐색하고, 상기 탐색된 메인 대피 경로에 관한 정보를 이용하여 상기 복수의 무인 비행체 각각에 대피 경로 안내를 위한 비행 제어 신호를 전송하는 지상 관제 시스템을 포함한다.
assignees: PAICHAI UNIV INDUSTRY ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION

title_en: Emergency evacuation path planning method, device, medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides an emergency evacuation path planning method, an emergency evacuation path planning device, a computer-readable storage medium and electronic equipment, wherein whether a congestion node exists in a current path or not is judged, when the congestion node exists, the shortest alternative path of each vehicle at the congestion node is calculated, whether the congestion condition of the congestion node can be relieved or not is judged, if the congestion condition can be relieved, whether an uncongested path exists or not is judged after the paths of part of vehicles at the congestion node are replaced by the shortest alternative paths or not is judged, when the uncongested path exists, the first evacuation time of the uncongested path is calculated, and when the first evacuation time meets a preset condition, the path corresponding to the first evacuation time is set as an alternative path; through a series of route replacement and calculation of corresponding evacuation time, the non-congestion path with the evacuation time meeting the preset conditions is obtained in the shortest time, so that safe evacuation of each vehicle is conveniently guided.
assignees: SHENZHEN HUITUO INFINITE TECH CO LTD

title_en: GNSS positioning module
abstract_en: The utility model provides a GNSS orientation module, include: the device comprises a processor unit, a GNSS multi-frequency receiving unit, a wireless communication unit and an inertia measurement unit; the GNSS multi-frequency receiving unit, the wireless communication unit and the inertia measuring unit are respectively and electrically connected with the processor unit; the GNSS multi-frequency receiving unit is used for generating navigation message information according to the signals received by the GNSS antenna and transmitting the navigation message information to the processor unit; the wireless communication unit is used for acquiring error correction data of the satellite and transmitting the error correction data to the processor unit; the inertial measurement unit is used for acquiring inertial navigation data and transmitting the inertial navigation data to the processor unit; the processor unit is used for generating target positioning information according to the inertial navigation data, the error correction data of the satellite and the navigation message information. The utility model discloses can generate centimeter level target positioning information, improve positioning accuracy, reduce first positioning time duration, can not lose positioning information through inertial navigation data under the condition that exists the shelter.

title_en: Method for navigating people in building floor, method and system for navigating people in multi-floor building
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for navigating people in a building floor, a method for navigating people in a multi-floor building and a system. The navigation method can enable the evacuation path to be planned more scientifically, and once an emergency occurs, the optimal evacuation path can be determined quickly according to the current personnel distribution condition; meanwhile, each individual person can independently observe the evacuation path of the person, so that the escape efficiency is higher.
assignees: CHINA ACADEMY OF BUILDING RES;JIANYAN FIRE PROTECTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Indoor VR system of fleing of market under three-dimensional visual condition
abstract_en: The invention provides a mall indoor VR escape system under a three-dimensional visualization condition, which comprises a road network processing module, a disaster sensing sensor, a weight determination module, an evacuation streamline analysis module, an optimal path planning algorithm and a three-dimensional panoramic VR display. The weight determination module comprehensively considers a plurality of factors influencing personnel escape, comprehensively evaluates the factors by using a fuzzy theory, plans a live-action escape route and direction by combining evacuation streamline analysis and an optimal path planning algorithm, and visually displays the live-action escape route and direction through a VR virtual scene. The method has the advantages that the optimal path is displayed in the VR three-dimensional scene, so that the path is planned more specifically and visually, and the immersion sense of the scene is improved to rapidly guide people to escape and evacuate.

title_en: Planning method suitable for fastest walking path of emergency refuge in complex terrain in mountainous area
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of emergency refuge path planning, and aims to provide a method for planning a fastest walking path for emergency refuge in a complex terrain in a mountainous area. The method comprises the steps of carrying out emergency risk avoiding path planning in the shortest time on a two-dimensional elevation grid topographic map of a planning area by using an A-x algorithm; and on the basis, the influence coefficient of the local common ground type on the walking speed of the person is further measured through a unified standard, and the A-star algorithm is corrected by considering the influence of the slope and the ground type on the walking speed of the person. The connection line between paths with smaller G value formed by the grid with the smallest F value is used as the shortest emergency evacuation route from the starting point to the end point. The invention increases the influence of the ground type and the gradient change on the path planning based on the improvement of the traditional A-star algorithm, and the emergency refuge path planning result is more suitable for the practical application situation of complex areas in mountainous areas.

title_en: Positioning system and method based on inertial navigation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a positioning system and method based on inertial navigation, and belongs to the technical field of vehicle positioning. The method comprises the steps of firstly receiving an overhead image of the roof acquired by an image acquisition device, judging whether a target shelter exists in the overhead image of the roof, positioning the vehicle by using an inertial navigation system when the target shelter exists, positioning the vehicle by using the inertial navigation system and a satellite navigation system when the target shelter does not exist, and further comprehensively using the inertial navigation system and the satellite navigation system to position the vehicle, so that the positioning accuracy of the vehicle can be further improved.
assignees: INST OF APPLIED PHYSICS JIANGXI ACADEMY OF SCIENCES

title_en: Tropical farm planning and management system based on GIS and remote sensing technology
abstract_en: The invention provides a tropical farm planning and management system based on GIS and remote sensing technology, which comprises a human-computer interaction screen, a planning host and a remote sensing information acquisition module, wherein a GIS module, a path planning module, a water source distribution module, an agricultural resource distribution module and an information processing module are arranged in the planning host, the remote sensing information acquisition module comprises a camera, a multispectral scanner and an imaging radar, the remote sensing information acquisition module acquires the terrain, the water source information and the like of a farm, acquired data are transmitted to the planning host, the planning host draws a map and superposes all resources according to the GIS information, a collection route, a fire fighting route, an emergency evacuation route, a planting route, a sewage drainage route and the like can be planned through the arranged path planning module, and comprehensive planning and management of the farm are realized, the effective utilization of resources and the rationality of crop planting are ensured.
assignees: HAINAN JINKEN CYBER INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: System and method for emergency evacuation route guidance
title_ko: 긴급대피 경로 안내 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: In a method in which an emergency evacuation route guidance system generates an evacuation route, a weight between any two regional nodes among a plurality of regional nodes installed on a target floor to be managed in the entire building is calculated and a regional graph is formed based on the calculated weight. A local route for the target floor to be managed is evaluated by using a local graph, a cross graph for the entire building is created, and a global route is evaluated based on the cross graph and the local route. A shortest route from a cross node to the exit is calculated based on the global route, and an evacuation route is selected by using weight information of the calculated shortest route and the local route.
abstract_ko: 긴급대피 경로 안내 시스템이 대피 경로를 생성하는 방법으로서, 건물 전체 중 관리 대상 층에 설치된 복수의 지역 노드들 중 임의의 두 지역 노드 사이의 가중치를 계산하고, 계산한 가중치를 기초로 지역 그래프를 구성한다. 지역 그래프를 이용하여 관리 대상 층에 대한 지역 경로를 평가하고, 건물 전체에 대한 교차 그래프를 생성한 후, 교차 그래프와 지역 경로를 기초로 전역 경로를 평가한다. 전역 경로를 바탕으로 교차 노드에서 출구까지 최단 경로를 계산하고, 계산된 최단 경로의 가중치 정보와 지역 경로를 이용하여 대피 경로를 선택한다.

title_en: Visitor navigation method and system based on fire evacuation indication terminal and terminal
abstract_en: The method comprises the steps of obtaining an access reservation signal sent by a visitor, generating route planning information and a pass permit certificate, storing the route planning information and the pass permit certificate in a correlation mode to form navigation planning information, comparing and verifying current portrait information and visitor portrait information after receiving the access application signal, and generating a door opening signal to open an access control device for the current visitor to pass through after the verification is passed; and acquiring first real-time monitoring image information, comparing the first real-time monitoring image information with the visitor portrait information, and after judging that the current visitor arrives at the target floor, sending navigation planning information to a corresponding fire-fighting evacuation indication terminal to guide the fire-fighting evacuation indication terminal. The method and the device have the effects of reducing the route searching time of the visitor and improving the resource utilization rate.
assignees: SHENZHEN FUSIYUAN SMART FIRE CO LTD

title_en: Fire-fighting emergency method based on UWB positioning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-fighting emergency method based on UWB positioning. The invention comprises the following steps: step 1, firstly, constructing a three-dimensional safety control system in a thermal power plant; the three-dimensional safety management and control system comprises a positioning hardware system and a background calculation display module; step 2, the three-dimensional safety management and control system is in butt joint with a fire fighting system of the thermal power plant through a ModBus; and 3, realizing fire evacuation rescue by combining the UWB accurate positioning technology with fire management. The invention can quickly check the fire position and peripheral fire-fighting facilities, and can also quickly call the camera to check the field situation. After a fire disaster occurs, except that the lamp of the emergency evacuation channel is lightened, the invention can indicate the optimal escape route and the nearby fire-fighting facilities. The invention can know the fire position and can quickly reach the fire position through navigation.
assignees: ZHEJIANG ZHENENG TAIZHOU NO 2 POWER GENERATION CO LTD;HANGZHOU PUFIN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Navigating apparatus and method for evacuation path
title_ko: 대피 경로 안내 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: An evacuation route guidance device is provided. The evacuation route guidance device includes: a sensor unit including at least one sensor disposed in a building to measure state information on a target point; a processor determining an evacuation route which satisfies a preset evacuation condition by using the state information, and generating a control signal for inducing evacuation of a user based on the target point; and an optical output unit irradiating light including type information of the final escape route of the evacuation route, risk information of the target point, and direction information to the next target point included in the evacuation route according to the control signal onto the ground of the target point.
abstract_ko: 대피 경로 안내 장치가 제공된다.  상기 대피 경로 안내 장치는 건축물 내에 배치되어 타겟 지점에 대한 상태 정보를 측정하는 적어도 하나의 센서를 포함하는 센서부, 상기 상태 정보를 이용하여 기설정된 대피 조건을 만족하는 대피 경로를 결정하고, 상기 타겟 지점을 기준으로 사용자의 대피를 유도하기 위한 제어 신호를 생성하는 프로세서 및 상기 제어 신호에 따라, 상기 대피 경로의 최종 탈출구의 유형 정보, 상기 타겟 지점의 위험도 정보 및 상기 대피 경로에 포함되는 다음 타겟 지점까지의 방향 정보를 포함하는 광을 상기 타겟 지점의 지면 상으로 조사하는 광 출력부를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Vehicle emergency navigation method with space-time characteristic situation information
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vehicle emergency navigation method with space-time characteristic situation information. The method achieves the effect of simplification while ensuring the integrity of the road network structure, thereby improving the quick update of situation information and realizing a quick mapping mechanism of a path; and finally, on a vehicle path planning layer, combining the processing results of the two layers to the road network, providing a heuristic dynamic path planning algorithm aiming at urban emergency, and realizing the planning of the vehicle emergency route by the recommended evacuation area and the analysis of the situation information of the road. The invention enables the vehicle to drive from the emergency area to the safe area in the shortest time, achieves good vehicle evacuation effect and enables the route planned by the emergency navigation of the vehicle to be more accurate and reliable.

title_en: Dynamic dangerous shipborne environment self-adaptive emergency navigation method
abstract_en: A self-adaptive emergency navigation method for a dynamic dangerous shipborne environment comprises the following steps: A. extracting a 3D topological model of a ship according to the ship structure, and laying a ship-borne wireless sensor network according to the model; B. establishing a ship emergency evacuation model by utilizing a graph theory based on a ship-borne wireless sensor network; C. defining an optimal passenger escape path under the damaged ship environment according to the ship emergency evacuation model; D. in the preprocessing stage, a path lookup table is established for each navigation landmark; E. in the actual navigation stage, according to the walking speed of the passenger, the next navigation road sign is determined for the passenger by referring to the path lookup table until the escape set point is reached. The design not only improves the navigation efficiency and the navigation success rate, but also improves the user safety.

title_en: Intelligent evacuation and rescue navigation system and method based on fire-fighting emergency lamp positioning
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent evacuation and rescue navigation system and method based on fire-fighting emergency lamp positioning, and belongs to the technical field of fire safety and emergency rescue. The emergency lighting controller and the fire emergency lamp are internally provided with a wireless communication module, and the rescue personnel handheld terminal and the indoor personnel handheld terminal can be communicated with the wireless communication module of the fire emergency lamp; the special cloud platform can interact with the information of the indoor personnel and the handheld terminals of the rescue personnel, the emergency lighting controller and the emergency rescue scene command platform and conduct data analysis. The device overcomes many problems caused by beacons such as rear-mounted Bluetooth, provides daily action auxiliary navigation for indoor personnel, and ensures efficient, accurate and safe rescue of the rescue personnel by acquiring the position information of the rescue personnel in real time.

title_en: Apparatus and method for evacuation route guidance
title_ko: 대피 경로 안내 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: An apparatus and a method for guiding an evacuation route are disclosed. The method for guiding the evacuation route comprises the steps of: generating an indoor topology map by receiving an indoor map and installation locations of a plurality of sensor nodes; sensing the occurrence of a disaster situation at a location where at least one first sensor node among the plurality of sensor nodes is installed by monitoring sensor data received from the plurality of sensor nodes; receiving a message from a user terminal wherein the message includes sensor data acquired from a second sensor node adjacent to the user terminal among the plurality of sensor nodes; classifying the first sensor node and the second sensor node as a danger node and a user node, respectively; and generating evacuation route information for displaying the evacuation route from the user node to an evacuation node adjacent to an exit on the indoor topology map while avoiding the danger node and transmitting the evacuation route information to the user terminal. The present invention can identify the position of the user when a disaster situation occurs and can provide the evacuation route to the user based on the identified position of the user.
abstract_ko: 대피 경로 안내 장치 및 방법이 개시된다. 대피 경로 안내 방법은, 실내 지도 및 복수의 센서 노드의 설치 위치를 입력받아 실내 토폴로지맵(topology map)을 생성하는 단계, 복수의 센서 노드로부터 수신되는 센서데이터를 모니터링하여 복수의 센서 노드 중 적어도 하나의 제1 센서 노드가 설치된 위치에서의 재난상황 발생을 감지하는 단계, 사용자 단말이 복수의 센서 노드 중 인접한 제2 센서 노드로부터 획득한 센서데이터를 포함하는 메시지를 사용자 단말로부터 수신하는 단계, 제1 센서 노드 및 제2 센서 노드를 각각 위험 노드 및 사용자 노드로 분류하는 단계 및 위험 노드를 회피하여 사용자 노드로부터 탈출구에 인접한 탈출 노드로의 대피경로를 실내 토폴로지맵에 표시한 대피경로정보를 생성하여 사용자 단말로 전송하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: Smart fire detector
abstract_en: To provide a smart fire detector capable of notifying not only of a fire but also of a detected fire element for each type through analysis of a detected fire element for each type.SOLUTION: A smart fire detector 100 includes: a sensing unit 10 configured to detect one or more fire elements (heat, smoke, gases, and particulate matters); a controller 20 configured to analyze detected sensing signals to determine whether a fire has occurred and to output a fire signal; an imaging unit 30 configured to take an image of an area in which the fire elements have been detected in response to the fire signal and to extract an image and a picture of a high-definition snapshot from the taken image; and a notification unit 40 configured to output a fire alarm and near fire escape route guidance sound in response to the fire signal. The controller 20 includes: a communication unit 25 configured to transmit the image and the picture extracted through the imaging unit 30 to a control center; and a determination unit 21 configured to compare measurement values of the fire elements detected by the sensing unit with preset reference values and analyze comparison results. The determination unit 21 determines that a fire has occurred if the measurement values of the fire elements exceed the preset reference values.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Fire-fighting evacuation path planning device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sparse route planning device of fire control, including placing two conveyer belts subaerial, two rotate between the conveyer belt and be connected with first rotation pole, it is connected with the planning frame to rotate on the first rotation pole, plan and seted up two apertures on the frame, first rotation pole passes through the aperture and plans the frame rotation and be connected, two fixed connection between the inside of conveyer belt and the planning frame, plan the both sides fixedly connected with dead lever of frame, fixedly connected with gag lever post on the dead lever. The utility model discloses, can adjust the brush angle that is used for the sparse route planning of fire control, consequently, can be to the planning of route planning in-process, the planning of better realization route when having solved most route planning, can only draw sharp problem, owing to the regulation of route planning brush angle, can realize drawing the slash when route planning, satisfy the needs of different angle route planning.

title_en: Evacuation route providing system and method using the same
title_ko: 안전 체험시 사용가능한 대피 경로 제공 시스템 및 이를 이용한 대피 경로 제공 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are an evacuation route providing system usable during safety experience and an evacuation route providing method using the same. The evacuation route providing system comprises: a fire hydrant with NFC tag for providing hydrant information and Bluetooth pairing information; a smart band for requesting pairing based on the Bluetooth pairing information received from the NFC tag; and an intermediary terminal for receiving a pairing request from the smart band to pair with the smart band, and extracting route information based on the fire hydrant information and device information received from the smart band. The smart band displays a route guidance screen for a route to a destination based on route information received from the intermediate terminal. Accordingly, without using expensive equipment such as smartphones, by using a smart band that is simple to possess, not frequently damaged, easy to collect after distribution, and easy to manage. It is possible to provide an evacuation route in an emergency situation to users who do not have or cannot have a smartphone, so that they can evacuate quickly.
abstract_ko: 대피 경로 제공 시스템 및 이를 이용한 대피 경로 제공 방법이 개시된다. 본 대피 경로 제공 시스템은, 소화전 정보 및 블루투스 페어링 정보를 제공하기 위한 NFC 태그를 부착한 소화전; 상기 NFC 태그로부터 수신된 상기 블루투스 페어링 정보를 기반으로 페어링을 요청하는 스마트 밴드; 및 상기 스마트 밴드로부터 페어링 요청을 수신하여 상기 스마트 밴드와의 페어링되도록 하고, 상기 스마트 밴드로부터 수신된 소화전 정보와 디바이스 정보를 기반으로 경로 정보를 추출하는 중개 단말;을 포함하고, 상기 스마트 밴드는, 상기 중개 단말로부터 수신된 경로 정보를 기반으로 목적지까지의 경로에 대한 경로 안내 화면을 표시한다. 이에 의해, 스마트폰과 같은 고가의 장비를 활용하지 않고서도 오히려 소지가 간편하고 파손이 잦지 않으며 배포 후 수거가 용이하고 관리가 용이한 스마트 밴드를 이용함으로써, 스마트폰을 소지하지 않거나 스마트폰을 소지할 수 없는 사용자들에게도 비상 상황에서 대피 경로를 제공하여 신속한 대피가 가능하도록 할 수 있게 된다.

title_en: High-precision navigation device and navigation method based on panoramic photo
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of automatic navigation of unmanned automobiles, in particular to a high-precision navigation device and a navigation method based on panoramic photos. The specific technical scheme is as follows: firstly establishing a reference characteristic line database of the panoramic picture, then comparing the panoramic picture shot when the vehicle normally runs with the reference characteristic line database, and immediately positioning after the result is obtained by comparison. Simultaneously, through navigation head's cooperation, make panoramic camera can adjust in real time and the roof between the distance, even have the front truck to shelter from also can accurately carry out accurate quick location to the vehicle that traveles at present under the unable condition of fixing a position. Therefore, the invention effectively solves the problem that the specific position of the running vehicle in the road cannot be determined quickly and accurately in the prior art.

title_en: Evacuate route guiding system
title_ko: 대피경로 안내시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an evacuation route guidance system. More specifically, when receiving fire detection information from any one or more of a plurality of fire detectors installed in a building, the evacuation route is transmitted to a user terminal located in a building, in the evacuation route guidance system.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 대피경로 안내시스템에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 건물 내에 설치된 복수의 화재감지기 중 어느 하나 이상으로부터 화재감지정보를 전송받을 경우 건물 내에 위치한 사용자단말기에 대피경로를 전송해주는 대피경로 안내시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Emergency escape guidance technology in building using lighting control technique
title_ko: 조명제어 기법을 활용한 건물내 비상대피로 안내 기술
abstract_en: The present invention discloses an emergency evacuation route guidance technology in buildings using a lighting control technique. According to the present invention, in a fire situation, a server unit detects an evacuation route from an evacuation route analyzer and transmits corresponding information to an LED corresponding to the evacuation route through a network device. An LED controller changes the color of the LED through the corresponding data.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 조명제어 기법을 활용한 건물내 비상대피로 안내 기술을 개시한다.
assignees: UNIV CHUNG ANG IND ACAD COOP FOUND

title_en: Fire control system and method integrating home gateway and intelligent Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire control system and a method integrating a home gateway and an intelligent Internet of things, wherein the system comprises a cloud end and further comprises: the image acquisition module is used for acquiring and sending image information to the cloud; the fire fighting equipment management and control module is used for starting the fire fighting equipment under the control of the cloud; the escape indication module is in communication connection with the cloud and used for indicating an escape route; the mobile terminal is in communication connection with the cloud end and used for receiving and displaying escape navigation information; wisdom house module, it includes: the home gateway equipment is in communication connection with the cloud end; and the fire alarm network access unit and the home network access unit are accessed to the home gateway. The cloud is also connected with an elevator control module of the building and used for controlling the elevator without passengers to stop running under the condition of fire. In the wisdom house module, fire alarm network access unit and house network access unit adopt different modes to insert the gateway, realize the intercommunication mutual control of information, have more high intellectuality, not only the management of being convenient for but also economical and practical.
assignees: YINGKOU TIANCHENG FIRE PROT EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for guiding evacuation route to persons to be rescued in disastrous site
title_ko: 재난 현장에서 요구조자에게 대피 경로를 안내하는 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed are a method and a system for guiding an evacuation route to a person in need at a disaster site. An evacuation route guide method comprises the steps of: detecting the strength of a signal transmitted and received between one or more positioning devices and a smart device possessed by a requestor, and measuring the position of the requestor on the basis of the strength of the detected signal; detecting whether a disaster has occurred and a point of occurrence of a disaster on the basis of sensor information received from one or more disaster detection sensors; when a disaster is detected, determining the current status of victims, including the number and location of those who need rescue, and transmitting the same to a disaster management center; and determining an evacuation route to avoid the disaster point for each person in need of rescue, and providing the determined evacuation route to a smart device of the person in need. According to the present invention, artificial intelligence performs analysis so that people can safely evacuate within the golden time through positioning of a remaining personnel at the fire site, and the shortest distance evacuation route can be automatically determined and provided to the person in need.
abstract_ko: 재난 현장에서 요구조자에게 대피 경로를 안내하는 방법 및 시스템이 개시된다.  대피 경로 안내 방법은, 하나 이상의 측위 디바이스와 요구조자가 소지한 스마트 디바이스 사이에 송수신되는 신호의 세기를 검출하고, 검출된 신호의 세기에 기반하여 요구조자의 위치를 측정하는 단계; 하나 이상의 재난 감지 센서로부터 수신된 센서 정보에 기반하여 재난 발생 여부 및 재난 발생 지점을 감지하는 단계; 재난이 감지될 경우 구조가 필요한 미대피 요구조자의 인원수 및 위치를 포함하는 요구조자 현황을 결정하여 재난 관리 센터로 전송하는 단계; 및 구조가 필요한 요구조자마다 상기 재난 발생 지점을 회피하는 대피 경로를 결정하고, 결정된 대피 경로를 요구조자의 스마트 디바이스에 제공하는 단계를 포함한다.  본 발명에 의하여, 화재현장 잔류 인원의 위치 측위를 통하여 골든타임 내에 사람들의 안전한 대피가 가능하도록 인공지능이 분석하고 최단거리인 대피 경로를 자동으로 결정하여 요구조자에게 제공할 수 있다.
assignees: UNIV DONG A RES FOUND FOR IND ACAD COOP

title_en: Method and device for evaluating evacuation safety of fire personnel in navigation tunnel ship
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a device for evaluating evacuation safety of fire personnel in a navigation tunnel ship, electronic equipment and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring maximum fire heat release rates of ships in different navigation tunnels in fire scenes, and determining critical wind speeds of the ships in different navigation tunnels in the fire scenes; determining different fire working conditions according to different navigation tunnel ship fire scenes and different current wind speeds, acquiring the time for human body contact temperature and combustion heat radiation to reach the outside of the tolerable range of the human body on the characteristic height under different fire working conditions, and taking the minimum value of the two times as the available safe evacuation time under the corresponding fire working conditions; the method comprises the steps of obtaining the single-ship personnel landing time and the platform evacuation time, determining personnel evacuation movement time according to the single-ship personnel landing time and the platform evacuation time, and obtaining the necessary safety evacuation time according to the personnel evacuation movement time. The method realizes the safety evaluation of personnel evacuation under the fire condition of the navigation tunnel ship.

title_en: Personnel emergency evacuation simulation method considering radioactive influence
abstract_en: The invention relates to a personnel emergency evacuation simulation method considering radioactive influence, which comprises the steps of firstly carrying out scene modeling, then considering the influence of radioactive substance distribution, judging an available path area for personnel evacuation, carrying out static path planning, adopting a proper personnel behavior model to simulate the interaction between people and obstacles in the personnel evacuation process so as to obtain personnel speed and density data in the whole evacuation process, comprehensively considering the radioactive substance distribution, path distance and passing time influence factors, and timely adjusting personnel evacuation paths to realize dynamic path planning. The invention can provide an auxiliary tool for formulating and perfecting a feasible and efficient emergency plan, improves the operability of the emergency plan, and has a positive effect on reducing the influence of serious accidents of the nuclear power plant on people and environment.
assignees: CHINA NUCLEAR POWER ENG CO LTD

title_en: Evacuation route guidance method and evacuation route guidance system to life raft of ship
title_ko: 선박 대피경로 안내 방법 및 선박 대피경로 안내 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a ship evacuation route guidance method which, in the case of a ship accident, determines the inclination of a ship, checks safety of a life raft (life jacket) for escaping from the ship, and guides passengers to the life raft whose safety is confirmed while avoiding the location of a fire through an evacuation route application of a terminal device of a user who boards the ship, thereby realizing a safe and quick escape, and a ship evacuation route guidance system thereof. According to the present invention, the ship evacuation route guidance method comprises: a life raft inspection step of inspecting whether a life raft is operating normally through a life raft normal operation inspection device installed in each life raft and transmitting an inspection result to an inspection result receiving step in real-time or periodically; a fire detection signal detection step of detecting a fire detection signal in real-time by a fire detection module installed in a plurality of places on a ship; a detection signal receiving step of receiving the inspection result and the fire detection signal at a central control unit; an evacuation route extraction step of extracting an evacuation route of movement lines for the life rafts whose normal operation is confirmed while avoiding a fire location on the basis of the received inspection signal of whether the life raft operates normally and the fire detection signal; and an evacuation route display step of displaying and guiding the extracted evacuation route through at least one of a plurality of monitors installed on the ship and an evacuation route application installed on a user terminal device of ship passengers.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 선박 사고 시 선박의 기울기 등을 판단하고, 선박으로부터 탈출하기 위한 라이프레이트(구명벌)의 안전성을 확인하며, 선박에 탑승한 사용자의 단말장치의 대피경로 애플리케이션을 통해 화재 위치를 회피하면서 안전성이 확인된 라이프레프트로 탑승객을 유도하여 안전하고 신속한 탈출을 가능하게 하는 선박 대피경로 안내 방법 및 선박 대피경로 안내 시스템에 관한 것이다. 본 발명에 따르면, 각 라이프레프트에 설치된 라이프레프트 정상작동 검사장치를 통해 라이프레프트의 정상 작동 유무를 검사하여 하기 검사결과 수신 단계로 실시간 또는 주기적으로 전송하는 라이프레프트 검사 단계; 선박의 복수 개소에 설치되는 화재감지모듈에 의해 화재 감지 신호를 실시간 검출하는 화재감지신호 검출 단계; 상기 검사결과 및 화재감지신호를 중앙 통제부에서 수신하는 검출신호 및 감지신호 수신 단계; 상기 수신된 라이프레프트의 정상 작동 유무의 검사 신호 및 화재 감지 신호에 기반하여 화재 위치를 회피하면서 정상작동이 확인된 라이프레프트들에 대한 동선의 대피 경로를 추출하는 대피경로 추출 단계; 및 상기 추출된 대피경로를 선박에 설치된 복수의 모니터 및 선박 탑승자의 사용자 단말장치에 설치된 대피경로 애플리케이션 중 적어도 하나를 통해 디스플레이하여 안내하는 대피경로 디스플레이 단계;를 포함하는 선박 대피경로 안내 방법이 제공된다.

title_en: Fire evacuation path planning system for building and control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire evacuation path planning system for a building, which comprises a detection unit and also comprises: the indicating unit, the storage unit, the early warning unit and the control unit are used for monitoring fire-fighting data, if the output signal is that a fire occurs, the control unit controls the indicating board to indicate the position of the safety exit, and the alarm lamp corresponding to the indicating board flickers intermittently; if the output signal is the fire spread, the control unit controls the indicating plate to indicate the position of the safety exit far away from the fire spread, and the alarm lamp corresponding to the indicating plate flickers intermittently. This scheme can utilize the mode early warning of sign, warning light and broadcast, reminds the inside personnel of building in time to flee, simultaneously, carries out timely early warning to the conflagration diffusion, increases personnel chance of fleing.

title_en: Digital display method and device for fire-fighting plan, server and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application is applicable to the technical field of image processing, and provides a digital display method, a device, a server and a readable storage medium for a fire protection plan, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a current scene three-dimensional model; generating and marking an escape route in a current scene three-dimensional model based on a preset path planning algorithm by taking a virtual position point as a starting point, a preset distance difference between a fire point and the virtual position, a fire spreading direction, smoke spreading and an obstacle position as influence factors and an exit point as an end point; and sending the current scene three-dimensional model to the user terminal so as to instruct the user terminal to display the current scene three-dimensional model to the user. Therefore, according to the embodiment of the application, after the user obtains the current scene three-dimensional model by shooting with the aid of the depth camera in any real scene, the user terminal can display the escape route generated in the fire process in the current scene three-dimensional model in a simulated mode to serve as the fire protection plan, and the effect of visually displaying the fire protection plan is achieved.
assignees: CHINA GERMANY ZHUHAI ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;4DAGE CO LTD

title_en: Rapid generation system and method for shortest escape route in public place
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for quickly generating the shortest escape route in public places, which comprises the following steps: an escape route planning module, an escape route library, an escape environment monitoring module, a lamp indication control module and an escape route generation module, the escape passage is divided and reconnected by the escape path planning module to obtain an escape route with a safety exit, the shortest escape route is generated by comparing the lengths of the escape routes and is sent to an escape route library, so that the escape time is saved, the workload of compiling evacuation plans is reduced, a fire scene is simulated, the shortest escape route is extracted, the smoke concentration detected by all smoke sensors on the route is obtained, the smoke diffusion direction is analyzed, whether the smoke diffusion direction is consistent with the indication direction of the lamp or not is judged through the lamp indication control module, the indication direction of the lamp is adjusted to change an escape route, people are prevented from being evacuated to a place with large smoke, and the probability that the people are damaged and even die due to the smoke is reduced.
assignees: NEAT XIPU FIRE FIGHTING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Indoor positioning system for fire safety evacuation
abstract_en: The invention discloses an indoor positioning system for fire safety evacuation, which comprises a system architecture, a navigation system, a multi-source fusion positioning algorithm, an Internet of things wireless positioning network and a Bluetooth beacon, wherein the system architecture comprises a plurality of positioning modules; the system architecture comprises an application layer, a service layer and a data & engine layer; the navigation system comprises a cloud server, a management background, a mobile device and a Bluetooth beacon; the multi-source fusion positioning algorithm fuses a plurality of positioning data sources, including Bluetooth, an inertial navigation positioning system and a GPS, and supports the expansion fusion of other wireless signal positioning technologies; the invention adopts the combination of the indoor positioning technology and the fire safety system, and realizes the purposes of managing and evacuating people on the fire scene by methods of intelligently guiding a safety evacuation channel, positioning the personnel on the fire scene, displaying the track of the rescue personnel and the like through a small program, thereby meeting the use requirements of people.
assignees: LIAONING GUOCI FIRE FIGHTING LIGHTING CO LTD

title_en: Multi-sensor fusion absolute positioning method suitable for complex non-cooperative scene
