abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-sensor fusion absolute positioning method suitable for a complex non-cooperative scene, which is suitable for multi-sensor fusion absolute positioning of the complex non-cooperative scene, aims at disaster environments that GNSS high-precision absolute positioning fails under a sheltering condition and a wide-area dynamic scene laser radar SLAM cannot realize absolute positioning and communication interruption and loss, constructs a GNSSPPP-RTK/INS and laser radar distributed fusion processing system taking inertial navigation as a medium, and designs a GNSSPPP-RTK and inertial navigation fusion absolute positioning method.
assignees: 54TH RES INST CHINA ELECTRONICS TECH GROUP CORP

title_en: Fire-fighting emergency evacuation system with personnel positioning and self-detection functions
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire-fighting emergency evacuation system with personnel positioning and self-detection functions, which comprises a position server, a fire alarm host, a plurality of emergency lamps and a plurality of mobile terminal identifiers, wherein the emergency lamps comprise emergency direction lamps, and the fire alarm host, the emergency lamps and the mobile terminal identifiers are all arranged in a building; an emergency direction lamp is arranged at each channel corner in the building and can indicate each direction at the channel corner; the fire alarm host can detect fire information and input the information to the position server, the mobile terminal recognizer can recognize the mobile terminal and input the information to the position server, the position server receives the information input by the mobile terminal recognizer and performs information analysis and path planning, the system can plan a reasonable escape path according to personnel distribution conditions, guides personnel to rapidly move to an escape outlet, can recognize the positioning of trapped personnel, pertinently expands rescue, and improves rescue efficiency.
assignees: SHANGHAI MANGO INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Evacuation path planning method, evacuation path planning device, evacuation path planning equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to an evacuation path planning method, an evacuation path planning device, an evacuation path planning equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining a curved surface map of an evacuation area, determining the position of a target grid point of each grid point based on the position of each grid point in the curved surface map and the gradient descending direction vector of each grid point in the curved surface map, wherein the gradient descending direction vector is the direction vector of each grid point pointing to the nearest direction of the safety exit point, and sequentially connecting each grid point, the target grid point of each grid point and the safety exit point to generate an evacuation path of the evacuation area. By the aid of the technical scheme, evacuation routes of evacuation areas can be automatically generated, the evacuation routes can be accurately and quickly planned according to drawings of complex buildings, manual experience is not needed, exhaustion is not needed, both hands of users are liberated, and a large amount of labor cost is saved.
assignees: ARCHITECTURAL DESIGN AND RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF TSINGHUA UNIV CO LTD

title_en: Fire scene escape-rescue combined system based on deep reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire scene escape-rescue combined system based on deep reinforcement learning, which comprises an escape suit arranged near a fire hydrant box of a fire safety key unit and a fire control room arranged on a fire rescue vehicle, wherein the escape suit is arranged in the fire control safety key unit; the escape suit is provided with a low-power-consumption wireless signal transmission module which is communicated with the outside in a severe environment and is implanted into a building escape route map, an indoor positioning system and an enhanced learning escape route planning algorithm based on Q-learning; the fire control room is provided with an information receiving module and an escape route guidance algorithm based on real-time fire and LSTM; in case of a fire, when the field personnel take the escape suit to move quickly, the line signal transmission module of the escape suit automatically starts to guide personnel to evacuate, and the line signal transmission module is communicated with the fire control room and the fire rescue vehicle in real time, so that the combination of fire scene self rescue and fire rescue personnel search and rescue is realized, the survival rate is effectively improved, and the damage degree of the fire scene personnel is reduced to the maximum extent.
assignees: SUZHOU INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY JIANGSU UNIV OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY

title_en: method for drawing optimal escape route from fire
title_ko: 화재로부터 탈출을 위한 최적 경로 도출 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for deriving an optimal fire escape route. According to the present invention, in the event of a building fire, various IoT sensors are used to comprehensively consider risk factors such as intra-building temperature, visible distance, toxic gas concentration, and occupant density. Each risk factor is given an appropriate weight, an optimal escape route is derived for each room, and then an optimal escape route notification is given to an occupant smartphone or the like. The method includes: (a) a step in which a central control server storing corridor area or length for each building floor, emergency exit count, and escape route for each room determines whether a fire has occurred by periodically receiving detection signals from building room occupant and fire detection sensor modules and a monitoring sensor module installed at an interval in a corridor and detecting visible distance, temperature, and toxic gas concentration at that point; (b) a step of checking the occupant count for each room based on the detection signal from the occupant detection sensor module in the event of a fire occurrence determination; (c) a step of calculating a risk factor for each of the visible distance, temperature, toxic gas concentration, and occupant density; and (d) a step of calculating a risk score for each escape route in accordance with the result of weighting of each risk factor and then deriving the escape route with the minimum risk score as the optimal escape route.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 건물 화재 발생시 각종 IoT 센서를 이용해 건물 내부 온도, 가시거리, 유독가스 농도 및 재실자 밀집도 등의 위험도 계수를 종합적으로 고려하되 각 위험도 계수에 적절한 가중치를 부여해서 각 방의 최적 탈출 경로를 도출한 후 재실자의 스마트폰 등을 통해 알려주는 화재로부터 탈출을 위한 최적 경로 도출 방법에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명의 화재로부터 탈출을 위한 최적 경로 도출 방법은 건물의 각 층의 복도 면적이나 길이, 비상 탈출구 수 및 각 방의 탈출 경로를 저장하고 있는 중앙 관제 서버가 건물의 방에 설치된 재실자 감지 센서 모듈 및 화재감지 센서 모듈, 복도에 간격을 두고 설치되어 해당 지점에서의 가시거리, 온도 및 유독가스 농도를 감지하는 모니터링 센서 모듈로부터 주기적으로 감지 신호를 수집하여 화재 발생 여부를 판단하는 (a) 단계; 화재가 발생한 것으로 판단되면, 재실자 감지 센서 모듈로부터의 감지 신호에 의거하여 각 방의 재실자 인원수를 확인하는 (b) 단계; 가시거리, 온도, 유독가스 농도 및 재실자 밀집도 각각에 대한 위험도 계수를 산출하는 (c) 단계 및 각각의 위험도 계수에 각각의 가중치를 부여한 결과에 따라 각 탈출 경로에 대한 위험 점수를 산출한 후 최소 위험 점수를 갖는 탈출 경로를 최적 탈출 경로로 도출하는 (d) 단계를 포함하여 이루어진다.

title_en: Evacuation rescue vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an evacuation rescue vehicle, including automobile body, seat and rescue subassembly, the camera is installed to the top equidistance of automobile body, the seat is installed to the inside equidistance of automobile body, fixed mounting has the workstation between the seat. The utility model discloses a camera is installed to top equidistance at the automobile body, can utilize and be equipped with on-vehicle 4G terminal, GPS positioning navigation exchanges audio and video data information with command center at any time, but real time monitoring vehicle state, but the high integrated and high electronization advantage of modernization communication is appeared to the fillible, then through on-vehicle computer, network switch, on-vehicle 4G terminal can realize on-the-spot resource sharing, exchange data information with command center, environmental data collection system through automobile body installation after that, upload command center through on-vehicle 4G terminal with data such as site environment's humiture, then monitor through the camera, can realize omnidirectional on-the-spot monitoring search function.
assignees: HUNAN LIEBAO SPECIAL VEHICLE CO LTD;UNIV CENTRAL SOUTH

title_en: Optimal path calculation technology using Adaptive Astar algorithm
title_ko: Adaptive Astar 알고리즘을 이용한 최적 경로 산출 기술
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a technology for calculating an optimal evacuation route using the Adaptive Astar algorithm, which includes: a starting point in space; a destination point to which an evacuee can escape; an emergency situation which has occurred in the space; an optimal route through which the evacuee can escape to the destination point by avoiding an emergency area; and an optimal path which is changed in real time according to the occurrence of an emergency situation and the severity of the emergency situation.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 Adaptice Astar 알고리즘을 이용한 최적 대피 경로 산출 기술에 관한 것으로, 본 발명의 구성은, 공간에서의 출발점; 대피자가 탈출할 수 있는 도착점; 공간에서 발생한 돌발 상황; 대피자가 돌발 상황 지역을 피해 최적의 경로로 도착점으로 탈출할 수 있는 최적경로; 돌발 상황 발생 및 돌발 상황 경중으로 실시간 변경되는 최적 경로를 포함하여 이루어진다.

title_en: Optimal evacuation route calculation technology for underground space disasters using multi-point transmission gas detection method
title_ko: 다점 송출식 가스탐지기법을 응용한 지하공간 재난상황 최적 대피 경로 산출 기술
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an optimal evacuation route calculation technology of an underground space when gas is generated, wherein a configuration of the present invention comprises: an evacuee of an underground space; an exit from which the evacuee can escape; gas generated from the underground space; an optimal route that allows the evacuee to escape to the exit with the optimal route avoiding the gas generating area; and an optimal route that changes in real-time due to gas generation. Therefore, the present invention is capable of allowing the evacuee to safely evacuate through the exit.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 가스발생 시 지하공간의 최적 대피 경로 산출 기술에 관한 것으로, 본 발명의 구성은, 지하공간에서의 대피자; 상기 대피자가 탈출할 수 있는 출구; 지하공간에서 발생한 가스; 상기 대피자가 가스발생 지역을 피해 최적의 경로로 출구로 탈출할 수 있는 최적경로; 가스 발생으로 실시간 변경되는 최적 경로를 포함하여 이루어진다.

title_en: Technology to calculate the optimal evacuation route for underground spaces in case of fire
title_ko: 화재 시 지하공간의 최적 대피 경로 산출 기술
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a technology to calculate an optimal evacuation route of an underground space in case of fire. The present invention comprises: an evacuating person in the underground space; an exit for the evacuating person to evacuate; fire occurring in the underground space; and an optimal evacuation route so that the evacuating person evacuates through the optimal evacuation route to avoid a fire area. The optimal evacuation route changes in real time in case of fire.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재 시 지하공간의 최적 대피 경로 산출 기술에 관한 것으로, 본 발명의 구성은, 지하공간에서의 대피자; 상기 대피자가 탈출할 수 있는 출구; 지하공간에서 발생한 화재; 상기 대피자가 화재 지역을 피해 최적의 경로로 출구로 탈출할 수 있는 최적경로; 화재 발생으로 실시간 변경되는 최적 경로를 포함하여 이루어진다.

title_en: Comprehensive transportation junction emergency evacuation vehicle path planning method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for planning the path of an emergency evacuation vehicle of a comprehensive transportation junction, which comprises the following steps: collecting the demand to be evacuated and the vehicle supply information; evacuation distance, estimation of road section operation time and evacuation demand division; establishing a multi-yard, multi-travel and emergency evacuation vehicle path planning model with time window limitation based on the yard, refuge and hub node information to be evacuated; based on the model, a single-point access full-load single-vehicle evacuation path and a route arrangement which meet the constraint limit of the model are obtained by utilizing route division and demand splitting; generating an emergency vehicle evacuation path by multipoint access; and (4) stabilizing the path set, finishing calculation, and generating information such as paths, the number of people evacuated by the vehicle at each point and the like. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of considering complex scenes such as unbalanced supply and demand, multipoint disaster and the like under the background of emergency evacuation, improving the applicability of the vehicle evacuation path planning to the complex scenes, improving the effectiveness of evacuation and the like.

title_en: Intelligent industrial modernization management monitoring alarm and building patrol system
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent industrial modern management monitoring alarm and building patrol system, which relates to the technical field of security systems and comprises a management platform, an alarm host, a smoke detector, a gas leakage detector, a vibration detector, a siren, a warning lamp, a broadcast, an auxiliary host, an electronic map, road sign navigation, a monitoring camera, a data storage server, a manual patrol, an interphone, a viewing terminal, a contact terminal, a control host, a door access device, a face recognizer and a vehicle recognition register. According to the invention, through the arrangement of the management platform, when special conditions occur, the alarm host can control the corresponding alarm to be sent out, the management platform can mark the information position on the electronic map through the auxiliary host and light up the road sign for navigation on a proper route, so that rescue workers can arrive at the alarm place in time, and a better evacuation guiding effect is achieved.

title_en: Terminal, evacuation guidance system and escape route guidance method using the same
title_ko: 단말, 피난안내 시스템 및 이를 이용한 탈출 경로 안내 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for providing an escape route received by a user terminal from an evacuation guidance system. A tag is provided on one side of a building guidance map installed in a floor. The user terminal receives tag identification information and the building guidance map from the tag when coming in contact with the tag at a pre-set distance, The user terminal transmits the tag identification information, location information of the user terminal, and identification information of the user terminal to the evacuation guidance system, receives an escape route based on the location information of the user terminal from the evacuation guidance system, and displays the escape route to be overlapped with the building guidance map.
abstract_ko: 사용자 단말이 피난 안내 시스템으로부터 수신한 탈출 경로를 제공하는 방법으로서, 층 내 설치되어 있는 건물 안내도의 일측에 태그가 구비되어 있고, 사용자 단말이 태그와 미리 설정된 간격으로 접촉되면 태그로부터 태그 식별 정보와 건물 안내도를 수신한다. 태그 식별 정보와 사용자 단말의 위치 정보 그리고 사용자 단말의 식별 정보를 상기 피난 안내 시스템으로 전송하고, 피난 안내 시스템으로부터 사용자 단말의 위치 정보를 토대로 생성된 탈출 경로를 수신하고, 탈출 경로를 건물 안내도에 중첩되도록 표시한다.

title_en: Emergency evacuation path planning method in toxic gas leakage accident
abstract_en: The invention provides an emergency evacuation path planning method in a toxic gas leakage accident, and provides a personnel emergency evacuation path planning method in the toxic gas leakage accident. And providing a proper refuge point for the disaster-stricken through the constructed geographic data network diagram, and determining whether a grouping evacuation strategy is adopted or not by combining the number of evacuated people and the residual capacity of the refuge point. The method can realize rapid evacuation planning and rapid and safe evacuation of personnel.

title_en: Method and system for evacuation route guidance of occupants using augmented reality of mobile devices
title_ko: 휴대 기기의 증강현실을 이용한 재실자의 피난 경로 안내 방법 및 이를 위한 시스템
abstract_en: The embodiment of the present invention provides a system for an evacuation route guidance of occupants using augmented reality of a mobile device, which includes: a portable device carried by an occupant in which an evacuation guidance application is installed to suggest an evacuation route from a current location of the occupant to an evacuation site in case of a disaster; and a server which provides information on a plurality of evacuation routes to the mobile device, wherein the mobile device is configured to: display an evacuation guidance interface by executing an evacuation guidance application; display a captured landscape image in an image display area of the evacuation guidance interface; display any one of the plurality of evacuation routes set based on detailed information related to a type of disaster, user's exercise ability, and personal situation on a map display area of the evacuation guidance interface; and overlap the landscape image on the image display area to display guide information for indicating a direction to move from the current location along the evacuation route displayed on the map display area.
abstract_ko: 실시예는, 재해 발생 시 재실자의 현재 위치에서 피난장소까지의 피난 경로를 제시하기 위한 피난 유도 어플리케이션이 인스톨된 재실자가 휴대한 휴대 기기; 및 상기 휴대 기기로 복수의 피난 경로 정보를 제공하는 서버;를 포함하고, 상기 휴대 기기는 상기 피난 유도 어플리케이션을 실행하여 피난 유도 인터페이스를 표시하고, 상기 휴대 기기는 촬영한 풍경 영상을 상기 피난 유도 인터페이스의 영상 표시 영역에 표시하고, 재해의 종류, 사용자의 운동 능력, 개인 상황과 관련된 세부 정보에 기초하여 설정된 상기 복수의 피난 경로 중 어느 하나를 상기 피난 유도 인터페이스의 지도 표시 영역 상에 표시하고, 상기 휴대 기기는 상기 영상 표시 영역 상에 상기 풍경 영상과 중첩하여 상기 지도 표시 영역 상에 표시된 피난 경로를 따라 현재 위치에서 이동할 방향을 표시하기 위한 가이드 정보를 표시하는 휴대 기기의 증강현실을 이용한 피난 경로 안내하기 위한 시스템을 제공할 수 있다.

title_en: Monitoring system and method based on multi-source information of mountain torrent disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a monitoring system and method based on multi-source information of a mountain torrent disaster. The monitoring system comprises a processing center, a monitoring unit and a road environment unit. The processing center comprises a data receiving module, a data analysis module, a mountain torrent disaster situation evaluation module and a transmission module. The monitoring unit comprises a weather detection module, a geological detection module, a rainfall detection module and a water level detection module. The road environment unit comprises an entry module, an danger avoiding road planning module, a road calling module and a navigation module. The monitoring system integrates multi-source information monitoring, enriches monitoring data, improves the accuracy of mountain torrent disaster monitoring, can prevent/treat mountain torrent disasters in a targeted and orderly manner, realizes accurate prediction, can indicate road distribution of mountain torrent high-incidence areas to help risk avoidance, and improves the timeliness of mountain torrent disaster evacuation. The disaster warning information and the emergency evacuation information can be widely diffused to ensure the safety of personnel in the area.

title_en: On-site intelligent emergency broadcasting multi-program exchange control device consisting of 1:1 customized live emergency broadcasting output signal and digital program conversion signal
title_ko: 1:1 맞춤형 라이브 비상방송출력신호·디지털 프로그램 전환신호로 이루어진 현장지능형 비상방송다중프로그램교환제어장치 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a device and a method for exchanging and controlling an emergency broadcasting multi-program of an on-site intelligent type including a one-to-one-customized live emergency broadcasting output signal and digital program conversion signal, which can minimize loss of lives. The device of the present invention comprises: an on-site intelligent type emergency broadcasting multi-program exchange control module (100); and a digital network program (DNP) exchange module (200) connected to the on-site intelligent type emergency broadcasting multi-program exchange control module (100) through a network.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에서는 종래 프로그램 교환기의 경우에 획일적인 비상방송만을 송출하기 때문에 재난발생위치와 대피경로, 그리고 다양한 재난발생(지진, 연기, 불꽃, 가스, 미세먼지)에 따른 맞춤형 비상방송이 없어, 비상방송 시스템의 대피 안내 신뢰도, 실효성이 떨어져 긴급피난 및 신속대처가 어렵고, 선로 포설에 대한 물적, 인적 부담이 큰 문제점과, 지진, 화재로 인한 재난발생시, 전원장치가 단락되거나 단선되어 비상구 위치 또는 출입구 위치에 대한 대피경로 안내방송까지 멈추게 되는 경우에, 어둡고 깜깜한 실내에서 비상구 위치 또는 출입구 위치를 찾지 못해 우왕좌왕하거나, 긴급대피를 못해 질식사하는 등 인명피해가 많이 발생되는 문제점을 개선하고자, 현장지능형 비상방송다중프로그램교환제어모듈(100), DNP(Digital Network Program) 익스체인저모듈(200)로 구성됨으로서, 특정된 공간의 구조에 정확하게 부합하는 특정대피경로 + 재난발생위치정보 + 재난발생에 맞는 비상안내방송멘트로 이루어진 1:1 맞춤형 라이브 비상방송을 제공할 수 있어, 비상방송 시스템의 대피 안내 신뢰도, 실효성을 기존에 비해 80% 향상시킬 수 있고, 이로 인해 재난사고로 인한 인명피해를 최소화할 수 있고, 인터넷 프로토콜을 활용하여 동일한 네트워크망 내에서 고유한 장치식별번호를 통해 연결 및 구성이 가능하여 선로 포설에 대한 물적, 인적 부담을 기존에 비해 60% 이상으로 줄일 수가 있으며, 사용자가 별도의 인터넷 프로토콜에 대한 설정을 하지 않아도 동일한 네트워크망에 위치한다면 자동으로 고유한 장치식별번호를 통해 연결이 되는 시스템의 특성상 설치기간을 기존에 비해 1.5배~2배 더 빠르게 할 수 있는 1:1 맞춤형 라이브 비상방송출력신호·디지털 프로그램 전환신호로 이루어진 현장지능형 비상방송다중프로그램교환제어장치 및 방법을 제공하는데 그 목적이 있다.

title_en: System and method for indicating emergency evacuation in an independent module
title_ko: 독립모듈형 비상대피 인디케이팅 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an independent module-type emergency evacuation indicating system. According to the present invention, a long-life modular indicator based on independent power supply is used instead of a charging-type indicator, and thus additional installation and maintenance can be performed with ease even without connection to an existing external power supply system. In addition, real-time emergency evacuation route guidance is provided using a direction indicator light, broadcasting, and so on, and thus emergency passenger evacuation can be performed with speed and efficiency. The independent module-type emergency evacuation indicating system includes: a main control panel connected to various sensors and CCTVs, performing danger or blockade detection, and displaying a location of disaster on a screen in the event of a disaster, calculating an optimal evacuation route in accordance with an algorithm, outputting direction indication information and broadcasting information for evacuation, and displaying the degree of communication congestion using congestion measurement information by indicator group; and at least one individual indicator transmitting power supply and communication status information by performing periodic communication with the main control panel, receiving an emergency signal from the main control panel and waking up indication of a direction and a broadcasting device via an internal MCU in the event of an emergency, and performing a direction indicator lighting and broadcasting operation based on data received with an individual indicator communication module.
abstract_ko: 충전형이 아닌 장수명 독립전원에 기반한 모듈형 인디케이터를 활용하여 기존 외부 전원시스템과 연계없이 손쉬운 추가설치 및 유지보수가 가능하고, 방향지시조명, 방송 등을 활용한 실시간 비상대피경로 안내를 통해 승객들의 비상대피가 효율적이고 신속하게 이루어질 수 있도록 하는 독립모듈형 비상대피 인디케이팅 시스템이 개시된다. 독립모듈형 비상대피 인디케이팅 시스템은, 재난 발생시, 각종 센서, CCTV와 연계되어 위험물 혹은 봉쇄를 감지하여 재난위치를 화면에 표시하고, 최적 대피경로를 알고리즘에 따라 연산하여 대피를 위한 방향표시 정보 및 방송 정보를 출력하고, 개별 인디케이터 그룹별 혼잡도 측정 정보를 통해 통신용 혼잡도를 표시하는 주제어반; 및 상기 주제어반과 주기적 통신을 수행하여 전원 및 통신상태 정보를 송신하고, 비상상황에는 상기 주제어반으로부터 비상신호를 수신하여 내부의 MCU를 통해 방향표시 및 방송장치를 웨이크-업(wake-up)시키고, 개별 인디케이터 통신모듈로 수신된 데이터를 기준으로 방향지시조명 및 방송 전개 동작을 수행하는 하나 이상의 개별 인디케이터를 포함한다.

title_en: Dynamic evacuation method for multiple vehicles smoothly driven in short distance
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-vehicle dynamic evacuation method driven smoothly in a short distance. In a navigation algorithm based on short-distance clear assurance, a route search is performed based on an A-x algorithm. In the searching process, for the blocked road section, the blocking weight is judged according to the distance between the blocked road section and the vehicle, the real length of the blocked road section is extended according to the blocking weight to simulate the blockage of the road section, and finally, the optimal path under the current condition can be returned. For a multi-vehicle evacuation algorithm based on route diversity. The evacuation sequence of the vehicle is divided mainly by two steps. Step 1: and obtaining the driving path of the vehicle by using a vehicle navigation algorithm for ensuring the smoothness of the short distance. Step 2: according to the route diversity principle, the vehicle with the lowest route similarity with the previously evacuated vehicle is selected for priority planning each time. The quantity of the vehicles evacuated in all directions of the road network is ensured to be relatively uniform.

title_en: Intelligent fire control sign control system adapting to environment for transformation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent fire control systems, in particular to an intelligent fire control sign control system adapting to environment for transformation. It includes sign reminder system, and sign reminder system includes smog recognition cell, voice prompt unit and pilot lamp suggestion unit, and smog recognition cell output is connected with the information transmission unit, and the information transmission unit output is connected with the control unit, and the control unit output is connected with the removal end. In the invention, when a fire disaster occurs, smoke information of the indicator lamp is transmitted to the control unit through the information transmission unit, the control unit sorts and transmits the information to the route planning unit, meanwhile, the control unit can control the indicator lamp on the optimal route to prompt, the route planning unit calculates the shortest escape route, the generated optimal escape route is transmitted to the mobile terminal, and a user can escape according to the prompt route after receiving the shortest escape route, so that the escape rate of the user is improved, and the escape time is strived for the user.
assignees: SHENZHEN ZHENGWEIGE INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Building route navigation system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building path navigation system which comprises evacuation indicating equipment, terminal equipment and a cloud server, wherein the evacuation indicating equipment, the terminal equipment and the cloud server are arranged in a plurality of evacuation lamps in a building. When the terminal equipment has a navigation demand in a building, obtaining initial position information based on wireless communication with the evacuation lamp, and uploading the initial position information and the target position information to a cloud server; the cloud server plans navigation route information according to the initial position information, the target position information and prestored map information in the building; determining current position information of the terminal equipment based on wireless communication between the terminal equipment and the evacuation lamp, and updating navigation route information according to the current position information; the terminal device displays the navigation route information and updates the display based on the updated navigation route information. Therefore, the evacuation lamp in the building is fully utilized for navigation and positioning, the positioning precision is high, the positioning speed is high, the problem that the route in the building is difficult to find due to the fact that no effective geographic sign exists in the route can be solved, and the user experience is improved.
assignees: NOOER SCIENCE AND TECH CO LTD

title_en: Tunnel escape indication method and system, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tunnel escape indication method, a system, computer equipment and a storage medium, comprising the following steps: s1: acquiring a spectral image in the tunnel, and determining the position information and the fire information according to the received spectral image; s2: the main processor sends an escape route to intelligent terminals of pedestrians and vehicles through the base station and controls the barrier machine at the entrance to be put down, so that the following vehicles are prevented from continuously driving into the tunnel, and the escape route is specifically planned according to the position of a fire and the difference of the types and positions of the pedestrians and the vehicles. The invention can make escape path planning suitable for pedestrians and vehicles according to the current fire situation.
assignees: ZHEJIANG HIGHWAY INFORMATION ENGINEERING TECH LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Indoor true three-dimensional navigation space data model of building
abstract_en: The invention discloses an indoor true three-dimensional navigation space data model of a building, which comprises the following steps: (1) a semantic model of the building indoor true three-dimensional navigation space data model; (2) a space geometric structure model of the indoor true three-dimensional navigation space data model of the building; (3) building indoor true three-dimensional space octree expression and subdivision method, and (4) building indoor true three-dimensional navigation path generation algorithm. The invention can combine the building entity components of the indoor space of the building with the three-dimensional reachable space surrounded by the building entity components, combine the geometric and semantic representation of the indoor space with the navigation application, expand the expression model and the application algorithm of the indoor true three-dimensional space, and provide theoretical and method support for the indoor true three-dimensional modeling research and the three-dimensional space analysis application of the building. The model can be used as a core data model of spatial information systems such as a three-dimensional geographic information system and the like, and is popularized and applied in the fields of smart cities, disaster relief, emergency evacuation and the like.
assignees: SHENZHEN DIGITAL CITY ENGINEERING RES CENTER;NANJING UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Dynamic building identification guiding method and system based on Internet of things and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a dynamic building identification guiding method and system based on the Internet of things and electronic equipment. It should be appreciated that dynamic building identification guidance of a fire escape route is essentially a fire escape path planning problem when a fire breaks out within a building. Specifically, the hidden information of each position in the thermodynamic diagram inside the building formed by the temperature values is explicitly coded through a spatial convolution mechanism of a convolutional neural network, so that the characteristics obtain the expression of the spatial information inside the building on the basis of the temperature information, and further, the radiation vector of the candidate path is calculated on the basis of the principle of a nerve radiation field, and a more accurate planned path can be obtained on the basis of the temperature element and the spatial element. Therefore, the effectiveness and the accuracy of dynamic building identification guidance in the case of fire can be improved.

title_en: Navigation device and program
abstract_en: To provide a navigation device and a program with which it is possible for users to select an evacuation site from one or more candidates for evacuation sites.SOLUTION: Provided is a navigation device 10 for searching for a route from the place of departure to a destination. The navigation device comprises: a storage unit for storing user information; a communication unit 12 for receiving disaster information related to an area where a disaster has occurred from external devices; a display control unit 19 for displaying points not included in the area as candidates for evacuation sites on the basis of the user information; and an operation acceptance unit 17 for accepting selection of an evacuation site from the candidates for evacuation sites displayed by the display control unit.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title_en: Apparatus for navigation of underground space and method thereof
title_ko: 지하 공간에 대한 네비게이션 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed is a user terminal apparatus. The user terminal apparatus comprises: a communication device communicating with an external device; a display; and a processor which controls the communication device to receive location information from at least one of a plurality of BLE devices disposed in an interior space when a predetermined event occurs, controls the communication device to receive evacuation route information based on the received location information from the external devices when the location information is received, and controls the display to display the received evacuation route information. The navigation apparatus guides a user to a safe location by obtaining location information from the plurality of BLE devices.
abstract_ko: 사용자 단말장치가 개시된다. 본 사용자 단말장치는 외부 장치와 통신하는 통신 장치, 디스플레이, 및 기설정된 이벤트가 발생하면 실내 공간에 배치되는 복수의 BLE 장치 중 적어도 하나로부터 위치 정보를 수신하도록 상기 통신 장치를 제어하고, 상기 위치 정보가 수신되면 외부 장치로부터 상기 수신된 위치 정보에 기초한 피난 경로 정보를 수신하도록 상기 통신 장치를 제어하고, 상기 수신된 피난 경로 정보를 표시하도록 상기 디스플레이를 제어하는 프로세서를 포함한다.

title_en: Server for providing navigation information of underground space and method thereof
title_ko: 지하 공간에 대한 네비게이션 정보를 제공하는 서버 및 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed is a server. The server comprises: a communication device which communicates with an external device; a memory which stores map information for an interior space, information on a plurality of BLE devices disposed in the interior space, and a personnel prediction model for each of a plurality of spaces composing the interior space; and a processor which controls the communication device, when location information is received from the user terminal device, to provide evacuation route information including movement route information to the user terminal device based on the received location information and personnel prediction model. A navigation apparatus guides a user to a safe location by obtaining location information from the plurality of BLE devices.
abstract_ko: 서버가 개시된다. 본 서버는 외부 장치와 통신하는 통신 장치, 실내 공간에 대한 지도 정보, 실내 공간에 배치된 복수의 BLE 장치에 대한 정보, 실내 공간을 구성하는 복수의 공간 별 인원 예측 모델을 저장하는 메모리, 및 사용자 단말장치로부터 위치 정보를 수신하면, 수신된 위치 정보 및 인원 예측 모델에 기초하여 이동 경로 정보를 포함하는 피난 경로 정보를 사용자 단말장치에 제공하도록 통신 장치를 제어하는 프로세서를 포함한다.

title_en: Path planning method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a path planning method and a device, comprising the following steps: respectively acquiring a digital orthophoto map and a surface model according to the three-dimensional model of the target area; according to the digital orthophoto map, the ground feature classification information of the target area is obtained, and the ground feature classification information comprises first-class ground feature information and second-class ground feature information; screening a path model containing a starting position and an end position from the surface model according to the information of the ground objects; determining a target path from the path model according to the information of the second type of ground objects; the total value of the cost distances between all nodes constituting the target path is minimal. The invention is particularly suitable for emergency scenes of field, geological disasters, rescue, fire, urban inland inundation and the like, can automatically evade some dangerous areas according to the three-dimensional model of the target area, automatically generates a most reasonable rescue path according to the configuration of rescue facilities, can effectively meet the use requirement of severe environment, improves the rescue efficiency and improves the safety of rescue or evacuation.
assignees: WUHAN DISTRICT LARGE INFORMATION ENG CO LTD

title_en: Transmission and Fire Engine withing System for Fire Alarm Propagation and Escape Road at Apartment
title_ko: 아파트 화재 발생 시의 화재 발생 경보와 대피로 정보 제공 및 소방차 연동 시스템
abstract_en: A system for providing a fire occurrence alarm and escape route and interconnecting with a fire engine in case of apartment fire of the present invention comprises: an apartment management server receiving and storing user smart terminal-specific information, apartment main entrance and house number information, rooftop entrance digital doorlock module-specific information, fire detection module-specific information, and fire engine navigation module-specific information, pre-setting the escape route to store the route as an image form, receiving fire detection information from the fire detection module, generating the fire occurrence alarm, grouping user smart terminal phone number information, providing escape route information and the fire occurrence alarm to the grouped user smart terminal phone number, and transmitting the fire occurrence alarm to the rooftop entrance digital doorlock module and the fire engine; a user smart terminal of each household receiving the fire occurrence alarm and escape route image information from the apartment management server to be provided; a rooftop entrance digital doorlock module receiving the fire occurrence alarm from the apartment management server so that a resident can escape to a rooftop; a fire detection module connected with a plurality of fire detection sensors to transmit the fire detection information and specific information to the apartment management server in case of fire; and a fire engine navigation module receiving information on the fire occurrence alarm from the apartment management server to provide a route to the apartment.
abstract_ko: 본 발명 아파트 화재 발생 시의 화재 발생 경보와 대피로 정보 제공 및 소방차 연동 시스템은 각 세대가 지정한 사용자 스마트 단말기 고유 정보와 사용자가 거주하는 아파트 메인 출입구와 거주 층을 나타내는 호수 정보 및 해당 옥상 출입문 디지털 도어락 모듈의 고유 정보,각 세대별로 설치되는 화재 감지 모듈 고유 정보 및 관할 소방소의 소방차 네비게이션 모듈 고유 정보를 등록받아 저장하고, 임의의 화재 발생 아파트 호수를 기초로 대피로를 미리 설정하여 이미지 형태로 저장하며, 아파트의 어느 호수에서 화재가 발생하여 해당 화재 감지 모듈로부터 화재 감지 정보를 수신하고, 수신된 화재 감지 정보를 기초로 해당 동 해당 호수의 화재 발생 경보를 생성하며, 해당 동 해당 호수 화재 발생 정보를 기준으로 기 등록하여 저장된 사용자 스마트 단말기 전화 번호 정보를 그룹핑하며, 그룹별로 기 설정하여 저장된 대피로 정보를 해당 그룹핑된 해당 사용자 스마트 단말기 전화 번호로 해당 동 해당 호수 화재 발생 경보와 함께 제공하고, 화재 발생 경보를 해당 동 해당 호수가 속하는 해당 옥상 출입문 디지털 도어록 모듈로 전송하고 해당 아파트, 해당 동, 해당 호수 화재 발생 경보 등록 저장된 해당 소방차로 전송하는 아파트 관리 서버와, 아파트 관리 서버에 저장 등록되는 것으로 화재 발생 시에는 해당 동의 해당 화재 발생 호수를 기준으로 아파트 관리 서버에 의하여 그룹핑되며, 그룹별로 아파트 관리 서버로부터 해당 동 해당 호수 화재 발생 경보와 대피로 이미지 정보를 수신하여 제공하는 해당 아파트 동별, 호수별 각 세대의 사용자 스마트 단말기와, 아파트 각 동의 메인 출입구 계단 상부 끝단에서 옥상으로 출입하도록 옥상 출입구 문에 설치되는 것으로 아파트 관리 서버로부터 해당 동의 해당 호수 화재 발생 경보를 수신하여 도어의 록킹을 해제하도록 제어하여 옥상으로 주민이 대피하도록 하는 해당 동의 해당 호수가 속하는 옥상 출입문 디지털 도어락 모듈과, 아파트 각 세대에 설치되는 것으로 다수의 화재 감지 센서가 연결되어 화재 발생시에 화재 감지 정보와 고유 정보를 아파트 관리 서버로 전송하는 화재 감지 모듈 및 아파트 관리 서버로부터 해당 아파트, 해당 동의 화재 발생 경보 정보를 수신하여 수신된 해당 아파트의 해당 동으로 경로를 제공하는 소방차 네비게이션 모듈로 구성된 것을 특징으로 하는 것이다.

title_en: Disaster investigation system based on special vehicle and disaster investigation method using the same
title_ko: 특수차량기반 재난조사시스템 및 이를 활용한 재난조사 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are special vehicle-based disaster investigation system which performs regular monitoring for disaster prevention and risk management in normal times and uses an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) to investigate and analyze the cause of the disaster and simulate the cause of the accident when a disaster occurs, and a disaster investigation method using the same. According to the present invention, a disaster investigation special vehicle equipped with a UAV comprises: a UAV acquiring disaster images by photographing a disaster site while flying according to a predetermined flight path and remote navigation control at a disaster site; a UAV landing platform for landing or accommodating the UAV; a PC installed with a program for data processing and analysis including data matching, merging, contour generation, volume and area calculation, and distance and angle calculation for the disaster site; and an analysis server executing three-dimensional (3D) numerical analysis for processing and analyzing observational data of the disaster site or including software (SW) for numerical analysis of flood landslide and sediment runoff, and disaster evacuation simulation analysis to control data acquisition, processing, and display.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 평상 시에 재해 예방 및 위험 관리를 위한 정기적인 모니터링을 수행하고, 재난 사고 시에는 무인 비행체를 이용하여 재난 사고의 원인 조사와 분석, 그리고 사고 원인의 시뮬레이션을 실행하는, 특수차량기반 재난조사시스템 및 이를 활용한 재난조사 방법이 개시된다. 
개시된 무인 비행체 탑재형 재난 조사 특수 차량은, 재난 현장에서 사전 지정된 비행 경로 및 원격 항법 조정에 따라 비행하면서 사고 현장의 모습을 촬영하여 재난 영상을 획득하는 무인 비행체; 상기 무인 비행체를 안착하거나 수용하기 위한 비행체 안착대; 상기 재난 현장에 대한 데이터 정합, 병합, 등고선 생성, 체적 및 면적 계산, 거리 및 각도 계산을 포함한 데이터 처리 및 분석을 위한 프로그램이 설치된 PC; 및 상기 재난 현장의 관측자료 처리분석을 위한 3차원 수치 해석을 실행하거나, 홍수산사태 토사유출 수치해석, 재난대피 모의(simulation) 분석에 관한 소프트웨어(SW)가 탑재되어, 데이터의 취득, 처리, 표출을 제어하는 분석용 서버를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Method and system for planning personnel evacuation simulation path in subway station under multiple danger sources
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for planning personnel evacuation simulation paths in a subway station under multiple dangerous sources, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring basic data in a subway station; based on basic data in the subway station, gridding the space in the subway station, and determining the initial position of people to be evacuated; acquiring evacuation speed of personnel at each road section and position information of each hazard source under the disaster condition; establishing a personnel evacuation multi-target path optimization model based on the initial position of personnel to be evacuated, the evacuation speed of personnel at each road section and the positions of all hazard sources; and solving the personnel evacuation multi-target path optimization model to obtain evacuation path optimization schemes under different control parameters, so as to evacuate the personnel to be evacuated. Through proper modification, the multi-target robust model is suitable for providing a path planning scheme for evacuation of personnel in stations under different emergencies (fire, toxic substance release, explosion and the like), and the efficiency and the safety of the subway evacuation system are improved.

title_en: Fire emergency evacuation path planning method and device, intelligent terminal and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire emergency evacuation path planning method, a device, an intelligent terminal and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a cell set based on a spatial structure of a fire scene; obtaining evacuation risk factors of all cells of the cell set based on the environmental data and the personnel data; and obtaining an evacuation path according to an evacuation path planning model based on the evacuation risk factor. Compared with the prior art, the evacuation risk factor is obtained by collecting the environmental data and the personnel data of the fire scene, and the evacuation risk factor is brought into the evacuation route planning model, so that the evacuation timeliness and the evacuation safety are considered simultaneously when the evacuation route is dynamically planned, and the planned route is more reasonable.

title_en: Outdoor waterproof navigator
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an outdoor waterproof navigator, which belongs to the technical field of navigators, wherein when outdoor sunlight is strong, a screen is not always visible, if the screen is in rainy days, the screen is in touch failure and is not waterproof when meeting rainwater, and meanwhile, the screen is easy to damage when bumping and the like; the back splint adopts the design of circular arc streamlined, not only has the arc brim of a hat to shelter from most sunshine, improves liquid crystal display's life, has the spring ejector pin type head that charges moreover, only needs to impel the machine to detain the position and just can realize fixing of navigator, can directly supply the electricity for the machine through the thimble moreover, need not to go the plug head that charges to make open air navigation more convenient, simultaneously, the waterproof nature of navigator in this scheme, the more traditional navigator of practicality is compared better.

title_en: Building Fire Evacuation Route Guidance System
title_ko: 건물의 화재 피난경로 안내 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an evacuation route guide system which notifies residents of an evacuation route in case of a building fire, wherein a variable evacuation guidance lamp visually indicates an evacuation route and a speaker at an exit on the evacuation route audibly guides the evacuation route to help the weak and elderly or people with vision or hearing impairment rapidly evacuate in case of a fire, thereby reducing damage to a human life caused by a fire. The evacuation route guide system of the present invention comprises: a plurality of fire detectors disposed in the inside of a building to detect any fire; a server receiving a fire signal and a unique ID from the fire detectors, sensing a location of the fire based on the fire signal and the unique ID, and selecting one of the safest evacuation routes among the predetermined routes according to the location of the fire; a plurality of evacuation guidance lamps operated by the server in case of a fire to indicate the evacuation route inside the building; and a plurality of speakers receiving a message set by the server and outputting a voice signal to guide occupants in the safest direction and location of the evacuation route.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 건물에 화재가 발생할 경우, 거주하는 사람들에게 피난경로를 알리는 안내 시스템에 관한 기술로서, 가변형 피난 유도등이 시각적으로 피난경로를 안내하고, 피난경로의 비상구에서 스피커를 통해 청각적으로 피난경로를 안내함으로써, 화재 발생시 노약자나 시각 또는 청각 장애인 등이 신속하게 대피할 수 있으므로, 화재로 인한 인명 피해를 줄이는 건물의 화재 피난경로 안내 시스템에 관한 기술이다. 
이러한 본 발명의 주요 구성은, 화재 발생 여부를 감지하고, 건물 내부에 배치되는 다수의 화재 감지기; 상기 화재 감지기로부터 화재 신호와 고유 아이디가 수신되며, 화재 신호와 고유 아이디를 통해 화재 위치를 감지하고, 화재 위치에 따라 설정된 피난경로 중에서 가장 안전한 피난경로를 선택하는 서버; 상기 서버를 통해 화재 발생시 작동하며, 건물 내부에서 피난경로를 표시하는 다수의 피난 유도등; 및 상기 서버에서 설정된 메시지를 수신하고, 음성 신호를 출력하여 피난경로의 방향과 위치를 안내하는 다수의 스피커;를 포함하여 구현된다.

title_en: Method for planning off-site emergency evacuation path of nuclear power plant
abstract_en: The method comprises the steps of collecting the wind speed and the leakage point source intensity outside a nuclear power plant, constructing a radiation dose field diffusion model, collecting road condition information outside the nuclear power plant, constructing a road resistance function model of real-time traffic, and solving and obtaining a vehicle allocation scheme, namely corresponding relations among a garage, an aggregation point and a placement point by taking evacuation time as an optimization target through integer linear programming; and then solving an optimal evacuation route, selecting the total evacuation time of the vehicles and the radiation dose of personnel as a target function of path planning when the nuclear emergency vehicles evacuate back and forth, solving the evacuation travel of each vehicle through a non-dominated fast genetic algorithm to obtain a diversity solution set at the front edge of Pareto, setting a threshold value of the radiation dose upper limit value of the personnel to screen the diversity solution set, and evaluating the screened optimal solution set at the front edge of the Pareto by adopting a TOPSIS decision method to obtain the optimal evacuation route.

title_en: Emergency path planning method and system combining space concentration potential field and toxicity load
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency path planning system combining a space concentration potential field and a toxic load, which comprises an information acquisition module, a data analysis module and a route notification module, wherein the information acquisition module comprises a toxic gas leakage alarm, an anemorumbometer and a central management background, and the data analysis module is used for toxic gas diffusion simulation and concentration calculation. The invention belongs to the technical field of safety engineering planning systems, and particularly provides an emergency path planning method and an emergency path planning system which are combined with a space concentration potential field and a toxic load and have practical effects, wherein the method is used for combining the wind direction and the wind speed data of a wind field in a chemical engineering park, calculating the influence range and the degree of toxic gas leakage, effectively informing people in a dangerous area to evacuate first, limiting the direction of an emergency evacuation path through the negative direction of the space concentration potential field, improving the convergence speed of an algorithm, and determining the optimal emergency evacuation path through replacing the distance with a toxic gas load.

title_en: Evacuation route guide system
title_ko: 승선자 대피 경로 안내 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a passenger evacuation route guidance system. The passenger evacuation route guidance system comprises: a service server including a database unit for storing various data and a module unit for processing the data stored in the database unit and driving and executing a service platform; and a user terminal connected to the service server through a communication network to enable mutual data communications using the service platform provided by the service server, and including a passenger terminal used by a passenger and a manager terminal used by a manager. The module unit includes: a map information collection module that collects map information of a ship; a passenger information collection module that collects information on passengers on the ship; an evacuation route calculation module that calculates an evacuation route for passengers using a star (A*) algorithm; an image information generation module that generates image information of the evacuation route calculated by the evacuation route calculation unit so that the passengers and the manager can check the evacuation route; and a monitoring module that indicates coordinates of current locations of the passengers based on the map information of the ship so that the manager can check the locations of the passengers in real time. The present invention has remarkable effects of enabling efficient rescue activities by monitoring the movement of each passenger on board in a situation room in case of a disaster, finding out the number of passengers at a shelter and the number of passengers who have not escaped from the ship, and locating the passengers.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 승선자 대피경로 안내 시스템에 관한 것으로, 각종 데이터를 저장하는 데이터베이스부 및 상기 데이터베이스부에 저장된 데이터를 처리 및 가공하고, 서비스 플랫폼의 구동 및 실행하는 모듈부를 포함하는 서비스 서버와 상기 서버스 서버에 의해 제공되는 서비스 플랫폼을 이용하여 상기 서비스 서버와 통신망으로 상호 데이터통신 가능하게 연결되며, 승선자가 사용하는 승선자 단말기와 관리자가 사용하는 관리자 단말기를 포함하는 사용자 단말기를 포함하되, 
상기 모듈부는, 선박의 지도 정보를 수집하는 지도정보 수집모듈, 선박에 탑승하는 승선자의 정보를 수집하는 승선자정보 수집모듈, 에이스타 알고리즘을 활용하여 승선자의 대피 경로를 산출하는 대피 경로 산출모듈, 상기 대피 경로 산출모듈에서 산출된 대피 경로를 승선자 및 관리자가 확인할 수 있도록 이미지 정보로 생성하는 이미지정보 생성모듈, 관리자가 승선자의 위치를 실시간으로 확인할 수 있도록 선박의 지도정보를 기초로 승선자의 현재 위치좌표를 나타내는 모니터링 모듈을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하며, 본 발명은 재난상황 시 상황실에서 각 승선자의 움직임을 모니터링하여 재난발생 시 대피소의 승선자 인원 및 선박 내 탈출을 하지 못한 승선자의 인원, 위치파악이 용이하여 효율적인 구조활동이 가능한 현저한 효과가 있다.

title_en: Inspection robot communication system and communication method based on Internet of things platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses an inspection robot communication system and method based on an Internet of things platform. According to the invention, data access, cleaning and gathering are realized through the Internet of things platform, and workers are powerfully assisted in daily patrol, maintenance and overhaul, emergency evacuation and emergency treatment, so that the driving and the navigation protection are ensured for people.
assignees: JIANGSU ZHI MATERIAL INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Combined navigation positioning mechanism for intelligent agricultural machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a combination navigation positioning mechanism for intelligent agricultural machinery relates to agricultural machinery navigation positioning technical field, has solved navigation mechanism and has penetrated the back directly by sunshine, and display screen reduces the very unclear problem of white Mongolia slice with contrast on every side. A combined navigation positioning mechanism for an intelligent agricultural machine comprises a navigation display module; the navigation display module both sides all sliding connection have link block, link block rotates and sets up the upper and lower both ends at back connection draw runner, and fork frame head end and tail end all are provided with the connection slide bar, and back connection draw runner side spout is through connecting slide bar and fork frame sliding connection, and the fork frame is the alternately fork structure that rotates the flexibility, and the fork frame head end is through connecting slide bar and preceding connection draw runner sliding connection, and preceding connection draw runner anterior slip is provided with preceding fixing stud. This practical outer shade spare shelters from light, promotes the display effect of navigation display module under the sunshine.
assignees: JILIN HUA INTELLIGENT SCIENCE AND TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent inspection robot positioning method based on Beidou navigation system
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent inspection robot positioning method based on a Beidou navigation system, which comprises six basic steps of determining a reference base station, calculating a differential correction value, correcting a positioning position of an inspection robot, establishing a working coordinate system, determining an original point of the working coordinate system, calculating a real-time positioning position of the inspection robot and a conversion matrix from the positioning position of the reference base station to the working coordinate system, calculating an optimal inspection path and performing inspection navigation. The invention not only enables the intelligent inspection robot to complete accurate autonomous navigation in open environment, but also ensures the positioning accuracy requirement of the intelligent inspection robot in some sheltered environments, thereby meeting the navigation requirement in complex environment.
assignees: MAINTENANCE BRANCH COMPANY OF JIANGXI PROVINCE ELECTRIC POWER LTD COMPANY OF STATE GRID;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;BEAD HEIGHT ELECTRICAL DETECTION LTD COMPANY

title_en: Distributed crowd evacuation path planning method and system based on federal learning
abstract_en: The disclosure belongs to the technical field of crowd evacuation path planning, and provides a distributed crowd evacuation path planning method and system based on federal learning, which comprises the following steps: acquiring video information data of a subregion, and constructing a local potential energy field; calculating a local potential energy value based on the constructed local potential energy field, and constructing a local density field; determining the collision-free movement speed of the individual according to the constructed local potential energy field and the local density field; aggregating the constructed local potential energy fields of all the sub-regions to construct a global potential energy field; and building a crowd evacuation simulation platform according to the constructed local potential energy field and the global potential energy field, and performing analog simulation of crowd evacuation according to the obtained collision-free movement speed of the individual.

title_en: Ocean passenger ship personnel emergency evacuation path planning algorithm based on virtual nodes
abstract_en: The invention provides an ocean passenger ship personnel emergency evacuation path planning algorithm based on virtual nodes, which solves the problems of personnel exit balanced distribution and ordered evacuation process simulation under the condition of multiple exits in the process of passenger ship evacuation. Because the passenger ship has a plurality of symmetrical exits, the efficiency of judging straight lines by adopting straight line distances is low, and the problem of low path quality is easily caused. The method is based on the node network map, introduces the virtual nodes on the basis of the original map node network, connects the nodes with each outlet, takes the virtual nodes as target nodes and each outlet as a middle node, expands the algorithm search, reduces the search time of the algorithm, dynamically updates the virtual nodes on the basis of the problem of uneven personnel distribution, and further solves the problem of uneven distribution of personnel at multiple outlets. And finally, a social force model based on the guide path is constructed, the evacuation process of the crowd is simulated, the evacuation trajectory of the crowd is dynamically reflected, and the evacuation is effectively guided.

title_en: Path correction method, device and equipment and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a path correction method, a path correction device, path correction equipment and a readable storage medium, which relate to the technical field of virtual reality and comprise the steps of establishing a navigation grid for an evacuation scene and carrying out global path planning on people to be evacuated; extracting key points of the route, and correcting the local evacuation route according to the length of the road section and the density of pedestrians; calculating the moving speed and direction; moving to a target point, and revising the route if environmental change occurs; and obtaining the corrected path until reaching the safety exit. On one hand, the state change of the station staff to the dynamic barrier is reflected by utilizing the navigation grid to update, and the response of the passenger to the interactive virtual environment is reflected; on the other hand, a road section evaluation function of the path and the density is established, the passenger adjusts the route according to the environmental information in the field of view, and the moving process fully considers the panic factor and the influence of other pedestrians and dynamically adjusts the moving speed and the moving direction.

title_en: Robot-based indoor trapped person search and rescue guiding evacuation system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a robot-based indoor trapped person search and rescue guide evacuation system and method, and belongs to the technical field of virtual simulation. The invention senses the environment by setting the number and the initial position of the robots, intelligently searches and rescues the indoor trapped people in disaster situations, collects the real-time three-dimensional image data of the scene, makes decision analysis and transmits the surrounding environment information to the scene rescue personnel in time. The evacuation method provided by the invention adopts the robot to perform simulation training, relies on a virtual reality technology, optimizes the evacuation path through an improved path planning algorithm, creates a more realistic evacuation environment and character reconstruction model, improves the evacuation efficiency, and can better simulate the real evacuation process, thereby providing references for effectively reducing casualties in personnel evacuation and establishing an optimal rescue scheme, having certain practical guiding significance, and being worth popularizing and using.

title_en: Fire evacuation route guidance system and method
title_ko: 화재 대피 경로 안내 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are a fire evacuation route guidance system and method. According to one aspect of the present invention, a fire evacuation route guidance system includes: a plurality of fire detectors installed at each location of a building to detect a fire; a plurality of path beam devices installed in a passage of the building to display the evacuation direction on a floor, and displaying the evacuation direction at a plurality of locations with a single beam using a reflector; and a control device which detects the fire and identifies a fire detector which transmits a fire signal to determine the location of the fire, determines an evacuation route according to the location of the fire, and controls the operation of path beam devices, when a fire signal is received. The present invention can guide a more stable evacuation direction even if a failure occurs in a part of the system.
abstract_ko: 화재 대피 경로 안내 시스템 및 방법이 개시된다. 본 발명의 일측면에 따른 화재 대피 경로 안내 시스템은, 건축물의 각 위치에 설치되어 화재를 감지하는 복수개의 화재감지기들; 건축물의 통로에 각각 설치되어 대피방향을 바닥에 표시하되, 반사경을 이용하여 하나의 빔으로 복수개의 위치에 대피방향을 표시하는 복수개의 경로빔장치들; 및 화재신호가 수신되면, 화재를 감지하여 화재신호를 전송한 화재감지기를 식별하여 화재위치를 확인하며, 화재위치에 따른 대피경로를 판단하여 경로빔장치들의 작동을 제어하는 관제장치를 포함한다.

title_en: Optimization scheme for calculating embankment emergency refuge site selection and path planning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for calculating a dyke emergency refuge site selection optimization scheme and path planning, which solves the problems of refuge site selection optimization and path planning difficulty in the dyke flood emergency refuge transfer process in the prior art. The invention comprises the following steps: 1. constructing a dyke-breaking flood numerical simulation model; 2. the risk avoidance transfer evacuation unit and the people number analysis; 3. constructing an evaluation index selection principle and an index system; 4. combining weighting based on division integration method; 5. comprehensive assigning model of refuge site selection based on TOPSIS; 6. and constructing an risk avoiding transfer path optimization model. The technology analyzes the flood evolution condition of the embankment protection area after the flood disaster is avoided through engineering measures, is used for refuge site planning and path planning research after the embankment is broken, and has important significance in improving emergency rescue efficiency, improving emergency flood control decision making capability and level, enhancing the flood control safety guarantee capability of the embankment engineering and reducing potential embankment loss.

title_en: Explosive crowd evacuation method and system in earthquake disaster obstacle environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a burst crowd evacuation method in an earthquake disaster obstacle environment, which comprises the following steps: acquiring target building data, establishing a model and carrying out time course analysis; establishing a digital damage model of the seismic acceleration based on the data sample; predicting building damage distribution according to the damage data, and determining a building damage prediction value by adopting an anti-seismic performance evaluation method; establishing a barrier environment according to the building damage predicted value; selecting an optimal evacuation scheme with highest evacuation efficiency; inputting the crowd distribution information monitored in real time into the damage model, and establishing the dynamic interaction between the real world and the digital model; simulating explosive crowd evacuation according to the optimal evacuation scheme, and sending the optimal path to the crowd; and dynamically guiding and evacuating the people actually gathered in the building in a real-time interactive mode. According to the invention, through the damage model, the obstacle environment establishing module, the dynamic prompting module and the path planning module, evacuation is faster and more reasonable, and more time is strived for emergent growth of people.

title_en: Optimal route generation, system, electronic device and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides an optimal route generation method, an optimal route generation system, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of emergency evacuation. The system comprises a Bluetooth positioning module, an optimal route calculation module and an optimal route display module; the Bluetooth positioning module is used for obtaining the positioning of the mobile phone terminal of the crowd to be evacuated; the optimal route calculation module divides the plane into a plurality of areas, evacuates people according to the areas, when people on the upper layer are evacuated to the next layer, the distribution of people on the next layer is updated through positioning, and the calculation is repeated until the evacuation time of each area is completed by evacuating people to form an optimal evacuation route; the optimal route display module is used for displaying an optimal evacuation route and guiding people to evacuate. The invention can quickly determine the optimal evacuation exit of each area, can quickly evaluate and prejudge the evacuation time of each area, and can help the decision-making layer to adopt effective external force intervention to promote the evacuation of the slower evacuation area in advance. The technical problem that the optimal evacuation route is inaccurate is solved.
assignees: SHENZHEN URBAN TRAFFIC PLANNING DESIGN RES CENTER LTD COMPANY

title_en: Automatic navigation type fire smoke decontamination robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic navigation type fire smoke decontamination robot, which relates to the field of fire fighting, and comprises a power walking system, a smoke decontamination system, a smoke suction system and a control system; the smoke gas washing and disinfecting system is arranged on the power walking system, the smoke gas suction system is arranged on the smoke gas washing and disinfecting system and is communicated with the smoke gas washing and disinfecting system, and the power walking system, the smoke gas washing and disinfecting system and the smoke gas suction system are respectively connected with the control system; the control system is provided with an information processing module, a path planning module, an infrared camera recognition module and a smoke concentration temperature sensor module. The utility model has the advantages that: the smoke and dust in the fire can be washed and eliminated, the fire can be quickly started when the fire occurs, the rescue and evacuation safety channel can be guaranteed in time, and the evacuation time of people is prolonged.
assignees: LIMITED RESPONSIBILITY COMPANY FOR JIANFENGSHI SCIENCE DAI IMMEDIATE SAFETY TECH

title_en: Design method of seabed position reference station
abstract_en: A design method of a seabed position reference station belongs to the technical field of ocean surveying. The invention aims at the problem that the existing reference beacon in the seabed position reference station has single function and can not meet the requirement of high-precision positioning navigation service. The method comprises the following steps: adopting a direct sequence as a navigation signal waveform of a reference beacon; determining the type and the sequence length of the direct sequence according to the acoustic propagation characteristics under the target propagation distance; designing the working mode of the reference beacon; and (3) designing a multi-sensor configuration: arranging a sonar sensor, an inertial navigation sensor, a pressure sensor, a magnetic sensor and a gravity sensor on the shelter, and integrating the sensors with a reference beacon; safety guarantee design: performing anti-corrosion treatment and silt prevention treatment on each component of the shelter; interface design: each reference beacon comprises at least one mechanical interface; each reference station comprises at least two electrical interfaces. The invention can meet the design requirements of the seabed position reference station with large action range, large operation depth and high reliability.

title_en: Data fusion algorithm for accurate positioning based on GNSS, vision and IMU
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data fusion algorithm for accurate positioning based on GNSS, vision and IMU. The GNSS positioning technology is easily limited by external observation conditions, and satellite signal receiving capacity is sharply weakened in sheltered areas such as viaducts and urban canyons, so that the positioning and navigation requirements cannot be met. The scale problem cannot be solved by pure visual position estimation, and a matching relation cannot be established in a weak texture scene and a fast motion scene, so that tracking loss is easy to occur; the IMU can reflect dynamic changes in a short time (in milliseconds), but its cumulative error increases over long runs (in seconds). According to the invention, according to the complementarity among different sensor data sources, the global positioning precision of the GNSS is improved by using the local data sources (vision and IMU), the local accumulated error is eliminated by using the global data sources of the GNSS, the short-term high-precision global positioning is maintained by depending on the local vision and IMU data when the satellite signals are shielded, and the performance and the robustness of the positioning navigation system are integrally improved.

title_en: Three-dimensional ship scene oriented extensible real-time rapid emergency path planning method
abstract_en: A three-dimensional ship scene oriented extensible real-time rapid emergency path planning method comprises the following steps: constructing a three-dimensional navigation network according to the indoor structure of the ship; firstly, distributing wireless sensors at road sign nodes of a three-dimensional navigation network, constructing a wireless sensor network, then collecting road section delay information between adjacent road sign nodes and time interval information of dangerous arrival road sections by using the wireless sensors, and then establishing an emergency navigation model by using a directed graph according to the road sign nodes and the road section delay information; planning an optimal navigation path for each ship-borne personnel by utilizing a rounding and scaling algorithm according to the target of the emergency navigation strategy; and according to the dynamic change of the evacuation environment of the ship, updating the parameters of the emergency navigation model in real time by using the information acquired by the wireless sensor network, and finally calculating the optimal navigation path of the ship-borne personnel in real time by using a rounding and scaling algorithm. The design has the advantages of good expandability, high evacuation efficiency and high user safety.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted navigation instrument based on satellite positioning
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of vehicle navigation, and discloses a vehicle navigation instrument based on satellite positioning, which comprises a shell, wherein a containing groove is formed in the left side of the shell, a display is movably connected inside the containing groove, an electric push rod is fixedly installed on the right side wall of the containing groove, and a protective baffle is arranged on the left side of the shell. This vehicle navigation instrument based on satellite positioning, through the shell, accomodate the groove, the display, electric putter, the gag lever post, the dead lever, spacing hole, guard flap, the connecting strip, mutually support between the fixed block for the display is located the inside of accomodating the groove, and then makes guard flap rotate downwards and shelters from the left side of display, thereby can protect the display through guard flap, prevents that the dust from attaching to the display on the surface, guarantees video definition down.
assignees: WEIBO NAVIGATION ELECTRONIC SHENZHEN CO LTD

title_en: Fire evacuation path planning method based on deep learning and hybrid genetic algorithm
abstract_en: The application relates to a fire evacuation path planning method based on deep learning and hybrid genetic algorithm, which comprises the following steps: when a fire disaster in a target area is determined according to a video of real-time fire monitoring, acquiring tracking information corresponding to an evacuation target in the target area, wherein the tracking information comprises people stream information and target position information; acquiring node information corresponding to a plurality of spatial nodes outside a target area, and generating an evacuation route corresponding to an evacuation target, wherein the spatial nodes are used for representing areas through which the evacuation target passes during evacuation; determining an evacuation optimization tag based on the people flow information, the target position information and the evacuation route; and processing the evacuation routes by using a hybrid genetic algorithm and an evacuation optimization tag to obtain alternative evacuation routes corresponding to each evacuation target, and determining an evacuation route planning result according to whether the alternative evacuation routes are blocked. By the aid of the method and the device, the problems that the planned fire evacuation path is low in crowd evacuation speed and low in evacuation efficiency in the related art are solved.

title_en: System and method for guiding path to shelter in disaster state
title_ko: 재난 상황에서 대피소까지 차량 경로 안내 시스템 및 방법
abstract_ko: 재난 상황에서 대피소까지의 경로를 안내하는 시스템 및 방법이 개시된다. 본 발명은, 재난 상황에서 대피소까지의 경로를 안내하는 시스템에 있어서, 상기 대피소를 향하는 도로 주변에 미리 설치되어 제1 도로 상황 정보를 감지하는 복수의 센서, 상기 도로 주변의 운전자에 의하여 제2 도로 상황 정보가 입력되는 입력 장치, 상기 제1 도로 상황 정보 및 상기 제2 도로 상황 정보를 수신하고, 상기 제1 도로 상황 정보 및 상기 제2 도로 상황 정보에 기초하여 상기 대피소까지의 추천 경로를 획득하는 서버 및 상기 서버로부터 상기 추천 경로에 대한 안내 데이터를 수신하여 표시하는 디스플레이 장치를 포함할 수 있다.
assignees: UNIV DONG EUI IND ACAD COOP FOUND

title_en: Vehicle navigation method and system based on sensor
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field related to vehicle safety, and discloses a vehicle navigation method and a system based on a sensor, which comprises a sensing acquisition module, a wireless sharing module, a range road condition module and a safety navigation module; the effect is based on the real-time interaction of radar sensing data between a plurality of adjacent vehicles of wireless system realization, thereby realize that vehicle navigation and dodge the system and can have more time to remove perception and acquisition to the barrier in wider range, thereby remind navigating mate safe state or guide navigating mate to make a response, also or realize promptly dodging of vehicle, compare in the mode that vehicle self radar sensing handled among the prior art, can avoid the huge blind area that produces when adjacent vehicle or barrier shelter from, can reduce the incident probability of taking place that can not in time discover to lead to because of blind area barrier pedestrian etc..
assignees: BEIJING JIESHENG TONGDA INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Visual escape route guidance system and method for protective clothing
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of protective clothing, which is used for solving the problems that the existing protective clothing cannot guide escape routes for users in the using process, so that the users cannot escape from a fire scene in the fastest time, the safety of the users is easy to be adversely affected, and the safety of the users cannot be guaranteed, in particular to a visual protective clothing escape route guiding system and a visual protective clothing escape route guiding method, wherein a processor acquires an accident road section, a safety route and a dangerous road section according to a danger value, screens the escape routes without the dangerous road section to obtain the safety routes, compares the number of the safety routes, guides the routes of the protective clothing users through a route guiding module, so that the protective clothing users can efficiently escape, and can be guided to reach the safety position to wait for rescue when the escape is difficult, and the protective clothing users are prevented from entering dangerous zones to be subjected to danger, the system can fully ensure the safety of the user of the protective clothing, and has high safety level.
assignees: ANHUI SHANGZAO INTELLIGENT EQUIPMENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Emergency flashlight for evacuation route guidance and evacuation method using the same
title_ko: 피난로 안내용 비상손전등 및 이를 이용한 피난방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an emergency flashlight for evacuation route guidance and an evacuation method using same. The emergency flashlight comprising a light source unit in which an LED element, a focusing lens, and a focus adjustment lens are built in a row inside a cylindrical housing, and a power supply unit for supplying power to the light source unit, comprises an information output unit. The information output unit includes: a cover coupled to an end region of the housing toward which light travels; an insertion hole formed on one side of the cover by a certain arc length; a transparent rotating plate, a part of which is inserted into the insertion hole, and in which a fixing pin passing through the cover is inserted and fixed to a fixing hole formed at the center thereof to be rotated when pressed with a certain amount of force; and a plurality of image lenses each including information and radially provided around the fixing hole of the transparent rotating plate, wherein one of pieces of the information is an evacuation guide map of a floor equipped with the emergency flashlight, such that, when the power of the emergency flashlight is turned on, the evacuation guide map is transmitted.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 피난로 안내용 비상손전등 및 이를 이용한 피난방법은, 원통형의 하우징 내부에는 LED소자, 집속렌즈 및 초점조절렌즈가 일렬로 내장되는 광원부와, 상기 광원부에 전원을 공급하는 전원부로 구성되는 비상손전등으로서, 상기 비상손전등은 정보출력부를 포함하고, 상기 정보출력부는, 빛이 나아가는 쪽 상기 하우징의 단부영역에 결합되는 덮개; 상기 덮개의 일측면에 일정 호의 길이만큼 형성되는 삽입공; 상기 삽입공에 일부가 삽입되고, 중앙에 형성된 고정공에 상기 덮개를 관통하는 고정핀이 삽입 및 고정되어 일정 힘의 크기로 가압하면 회전 가능하게 이루어지는 투명회전판; 및 각각 정보를 담고 있고, 상기 투명회전판의 고정공을 중심으로 방사형으로 구비되는 다수개의 이미지 렌즈를 포함하고, 상기 정보 중 어느 하나는 상기 비상손전등이 구비된 층의 피난안내도이어서 상기 비상손전등의 전원을 켜면 피난안내도가 투과되는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: UNIV NAT INCHEON RES & BUSINESS FOUND

title_en: Disaster monitoring response System based on IoT Wireless Network
title_ko: ＩｏＴ 무선네트워크 기반 화재 감시 대응시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire monitoring response system based on an Internet of Things (IoT) wireless network and, more particularly, to a fire monitoring response system based on an IoT wireless network, which comprises: a sensing unit installed inside a building, sensing at least one among heat, smoke, carbon monoxide (CO), flame, humidity, and outlet arc, and having an IoT communication chip embedded therein; a wireless gateway for wireless reception, which is installed inside the building, which receives measurement data measured from the sensing unit and information on a location of an evacuee in the building, and which receives CCTV image data in the building; a platform server receiving the measurement data, the location information, and the image data in real time from the wireless gateway, predicting a situation based on simulation data, transmitting response information to a user terminal of the evacuee, and controlling that the situation to be notified through an IoT control unit; and an IoT control unit installed in several places inside the building and embedded with a speaker, a housing, and a display unit displaying an optimal route or an indicator to guide the optimal route.
