According to the invention, an array voltage sensor is arranged at the boot bottom, step voltage is acquired in real time and wirelessly exchanged, an edge AI module calculates the leakage power supply direction, an evacuation path is indicated by an arrow of a boot-face LED, and meanwhile, the four insulation states of 'normal/damp/critical/breakdown precursor' are judged on line by a lightweight coding-decoding model by utilizing the voltage distribution of coupling of a boot-bottom conductive micro-fiber net, and a result is output only if the confidence level continuously reaches the standard, so that the closed loop of self-checking, early warning and navigation is realized. The insulating boot can be used for high-voltage operators to provide real-time insulation monitoring and leakage escape guidance for the operators, so that personal safety is improved.
assignees: LUOYANG YANSHI POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Evacuation route guidance system
title_ko: 대피 경로 유도 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 기술은 작업현장에서 화재 등과 같은 비상상황이 발생시에 그 화재발생구역을 기준으로 안전구역으로 대피할 수 있는 대피로에 설치된 유도등만 점등시켜 작업자가 신속하고 안전하게 대피할 수 있도록 유도할 수 있는 경로 유도 시스템에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 화재발생구역에 대한 화재감지정보는 물론, 관리자가 화재발생구역을 모니터링 하기 위한 영상정보를 획득하는 다수의 화재감지수단 및 상기 화재감지수단으로부터 전송되는 화재감지정보와 영상정보를 전송받되 전송된 정보를 기반으로 미리 저장된 맵 데이터정보와 대비하여 작업자가 안전구역으로 이동할 수 있게 유도정보를 제공하는 중앙제어부를 포함하며, 상기 화재감지수단은 화재감지기, 가스감지센서, 카메라 중 적어도 어느 하나인 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: System for Optimal Evacuation Route Selection Based on Elevation and Slope Analysis for Slope Walking Evacuation Simulation
title_ko: 경사로 보행 대피 시뮬레이션을 위한 고도 및 경사도 분석 기반의 최적 대피 경로 선정 시스템
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 재난 발생 시 보행 대피 시뮬레이션을 기반으로 대피 경로를 분석하고 최적화하는 기술에 관한 것으로,  
경사로 보행 대피 시뮬레이션을 위한 고도 및 경사도 분석 기반의 최적 대피 경로 선정 시스템에 있어서, 
수치 표고 모형(Digital Elevation Models, DEM) 데이터를 기반으로 지형의 고도를 분석하는 고도 분석 모듈과; 도로 링크 데이터를 활용하여 링크별 지점의 경사도를 산출하는 경사도 분석 모듈과; 산출된 경사도 데이터를 이용하여 대피자들의 이동 특성을 고려한 최적 경로를 생성하는 대피 경로 최적화 모듈과; 생성된 경사도 데이터와 대피 경로 데이터를 데이터베이스(DB)에 저장하고 관리하는 데이터 관리 모듈과; 대피 지역의 세부적인 존(Micro 존) 분할을 통해 통행량을 예측하고 이를 대피 시뮬레이션에 적용하는 존 세분화 모듈과; 대피 지역 및 경로에 대한 시뮬레이션을 실행하여 대피자의 이동 경로와 소요 시간을 시각적으로 제공하는 시뮬레이션 모듈을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: system
abstract_en: An object of a system according to an embodiment is to provide information on an evacuation site at the time of occurrence of a disaster and support rescue activities.SOLUTION: A system includes a navigation unit, a visualization unit, a registration unit, an upload unit, and a matching unit. The navigation unit navigates to the nearest evacuation site according to the type of disaster. The visualization unit visualizes an opening status and an accommodation status of the shelter. The registration unit registers information of a rescue requester and shares the information on a map. The upload unit uploads an image or a moving image of a disaster area to visualize a dangerous area or a non-passable area. The matching unit matches a volunteer requester with a volunteer.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Digital twin evacuation early warning method for barrier-free channel of booster station
abstract_en: The application discloses a digital twin evacuation early warning method for a barrier-free channel of a booster station, which effectively solves the problem of path planning misalignment caused by insufficient fusion of multisource perception data. Through the spatial data integration of the digital twin model, the usable state and disaster influence range of the barrier-free facilities can be accurately identified. The dynamic path planning algorithm continuously optimizes the evacuation route in the disaster evolution process, and prevents personnel from entering the affected dangerous area. The multi-mode instruction generation mechanism ensures that people with different physiological characteristics can obtain adaptive evacuation guidance, the detention risk caused by single information transmission mode is reduced, the real-time state monitoring and path updating function further improves the response speed and reliability of the emergency evacuation system, the geometric dimension and the space coordinates of facilities are acquired excessively accurately, the consistency of a virtual model and an actual environment is ensured, and the data support is provided for evaluating the availability of the facilities in a disaster environment by configuring material characteristics and accessibility parameters.

title_en: Intelligent linkage control system for video monitoring, access control and fire alarm
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent linkage control systems for video monitoring, access control and fire alarm, in particular to an intelligent linkage control system for video monitoring, access control and fire alarm, which aims to solve the problems of low integration level, linkage logic solidification and high misjudgment rate of the existing security system. The system comprises a multi-source data perception fusion module, a fire situation intelligent evaluation module, a dynamic evacuation path planning module and a multi-system cooperative execution control module, wherein the intelligent evaluation of the fire situation and the dynamic evacuation path planning are realized by fusing video, access control and fire alarm data, video tracking, access control opening and closing and fire control broadcasting are cooperatively controlled, and the accuracy and the efficiency of emergency response are improved.

title_en: Mine intelligent disaster avoidance path planning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mine intelligent disaster avoidance path planning method which comprises the steps of collecting mine environment parameters, disaster information, personnel distribution data and danger avoidance facility state data in parallel, triggering disaster early warning when the parameters are detected to exceed a safety threshold value continuously for many times, generating disaster event identification, centering on the event, defining an influence area according to the disaster information, converging data in the area to form a dynamic data pool, executing disaster diffusion simulation and personnel evacuation track simulation based on the dynamic data pool, fusing the disaster diffusion simulation result and the personnel evacuation track simulation result to form a dynamic obstacle map, obtaining a plurality of paths according to the personnel distribution data and the danger avoidance facility state data, adopting a multi-objective optimization algorithm based on the dynamic obstacle map, and obtaining a disaster avoidance path according to path length, safety redundancy and group evacuation efficiency. The invention realizes the dynamic planning of the mine disaster avoidance path, and obviously improves the path safety and the evacuation efficiency.
assignees: SHANDONG INSPUR DIGITAL SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: system
abstract_en: An object of a system according to an embodiment is to enable an individual to take an appropriate action in a disaster or an emergency situation.SOLUTION: A system according to an embodiment includes smart devices equipped with a generation AI and an application. The smart device includes a disaster information providing unit, a rescue procedure providing unit, an evacuation route guiding unit, and an emergency call support unit. The disaster information providing unit provides disaster information. The rescue procedure providing unit provides a rescue procedure for the injured person. The evacuation route guidance unit guides a safe evacuation route based on the GPS information of the user. The emergency call support unit supports an emergency call.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Personalized escape assistance arrangement and personalized escape assistance method
abstract_en: The escape assistance arrangement and the escape assistance method guide a user to a safe target position if an alarm situation has occurred in a spatial area and an alarm message has therefore been sent. The user carries an escape assistance device with a vital parameter sensor, a geoposition sensor and an output unit. A navigation unit calculates an escape route for the user, wherein the escape route leads from the current geoposition of the user to the safe target position. The navigation unit generates an escape route description for this escape route. For this purpose, it classifies the user's current state depending on a vital parameter and generates the escape route description depending on the classified current state. The output unit outputs the escape route description.

title_en: system
abstract_en: An object of a system according to an embodiment is to perform quick and appropriate evacuation guidance in an emergency situation.SOLUTION: A system includes a generation part, a navigation part, and a voice guide part. The generation unit generates information corresponding to the emergency situation scenario. The navigation unit performs navigation based on the information generated by the generation unit. The voice guide unit provides the navigation information provided by the navigation unit as a voice guide.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: system
abstract_en: An object of a system according to an embodiment is to provide a quick and appropriate evacuation route when an emergency occurs.SOLUTION: A system includes a generation unit, a navigation unit, a guide unit, and an evacuation route providing unit. The generation unit generates information corresponding to the emergency situation scenario. The navigation unit performs navigation based on the information generated by the generation unit. The guiding unit guides the user based on the information provided by the navigation unit. The evacuation route providing unit is activated when an emergency occurs, and provides an appropriate evacuation route based on the video from the drone.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Method and device for dispatching and monitoring mobile concrete transportation vehicles
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for dispatching and monitoring a mobile concrete transportation vehicle, which belong to the technical field of vehicle dispatching, the scheme brings fundamental promotion in the aspects of navigation and emergency evacuation through innovative hardware structural design, a highly reliable control closed loop is constructed, a special circuit realizes accurate positioning, a command blind area is eliminated, each lamp is independently controlled through a physical wire harness, a dynamically moving green light band is generated based on the real-time position of the vehicle, the electronic path is converted into a continuous visual physical track, the problems of navigation and safety caused by low visibility and multiple branches are solved, in the emergency evacuation aspect, any vehicle storage battery can be used as an emergency power supply, all indication strips are directly driven by electric power through manual plug-in connection, the emergency light band with a specific color penetrating through a tunnel is formed instantly, the problem of safe evacuation under extreme faults is solved, and the system is endowed with extremely high safety redundancy and disaster viability.
assignees: HUNAN CHANGSHA DONGNANFANG NEW MATERIAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire door and window dynamic opening and closing decision method and system based on multi-source fire disaster characteristics
abstract_en: The invention provides a fire door and window dynamic opening and closing decision method and a system based on multisource fire characteristics, which are characterized in that multisource data such as smoke concentration, ambient temperature, personnel activity state and the like are collected through distributed sensing nodes, a comprehensive fire situation assessment result is generated through space-time registration and feature fusion, evacuation priority is determined by combining a house type map and a personnel thermodynamic model, a cellular automaton model is adopted to conduct fire spread prediction, door and window state weights, smoke attenuation coefficients and personnel density factors are introduced into path planning, door and window opening and closing priority sequences are dynamically calculated based on an improved A path planning algorithm, finally intelligent control and manual emergency intervention are realized through an executing mechanism, automatic control is suspended and information uploading is recorded when an inner side manual opening signal is received, relevant area priority is recalculated, and functions of accurately responding to fire and dynamically adapting opening and closing strategies are realized through cooperation of units such as a multisource sensing module, a data preprocessing module, a decision analysis module and the like.
assignees: CHINA FIRST METALLURGICAL GROUP CO LTD

title_en: system
abstract_en: A system is provided.SOLUTION: A system comprising: means for collecting location data from vehicles, pedestrians, bicycles, and motorcycles; means for controlling traffic lights at intersections; means for calculating an optimal route to a destination; means for predicting the risk of traffic accidents and providing warnings; means for providing driving instructions to improve fuel economy; and means for calculating and providing emergency evacuation routes.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: system
abstract_en: An object of the system according to the embodiment is to provide a quick and safe evacuation route at the time of disaster.SOLUTION: A system according to an embodiment includes a collection unit, a damage prediction unit, an evacuation route selection unit, and a navigation unit. The collection unit collects data. The damage prediction unit predicts damage based on the data collected by the collection unit. The evacuation route selection unit selects an evacuation route based on the damage predicted by the damage prediction unit. The navigation unit guides the user along the evacuation route selected by the evacuation route selection unit.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Cooperative guiding system and method for emergency escape unmanned aerial vehicle for tunnel traffic accident
abstract_en: The application discloses a collaborative guiding system and a collaborative guiding method for an emergency escape unmanned aerial vehicle for tunnel traffic accidents, and belongs to the technical field of tunnel safety emergency. The system comprises an internal ejection mechanism, an unmanned aerial vehicle nest unit for accommodating a plurality of foldable unmanned aerial vehicles, a guiding unmanned aerial vehicle for carrying SLAM navigation, a thermal imaging instrument, a projection lamp and an emergency material throwing device, and a communication relay unmanned aerial vehicle for constructing a mesh+ optical communication redundant link, wherein the control method is based on a reinforcement learning algorithm to dynamically optimize path planning and combine UWB positioning and a self-adaptive projection lamp to realize 'visual-touch-auditory' multichannel guiding. According to the application, the complex environment sensing precision is improved through multi-sensor fusion positioning, the communication delay is reduced by the cooperation of the dual-frequency Mesh network and optical communication, the evacuation efficiency is improved through the interaction of dynamic projection and the AR terminal, the problems of real-time positioning, communication coverage and accurate guiding in a tunnel fire scene are effectively solved, and the emergency rescue success rate is remarkably improved.
assignees: HEBEI DAZHONG TRAFFIC PLANNING AND DESIGN CO LTD

title_en: system
abstract_en: A system according to an embodiment provides information and training for quick and appropriate evacuation in an emergency situation.SOLUTION: A system according to an embodiment includes an information generation unit, a navigation unit, a voice guide unit, and a training unit. The information generation unit generates information corresponding to the emergency situation scenario. The navigation unit displays an evacuation route based on the information generated by the information generation unit. The voice guide unit performs voice guidance based on the evacuation route displayed by the navigation unit. The training unit provides training in a virtual reality space.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Evacuation simulation method and device for multi-story building
abstract_en: The application discloses an evacuation simulation method and device for a multi-story building. The evacuation simulation method comprises the steps of obtaining passable rectangular area data of all floors in a multi-layer building, reversely determining obstacle rectangular area data based on the passable rectangular area data and corresponding security exclusion zone rectangular area data based on the determined obstacle rectangular area data, determining a PRM navigation road network based on the passable rectangular area data of the floors and the determined security exclusion zone rectangular area data for each floor, determining a moving path based on a path planning starting point, a path planning end point and the determined PRM navigation road network for each agent, and controlling the agent to move based on the moving path of the agent in a full simulation time course for each agent in combination with environmental parameters of the position of the agent in each simulation time step. Therefore, the efficiency and the accuracy of evacuation simulation are improved.
assignees: BEIJING GENERAL MUNICIPAL ENGINEERING DESIGN & RESEARCH INST CO LTD

title_en: Scenic spot crowd treading early warning and emergency dredging system and method based on unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention provides a scenic spot crowd trampling early warning and emergency guiding system and method based on unmanned aerial vehicles, scenic spots are inspected in real time through the unmanned aerial vehicles, crowd density data is collected, and a high-density area and potential treading risks are dynamically identified by combining a target detection algorithm and a path planning technology. And simultaneously, the unmanned aerial vehicle calculates an optimal rescue path (based on a principle of minimum flow of people) and an evacuation direction (guiding to a low-density area) in real time and pushes the optimal rescue path to field personnel through an acousto-optic device or a mobile terminal. The invention solves the problem of response delay caused by the dependence of traditional scenic spot management on manual inspection, realizes active prevention, quick positioning and efficient dredging of trampling events, and remarkably improves the public safety level.
assignees: NANJING ZHUANGDA INTELLIGENT SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY RESEARCH INST CO LTD

title_en: system
abstract_en: A system is provided.SOLUTION: The system includes an input means for inputting disaster situation, rescue request, and necessary supplies information by a victim, an analysis means for analyzing the input information and specifying the disaster situation, the type and quantity of necessary supplies and rescue, and a notification generation means for generating and transmitting a notification to an appropriate department based on the analysis result, a route guidance means for acquiring the current position of the victim by using a GPS function and guiding a route to the nearest shelter, and a safety information means for receiving the safety information of the victim and posting it on a disaster message board.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Control method and system for fire-fighting emergency evacuation equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a control method and a system of fire emergency evacuation equipment, which relate to the technical field of fire control, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring real-time environment data inside a building; the method comprises the steps of importing real-time environment data into a pre-trained evacuation path risk assessment model, outputting risk coefficients of each grid unit in a grid diagram corresponding to a building at a future time point, planning an evacuation path by taking the current position of a target person as a starting point, taking a safety area as an end point and taking the risk coefficients corresponding to the grid units as path weights, outputting at least one evacuation path in a path searching mode, generating a control instruction according to the evacuation path correspondence, and dynamically adjusting image indication content and/or voice broadcasting content of fire emergency evacuation equipment according to the control instruction. The method generates the safe evacuation path through dynamic risk assessment and intelligent path planning, and cooperates with the guiding equipment to remarkably improve the evacuation success rate and safety in emergency.
assignees: POWERCHINA JIANGXI ELECTRIC POWER DESIGNING INST CO LTD

title_en: Evacuation Route Guidance System
title_ko: 대피로 안내 시스템
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 물류창고 등에서 화재, 지진 또는 폭발상고가 발생하였을 경우 내부 작업자를 대피시키기 위한 시스템에 대한 것이다. 
작업자가 소지하는 비콘스캐너 신호와 물S창고 일측에 설치된 대피안내장치를 비롯한 각종 센서들을 활용하여 급박한 재난환경에서 최적의 대피방법을 대피로 피해 상황, 작업자 위치 그리고 작업자 건강상태 등을 종합적으로 고려하여 안내함으로써, 인명피해를 최소화할 수 있는 방법을 제시하였다.

title_en: Driving travel camping safety reminding method, system, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a driving travel camping safety reminding method, a driving travel camping safety reminding system, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the field of disaster avoidance, wherein the driving travel camping stage information is acquired; setting a safety reminding strategy according to a driving and traveling camping stage, wherein the safety reminding strategy comprises the steps of acquiring multi-dimensional factor data, distributing weight of the multi-dimensional factor data, evaluating safety risks and outputting warning information, and the warning information comprises the grade of safety warning, the safety risk state display corresponding to the grade of safety warning and the recommendation of a risk avoiding strategy. According to the application, through integrating a third party multimode data deep fusion, full-field Jing Dongtai weight control, a visual risk map, a precise action strategy and a camping intelligent recommended vehicle-mounted system camping safety early warning algorithm, the full-flow safety management of camping selection, path planning, en-route early warning, camping residence and emergency evacuation is realized.
assignees: CHINA FAW GROUP CORP;FAW BEIJING SOFTWARE TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for planning personnel evacuation real-time path in building fire scene
abstract_en: The application relates to the fields of safety science and emergency management, and provides a method and a device for planning a real-time path for personnel evacuation in a building fire scene, electronic equipment and a computer readable storage medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a building fire map in real time, constructing a sampling evacuation path based on a preset algorithm for any sampling time, and forming a real-time evacuation path according to the change of the sampling evacuation path along with time, wherein the preset algorithm comprises the steps of constructing a preliminary evacuation path according to a preset path planning algorithm, constructing initial pheromone distribution of an ant colony algorithm according to the preliminary evacuation path, wherein the pheromone concentration on the preliminary evacuation path in the initial pheromone distribution is higher than that of a common grid, and constructing the sampling evacuation path according to the initial pheromone distribution and the ant colony algorithm. The method has the technical effects of improving the searching speed of the ant colony algorithm, improving the convergence speed, improving the reliability of the path planning result, improving the personnel evacuation efficiency and improving the personnel evacuation safety.

title_en: Fuzzy-CA toxic gas leakage risk assessment method based on large language model and Fuzzy reasoning
abstract_en: The invention provides a Fuzzy-CA toxic gas leakage risk assessment method based on a large language model and Fuzzy reasoning, and relates to the field of dangerous chemical accident risk assessment and emergency management. The method aims at solving the problem that the existing model is difficult to consider physical diffusion and toxicology characteristics, and is characterized in that firstly, a diffusion process after toxic gas leakage is efficiently simulated based on a cellular automaton, then, toxicology parameters and diffusibility attributes of the toxic gas are automatically extracted by using a large language model, corresponding fuzzy rules are generated, and finally, a global risk distribution map is output by integrating concentration distribution, toxicity intensity and diffusibility factors through a fuzzy reasoning system. The invention can realize rapid, steady and interpretable risk assessment under the conditions of multiple toxic gases and multiple scenes, and is suitable for personnel evacuation, path planning and area management and control in emergency response.

title_en: Crowd evacuation method based on multi-mode sensing and particle swarm optimization
abstract_en: The invention provides a crowd evacuation method based on multi-mode perception and particle swarm optimization, which comprises the steps of determining high-risk areas through building information models and historical passenger flow data, arranging multi-mode sensor nodes in the areas, collecting multi-mode data, calculating risk grades of the high-risk areas according to real-time data by utilizing an improved particle swarm optimization algorithm, determining optimal dredging target points of each area, constructing a real-time risk potential field diagram based on the space layout of the optimal dredging target points and the high-risk areas, generating a safe evacuation path by adopting a path planning algorithm, and dynamically evacuating and guiding the crowd through a multi-mode alarm device according to the risk grades and path planning results to ensure that people are evacuated to the safe areas quickly and safely. The invention can evaluate risks in real time, optimize path planning and implement dynamic guidance through the multi-mode alarm system, thereby effectively reducing congestion and risks in the evacuation process and improving emergency response capability and personnel safety.

title_en: Mine personnel positioning and disaster early warning system and method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of mine safety monitoring, and particularly relates to a mine personnel positioning and disaster early warning system and method. In the aspect of positioning, the complex environment is accurately tracked by overcoming the multipath effect and signal shielding of a metal ore body through the ultra-wideband combined inertial navigation compensation algorithm, the hidden danger of position failure of a key area is eliminated, in the aspect of disaster response, a linkage platform is used for associating personnel positions, environment parameters and equipment states in real time, shortening the response delay of emergency situations such as gas overrun and the like from more than 3 minutes to the second level, improving the evacuation efficiency, in the aspect of enhancing the reliability of a system, the time division multiple access protocol is used for reducing communication conflict, and the intrinsic safety authentication is used for an intrinsic safety terminal, so that the requirements of underground gas and dust environments are met, and the endurance is prolonged. The system has the advantages that the system has the intelligence and the compatibility, a standardized interface is adopted to break the data island, the active risk avoidance mechanism linkage equipment is controlled and the path is planned, the false alarm rate is reduced, and technical support is provided for mine safety.
assignees: CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY ENGINEERING GROUP CHONGQING RESEARCH INST

title_en: Urban waterlogging resident emergency evacuation path guiding method for intelligent community
abstract_en: The invention discloses a city waterlogging resident emergency evacuation path guiding method for a smart community, and relates to the technical field of smart cities and emergency management; the method comprises the steps of firstly constructing a community digital twin substrate integrating geographic information, building information, sensing data of the Internet of things and a hydrodynamic model, realizing dynamic inversion and prediction of waterlogging situation by assimilating a multisource observation data driving model, calculating space-time dynamic risks of an evacuation road network based on prediction results and generating a risk map, adopting a double-layer optimization model combining macroscopic flow distribution and microscopic path planning to calculate a space-time evacuation scheme comprising optimal departure time and a specific path sequence for residents or families by combining resident personalized constraint, and finally issuing instructions through multiple channels such as intelligent terminals, broadcasting and the like and dynamically adjusting based on real-time monitoring.
assignees: SUZHOU JIUZHANG TONGSUAN INFORMATION IND CO LTD

title_en: Nuclear emergency path and opportunity decision method based on reinforcement learning and deep learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to a nuclear emergency path and opportunity decision method based on reinforcement learning and deep learning, which comprises the steps of taking minimized exposure dose and evacuation time as targets, adopting a deep reinforcement learning A3C algorithm to make decisions on evacuation of an agent to be evacuated, obtaining a plurality of evacuation paths and corresponding action opportunity schemes as candidate schemes, establishing a training set based on the candidate schemes and decision samples formed by corresponding decision variables and multi-source environment information, training a deep learning model formed by a transducer and a random forest from an environment state tensor to the candidate schemes, outputting priori scores, adopting linear weighting of scoring weights to obtain weighted scores of the candidate schemes, fusing the weighted scores and the priori scores to obtain comprehensive scores, and determining an executable scheme from the candidate schemes based on the comprehensive scores. The invention solves the defects of the prior art in the aspects of self-adaptability, instantaneity and benefit cost analysis capability in nuclear accident emergency decision and path planning.

title_en: Urban waterlogging emergency path planning method and system based on multi-mode crowdsourcing data and dynamic risk weight
abstract_en: The invention provides a city waterlogging emergency path planning method and system based on multi-mode crowdsourcing data and dynamic risk weights. The method comprises a road network state updating flow and a user path searching flow, wherein the road network state updating flow dynamically updates a global road network risk map by adopting a data fusion model based on a multi-source verification and space-time attenuation model, the user path searching flow calculates the passing cost of each road section based on the latest global road network risk map, and a path planning algorithm is operated to search the optimal safe evacuation path from a starting point to a terminal point by taking the lowest passing cost as a target and send the optimal safe evacuation path to a user terminal for navigation guidance. The invention can obviously improve the evacuation safety.

title_en: System for calculating evacuation routes based on CBR contamination spread prediction and controlling method for the same
title_ko: 화생방 오염확산예측 기반 대피경로 산출시스템 및 그 제어방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화생방 오염확산예측 기반 대피경로 산출시스템 및 그 제어방법에 관한 것으로, 화생방 상황 발생 시 사용자에 의해 정의된 구역 내에서 화생방 오염확산예측 툴(Tool)로부터 획득한 시간대 별 오염확산예측 데이터를 기반으로 사고 발생 인근 출발점으로부터 안전 구역까지 탈출 경로를 자동으로 계산함으로써, 보다 신속하고 신뢰성 있는 화생방 대피경로를 산출함으로 그에 따라 재난민의 도피 안정성을 극대화시킬 수 있음은 물론, 화생방 오염 발생 시 시간대 별 오염확산 데이터, 도로, 교통량 등의 공간정보를 최적 경로 산출 알고리즘에 적용하여 최적의 대피경로를 산출하여 안내함으로써, 화생방 오염으로부터 재난민을 안전지역으로 신속히 도피시킬 수 있으므로 그에 따라 인명피해를 최소화할 수 있다.

title_en: Method for selecting fire escape safety path in large building
abstract_en: The application provides a method for selecting a fire escape safety path in a large building, which relates to the field of dynamic path planning, and comprises the steps of constructing a building topological graph model, and abstracting a building space into a graph structure formed by nodes and edges; the method comprises the steps of dynamically calculating the danger level of each node by adopting a nonlinear attenuation model based on a fire disaster occurrence position, updating the danger level of the node along with time, adopting a danger sensing type path searching algorithm, fusing the danger level of the node with the moving cost, planning an escape path from a starting point to a safety exit, monitoring fire change in real time, triggering a path re-planning mechanism, dynamically adjusting the escape path, and evaluating the escape path through a multi-dimensional evaluation system to determine a final escape path. The technical scheme of the application realizes the dynamic planning of escape paths with faster response, higher safety and stronger adaptability, and provides reliable technical support for the evacuation of people in large-scale building fire disasters.

title_en: Evacuation path planning method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to an evacuation path planning method, an evacuation path planning device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of responding to an emergency evacuation instruction, and acquiring environment risk perception data, personnel state data and channel congestion coefficients in real time; the personnel state data comprise evacuation personnel positions, environment risk perception data, personnel state data and channel congestion coefficients are processed to construct a dynamic emergency situation map, each path edge in the dynamic emergency situation map is associated with a dynamic weight, the dynamic weight is calculated based on the real-time risk coefficients, the channel congestion coefficients and basic transit time, a target optimization model of multiple optimization targets is constructed based on the dynamic emergency situation map aiming at the evacuation personnel positions, the target optimization model is solved to obtain a target evacuation path, the target evacuation path is converted into an evacuation guiding instruction, and the evacuation guiding instruction is issued, so that the intellectualization, the precision and the safety level of emergency evacuation are improved.
assignees: SUZHOU JOYSUCH INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Information providing program
abstract_en: The present invention provides, e.g., an information providing program that takes into account estimated evacuation completion times.　The information providing program provides guidance on evacuation routes from each of one or more departure areas in a route guidance target to one or more arrival areas in the route guidance target. The information providing program executes a calculation step for identifying one evacuation route group from candidates of two or more evacuation route groups on the basis of first information about personnel allocation for each departure area, second information about the candidates of the two or more evacuation route groups including evacuation routes for each disaster occurrence place and for each departure area, third information about estimated evacuation completion times calculated on the basis of the first information and the second information for each disaster occurrence place and for each candidate of the two or more evacuation route groups, and fourth information about at least the place of disaster.

title_en: Disaster response system through drainage channels monitoring
title_ko: 배수로 감시를 통한 재난 대응 시스템
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 배수로 감시를 통한 재난 대응 시스템에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 지역의 각 배수로에 설치되며, 각 배수로의 수위 및 유속 등을 실시간으로 감시하고, 감시 데이터를 취합하여 재난 발생에 선제하여 도로 통제나 주민 대피 등의 대응을 할 수 있도록 하는 배수로 감시를 통한 재난 대응 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명은 적어도 하나의 프로그램이 저장되며, 감시대상지역의 지도정보, 현황정보 및 감시대상지역에 설치되는 배수로의 위치, 수위 및 유속을 실시간으로 감시하는 감시부로부터 수신된 배수로정보가 저장되는 메모리와, 상기 감시부와 네트워크를 통해 통신하기 위한 통신모듈과, 상기 적어도 하나의 프로그램을 실행함으로써 상기 배수로정보에 따른 재난대응정보를 제공하는 프로세서를 포함하는 서버를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: AI-based evacuation route guidance fire alarm system, and method thereof
title_ko: Ａｉ 기반의 대피로 경로안내 화재경보시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 AI 기반의 대피로 경로안내 화재경보시스템 및 그 방법에 관한 것으로, 보다 구체적으로는, 4차 산업 및 디지털 산업의 발전으로 개인용 휴대전화를 통한 주변 환경의식이 불명 한점과 이어폰의 성능 발전으로 화재 및 심각성의 문제를 해결하도록 하기 위한 AI 기반의 대피로 경로안내 화재경보시스템 및 그 방법에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Nuclear accident emergency path planning method, medium, equipment and product
abstract_en: The specification discloses a nuclear accident emergency path planning method, medium, equipment and product, and relates to the technical field of nuclear accident emergency management and intelligent decision making. An evacuation decision dataset for a deep learning model is constructed by collecting user data, resource information, environmental meteorological data, environmental radiation data, and map information, and acquiring concentration field prediction data and/or dose field prediction data. And carrying out joint modeling on the radiation diffusion trend, the road space structure and the personnel state by using the model, and outputting probability distribution of candidate evacuation azimuth angles. And finally, carrying out safety evaluation on the evacuation route to determine a final evacuation route. According to the invention, under a complex dynamic environment after nuclear accident occurrence, radiation diffusion prediction information and deep learning decision-making capability are fully utilized, prospective planning and dynamic optimization of a personnel evacuation path are realized, the radiation exposure risk of personnel is effectively reduced, and the safety and reliability of nuclear accident emergency evacuation are improved.

title_en: Flood avoidance path planning method based on population dynamic distribution and flood inundation risk
abstract_en: The invention provides a flood avoidance path planning method based on population dynamic distribution and flood inundation risk, and relates to the technical field of flood control engineering. The method comprises the steps of acquiring position data of a mobile terminal in real time to determine a population gathering area, analyzing population short-time migration rules, determining population migration leading directions, utilizing historical road blocking events and real-time rainfall monitoring data to construct a road flooding evolution network defining a ponding propagation boundary by combining an urban road drainage pipe network structure, identifying path nodes with traffic conflict risks through space topology analysis, determining a node avoidance sequence according to node communication stability characteristics, and adopting an ant colony search model fused with a local path direction guiding mechanism to achieve precise planning of flood avoidance evacuation paths for avoiding road flooding risk areas, so that instantaneity and reliability of population evacuation path planning under flood disaster situations are effectively improved.

title_en: Subway station fire dynamic evacuation path planning method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rail transit and discloses a subway station fire dynamic evacuation path planning method which comprises a fire simulation module, a network topology construction module and a global path planning module, wherein the fire simulation module is used for constructing a fire simulation model of a subway station, acquiring whole station railway scene data and extracting disaster causing factor change data at key evacuation nodes again, the network topology construction module is used for establishing a network topology diagram of 'starting point-key evacuation nodes' according to pedestrian distribution and the key evacuation nodes, and the global path planning module is used for planning key node selection of each crowd by using Dijkstra algorithm based on the network topology diagram. And the grid topology construction module optimizes local path details among the key nodes through a Q-learning algorithm on the basis of global planning. And the path reconstruction module is used for reconstructing the evacuation path in real time in different development stages of the fire scene by combining the available time of the key evacuation nodes. The method can be used for planning a safer evacuation path for escape passengers according to the dynamic evolution condition of the fire scene while relieving the congestion.

title_en: Personnel evacuation path planning method for fire disaster growth period
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of fire safety and emergency management, and discloses a method for planning a personnel evacuation path in a fire disaster growth period, which comprises the steps of collecting physical quantity, personnel distribution, individual characteristics and behavior states of a fire disaster in real time, digitizing a building plan, evacuation channels and barriers, predicting fire spread, temperature and smoke spread based on multidimensional environment and personnel data to generate a dynamic risk map, evaluating individual escape window period and threat level, establishing a behavior model to analyze the popular psychology and potential congestion to generate multidimensional behavior risk parameters, taking the multidimensional behavior risk parameters as a core, adopting an ant colony algorithm to generate a preliminary path, combining VR, lamplight and sound to guide people in real time, executing a safe behavior flow scheme, dynamically shunting, standby paths and abnormal behavior intervention, and simultaneously reflowing personnel behavior and environment feedback data to generate a continuously updated risk model and a self-adaptive guiding strategy. The invention has the advantage of improving the evacuation safety.

title_en: Fire Evacuation System
title_ko: 화재 대피 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재 발생 시 신속하고 안전한 대피를 지원하는 화재 대피 시스템에 관한 것이다. 본 시스템은 화재 감지 센서, 중앙 제어 장치, 대피 경로 안내 장치, 개인 휴대용 대피 장치, 및 IoT 기반 통신 네트워크를 포함한다. 실시간으로 안전한 대피 경로를 계산하고 안내하며, 개인별 맞춤형 대피 지원을 제공한다. 또한 연기 농도 센서와 열화상 카메라를 활용하여 위험 구역을 식별하고, 음성 안내 및 진동 알림 기능을 통해 다양한 상황에서의 대피를 지원한다. 이를 통해 대피 시간을 단축하고 인명 피해를 최소화할 수 있다.

title_en: AI-based Customized Emergency Alert System for the Hearing Impaired
title_ko: 청각장애인을 위한 ai 기반 맞춤형 비상 알림 시스템
abstract_ko: 발명은 청각장애인을 위한 AI 기반 맞춤형 비상 알림 앱에 관한 것이다. 본 발명은 AI 기반 맞춤형 경보, 긴급 구조 요청 자동화, 대피소 및 AED 위치 안내, 다국어 및 수어 지원의 기능을 제공한다. 특히, AI 알고리즘을 활용하여 사용자 개인의 위치, 행동 패턴, 선호도를 학습하고 이를 기반으로 불필요한 알림을 최소화하며, 중요한 경보만 선별적으로 제공한다. 긴급 상황 발생 시, 단일 버튼 조작만으로 구조대에 위치 정보와 상황이 자동으로 전달되어 신속한 구조 요청이 가능하다. 또한, 사용자에게 재난 상황에 맞는 색상, 진동, 플래시 패턴을 통해 직관적인 정보를 제공하여 재난 인지 속도를 높인다. 대피소와 AED 위치 정보는 실시간으로 업데이트되며, 다국어 번역과 수어 영상 지원으로 외국인 및 청각장애인의 접근성을 대폭 향상시킨다. 이러한 기능을 통해 재난 대응에서의 정보 접근성을 높이고, 보다 안전하고 신속한 대처를 가능하게 한다.

title_en: Direction indicating sound system with message
title_ko: 방향지시 메시지전달 음향시스템
abstract_en: An exit path indicating device includes at least a first port for receiving an alarm indication signal. In normal operation of receiving the alarm indication signal, the device outputs verbal and non-verbal sounds indicating the presence of an alarm condition for evacuation of persons in the area. The second port is for disabling non-verbal output. The second port may be coupled to a local sensor that provides an indication of a dangerous or alarm condition on or near the exit or evacuation path. If the sensor indicates that a dangerous or alarming condition exists, the non-verbal output may be disabled while continuing to emit verbal direction indications.

title_en: Luminaires for emergency exit sings control system
title_ko: 피난 유도 방향 표시 기능을 구비한 소방용 유도등 제어시스템
abstract_en: A fire emergency light control system with a guiding direction display function is provided to protect precious lives of people by effectively guiding residents of a building to an exit path of the building. A fire emergency light control system with a guiding direction display function includes a fire emergency light(30) and an automatic fire detection receiver(70). The fire emergency light includes a CPU(Central Processing Unit,80), a voice output circuit, and a direction indication lamp(40), which are embedded therein. The fire emergency light is electrically(10) coupled with the receiver by a signal(20). The automatic fire detection receiver is electrically coupled with conventional sensors(50) and signal generators(60). When fire breaks out in a building, the sensor detects fire, the receiver receives a fire signal from the sensor and locates a fire site, and then the receiver generates alarm and delivers commands to the fire emergency light.

본 발명은 건축물 화재시 비상 피난을 유도하는 시스템 으로써, 기존에 사용되고 있는 통로 유도등, 피난구 유도등 및 객석 유도등에 소방용 자동화재탐지설비 주수신반(보조수신반 및 로컬 수신반 등)으로부터 피난 경로 유도 신호를 전달 받아 실행할 수 있는 내부연산장치(CPU)를 형성 시킴으로써, 화재 발생시 소방용 자동화재 탐지설비 주수신반(보조수신반 및 로컬 수신반 등)에 내장되어 있는 컴퓨터 시스템의 자동 연산장치(CPU)에 의해 명령을 전달받아 건물내에 있는 다수의 사람들을 안전하게 대피시킬 수 있는 것을 특징으로 하는 피난 유도 방향 표시 기능을 구비한 소방용 유도등 제어 시스템을 제공함에 있다. 현재의 자동화재 탐지설비 주수신반(보조수신반, 로컬수신반 등)은 고도의 산업이 발전함과 더블어 다양한 기능 및 첨단 감시 시스템을 내장하고 있으며 대부분이 컴퓨터(CPU) 시스템에 의해 제어되고 있다. 또한 보다 세밀하고 안정적으로 건물의 화재 등을 감시하기 위하여 다양한 방법들을 사용하고 있으며 특히 실시간 감시를 위하여 디지털 방식은 물론 시분할 감시 등 아날로그 방식을 통하여 건물의 보안 감시 및 화재를 감시하고 있다. 본 시스템은 이들의 기존 시스템을 활용하여 현재 제어되고 있지않는 소방용 유도등(통로유도등, 피난구유도등, 객석유도등)을 제어함으로써 위험상황 발생시 이들을 유용하게 통제하여 건물내의 사람들을 안전하게 대피시킬 수 있는 피난 유도 방향 표시 기능을 구비한 소방용 유도등 제어 시스템을 제공하고자 한다. 본 시스템은 자동화재 탐지설비 주수신반(보조수신반 및 로컬 수신반 등)의 주컴퓨터(CPU)에  연결되어 있는 각 구역의 감지기들의 상황을 수시로 파악하여 화재 발생시 화재 발생 지역의 감지기 위치를 인지하여 내부연산 프로그램에 의해 최적의 피난 통로를 기존의 소방용 통로유도등(피난구유도등, 객석유도등)을 통하여 유도하게 되는 특징을 갖게 된다. 현재의 자동화재 탐지설비 주수신반(보조수신반, 로컬수신반 등)들은 상기의 감지기 위치를 어드레스(ADDRESS) 별로 관리 및 감시를 하고 있으며 화재시 화재신호 발령 및 초기 소화 장치들을 제어하고 있다. 본 시스템은 이에 추가적 으로 자동화재 탐지설비 주수신기(보조수신반, 로컬수신반 등)가 소방용 통로 유도등(피난구유도등, 객석유도등)을 제어할 수 있도록 통로유도등(피난구유도등, 객석유도등 )에 자동화재 탐지설비 주수신반(보조수신반, 로컬수신반 등)으로 부터의 명령 및 제어를 수행할 수 있도록 내부연산장치(CPU)를 형성 시킴으로써 전체적인 피난 유도 방향 표시 기능을 구비한 소방용 유도등 제어 시스템이 완성되게 된다. 상기의 통로 유도등(피난구유도등, 객석유도등)의 내부연산장치(CPU)는 간단한 논리적 회로인 OR 게이트의 단순한 구현으로 그 실행이 가능하다. 즉 기존의 소방용 유도등(통로유도등, 피난구유도등, 객석유도등)은 기존의 유도등 기능을 유지 하면서 유사시에 방향 표시 기능을 추가할 수 있는 시스템에 관한 것이다. 또한 상기 소방용 유도등은 화재로 인하여 자동화재 탐지설비 주수신반(보조수신반, 로컬수신반 등)과의 신호선이 단선될 경우에는 자동백업(back up) 기능에 의하여 피난 유도 방향 표시를 하지 않고 기존의 소방용 유도등의 기능만을 수행하게 된다. 또한 시각 장애인을 위하여 소방용 자동화재 탐지설비 주수신반(보조수신반, 로컬수신반 등)으로 부터 전달된 연산 신호를 소방용 유도등에 형성되어 있는 내부 연산 장치(CPU)에 의하여 실행되는 방향 표시는 물론 해당 방향으로 유도할 수 있는 음성 신호를 출력할 수 있는 기능도 내장하게 된다. 이는 해당 방향으로의 신호 접점을 유지 시켜줌 으로써 내부 연산장치(CPU)에 내장되어 있는 해당 음성 신호를 일측에 형성된 스피커를 통하여 출력할 수 있게 된다. 
       
     통로 유도등(피난구유도등,객석유도등), 연상장치(CPU), 어드레스(ADDRESS), 자동화재 탐지설비, 주수신반(보조수신반, 로컬수신반), R형 수신반, 접점, 피난계획, 규정중심, 성능위주, 피난경로, 피난동선, 페닉(PANIC), 추종본능, 회귀본능

title_en: Evacuation assistance device for elevator
title_ko: 엘리베이터의 피난 지원 장치
abstract_en: In a building, a service zone including a plurality of floors is set. The building is provided with an elevator that is assigned to the floors in the service zone as service floors. In an event of a fire in the building, an evacuation support apparatus for the elevator controls the operation of the elevator to convey those stranded in the building to an evacuation floor. The evacuation support apparatus has an emergency control device and an evacuation guidance device. The emergency control device has a rescue floor setting portion for setting at least a predetermined one of the service floors as a rescue floor, and an evacuation operation command portion for controlling the elevator such that evacuation operation is performed to vertically reciprocate a car between the rescue floor and the evacuation floor. The evacuation guidance device is installed in the building to impart to those stranded in the building evacuation information including information for specifying the rescue floor, based on information from the emergency control device.
abstract_ko: 건물에는 복수의 층을 포함하는 서비스 존이 설정되어 있다. 또, 건물에는 서비스 존내의 각 층을 서비스 층으로 하는 엘리베이터가 마련되어 있다. 엘리베이터의 피난 지원 장치는 건물에 화재가 발생했을 때에, 건물 내에 남겨진 재관자를 피난층에 운반하도록 엘리베이터의 운전을 관리한다. 피난 지원 장치는 피난시 관리 장치 및 피난 유도 장치를 갖고 있다. 피난시 관리 장치는 서비스 존에 대하여 소정의 서비스 층을 구출층으로서 설정하는 구출층 설정부와, 구출층과 피난층 사이에서 엘리베이터 칸을 왕복 이동시키는 피난 운전을 행하도록 엘리베이터를 제어하는 피난 운전 지령부를 갖고 있다. 피난 유도 장치는 건물내에 설치되고, 피난시 관리 장치로부터의 정보에 기초하여, 구출층을 특정하기 위한 정보를 포함하는 피난 정보를 재관자에게 알린다.

title_en: Evacuation assistance device for elevator
title_ko: 엘리베이터의 피난 지원 장치
abstract_en: An elevator and an evacuation stairway are provided in a building. Each floor is segmented into an elevator region where the elevator is provided and a stairway region where the evacuation stairway is provided. When a fire occurs in the building, an evacuation assistance device for the elevator manages elevator operation such that persons in the building are transported from a rescue floor to an evacuation floor with a predetermined service floor defined as the rescue floor. At the rescue floor, a rescue floor congestion detection device detects whether there is congestion in the elevator region. An evacuation guidance device is placed in the building and the device issues to the persons in the building a piece of information on whether they can enter the elevator region of the rescue floor from the stairway region. The information from the rescue floor congestion detection device is transmitted to an evacuation management device. The evacuation management device has a section for determining whether transportation from the rescue floor to the evacuation floor can be made and a section for controlling the evacuation guidance device.
abstract_ko: 건물에는 엘리베이터와 피난 계단이 마련되어 있다. 각 층은 엘리베이터가 마련된 엘리베이터 영역과, 피난 계단이 마련된 계단 영역오로 구분되어 있다. 엘리베이터의 피난 지원 장치는 건물에 화재가 발생했을 때에, 소정의 서비스층을 구출층으로 하고, 재관자를 구출층으로부터 피난층으로 운반하도록 엘리베이터 운전을 관리한다. 구출층에서는 엘리베이터 영역의 혼잡 유무가 구출층 혼잡 검출 장치에 의해 검출된다. 건물내에는 계단 영역으로부터 구출층의 엘리베이터 영역으로 재관자의 진입 가부를 나타내는 진입 가부 정보를 재관자에게 알리는 피난 유도 장치가 마련되어 있다. 구출층 혼잡 검출 장치로부터의 정보는 피난시 관리 장치에 전송된다. 피난시 관리 장치는 구출층으로부터 피난층으로의 운반 가부를 판정하는 피난 운전 가부 판정부와, 피난 운전 가부 판정부 및 구출층 혼잡 검출 장치 각각으로부터의 정보에 기초하여, 피난 유도 장치를 제어하는 피난 유도 장치 제어부를 갖고 있다.

title_en: Vehicle adapted to evacuation life
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To allow an elderly or an infant who needs nursing care or a physically-disabled person or its family to lead an evacuation life feeling relieved without worrying about surroundings by connecting a vehicle for use in evacuation to a bed when a disaster strikes.  <P>SOLUTION: The vehicle adapted to an evacuation life comprises: a hatchback type vehicle 1 in which a cargo fixing frame 14 is mounted on a rooftop 11; a bed 2 connected to the backside of the vehicle; and a tent 3 for covering the bed 2 after being connected. The bed 2 is formed in a folded form so as to be loaded on the rooftop 11. The vehicle 1 and the bed 2 are connected by using a connecting frame 15 mounted on the backside of the vehicle and a locking plate 22 mounted on the front side of the bed so that a floor 13 of the vehicle 1 and a mat body 29 of the bed 2 may be flush with each other.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2007,JPO&INPIT

title_en: The raised block combined with induce lamp for evacuation
title_ko: 피난 유도등 겸용 점자블록
abstract_en: A light-embedded raised block for the blind is provided to help the blind to evacuate in an emergency by storing lighting and supplying lighting for a long time in case of an emergency. A light-embedded raised block for the blind comprises a raised block(10) made of a transparent panel or a semitransparent panel, where a protrusion unit(11) is formed on an upper surface and a groove(12) are formed on a lower surface, and an emergency device including a plurality of LEDs(13), a solar battery plate(14), a sensor, a circuit plate(17) on which a microchip(15) is installed and a battery(18).

title_en: Apparatus for guiding into emergency exit without man and control method therefor
title_ko: 비상구 무인유도 장치
abstract_en: An unmanned guide device for an emergency exit is provided to switch on and off a high-brightness lamp installed at an emergency guide lamp and concentrate the light to guide the emergency exit effectively. An unmanned guide device for an emergency exit connected to a fire alarm system(20) detecting a fire and outputting alarm sound is composed of an interface unit(30) receiving an emergency sensing signal transmitted from the fire alarm system; a memory(200) storing voice guidance data about the emergency state and the emergency exit; an auditory guiding unit(300), converting voice guidance data about the emergency state and the emergency exit stored in the memory, into a voice signal if the emergency sensing signal is transmitted through the interface unit and then outputting the voice signal; a visual guiding unit(400) turning on and off a lamp(410) if the emergency sensing signal is transmitted through the interface unit; a control unit(100) detecting data in the memory by receiving the emergency sensing signal transmitted through the interface unit, transmitting the data to the auditory guiding unit, transmitting a control signal for switching on and off the lamp to the visual guiding unit, and carrying out operations for driving each component; and a power supply unit(500) having an emergency power unit charged with power supplied from a power source to supply the charged power to the visual and auditory guiding units.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 비상구 무인유도 장치 및 제어방법에 관한 것으로서, 시각장애인이나 시력이 좋지 못한 대상에게 비상사태 및 비상구를 음성으로 안내하고, 비상구를 안내하는 유도등의 램프 식별을 더욱 용이하게 하는 것을 목적으로 한다. 
     상기 목적을 달성하기 위하여 본 발명은, 유선 또는 무선으로 연결된 화재경보시스템으로부터 비상감지신호를 전송받아 그에 대응되는 신호를 출력하여 각 구성요소를 작동시키는 제어부와, 비상사태 및 비상구 음성안내 데이터가 사전 저장된 메모리와, 메모리에 사전 저장된 비상사태 및 비상구 안내 데이터를 음성신호로 변환출력하여 비상사태 발생시 시각장애인들의 대피를 돕는 청각유도수단과, 램프에서 발산되는 빛을 점멸 및 집광시킴으로써 램프 식별을 더욱 용이하게 하기 위한 시각유도수단, 및 평상시에 상용전원으로부터 전원을 공급받아 비상용 전원으로 충전하였다가, 비상사태 발생시 전원을 공급하여 청각유도수단 및 시각유도수단을 포함한 각 구성요소를 정상작동시키기 위한 비상전원부를 포함하는 전원공급수단으로 이루어진다. 
       
     음성안내, 청각유도수단, 비상전원부, 무인유도

title_en: Evacuation device adapted to wheelchair
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To solve issues that conventional evacuation tools and devices require a plurality of pieces of care taking for evacuation and are physically hard to use for a wheelchair user in a disaster.  <P>SOLUTION: An evacuee rides in a basket while riding on a wheelchair and the basket descends in a suitable speed. Thus the evacuee can be safely evacuated.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Evacuation assistance device for elevator
title_ko: 엘리베이터의 피난 지원 장치
abstract_en: In an emergency, an evacuation assistance device for an elevator serving multiple floors manages operation of the elevator to thereby allow people left in a building to evacuate to an evacuation floor. Also, the evacuation assistance device has an evacuation-operation execution section, an evacuation-operation-time calculation section, and an evacuation-operation determination section. The evacuation-operation execution section sets at least some of the multiple served floors as the evacuation floor and causes the elevator to perform evacuation operation for carrying the people left in the building from rescue floors to the evacuation floor. Upon receiving emergency degree information indicating the degree of emergency, the evacuation-operation-time calculation section calculates, based on the information, an estimated time period in which the evacuation operation continues. The emergency-operation determination section determines, based on the information from the evacuation-operation-time calculation section, whether the evacuation operation is to be continued. The evacuation-operation execution section controls the evacuation operation based on the information from the emergency-operation determination section.
abstract_ko: 엘리베이터의 피난 지원 장치는 복수의 층을 서비스층으로 하는 엘리베이터의 운전을 긴급시에 관리하는 것에 의해, 건물내에 남겨진 재관자를 피난층에 피난시킨다. 또, 엘리베이터의 피난 지원 장치는 피난 운전 실시부, 피난 운전 시간 산출부 및 피난 운전 판정부를 갖고 있다. 피난 운전 실시부는 각 서비스층의 적어도 어느 하나를 구출층으로 설정하고, 재관자를 구출층으로부터 피난층으로 운반하기 위한 피난 운전을 엘리베이터에 대해 실시한다. 피난 운전 시간 산출부는 긴급의 정도를 나타내는 긴급도 정보를 받는 동시에, 긴급도 정보에 기초하여 피난 운전을 계속할 예정 시간을 피난 운전 시간으로서 산출한다. 피난 운전 판정부는 피난 운전 시간 산출부로부터의 정보에 기초하여 피난 운전의 계속 여부를 판정한다. 피난 운전 실시부는 피난 운전 판정부로부터의 정보에 기초하여 피난 운전을 제어한다.

title_en: Assembly base and dropping mouth
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an emergency public toilet which enables a disaster victim to quickly assemble it and start using it, has a function also helpful for local people in normal times, is excellently durable, and has devices that allow a large number of disaster victims including the disabled to use safely and hygienically when a serious disaster happens in an evacuation area or nearer there when the serious disaster causing great damage to supply of water and electricity and transportation happens.  <P>SOLUTION: In normal times, the toilet functions as an artful stone mosaic flower pot or a bench, whereas when a disaster happens, it can be assembled into a toilet. Since it is made of stone, it is durable for decades' use and can store all toilet assembly equipment in a lower layer inner part of the flower pot or a storage space below a top panel of the bench in an excellent state. In an emergency, an existing manhole is used as a toilet tank, the equipment taken out of the storage space is instantly assembled above it, and used as a toilet.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

title_en: The portable lighting apparatus
title_ko: 휴대 조명장치
abstract_en: A portable lighting apparatus is provided to guide safe driving of a disabled car by being mounted on a surface of the disabled car to secure a driver's visual field. A portable lighting apparatus includes a lighting unit(100) and a support(200). The lighting unit selectively turns on an LED(Light Emitting Diode) lamp, an induction lamp, and a flashlight of a light emitting unit(130) by using power charged in a battery according to control of a switch. The support is composed of a support member(210) to receive and support the lighting unit, a charging terminal(220) protruded inside the support member to ground the battery, and a position indicating lamp(230) installed at one side of the support member.

title_en: Evacuation system which uses the strobe light and an alarm sound
title_ko: 시청각 복합형 피난유도 시스템
abstract_en: An evacuation guiding system is provided to enable users to quickly evacuate a dangerous situation by guiding the users to escape using both visual and audio signals. An evacuation guiding system includes a driving body(15), which includes a controller and a power supply and is implemented on an implementation surface. The driving body includes a semi-transparent or transparent light emitting surface(151), on which a guiding lamp(22) is arranged. The light from the guiding lamp is emitted to outside. One side of the light emitting surface is coupled with the driving body. A visual alarm lamp(32) and an alarm speaker(42) are installed on the other side of the light emitting surface.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 피난유도 시스템에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 피난을 유도하기 위한 유도램프(22)가 제어부(10)의 제어에 의하여 유도용 빛이 발광되도록 구비되어지되, 상기 제어부(10)에서 시각경보제어부(31) 및 음향경보제어부(41)가 작동하도록 구비함에, 상기 시각경보제어부(31)는 상기 제어부(10)로부터 시각경보램프(32)의 점등 제어신호를 수신받아 시각경보램프(32)를 점등되도록 하며, 상기 음향경보제어부(41)는 상기 제어부(10)로부터 음향경보 제어신호를 수신받아 음향경보용 음향신호가 경보스피커(42)에서 발신되도록 구비되어, 밝은 빛을 보고 안내음향을 들으면서 피난자들, 특히 청각장애인 및 시각장애인들이 용이하게 피난할 수 있도록 하는 시청각 복합형 피난유도 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
       
     피난유도, 램프, 스피커, 시각, 음향

title_en: Caregiver personal alert device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a portable caregiver personal alert device to facilitate the improvement in the delivery of bedside patient care. The device assists caregivers in ensuring time-sensitive tasks are performed within a specific time frame and in a specific sequence to ensure efficiency, compliance with standard of care or regulation and patient comfort. The device of the present invention comprises a display, a microprocessor that monitors various tasks for multiple patients, and at least one user input feature and at least one alarm, capable of alerting a caregiver when it is time to perform the task. The device preferably includes various functions such as a bed assignment mode, a task mode for choosing applicable tasks associated with the needs of one or more bed numbers, and at least one clock for coordinating a plurality of alarms to one or more corresponding bed number and associated task.

title_en: A push and pull door lock body
title_ko: 양방향 푸시풀 도어락 바디
abstract_en: A bidirectional push-pull door lock body including a driving circulation unit is provided to conveniently open a door together with a locking cancel of a mortise by pushing/pulling an operation lever having a bidirectional circulation function. An operation lever(60) is combined with door lock bodies(10a,10b,10c,10d) of an indoor and outdoor side closed by a cover member(15). One side of the door lock body of an indoor and outdoor side is coupled with a hinge. A connection circulation body is circulated into up/down direction by combining in a bottom of the operation lever. A slide member(30) is installed at an inner side of the door lock body, has a to-and-fro motion corresponding to the connection circulation. A driving circulation unit operates a driving part within a mortise for a locking cancel of the mortise. The driving circulation unit is installed at the inner side of the door lock body, and is connected to the mortise for a locking unit.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 도어의 측단면에 삽착되는 잠금장치인 모티스와 연결된 상태로 도어의 내,외측에 설치 고정되어 도어의 열림방향 및 이와 관련되어 도어 오픈을 위한 도어락 바디의 내부장치 변경이나 별도의 설정없이 푸시(Push) 및 당김(Pull)의 양방향 회동이 가능하게 설치된 도어락 바디의 작동레버를 밀거나 당겨서 모티스의 락킹 해제를 이루는 양방향 푸시풀 도어락 바디에 관한 것이다. 
     이러한 본 발명의 양방향 푸시풀 도어락 바디는, 커버부재에 의해 밀폐된 실내측 및 실외측 도어락 바디와 결합되며, 힌지 결합된 상단을 지점으로 하단의 푸시(Push)와 당김(Pull) 작용이 병용되도록 이루어진 혼용적 구조의 작동레버와; 상기 실내외측 도어락 바디의 일측에 각각 힌지 결합되며, 작동레버의 하단과 결합되어 상기 작동레버 작동 시 상,하로 회동되는 연결회동체와; 상기 연결회동체의 일측에 결합된 상태로 실내외측 도어락 바디의 내측에 설치되며, 연결회동체와 대응되어 직선왕복운동을 하는 슬라이드부재와; 상기 슬라이드부재의 일측과 연결된 상태로 실외측 도어락 바디의 내측에 설치됨과 동시에 상기 실내외측 도어락 바디 사이에 설치된 잠금장치용 모티스와 연결되며, 슬라이드부재와 대응되어 회동하면서 상기 모티스의 락킹 해제를 위해 모티스 내의 구동부를 작동시키는 구동회동체를 포함하여 구성된 것을 특징으로 한다. 
     따라서 본 발명에 의하면, 랫치부재의 슬라이드 작용에 한정된 모티스와 더불어 별도의 장금장치를 구비하면서 작동레버가 각기 일방향으로만 회동되는 종래 의 도어락 바디에 비해 도어의 열림방향 및 이와 관련되어 도어 오픈을 위한 도어락 바디의 내부장치 변경이나 별도의 설정없이 혼용적 구조로서 푸시(Push) 및 당김(Pull)의 양방향 회동이 가능하게 설치된 작동레버를 밀거나 당겨서 모티스의 락킹 해제와 함께 간편하게 도어를 오픈시킬 수 있으며, 특히 노약자나 몸이 불편한 장애인 또는 화재 등 긴급 비상 시 실내측 사용자의 신체 어느 부위를 이용하더라도 혼용적 구조의 작동레버를 간편하게 작동시킬 수 있기 때문에 이에 대한 락킹된 도어의 오픈시간 및 실내측 사용자의 대피시간을 크게 단축시킬 수 있는 등의 탁월한 효과가 있다. 
       
     양방향 푸시풀 도어락, 도어락 바디, 작동레버, 푸시(Push) 및 당김(Pull) 병용, 연결회동체, 슬라이드부재, 구동회동체, 연결핀, 모티스, 해정키

title_en: Channel type live-saving equipment for quickly falling from building
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a high building lifesaving device, in particular to a fast high building lifesaving device, i.e., a passage type high building fast-falling lifesaving device which adopts the technique scheme that a passage type high building fast-falling lifesaving device is arranged on an extended body, and structurally comprises a tube-shaped passage, wherein a passage inflatable ring is arranged at the top of the tube-shaped passage in which a buffering inflatable body is arranged. A floor buffering inflatable cushion is arranged at the bottom of the tube-shaped passage. A landing device matched with the tube-shaped passage in diameter after being unfolded is provided. The device is pre-installed at an evacuation passage of a high building and can be equipped and maintained by the fire department or professionals. In case of fire, earthquake or other emergencies in the high building, firemen or professionals arrive at the spot, and the device is opened for use. The high building lifesaving device is not restricted by the height of the high building, and people can safely fall down in the descending passage to escape. The utility model has the advantages of reasonable design and low cost, and is suitable for popularization and can be used by various people, such as the old, the young, the sick and the disabled.

title_en: Threat based adaptable network and physical security system
abstract_en: A security system (200) for a network, including a security system interface (220) configured to respond to a received threat level, and a computing module (230) configured to determine whether the received threat level exceeds a threshold value (560) assigned to the network, wherein the network is modified (570) upon a determination that the threat level exceeds the threshold value. Further including a similar threat based modification security system (200) for monitoring communication and physical facilities. Where a threat level (222) is compared (460) against assigned threshold values to determine if physical security devices should be activated or communications systems disabled (470).

title_en: Container for hospitalization or the like and correspondence system for the time of emergency using the container
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a container for hospitalization by which a blood type, a medical history or the like can be presented to a person involved in medical treatment such as a doctor, or individual information such a name can be presented to a firefighter or the like, and which is useful for the preparation of appurtenances required for hospitalization and the evacuation in the case of disaster, and to provide a correspondence system for the time of emergency.  <P>SOLUTION: The container for the hospitalization or the like comprises the container 1 for the hospitalization for sectioning and storing various kinds of equipment such as livingware needed by elderly people or people with a chronic disease when getting hospitalized or needed by people when a natural disaster occurs, and a display card provided on the container 1 for entering items required for treatment such as the medical history and the blood type or individual information such as a name, an address and a contact. By always keeping the display card 7 which is provided on the conspicuous position of the container 1 and on which the items required for treatment such as the medical history and the blood type or the individual information such as a name, an address and a contact is entered, and reporting the condition of the person always keeping the container 1 for the hospitalization or the like to a fire department or the like and executing central management, correspondence is performed for the time of emergency hospitalization and for the time of the natural disaster.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Make flicker display or multi-flicker display and a short sound of function a fire detector
title_ko: 화재감지기 작동시의 점멸등 또는 다수 점멸등 및 단음부착형 화재감지기
abstract_en: A make flicker display or a multi-flicker display and a short sound of a function in a fire detector is provided to allow a user to put out a fire in rapidly by informing a fire through a sound and a visual display. In a make flicker display or a multi-flicker display and a short sound of a function in a fire detector, a fire detector(70) senses smoke and heat when a fire out breaks. A lighting light emitting diode is displayed when a gate signal turned on. A current is flowed between the anode and the cathode of a thyristor(60) when the gate signal is turned on, and a relay(10), a sensor circuit terminal, and a relay are interlinked with each other.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 화재감지기 작동시의 점멸등 또는 다수 점멸등 및 단음 부착형 화재감지기에 관한 것으로서, 이를 위하여 본 발명은 화재감지부(70)와, 화재감지기 시험스위치(7)와, 사이리스터(60)의 게이트(G) 회로와, 사이리스터(60)의 애노드(A)및 캐소드(K)간의 회로와, 점등 발광다이오드(6)와, 다이오드브릿지(30)회로와, 릴레이(10)와, 감지기 회로선(3, 4)의 단자로서 이루어지는 자동화재탐지설비의 화재감지기 작동시 점등되는 점등 부착형 화재감지기에 있어서, 상기 화재감지부(70)와 화재감지기 시험스위치(7)와 사이리스터(60)와 점등 발광다이오드(6)와 다이오드브릿지(30)와 릴레이(10)의 전방과 후방에 구비되는 점멸등(300) 또는 다수 점멸등 순차점멸등(400) 및 단음외 음성소자(500) 등과; 상기 화재감지기(5)의 외부 겉면 등에 구비되는 점멸등(300) 또는 다수 점멸등 순차점멸등(400) 및 단음외 음성소자(500) 등을 포함하는 구성에 의해 각 구역의 화재감지기 가운데 작동된 화재감지기를 현장에서 조기발견해야 하고 신속하게 화재여부를 탐색해야 하는 방재요원의 업무가 향상됨은 물론 작동된 화재감지기의 현장주변에서 활동하고 있을 수 있는 일반인 또는 노약자 및 장애인도 현장에서 바로 알수 있도록 되어 화재의 조기발견이 가능하고 바로 진화 및 대피가 가능하도록 되므로서 귀중한 인명과 재산의 손실을 방지되도록 하는데 특징이 있다. 
       
     화재감지기, 발광다이오드, 점등, 점멸등, 다수 점멸등 순차점멸등, 단음외 음성소자

title_en: Light emitting block using piezoelectric ceramics
title_ko: 압전세라믹을 이용한 발광블럭
abstract_en: A radiation block using the electrostrictive ceramics is provided to quickly make people induce to a safe shelter by lighting a luminous unit in an emergency. A radiation block using the electrostrictive ceramics comprises a lower part main body(10), an electrostrictive ceramics unit(20), a rechargeable battery(30), a luminous unit(40) and a controller(50). The radiation block includes a top main body(60), a pressure projection board(70) and a tempered glass member(80). The top of the lower part main body is open. A space unit(11) is formed in the inside. A combining projection(12) is equipped on the floor side of the lower part main body. The rechargeable battery is electrically connected to the electrostrictive ceramics unit. The luminous unit is electrically connected to the rechargeable battery and installed inside the space unit. The controller is installed inside the space unit, and electrically connected to the rechargeable battery and the luminous unit. The controller controls the flash of the luminous unit. A penetration slit(61) is formed at one side of upper surface of the top main body. A display(62) is formed at the other side of upper surface of the top main body.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 햇빛이 들지 않는 실내에 설치되되 다수의 압전세라믹을 구비하여 오고가는 행인이 가압함에 따라 전기에너지를 발생하여 충전시킨 후, 화재 또는 정전 등 비상 상황 시에 충전된 전기에너지를 통해 비상구의 위치를 파악할 수 있는 발광유닛을 점등시켜 안전하고 신속한 대피를 유도할 수 있으며, 돌출 형성되는 가압돌기판을 통해 장애인의 안전한 보행을 유도할 수 있는 한 압전세라믹을 이용한 발광블럭에 관한 것이다. 
     본 발명의 바람직한 일 실시예에 따른 압전세라믹을 이용한 발광블럭은 상부가 개방되고 내부에 공간부가 형성되며 바닥면에 결합돌기가 구비되는 하부본체와, 상기 결합돌기 내에 설치되는 압전세라믹유닛과, 상기 공간부 내에 설치되고 상기 압전세라믹유닛과 전기적으로 연결되는 충전지와, 상기 충전지와 전기적으로 연결되어 상기 공간부 내에 점멸가능하게 설치되는 발광유닛과, 상기 공간부 내에 설치되고 상기 충전지 및 발광유닛과 전기적으로 연결되며 상기 발광유닛의 점멸을 제어하는 제어부와, 상기 하부본체의 상측에 결합되되, 상부면의 일측에는 상기 압전세라믹유닛이 돌출 위치되도록 관통슬릿이 형성되고, 타측에는 상기 발광유닛으로부터 발산되는 빛이 외부로 노출되도록 표시창이 관통 형성되는 상부본체와, 상기 관통슬릿에 기밀적으로 결합되고, 그 하부면이 상기 압전세라믹유닛의 상부면과 면접하게 배치되는 가압돌기판과, 상기 표시창에 기밀적으로 결합되는 강화유리부재를 포함하여 이루어지는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
       
     압전세라믹, 발광블럭, 상부본체, 하부본체, 충전지, 발광유닛, 제어부, 가압돌기판, 강화유리부재

title_en: Character display function speaker
title_ko: 청각장애인을 위한 문자정보 표시기능이 내장된 음성출력스피커
abstract_en: A character display function speaker for an auditory disabled person is provided to easily inform an auditory disabled person of a current situation by using voice and character broadcasting. A voice output speaker displaying character information for an auditory disabled person comprises rack broadcasting equipment(100). The rack broadcasting equipment comprises a character information generator(55) generating a character according to a kind of broadcasting. The broadcasting information generated by the character information generator is loaded to a sound source outputted from a sound source amplifier in an FSK(Frequency Shift Keying) mode. The sound source of the sound source amplifier including broadcast information of the character information generator is outputted to a character display speaker(110). The character display speaker outputs the character information to a character display panel(113). The character display speaker outputs voice to a speaker(114). The character display panel displays a green lamp(112) during a normal broadcast and a red lamp(111) during an emergency broadcast.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 청각장애인이 거주하는 건물 내에 화재와 같은 비상 재난상황이 발생하면, 신속히 청각장애인이 인식할 수 있도록 비상등과 문자정보로 비상상황을 전달하는 스피커 장치에 관한 것이다. 
     본 발명에 따르면, 일반방송이나 화재와 같은 비상상황이 감지되면 시설 내에 설치되어 있는 방송 스피커를 통하여 대피방송과 더불어 스피커에 내장된 문자표시창을 통하여 지금 방송이 일반방송인지, 비상방송인지를 구분하여 문자 표시와 비상등을 통하여 청각장애인이 그 상황을 파악하기 용이하게 하여, 화재시 얼마든지 발생할 수 있는 대형 참사를 사전에 예방할 수 있게 된다. 
       
     문자정보 스피커, 청각장애인용 문자정보 스피커, 비상방송 문자 서비스

title_en: Escape rope for disaster
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an escape rope for a disaster, enabling two or more evacuees including small children, elderly people and the sick to be quickly and smoothly evacuated in the case of a fire at the second or higher floor of a building.  <P>SOLUTION: Axilla belts are provided at both ends of a rope, respectively, through a speed governor, whereby when an evacuee descends using one rope, the other rope is wound up so that the ropes are alternately moved up and down to enable two or more evacuees to quickly descend and be evacuated.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT

title_en: High-rise escape sliding plate
abstract_en: The effective rescue and emergent escape for high-rise fire become social problems highly concerned by people, main innovation contents of the invention are to fully concern the optimal matching problem of high-rise fire-fighting equipment and reform a high-rise rubbish pipeline into a multifunctional emergent escape and rescue passage which consists of a vertical well mouth passage and enter gateways of various floors in the whole shape; and main members of the multifunctional emergent escape and rescue passage consist of a two-layer sliding plate, a spiral sliding rail well wall and two multifunctional vertical bars. The invention has the advantages that: (1) with multiple functions, the invention is used as a common rubbish pipe at normal times and not idle to waste; (2) with the simple structure and low cost, the invention can be applied to industrial production; (3) with absolute safety, the invention is suitable for self rescue of old, weak, sick and disabled groups; (4) the invention does not need operation technology and is suitable for cowards; (5) the height of the floor is not limited; (6) the invention is free from being reduced to the bottom once from high floors and can be changed in the midway for evacuation; (7) the operation is quite simple, so the push and placement of one person can be finished in 10 seconds, and the volume is large, so more than 200 persons on one floor can be evacuated in several minutes; (8) the service life is long and the overhaul and the maintaining are not needed; and (9) the invention is easy to be harmonious with the building design, has attractive appearance and is easy to be hidden.

title_en: Evacuation assistance system
title_ko: 피난 지원 시스템
abstract_en:
Provided is an evacuation supporting system which can provide elevators in a building as evacuation means in the event of a fire and can substantially reduce the burden required by the rescue at the site of the fire by providing, before the arrival of firemen at the building, the firemen with information on the evacuation condition of the weak and the condition of evacuation of those who are present in the building carried out by use of the elevators. 
     For this purpose, in an ancillary room within the building, there is installed an evacuation detection device which is used by disaster preventing staff in a disaster prevention center within the building to check for persons who have escaped into the ancillary room. When a fire has been detected by a fire detector, the elevators in the building are provided as evacuation means for those who are present in the building, and the input status of the evacuation detection device and the evacuation operation condition of the elevator are transmitted to an external computer environment.
abstract_ko:
화재 발생시에 빌딩 내의 엘리베이터를 피난 수단으로서 제공할 수 있음과 아울러 소방원이 그 빌딩에 도착하기 전에, 약자의 피난 상황이나 엘리베이터를 이용한 재관자의 피난 상황을 소방원에게 제공하여, 화재 발생 현장에서의 구출에 요구되는 부담을 큰 폭으로 경감시킬 수 있는 피난 지원 시스템을 제공한다.  
이를 위해, 빌딩 내의 부속실에, 빌딩 내의 방재 센터에 있는 방재원이 부속실에 피난한 사람을 확인하기 위한 피난 검출 장치를 설치한다. 그리고, 화재 감지기에 의해 화재가 감지된 경우에, 빌딩 내의 엘리베이터를 재관자의 피난용으로서 제공하고, 또한, 피난 검출 장치의 입력 상황과 엘리베이터의 피난 운전 상황을 외부의 계산기 환경에 대해서 송신한다.

title_ko: 피난 유도등 겸용 점자블록

title_en: Apparatus for guiding into emergency exit without man
title_ko: 비상구 무인유도 장치
abstract_ko:
본 고안은 비상구 무인유도 장치에 관한 것으로서, 시각장애인이나 시력이 좋지 못한 대상에게 비상사태 및 비상구를 음성으로 안내하고, 비상구를 안내하는 유도등의 램프 식별을 더욱 용이하게 하는 것을 목적으로 한다. 
     상기 목적을 달성하기 위한 본 고안은, 유선 또는 무선으로 연결된 화재경보시스템으로부터 비상감지신호를 전송받아 그에 대응되는 신호를 출력하여 각 구성요소를 작동시키는 제어부와, 비상사태 및 비상구 음성안내 데이터가 사전 저장된 메모리와, 메모리에 사전 저장된 비상사태 및 비상구 안내 데이터를 음성신호로 변환출력하여 비상사태 발생시 시각장애인들의 대피를 돕는 청각유도수단과, 램프에서 발산되는 빛을 점멸 및 집광시킴으로써 램프 식별을 더욱 용이하게 하기 위한 시각유도수단, 및 평상시에 상용전원으로부터 전원을 공급받아 비상용 전원으로 충전하였다가, 비상사태 발생시 전원을 공급하여 청각유도수단 및 시각유도수단을 포함한 각 구성요소를 정상작동시키기 위한 비상전원부를 포함하는 전원공급수단으로 이루어진다. 
       
     음성안내, 청각유도수단, 비상전원부, 무인유도

title_en: A fire escape for an emergency staircase
title_ko: 비상계단용 화재 대피장치
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A fire escape apparatus for emergency staircase is provided to enable the elderly, pregnant, and disabled persons to move to a safe place by installing a cart in the emergency staircase and to discharge poisonous gas using an induction damper installed at each stair. CONSTITUTION: A fire escape apparatus for emergency staircase comprises: a rack gear which is included on the upper side of the banister of the staircase and interlinks up and down stairs of the emergency staircase; a pinion gear which is installed on a shield case(230) and in which a flange is formed in both sides; a driving gear which is combined to the pinion gear and is installed inside the shield case; a driven gear; a braking device which is combined with the shaft of the driven gear; a separable a seat back which is separable from a seat board(203) and a foot rest(205); a safety belt which is connected to a loop and a hook; and a cart(200) including a supporting roller which is settled on a guide rail(340).
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 비상계단용 화재 대피장치에 관한 것으로, 각층에 구성된 비상구와 연결된 비상계단실에 있어서, 상기 비상계단실에 급배기장치를 가지고, 상기 비상계단실의 윗층 계단과 아랫층 계단을 연결하는 계단난간의 상부면에 형성된 랙기어와, 상기 랙기어와 치합되도록 보호케이스에 축으로 설치되고, 양측면에 플랜지가 형성된 피니언기어와, 상기 피니언기어와 축으로 결합되어 보호케이스 내부에 설치되는 구동기어와, 상기 구동기어와 치합되어 구동기어 직하부에 설치되는 종동기어와, 상기 종동기어의 축과 결합되어 보호케이스 내부에 설치되는 브레이크장치와, 상기 보호케이스의 일측면에 설치된 사각파이프와 경첩으로 설치되어, 대피자들이 탑승하여 좌석에 착석하도록 하는 좌판과, 상기 보호케이스의 일측면에 설치된 사각파이프와 경첩으로 설치되고, 상기 좌판의 위치보다 낮게 설치되어 좌판과 연결봉으로 연결된 발받침대와, 상기 좌판의 후방에 분리가능하도록 설치되는 등받이와, 상기 보호케이스 일측면에는 운행 중 탑승객을 보호하도록 설치되는 안전벨트와, 상기 보호케이스의 계단난간 측 측면에는, 상기 계단난간에 설치되는 가이드레일에 안착되어 구르도록 설치되는 보조롤러가 구비된 카트를 포함하여 구성된다. 
       
     화재, 비상, 카트

title_en: Elevator system
abstract_en: Provided is an elevator system which enables efficient evacuation using an elevator when a fire occurs, and enables the confirmation of the situation of remaining evacuees when the evacuation operation of the elevator is stopped. An evacuation call response sequence setting unit (43) sets the priority sequences for responses to evacuation-only calls registered with an evacuation-only call registration unit (26) on the basis of fire occurrence information received by a fire situation reception unit (22), and selects a response floor on the basis of the priority sequences.
