A computer center control unit is connected to an intelligent system control unit which is respectively connected to a voice unit, an information pointing unit, a warming light unit, a vibrator unit. The intelligent system control unit is constructed by sequentially connecting an RS485 bus receiving module, a microcomputer control module, a switch control module. The information pointing unit is constructed by sequentially connecting a singlechip processing module and a cache module and a display module. The information pointing unit receives a switch control command from the intelligent system control unit, chooses the to-be-displayed information segment which is processed by a singlechip and output by the display module. The invention can full-automatically help the normal life management in the school of deaf-mutes and the school for blind and achieve rapid alarm in emergency thereby avoiding the state that the people can not deal with work-and-rest, calling and emergency alarm in normal life due to deaf mute and blind.

title_en: Alarm apparatus for hearingdefect person
title_ko: 청각장애인용 알림 장치
abstract_ko:
본 고안은 청각장애인용 알림 장치에 관한 것으로서, 특히, 초인종, 팩스, 화재경보 신호 및 보일러 이상유무를 감지하여 각각의 알림신호가 발생되는 신호발생유닛과, 신호발생유닛에서 인식된 알림신호를 송신하는 송신유닛과, 송신유닛에서 송신된 알림신호를 수신하는 수신유닛과, 실내의 청각장애인이 인식하도록 수신된 신호를 표시하는 디스플레이유닛 및, 신호발생유닛, 송신유닛, 수신유닛 및 디스플레이유닛을 제어하기 위한 제어유닛을 포함하고, 디스플레이유닛은 "초인종" 글자를 표시하는 램프가 구비되는 초인종알림표시부와, "팩스" 글자를 표시하는 램프가 구비되는 팩스표시부와, "보일러 이상" 글자를 표시하는 램프가 구비되는 보일러고장표시부 및, "화재경보" 글자를 표시하는 램프가 구비되는 화재경보표시부를 포함하는 구성으로, 실내에 거주하던 청각장애인들이 이들 신호를 신속하게 인지하여 상황에 맞는 대처를 효과적으로 할 수 있는 특징이 있다. 
       
     초인종, 전화, 화재경보, 램프

title_en: Fire Alarm System Using TTS
title_ko: 티티에스를 이용한 화재 경보 시스템
abstract_ko:
본 고안은 TTS를 이용한 화재 경보 시스템에 관한 것이다. 본 고안은, 화재감지 시스템으로부터 화재발생 위치정보를 포함하는 화재발생신호를 수신하는 수신부; 텍스트로 구성되고 편집 가능한 화재방송 시나리오를 적어도 하나 이상 포함하는 시나리오 데이터베이스를 저장하는 저장부; 상기 화재발생 위치정보에 따른 대피경로를 획득하고, 상기 화재발생 위치정보와 상기 획득된 대피경로를 상기 화재발생 시나리오에 반영함으로써 화재방송용 텍스트를 구성하는 화재방송용 텍스트 구성부; TTS 엔진을 이용하여 텍스트를 음성으로 변환하는 음성 변환부; 상기 음성 변환부에서 변환된 음성을 구내 방송 시스템으로 전송하는 제1 전송부; 화재발생 정보를 소방서로 전송하는 제2 전송부; 및 상기 화재감지 시스템으로부터 상기 화재발생신호를 수신한 경우, 상기 시나리오 데이터베이스를 참조하여 상기 수신된 화재발생신호에 포함된 화재발생 위치정보에 부합하는 화재방송 시나리오를 검색하고, 상기 화재방송용 텍스트 구성부를 제어하여 상기 수신된 화재발생신호에 포함된 화재발생 위치정보에 따라 화재방송용 텍스트를 구성하고, 상기 음성 변환부를 제어하여 상기 구성된 화재방송용 텍스트를 음성으로 변환하여 상기 제1 전송부를 통해 상기 구내 방송 시스템으로 전송하고, 상기 제2 전송부를 통해 상기 화재발생 정보를 상기 소방서로 전송하는 제어부를 포함하는 TTS를 이용한 화재 경보 시스템을 제공한다. 
     
     화재 감지, 화재방송 시나리오, 화재방송용 텍스트, TTS, 구내 방송, 화재발생 정보, 다국어

title_en: Fire Alarm System Using TTS
title_ko: Ｔｔｓ를 이용한 화재 경보 시스템
abstract_ko:
본 고안은 TTS를 이용한 화재 경보 시스템에 관한 것이다. 본 고안은, 화재 감지 시스템으로부터 화재발생 위치정보를 포함하는 화재발생신호를 수신하는 수신부; 텍스트로 구성되고 편집 가능한 화재방송 시나리오를 적어도 하나 이상 포함하는 시나리오 데이터베이스를 저장하는 저장부; 상기 화재발생 위치정보에 따른 대피경로를 획득하고, 상기 화재발생 위치정보와 상기 획득된 대피경로를 상기 화재방송 시나리오에 반영함으로써 화재방송용 텍스트를 구성하는 화재방송용 텍스트 구성부; TTS 엔진을 이용하여 텍스트를 음성으로 변환하는 음성 변환부; 상기 음성 변환부에서 변환된 음성을 구내 방송 시스템으로 전송하는 전송부; 및 상기 화재 감지 시스템으로부터 상기 화재발생신호를 수신한 경우, 상기 시나리오 데이터베이스를 참조하여 상기 수신된 화재발생신호에 포함된 화재발생 위치정보에 부합하는 화재방송 시나리오를 검색하고, 상기 화재방송용 텍스트 구성부를 제어하여 상기 수신된 화재발생신호에 포함된 화재발생 위치정보에 따라 화재방송용 텍스트를 구성하고, 상기 음성 변환부를 제어하여 상기 구성된 화재방송용 텍스트를 음성으로 변환하여 상기 전송부를 통해 상기 구내 방송 시스템으로 전송하는 제어부를 포함하는 TTS를 이용한 화재 경보 시스템을 제공한다. 
     
      화재 감지, 화재방송 시나리오, 화재방송용 텍스트, TTS, 구내 방송

title_en: Providing notifications using text-to-speech conversion
abstract_en: Methods and systems for providing electronic notifications are described. A server is configured to serve an interface, such as a Web page, to a terminal that requests from a user a first set of user contacts to be used to provide notifications to the user by a telephonic notification system in response to a notification process initiated by an organization associated with the user. The interface further requests a first set of priorities corresponding to the first set of user contacts, wherein the notification system will attempt to provide notifications to the first set user contracts in an order based at least in part on the first set of priorities. A database is configured to store the first set of user contacts and the first set of priorities. A voice interface circuit is configured to transmit a voice notification to at least one of the first set of user contacts.

title_en: Braille block
title_ko: 지하철 보도용 점자블록
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A raised block for subway sidewalk is provided to use the raised block for the person who is visually handicapped on usual days, and evacuate passengers to a safe place by switching off a light emitting diodes in case of a fire. CONSTITUTION: A raised block for subway sidewalk comprises a raised block(20), a fire alarm, and a control device. The raised block has a fire alarm, a control device, and a plurality of light emitting diodes(242) which display a guide direction. The fire alarm generates a loud bell and lighting in case of a fire. The control device connected with the fire alarm controls the light emitting diodes and characters shape installed in the raised block in case of a fire.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 지하철 보도에 설치되는 점자블록에 관한 것으로서, 지하철 보도에 설치되는 점자블록에 있어서 소정의 높이와 면적을 가지며 상부에는 장착공간이 구비된 점자가 일정간격으로 돌출형성되는 커버 판을 폴리카보네이트를 이용해서 투명하게 형성하고 상기 커버 판의 하부에는 상면이 노란색으로 형성되며 상기 장착공간과 대응되는 위치에 다수의 발광다이오드가 장착된 회로기판을 장착하여 점자블록을 구성하고, 상기 점자블록은 화재발생에 따른 화재경보기의 작동시 이를 인지하고 작동신호를 회로기판에 전달하는 컨트롤 장치와 연결되어, 평상시에는 시각장애인의 점자보도로 이용되고 화재 발생이나 비상시에는 컨트롤 장치에서 전달되는 신호에 따라 회로기판에 장착되는 발광다이오드를 화살표나 진행방향으로 점멸시켜 승객들을 안전한 곳으로 이동할 수 있도록 한 것을 특징으로 한다.  
       
     점자블록, 커버 판, 점자, 회로기판, 발광다이오드, 화재경보기, 컨트롤 장치, 진동모터.

title_en: Emergency alert notification for the hearing impaired
abstract_en: An indication of an emergency alert message is provided to a user, potentially having a disability, via a networked enabled portable device. The emergency alert message is provided via sign language video images indicative of the emergency alert. A notification makes the user aware when broadcast emergency alerts are issued. In various embodiments, the portable device is enabled to receive information about an emergency alert broadcast of which the potentially disabled user should be aware, e.g., from the EAS, and to notify the user of the emergency alert. The user can be automatically taken to the emergency alert information by having the portable device automatically tune to the emergency broadcast information, the user can optionally retrieve the emergency information by tuning to the emergency broadcast channel, and/or the user can otherwise be presented with a reference to the emergency data, such as a link to the information.

title_en: Remote control detecting and warning system for preventing closing on grounding-wire
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a remote control detecting and warning system for preventing closing on grounding-wire, comprising a wireless remote-control launching device and at least one wireless receiving detector. The wireless remote-control launching device is arranged for sending a grounding-wire detecting command signal to the wireless receiving detector. The wireless receiving detector is arranged for detecting the grounding status of grounding-wire after receiving the grounding-wire detecting command signal from the wireless remote-control launching device. If the grounding-wire is notremoved, the system will warn. Compared with the prior art, the utility model has the advantages of small volume, convenient use, wide coverage, strict detection, blind angle free, etc. The utility model can effectively avoid the serious failure caused by closing on grounding wire and can be applied to various power substations or converting stations without an integrated automatic monitor systemfor electrical operation.

title_en: Rainwate catch filter
title_ko: 빗물 차 집 필터
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A rainwater collecting filter is provided to remove and store foreign materials included in rainwater when the quantity of the rainwater is increased, and to prevent environmental contamination by clearly and conveniently managing and maintaining the filter. CONSTITUTION: A rainwater collecting filter comprises the following: a rainwater inflow pipe(23) receiving rainwater; a initial rainwater cut off bank(21) blocking inflow of the rainwater when the rainwater is flowed through the initial rainwater cut off bank; a first filtering net(18) filtering foreign materials included in the rainwater when a water level reaches the constant level; a second filtering net separating the foreign materials; a ceramic layer(25) rectifying the rainwater; and a storage tank storing the refined water.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 빗물 저장시설에서 빗물을 차 집 할 때 사용하는 방법으로서 더욱 상세하게는 빗물을 차 집 할 때 비가 적게 오거나 초기 빗물 속에는 이물질이 많아 이 초기 빗물을 버리고 이물질이 빗물과 같이 씻겨 내려가고 빗물의 양이 많아지면 수위센서가 감지하여 초기빗물차단문을 열어 빗물유입관으로 들어오는 빗물을 1차 거름망에서 이물질을 제거하고 차 집을 한 후 속 거름망에서 한번 더 거른 다음 이물질을 침전 실에서 최종 침전을 하고 저장탱크로 보내어 빗물을 저장할 때 사용하는 빗물 차 집 필터의 방법으로서 
빗물을 저장하여 사용하면 홍수를 예방하고 상수원을 공급할 때 사용하는 에너지를 절약하여 경제적인 파급효과는 물론 환경보전에서도 획기적인 파급효과가 있는 줄 알면서도 시설비가 많이 소요되고 유지관리가 어려워 지금까지 시설을 외면하여 왔다. 
그러나 세계적으로 홍수가 자주 발생하고 또한 우리나라는 유엔에서 정하는 물부족국가 이여서 최근에는 정부차원으로 빗물을 저장하여 사용하는데 많은 지원이 있어 많은 지방자치단체에서 빗물저장을 의무화하는 조례를 만드는 준비를 하고 있는 것으로 조사되었다. 
빗물저장시설에서는 가장 시급한 것이 빗물저장탱크로 이물질이 유입되는 것이다  이물질이 유입되면 아무리 좋은 시설을 하여도 그 시설은 무용지물이 되어 버리고 또한 유지관리 면에서도 많은 비용이 소요되어 빗물저장으로 인한 경제적인 효과가 없어 시설을 하였다 하더라도 경제적인 효과가 없으면 가동을 하지 않을 것이다.  
이에 본 발명의 빗물 차 집 필터를 개발하여 빗물 차 집 시에 이물질을 제거하고 빗물을 저장하면 유지관리 면에서는 물론 환경보전에서도 획기적인 파급효과가 있을 것이다.

title_en: Control system of vehicle with a automatic breaking function based on observation result of blind spot
title_ko: 사각지대의 감시 결과에 기초한 자동 제동 기능을 가지는 차량 제어 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An automatic braking function based on a monitoring result of a blind spot is provided to prevent collision by using warning announcement. CONSTITUTION: An automatic braking function based on a monitoring result of a blind spot comprises a memory(101), a camera, an acceleration pedal sensor(103), an ECU(Engine Control Unit)(105), and an ABS(Anti-lock Brake System)(106). The cameras output captured image data of a blind spot. The gear reduction unit senses the location of a shift gear and outputs a first sensing signal. The acceleration pedal sensor senses the operation of the acceleration pedal. The second sensing signal is outputted. The ECU recognizes the operation state of the vehicles based on the first and the second sensing signal, compares the captured image data and reference image data, and then outputs a braking control signal in an emergency situation.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 사각지대의 감시 결과에 기초한 자동 제동 기능을 가지는 차량 제어 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 본 발명에 따른 차량 제어 시스템은 메모리, 복수의 촬영 장치들, 기어 감지부, 가속패달 감지부, ECU, 및 ABS부를 포함한다. 메모리는 기준 영상 데이터들을 저장한다. 복수의 촬영 장치들은 차량 외부의 전방, 후방, 및 양측에 각각 설치되어, 차량 주변의 사각지대들을 각각 촬영하고, 촬영 영상 데이터들을 각각 출력한다. 기어 감지부 변속 기어의 위치를 감지하고, 제1 감지 신호를 출력한다. 가속패달 감지부 가속 패달의 작동 상태를 감지하고, 제2 감지 신호를 출력한다. ECU는 차량의 점화 신호에 응답하여 동작하고, 제1 및 제2 감지 신호들에 기초하여 차량의 동작 상태를 인식하고, 촬영 영상 데이터들을 기준 영상 데이터들에 각각 비교하고, 그 비교 결과에 따라 위험 상황을 판단하고, 위험 상황일 때 차량의 동작 상태에 따라, 제동 제어 신호를 출력한다. ABS부는 제동 제어 신호에 응답하여, 복수의 휠 실린더가 차량의 복수의 차륜의 브레이크들을 각각 작동시키도록, 복수의 휠 실린더의 유압을 각각 증가시킨다. 본 발명에 따르면, 사각지대에서의 충돌 사고를 예방할 수 있다. 
       
     촬영 장치, ECU

title_en: A pedestrian crossing indicator
title_ko: 횡단 보도 표시기
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A pedestrian crossing indicator is provided to safely guide a disabled person, especially a blind person, and to reduce unnecessary power consumption. CONSTITUTION: A pedestrian crossing indicator comprises advertising banners(12b), indicating lamps(10c), human body sensors(17a,17b), speakers(16), a signal lamp, and solar panels(13a,13b). Photo-luminescent print parts(19) are formed in the advertising banners. The indicating lamps are installed in the top ends of first posts, and are protected by acryl transparent panels(10d). The human body sensors and the speakers are installed on the side surface of the first posts. The signal lamp is installed in the side of one first post. The solar panels are installed in the top ends of second posts(16).
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 지방자치단체 또는 사업허가권자 등이 관할 교통로 상의 횡단 보도와 인접하는 인도의 양측 가장자리에 홍보용 또는 대민광고와 맹인을 위한 횡단신호 안내 및 야간에 신호등 알림 기능 등을 구비하여 설치하는 횡단 보도 표시기에 관한 것으로, 횡단 보도와 인접한 인도의 양측 가장자리에 각각 사각 기둥형상의 제 1장치 포스트가 지반에 지지고정되고 상기 두 개의 제 1장치 포스트와 일정거리를 유지하는 지점에 제 2장치 포스트가 또한 각각 지지고정되어 양측의 제 1장치 포스트와 제 2장치 포스트 사이에 축광 인쇄된 광고 현수막이 연결되고 두 개의 제 1장치 포스트의 상단 부에는 표시 전등이 설치되어 아크릴 소재의 사각 보호막이 안착 되며 중간 인도 방향 측면 부에는 인명 감지센서와 스피커가 내장되고 도로 방향 측면 부에는 신호등이 구비되며 다른 두 개의 제 2장치 포스트의 상단 부에는 태양열 전지판이 구비되어 하단 내부의 축전지에 전력을 축전시켜 자체 소용되는 등의 방법으로 설비함으로써 대민광고와 홍보 및 맹인 안내 및 신호등 표시 및 전력절감 등의 효과를 가져 올 수 있는 횡단 보도 표시기에 관한 것이다. 
       
     횡단 보도, 제 1장치 포스트, 제 2장치 포스트, 태양열 전지판, 현수막.

title_en: System and method for sos rescue and prevention of crime
title_ko: 응급신호 발신 및 범죄예방 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An emergency signal sending method, a crime prevention system, and a method thereof are provided to prevent crimes in the blind spot of a discount store by using a light lamp and an alarm sound according to the emergency signal sending of a mobile terminal. CONSTITUTION: A key(106) of a mobile terminal(100) is used to send an emergency signal. A local communications part(104) of a mobile terminal transmits an emergency signal. A controller(102) of a mobile terminal decides the pressing of the emergency signal send key. The controller of the mobile terminal transfers the emergency signal sending command to the local communications part. A local area network receiver of a security company structure(200) receives the emergency signal transmitting from the local communications part of the personal mobile terminal. A controller(202) of the security company operates an alarm device according to an emergency signal. The alarm device executes an alarm operation according to the command of the controller of the security company structure.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 응급상황에 처한 사람들이 휴대 단말기의 응급신호 버튼을 누르면 응급구조를 신호를 주변의 경광등 내지 사이렌 등의 알람기기가 구비된 보안업체의 구조물들에게 전송하고 응급신호를 전송받은 보안업체의 구조물들은 아람기기를 가동하여 범죄를 방지함과 동시에 중앙센터로 응급신호를 전송하고 응급신호 발생위치에서 제일 가까운 직원에게 출동을 연결하여 범죄를 예방하는 것을 특징으로 한다.  
       
     휴대단말기, 응급구조, 보안업체

title_en: Blind with warning function and crime prevention window having the same
title_ko: 경보기능이 마련된 블라인드 및 이를 포함하는 방범창
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A blind with crime prevention and alarming functions, and a safety window including the same are provided to improve view efficiency, prevent outsiders from entering inside, and use in emergency situations for escape. CONSTITUTION: A safety window including a blind with crime prevention and alarming functions comprises a window frame(110), a window(120) and a blind(200). The window is coupled with the window frame to be opened and closed. The blind is installed on the window. The blind has crime prevention alarming functions. The blind comprises a pair of frames, a plurality of rotary shafts, a blind blade, a power supply unit, a controller, and an alarming unit. A pair of blinds are installed outside the window. The rotary shaft is positioned inside the frame. The blind blade is formed in the rotary shaft. The power supply unit applies electrical signals on the rotary shaft. The controller senses the signals applied on the rotary shaft. The alarming unit alarms the outside when the controller does not sense electrical signals.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 창의 외측에 여닫이 방식으로 설치되는 한 쌍의 프레임과, 상기 프레임의 내부에 수평 또는 수직방향으로 배치되는 다수의 회전축과, 상기 회전축에 마련되는 블라인드 날개와, 상기 회전축에 전기적인 신호를 인가하는 전원부와, 상기 회전축에 인가된 전기적인 신호를 감지하는 제어부와, 상기 제어부에서 전기적인 신호를 감지하지 못할 경우 이를 외부로 알리는 경보수단을 포함하는 경보기능이 마련된 블라인드와; 건축물의 벽면 개구부에 설치되는 창틀과, 상기 창틀에 개폐 가능하게 설치되는 창과, 상기 창의 외측에 설치되는 상술한 경보기능이 마련된 블라인드를 포함하는 방범창에 관한 것으로, 채광, 통풍, 환기, 단열, 방음, 조망 등의 기본적인 기능 이외에 외부인의 침입을 방지하고 비상시 탈출용으로 사용이 가능하며 조망 효율을 향상시킨 경보기능이 마련된 블라인드 및 이를 포함하는 방범창을 제공한다. 
       
     경보기능, 블라인드, 방범창, 방범시스템

title_en: Alarm apparatus for hearingdefect person
title_ko: 청각 장애인용 알림장치
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An alarm apparatus for a hearing-impaired person is provided to respond the operational state of an electronic apparatus by converting the alarm signal of the electronic apparatus to vibration signal or visual signal and transmits the signal to a portable terminal. CONSTITUTION: A wireless receiving module(12) receives alarm signal from an electronic apparatus(10). A signal conversion module(22) converts the alarm signal to vibration signal and visual signal. The vibration module(23) generates vibration based on the vibration signal from the signal conversion module. A display module(24) displays the visual signal from the signal conversion module.
abstract_ko:
본 고안은 청각 장애인용 알림장치에 관한 것으로, 초인종, 팩스, 화재경보 및, 보일러 등 각종의 전자장치에서 생성된 알림신호를 감각 또는 시각으로 인지가 가능한 진동신호 또는 시각신호로 변환하여 청각 장애인이 착용하고 있는 휴대 단말기에 무선 제공하여, 청각 장애인들이 상기 휴대 단말기를 통해 최종 제공되는 진동신호 또는 시각신호를 통해 각종 전자장치의 작동상태를 인지하여 대처하도록 구성된 청각 장애인용 알림장치에 관한 것이다. 
       
     청각 장애인용, 알림장치, 진동, 시각, 휴대 단말기

title_en: Intelligent calling and alarming system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent calling and alarming system. The connection relations of the internal modules of the intelligent calling and alarming system are as follows: a wireless control module is connected with a system control unit; the system control unit is respectively connected with a voice unit, an information cue unit, a caution light unit and a vibrator unit; and a smog alarming unit is respectively connected with the voice unit, the information cue unit, a caution light unit and a vibrator unit. The utility model can full-automatically assist daily life management of schools for deaf-mutes and blind schools and rapid alarming of emergencies, thus avoiding the situation that work and rest, calling and emergency alarming in daily life can not be coped with as the deaf and mute persons can not hear and the blind persons can not see.

title_en: Blind-guiding stick
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a blind-guiding stick, which comprises a stick body (1) and a handle (2), wherein the stick body (1) is hollow and is made of light aluminum alloy; the lower end part of the stick body (1) is fixedly connected with an iron hemisphere base (3); an alarm device (4) is arranged on the stick body (1); a switch (5) is arranged on the handle (2); and a fluorescence layer (6) is coated at the outer surface of the stick body (1). As the overall blind-guiding stick adopts the tumbler-type design with the upper part being light and the lower part being heavy, when the blind-guiding stick is used, even though the blind-guiding stick slips out of the hand, the blind person can be convenient to find the blind-guiding stick again; in addition, the blind person can be convenient to open the alarm device to obtain help when in emergency situation; moreover, the fluorescence layer can be convenient to give an alarm for passersby and vehicles when the blind person walks in dark environment, so as to ensure the safety of the blind person; therefore, the blind-guiding stick has novel structure and is convenient and practical.

title_en: Fireman rescue device with wireless direction-finding positioning function
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of fire fighting equipment, and in particular relates to a fireman rescue device with wireless direction-finding positioning function. The rescue device consists of a multi-radial wireless receiving circuit, a wireless transmission circuit, a single-chip microprocessor, a motion sensor, a temperature sensor, an orientation indicator, a distance indicator, a sound alarm device and a power source, wherein the multi-radial wireless receiving circuit consists of a magnetic antenna group, a receiving control circuit, a filtering-amplifying circuit and an intermediate frequency receiving circuit; the wireless transmission circuit consists of the magnetic antenna group, a transmission drive circuit and a transmitting-frequency modulation circuit; the motion sensor, the temperature sensor, the orientation indicator, the distance indicator and the sound alarm device are connected with I/O ports of the single-chip microprocessor; and the power source is connected with the components to supply power. Due to the wireless direction-finding positioning function, the rescue device reduces rescue blindness in harsh environment and greatly improves rescue efficiency, thereby saving the lives of firemen to the utmost extent.
assignees: SHANGHAI FIRE RES INST OF THE MINISTRY OF PUBLIC SECURITY;SHANGHAI BEIAN INDUSTRY CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent calling and warning system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent calling and warning system. A computer center control unit is connected with an intelligent system control unit, the intelligent system control unit is respectively connected with a speech unit, an information prompting unit, a warning lamp unit and a vibrator unit, the intelligent system control unit is formed by sequentially connecting an RS485 communication module to a microcomputer control module and a switch control module, and the information prompting unit is formed by sequentially connecting a single chip processing module to a buffer memory module and a display module. The information prompting unit receives a switch control instruction from the intelligent system control unit, and selects information segments to be displayed, and the selected information segments are processed by a single chip and are output by the display module. The utility model can help the daily life management of school for deaf-mute people and schools for blind people in a full automatic way, can realize the fast warning of emergency events, and avoids the conditions that the work and rest, the calling and the emergency event warning in daily life can not be realized because of the hearing disturbance of deaf-mute people and the seeing disturbance of the blind people.

title_en: Liquefied gas and compressed gas filling apparatus and control method thereof
title_ko: 액화 및 압축가스 충전장치 및 이를 제어하는 제어방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A device and a method for charging liquefied and compressed gas are provided to enable a charging facility to be controlled without depending on a foreign company. CONSTITUTION: A device for charging liquefied and compressed gas comprises a storage tank part(100), primary pumps(P101,P102), a primary heat exchanger(V101), secondary pumps(P201,P202), secondary heat exchangers(V201,V202), a feeding tank part(300), a detection sensor, an alarm unit, and an integral controller. The storage tank part stores liquefied gas. The primary pumps circulate the liquefied gas to the storage tank part. The primary heat exchanger heat-exchanges the liquefied gas provided by the primary pumps in a saturation state. The secondary pumps pressurize the low pressure liquefied gas provided from the storage tank part to the high pressure liquefied gas. The secondary heat exchanger vaporizes the liquefied gas provided from the secondary pumps. The feeding tank part stores the compressed gas provided from the secondary pumps. The detection sensor senses the pressure, the flow rate, the temperature and the density of liquefied and compressed gas, the water level of the storage tank part, and the driving states of the secondary pumps. The alarm unit informs the outside of the signal detected by the detection sensor. The integral controller controls the flow of the liquefied gas through the signal detected by the detection sensor.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은, 액화 및 압축가스 충전장치와 상기 액화 및 압축가스 충전장치를 안전하게 운영할 수 있도록 액화 및 압축가스 충전장치의 제어방법에 관한 것이다. 
     본 발명의 액화 및 압축가스 충전장치는, 액화가스를 저장하는 저장탱크부; 상기 저장탱크부의 액화가스를 상기 저장탱크부로 순환 공급시키는 적어도 하나 이상의 1차펌프; 상기 1차펌프에서 공급되는 액화가스를 포화상태로 열교환시키는 1차열교환기; 상기 저장탱크부에서 공급되는 저압의 액화가스를 고압의 액화가스로 가압하는 적어도 하나 이상의 2차펌프; 상기 2차펌프에서 공급되는 액화가스를 기화시키는 적어도 하나 이상의 2차열교환기; 상기 2차펌프에서 공급되는 압축가스를 저장하고 이를 사용처에 공급하는 적어도 하나 이상의 저장공급탱크부; 상기 액화 및 압축가스의 압력, 유량, 온도와 밀도 및 상기 저장탱크부의 수위 그리고 2차펌프의 구동상태를 감지하는 감지센서; 상기 감지센서에서 감지된 신호를 외부에 알리는 알람부; 및 상기 감지센서에서 감지된 신호를 통해 상기 액화가스의 흐름을 제어하는 통합제어부; 로 이루어지는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
     또한, 본 발명에 구동방법 액화가스의 열교환 제어방법은, 제어밸브를 제어하는 1차제어단계; 온도감지센서에서 1차펌프의 온도를 감지하는 온도감지단계; 1차펌프를 구동하는 1차펌프구동단계; 상기 제어밸브를 제어하는 2차제어단계; 압력감지센서에서 구동정지조건을 감지하는 제1구동조건감지단계; 상기 제어밸브를 제 어하는 3차제어단계; 상기 온도감지센서 및 수위감지센서에서 구동정지조건을 감지하는 제2구동조건감지단계; 및 상기 제1,2구동조건감지단계의 조건에 따라 포화상태의 열교환을 완료하는 완료단계; 를 포함하여 이루어지는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
     또한, 본 발명에 따른 구동방법 중 통합제어부에 의해 액화가스 충전을 제어방법은, 제어밸브를 제어하는 1차제어단계; 온도감지센서에서 온도를 감지하는 온도감지단계; 제어밸브를 제어하는 2차제어단계; 1차펌프를 구동하는 1차펌프구동단계; 제어밸브를 제어하는 3차제어단계; 상기 유량감지센서 및 밀도감지센서에서 액화가스 충전의 구동조건을 감지하는 구동조건감지단계; 상기 유량감지센서에서 충전되는 유량을 합산하는 유량합산단계; 및 상기 구동조건감지단계의 조건 및 유량합산단계에서 합산된 유량에 따라 액화가스 충전을 완료하는 완료단계; 를 포함하여 이루어지는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
     본 발명의 제어 방법 중 압축가스의 생산을 제어하는 방법은, 제어밸브를 제어하는 1차제어단계; 온도감지센서에서 온도를 감지하는 온도감지단계; 1차펌프를 구동하는 1차펌프구동단계; 제어밸브를 제어하는 2차제어단계; 상기 온도감지센서에서 2차펌프의 온도를 감지하는 2차온도감지단계; 2차펌프를 구동하는 2차펌프구동단계; 상기 유량감지센서에서 압축가스 생산모드의 구동조건을 감지하는 구동조건감지단계; 제어밸브를 제어하여 2차펌프에서 압축가스를 바이패스(Bypass) 시키는 3차제어단계; 제어밸브를 제어하여 2차펌프에서 압축가스의 바이패스(Bypass)를 종료시키는 4차제어단계; 상기 압력감지센서에서 감지된 압축가스의 압력에 따라 압축가스를 제1,2,3저장탱크로 저장하는 압축가스저장단계; 및 상기 제1,2,3저장탱 크의 압력의 이상 유무를 감지하여 이상 유무에 따라 제어밸브와 2차펌프를 제어하여 압축가스 생산공정을 종료하는 종료단계; 를 포함하여 이루어지는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
     마지막으로, 본 발명의 제어방법 중 구동대기 제어방법은, 제어밸브가 정상구동되는 구동단계; 1,2차펌프 및 제어밸브의 구동을 중단시키는 구동해제단계;  및 액화 및 압축가스 충전장치의 비상상황을 감지하는 비상감지모드를 선택하는 비상모드선택단계; 를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
     
     제어, 제어방법, 충전장치

title_en: Stand alone fire alarm apparatus
title_ko: 독립형 화재경보장치
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A stand-alone fire alarm device is provided to notify a fire to a visually handicapped person and hearing impaired person as well as general people. CONSTITUTION: A smoke sensing unit(10) comprises a smoke sensor and outputs a fire sensing signal. A power supply(20) changes commercial AC power into DC power and supplies the DC power. A sound or voice generator(40) outputs previously stored voice or sound when a fire is sensed. A flickering unit(50) discharges strobe at a fixed cycle when a fire is sensed.
abstract_ko:
연기감지센서를 구비하여 화재 감지신호를 출력하는 연기감지부; 상용 교류 전원을 직류전원으로 변환하여 충전함과 동시에 상기 직류전원을 공급하는 전원공급부; 화재감지시 기저장된 음성이나 음향을 출력하는 음 발생부; 화재감지시 기설정된 주기로 스트로보 방전하는 점멸부; 및 상기 각 부분을 제어하는 제어부를 포함하며, 상기 각 부분은 하나의 인쇄회로기판에 구현되어 단일 하우징에 수납되는 독립형 화재경보장치가 개시된다. 
     
     경보, 스트로보, 음성, 독립, 케이싱, 충전 배터리

title_en: System for monitoring intrusion of foreign bodies
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a system for monitoring the intrusion of foreign bodies. The system comprises intrusion monitoring terminals, a monitoring and alarming processing system and a monitoring management system, at least one intrusion monitoring terminal is connected with the monitoring and alarming processing system through data transmission channels; and the monitoring and alarming processing system is connected with the monitoring management system through a data transmission network. The system of the utility model has the advantages of simple structure and convenient implementation; by adopting various alarming manners, the system can guarantee that the alarming message can be delivered accurately and carry out the analysis and pre-alarming treatment on various alarming messages, thus preventing disasters and secondary disasters.
assignees: SICHUAN GEZHI TECHNOLOGY DEV CO LTD

title_en: Apparatus and method for providing emergency and alarm communications
abstract_en: An apparatus and method for establishing emergency and alarm communications between devices via an interface device are provided. According to one aspect, an interface device comprises an input, an output, and logic. The input receives data in a first format from the first device. The logic detects whether the data is intended to request assistance from emergency services and if so, determining proper routing, retrieving location information and transmit the data and location information to the proper destination. If not intended to request assistance, a second device for receiving the data is identified as well as a second format, the data is translated to the second format and transmitted to the second device. A battery may selectively provide power to essential components of the interface device upon detection of a power failure. Notifications are made upon detection of a power failure, malfunction, or emergency request.
assignees: TISCHER STEVEN;ZELLNER SAMUEL N;STARR ROBERT J

title_en: Earthquake protection warning system of nuclear reactor
abstract_en: The utility model provides an earthquake protection warning system of a nuclear reactor, which comprises a plurality of intelligent sensor modules and a main control unit that are connected into a data communication network through a twisted-pair cable. Each intelligent sensor module comprises a triaxial acceleration sensor, an A/D converter, a single chip microcomputer, a communication chip and a communication interface that are connected sequentially; and the main control unit comprises a main-control module, and a display, an audible-visual annunciator, a keyboard, a nuclear reactor emergency shutdown switching circuit and a communication interface circuit that are connected with the main-control module. The intelligent sensor modules are mounted on building supporting structure on the periphery of the nuclear reactor, so as to obtain the maximal monitoring area, and no detection blind zone or repeat detection zone appears; and after the information collected by each intelligent sensor module is calculated and compared by the main control unit, working personnel can judge whether an earthquake wave emerges and obtain the strength of the earthquake; in the case of a strong earthquake, the nuclear reactor is closed automatically and quickly, and the warning system gives an alarm to inform the working personnel to escape.

title_en: Nowcast of Natural Resource and Calamity Warning
abstract_en: A method of forecasting naturally-occurring phenomena, such as seismic activity, includes taking localized measurements of the Earth's gravitational force change using MEM inertial motion units. Trends in the measurements are interpreted and related to a phenomenon of interest, a likelihood of occurrence is predicted based on the relationship, and the likelihood is reported to interested parties, preferably automatically to emergency bulletin sources. Measurements can be taken from above the Earth's atmosphere. The trends can be interpreted by determining blind source separation information directed to the region underneath the Earth's mantle crust to determine composition and/or movement.

title_en: Matter removing device and base station with matter removing function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the wireless communication technology, in particular to a matter removing device and a base station with the matter removing function. The matter removing device comprises a monitoring unit, a control unit and a processing unit, wherein the monitoring unit is connected with the control unit and is used for sending an alarm signal to the control unit when monitoring foreign matters; the control unit is connected with the processing unit and is used for triggering the processing unit to activate the matter removing function after judging the signal sent by the monitoring unit as the alarm signal; and the processing unit is used for activating the matter removing function to remove the foreign matters. As the foreign matters entering the base station can be monitored by the device and removed through the processing unit, the safety of equipment in the base station is ensured.

title_en: Firemen search and rescue device with radio direction-finding location function
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of fire-fighting equipment, particularly relates to a firemen search and rescue device with the radio direction-finding location function. The device comprises a multiple-radial direction radio receiving circuit, a radio transmitting circuit, a monolithic microprocessor, a motion sensor, a temperature sensor, a position indicator, a distance indicator, a voice alarm device and a power supply, wherein the multiple-radial direction radio receiving circuit comprises a magnetic antenna group, a receiving control circuit, a filter amplifying circuit and an intermediate-frequency receiving circuit; the radio transmitting circuit comprises a magnetic antenna group, a transmitting driving circuit and a transmitting-frequency modulation circuit; the motion sensor, the temperature sensor, the position indicator, the distance indicator and the voice alarm device are connected with an I/O port of the monolithic microprocessor; and the power supply is connected with all the parts for supplying power. The device has the radio direction-finding location function, reduces the search and rescue blindness in severe environment and greatly improves the search and rescue efficiency, thereby saving the life of firemen to the utmost extent.
assignees: SHANGHAI FIRE RES INST OF THE MINISTRY OF PUBLIC SECURITY;SHANGHAI BEIAN INDUSTRY CO LTD

title_en: Multiple sound and voice detector for hearing- impaired or deaf person
abstract_en: A system, an apparatus, a kit or a method for notifying a deaf/hearmg impaired user of multiple sounds produced in the ambient environment including non-verbal sounds and words spoken by the human voice comprises a controller, at least one audio input device and at least one output device. The controller provides for storing a plurality of target sounds. The audio input device continuously captures in real-time sounds produced in the ambient environment and transmits in real-time the captured sounds to the controller. The controller compares in real-time a given captured sound to each target sound in order to determine a match there between. The controller signals the output device when a match is made. The output device receives this signal from the controller that a given sound produced in the ambient environment has been captured and produces a notification signal thereby notifying in real-time the user of the given captured sound.
assignees: HARMONYA TECHNOLOGIES;TAILLEFER ERIC;PELADEAU MICHEL;ROCHETTE LIONEL;TAILLEFER PIERRE;LESSNICK HUGO

title_en: Forest fire prevention early warning system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a forest fire prevention early warning system, which comprises a front-end monitoring device, a communication and control server, an intelligent fire searching or fire judging server, a monitoring client and a geographic information system GIS. The communication and control server is respectively in signal connection with the front-end monitoring device and the intelligent fire searching or fire judging server, and the monitoring client is respectively in signal connection with the communication and control server, the intelligent fire searching or fire judging server and the geographic information system GIS. The early warning system is wide in monitoring range and more accurate in fire judgment, has no blind spot during station switching, can perform all-weather continuous monitoring, realizes real observation of dynamic conditions of forests, can perform fire monitoring in visible light fire identification and infrared flame identification ways, and is accurate in fire site positioning.
assignees: JILIN FORESTRY INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Disaster prevention and safety monitoring system
abstract_en: A disaster prevention monitoring system comprises a strong wind, rainfall, earthquake and foreign body invasion monitoring subsystem and is characterized in that the subsystem consists of display alarm equipment, logical judgment generation equipment, data acquisition processing equipment, field monitoring equipment, a train control center and power supply equipment, wherein the logical judgment generation equipment is respectively connected with the display alarm equipment and the data acquisition processing equipment; and the field monitoring equipment is connected with the data acquisition processing equipment, the train control center and the power supply equipment. As a civil high-speed running passenger special line, the disaster prevention and safety monitoring system can ensure the safety of the trains under various disasters and sudden disasters, and a railway strong wind monitoring and early warning system is established to ensure the running safety of the train, improve the railway transportation efficiency of the train as far as possible and timely take emergency measures for disasters.
assignees: JIANGSU KTK TRANSP INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Signal processing system and methods for reliably detecting audible alarms
abstract_en: A signal processing system and associated methods are disclosed for reliably detecting audible alert signals, such as Temporal-3 (or Code-3) and Temporal-4 (or Code-4) alert signals generated by commercially available smoke, fire, and carbon monoxide detectors. The system and methods are capable of detecting audible alert signals of different intensities in the presence of dynamic background environment (e.g., television programming, music, noise, and the like). The system and methods are capable of detecting audible alert signals generated by far away smoke, fire, and carbon monoxide detectors. The signal processing system and methods may, in some embodiments, be incorporated into a bedside or other unit that generates a supplemental alert signal capable of alerting individuals who might not otherwise respond to the alarm condition, such as individuals who are asleep, children, hearing impaired, or intoxicated.
assignees: HOY LESLIE D;ALBERT DAVID E;SMITH LANDGRAVE T;LEWIS JAMES J

title_en: Digital content distribution system for delivering location specific content to an ad hoc group of mobile subscribers
abstract_en: A digital content distribution system and method are disclosed for delivering location specific content to an ad hoc group of mobile subscribers and method of delivering subscriber-requested, location-based content directly to a mobile communication device, such as a cell phone or personal digital assistant (PDA) or other mobile communication device. The system consists of a downloadable application that runs on the subscribers mobile communication devices and communicates with the server-based content composer system. The content composer system manages outgoing content based upon the geographic location reported by the mobile communication device application and the demographic and preference data stored in a subscriber database. Using available messaging technology, such as Short Message Service (SMS) and Multimedia Messaging Service (MMS) messaging, relevant sponsored content, mobile emergency alerts, and the ability to facilitate 2-way text or voice based services utilizing Global Positioning System (GPS) mapping is provided to an ad hoc group of subscribers in designated geographic locations. In order to optimize the utility for deaf and hard of hearing subscribers, the mobile communication device may be placed in a low power sleep or hibernate mode instead of a no power mode when the device is turned off. In a hibernate mode, in response to emergency content, the mobile communication device will wake up to an alert even when it is hibernating. Moreover, the alerts take over the portable device no matter what other tasks are being executed. In accordance with another important aspect of the invention, in response to emergency content, the system will cause the mobile communication device to vibrate even if the mobile communication device has been configured with the vibrate feature turned off.

title_en: Rubber vibration isolating and absorbing device for building
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a rubber vibration isolating and absorbing device for a building, belonging to the field of anti-seismic facilities of buildings. The design consists of an inner supporting column, an outer guard body, an upper supporting seat, a lower supporting seat and a warning system, wherein the inner supporting column has an integrated structure consisting of special rubber and an elastic spring so as to meet the requirements of vertical bearing capacity and compression deformation of the building; when the supporting seats are subjected to large shearing and deformation force generated by earthquake, the arc end surface of the inner supporting column matched with the arc inner bottom surface of the supporting seat can generate corresponding displacement so as to release stress; the outer guard body plays a role in protection around the inner supporting column, so that strong earthquake impact force can be safely released and attenuated; the upper part structure of the building only has slight translational motion, after the earthquake force is eliminated, the inner supporting column returns to the original position, thus avoiding serious damage of the building structure and protecting the safety of human life and property; and the sensor is arranged in a central hole of the inner supporting column, and is connected with a ground display by a warning circuit so as to be capable of displaying the earthquake level.
assignees: WUHAN TIANYOU RUBBER PRODUCT CO LTD

title_en: Railway disaster prevention safety monitoring system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a railway disaster prevention safety monitoring system, which comprises at least one on-site monitoring sensor, at least one monitoring unit, monitoring data processing equipment and a monitoring terminal. The railway disaster prevention safety monitoring system carries out real-time monitoring, acquisition, summarizing, alerting, early warning and emergency treatment on natural disasters like gale, rainfall, snowfall, earthquake and the like, foreign matter invasion and accidents to realize the distributive acquisition, the centralized management and the comprehensive utilization of monitoring information. The system adopts a corresponding emergency treatment measure according to the order of severity of the disasters and provides the technical support for regulating an operation plan and transmitting traffic control, recovering traffic, rescuing, inspecting and maintaining and the like so as to avoid or relieve the loss caused by the disasters and secondary disasters to the maximum limit.
assignees: RES INST OF ELECTRONIC COMPUTING TECHNOLOGY CHINA ACADEMY OF RAILWAY SCIENCES;Beijing jingwei information technology co ltd

title_en: Portable prompt device for sentinels against attack
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a portable prompt device for sentinels against attack, which is designed for avoiding the problems that an attack incident can happen to bring about casualties and further threaten the national security because darkness is unfavorable to watch or find enemy situation when military or police sentinels are on duty in the night and the like. The prompt device consists of two parts that: in the first part, an infrared detector and a signal generator combine to form a separate unit on which a parallel interface is arranged; and in the second part, a signal receiver and a mini vibration alarm combine to form a receiving unit. The infrared detector captures the signal of a foreign body, the signal generator sends the signal out, and the signal receiver converts the received signal to an output warning in a mechanical vibration way by the mini vibration alarm. The utility model has the advantages of effectively preventing the sentinels, security guards or night watchmen and the like from being attacked on guard in a fixed position, reminding by adopting a vibration mode, ensuring that the alert personnel can prepare in advance for conveniently and timely responding to an emergency incident and avoiding the casualties caused by being attacked when warning without alerting intruders particularly when the view is limited in the night.

title_en: Community-based response system
abstract_en: An example of a medical equipment management system includes a notification system, separate from a dispatch center, that is configured to post a Internet accessible application, receive responder enrollment information prior to an emergency event from a user interface of the application, associate the responder with an account for sending information to a mobile device, receive, from the dispatch center, an emergency location, receive, a current location from the mobile device, receive equipment locations for registered medical equipment, and based on the emergency location, the equipment locations, and the current mobile device location, provide to the mobile computing device, an automatic notification that includes the emergency event information and mapping information that indicates a location of registered medical equipment that is located near the current mobile device location, and the current mobile device location relative to the emergency location and relative to the registered medical equipment location.

title_en: A listening system comprising an alerting device and a listening device
abstract_en:
The application relates to: A listening system. The object of the present application is to provide a system that eases the acknowledgement of 'alarm signals', as e.g. issued by alarm indicators, in the environment of a user in difficult listening situations. The problem is solved in that the system comprises 
o a listening device adapted to be worn at or in an ear of a user, and 
● an alerting device adapted to detect or receive an external alarm signal, 
● wherein 
● the listening device and the alerting device each comprise at least one communication interface allowing to establish a communication link between them, 
● the alerting device is adapted to sense or receive information as to whether or not the listening device is in operational use, and 
● the listening system is adapted to operate in at least two modes, 
● a NORMAL mode, when said listening device is in operational use, 
and 
● an ALARM mode, when said listening device is NOT in operational 
use; and wherein 
said listening system is adapted to issue specific ALARM mode signals to the user corresponding to said external alarm signals, when said listening system is in an ALARM mode. An advantage of the present system is that a user is able to take notice of alarms from normal indicators even in case of a hearing impairment and/or when located in a noisy environment. The invention may e.g. be used for the hearing instruments, ear protection devices, earphones, headsets or combinations thereof.

title_en: Method and system for monitoring the accessibility of an emergency exit
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for monitoring the accessibility of an emergency exit, the method comprising illuminating an area in front of the emergency exit by emitting light, detecting reflected light from the illuminated area using an image sensor, calculating a plurality of distances based on said detected reflected light for discrete positions in said image sensor, comparing said each of said plurality of distances with a predetermined distance, and generating an alarm signal if said comparing indicates a substantial difference in distance in at least one position in said image sensor. The present invention also relates to a system and a device for monitoring the accessibility of an emergency exit.

title_en: Flash type smoke alarm
abstract_en: The invention provides a flash type smoke alarm comprising a shell, a detector, an LED (light-emitting diode) lamp and a horn applying actions according to signals detected by the detector,, wherein the detector detecting the smoke or acousto-optic is installed on the surface of the shell; the LED lamp is installed in the shell and a lamp head of the LED lamp extends out of the exterior of the shell; the horn is installed in the shell; and when the detector detects the smoke, the horn sends out sound and simultaneously the LED lamp gives a flare so as to remind people to pay attention to fire or other smoke resources. The flash type smoke alarm is simple in structure and convenient in use, and can make flashing warming while sending out sound after the smoke is detected, thus enabling people losing hearing or having hearing impaired to observe the alarm.

title_en: On-vehicle traffic light assisting device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an on-vehicle traffic light assisting device in the technical field of intelligent transportation, which comprises a traffic light map module, a global positioning system (GPS) module, an image sensor, a traffic light detection and identification module, a lane identification module and a traffic light state display and prompting early warning module. The on-vehicle traffic light assisting device solves the problems of safe driving of groups with visual disturbance such as color weakness, color blindness and the like, can reduce the probability of traffic accidents caused by the running of the red light of a driver under exceptional conditions, and improves transportation efficiency at crossings.

title_en: Fire alarm bell and connecting rod for the same
title_ko: 화재경보종 및 화재경보종의 커넥팅 로드
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A fire alarm bell and a connecting rod of the fire alarm bell are provided to increase a strike sound by vibrating a crank with the elastic force of a spring. CONSTITUTION: A frame(120) is installed in the inside or outside of a fire alarm and mounts a spring(160) and a connecting rod(150). One side of the spring is comprised of a free end. The other side of the spring is fixed to the frame. A hammer(170) is mounted on the spring and translates according to the vibration of the spring. A motor(130) is formed in the frame and rotate with power when a fire occurs.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 경보음이 보다 크며 내구성을 향상시킬 수 있는 하재경보종 및 화재경보종의 커넥팅 로드에 관한 것으로서, 본 발명의 일 형태에 따르면, 경종, 프레임, 일측방향으로 길이방향을 가지도록 배치되고 일측단은 자유단이며 타측단은 고정되어 탄성에 의해 자유단이 병진운동하는 스프링, 상기 스프링에 구비되어 상기 스프링의 탄성에 의해 상기 경종을 타격하는 해머, 회전력을 제공하는 모터, 일측단이 상기 모터의 회전축에 결합되며 타측단은 상기 모터의 회전축으로부터 일정거리 이격되어 상사점과 제일 먼 하사점 사이를 회전하는 크랭크, 일측단은 상기 스프링의 일측단에 결합되고 타측단은 상기 크랭크의 타측단에 결합되어 상기 크랭크의 회전에 따라 병진운동하면서 상기 스프링을 당기도록 구비되며, 상기 스프링의 모터를 향하는 면의 대향된 면과 접촉하여 상기 크랭크가 하사점으로 회전될 때 상기 스프링의 일측단을 모터측으로 당겨 스프링을 탄성변형되게 하고, 상기 스프링의 일측단의 모터를 향하는 면과는 접촉되지 않도록 개방되어 크랭크가 상사저으로 회전될 때에는 상기 스프링의 탄성력으로서 탄성복원되도록 이루어지는 커넥팅 로드를 포함하여 이루어지는 화재경보종이 개시된다.
assignees: GUMSEONG FIRE PREVENTION IND CO LTD

title_en: Security switch
abstract_en: The invention relates to a security switch comprising a base and a cover plate buckled on the base, wherein a sheet switch pin, a contact piece and a rotary handle are arranged in the base, the bottom end of the switch pin extends out of the side face of the base, and one end of the rotary handle is moveably connected with the base through a rotating shaft; the contact piece is installed at the other end of the rotary handle and matched with the upper part of the switch pin; and a button is arranged at one side of one end of the rotary handle installed with the contact piece, opposite to the contact piece, the upper part of the button extends out of the base, and when the button is pressed, the rotary handle rotates around the rotating shaft so as to drive the contact piece to slide, and the surface of the contact piece is in contact with the surfaces of the two corresponding switch pins in a sliding manner. The security switch replaces the original point contact manner of a push switch with a sliding surface contact mode; and when being applied to a fire-fighting alarm device which is not used for a long time, the security switch can effectively avoid the problem of unavailability caused by foreign matters at the switch contact part, and ensures reliable contact when being used under the state of emergency.

title_en: Multi-function alarm pill case
title_ko: 다용도 알리미 약상자
abstract_ko:
본 고안은 만성질환자가 질병치료 목적으로 여러종류의 약을 장기간 복용 할 때에 약수납을 간편하게 하고 정해진 일시에 정해진 약을 빠뜨리지 않고 꾸준히 복용할 수 있게 도와주는 약상자에 관한 것으로서, 복용할 약이 봉지약 형태이거나 알약 형태라도 수납이 가능하게 범용으로 고안되었으며 전자화 된 컨트롤부를 활용해 복용 시작일자, 복용 마지막 일자, 하루중 복용횟수, 복용시간을 셋팅 할 수 있으며 복용할 약을 표시해주는 LED를 활용해 약물 오남용을 방지하고 시각장애인도 쉽게 인지할 수 있도록 양각된 글자를 약배출 버튼 표면에 새겨 넣어 시각장애인도 사용 할 수 있도록 한 것 이다. 이 고안을 통해 만성질환자의 높은 약복용율을 유도하여 약복용자의 건강 증진에 도움이 될 수 있게 하는 것이다. 
     종래에는 약을 조제 할 때에 약 먹을 시간과 날짜에 따른 구분을 미리 설정하여 약봉투 겉면 혹은 복용지시서에 적어 주어서 장기간 보관 할 경우 약봉투 또는 복용지시서의 분실로 인해 복용방법의 혼란을 초래하거나 기재가 쉽게 지워져 정확한 복용을 어렵게 하며 기억력 감퇴로 인해 약복용을 빠뜨리는 경우가 왕왕 발생되고 있었다. 또한 시각장애인의 경우에는 기재를 읽을 수 없는 폐단이 있어왔다. 
     본 고안은 전술한 문제점을 개선하기 위하여 안출된 것으로서 최대 한달 정도의 약을 수납하게 될 복용 시간대별 약수납부(아침,점심,저녁,취침전)와 약배출 버튼 표면에 양각의 문자를 새겨 넣어 시각장애인들도 구분 할 수 있도록 하고 약 복용 시간셋팅 및 약복용을 음성으로 알려주는 컨트롤부로 나누어 수납만을 위주로 한 종래의 약상자를 개선하고자 하는 목적으로 한 고안이다 
       
     약복용 확인 센서 --- 약 복용 여부를 확인하기 위해 설치하는 센서. 약케이스 --- 봉지약 또는 알약을 넣어 보관하기 위한 구성품. 약봉투 --- 봉지약을 담는 큰 봉투

title_en: Time division multiple access technology-based communication system for transmitting air situation and disaster situation early warning information
abstract_en: The invention discloses a time division multiple access (TDMA) technology-based communication system for transmitting air situation and disaster situation early warning information. In the system, early warning information of various types of alarms such as air defense, disaster prevention and the like is transmitted by using the TDMA technology and a distributed network topological structure; meanwhile, message communication, data communication and acoustic code word communication are performed; and alarm information covers areas such as buildings, pits, tunnels, underground stores and the like by using various alarm information transmission technologies. The aims of quickly and reliably transmitting and returning various types of early warning information, reporting the various types of alarm information and transmitting various types of service are fulfilled. The system has the function of quickly transmitting and distributing the various types of early warning information such as air defense, flood defense, shock resistance, fire prevention, flood discharge and the like, and can realize quick and accurate information transmission and all-around coverage of the alarm information, so that the alarms are reported without miss points or blind points, and real-time property, accuracy, high efficiency and all-around property of a civil air defense alarm are improved.

title_en: Alerting system
abstract_en: A system for alerting a person with a hearing impairment participating in a game to a signal provided by a referee of the game is disclosed. The system comprising a referee module 10 to be worn by the referee during use and at least one player module 12 to be worn by a respective player during use. The referee module comprising a microphone, means for detecting a predetermined audio signal received through the microphone, and a transmitter responsive to detection of the predetermined audio signal to transmit an alert signal to a receiver of the or each player module. The player module further comprises means to alert the or each player to receipt of the alert signal.

title_en: Auto-discovery of diverse communications devices for alert broadcasting
abstract_en: Methods and systems for communicating messages to target communications devices in a target physical location are disclosed. Network sources are queried for logical locations accessible to the network source. A specification of a physical location associated with each logical location is received. Each logical location specification is stored in a data store in association with the associated physical location specification. A specification of the target physical location is received. Those logical location specifications associated with the target physical location are retrieved from the data store, thereby identifying target logical locations. For each target logical location, at least one of the network sources accessible to that logical location is queried for specifications of communications devices accessible to that logical location, thereby identifying the communications devices in the target physical location. The message is communicated to the target communications devices in the target physical location via at least one of the target logical locations.
assignees: ABU-HAKIMA SUHAYYA;GRIGG KENNETH E;MCFARLAND CONNIE;GUEVREMONT VINCE;PISKORZ OSKAR;CHRISTIE COLIN

title_en: Notice system for individual common knowledge of school
title_ko: 학교 공지시스템 장치
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A school announcing system device is provided to enable a simple message which is displayed as a letter and transmission of a learning video material using a display device to be read by being displayed. CONSTITUTION: A class terminal unit(200) is prepared in biographical information, teacher information and a discrete class corresponding to a plurality of multiple class. A DB(110) includes location information of the class terminal unit. A main terminal(120) transmits notifying information including event and schedule to corresponding class terminal by referring DB. A multimedia server(130) transmits result data about a connector request of the class terminal. The multimedia server includes data for transmitting image and voice data among message information. An administration unit consists of the multimedia server.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 학교 또는 학원 등의  공지사항을 학생과 교사에게 효과적으로 전달하기 위한 전달시스템 장치에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 관리자에 의해 다수의 학급 각각에 전달 사항을 효과적으로 제공하고, 개별 학급별, 교사별 또는 학생에 따른 전달 사항을 제공하되 그 형태를 웹사이트, 영상 그리고 문자표시로 분류하여 제공할 수 있으며 특히 개인별 알림 사항을 휴대전화의 단문메세지서비스로 발송할 수 있는 학교 공지시스템 장치에 관한 것이다. 
이에, 다수 학급에 각각에 대응되는 인명정보 및 교사정보 그리고 개별 학급에 마련되는 학급단말부의 위치정보를 포함하는 DB(데이터베이스)와, 상기 DB를 참조하여 해당 학급단말부에 학교의 행사나 일정을 포함하는 공지사항 정보를 전송하며 상기 학급단말부의 접속자 요청에 대한 결과 데이터를 전송하는 메인단말기와, 상기 공지사항 정보 중 영상과 음성 데이터의 전송을 위한 데이터를 포함하는 멀티미디어서버로 이루어지는 관리부와; 상기 관리부로 공지사항 정보를 전송받아 출력형태에 따라 웹(web) 데이터, 영상 및 음성 데이터, 문자 데이터로 분류하는 단말관리기와, 상기 웹 데이터를 전송받아 포함된 웹 브라우저(web browser)로 번역하여 표시하는 교사단말기 및 학생단말기와, 상기 영상 및 음성 데이터를 전송받아 표시하는 디스플레이장치와, 상기 문자 데이터를 전송받아 문자열로 표시하는 문자표시장치로 이루어지며, 유무선 통신망으로 상기 관리부와 연결되는 다수의 학급단말부와; 상기 관리부의 공지사항 정보 중 상기 문자 데이터를 전송받아 휴대전화에 단문메세지서비스(SMS;short message service)를 발송하되, 상기 휴대전화의 정보는 상기 DB를 참조하는 단문메세지서비스(SMS) 발송서버;를 포함하여 구성되는 것을 특징으로 하는 학교 공지시스템 장치를 제공한다.

title_ko: 인명용 승강기 운행 통로 청소
abstract_en: PURPOSE: Inside of the elevator shaft the dust and foreign object is eliminated. In that way the respiratory disease and skin disease symptom can be prevented. CONSTITUTION: An elevator operation path cleaning for the human life comprises an opening unit and a purification air filter. The opening unit can purify the air with the fire alarm control station to the elevator operation path. The purification air filter is installed in the elevator shaft. The purification air filter is installed in the aperture side.
abstract_ko:
인명용 승강기가 운행하는 통로를 승강기 상부에 탑승하여 수동으로 승강기를 조정하며 운행 통로 내 먼지 및 승강기 운행으로 발생한 오염 물질을 진공 청소기 와 기타 청소 도구를 통해 청소를 하여 깨끗하게 제거하고 소독까지 한다. 특히 승강기 하단 낙하용 충격 흡수용 스프링이 있는 곳은 건물 건축시부터 청소를 하기가 무척 까다로운 지형이라 쉽게 청소가 되지 않는 부분이다. 이곳엔 특히 많은 오염 물질이나 기타 유해 물질이 싸여 있을 수 있어 이곳까지 청소를 한다. 
승강기 운행 통로에 유해 물질을 완전히 제거하여 승강기 운행 통로의 유해 물질로 인한  피해를 방지하며 이런 정화 작업을 1년에 1회 이상  하여 인명용 승강기를 이용하는 사람들 특히 노약자나 어린이들에게 맑고 깨끗한 공기를 흡입하게 하여 오염된 공기를 흡입하여 발생하는 질병들을 막는 것이  이 고안에 특징이다.

title_en: Special vacuum cup for the blind
abstract_en: The utility model provides a vacuum cup, in particular a special vacuum cup for the blind, the special vacuum cup having separate air inlet and air exhaust hole and being provided with vibration and buzzing warning signals. The special vacuum cup comprises an air inlet, an air inlet rubber plug, an air exhaust valve, an air valve composed of a valve a ball-shaped object and an air valve rubber plug, a contact carriage arranged in a cup body, a contact in the contact carriage, a circuit spring contact sheet, an upper sleeve, a lower carriage, a spring, a battery box, a vibrator sleeve and a nut. A buzzer is arranged in a hole on a cup wall and is in sleeve joint with a spiral wiring sleeve through a sealing ring, a cup body seal and a buzzer wiring pin, which facilitates mounting and dismounting of the contact carriage. Vacuum sucking force varies during cupping, and the contact moves up and down in the carriage to power on and off the circuit through the circuit spring contact sheet. And, a blind operator can know the vacuum force based on the signals sent out by a vibrator and the buzzer when the circuit is powered on or off.

title_en: The protection cover for unwanted alarm and the detector of fire
title_ko: 비화재보 방지 커버 및 화재 감지기
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A fault alarm prevention cover and a fire detector using the same are provided to block the inflow of foreign materials of the upper space of a target installation object to a detector main body, thereby preventing the inflow of water according to the dew condensation of the target installation object to the detector main body. CONSTITUTION: A fault alarm prevention cover comprises a base(100) and a pipe(200). The base has the same size as a detector body. The base arranges a penetration hole in the center of a plate by being combined in the upper part of the detector body. The pipe is combined in the base while maintaining the concentricity with the penetration hole. The detector body is fixed and coupled in the upper part of a detector cover. A cable clamping part(300) is fixed and coupled in the upper end part of the pipe. The cable clamping part blocks the inflow of foreign materials.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 비화재보 방지 커버 및 화재 감지기에 관한 것으로서, 본 발명의 비화재보 방지 커버는, 중앙에 관통공이 형성된 베이스와; 내부에 통과홀이 형성되어 상기 베이스의 상부에 설치된 파이프를 포함하고, 본 발명의 화재 감지기는, 케이블에 연결되는 화재감지센서가 부착된 감지기 몸체와; 상기 감지기 몸체를 보호하는 감지기 커버와; 피설치물과 상기 감지기 몸체 사이에 설치되는 베이스와; 상기 베이스에 형성된 관통공과 동심을 갖는 통과홀이 내부에 형성되면서 상기 베이스에 고정되는 파이프를 포함하여, 화재 이외의 요인에 의해 화재 감지기가 오동작하지 않도록 하는 비화재보 방지 커버 및 화재 감지기를 제공한다.

title_en: Doorbell alarm special for blind
abstract_en: The invention discloses a doorbell alarm special for the blind, belonging to the technical field of doorbell devices. The doorbell alarm comprises a power source I, a power source II, an LED lamp, a wireless receiver, a wireless transmitter, a vibrator, a pressure sensor, a controller I, a controller II and a life detector, wherein the power source I is respectively electrically connected with the LED lamp, the vibrator, the wireless receiver and the controller I, and the controller I is respectively electrically connected with the LED lamp, the vibrator and the wireless receiver; the power source II is respectively electrically connected with the wireless transmitter, the pressure sensor, the controller II and the life detector, and the controller II is respectively electrically connected with the wireless transmitter, the pressure sensor and the life detector. The invention has the beneficial effects that a user can be told that someone presses a doorbell through the vibration of the vibrator and the flashing of the LED lamp, and the doorbell alarm is simple in structure and convenient to use.

title_en: Building alarm system with occupants evavuation method
abstract_en:
The present invention discloses a method for an emergency alarm system capable of directing building occupants to a safe location in real time during an emergency situation. 
     The method comprises a plurality of functionalities with the aim to monitor an emergency condition, to evaluate the data collected, to calculate accessible evacuation paths, and to send results to output devices which provide information about the emergency location and directional evacuation information to occupants. By combining an analysis of the flow of evacuees and indications of presences with the evolution of an emergency state, the method combines situation-aware data with contextual information to provide the best available evacuation routes. In this manner, the method minimize problems due to congestion, potential panic of occupants, and changes in the emergency condition while increasing the probability that people will reach a safe location. 
     Finally, the method can be activated on demand, e.g., remotely, in circumstances of dangerous environmental situations, e.g., earthquake, etc.

title_en: Guiding stick with safety warning performance
abstract_en: The invention relates to a guiding stick with a safety warning performance. According to the invention, vibration luminous zones are installed on a guiding stick body for illumination and a switch, which is arranged and is in match with a blind road, is utilized to start a voice guide; therefore, a user that is using the guiding stick is prompted for pedestrians passing by and vehicles passing and safety of the user is also ensured, so that a guiding stick with a safety warning performance is formed; besides, the guiding stick provided in the invention can be used by the old and people with poor eyesight.

title_en: Guide stick with safety warning function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a guide stick with a safety warning function. The guide stick adopts the structure that a vibration luminous belt for lighting and a switch matched with the blind sidewalk and used for starting voice guide are mounted on the guide stick body to remind a user of the pedestrians and vehicles for protecting the safety of the user. Therefore, the guide stick provided by the utility model is suitable for the older and people with poor sight.

title_en: Apparatus and method for controlling synchronization of sleep cycle to support emergencyh alert service in wireless communication system
title_ko: 무선통신 시스템에서 긴급 경보 서비스를 위한 슬립 모드의 슬립 사이클 동기 제어 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A synchronization control apparatus between sleep modes and method are provided to maintain sleep mode synchronization by controlling state translation between a terminal and a base station through a sleep control signaling. CONSTITUTION: A modem(604) transmits a request message to a base station in case the modem does not receive a traffic indication message and uni-cast data. The request message is a message for requesting the location of a scheduled listing window. A control unit(606) receives a response message for the request message. The control unit synchronizes a sleep cycle by using synchronization information including the response message. The control unit determines the transmission of a message related to an emergency alarm service by using information related to the emergency alarm service including the response message.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 광대역 무선 접속 시스템에서 슬립 사이클 동기화에 관한 것으로, 단말의 동작 방법은, 리스닝 윈도우 동안 트래픽 지시 메시지(traffic indication message) 및 유니캐스트 데이터(unicast data)를 수신하지 못한 경우, 기지국으로 다음 스케줄된 리스닝 윈도우의 위치를 문의하기 위한 요청 메시지를 송신하는 과정과, 상기 요청 메시지에 대한 응답 메시지를 수신하면, 상기 응답 메시지에 포함된 동기화 정보를 이용하여 슬립 사이클에 대한 동기화를 수행하는 과정과, 상기 응답 메시지에 포함된 긴급 경보 서비스 관련 정보를 이용하여 긴급 경보 서비스 관련 메시지의 전송 여부를 판단하는 과정을 포함한다.

title_en: Bi-directional blind sight illumination and deflector device
abstract_en: An optical device that reflects back some of the same light that been projected towards the reflector with more intensity when transmitting through the reflector such that the remaining light is dispersed and still can been seen. The light is concentrated and projected forward by the device such that the appearance of the intensified light may act as a warning of oncoming vehicles, emergency situations, stopped vehicles and pedestrians on a hill or curve where line of sight is inhibited. The device is comprised of at least one reflective, dispersive and transmitting lens having a front and a rear surface and side edges; a frame that encircles the transmitting lens; a pole for affixing and placing the transmitting lens and frame to the ground; and a means to secure the frame of the transmitting lens to the pole.

title_en: Customer-controlled instant-response anti-fraud/anti-identity theft devices (with true- personal identity verification), method and systems for secured global applications in personal/business e-banking, e-commerce, e-medical/health insurance checker, e-education/research/invention, e-disaster advisor, e-immigration, e-airport/aircraft security, e-military/e-law enforcement, with or without NFC component and system, with cellular/satellite phone/internet/multi-media functions
abstract_en: All-in-one wireless mobile telecommunication devices, methods and systems providing greater customer-control, instant-response anti-fraud/anti-identity theft protections with instant alarm, messaging and secured true-personal identity verifications for numerous registered customers/users, with biometrics and PIN security, operating with manual, touch-screen and/or voice-controlled commands, achieving secured rapid personal/business e-banking, e-commerce, accurate transactional monetary control and management, having interactive audio-visual alarm/reminder preventing fraudulent usage of legitimate physical and/or virtual credit/debit cards, with cheques anti-forgery means, curtailing medical/health/insurance frauds/identity thefts, having integrated cellular and/or satellite telephonic/internet and multi-media means, equipped with language translations, GPS navigation with transactions tagging, currency converters, with or without NFC components, minimizing potential airport risks/mishaps, providing instant aid against school bullying, kidnapping, car-napping and other crimes, applicable for secured military/immigration/law enforcements, providing guided warning/rescue during emergencies and disasters.

title_en: Walk assistance apparatus for blind people
title_ko: 시각 장애인을 위한 보행 보조 장치
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A walk assistant device for the blind is provided to automatically inform of the location of a user in an emergency situation. CONSTITUTION: A walk assistant system for the blind comprises a walk assistant device(100), a mobile radio communication network(200), and a server(400). The walk assistant device is equipped with a separation and emergency situation detection part, a walk assistant device top end part, a walk assistant device bottom end part, an internal device, a location information confirmation switch, a walk obstacle detection part, a foldable walk obstacle detection button, and an obstacle detection part.
abstract_ko: 시각 장애인을 위한 보행 보조 장치가 개시된다, 시각 장애인을 위한 보행 보조 장치는, 시각 장애인의 위치 정보를 수신하는 GPS 수신부, 외부 서버와 통신하는 이동통신모듈, 초음파 센서를 이용하여 장애물을 감지하고, 장애물까지의 거리를 측정하는 장애물 감지부, 장애물이 감지되면, 경보음, 음성, 및 진동 중 적어도 하나를 시각 장애인에게 출력하는 출력부, 및 측정된 장애물까지의 거리에 따라 경보음, 음성, 및 진동 중 적어도 하나를 시각 장애인에게 상이하게 출력하도록 출력부를 제어하는 제어부를 포함한다.

title_en: Non-electric automatic control water door
title_ko: 수위를 이용한 무동력 자동조절 수문
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A non-motorized automatic control water gate using a water level is provided to prevent foreign materials from piling up inside a drainpipe by automatically controlling the opening and closing of the water gate in real time. CONSTITUTION: A non-motorized automatic control water gate using a water level comprises a drainpipe, a water gate frame(70), a water gate(10), a rotating unit(20), and an opening and closing unit(40). The drainpipe drains branch river water to a main river. The water gate frame has an incline fixed to the front end of the drainpipe. The water gate is installed at the front of the water gate frame and controls the flow of water. The rotating unit rotates the water gate. The opening and closing unit is connected to the front of the water gate and opens and closes the water gate depending on the water level of the main river.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 제방을 횡단하여  본류하천으로 유입되는 지류하천이나 수로에 설치된 암거 및 배수관로 내부를 흐르는 하천수의 역류발생 방지를 위한 무동력 자동조절수문으로 홍수 발생 시 제방 내·외부의 수위차를 이용하여 암거 입구에 설치된 수문을 자동 조절하여 본류하천의 수위 상승에 따른 지류하천 범람과 배후지 침수를 방지하기 위한 것으로, 하천의 수위 변동에 능동적으로 대처하여 자연재해 발생을 예방하고, 배수관로 내부의 원활한 유속을 확보하여 퇴적물 발생을 방지하는 등 효율적인 배수시설 유지관리가 가능하도록 하였으며, 동시에 동물이동통로 기능을 겸할 수 있도록 함으로서 생태환경보존에 기여할 수 있도록 하는 수위를 이용한 무동력 자동조절 수문을 제공하는 것이다.

title_en: High-capacity automatic extinguishing device with spring as stored power to vortically spray dry fire-extinguishing powder
abstract_en: According to the first automatic extinguishing device in the world, a plurality of springs are used as the stored power for fire extinguishing to realize large unit capacity storage and vortical spraying of a dry fire extinguishing powder, and any outside force such as human, electricity, water, gas and the like cannot be required to extinguish any types of indoor fires and prevent after-combustion. A sample machine has passed the national test and it is proved through data that present domestic and foreign automatic fire extinguishing equipment can not reach the unit fire extinguishing grade and automatic protection area of the sample machine provided by the invention. According to the device provided by the invention, rolling springs and pressure springs are used as the power to loosen, stir and rotate the dry powder for fire extinguishing when starting. Temperature limiting glass beads are used as an induction starting part. After starting, the dry powder is vortically and uniformly sprayed in the protection area according to a designed angle. During the operating period, the device does not require detection and maintenance, has advantages of low price and beautiful appearance, and fills gaps in the world where there was no automatic fire extinguishing configuration in intensive fire-fighting monitor places such as oil chemical, dangerous material warehouse, HV switch-house, tunnel and document machine room and the like. An additional power supply of the device can be used to realize synchronized automatic alarm, photoelectric smoke electrothermal starting and electrothermal linkage of device arrays driven after temperature-sensed starting of a single unit.

title_en: Blind guiding crutch
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a blind guiding crutch which comprises a handle, a key operation panel and a crutch body; the handle is connected with the upper end of the key operation panel; a GPS (Global Position System) antenna used for receiving and sending GPS signals is arranged at the upper end of the handle; a battery module for providing system power source is arranged inside the handle; the crutch body is connected with the lower end of the key operation panel; a system circuit board used for processing data is arranged in the key operation panel; a key switch used for operating an embedded system is arranged on the key operation panel; and a strobe light used for warning is further arranged at the upper end of the crutch body. The technical scheme has the benefits that the use is simple, safety and convenience are ensured, multiple assistance functions such as a travel route guidance, information broadcast and emergency situation positioning can be provided for visually handicapped persons, the life of visually handicapped persons is optimized, equipment integrated on the blind guiding crutch does not affect the normal use of the blind guiding crutch, and the blind guiding crutch has the functions of rain prevention, shock resistance and the like.

title_en: Indoor automatic monitoring and fire extinguishing linkage system for fire disaster
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an indoor automatic monitoring and fire extinguishing linkage system for fire disaster, which comprises a set of linkage system. The linkage system is characterized in that a fire alarm is a trigger device of the linkage system, a fireproof electric roller blind is turned on to close a window after a fire alarm signal is fed back to a linkage switch cubicle, so that a source approach of oxygen in air required by burning can be cut off, non-toxic and combustion support-free inert gas in a high-pressure inert gas storing tank can fast flow into a room when an electric air valve is turned on, the indoor air is drawn once a powerful fan is turned on when the fireproof roller blind is completely closed, and the concentration of the oxygen in the indoor air can be fast reduced until the burnt fire source is extinguished since the indoor environment is changed into the sealed special environment by various measures. The aim that the personal casualty and the property loss can be reduced as much as possible since a fire scene can be fast, safely and efficiently isolated and the fire can be automatically extinguished can be achieved.

title_en: Automatic loudspeaker control device for blind persons or vehicles
abstract_en: An automatic control device on a warning loudspeaker of a blind person or a vehicle is used for automatically giving out a warning sound and caution light during walking of the blind person or running of the vehicle, so as to remind a user and others. The automatic loudspeaker control device for blind persons or vehicles does not need to control the loudspeaker to sound along with scenes for a long term, instead, the automatic control device perceiving passerby or running vehicles automatically blow horns; and when the automatic control device approaches the passerby or the running vehicle, analog sounds given by other running motor vehicles are used for warning at first, or a specific sound is used to remind the approached passerby of the types of the approaching vehicles.

title_en: Alert broadcasting to unconfigured communications devices
abstract_en: Methods and systems for communicating alert messages to target communications devices in a target physical location are disclosed. The target devices may not be preconfigured to be discovered or to receive the alert message. Network sources are queried to identify accessible logical locations, which are associated with physical locations in a database. The logical locations include an intelligent network source which, having received the alert message, detects nearby devices in the target physical location. The system prepares and communicates the alert message to the target device. The intelligent network source may be configured to prepare and communicate the alert message without any intermediate system step of formulating a list of recipients. Auto-discovery and message delivery methods employ protocol packet injection, network and access point spoofing, and Bluetooth signaling. Auto-discovery and unconfigured delivery methods can be used to reveal the presence of devices in an area.
assignees: ABU-HAKIMA SUHAYYA;GRIGG KENNETH E;MCFARLAND CONNIE;CHRISTIE COLIN;GUEVREMONT VINCE;PISKORZ OSKAR

title_en: The sense warning device use led indication device
title_ko: 시각경보 장치용 엘이디 표시장치
abstract_ko: 본 고안은 원터치에 의해서 엘이디 기판 및 커버의 조립이 가능토록하고, 또한 커버 내측에 빛 확산을 위한 볼록렌즈를 다수개 형성하여 빛을 고르게 확산시켜 정해진 조도를 유지 시킴으로서 멀리서도 화재 경보기의 위치를 쉽게 식별할 수 있도록 한 것을 특징으로 하는 시각경보 장치용 엘이디 표시장치에 관한 것으로, 본 고안은 시각 경보기 하우징(100)과;  상기 시각 경보기 하우징에 결합되는 엘이디 기판(200)과;  상기 시각 경보기 하우징의 엘이디 기판을 감싸서 결합되는 덮개용 커버(300)를 포함하여 이루어지되.  상기 덮개용 커버(300)는,  하부에 결합용 갈고리(300a)를 다수 형성하고, 외면은 터널형 돔 형태로 이루어지고, 내면은 전체적으로 " "형과 같이 다각형으로 형성하되, 내측 기판 중앙부에 설치된 LED(210)의 정면 위치와 대응되는 덮개용 커버(300) 내측에 볼록렌즈가 길이방향으로 다수개 반복 정렬되어 LED로부터 조사되는 빛을 확산시키는 제 1 볼록렌즈부(310)와;   상기 제 1 볼록렌즈부(310)의 테두면에 인접되도록 경사면으로 형성되고 이의 경사면에 볼록렌즈가 길이방향으로 다수개 반복 정렬되어 빛을 측면으로 확산시키는 제 2 볼록렌즈부(320)와;   상기 경사면에 형성된 제 2 볼록렌즈부(320)의 측면으로 연장 형성되며 LED(210)의 빛을 외부로 방출하며 사출시 금형 코어가 용이하게 이탈될 수 있도록 형성된 단차부(330)로 이루어진 구성이다. 이와 같이 구성된 본 고안은 일반인은 물론 시각장애가 있는 사람들도 본 고안의 시각경보장치의 조명등을 보고 비상상황을 인지하여 빠른 대응과 대피가 가능하게 할 수 있는 시각경보 장치용 엘이디 표시장치에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Network-Based System for Predicting Landslides and Providing Early Warnings
abstract_en: A wireless node for monitoring landslide conditions has at least one tubular probe body deployed in a borehole in a landslide prone area and anchored to rock below soil, multiple sensors carried by and deployed within and or outside of the tubular probe body for measuring geologic motion and hydrologic saturation and pressure at three or more distinct levels of soil above the rock, a power source, a data acquisition board in communication with the sensors carried by and or deployed within or outside of the probe body, and a wireless transceiver in communication with the data acquisition board and accessible to a local area wireless network (LAWN), which is in turn accessible to a wide area wireless network (WAWN).
