title_en: Online SAR target detection method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses an on-line SAR target detection method based on deep learning, which mainly solves the problem of low detection performance in a complex SAR scene in the prior art, and the implementation scheme is as follows: 1. acquiring a training sample slice from the MiniSAR data set; 2. expanding the training sample slice through random translation, and training an end-to-end real-time detection-based model YOLO by using the expanded training sample; 3. carrying out double-parameter Constant False Alarm Rate (CFAR) detection on the SAR image to be detected to obtain a section to be detected; 4. detecting each section to be detected by using the trained model, and merging the detection result into an original image to obtain an SAR image detection result; 5. and continuously updating the model by using the SAR image updated on line and the core set Coreset in the sample library, thereby improving the detection performance of the model. The method improves the detection performance of the target in a complex SAR scene, and can be used for disaster detection, environment detection and resource exploration.

title_en: High-rise building security rescue capsule marble network relay alarm system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a marble network relay alarm system for a high-rise building security rescue capsule, which comprises a capsule body and a rescuer mobile phone APP; the cabin body comprises a marble module, an extravehicular environment sensor module, a control module, a display module, an input module, an image recognition module, a wireless local area network server module, a loudspeaker, a microphone, a camera, a video and audio coding and decoding module, an in-cabin environment sensor module and a power supply module; the marble module comprises an extravehicular camera, a marble cabin, marbles, springs, an ejection module and a three-dimensional holder. The wireless network is established to the cabin body, and the marble pops out, and every marble all is wireless network's relay, extension wireless network coverage, and marble audio alert reminds rescue personnel accessible wireless network and the interior personnel of cabin body to contact, and the cabin interior personnel can talk with rescue personnel's cell-phone APP video, send the inside and outside environmental data of cabin body and image. The invention enlarges the wireless network range and the alarm area, and is convenient for communicating with rescuers.

title_en: Flame detectors viewing all directions
title_ko: 다방향 불꽃감지기
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a flame detector. The present invention comprises: a case main body which is installed to be attached to a ceiling and has a communication module, an alarm module, and a power module mounted on one side; a sensor module which includes a plurality of flame sensors sensing a flame by being installed in a lower end of the case main body while being arranged and installed in a radial direction along a circumference of the case main body and transmits the sensing information of the flame sensors to a control unit; and the control unit which is provided in the case main body to integrally control the communication module, the alarm module, and the power module while calculating, analyzing, and storing the sensing information transmitted through the sensor module. In the provided multi-directional flame detector provided by the present invention, the sensor module comprises: an FPCB which has flexibility to be closely attached along an inner side circumference of the case main body; and the plurality of flame sensors which are arranged at intervals on one surface of the FPCB to correspond to a sensor insertion hole formed in the case main body. The present invention has an effect of: quickly dealing with fire risk by sensing flame in all directions without a blind spot through the sensor module having the plurality of flame sensors; minimizing operation error capable of being generated by hiding a sensor exposing unit by various foreign matters, dust, and insects capable of existing in a place where the present invention is installed; minimizing damage of scene of the installation place through light weight and small size; and securing safety of people from fire risk by promoting popularization through cheap price.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 불꽃감지기에 관한 것으로, 천장에 부착 설치됨과 아울러, 통신모듈, 경보모듈, 전원모듈이 일측에 내장된 케이스본체와; 상기 케이스본체의 둘레를 따라 방사 방향으로 배열 설치됨과 동시에, 상기 케이스본체의 하단에 설치되어 불꽃을 감지하는 복수의 불꽃센서를 포함하며, 이 불꽃센서의 감지정보를 제어부에 전달하는 센서모듈과; 상기 케이스본체의 내부에 구비되어 상기 센서모듈을 통해 전달된 감지정보를 연산, 분석, 저장함과 아울러, 상기 통신모듈, 경보모듈, 전원모듈을 통합적으로 제어하는 제어부로 구성되며, 상기 센서모듈은 상기 케이스본체의 내측면 둘레를 따라 밀착되도록 유연성을 갖는 FPCB와; 상기 케이스본체에 형성된 센서삽입공에 대응하여 상기 FPCB의 일면에 간격을 두고 배열 형성되는 복수의 불꽃센서로 구성되는 것을 특징으로 하는 다방향 불꽃감지기를 제공함으로써, 복수의 불꽃센서를 갖는 센서모듈을 통해 사각지대 없이 전방위로 불꽃을 감지할 수 있어 화재 위험으로부터 신속하게 대처할 수 있으며, 본 발명이 설치된 공간에서 있을 수 있는 다양한 이물질, 먼지, 벌레 등에 의하여 센서 노출부를 가리면서 발생할 수 있는 작동 오류를 최소화하고, 경량화, 소형화를 통해 설치장소의 경관 훼손을 최소화할 수 있는 것은 물론, 저렴화를 통해 보급화를 촉진할 수 있어 누구나 화재 위험으로부터 안전을 보장 받을 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Crime prevention and call signal alarm system using sms service and method thereof
title_ko: Sms 팝업 알림 서비스를 이용한 범죄 징후 차단 및 구조 신호 통보 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for blocking a criminal sign and issuing a rescue signal and a method thereof. The method of the present invention comprises the steps of: wirelessly transmitting a sensing signal of a sensor or a rescue request signal including a personal identification code to a mobile communications alarm repeater installed in an adjacent safety blind spot with an RF signal when an emergency remote controller carrier simply operates a button; outputting, by the mobile communications alarm repeater, an alarm light, an alarm sound, or a rescue voice in response to the reception of the rescue request signal, and simultaneously transmitting a communications modem unique number of the mobile communications alarm repeater with the personal identification code to an emergency management server through a mobile communications network; confirming, by the emergency management server, customer information using the personal identification code, and then requesting a push server to transmit an SMS notification message including a name, an emergency contact phone number, and the like of a corresponding customer; and transmitting, by the push server, the SMS notification message to the emergency contact number by interworking with an application server, and allowing the SMS notification message to be popped-up in a receiver terminal by generating an alarm sound such as a siren and converting the screen into yellow.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 범죄 징후 차단 및 구조 신호 통보 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 감지센서의 감지신호나 비상 리모컨 휴대자가 간단하게 버튼을 조작하면 개인식별코드를 포함하는 구조요청신호가 근방의 안전사각지대에 설치된 이동통신 경보중계기에 RF신호로 무선 전송되고, 이동통신 경보중계기에서는 상기 구조요청신호의 수신에 따라 경광등, 경보음 또는 구조음성을 출력함과 동시에 상기 개인식별코드와 함께 이동통신 경보중계기 자신의 통신모뎀 고유번호를 위기관리서버로 이동통신망으로 전송하며, 위기관리서버에서는 상기 개인식별코드를 이용하여 고객정보를 확인한 후 푸시서버에 해당 고객의 성명, 긴급연락 전화번호, 비상연락 전화번호 등을 포함하는 SMS 알림 메시지를 전송하도록 요청하며, 푸시서버에서는 어플리케이션 서버와 연동하여 상기 긴급연락전화번호에 SMS 알림 메시지를 전송하되, 수신자 단말기에서는 싸이렌 소리와 같은 경고음 울리고 화면이 노란색으로 전환되면서 상기 SMS 알림 메시지가 팝업 되도록 이루어져 있다.

title_en: A kind of development machine tail stopping means
abstract_en: The utility model provides a kind of development machine tail stopping means, belongs to mechanical field.Development machine tail stopping means includes alarm device, universal switch, power supply and spacing block piece, wherein, alarm device is arranged in the driver's cabin of development machine, and universal switch is connected by wire；Universal switch sets the tail end of two fortune of development machine, has the push rod of controlling switch；Spacing block piece is arranged on the front end of belt feeder aircraft tail shelf, can be contacted with push rod and cause push rod to deviate initial position；Wherein, alarm device, power supply and universal switch connect to form loop, and during push rod initial position, universal switch is normally open；When push rod deviates initial position, universal switch is normally off.The device enables driver promptly and accurately to know stop position, avoids development machine casualties and equipment damage caused by it can not be shut down in time in retreating blind area.

title_en: Led lamp system equipped with a function of fire warning
title_ko: 계층 토폴로지 기반 화재 경보 기능 내장 led 조명 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an LED lamp which has a built-in fire alarm linking function. According to a preferred embodiment of the present invention, a master LED lamp included in a LED lamp system which has a built-in fire alarm linking function includes: a first LED module unit emitting light at a color temperature and brightness suitable for an installation space; a lighting control unit for turning the first LED module unit on or off; a fire sensing unit which monitors the fire occurrence in the installation space; and an alarm unit which provides an alarm when the fire sensing unit senses the fire occurrence. The master LED lamp also includes a communication unit for communicating with another master LED lamp of a different household while sharing the fire information between the households. The alarm unit can provide the fire alarm through various media to let users see and hear the fire alarm and recognize the situation regarding the fire. The LED lamp is used to provide the fire alarm. Households can exchange the fire alarm information, enabling all households in an apartment building to quickly respond to a fire. The fire alarm from the LED lamp is provided on an audio-based and visual manner to let visually impaired or hearing-impaired users recognize the fire easily.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재 경보 연동 기능이 내장된 LED 조명에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 바람직한 일 실시예에 따른 화재 경보 기능 내장 LED 조명 시스템은 설치된 공간에 적합한 색온도와 조도로 발광하는 제 1 LED 모듈부, 제 1 LED 모듈부의 온/오프를 제어하는 조명 제어부, 설치된 공간에서의 화재 발생 여부를 모니터링하는 화재 감지부, 화재 감지부에 의해 화재 이벤트가 감지되면 경보를 제공하는 경보부를 구비한 마스터 LED 조명을 포함하고, 마스터 LED 조명은 다른 세대의 마스터 LED 조명과 통신을 제공하는 통신부를 더 포함하며, 통신부를 통해 세대 간 화재 정보를 공유할 수 있다. 이때, 경보부는 시각과 청각으로 화재 상황은 인지할 수 있게 다양한 매체를 통해 화재 경보를 제공할 수 있다. 본 발명은 LED 조명을 통해 화재 경보를 제공할 수 있다. 그리고, 세대 간 화재 경보 정보를 상호 교환할 수 있어 다가구/다세대 주택에서 모든 세대들이 화재에 신속하게 대응하도록 할 수 있다. 또한, LED 조명을 통해 시각과 청각으로 경보를 제공하는 것에 의해 청각 장애인 및 시각 장애인이 쉽게 화재 사실을 인지할 수 있다.

abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of Geological Hazards of debris monitoring system, is related to disaster monitoring system technical field, mainly including user terminal, reception system, early warning radar, multispectral monitoring system, for distribution subsystem and control communication subsystem.The Geological Hazards of debris monitor system performance stabilization of the present invention, the low, high sensitivity that consumes energy, in light weight, detection range is remote, the object that translational speed is 0.5 100s/m can be automatically detected, the generation of the disaster such as rainfall degree and mountain torrents, mud-rock flow can be accurately identified, while solves rainfall monitoring and mud-rock flow in modern saltant type Natural calamity monitoring technology and identifies two hang-ups；Further, monitoring system supports ad-hoc communication/mobile communication/satellite communication Three models, can adaptively switch between Three models, and user can match disparate modules according to the demand of oneself.

title_en: Moving objects collision warning apparatus and method for large vehicle
title_ko: 대형 차량의 이동 객체 충돌 경고 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus and a method for warning a moving object collision of a large vehicle. The apparatus comprises: a rear camera module mounted on at least one side surface of a large vehicle, and photographing a photographed object toward the front of the large vehicle; an image receiving unit receiving an image photographed by the rear camera module; a moving object determining unit for recognizing an image received from the image receiving unit, extracting an object included in the image, and determining whether the extracted object is a moving object including a bicycle, a two-wheeled vehicle, and a pedestrian; a moving object collision possibility determining unit for determining whether the moving object determined by the moving object determining unit is located within a preset dangerous area, and outputting a collision risk signal; a warning unit for outputting a visual or auditory warning signal to a driver of the large vehicle; and a control unit for controlling the warning unit to operate the warning unit when the collision risk signal is outputted from the moving object collision possibility determining unit. According to the present invention, a moving object such as a bicycle, a two-wheeled vehicle, a pedestrian, or the like located within a radius of rotation during rotation of a large vehicle can be accurately identified to warn a driver or to perform emergency braking. Therefore, the present invention has an effect of preventing a coarse life accident occurring in side and rear blind zones of a large vehicle.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 대형 차량의 이동 객체 충돌 경고 장치 및 방법에 관한 것으로서, 본 발명의 대형 차량의 이동 객체 충돌 경고 장치는, 대형 차량의 적어도 일측면 후방에 장착되며 상기 대형 차량의 전방을 지향하여 피촬상물을 촬상하는 후방 카메라 모듈; 상기 후방 카메라 모듈에서 촬상된 영상을 수신하는 영상 수신부; 상기 영상 수신부에서 수신된 영상을 인식하여 영상 내에 포함된 객체를 추출하고 추출된 객체가 자전거, 이륜차, 및 보행자를 포함하는 이동 객체인지를 결정하는 이동 객체 결정부; 상기 이동 객체 결정부에서 결정된 상기 이동 객체가 미리 설정된 위험 구역 내에 위치하는지를 판단하여 충돌 위험신호를 출력하는 이동 객체 충돌 가능성 결정부; 상기 대형 차량의 운전자에게 시각적 또는 청각적 경고신호를 출력하는 경고부; 및 상기 이동 객체 충돌 가능성 결정부에서 충돌 위험신호가 출력되면 상기 경고부를 동작시키도록 제어하는 제어부를 포함한다. 
본 발명에 따르면, 대형 차량의 회전 시에 회전 반경 내 위치한 자전거, 이륜차, 보행자 등의 이동 객체를 정확하게 식별하여 운전자에게 이를 경고하거나 비상 제동을 실시할 수 있고, 이에 따라 대형 차량의 측후방 사각지대에서 발생되는 저속의 인명 피해 사고를 예방할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Notification terminal with text-to-speech amplifier
abstract_en: A mass notification terminal may have a data parser and decoder connected to a communications terminal. Announcements may be transmitted to the communications terminal in the form of linguistic symbols and commands using low bandwidth and low power protocol transmissions. Push transmissions conserve bandwidth. An abstraction of an audio announcement may be transmitted for use with a speech synthesizer. The abstraction may be linguistic symbols such as phenomes, text, or may identify pre-stored clips. The system may provide announcement confirmation. The system may take advantage of communication protocols that have message size limitations. The announcements may be sent in one or more message transmissions. When an announcement is composed of multiple messages, using message sequence numbers and announcement identifications may facilitate grouping and arranging of the messages that make up the announcement.

abstract_en: Conventionally, since scraps are attached on a windshield of a vehicle due to foreign matters or scratches remaining after an illegal parking sticker is removed, disadvantages of causing a traffic accident or being difficult to remove are aroused. To solve such problem, a street alarm device to prevent illegal parking of the present invention comprises: a distance sensor to measure a distance between a vehicle being illegally parked and the sensor; an alarm sound device to issue an alarm sound when the measured distance is less than one meter, and to transfer a report to a related institution; an information transfer communication device to transmit the report; and an information processing device to process information. Accordingly, provided are effects of: alerting illegal parking with a signal through the alarm sound, not an illegal parking sticker; providing a first opportunity to one person illegally parking a vehicle as a report is received when warning is given to the person twice; and using the distance sensor to allow a user to set a distance as much as a required distance (a reference distance is one meter).

title_en: Multi-weight public opinion value calculation method and system and computer
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of networks and discloses a multi-weight public opinion value calculating method, a system and a computer, wherein the multi-weight public opinion value calculating method is used for scoring public opinion values by combining five characteristics of media weight, media channel weight, layout position weight, positive and negative emotion and information exposure rate; determining channels and weights of media through breadth-first traversal collection; determining the importance of the reports in the layout through a layout recognition algorithm; determining the emotional intensity of the whole report through emotional tendency calculation; calculating information exposure rate through sorting in the search engine; and unifying the related elements of the public sentiment value together to carry out quantitative calculation of the public sentiment value. title_en: Moving Robot and controlling method

abstract_en: The present invention relates to a mobile robot and a mobile robot control method. The mobile robot monitors a cleaning region by capturing an image while moving in a plurality of regions based on a map of the cleaning region. With the present invention, monitoring can be performed with a plurality of regions or a specific region designated. It is possible to monitor the entire region by capturing an image while rotating at a monitoring position by designating the monitoring position in the region. It is possible to set a specific position as the monitoring position in the region and perform imaging at a specific imaging angle with a monitoring direction designated at the monitoring position. Monitoring can be performed on a plurality of regions with a minimum movement. It is possible to capture an image of a blind spot by changing or adding the monitoring position based on obstacle information, and thus effective monitoring can be performed. A schedule can be set for monitoring at a specified time, and intrusion can be detected based on image analysis-based obstacle recognition. In the event of intrusion, a warning is output and an intrusion detection signal is transmitted, and thus security can be enhanced.

본 발명은 이벤트 서버가 구비되어 안정성을 높인 비상벨-CCTV 통합 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 보다 구체적으로는 이벤트 서버가 구비되어 안정성을 높인 비상벨-CCTV 통합 시스템으로서, 건물내주차장의 안전 사각지대에 설치되며, 위급상황 시에 사용자 조작 실행에 따라 구동되어 미리 설정된 비상벨 신호를 발생시키는 비상벨 장치와, 건물내주차장의 안전 사각지대에 설치되어 주변 지역을 감시 촬영하고, 상기 비상벨 장치에서 발생시키는 비상벨 신호를 수신하도록 자동 연결되는 카메라를 구비하는 이벤트 감시 장치; 상기 이벤트 감시 장치와 네트워크를 매개로 단일 망으로 연결 접속되며, 상기 이벤트 감시 장치의 카메라를 통해 촬영되는 감시 영상을 수신하여 디스플레이하고, 상기 이벤트 감시 장치의 비상벨 장치에서 발생시킨 비상벨 신호에 대응하여 비상상황 경고 및 비상 호출을 위한 비상벨 이벤트를 처리하기 위해 관제실에 구비되는 NVR(Network Video Recorder); 및 비상호출이 발생한 비상벨 장치의 해당 지역으로 경비원이 출동하여 위급상황에 신속한 대처가 가능하도록 상기 NVR로부터 비상벨 이벤트 발생에 따른 위치 정보와 영상 정보가 포함된 비상벨 이벤트 신호를 수신하기 위해 경비실에 각각 설치되는 CMS(Central Management System)를 포함하는 것을 그 구성상의 특징으로 한다. 
본 발명에서 제안하고 있는 이벤트 서버가 구비되어 안정성을 높인 비상벨-CCTV 통합 시스템에 따르면, 양방향 통화 기능이 구비된 비상벨 장치를 카메라부의 오디오 보드에 연결하여 비상벨 신호를 수신하도록 하고, 단일 망으로 형성되는 네트워크를 매개로 NVR이 접속 연결되며, NVR에 연결되는 경비실에 구비되는 복수의 CMS를 포함하되, NVR에 이벤트 서버를 더 구성하여 N개의 이벤트 소스가 M개의 클라이언트에 동시 이벤트 전송이 가능하도록 구성함으로써, 비상벨 이벤트 발생이 손실 없이 안정적으로 전달되고, 그에 따른 비상벨-CCTV의 통합 운용 관리가 안전하게 관리 유지될 수 있도록 할 수 있다. 
또한, 본 발명에 따르면, 이벤트 서버에서 N개의 이벤트 소스가 M개의 클라이언트에 동시 이벤트 전송이 가능하도록 N:1:M으로 이벤트 송신 클라이언트와 이벤트 전송 처리부 및 이벤트 수신 클라이언트를 구성하되, 이벤트 전송 처리부의 입/출력단에 버퍼 큐를 구성하여 이벤트 손실 발생을 최소화하고, 셀프 와치 독 기능을 이벤트 전송 처리부에 구성함으로써, 프로그램 버그 시 자동으로 재시작 하도록 하여 동작의 연속성이 안정적으로 보장될 수 있도록 할 수 있다. 
뿐만 아니라, 본 발명은, 범죄예방을 위한 안전 사각지대로 지목되는 건물내주차장에 설치되는 비상벨 장치와 카메라들의 배관/배선을 카메라 선로를 이용하여 시공 공정을 단순화하여 공정 원가를 절감하고, 또한 위급상황 시에 긴급호출을 통한 도움 요청과 함께 양방향 통화를 제공함으로써, 빈번하게 발생하는 안전 사각지대의 위험요소에 대한 신속하고 정확한 상황대처로 사고를 미연에 방지하며, 그에 따른 사용자의 불안감 해소와 안전한 생활공간 및 범죄를 사전에 예방할 수 있도록 할 수 있다.

title_en: Detecting Apparatus Capable of Detecting Foreign Materials for Extruder
title_ko: 압출기용 이물질 감지장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an extruder comprising: an extruding unit, a kneading block and a screw, a resin discharging unit, and a seal box. The extruding unit includes a hopper in an upper part of one side and is horizontally combined with a plurality of feed barrels. The kneading block and the screw are mounted inside the extruding unit, are driven and rotated by a motor (not shown), and mix and extrude resin. The resin discharging unit is formed in one side of the extruding unit. The seal box is formed in the other side of the extruding unit. According to the present invention, a foreign substance sensing device for an extruder is provided with a vibration sensing sensor mounted on a lower part of a body of a feed barrel with a screw embedded therein adjacent to a feed barrel with the kneading block embedded therein. The foreign substance sensing device for an extruder informs an alarm to a worker with light and sounds by a control unit, and stops driving of the extruder when a vibration frequency measured from the vibration sensing sensor is higher than a vibration frequency of an extruder normal driving state which is set in advance. The present invention extrudes the resin by using the extruder, and rapidly finds and removes foreign substances inside the extruder with a simple structure, which are wrongly received with the resin. Therefore, the present invention can prevent damage of the extruder, minimize downtime, and be manufactured with relative low costs.

title_en: Stadium outdoor site emergency refuge instant use condition prediction control method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a prediction control method for the emergency refuge instant use condition of an outdoor place of a stadium, which comprises the following steps: (a) accessing a database of a stadium monitoring center to a China earthquake platform network to acquire real-time earthquake information; (b) inputting a burst early warning parameter into a database of a monitoring center of a stadium, and setting an early warning threshold value of the burst early warning parameter; (d) acquiring the flow of evacuated people through a plurality of network cameras arranged outside the stadium, and displaying the flow on monitoring equipment of a monitoring center of the stadium; (e) people flow is guided to evacuate according to the evacuation route through broadcast broadcasting. title_en: Infrastructure based backup and exit aid
abstract_en: Infrastructure-based warning system having the ability to detect cross-traffic long before onboard vehicle sensors, and broadcast a basic safety message (BSM) including the vehicle's global position, velocity, heading, etc. over dedicated short-range communication (DSRC). A vehicle leaving a parking space is able to receive broadcast over DSRC from infrastructure and provide the driver with an HMI warning that it is unsafe to backup. A vehicle exiting from a blind alley way or parking garage may be positioned such that the driver of the vehicle may not see that there is a pedestrian about to cross and that there is cross-traffic. The infrastructure mounted sensor is able to detect the pedestrian and cross-traffic and broadcast their location, velocity, and headings. The vehicle receives the BSM from the infrastructure and provides the driver with an HMI warning that it is unsafe to move out into the crosswalk and road.

title_en: Railway foreign matter invasion safety sensing and identifying system based on distributed optical fiber sensing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a railway foreign matter invasion safety sensing and identifying system based on distributed optical fiber sensing, which is based on two distributed optical fiber sensing technologies and a video linkage technology: monitoring vibration intrusion signals generated when illegal personnel, vehicles and construction intrudes into a high-speed railway by using a phase optical time domain analysis technology, and giving information such as positions and events of the intrusion signals; when large-scale falling rocks and debris flows invade a high-speed railway, a brillouin optical time domain analysis technology is utilized to monitor a high-speed railway fence deformation signal generated, and information such as the position of the invasion signal is given; when any one of the two optical fiber sensing systems or the two optical fiber sensing systems generate an alarm, the two optical fiber sensing systems can be linked with cameras arranged on the high-speed railway tower pole to call a monitoring picture of an intrusion event. The three subsystems work synchronously, learn each other, monitor intrusion layer by layer, and jointly realize early warning and recognition of high-speed railway foreign matter intrusion.

abstract_en: The utility model discloses intelligent blind-guiding walking sticks, it is related to electronic circuit technology field, including battle body and handle, controller, ultrasonic distance measurement circuit, photoelectric alarm circuit, voice alarm circuit and telecommunication circuit are installed inside battle body, liquid crystal display, vibrating motor and multiple keys are installed inside handle.When user presses the essential information that liquid crystal display when information shows key shows user；In the distance that ultrasonic distance measurement circuit detects when other than secure threshold, vibrating motor vibration, while voice alarm circuit issues alarm sound；After user presses household's help key, controller obtains the current location of walking stick by A7 chip, and it is sent to the mobile phone terminal of guardian by A7 chip, prompts guardian to go to immediately and checks.Above-mentioned intelligent blind-guiding walking stick keeps the trip of blind person more humanized, and improves the safety coefficient that blind person goes on a journey alone.When meeting emergency situations by chance, itself safety can be ensured by various help modes.

title_en: A kind of fire-fighting link device in automatic transmission decline machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the fire-fighting link devices in a kind of automatic transmission decline machine, belong to field of mechanical technique, it solves the problems, such as that automatic decline machine fire-fighting roller shutter in the prior art is not available.Fire-fighting link device in this automatic transmission decline machine, including delivery track, electric control gear, fire resisting shutter, delivery track includes track and movable rail after track, fire-fighting before fire-fighting, the translation mechanism that control movable rail is detached from track after track and fire-fighting before fire-fighting is additionally provided in rack, fire resisting shutter is set to the top before fire-fighting after track and fire-fighting between track, and electric control gear can receive fire-fighting alarm signal and send before signal control translation mechanism drives movable rail to be detached from fire-fighting track after track and fire-fighting to concede the space of fire resisting shutter decline.The advantages of having structure simple with the automatic transmission decline machine of this fire-fighting link device, promote security against fire.
assignees: SHANGHAI LIGELANG ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire monitoring system and method
title_ko: 화재 감시 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to fire monitoring system and method for monitoring a fire in real time by using a blind spot detection (BSD) camera. The system comprises: camera devices which are provided in fire monitoring areas, photograph the fire monitoring areas in real time and transmit the captured BSD image; a fire monitoring server which previously sets and stores information on a flame image in a memory, receives the BSD image transmitted from the camera devices, monitors occurrence of a fire by identifying whether the flame image stored in the memory is included in the BSD image, and generates and transmits a fire alarm signal when the fire occurs; and a plurality of fire receiving terminals which inform the occurrence of the fire by receiving the fire alarm signal transmitted from the fire monitoring server.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 BSD(Blind Spot Detection) 카메라를 이용하여 실시간으로 화재를 감시할 수 있도록 구현한 화재 감시 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 카메라장치가 화재감시영역에 설치되어, 화재감시영역을 실시간으로 촬영하여 촬영된 BSD 영상을 전송하며; 메모리에 화염이미지에 대한 정보를 미리 설정하여 저장해 두었다가, 상기 카메라장치로부터 전송되는 BSD 영상을 수신받아, 메모리에 저장된 화염이미지가 BSD 영상에 포함되어 있는지를 식별하여 화재 발생 유무를 감시하며, 화재 발생 시에 화재알림신호를 생성시켜 전송하는 화재 감시 서버; 및 상기 화재 감시 서버로부터 전송되는 화재알림신호를 수신받아 화재 발생을 알려주는 복수 개의 화재수신단말을 포함하는 화재 감시 시스템을 포함한다.

title_en: System for a monitored and reconstructible personal rendezvous session
abstract_en: Disclosed is a system that adapts a personally portable “smart” communications device to enhance a user's personal security by continuously monitoring an alert function of the device from a remote location during a user initiated “session.” The user device is in communications with a remote server, which monitors the alert function and provides: accurate preservation of session data; monitoring of user device ambient conditions; dispatch of emergency services; and notification of third parties. Server software (host application) on the remote server manages communications with user devices. The server collects, processes and stores data; dispenses data according to a rule set, and manages multiple user sessions. User software manages the initiation and conduct of a session and communications with the server. The user and server software in combination provide for establishing, maintaining operations of the system, and databases accessible by the remote server for storage/archiving of system data.

title_en: Wireless neighborhood wildfire defense system network supporting proactive protection of life and property in a neighborhood through gps-tracking and mapping of environmentally-clean anti-fire (af) chemical liquid spray applied to the property before wild fires reach the neighborhood
abstract_en: A wireless wild fire defense system network supporting proactive protection of life and property in GPS-specified neighborhoods using GPS-managed delivery of environmentally-clean anti-fire (AF) chemical liquid spray to property before wild fire reaches the neighborhoods. The wireless system network includes a GPS system for providing GPS-location services to each system components in the wireless system network. A wireless communication network supports one or more network databases accessible by systems and devices deployed on the wireless communication network. A fleet of mobile GPS-tracked anti-fire liquid spraying systems are assigned to GPS-specified neighborhoods for spraying anti-fire chemical liquid on combustible property, buildings, and ground cover to inhibit fire ignition and flame spread wherever the anti-fire chemical liquid is sprayed. When allowed to dry, the anti-fire chemical liquid provides fire-protection status to sprayed property that is GPS-tracked and mapped within a network database maintained on the wireless communication network, recording wherever the environmentally-safe anti-fire chemical liquid has been spray applied. The system network includes mobile computing systems, each running a mobile application and deployed to a property owner, spray contractor or other stakeholder, such as firefighters and property insurance inspectors, for remotely monitoring the fire-protection status of property in any GPS-specified neighborhood, at any time on any specified date, along with the status of active wild fires surrounding the neighborhood. A command center deployed on the wireless system network transmits wild fire alerts and notifications and property spray orders, and supports microservices configured for monitoring and managing GPS-tracked spraying operations within GPS-specified neighborhoods. Through GPS-managed delivery of anti-fire chemical liquid spray on property surfaces before arrival of wild fire, fire ignition and flame spread are inhibited, and human and animal life and property are protected.

title_en: Method for controlling alarm in the electric range
title_ko: 전기레인지의 경보 제어방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for controlling alarm of an electric range to sound alarm when emergency situation that a cooking vessel positioned on top of a top plate in an electric range moves or foreign matters occur on an upper surface of a top plate occurs. The method comprises the steps of: controlling a fuel intake driving unit according to a crater operation key signal to drive a fuel intake by a control unit; determining whether a cooking vessel positioned in the fuel intake is moved in response to a detection signal of a vessel movement detection unit by the control unit; and controlling an alarm generating unit to sound alarm the movement of the cooking vessel and stop the fuel intake when the movement of the cooking vessel is determined by the control unit.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 전기레인지에서 상판의 상부에 위치시킨 조리용기가 이동하거나 또는 상판의 상면에 이물질 등이 발생하는 등의 이상상황이 발생할 경우에 이를 경보하는 것으로서 화구 동작 키신호에 제어부가, 화구 동작 키신호에 따른 해당 화구 구동부를 제어하여 해당 화구를 구동시키는 단계와, 상기 제어부가, 용기이동 검출부의 검출신호로 상기 해당 화구에 위치된 조리용기의 이동 여부를 판단하는 단계와, 상기 제어부가, 상기 조리용기의 이동이 판단될 경우에 경보 발생부를 제어하여 조리용기의 이동을 경보하고 상기 해당 화구를 정지시키는 단계를 포함하는 전기레인지의 경보 제어방법에 관한 것이다.

title_en: criminal note
title_ko: 범죄노트
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a criminal note capable of solving a problem with the low provision of overall criminal information by enabling a user to conveniently acquire information about crimes and crime-ridden districts located near a residential district and information and positions of sex offenders. The present invention comprises: a server part forming a network system and configuring an exclusive server to transmit criminal information to a smartphone; an emergency module transmitting crime and help messages to acquaintances in an emergency contact list which is basically set; and an information providing part forming a customized information system and a network between the server part and each smartphone application.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 범죄노트 에 관한 것으로서 기존의 인지도가 부족한 관련기관의 범죄정보검색보다는 간편한 접근성으로 자기 주위나 거주지역에 위치한 우범지역과 범죄관련 정보 및 성범죄전과자 위치와 정보를 간편히 취득함으로서 범죄예방률을 높이고 각 개인의 범죄 대처 능률을 높일 수 있음하도록 함으로써 기존의 기존의 범죄정보제공사이트는 개별 정부기관마다 제각기 운영하여 정보의 접근성이 떨어지며 정보의 혼란이 올 수 있으며 종합적인 범죄정보 제공능력이 떨어지는 문제점을 해소 하도록 한 것이다. 즉 본 발명은,  범죄정보제공 사이트에 있어서 스마트폰 어플리케이션에 긴급문자 지역 경찰기관에  발송 및 개별 정부기관에 범죄 정보 수집 및 통합운용와 스마트폰에 범죄정보 발송 할 수 있게 전용서버 구성 및 네트워크 시스템 형성한 서버부, 범죄 위급상황시 비상경보사이렌 울림과 기본설정된 비상전화목록에 지인들에게 범죄및 구조문자 발송 스마트폰 어플리케이션으로 긴급모듈 구성한 긴급모듈, 각 정부기관에서 수집된 범죄 관련 정보 와 자기 거주 지역 주변 전과자 및 우범지역 과 범죄 발생률 그리고 범죄 전후와 관련하여 행동요령과 대처방안에 정보를 구축된 서버에서 각 스마트폰으로 개별 발송 할 수 있게 서버부와 각 스마트폰 어플리케이션 사이에 네트워크를 형성 및 개별 맞춤 정보 체계 구성한 정보제공으로 구성한 것이다. 따라서, 본 발명은 기존의 인지도가 부족한 관련기관의 범죄정보검색보다는 간편한 접근성으로 자기 주위나 거주지역에 위치한 우범지역과 범죄관련 정보 및 성범죄전과자 위치와 정보를 간편히 취득함으로서 범죄예방률을 높이고 각 개인의 범죄 대처 능률을 높일 수 있음하도록 함으로써 기존의 기존의 범죄정보제공사이트는 개별 정부기관마다 제각기 운영하여 정보의 접근성이 떨어지며 정보의 혼란이 올 수 있으며 종합적인 범죄정보 제공능력이 떨어지는 문제점을 해소하도록 한 효과를 갖는 것이다.

title_en: IOT security alleyway signal light
title_ko: Iot 방범 골목길 신호등
abstract_en: The present invention relates to IoT (Internet of Things) security alleyway signal light. The purpose of the present invention is to prevent the fender-bender between vehicles in the blind spot of a road (alleyway) and a back road and to inform a pedestrian of the presence of the vehicles to assist in safe walking. The present invention notifies of the priority of road (alleyway) intersection passage according to directions from which the vehicles are detected and notifies drivers of the presence or absence (direction) of the vehicles, thereby preventing the fender-bender, and allows pedestrian bottom notification lights (21) to flash on sidewalks in the directions from which the vehicles are detected to notify a pedestrian walking on the sidewalks of the vehicle coming, thereby preventing a pedestrian accident. The present invention can prevent the fender-bender between the vehicles by previously notifying the driver of the presence or absence of the vehicles in the blind spot of the road (alleyway) in which the drive does not know whether a vehicle comes and notifying of the priority of passage. In addition, the safety of the pedestrian can be ensured from an invisible vehicle, and the safety can be ensured through an emergency call button (23) when an emergency situation occurs. Vehicle sensors (20) can collect traffic analysis data for each road, and embedded CCTVs (13) can be used for illegal parking and stopping as well as for crime prevention.
abstract_ko:
1.기술분야/해결과제 
본 발명은 도로(골목길) 및 이면도로의 사각지대에서 차량과 차량의 접촉사고를 미리 방지하고, 보행자에게는 차량의 존재를 알려주어 안전한 보행을 돕기 위한 것이다. 
2. 해결수단 
본 발명은 차량이 감지되는 방향에 따라 도로(골목길) 교차로 통과 우선순위를 알려주고, 차량의 존재 유, 무(방향)를 운전자에게 알려주어 접촉사고를 미리 방지할 수 있다. 
또한, 차량이 감지된 방향의 인도 위에는 보행자 바닥 알림등(21)이 깜빡여 그곳을 걸어오는 보행자에게 차량이 오고 있음을 알려주어 보행자 사고도 방지한다. 
3. 기대효과 
본 발명에 따르면 차량의 진입 여부를 알 수 없는 도로(골목길) 사각지대에서 차량의 존재를 운전자에게 미리 알려 줄 뿐 아니라 통과 우선순위를 알려줌으로써 차량의 접촉사고를 방지할 수 있다. 
또한, 보이지 않는 차량으로부터 보행자의 안전을 확보하고, 위급한 상황이 발생시 긴급호출버튼(23)을 통한 안전을 확보할 수 있다.  
차량감지 센스(20)는 도로별 통행량 분석자료를 모을 수 있으며, 내장된 CCTV(13)는 불법 주·정차단속으로도 활용할 수 있을 뿐 아니라 범죄예방으로도 활용될 수 있다.

title_en: System for Alarm Broadcasting using UAS
title_ko: 무인 비행체를 이용한 경보 방송 시스템
abstract_en: According to the present invention, in the event of a disaster, an alarm broadcasting system using an unmanned aerial vehicle allows to rapidly spread situation of the disaster to shadow and blind spots of the alarm, such as disaster areas, inside buildings in major institutions and densely populated areas, and mountainous areas. Therefore, alarm situation may be transmitted to residents in the buildings and non-receivers of the alarm in the mountainous areas that existed as shaded areas of conventional alarm broadcasting system, thereby allowing proactive respond to the alarm situation to reduce or prevent personal injury and property loss.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 무인 비행체를 이용한 경보 방송 시스템에 따르면, 재난 상황 발생 시 미리 설정된 지역을 무인 비행하는 무인 비행체를 이용하여 신속하게 재난 지역, 주요 기관 및 인구 밀집 지역의 건물 내부와 산간 지역과 같은 경보 방송 음영 및 사각 지대로 재난 상황을 전파할 수 있도록 하여, 기존 방식의 경보 전파에 음영 지역으로 존재하던 건물 내 거주민들과 산간 지역의 경보 미 청취자들에게 경보 상황을 전달함으로써, 경보 상황에 대하여 능동적인 대처를 할 수 있도록 하여 인명 피해와 재산 손실을 줄이거나 방지할 수 있도록 하는 효과가 있다.

title_en: The manufacturing method of feed by using food waste device
title_ko: 음식물 처리기기를 이용한 사료 및 퇴비의 제조방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for manufacturing feed and compost using a food treatment device, which efficiently removes harmful bacteria and moisture. The method of the present invention comprises: a step (B1) of inputting a food waste into a hopper; a step (B2) of separating foreign substances; a crushing and grinding step (B3); a step (B4) of separating a solid and waste liquid; a step (B5) of sterilizing harmful bacteria and removing moisture; a step (B6) of fermenting the solid; a step (B7) of mixing grains and basic chemicals with the fermented solid; a step (B8) of drying the mixed solid; and a step (B9) of packaging and shipping a molded and dried pellet.
abstract_ko:
발명은 음식물 쓰레기 내에 함유된 유해세균과 수분의 제거가 효율적으로 이루어지면서도, 비교적 저가인 열원을 사용함으로써 음식물 쓰레기 처리비용을 대폭 절감할 수 있도록 한, 저비용 고효율의 환경친화적 음식물 쓰레기 재활용방법에 관한 것이다. 
종래의 음식물 쓰레기를 이용한 사료제조공정은, 음식물 쓰레기 수거차량에 의하여 수거된 음식물 쓰레기를 호퍼에 투입하여(A1) 금속성 물질이나 비닐 등의 이물질을 분리하는 단계와(A2), 이를 잘게 부수는 파쇄 단계(A3), 보일러를 이용하여 고온·고압의 스팀자켓 내에서 살균하는 멸균 단계(A4), 고형물과 폐액을 분리하는 분리단계(A5), 분리된 고형물을 건조시키는 단계(A6), 건조된 고형물에 미생물을 첨가하여 발효시키는 단계(A7), 발효된 고형물에 곡물을 배합하는 단계(A8), 마지막으로 이를 펠릿(pellet)으로 성형하고 건조하여(A9) 일정 단위별로 포장 및 출하하는 단계(A10)로 이루어져 있다. 
그러나, 상기와 같은 종래의 처리방법에 있어서는, 멸균을 성공적으로 달성하기 위해서 일정하게 고온을 유지해 주면서 상당 시간 동안 계속 가열하여야 하므로 일정한 온도 유지에 따른 기술적인 어려움은 물론 저효율, 고비용의 경제적 부담에 따라 사업의 경제성이 거의 없는 문제점이 있었다. 
반면, 종래 방법에 따를 경우에는 상기와 같은 과다한 운영비용에도 불구하고, 멸균이나 수분의 제거가 만족할 만한 수준으로 이루어지지 못하고 따라서 완제품 사료의 수분함량이 과다하여 궁극적으로는 완제품 사료의 상품가치가 하락하고 제품의 변질로 인하여 보관기간이 짧아지는 단점이 있었다. 
아울러, 단위 시간 내에 처리할 수 있는 음식물 쓰레기의 양이 제한되고, 작업자가 화상이나 폭발 등의 재해 위험에 상시 노출되는 안전상의 문제가 내재하고 있었으며, 나아가 음식물 쓰레기를 재활용한다는 점에만 주안점을 둔 나머지, 
음식물 쓰레기의 처리시에 발생하는 폐액에 대해서는 별다른 처리공정 없이 방류하거나 해양에 투기함으로써 토양이나 수자원을 오염시켜 온 것이 동업계의 현실이었다. 
본 발명은 상기한 문제점을 해결하기 위하여 안출된 것으로서, 본 발명의 목적은 고난도의 기술로서 가능한 비교적 염가인 열원을 사용함으로써 2차 환경오염 없이 비용이 저렴하면서도 멸균이나 건조 및 발효가 완벽하게 이루어지는 저비용, 고효율의 음식물 쓰레기를 이용한 사료 또는 퇴비의 제조방법을 제공하는 것이다. 
본 발명의 다른 목적은, 음식물 쓰레기를 재활용함에 있어서 부수적으로 발생하는 폐액을 환경관련법 기준에 맞게 적절히 처리함으로써 환경보호 차원에서 완벽한 음식물 쓰레기의 재활용 방법을 제공하는 것이다. 
상기한 목적을 달성하기 위한 본 발명은, 음식물 쓰레기의 처리 단계에 소요되는 열원(熱源)으로서 대용량의 고주파를 사용함을 특징으로 한다. 
아울러, 열원으로서 고주파를 사용함에 따라 고형물의 멸균, 건조공정이 하나의 단계로 이루어질 수 있는 점을 특징으로 한다. 
본 발명은 또한, 음식물 쓰레기 수거차량에 의하여 수거된 음식물 쓰레기를 처리하고 재활용함에 있어서, 고형물과 폐액을 분리하는 분리단계와 분리된 고형물을 멸균·건조시키는 단계가 순차적으로 포함되어 있는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Single-component probe P wave first arrival time correction method for mine earthquake alarm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for correcting the first arrival time of a P wave of a single-component probe for mine earthquake alarm, which is particularly suitable for the technical field of coal mining and coal mine safety. Analyzing the P wave first arrival time of the vibration waveform on the channel corresponding to the single-component probe by adopting a P wave first arrival picking method; intercepting the waveform of the vibration waveform at the beginning of recording time period as a background noise signal, and calculating the average value of the background noise signal to be used for translating the vibration waveform to obtain the translated vibration signal waveform; calculating a waveform envelope curve in a time period, and calculating a standard value according to the envelope curve; and judging whether the standard value requirement is met or not, and finally determining the first arrival time of the corrected P wave. The method improves the accuracy and reliability of waveform P wave first arrival identification and mine earthquake focus positioning on each single-component probe, and has strong practicability, reliable result and wide application range.

title_en: Sleep safe alarm device
abstract_en: The technical development of the Sleep Safe product is intended to assist the hearing impaired to become aware of a smoke detector becoming active in their home. It will allow the person to wake safely and evacuate. It does this by detecting the smoke detector alert then providing auditory, visual and vibration alerts to wake the sleeping person. The Sleep Safe alarm system will be able to sense the house smoke detector siren wirelessly. The alarm detector listens to the smoke detector and communicates with the Base Unit. Once the smoke detector siren is sensed by the Sleep Safe unit, it will then switch on immediately and warn the sleeping person with a bright light, audible voice alarm announcing WARNING, FIRE, WAKE UP and also a vibrating pad directly wired from the Sleep Safe unit to the pillow or mattress pads. The Sleep Safe alarm system comprises of an Alarm Detector to this frequency band and has the advantage with longer wave-length and better wall penetration. The Alarm Detector includes an external microphone so that it can only detect the smoke alarm siren.

abstract_ko: 본 발명은 골프 시계 대여 방법에 관한 것으로, 앱을 통하여 골프시계 대여에 대한 정보를 입출력할 수 있고, 상기 골프시계에 저장된 점수와 랭킹을 확인할 수 있는 소비자단말기, 골프장 별로 마련되며, 상기 골프시계를 대여할 수 있도록 동작하는 키오스크, 상기 키오스크와 연동되어 마련되며, 내부에 상기 골프시계가 충전, 반납, 고장반납이 가능한 보관함, 앱을 통해서 상기 소비자단말기 및 키오스크의 정보를 확인 및 관리하는 본사단말기, 상기 소비자단말기, 키오스크 및 본사단말기와 연동되어 각종 정보를 저장 및 연산처리하는 서버를 포함하고, 관리자가 상기 본사단말기의 앱을 통하여 골프장 위치와 상기 골프시계의 정보를 등록하는 제 1단계, 소비자가 상기 소비자단말기로 앱을 다운하여 상기 소비자의 성명, 주민번호, 전화번호, 계좌번호, 소속된 실내·외 골프 연습장을 입력하여 회원가입하고, 상기 소비자가 외국인인 경우 여권 및 신용카드 정보 중에 하나를 입력하여 회원가입하며, 지문, 얼굴, 홍채 중 하나를 포함하는 2차 인증수단을 등록하며, 회원가입 정보와 2차 인증수단 정보가 상기 서버에 저장되는 제 2단계, 소비자가 상기 소비자단말기로 로그인하는 제 3단계, 상기 소비자가 로그인 입력 횟수를 초과하는 경우 상기 소비자단말기에서 로그인 오류를 선택하면 상기 서버에서 상기 소비자단말기로 로그인할 수 있도록 설정하는 제 4단계, 상기 소비자가 상기 소비자단말기로 로그인하면, 잔여 이용권 횟수, 이전에 사용했던 상기 골프시계 종류, 골프장 랭킹, 소속된 실내·외 연습장 랭킹, 게임방 생성, 게임방 입장을 확인하는 제 5단계, 상기 제 5단계에서 잔여 이용권 횟수가 부족한 경우, 이용권 결제창을 선택하고 이용권을 결제하고 상기 서버에서 상기 소비자단말기로 이용권 횟수를 추가하는 6단계, 상기 소비자가 상기 소비자단말기로 상기 골프시계가 배치된 골프장 위치를 선택하는 제 7단계, 상기 소비자가 상기 소비자단말기로 사용법 및 대여방법 알림을 확인하는 제 8단계, 상기 소비자가 상기 소비자단말기로 상기 골프시계를 선택하는 제 9단계, 상기 소비자가 상기 소비자단말기로 예약신청하면, 상기 서버는 해당되는 상기 소비자단말기의 이용권 횟수를 차감하며, 대여정보를 저장하고 해당 골프장의 상기 키오스크로 대여정보를 전달하는 제 10단계, 대여시간 전에 상기 서버에서 상기 소비자단말기로 대여시간 알림과 대여정보를 전달하고, 사용법 및 반납방법을 전달하는 제 11단계, 상기 소비자가 해당 골프장의 상기 키오스크로 대여를 선택하고 2차 인증수단을 인식하는 제 12단계, 상기 소비자가 상기 키오스크로 골프장 위치와 상기 골프시계 정보를 확인하는 제 13단계, 상기 키오스크에 마련된 상기 보관함이 열리고, 상기 소비자가 상기 골프시계를 대여하는 제 14단계, 상기 소비자가 상기 골프시계를 테스트하여 이상여부를 확인하는 제 15단계, 상기 제 15단계에서 상기 골프시계에 이상이 발생하는 경우 상기 소비자가 상기 키오스크를 통해 고장반납을 선택하고 2차 인증수단을 인식하는 제 16단계, 상기 보관함이 열리고, 상기 소비자가 상기 키오스크를 통해 오염, 분실, 도난, 파손, 침수 중에 하나를 선택하여 상기 대여시간 종료 알림을 전달하는 제 21단계, 상기 소비자가 상기 골프시계를 테스트하여 이상여부를 확인하는 제 22단계, 상기 제 22단계에서 상기 골프시계가 이상이 없는 경우, 상기 소비자가 상기 키오스크로 반납을 선택하고 2차 인증수단을 인식하여 상기 보관함을 열고 상기 골프시계를 충전연결하여 상기 골프시계를 반납하는 제 23단계, 상기 제 22단계에서 title_en: Optimized urgent scenario and emergency scenario mass/group messaging/notifications/communications service exposed/delivered via web user interface and mobile device application
abstract_en: Systems, methods, and devices for simultaneously distributing mass notifications to multiple users. A mass notification system receives input data and, based on this input data, creates notifications for mass distribution for urgent scenarios and emergency scenarios via Short Message Service (SMS) and/or Voice communication (audio recording or text to speech) The notifications are then transmitted to devices used by the users who are to be notified. The communication network control system confirms the indication of the emergency situation to the mobile device and notifies emergency personnel of the indication of the emergency situation. The communication network control system transmits an indication of the emergency situation to one or more additional mobile devices in the area. The message text and or voice recording is pre-configured/pre-set by the valid user. Target recipient groups for message/notification are also pre-configured/pre-set by the valid user.

title_en: Experimental device for testing impact damage and electromagnetic radiation effect of gas-containing coal rock
abstract_en: The invention relates to a testing experimental device for impact damage and electromagnetic radiation effect of coal rock containing gas, which comprises an electromagnet, a heavy hammer, a hammer barrel, a glass fiber heating belt, an impact generation sealed cabin, a nylon rod (PA-66), organic glass, a coal rock sample, an impact force sensor, a metal shielding net, a vacuum pump, a computer, a data acquisition system, a temperature probe, a temperature sensor, a strain gauge, an electromagnetic radiation receiving antenna, a gas tank, a fixing bolt, a harness cord bolt, an air inlet valve, an air outlet valve, an air inlet hole, an air outlet hole, a lead threading hole, a flange and a flange blind plate. The electromagnetic radiation signal is suitable for measuring the coal rock impact damage electromagnetic radiation signal in the gas-rich environment, is helpful for really researching the impact load and the influence rule between the structural characteristics of the coal body and the characteristics of the electromagnetic radiation signal such as amplitude, energy and frequency in the coal rock impact damage process in the gas-containing environment, provides theoretical basis for the prevention and early warning of the dynamic disaster of the coal rock of the gas-containing coal mine, and has strong practicability.

title_en: Blind area monitoring and alarming system of agricultural harvester
abstract_en: The invention discloses a blind area monitoring and alarming system of an agricultural harvester, which comprises a main body, wherein the lower side of the main body is connected with a moving device, the main body is connected with a control room, one side of the main body is provided with a harvesting device, and the harvesting device is arranged at one end of the main body, which is close to the harvesting device; the agricultural harvester blind area monitoring and alarming system has a multiple blind area visual field reminding function, and can detect the surrounding environmental information of the harvester through the arrangement of the early warning system, so that a user can take preventive measures in advance, and the damage to personnel caused by the visual field blind area of the harvester is reduced; through the arrangement of the display system, a user can observe the blind area in an all-around and visual manner, and through the arrangement of the vibration system, the user can feel visually, the environment of the blind area in the visual field can be treated in time, and casualties are reduced; through voice system's setting, can carry out voice broadcast to the blind area environment, further warning user.

title_en: All-round intelligent security early warning system of car
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automobile omnibearing intelligent safety early warning system, which comprises a foreign matter sensing system, a speed sensing module, a weather inducing system, a distance detection device, an omnibearing camera system and an alarm display module, wherein the foreign matter sensing system is used for sensing foreign matters around a vehicle, the speed sensing module is used for monitoring the speed of the vehicle, and the weather inducing system is used for sensing the weather during the running of the vehicle; the omnibearing intelligent safety early warning system for the automobile has various early warning types, is intelligent, and can reduce accidents caused by reaction and consideration of a driver, the foreign matter sensing module can sense foreign matters around the automobile under normal conditions and can also sense foreign matters such as falling rocks in natural disasters, the automobile speed control system is matched to avoid damage to the safety of the automobile and the driver caused by the falling rocks and the like, the weather induction system can also automatically turn on and off the light and the automobile window in time and automatically control the automobile speed, and the accidents caused by sudden weather are reduced.

abstract_en: The utility model relates to an emergent air feed life saving equipment device of fire disaster, including small-size air-blower, the battery, main guide duct, the siren, small-size gas pitcher, the lifesaving helmet, the air guide hose, the hanging flower basket, the lifting rope, control circuit constitutes, provide the required clean air that lasts for the stranded personnel of fire disaster provide breathe, simultaneously, play the warning and make things convenient for the rescue personnel to confirm stranded person's position effect, can make stranded personnel avoid the harm that the blind flee and bring in smog poisoning and the fire disaster, extension rescue time promotes stranded personnel's survival probability greatly, moreover, the steam generator is simple in structure, convenient and practical.

title_en: Monitoring method, device and system
abstract_en: The application provides a monitoring method, a monitoring device and a monitoring system, relates to the technical field of communication, and can avoid the situation that express mail loading and unloading processes become logistics monitoring blind areas. The method comprises the following steps: receiving a target video stream sent by a terminal device, wherein the target video stream comprises a first video stream and/or a second video stream, the first video stream is a loading video stream of a transport object acquired by the terminal device, and the second video stream is an unloading video stream of the transport object acquired by the terminal device; and if the target video stream meets the preset logistics monitoring condition, sending alarm indication information to the terminal equipment, wherein the alarm indication information is used for indicating the terminal equipment to output alarm information.

title_en: Functional fire safety management reminder signs
title_ko: 기능성 소방안전관리 알림표지판
abstract_en: The present invention relates to firefighting management notification sign board which comprises: a main body unit formed to be attached and fixed to a building, provided in the form of a plate, and configured to transmit information such specifications, locations, etc. of firefighting equipment in the form of letters, numbers, symbols, etc. displayed on a front surface thereof; an information checking means formed on a front side of the main body and capable of communicating with a fire station server management center (C) while double-checking accurate information such as firefighting-related equipment, located the inside and outside of the building, and operation states thereof through a terminal (B) such as a tablet PC during management performed by a firefighting equipment inspector (A) so as to allow for improvement of operational failure and operational malfunction in real-time; and a coating unit which protects the main body unit while preventing external foreign substances from entering the main body unit and the information checking means. According to the present invention, the firefighting management notification sign board enables a firefighting equipment inspector to recognize all kinds of information such as firefighting-related equipment of a building and a status of firefighting equipment (building drawing, emergency escape information, previously-conducted firefighting inspection items, etc.) at once and to identify whether initially-stored firefighting equipment details match information of a present view point which inspects modification information, thereby increasing convenience of firefighting management. In addition, the firefighting management notification sign board enables the firefighting equipment inspector to exchange various kinds of firefighting equipment information of a modified view point in real-time with the firefighting server management center through a terminal so that the firefighting equipment inspector may take precautions to cause the corresponding firefighting equipment to be properly functioning, and may also set up an emergency call available. Therefore, when an emergency situation occurs at night, it is possible to make an emergency call to a police station of a fire station.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 소방관리 알림표지판을 형성함에 있어서: 건물 등에 부착 고정이 가능하도록 구성되고, 플레이트 판 형태로 형성되어 전면에 글자 · 숫자 · 기호 등의 형태로 소방 설비 제원 · 위치 등의 정보를 전달하는 본체부; 본체 전면부에 형성되어 소방시설점검자(A)의 관리 시 태블렛 PC 등의 단말기(B)를 통해 건물 내·외부의 소방관련 장비와 작동상태 등의 정확한 정보를 재차 확인하면서 소방서버관리처(C)와의 교류가 가능하여 실시간 형태로 기기의 작동불능 및 오류의 개선 등이 가능하게끔 구비하는 정보확인수단; 및 본체부와 정보확인수단에 외부의 이물질 유입 등을 방지하면서 본체부의 보호가 가능하게끔 코팅부를 구비함을 특징으로 한다. 
이러한 본 발명에 따르면, 건물의 소방관련 장비와 소방 기기상황(건물도면 · 비상탈출정보 · 종전의 소방점검사항 등) 등의 모든 정보를 소방시설점검자가 일거에 인지하도록 하는 한편, 최초 저장된 소방설비내역과 변경정보 등을 점검하는 현재시점의 정보가 일치하는지를 단번에 알 수 있도록 함으로써 소방 관리의 편의성이 증진되도록 하면서도 변경된 시점의 각종 소방 설비정보를 소방시설점검자가 단말기를 통해 소방서버관리처와 실시간으로 교류하여 해당 소방 설비가 제대로 작동될 수 있도록 사전 조치하고 비상호출 또한 가능하도록 함으로써 야간에 긴박한 일이 발생할 시 경찰서 또는 소방서로 비상호출이 가능하게 한 효과를 제공한다.

title_en: Intelligent control type fire-fighting emergency lighting evacuation system with centralized power supply and construction method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a centralized power supply intelligent control type fire-fighting emergency lighting evacuation system and a construction method thereof. The system is linked with the original fire alarm device to clarify the fire point, evacuation simulation analysis is carried out through personnel evacuation simulation software, and an optimal dynamic evacuation route is generated in time, so that trapped personnel can actively avoid smoke and fire, judgment is accurately made, and the occurrence of group death and group injury accidents such as blind escape, treading and the like is avoided.
assignees: GUANGDONG NO 1 CONSTR ENG CO LTD

title_en: Tire breaking device for vehicle deceleration
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a tire-breaking device for vehicle deceleration, which comprises a panel and a main body, wherein the panel is fixedly arranged on the ground of a road through screws and is positioned on the same horizontal plane with the ground, and the main body is arranged in a blind groove arranged below the ground; the main body is of a hollow box body structure, a driving mechanism is arranged at the bottom in the main body and connected with a fixed plate, a plurality of tire breaking nails are mounted at the upper end of the fixed plate, and a plastic waterproof layer is further mounted at the uppermost end in the main body; the panel is externally electrically connected with an alarm, the panel is provided with nail holes corresponding to the broken tire nails one to one, and when the broken tire nails penetrate through the nail holes, the alarm can respond to triggering. The utility model discloses can conveniently arrange under the ground in public place, not only do not influence public transport, can also force illegal vehicle to slow down or stop in time, reduce emergency's casualties and loss of property.

title_en: Glass breakage alarm circuit and system
abstract_en: The application relates to a glass breakage alarm circuit and system, wherein an alarm induction lead is arranged on glass, no electric cross point exists on the whole layout of the alarm induction lead, and two ports of the alarm induction lead are respectively connected with corresponding devices in the glass breakage alarm circuit. When the glass is not broken, the circuit switching device is electrified, so that a loop formed by the external power supply, the alarm induction lead, the circuit switching device and the first protection device is conducted. When the glass is broken to cause the breakage of the alarm induction lead, the circuit switching device loses power, so that a loop formed by the external power supply, the circuit switching device and the alarm device is conducted. Through the scheme, the glass breakage alarm circuit is distributed on the glass at the positions of doors, windows and the like, when the glass breaks due to severe weather or impact of foreign objects, the alarm device can send an alarm signal to remind a user in time, and the use reliability of the doors, windows and the windows is effectively improved.

title_en: Railway foreign matter invasion safety sensing and identification system based on distributed optical fiber sensing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a railway foreign matter invasion safety perception and identification system based on distributed optical fiber sensing is based on two kinds of distributed optical fiber sensing technologies and video linkage technology: monitoring a vibration invasion signal generated when illegal personnel, vehicles and construction invade a high-speed railway by utilizing a phase optical time domain analysis technology, and giving information such as the position, the event and the like of the invasion signal; monitoring a fence deformation signal of the high-speed railway generated when large-scale rockfall and debris flow invade the high-speed railway by utilizing a Brillouin optical time domain analysis technology, and giving information such as the position of the invasion signal; when any one or two of the two optical fiber sensing systems gives an alarm, the optical fiber sensing systems can be linked with cameras arranged on a high-speed railway tower pole to call monitoring pictures of the intrusion event. The three subsystems work synchronously, study mutually, monitor invasion layer by layer, and realize early warning and identification of foreign matter invasion of the high-speed railway together.
assignees: NINGBO ZHENGYE AUTOMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Vehicle-mounted intensity meter with earthquake early warning function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a vehicle-mounted spirit meter with earthquake early warning function, which comprises a microprocessor, a power circuit, a network module, an earthquake analysis module, an acceleration sensor, a light alarm and a sound alarm, wherein the spirit meter with the earthquake early warning function is carried by the vehicle, has small volume and can be easily installed in a cab and can be used as early warning equipment of a driver, the equipment has the functions of local earthquake detection and foreign earthquake early warning, when the acceleration sensor arranged in the spirit meter monitors the local earthquake condition in real time and calculates the acceleration value to automatically analyze the vibration signal, when the signal is generated by natural disaster earthquake and the spirit value reaches the preset spirit threshold value, the sound and light alarm is automatically carried out, the light flickers, the alarm bell sounds, and the spirit meter transmits the signal to a server to provide data support for emergency rescue command, meanwhile, the earthquake early warning platform can obtain the information of the earthquake at different places, so that the early warning is given in advance, and the time is won for the driver to avoid danger in advance.
assignees: YIN HAITAO;LI YANZHAO;YANG LE;WANG JIEMIN;LIU HAN;ZHANG TIAN

title_en: Emergency evacuation method for dense crowd
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency evacuation method for dense crowds, which comprises the following steps: acquiring real-time people flow information at each escape passage in a building; according to the people flow information at each escape passage, respectively analyzing the people flow density in each escape passage of the building; determining evacuation routes according to pre-stored building structure information and structure distribution information of each escape channel and by combining people flow density in each escape channel; and transmitting and announcing the evacuation route to each output terminal respectively. When an accident occurs in a dense crowd gathering place, the invention can intervene and help large-scale crowds to evacuate and escape orderly, perform the functions of risk alarm, detect trapped people and conveniently implement rescue and the like, and avoid the singleness and blindness of the dense crowd during escape so as to reduce casualties of the sudden accident.

title_en: Fire hydrant monitoring terminal, device and system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire hydrant monitoring terminal, device and system, wherein fire hydrant monitoring system includes fire hydrant monitoring terminal, local monitoring host computer and remote server. The fire hydrant monitoring terminal comprises a pressure detection module, a flow switch, an angular displacement sensor, a main control module, an LED module, a GPS module, a power supply module and a LoRa radio frequency module; the local monitoring host comprises a main control module, a LoRa radio frequency module, a Wi-Fi module and a liquid crystal display screen. The fire hydrant monitoring terminal is connected with the local monitoring host through a LoRa radio frequency signal; the local monitoring host computer and the remote server are connected through the Internet. The utility model discloses can monitor the water pressure and the flow variation in the fire hydrant, when detecting that water pressure does not satisfy fire-fighting water requirement or flow switch action, both accessible detector itself, local monitoring host realize local alarming function, can send alarm information to remote server again, realize remote alarming function.

title_en: Intelligent walking stick system integrating machine learning and Internet of things technology for blind people
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent walking stick system for blind people, which integrates machine learning and Internet of things technology, and comprises an obstacle avoidance module, a help seeking module, a remote GPS positioning module, a GPRS communication module, a cloud server database, a core module and a WeChat small program unit; the system calculates the attitude angle by adopting a Kalman filtering algorithm according to attitude data acquired by a nine-axis accelerometer gyroscope sensor, the working principle of an alarm unit is that the sensing data acquired by the sensor is input into a classifier, then the sensing data is compared and classified with real-time nine-axis accelerometer gyroscope sensor data according to normal classification, the attitude data is judged and classified, if the classification is not in the normal classification, an alarm signal is output if the abnormal attitude is judged, the alarm information is transmitted to a WeChat small program unit to be popped up and displayed for reminding a guardian, and the safety of the blind person when going out and the guardian of family members can be fundamentally solved.

title_en: Monitoring method and monitoring device for foreign matter invasion of line corridor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for monitoring foreign body invasion of a line corridor, which comprises the following steps: shooting towards a preset direction to obtain an SAR image, and resolving two adjacent towers and a transmission line between the two towers from the SAR image; judging whether foreign matter shielding exists in the tower or the transmission line; and if so, generating an alarm, acquiring the longitude and latitude of the tower, and sending the longitude and latitude to a background server. The invention also discloses a device for monitoring the foreign body invasion of the line corridor. By implementing the monitoring method and the monitoring device for the foreign matter invasion of the line corridor, the condition of the foreign matter nearby the tower can be monitored in real time, the tower or the power transmission line is prevented from being damaged by the surrounding foreign matter under the weather condition of typhoon or thunder and lightning, and the potential safety hazard is eliminated.

title_en: Positioning blind-guiding glasses
abstract_en: The invention relates to a pair of positioning blind-guiding glasses, which comprises a glasses frame, wherein a main control module, a positioning module, a distance sensing module, a receiving module and an emergency module are arranged in the glasses frame, the positioning module comprises a GPS module and an SIM card module, the distance sensing module is connected with the main control module and is used for inputting the distance information of an obstacle into the main control module after the obstacle is detected and sending the distance information to the receiving module through the main control module, so that a blind person can obtain the distance information of the obstacle; the positioning module and the emergency module are respectively connected with the main control module, and the GPS module is used for acquiring the current position information of the blind person and sending the current position information to the associated mobile phone through the emergency module; the SIM card module provides required wireless signals and flow for the GPS module and the emergency module. The invention can send out alarm when the blind person is lost and other emergency situations occur, and can obtain rescue in time.

title_en: Solar blind ultraviolet lens with large relative aperture and long focal length and optical system

abstract_ko: 본 발명은 바이크 라이더용 스마트 헬멧을 이용하여 블라인드 스팟(Blind Spot)을 모니터링하는 방법에 있어서, 블라인드 스팟 모니터링 장치는, (a) 스마트 헬멧에 대응되는 제1 블라인드 스팟의 영상 이미지(Video Image)가 획득되면, 객체 검출기로 하여금 영상 이미지 상의 객체를 검출하도록 하고, 제1 블라인드 스팟에 위치하는 제1 객체를 확인하는 단계; 및 (b) 스마트 헬멧에 설치된 GPS 센서, 가속력 센서, 및 지자기 센서(Geomagnetic Sensor) 중 일부로부터 획득되는 센서 정보를 참조하여 스마트 헬멧 방향 및 바이크 주행 방향을 판단하고, 스마트 헬멧 방향과 바이크 주행 방향을 참조하여 제1 객체 중 바이크에 대응되는 제2 블라인드 스팟에 위치하는 제2 객체를 확인하고, 제2 객체를 상기 스마트 헬멧에 설치된 헤드업 디스플레이(Head Up Display; HUD)를 통해 표시하거나, 제2 블라인드 스팟에 제2 객체가 위치하고 있음을 스피커를 통해 소리로 경보(Alarm)하는 단계;를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 방법을 제공한다.

title_en: Systems, apparatuses and methods for enhanced notifications to users of wearable medical devices
abstract_en: A wearable medical device (e.g., wearable drug delivery pump) sends a request to another device for generation of an audible or vibratory notification at the other device, which is helpful when the wearable medical device is obscured by a user's clothing or the user is vision or hearing impaired. The other device receiving the request to generate a notification can be a remote controller or smartphone paired with the wearable medical device, or a smart watch or a Bluetooth (BT)-enabled headset or other device paired with the remote controller. The wearable medical device is configured with a BT stack that allows the device to pair with its controller in a secure bonded relationship, but to send signals requiring less security (e.g., requests for generation of notifications) to other devices (e.g., a BT-enabled headset or smart watch) using a more ubiquitous wireless protocol such as a standard BT protocol with broadcast mode.

title_en: Alarm apparatus for preventing blind accident

abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus for preventing an accident caused by a working line (13) of a roller blind (10). The apparatus comprises: a main body (20) including a space part (21) and a hanging part (23) therein and serving as a weight to the working line (13); a sensing means (30) installed on the main body (20) to detect the shaking of the main body (20); a covering means (40) installed on the main body (20) to reduce the exposed length of the working line (13); and a controller (50) issuing an alarm or operating the covering means (40) in response to a signal of the sensing means (30). Accordingly, the apparatus senses a state, in which a child accesses the roller blind installed on the window or the like to shade the light and plays with the roller blind, and issues an alarm. In addition, the apparatus temporally reduces an exposed portion of the working line, thereby increasing the accident prevention rate.

title_en: Wirelessly Activated Monitored Safety Temperature Sensing Alarm
abstract_en: This Wireless Safety Temperature Sensing Alarm is a thermally actuated alarm designed to send a wireless signal to a remote base which will turn on a buzzer, a visual light signal or an emergency alert system to alert anyone around that a child/person/pet/plant has been left in a confined environment that is experiencing extreme temperatures, whether hot or cold. It can also simply alert someone that a certain device or environment has reached the user defined set point temperature. It consists of 2 units: a base and a remote. The base is easily installed on any kind of carrier or as a standalone fixture, and it is designed to sense the temperature of the environment that the child/person/pet/plant is in and it can trigger a wireless signal on the remote to turn on the buzzer/alarm, and a flashing light for people who are hearing impaired or send an RF signal emergency alert. It's designed with a 10 minute turn-on delay to prevent false alarms upon startup. It also has a low-battery alert as an add-on safety precaution. The remote can be easily carried on or as a standalone device, or is easily installed on the exterior of the confined environment which the child/person/pet/plant is in. This makes it possible for anyone who is nearby to hear/see the alarm and take action. Many lives of children, beloved people, pets, and plants could be saved (and financial loss or wasted time could be prevented) using this easy to install invention. A future development of the product will be able to alert an emergency system in case that human lives are in danger of extreme temperatures.

title_en: Storm avoiding buildings and structures
abstract_en: A building sheltering structure is configured to facilitate the shielding of at least one domicile or building into an underground foundation before an emergency environmental condition arises. The foundation includes a cover plate that translates horizontally to occlude the at least one domicile upon retraction into a secure cavity of the foundation by a lift assembly positioned at the bottom of the foundation cavity. Mounted atop the lift assembly, the at least one domicile can be fully retracted into the foundation cavity and completely shielded by the cover plate. The operation of the lift assembly is commanded and powered by a supply system. A processor of the supply system facilitates emergency warnings and panic transmissions to signal for help. Further, the supply system accommodates a plurality of solar panels mounted atop the at least one domicile to keep the system charged for the use in emergency.

title_en: Switch gear with apparatus for judging earthquake-proof integrity

abstract_en: The present invention relates to a switchgear having an apparatus for determining earthquake-proof integrity, comprising: an enclosure having a device for a switchgear installed therein; an arc sensor installed inside the enclosure and sensing generation of arc; a temperature sensor installed inside the enclosure and measuring temperature; a tilt sensor installed inside the enclosure and measuring tilt; a sensor elevator installed inside the enclosure such that the arc sensor and the temperature sensor are installed therein, and elevating the arc sensor and the temperature sensor to vary a sensing area; an integrity determination unit for determining integrity of a switchgear depending on whether sensing results of the arc sensor, the temperature sensor and the tilt sensor satisfy integrity determination conditions; a communications unit for performing communications with an external device; and a control unit for controlling a determination result by the integrity determination unit to be provided to a predetermined terminal or system through the communications unit. According to the present invention, it is possible to determine warping, structural deformation and internal abnormal temperature and always diagnose an internal arc generation state in a switchgear and an internal device. If an abnormal state occurs, a warning signal can be transmitted to nearby workers or the like through a terminal such as a smartphone or the like. Thus, failure prevention of a switchgear and reduction of maintenance therethrough are possible, and temperature measurement at all times and inspection for a deterioration state are possible while simultaneously removing a blinding spot of sensors according to various components of a switchgear to sense occurrence of an abnormal state.
