title_en: Guard bar patrol machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of inspection devices, and provides a guardrail patrol machine which is used for solving the problem that a large amount of manpower and material resources are needed to patrol and detect on a current road; the driving unit is used for receiving a preset driving signal and driving the guardrail patrol machine to move relatively along the guardrail; the illegal snapshot unit is used for snapshot of illegal vehicle information preset on a road; the foreign matter monitoring unit is used for detecting whether preset foreign matter information exists on a road; the sound and light warning unit is used for warning the road according to a preset sound and light warning mode; and the real-time monitoring unit is used for acquiring the current image information of the road. The guardrail patrol machine can monitor foreign matters on the road and give an alarm correspondingly, and improves the driving safety of the road.

title_en: Intelligent traffic early warning system and early warning method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of traffic warning control, and provides an intelligent traffic early warning system which comprises a guardrail patrol machine, a tunnel patrol machine, a gateway robot, an acousto-optic early warning system and a background server, wherein the guardrail patrol machine is connected with the tunnel patrol machine through a network; the guardrail patrol machine is arranged on a road guardrail and used for sending preset early warning information to the background server; the tunnel patrol machine is arranged at a preset position of the tunnel and used for acquiring the illegal information of preset vehicles, the information of preset tunnel foreign matters, the air quality concentration and the preset traffic image information in the current tunnel and uploading the information to the background server; the gateway crossing robot is arranged at a preset position of a gateway crossing and used for acquiring preset vehicle information of the current gateway crossing and uploading the acquired preset vehicle information to the background server, and the sound and light early warning system is used for receiving preset alarm signals and carrying out corresponding sound and light early warning according to the received preset alarm signals. The system has the advantages of intelligent monitoring on high-speed traffic, high safety and strong convenience.

title_en: Traffic early warning system based on tunnel patrol machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of traffic warning control, and provides a traffic early warning system based on a tunnel patrol machine, which is used for solving the problem that accidents frequently occur due to the fact that a driver does not react in time due to road foreign matters in the current tunnel traffic, and comprises the following components: the system comprises a tunnel patrol machine, an acousto-optic early warning system, a fan control module, a light control module and a background server; the acousto-optic early warning system is used for receiving a preset acousto-optic early warning signal and carrying out corresponding preset sound early warning and preset light early warning; the fan control module is used for controlling the opening and closing of the fan according to the air quality concentration in the tunnel, and the light control module is used for receiving a preset light early warning signal and generating a preset light signal at a tunnel entrance to stop entering the tunnel. By adopting the system, the existence of foreign matters in the road can be accurately determined, early warning can be carried out through sound and light, and the occurrence rate of traffic accidents is greatly reduced.

title_en: Intelligent traffic early warning system and method based on acousto-optic early warning device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of traffic warning control, and provides an intelligent traffic early warning system based on an acousto-optic early warning device, which is used for solving the problem that accidents frequently occur due to the fact that road foreign matters are not timely reacted by a driver in current road traffic; the acousto-optic early warning system is used for receiving a preset alarm signal and uploading the preset one-key alarm signal to the background server; and the background server is used for calculating the guardrail patrol machine which is closest to the acousto-optic early warning device uploading the preset warning signal according to the received preset one-key warning signal, scheduling the guardrail patrol machine to move to the acousto-optic early warning device and carrying out early warning and rechecking. By adopting the system, the existence of foreign matters in the road can be accurately determined, early warning can be carried out through sound and light, and the occurrence rate of traffic accidents is greatly reduced.

title_en: Intelligent traffic early warning system based on guardrail patrol machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of traffic warning control, and provides an intelligent traffic early warning system based on a guardrail patrol machine, which is used for solving the problem that accidents frequently occur due to the fact that a driver cannot react timely when road foreign matters come in current road traffic; the guardrail patrol machine is used for sending preset early warning information to the background server; the background server is used for issuing a corresponding preset early warning instruction to the acousto-optic early warning system according to the received preset early warning information; and the sound and light early warning system is used for carrying out corresponding sound broadcast early warning and light starting early warning according to the received preset early warning instruction. By adopting the system, the existence of foreign matters in the road can be accurately determined, early warning can be carried out through sound and light, and the occurrence rate of traffic accidents is greatly reduced.

title_en: Tunnel patrol machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of traffic warning control, and provides a tunnel patrol machine, which comprises: the system comprises a control unit, and a driving unit, a networking transmission unit, an illegal snapshot unit, a foreign matter monitoring unit, a gas monitoring unit, an acousto-optic warning unit, a real-time monitoring unit and a position positioning unit which are respectively and electrically connected with the control unit; the illegal snapshot unit is used for snapshot of preset vehicle illegal information in the tunnel and snapshot of the preset vehicle illegal information; the foreign matter detection unit is used for detecting whether preset foreign matter information exists in the tunnel or not; the gas monitoring unit is used for monitoring the air mass concentration in the tunnel; the acousto-optic warning unit is used for carrying out tunnel warning according to a preset acousto-optic warning mode; the real-time monitoring unit is used for acquiring preset traffic image information within a preset distance range; the position locating unit is used for obtaining current position information. The tunnel patrol machine can actively identify the foreign matters and abnormal parking events of the current tunnel in time and perform early warning.

title_en: Forest fire prevention monitoring and early warning device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a forest fire prevention monitoring and early warning device which comprises a box body, wherein through holes are formed in the left side and the right side of the inner wall of the box body, the bottom of a torsion spring is fixedly connected to the outer wall of a bent plate, a belt is fixedly connected to the outer side of the bent plate, the outer wall of the belt is in clearance fit with the inner wall of the through holes, the outer wall of the belt is rotatably connected with a grooved wheel, the grooved wheel is rotatably connected with the rear end face of the inner wall of the through hole through a connecting shaft, rod bodies are fixedly connected to the outer side of the belt, and the two rod bodies are respectively rotatably connected. This forest fire prevention control early warning device for smoke alarm accessible box and box cover's protection carries out stable work, and convenient to use person takes out smoke alarm, makes box cover and box can carry out stable laminating, and then makes box cover and box can carry out stable protection to smoke alarm, makes smoke alarm can carry out stable protection.

title_en: Automatic recognition early warning method and system for road foreign matters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for automatically identifying and early warning road foreign matters, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the data acquisition unit acquires image information by installing cameras at various disaster hidden danger points; processing the acquired image information, and extracting various features in the acquired image information by the image after enhancing the source image; identifying the difference of image information obtained in adjacent time periods through the structural similarity; simplifying the extracted characteristic information by adopting a mathematical morphology method; and detecting whether the foreign matters in the acquired image information are motor vehicles, non-motor vehicles and pedestrians by adopting a YOLOv2 multi-target detection and identification model. According to the invention, through comparing the difference in the space structure between the images and adopting the YOLOv2 multi-target detection recognition model, the rockfall and other geological disasters of the road surface are recognized and detected, the problems of automatic recognition, prediction and early warning of the geological disasters of the road surface and the side slope are solved, and the image recognition and target detection precision is improved.
assignees: CHINA TRANSP TELECOMMUNICATIONS AND INFORMATION CENTER;CTTIC INFORMATION TECH NATIONAL ENGINEERING LABORATORY CO LTD

title_en: Barrier-free access control type personnel-deciding monitoring system for civil explosive production line
abstract_en: The invention discloses a barrier-free access control type personnel-ordering monitoring system for a civil explosive production line, which comprises four parts, namely an access control system, a workshop monitoring extension, a comprehensive monitoring platform and a user workstation, wherein the four parts comprise: the access control system is responsible for acquiring drive, personnel in-and-out logic judgment, display screen drive and alarm action; the workshop monitoring extension set is responsible for monitoring logic calculation of the workshop; the comprehensive monitoring platform is responsible for maintaining core data and key logic of the monitoring system; the user workstation is responsible for realizing user operation and data display. The system can monitor the entering and exiting of the workshop staff in real time, determine the number of the current workshop staff, give an alarm on the entering and exiting of illegal staff and the invasion of foreign matters, is assisted by prompts such as images, sounds and information broadcasting, and simultaneously uploads related information to a monitoring center to assist a management department to perform safety production supervision work.

title_en: Intelligent building disaster alarm monitoring device

title_en: Refuge early warning system in urban area
abstract_en: The invention provides a refuge early warning system in an urban area, which belongs to the technical field of disaster protection and comprises: the data acquisition module is used for acquiring population density data, refuge data, building data and earthquake magnitude distribution data; the building population number calculating module is used for calculating the population number of each building; the first evaluation result generation module is used for evaluating the refuge selection of refugees within the evacuation radius to generate a first evaluation result; the second evaluation result generation module is used for calculating the number of collapsed buildings and the number of refugees based on the refuge data, the building data and the earthquake magnitude distribution data, evaluating the accessibility of the refuge and the refuge capacity risk based on a GIS map and generating a second evaluation result; and the early warning module is used for sending the evaluation result to the mobile phone for early warning. The invention has the advantages that: the assessment and early warning of the capacity risk and accessibility of the refuge are realized, and the casualty number is further reduced.

title_en: Fire suppression system
abstract_en: A controller responds to an alert from a remote alert system and responds to an AI unit that detects a fire signature, and, in response, sends signals to fire suppression equipment to defend a structure against fire. A delivery device system may include delivery devices that are capable of spraying water and/or retardant at a structure or area to defend against fire. The system may act autonomously to defend against wildfires. The system includes a base station accessible by a user device to take control of the system. Alternatively, a central monitoring system may access the base station to control the system in addition to or instead of the user. In an embodiment, the system automatically sprays water or retardant prior to the outbreak of a fire. The system may optically detect embers landing on a structure or area being defended and sprays the embers with retard and/or water.

title_en: Infrared body sensing networking type wireless fire alarm
abstract_en: The invention discloses an infrared somatosensory networking type wireless fire alarm in the technical field of fire alarms, which comprises a mounting plate, a heat insulation porcelain tube, a circuit board and two groups of quarter-sphere heat insulation porcelain shells, wherein the center of the upper surface of the mounting plate is provided with a blind hole, two sides of the mounting plate are symmetrically penetrated through and screwed with a pair of countersunk bolts through stepped through holes around the center of the blind hole, by rotating the countersunk head bolt, the two groups of rectangular limiting devices move relatively to extrude the expansion bolt to complete the fixed installation, can solve the problem of fire alarm, people violation and the like in three small places, ensure the safety of personnel, can complete the cleaning of the filter screen, improve the sensitivity, and can utilize the connecting rod to make two sets of quarter globular thermal-insulated porcelain shell closure, thermal-insulated porcelain tube is sealed, has protected inside device to avoid being burnt by steam and flame, and the device degree of automation is high, convenient to use.

title_en: Automobile surrounding early warning device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automobile periphery early warning device, which comprises an infrared sensing device and an ultrasonic generation receiving device, wherein the infrared sensing device and the ultrasonic generation receiving device are arranged on an automobile; the infrared sensing device and the ultrasonic generating and receiving device are electrically connected with an alarm installed in the automobile, and the infrared sensing device is used for automatically sensing people or objects around the automobile for 5 meters and feeding back to the alarm to give an alarm when sensing short objects around the automobile or young children squat in a blind area of the automobile to remind a driver or passengers to get off the automobile to observe and eliminate potential safety hazards; the ultrasonic generation receiving device is used for sending ultrasonic waves towards the direction far away from the vehicle at intervals, the ultrasonic waves automatically return to be received and fed back by the receiving device on the vehicle after encountering a shelter and an obstacle, an ultrasonic detection result is transmitted to the alarm, the alarm reminds a driver, an early warning scheme is made in advance according to surrounding road conditions, and traffic accidents are avoided. The safety of vehicle driving is improved, traffic accidents are effectively avoided, and casualties and property loss are avoided.

title_en: Classroom blind area buffer stop
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a classroom blind area buffer stop belongs to the motor automation field. The utility model discloses an infrared sensing unit, infrared sensing unit transmits infrared perception information to distance transmission unit, distance transmission unit feeds back information to information processing module, information processing module classifies and integrates the information received, transmits to the judging module and carries out the threshold value judgement, transmits information to the executor after the threshold value is judged, the executor includes alarm unit and gate control unit, alarm unit control vigilance device sends out the alarm of degree; the peripheral assembly of buffer stop includes: the infrared sensor is arranged on a classroom door frame, the side gate is connected with the middle shaft rod, and the side gate moves along a track. The utility model discloses can in time send and remind, avoid the student to take place to collide because of walking too fast or the blind area in the field of vision to do not influence daily student's walking.

title_en: Intelligent walking stick for blind person
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent walking stick for blind people, wherein a walking stick handle and a walking stick body are both cylindrical, and are L-shaped after being connected; the SOS key, the LED warning lamp and the voice broadcasting module are arranged on the top surface of the crutch handle; the camera module is arranged at the front end of the crutch handle; the ultrasonic obstacle avoidance module is arranged at the bottom of the crutch body, an ultrasonic sensor is arranged in the ultrasonic obstacle avoidance module, and the ultrasonic sensor transmits detected ultrasonic reflection signals to the main controller; the GPS module is arranged in the crutch body and used for positioning the crutch body; the gesture detection module is arranged at the middle lower position in the crutch body and comprises a three-axis MEMS gyroscope and a three-axis MEMS accelerometer; the LED control key is arranged below the crutch handle. The intelligent blind person navigation system has the functions of emergency help seeking, tumble detection, communication positioning, navigation information broadcasting and the like, can provide guarantee for the personal safety of the blind person when the blind person goes out, and is simple and intelligent to operate and high in practicability.

title_en: Thermal imaging human body temperature measurement metal detection security door
abstract_en: The application discloses human temperature measurement metal detection safety inspection door of thermal imaging, including the door body, body temperature sensor, metal detector, sound player and controller. The body temperature sensor can quickly detect the body temperature of a passer, if the body temperature sensor detects a high-temperature passer, sound and light alarm is carried out through a sound player and a liquid crystal display screen, and the body temperature sensor can also count the number of the passers; the metal detector can remind security check people to further check whether a detected passer carries a metal object. In addition, the built-in voice recognition module in the security check door can perform real-time voice communication and voice translation, and is convenient for people in different countries to use. The security inspection door is suitable for places such as airports, schools, high-speed rails, subways, factories, schools, stations, concerts, sports meetings and the like where entrances and exits densely, and can realize high-efficiency high-temperature troubleshooting, crowds carrying metal articles and real-time communication so as to guarantee public safety.

title_en: Interactive electronic libretto/translation HD display interface apparatus and method
abstract_en: An addressable apparatus and method for simultaneous presentation of a performance script or other commentary, dialogue, and/or visual information available in the original language or one or more translations which can be selected by the user. Other visual information such as, sponsors, advertisements, and emergency alerts can be transmitted to each display in full color graphics or video. In one embodiment, a touch screen interface can allow point of sale applications pre-show, during intermissions, and/or post-show. Individual addressability allows direct messaging capabilities, seat-naming, anti direct-marketing media opportunities.

title_en: Elevator layer door car sill prevents that foreign matter blocks up mounting structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an elevator layer door car sill prevents that foreign matter blocks up mounting structure, including fixed panel, rubber slab and baffle. The fixed panel is fixed with the floor through the bolts, the rubber plate is fixed with the wall through the bolts, the stability of the device is guaranteed through the double fixing mode, foreign matters influencing the normal operation of the elevator cannot fall into the device through the baffle plate, and the operation safety of the elevator is guaranteed; the pressure sensor arranged on the rubber plate can detect people or objects entering the elevator, and the user can be reminded immediately through the alarm lamp and the loudspeaker after the elevator is overweight; the Y-shaped baffle can facilitate the discharge of liquid scattered on the baffle, and the filter screen can filter out impurities except the liquid, so that the foreign matters can be further prevented from falling into the filter screen; the emergency lighting lamp can provide brightness for the user when the user is in an emergency situation in the elevator, and the danger caused by invisible panic of the passenger is avoided.

title_en: Notification terminal with text-to-speech amplifier
abstract_en: A mass notification terminal may have a data parser and decoder connected to a communications terminal. Announcements may be transmitted to the communications terminal in the form of linguistic symbols and commands using low bandwidth and low power protocol transmissions. Push transmissions conserve bandwidth. An abstraction of an audio announcement may be transmitted for use with a speech synthesizer. The abstraction may be linguistic symbols such as phenomes, text, or may identify pre-stored clips. The system may provide announcement confirmation. The system may take advantage of communication protocols that have message size limitations. The announcements may be sent in one or more message transmissions. When an announcement is composed of multiple messages, using message sequence numbers and announcement identifications may facilitate grouping and arranging of the messages that make up the announcement.

title_en: Railway engineering flood control and disaster reduction monitoring and alarming device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a railway work flood control and disaster reduction monitoring alarm device which comprises monitoring point equipment, central machine room equipment and terminal display equipment, wherein the central machine room equipment is electrically connected with the monitoring point equipment and the terminal display equipment respectively, and the monitoring point equipment transmits acquired picture information data to the central machine room equipment and displays the picture information data on the terminal display equipment after the picture information data is processed by the central machine room equipment. The flood control and disaster reduction monitoring and alarming device for railway work can monitor and process a plurality of high-definition network cameras of a plurality of monitoring points in real time, and realizes the identification of personnel and trains in a railway clearance. The invention realizes the detection, identification and tracking of landslide, debris flow and foreign matter invasion of the mountain in the railway clearance, and solves the problem of accurately identifying the foreign matter under the condition of severe weather.

title_en: Multi-system emergency distress signal monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-system emergency distress signal monitoring method, which belongs to the civil aviation safety technology and adopts a multi-system emergency distress signal monitoring system to monitor aircrafts in a jurisdiction, wherein the multi-system emergency distress signal monitoring system comprises at least one outdoor ground dual-frequency monitoring device, at least one alarm display end and an aircraft alarm information processing center end, and the outdoor ground dual-frequency monitoring device is connected with the alarm display end and is arranged at an airport and/or a service station along a route; the alarm display end is connected with the aircraft alarm information processing center end through a communication network; the real-time outdoor monitoring terminal of 406MHz digital signals and 121.5MHz analog signals and the ground monitoring system depending on the terminal can be monitored in real time by a localization means, so that the all-day real-time monitoring of two channel signals of an aircraft can be realized, and the local area searching can be matched, thereby improving the searching efficiency and reducing the excessive dependence on the original foreign Cospas-Sarsat system.

title_en: Method for vehicle identification and communication between transportation network company (tnc) service users
abstract_en: A method for effective vehicle identification and communication between riders of transportation network companies (TNC), and the vehicles that are being designated to the riders. Accordingly, a system used to execute the method of the present invention conveys the information of the rider on a display device on the designated vehicle of the rider, so as to notify the rider before getting into the designated vehicle. Additionally, the present invention also helps assist blind people by conveying audio messages, such as pipe messages or announcing their names. abstract_en: The invention provides a self-rescue method based on a 5G D2D straight-through technology, which comprises the following steps: s1, the master D2D terminal located in the cellular network blind area initiates a detection request containing emergency rescue information to the nearby slave D2D terminal; s2, detecting the networking capability of the nearby slave D2D terminal after receiving the probe request; s3, extracting the emergency rescue information of the probe request from the D2D terminal and sending response information to the main D2D terminal; s4, the slave D2D terminal continuously initiates a probe request containing the emergency rescue information of the master D2D terminal to other slave D2D terminals near the slave D2D terminal; s5, detecting the networking capability of other nearby slave D2D terminals after receiving the detection request, if the detection is that the network exists, extracting the emergency rescue information of the detection request and sending response information to the slave D2D terminal at the upper stage, and if the detection is that the network does not exist, returning to S4; and S6, after receiving the response information, the main D2D terminal selects a path and sends the emergency rescue information to an alarm center. title_en: Personal emergency alert system, method and device
abstract_en: A system, method and device for notifying designated recipients about a personal emergency. An individual maintains a personal emergency alert device (PEAD) in accessible proximity. The PEAD is activated by onboard or remote sensor(s) in proximity to the PEAD. The sensor(s) monitor the occurrence of an emergency activation event. PEAD includes a controller. The controller, triggered by detection of an emergency event by a sensor, activates a geolocation module to obtain geolocation information, formulates an alert message, establishes a network connection, and transmits the message with geolocation information to a personal emergency alert notification service (PEANS). PEANS responds by sending a text, email or other emergency notification to designated notification recipient(s). Once activated, PEAD periodically tracks and transmits its geolocation until it runs out of power. Alternatively, PEAD can be deactivated by sending a deactivation code to the PEANS, which in turn instructs such PEAD to deactivate.

title_en: Wireless Power System With Foreign Object Detection
abstract_en: A wireless power system has a wireless power transmitting device and a wireless power receiving device. The wireless power transmitting device may be a wireless charging mat or other device with a charging surface. The wireless power receiving device may be a portable electronic device receiving transmitted wireless power signals from the wireless power transmitting device while resting on the charging surface. During digital ping operations, low-power wireless power signals may be transmitted from the wireless power transmitting device. Information gathered during the digital ping such as wireless power transmission efficiency information, coupling coefficient information, Q-factor information, and coil inductance information may be used in determining whether a foreign object is present. Control circuitry in the transmitting device can cause the receiving device to present an alert for a user indicating that wireless power transfer operations are commencing in response to determining that no foreign object is present.

The parking space fire early warning and controlling system can timely acquire relevant information at the initial stage of fire occurrence, takes active measures to carry out fire extinguishing operation through the fire control device, and simultaneously informs a fire department and a main monitoring platform to quickly find out foreign aid so as to avoid further expansion of the fire; measures can be taken at the first time, and personal and property losses caused by untimely discovery are avoided.

abstract_en: The invention discloses a doorbell suitable for hearing-impaired people, which comprises an outdoor switch, an information transfer processing system, a receiving processing device and an alarm system, wherein the outdoor switch is connected with the information transfer processing system; the information transfer processing system comprises an electronic bell, a first single chip microcomputer and a first chip, wherein the electronic bell is connected with the first single chip microcomputer, and the first single chip microcomputer is connected with the first chip; the receiving and processing device is provided with a first key and a second key, a second single chip microcomputer, a vibration module and a second chip are arranged in the receiving and processing device, and the second single chip microcomputer is connected with the vibration module and the second chip. The invention additionally utilizes an information transmission mode of a physical signal of 'vibration' and an alarm system on the basis of the traditional doorbell, reduces the life gap of the vulnerable group, can meet the use requirement of the normal doorbell, and is convenient for the daily life of people.

title_en: External alarm display and tester for electronic industrial equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an external alarm display and tester for electronic industry equipment belongs to electron technical field, and external alarm display includes the display body, the front installation display screen and the audible-visual annunciator of display body, the back mounted terminal box, install the connector on the terminal box, the multi-functional pole of rotation axis installation is passed through to the both sides of terminal box, the free end installation couple of multi-functional pole is through rotating multi-functional pole inclined support display body or vertical hanging the display body. Can conveniently be connected with electronic industry equipment through the connector, can make the display body have two kinds of modes of putting through multi-functional pole, rotate multi-functional pole and when being the tilt state, can support the display body, make the display body stably put, when rotating the vertical state of multi-functional pole, the accessible couple hangs in fixed position, makes the display body hang and puts, satisfies the user demand through different mounting means.

title_en: The disaster broadcasting PA in public facility, the remotely functioning A/V smart broadcasting device, a closed network system
title_ko: 공공 다중이용시설 재난재해 동보방송 구내방송장치(PA)와 원격 협업기능 A/V(Audio/Video) 스마트 방송장치 및 폐쇄자가망 시스템
abstract_en: When a civil defense alarm terminal which can be remotely controlled by the Korea Air and Space Operations Center (KAOC) or a multi-use facility control server receives emergency broadcast broadcasting data (disaster alert, disaster risk, air strike, CTRN, text to speech (TTS) data) for inside/outside public buildings such as schools, public institutions, or the like including the Article 33 (3) of the Framework Act on Civil Defense, and the Article 55-2 of the Enforcement Decree of the same Act (propagation of civil defense alerts) of buildings subject to alarm propagation, emergency broadcast is made through a multi-use facility alert terminal.
abstract_ko: 한국항공우주작전본부(KAOC: Korea Air and space Operations Center)에서 원격제어가 가능한 민방위 경보단말기 또는 민방위기본법 제33조 제3항, 동법 시행령 제55조의2(민방위 경보의 전파) "경보전파 대상 건축물"을 포함하는 학교, 관공서 등 공공 건축물 내/외부에 대해 비상방송 방송데이터(재난경계, 재난위험, 공습, 화생방, TTS(Text To Speech) 데이터)를 다중이용시설 통제서버가 수신하면, 다중이용시설 경보단말기를 통해 비상방송을 한다.

title_en: Emergency disaster warning system using TTS
title_ko: 문자음성 변환을 이용한 재난 경보 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a disaster warning system using text-to-speech conversion. The disaster warning system of the present invention is the disaster warning system which notifies disaster information by sending a text message from a disaster management center to a user terminal. The system includes: a disaster information receiving unit for receiving disaster information by text message from the disaster management center; a user language analysis unit for analyzing the language used by the user in the user terminal from which disaster information is received; a text-to-speech conversion unit for converting the text of the disaster information received in the user terminal into a speech including the language analyzed by the user terminal; and a disaster information transmission unit for transmitting the disaster information voice converted by the text-to-speech conversion unit to the outside. The system is configured to notify the disaster information with a voice signal including a user language using the user terminal.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 문자음성 변환을 이용한 재난 경보 시스템에 관한 것으로, 본 발명의 재난 경보 시스템은, 재난 관리 센터에서 사용자 단말기로 문자를 전송하여 재난정보를 알리는 재난 경보 시스템에 있어서, 상기 재난 관리 센터로부터 재난정보를 문자로 수신하는 재난정보 수신부, 재난정보가 수신되는 상기 사용자 단말기에서 사용자가 사용하는 언어를 분석하는 사용자 언어 분석부, 상기 사용자 단말기에 수신된 재난정보의 문자를 상기 사용자 단말기에서 분석된 언어를 포함하는 음성으로 변환하는 문자음성 변환부, 및, 상기 문자음성 변환부에서 변환된 재난정보 음성을 외부로 송출하는 재난정보 송출부를 포함하여, 상기 사용자 단말기를 사용하는 사용자 언어를 포함하는 음성 신호로 재난정보를 알리도록 구성된다.

title_en: Acousto-optic alarm sensing device for acoustic warning
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of alarm equipment, and provides an acousto-optic alarm sensing device for acoustic warning, which comprises a fixed part, wherein an alarm mechanism is arranged at the upper part of the fixed part; the alarm mechanism comprises an illuminating lamp, a control screen and an audible and visual alarm, wherein the control screen is respectively and electrically connected with the illuminating lamp and the audible and visual alarm; the side edge of the fixing part is provided with an induction part, and the induction part and the fixing part are arranged at an included angle of ninety degrees; the induction part comprises a data line and a radar inductor, and two ends of the data line are respectively connected with the control screen and the radar inductor; the radar sensor is provided with threely, just the radar sensor is followed the fixed part is array setting in proper order. The utility model provides a pair of audible and visual alarm induction system for vigilance does benefit to and provides the warning at the sight blind area, and the sentry of being convenient for is timely makes corresponding processing.

title_en: Fire control unit in intelligence building
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire fighting device in an intelligent building, which comprises an outer shell, wherein a manual button is movably arranged at the bottom end of the right side surface of the outer shell, an air inlet is arranged above the manual button, and a baffle is fixedly arranged at the upper part of the front surface of the outer shell; set up the upper cover and be glossy spherical curved surface, install miniature air pump and carry out the dust removal of regularly blowing to inductive probe, can avoid the dust to adhere to and pile up on inductive probe, make fire alarm device's response more sensitive, the early warning reaction is faster, strive for the quality time for relief and emergency rescue, set up three connecting rods of group and inductive probe simultaneously, reciprocating motion about connecting rod itself can make a round trip automatically, inductive probe can rotate around the connecting rod, very big promotion fire alarm device's response interval, inductive probe's field of vision blind area has been reduced, thereby reach the effect that utilizes fire alarm device still less to cover bigger monitoring range.

title_en: Emergency vehicle access notification device and method for the deaf
title_ko: 청각 장애인을 위한 긴급차량 알림 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to technology for a notification device for notifying an approaching emergency vehicle for a hearing-impaired person or a driver who has not heard an external sound. The notification device includes: an emergency vehicle notification signal generating unit which generates a signal to know the type of emergency vehicle; a transmission unit which transmits a signal from the emergency vehicle to a general vehicle; a reception unit which receives a signal of the emergency vehicle from the general vehicle; an emergency vehicle signal analysis unit which analyzes the received signal of the emergency vehicle; and a display unit which visually expresses the analyzed signal.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 청각장애인 또는 외부의 소리를 듣지 못한 운전자를 위하여 접근해오는 긴급차량을 알려주는 알림 장치에 관한 기술로서, 긴급차량의 종류를 알 수 있는 신호를 발생하는 긴급차량 알림신호발생부, 긴급차량에서 일반차량으로 신호를 송신하는 송신부, 일반차량에서 긴급차량의 신호를 받는 수신부, 수신한 긴급차량의 신호를 분석하는 긴급차량 신호분석부, 분석한 신호를 시각적으로 표현해주는 디스플레이부를 포함한다.

title_en: Zebra crossing system and wearable equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a zebra crossing system and wearable equipment, zebra crossing system includes: a zebra crossing body; the camera module is used for shooting to obtain the vehicle information of the intersection where the zebra crossing body is located, the delay condition of the green light and the walking condition of pedestrians on the zebra crossing body; the control pile is used for delaying the green light under the operation of the disabled; the warning information module is used for sending warning information under the condition that a person falls down on the zebra crossing body; blind bricks arranged on two sides of the zebra crossing body; and the radio frequency identification tags are arranged on the blind bricks, and each blind brick is provided with one radio frequency identification tag.

title_en: Intelligent gas leakage monitoring device based on optical fiber sensing technology
abstract_en: The utility model provides a gas leakage intelligent monitoring device based on optical fiber sensing technique. The device consists of five parts, namely an optical fiber sensor module, a signal conditioning module, a main control module, an audible and visual alarm module and a human-computer interaction display module. The device can detect the gas concentration in the kitchen in time when a household user uses gas, the gas concentration in the kitchen is displayed in real time through the human-computer interaction display module, and acousto-optic alarm reminding for the dangerous condition that the gas concentration in the kitchen and the gas leakage concentration exceed the standard is provided for the user in real time through the acousto-optic alarm module. When a user uses gas, the sound-light alarm module gives an alarm to remind, meanwhile, the man-machine interaction display module displays the gas concentration and gives a dangerous condition prompt, and the user can turn off the sound-light alarm prompt through the man-machine interaction display module when receiving the alarm prompt. The device adopts an alarm mode combining sound and light, and can be suitable for deaf-mute families. Therefore, the risk of using fuel gas by the user is greatly reduced, and the personal and property safety of the user is also greatly guaranteed.

title_en: Pattern recognition method based on point data
abstract_en: The invention relates to a pattern recognition method based on point data, which comprises the following steps: periodically acquiring detection data of the laser radar, and performing pulse conversion processing on the detection data of the laser radar to obtain a pulse feature matrix; performing feature decomposition on the pulse feature matrix, performing dynamic visualization processing on the obtained feature value, and extracting a dynamic change value; judging whether the extracted dynamic change values have biological characteristic values, if so, continuing to judge the dynamic change values after eliminating the biological characteristic values until all the dynamic change values have no biological characteristic values, and giving an alarm; if not, alarming is carried out. The scheme can accurately distinguish whether the scanned foreign object is a target object or not, such as falling rocks, debris flows, landslide, slumps and the like, and solves the problem that whether the foreign object is a living organism or a target object can not be distinguished when the radar detection is used conventionally, so that false alarm is caused.

title_en: Fire alarm apparatus having transparent stick
title_ko: 투광봉이 형성된 화재경보기
abstract_en: A fire alarm having a transparent stick according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: a body part detachably attached to a bracket installed on a ceiling; a fire detection part formed on one side of the body part to detect fire; a lighting part outputting predetermined light through a transparent stick having a predetermined length, which is detachably attached to the outside of the body part; a sound part formed on one side of the body part to output a preset sound; and a control part for outputting the predetermined light and sound when the fire is detected and providing a fire alarm. The hearing-impaired or general public can easily check the fire alarm.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 투광봉이 형성된 화재경보기는 천장에 설치된 브라켓에 탈부착되는 몸체부와, 상기 몸체부의 일측에 형성되어 화재를 감지하는 화재감지부와, 상기 몸체부의 외측에 탈부착되는 기 설정된 길이의 투광봉을 통해 기 설정된 조명을 출력하는 조명부와, 상기 몸체부의 일측에 형성되어 기 설정된 음향을 출력하는 음향부와, 화재가 감지되는 경우 기 설정된 조명 및 음향을 출력하여 화재경보를 하도록 하는 제어부를 포함한다.

title_en: Safety alarm system based on computer control
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an alarm system technical field specifically is a safety alarm system based on computer control, including pipeline closing device, alarm device, flame induction system, gaseous induction system, positioner, resident siren and computer terminal, it can change this point to indoor gas when utilizing air pipe to take a breath, judge whether there is conflagration or condition of a fire hidden danger to exist by the unified inhaled air of air pipe through detecting, its detection area is bigger than traditional fire detection head, the blind area is littleer, and will seal air pipe under the control at computer terminal after detecting the condition of a fire information, avoid the condition of a fire to spread through air pipe, practical meaning and spreading value have, expect to produce good economic benefits.

title_en: Safety monitoring alarm device for underground mobile equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a safety monitoring and alarming device for underground mobile equipment, which comprises an underground working vehicle, a multifunctional identification bracelet and an underground mobile equipment identification card which are used for underground workers to carry, a plurality of roadway wireless communication positioning base stations which are arranged at the turning, blind areas and rest chamber areas of the underground roadway and roadway warning lamps which are arranged in the underground roadway, cameras and wireless communication positioning base stations are arranged at the front end and the rear end of the underground working vehicle, and a video display and a roadway monitor are arranged in a cab of the underground working vehicle; the utility model can clear the relationship between the safety monitoring and the warning alarm of underground mobile equipment, people and roadways, carry out early warning when the distance is long, carry out alarm when the distance is short, and accurately identify and alarm at turning and blind area points of the roadways; the system effectively reminds a warning driver and other personnel to take reliable safe operation measures, and solves the problems of safety monitoring and warning alarm in the operation of underground mobile equipment.

title_en: Geological disaster monitoring sensor device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a geological disasters monitoring sensor device, including surveying the casing, the top of surveying the casing is provided with sealed locking Assembly, the inside fixed mounting who surveys the casing has wireless transmission module, the inside fixed mounting of casing is surveyed to one side of wireless transmission module has data acquisition module, the inside fixed mounting of casing is surveyed to one side of data acquisition module has the detection sensor. This geological disaster monitoring sensor device, accessible GPRS/CDMA network is connected with wireless transmission module, and send control command, data acquisition module carries out real-time collection dynamic display to the data that survey the sensor acquireed, the software will be can show the network state information that comes from wireless sensor network transmission and the information that the node gathered on graphical interface dynamically, simultaneously under the C/S mode, can forward other customer ends with the data of gathering, when surveying sensor data and reaching the warning upper limit of system setting, accessible terminal and cell-phone control alarm instrument and sound real-time warning.

title_en: Multifunctional video access control device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multi-functional video entrance guard device, including the entrance guard main part, the inside middle part that is located the entrance guard main part of entrance guard main part is equipped with electronic slide rail, slidable mounting has the screen main part on the electronic slide rail, the screen main part is equipped with the slip with electronic slide rail sliding connection department, the inside of electronic slide rail is equipped with traction spring, traction spring's one end is connected with screen main part top, the inside below that is located the screen main part of electronic slide rail is equipped with the telescopic link. The utility model discloses in, at first, be equipped with over-and-under type structure, send control signal to wireless receiving module through mobile terminal, wireless receiving module is with signal transmission to controller analysis processes back, realizes the lift of screen main part through electronic slide rail, the visual field blind area of being convenient for keep watch on, secondly, adopts wireless suggestion structure, passes through wireless transmission module with control information through mobile terminal and transmits to controller analysis processes back, starts the reputation warning light, has realized remote prompt facility.

title_en: A system for emergency safety warning and risk mitigation
abstract_en: Various embodiments relate to a system for activities of daily living (“ADL”) and instrumental activities of daily living (“IADL”) monitoring through electric current profile sensing, the system including an electric current profile sensing module configured to sense electricity usage and capture a current profile of a plurality of devices in a home using a plurality of current clamps, a device usage detection module configured to match the current profile for each of the plurality of devices to a referenced profile for each of the plurality of devices to determine a detected usage for each of the plurality of devices and an ADL and IADL module configured to translate the detected usage for each of the plurality of devices into ADLs and IADLs; wherein the ADL and IADL detection module determines whether a detected usage is a hazardous situation based on ADLs and IADLs.

title_en: Tramcar level crossing safety detection device and method based on image recognition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tramcar level crossing safety detection device and method based on image recognition, wherein the device comprises sound-light alarm equipment, an image acquisition and processing device and a barrier gate system; the barrier gate system rises and falls the barrier rod according to the analysis result of the image acquisition and processing device, and sends out an alarm prompt through the sound-light alarm device, so that vehicles and pedestrians passing through the level crossing can pass through safely. The invention can send out warning information before the tramcar reaches the level crossing by adding the image acquisition and processing device and combining the improvement of the barrier gate mechanism, thereby preventing the tramcar from invading into the crossing protection area and simultaneously accurately identifying the foreign matters which are still positioned in the crossing protection area, and then controlling the rising and falling of the road bar according to the result, ensuring the driving safety when the tramcar passes through the crossing protection area, and greatly improving the safety when the tramcar passes through the crossing protection area.

title_en: Multilingual safety management broadcasting device
title_ko: 다국어 안전관리 방송장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a multilingual safety management broadcasting device for realizing more efficient site management, which comprises: an RF board having an RF module; a main board including a voice IC, an audio controller, an internal/external speaker amplifier, a CPU for performing a control operation, a mobile communication module, and an internal/external speaker for outputting a voice signal to the outside; and an emergency button for operating a warning light, and issuing an alarm for an emergency situation.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 안전관리 방송장치에 관한 것으로서, 특히 마이크를 이용한 유선 또는 무전기 및 휴대폰을 이용한 무선에 의해 선택적으로 안전관리장치의 방송을 제어하고, 비상상황시 선택된 다국어로 안내방송을 출력함으로써, 보다 효율적인 현장관리를 구현하는 다국어 안전관리 방송장치에 관한 것이다.  이를 위해 본 발명은 외부의 무전기와 무선신호를 송·수신할 수 있도록 RF모듈이 구비된 알에프 보드(RF Board)와; 제어동작을 수행할 수 있도록 음성IC와, 오디오 콘트롤러와, 내·외부스피커 앰프와, 제어동작을 수행하는 CPU와, 이동통신모듈과, 음성신호를 외부로 출력하는 내·외부스피커가 구비된 메인 보드와; 경광등을 작동시키며 비상상황을 경보하는 비상버튼을 포함하여 구성되어, 스피커로 통해 안전관리 방송을 출력하고 경광등을 작동시키는 안전관리 방송장치에 있어서, 안전관리 방송장치에 구비된 비상버튼이 작동되는 경우 국가별 선택스위치에 의해 선택제어된 특정한 국가에 대한 국가별 안내방송을 순차적으로 내부스피커 및 외부스피커와 지정된 무전기로 출력하고, 지정된 휴대폰으로 긴급 안전문자를 발송하며, 무전기 또는 마이크 또는 휴대폰 중 어느 하나 이상에서 전달되는 음성신호에 의해 내부스피커 및 외부스피커와 지정된 무전기로 실시간 안전방송을 출력하되, 상기 안전관리방송장치에는 외부의 무전기를 안전관리 방송장치와 통신 가능한 상태로 등록하기 위한 주파수복사버튼이 구비되며, 외부의 무전기를 안전관리 방송장치(100)에 인접한 상태에서 송신을 하고, 안전관리 방송장치의 주파수복사버튼(108)을 작동하면, 상기 RF모듈이 주파수 스캔을 하여 무전기의 송신주파수를 검색하고, 그 주파수를 분석하여 안전관리 방송장치에 지정된 무전기로 저장하는 것을 특징으로 하는 다국어 안전관리 방송장치를 제안한다. 따라서, 본 발명은 유선 또는 무선에 의해 안전관리장치의 방송을 제어함에 있어서, 현재 발생된 비상상황에 따라 유선 또는 무선에 의해 효율적인 안전방송을 실현할 수 있고, 공사장이나 다중 이용 시설 등에 모여있는 다양한 국적의 사람들에게 모국어로 현재 상황을 인지할 수 있도록 방송함으로써, 안전사고의 피해를 최소화 할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Forward and Rear Safety Apparatus For Vehicle
title_ko: 탈 것을 위한 전후방주의 안전장치
abstract_en: Provided is a safety device for forward and backward collision warning for a vehicle. The safety device for forward and backward collision warning for a vehicle is a safety device mounted on a vehicle where a front wheel and a rear wheel are disposed respectively at the front side and the rear side, which comprises: an obstacle detection unit mounted on the front side or the rear side of the vehicle to detect an obstacle which comes closer or goes farther within a predetermined distance and transmit the detected data to a control unit; an image output unit mounted on one side of the vehicle to output the data received from the control unit as an image signal to a driver; a sound output unit mounted on one side of the vehicle to output the data received from the control unit as a sound signal to a driver; and a control unit for calculating a distance from the obstacle in real time, based on the data received from the obstacle detection unit, estimating chance of collision with the obstacle, based on the calculated data, and transmitting a warning signal to the image output unit and the sound output unit when the chance of collision exceeds a predetermined reference value. According to the present invention, the chance of collision with an obstacle is estimated to give a warning to a driver and a blind spot in driving can be eliminated to prevent an accident.
abstract_ko:
탈 것을 위한 전후방주의 안전장치가 제시된다.  본 발명의 실시예에 따른 전후방주의 안전장치는, 전방과 후방에 각각 전륜 및 후륜이 구비된 탈 것에 장착되는 전후방주의 안전장치로서, 상기 탈 것의 전방 또는 후방에 장착되고, 소정 거리 이내로 접근하거나 멀어지는 장애물을 검출하여 검출된 데이터를 제어부에 송신하는 장애물 검출부; 상기 탈 것의 일측에 장착되고, 제어부로부터 수신된 데이터를 탑승자에게 영상신호로 출력하는 영상출력부; 상기 탈 것의 일측에 장착되고, 제어부로부터 수신된 데이터를 탑승자에게 소리신호로 출력하는 소리출력부; 및 상기 장애물 검출부로부터 수신된 데이터를 바탕으로 장애물과의 거리를 실시간으로 산출하고, 산출된 데이터를 바탕으로 장애물과의 충돌 가능성을 예측하며, 충돌 가능성이 기설정된 기준값을 초과할 경우 영상출력부와 소리출력부에 경고발생 신호를 송신하는 제어부;를 포함하는 것을 구성의 요지로 한다. 
본 발명에 따르면, 장애물과의 충돌 가능성을 예측하여 탑승자에게 경고하고, 라이딩 중 사각지대를 해소함으로써 안전사고 발생을 미연에 차단할 수 있는 탈 것을 위한 전후방주의 안전장치를 제공할 수 있다.

title_en: Intelligent fire-fighting robot control method based on three-dimensional point cloud model
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent fire-fighting robot control method based on a three-dimensional point cloud model, which comprises the following steps: establishing a mapping relation between a robot coordinate system and a three-dimensional point cloud model, extracting coordinates of abnormal heating points from a picture captured by an infrared camera, determining an expected pose of the tail end of the robot, establishing a tail end expected homogeneous transformation matrix, solving angles of all shaft joints of the robot by using a Pieper method, selecting a most recent solution as an optimal solution, controlling the robot to move to an expected position, starting a high-pressure water mist spray gun valve to cool until the temperature is reduced to be below an alarm threshold value, finishing cooling, and resetting the robot. The method uses the Pieper method of intersecting the rotation translation matrix and the three axes, and can realize the accurate positioning of the six-axis fire-fighting robot to the abnormal temperature-rising point of the fire scene by virtue of the on-site three-dimensional point cloud model, and can avoid the threat and loss to the personal safety of workers and the electric power system caused by the abnormal temperature rise of the transformer and even the occurrence of fire explosion.

The method comprises the following steps: the system comprises an acquisition module, a marking module, a dividing module, a training module and an early warning module. title_en: Security access
abstract_en:
This invention consists of 2 main parts: 
     1. a smoke detector or fire/smoke alarm detection unit which includes a wireless transmitter. The wireless transmitter communicates with an electronic locking mechanism which is incorporated into each security bar assembly unit found at all the doors and windows in a building. The locking mechanism includes a receiver and actuator incorporated into the bar assembly unit. The wireless transmitter communicates with the receiver. The security bar assembly also includes spring hinges as well as a battery back up and low battery warning system featuring both a flashing light (for the hearing impaired) and a buzzer (for the visually impaired. There is also a manual release button. In the event that the smoke detection unit is activated, the wireless transmitter sends a signal to the receiver which in turn activates the electronic lock to the open position. Since smoke detectors and fire/smoke alarm detection units are interconnected, all the bars throughout the building would be activated regardless of where the fire originates thus allowing multiple exiting options for the occupants and multiple ingress options for emergency responders. The spring hinges then cause the bars to swing to the open position. The integrated battery provides power to activate the locking mechanism in case of loss of ac power. The low battery warning system provides a flashing light (for the hearing impaired) as well as a buzzer (for the visually impaired) to indicate that the battery needs replacing. The manual release button provides a means of egress in the event that both ac and battery power are non existent. 
     2. The electronic lock system also includes an actuator which allows for wireless communication via the internet using a mobile phone or computer app which would be installed on the devices of local emergency responders. 
     Each security bar assembly would be programmed with its own unique access code. This code would be provided to and filed with the local emergency dispatch center. The app would consist of a numeric key pad that when the user punches the correct code sends a signal to the actuator in the security bar assembly activating it into the open position. In the event of a 911 call, dispatch would provide the emergency responders with the access code and they would in turn use their mobile device to remotely activate the security bar assembly to the open position. The system would also include an integrated Knox type lock to provide a manual access option for emergency response personnel in the event of an electrical power outage and the battery has run dry or in the event of a more widespread loss of power.

The system mainly comprises an inertia measurement unit, a data processing unit, an acousto-optic early warning unit, a wireless communication unit and the like; the system acquires inertial data related to the head posture through an inertial measurement unit arranged on the safety helmet, processes the data through a data processing unit to obtain the fatigue state of personnel, and performs early warning when the conditions are met. title_en: Space Sterilization Machine

abstract_en: The present invention relates to a space sterilization device which is attached to a wall surface of a building, is configured to detect whether a person exists in a space, and is configured to generate, when it is determined that there is a person, a warning sound to evacuate people in the space or to automatically carry out disinfection when it is determined that there is no persons. The space sterilization device comprises: a nozzle unit which sprays a sterilization solution; an operation unit which includes a UV unit that emits UV rays and is attached to one side of a wall surface of a building; a pump unit connected to the operation unit and configured to transmit the sterilization solution to the nozzle unit; a control unit which controls the operation unit and the pump unit; and a filter unit configured to filter out foreign substances between the nozzle unit and the pump unit. The pump unit includes: a storage tank in which the sterilization solution is stored; a pump configured to transmit the sterilization solution from the storage tank to the nozzle unit; and a compressor which transmits high-pressure air into the pump so that the sterilization solution is sprayed in the form of mist from the nozzle unit. In this case, the control unit includes: a detection sensor provided in the operation unit and configured to detect the presence of a person in the space; and a pressure sensor which detects leakage of a pipe connected from the pump unit to the nozzle unit. In addition, the present invention further comprises an alarm unit which generates a warning sound when the presence of a person in the space is detected by the detection sensor, and the alarm unit is provided on one side of the operation unit.

title_en: Coal rock instability destruction precursor information identification method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for judging the information of a coal rock instability destruction precursor, which comprises the following steps: carrying out real-time acoustic emission monitoring on the loaded coal rock mass, and acquiring the spatial coordinates and the seismic time of an acoustic emission event corresponding to the loaded coal rock mass to obtain an acoustic emission event sequence; establishing a single-key group structure of an acoustic emission event sequence; calculating a unit vector of each single key, translating the starting point of each unit vector to the sphere center of the unit sphere, and converting the direction characteristics of each single key into discrete points on the spherical surface of the unit sphere for representation; obtaining the distribution characteristics of discrete points on the spherical surface by adopting a spherical crown surface covering method, and obtaining the fractal dimension of the distribution characteristics in the single bond direction; and acquiring the precursor information of coal rock instability damage by analyzing the change rule of the fractal dimension of the single-bond direction distribution characteristics, and realizing the early warning of coal rock instability damage. The method for judging and identifying the coal rock instability damage precursor information is convenient to solve and reliable in result.

title_en: Underground pressure monitoring device and method for petroleum production
abstract_en: The invention relates to an oil exploitation auxiliary system and method, in particular to an underground pressure monitoring device and method for oil exploitation. The technical scheme is as follows: the bottom of the process pipe column is provided with a monitoring early warning device, the upper part of the process pipe column is provided with a signal terminal receiver, the upper end of a system carrier of the monitoring early warning device is connected with the lower end of the blind plug, a pressure limiting carrier, an induction protection block and a sensor are sequentially arranged in an inner cavity of the system carrier, the lower end of the system carrier is provided with a limiting cover plate, the middle part of the induction protection block is provided with an induction contact and a sensing support spring, and the upper end of the induction contact is electrically connected with the sensor. The beneficial effects are that: the pressure signal and the blowout signal of the stratum are converted into electric signals by using the sensor, the stratum change in the well is transmitted to the ground in a wireless electromagnetic wave mode, and due to the fact that the transmission speed of the electromagnetic wave is high, personnel on the ground have time to rapidly start an emergency treatment scheme and rapidly evacuate and avoid risks, and casualties and partial property loss are reduced.

title_en: Intelligent internet-of-things heat-insulation fire-fighting well cover

This well lid can prevent that personnel or foreign matter from getting into the fire well at will and destroying the facility in fire well and the fire well, can also prevent rain and snow etc. to get into in the well. Thereby protecting and insulating the fire well. The detector is used for detecting whether the well lid is operated by mistake, and if yes, an alarm signal is generated. The alarm signal can be sent to the client or the monitoring terminal in a wireless or wired transmission mode to carry out early warning. Before operation, the well lid is opened after the identity is confirmed by the detector, otherwise, the system gives an alarm to prevent the misoperation of irrelevant personnel, and the well lid is automatically recovered when being covered again. The detector can also automatically inspect.

The invention can detect whether a foreign object touches the edge server, can protect the edge server deployed in the field, and plays a role in warning people or field animals touching the edge server.

title_en: Method and system for notifying danger zone and social distancing

abstract_en: Disclosed are a method and system for notifying of dangerous zones and social distance. According to the present invention, a transmission/reception device carried by a user transmits a unique ID thereof at regular intervals, receives a unique ID sent from another transmission/reception device, and calculates a distance between the transmission/reception devices by using the strength of signals when the unique ID is received. The transmission/reception device determines a close contact state when the accumulated number of times of the calculated distances less than or equal to a critical distance is greater than or equal to a critical number of times and provides a social distancing notification to the user through at least one of vibration, sound, and display. Accordingly, the method provides an effect of enabling all people, including the visually impaired and hearing impaired, to effectively participate in a social distancing movement.

title_en: Electric safety alarm method and system for the blind person and hearing-impaired person

abstract_en: The present invention relates to an electric safety alarm method and device for the visually impaired person and hearing-impaired person which detects risk factors for electrical disasters occurring in electrical facilities, directly alerts the visually impaired person and hearing-impaired person, and guides a third party through wired communication in order to quickly remove the risk factors of electrical disasters and inconveniences caused by power outages. The electric safety alarm method for the visually impaired person and hearing-impaired person of the present invention comprises: a step of detecting the power of a secondary side of an earth leakage breaker when any one of leakage, short circuit, or overcurrent occurs in the electrical facility; a step of providing an alarm notification directly to the visually impaired person or hearing-impaired person in the event of an abnormality or fire in the electrical facility; and a step of displaying an alarm-phrase or playing an alarm-voice using an application installed on a smartphone of the visually impaired person and hearing-impaired person through wireless communication to provide an indirect alarm notification when the alarm notification is directly provided.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 전기설비에서 발생하는 전기재해 위험요소를 감지하여 시청각장애인에게 직접 경보를 알리고, 전기재해의 위험요소 및 정전으로 인한 불편사항을 신속히 제거하기 위해 제3자에게 유선통신을 통해 안내하는 시청각장애인용 전기안전 경보 방법 및 장치에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 시청각장애인용 전기안전 경보 방법은 전기설비에서 누전, 단락, 과전류 중 어느 하나가 발생시 누전차단기 2차측의 전원을 감지하는 단계와, 상기 전기설비의 이상 발생 또는 화재 발생시 시각장애인 또는 청각장애인에게 직접 경보 알림을 제공하는 단계와, 상기 직접 경보 알림과 동시에 무선통신을 통해 시청각장애인의 스마트폰에 설치된 어플리케이션을 이용하여 경보문구 표시 또는 경보음성이 재생되어 간접 경보 알림을 제공하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: Guidance apparatus for visually impaired

abstract_en: Disclosed is a guidance apparatus for a visually impaired person to transmit a location and dangerous situation of a visually impaired person to a smart terminal and a service server. According to the present invention, the guidance apparatus for a visually impaired person comprises: a main body fixed to an upper handle of a cane for a visually impaired person; an operation switch actuating the guidance apparatus; a front detection unit detecting front obstacles; an upper detection unit detecting upper obstacles; a gyro sensor detecting movement of the visually impaired person; a vibration generation unit generating vibration; a warning generation unit outputting a warning sound; and a first control unit detecting the front and upper obstacles through the front and upper detection units according to a selection of the operation switch to generate vibration by operating the vibration generation unit when there are obstacles within a set distance, and outputting an emergency situation signal through the warning generating unit when it is determined through the gyro sensor that the visually impaired person has fallen.

title_en: Vehicle blind area early warning method, system and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vehicle blind area early warning method, a vehicle blind area early warning system and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring vehicle running information of a target vehicle, and determining a vehicle running state of the target vehicle according to the vehicle running information; determining a target detection device for detecting a vehicle blind area of the target vehicle according to the vehicle running state, and acquiring target detection information of the vehicle blind area through the target detection device; generating a blind area early warning instruction according to the target detection information and the vehicle running information, and controlling target early warning equipment of the target vehicle to perform early warning according to the blind area early warning instruction. The method and the device realize accurate monitoring of the obstacles in the vehicle visual field blind spot area under the vehicle running state under the influence of different factors, and timely early warning is carried out aiming at the running states of the obstacles and the vehicle, so that potential traffic accident danger is avoided.

title_en: Community monitoring video motion detection disaster early warning algorithm based on RAFT (reversible addition-fragmentation chain transfer) optical flow
abstract_en: The invention discloses a community monitoring video motion detection disaster early warning algorithm based on RAFT optical flow, and belongs to the technical field of disaster early warning. A community surveillance video motion detection disaster early warning algorithm based on RAFT optical flow is characterized in that a surveillance camera video flow is obtained in real time, a RAFT optical flow algorithm is used for calculating motion vectors between two continuous frames in a surveillance video in real time, a RANSAC algorithm is used for filtering motion features inconsistent with a main motion direction to optimize the motion vectors and calculate a homography matrix, translational and rotational motion parameters between two frames of the video are calculated based on the homography matrix, then a Gaussian filter is used for denoising, the denoised motion parameters are accumulated and whether a set threshold value is exceeded or not is judged, and if the motion parameters exceed the set threshold value, a disaster early warning event is output; the dependence on manpower can be reduced, the disaster advance early warning of a certain degree is realized, the emergency plan of community property operation management is convenient to generate, and the life and property safety of residents is guaranteed.

title_en: Security related systems and methods
abstract_en: Systems and methods relating to security for buildings and/or facilities and/or individuals. Security related documentation, prepared by credentialed security professionals, are stored in a secure online accessible vault and are accessible to authorities or security professionals. To assist in the detection of emergencies, security camera output is assessed using AI based methods. If an emergency is detected, the security camera output is forwarded to a human assessor for confirmation. Once the emergency is confirmed, access to the security cameras is forwarded to emergency services to provide them with a live feed at the emergency location. To alert the public of such emergencies, a mobile app can provide notifications of such emergencies. The app uses a server that acquires data from multiple sources and analyzes the data to detect emergencies. Depending on the emergency's proximity to one or more user designated locations, a notification may be sent to the user.

title_en: Rail line multi-domain limit foreign matter intrusion event condition identification method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for identifying the condition of a rail line multi-domain limit foreign matter intrusion event, which belong to the technical field of railway disaster prevention risk early warning, and a rail surface state acquisition sensor device is selected to acquire rail surface state data according to the whole process monitoring requirement of the occurrence of the foreign matter intrusion event; dividing a rail surface limit area into a concerned domain, an early warning domain and a safety domain, and identifying, tracking and extracting characteristics of foreign matters which invade the limit; defining an intrusion event state description model; based on the intrusion event state characteristics, the identified intrusion foreign matter characteristic data is used as an intrusion event state description model dynamic characteristic parameter quantification risk value, and the intrusion foreign matter event detection rate of a rail surface limit safety domain, an early warning domain and a concerned domain is calculated. The invention realizes the monitoring, identification and analysis of the characteristics of the track line intrusion event and the event occurrence process, further improves the risk prevention and control capability of the track traffic system, and has good application and popularization values.

title_en: Rail line foreign matter intrusion monitoring and risk early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for monitoring the intrusion of foreign matters on a track line and early warning risk, which belong to the technical field of railway disaster prevention and early warning, and acquire three-dimensional space point cloud data around the track and track plane image data; identifying and extracting the foreign body characteristics in the boundary area according to the point cloud data and the track plane image data; according to the characteristics of the intrusion foreign bodies, calculating risks of different characteristics by adopting an analytic hierarchy process and a risk matrix process, and carrying out fusion calculation on the risks of different characteristics to obtain a comprehensive risk value of the intrusion foreign bodies; and carrying out early warning treatment and evidence obtaining reporting according to the risk classification of the intrusion foreign bodies. The invention realizes the monitoring, identification and analysis of the characteristics of the track line intrusion event and the event occurrence process, further improves the risk prevention and control capability of the track traffic system, and has good application and popularization values.

title_en: Method, system, device and storage medium for preventing and controlling fire-fighting risk of stadium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system, equipment and a storage medium for preventing and controlling fire risks of a stadium, and relates to the field of building fire risk prevention and control. The method comprises the steps of monitoring and collecting environmental data in a stadium, judging whether the environment is abnormal or not according to the distribution condition of the environmental data in real time, determining abnormal environmental data according to the abnormal condition appearing in the environmental data, and further determining a risk coefficient based on the abnormal environmental data through a pre-trained risk identification model to serve as a reference index of risk early warning. Under the condition that the risk coefficient reaches a certain emergency degree, the possible flowing condition of the staff in the stadium is predicted by further combining the risk coefficient, the predicted flowing condition is used as reference information for staff evacuation, managers are assisted to find possible staff congestion or staff blind areas, reference is provided for fast and orderly evacuation of the staff, and better safety guarantee is provided for the staff in the stadium.

title_en: Fire safety guidance system for apartment houses
title_ko: 공동주택의 소방용 안전 유도장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a safety guiding device for firefighting of an apartment house comprising: a sensing unit; a controlling unit; a display unit; a visibility securing unit; and an interlocking unit. The sensing unit measures temperatures of a plurality of front doors, each household, stairs from a front door to a household, and an elevator; and transmits a temperature signal. The controlling unit calculates a fire generating area and a fire diffusion expecting area through the temperature signal received from the sensing unit, and determines an evacuation path. The display unit allows an evacuee to confirm the evacuation path depending on a driving signal transmitted from the controlling unit, and is provided in a common area among the household, the stairs, and the elevator. The visibility securing unit secures visibility to allow the evacuee to confirm the evacuation path by discharging foreign substances accumulated in the display unit or smoke generated during fire to a far direction from the display unit. The interlocking unit bypasses firewater to drive the visibility securing unit by hydraulic pressure of the firewater when the firewater is supplied to a sprinkler by outputting a fire alarm. The present invention can reduce time and a cost required to install the safety guiding device for firefighting.
