abstract_en: A dual motion vibration generator (1) of a driver warning device (100) applied to a vehicle comprises: vibration units (30, 60) rotating with a predetermined phase difference from a motor shaft (11a) of a motor (11), and generating different translational movements by the phase difference; and vibration boxes (20-1, 20-2) housing the motor (11) and the vibration units (30, 60) in a receiving space (21), and allowing a portion of the vibration unit (30, 60) to move in and out of one side of the receiving space (21) at phase difference intervals. Therefore, during driving of a vehicle, translational movements of different phases suitable for relieving driver fatigue or emergency warnings can be generated as location-specific vibrations from a single motor. title_en: All-in-one fire alarm system
title_ko: 올인원 화재 경보 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an all-in-one fire alarm system capable of being installed in a facility such as a refrigeration warehouse; sensing occurrence of fire through smoke sensing; improving a fire sensing performance by removing foreign substances such as dust or moisture of the facility. The all-in-one fire alarm system comprises: an enclosure unit; an air supplying line; a fire sensing device; a repeater; a cyclone hopper; an inline filter; and a water trap. The enclosure unit is installed in the refrigeration warehouse and forms an inner space to be opened and closed. The air supplying line supplies air of the refrigeration warehouse in which the enclosure unit is installed to the enclosure unit. The fire sensing device is installed in the enclosure unit, and senses smoke caused by fire in the air supplied through the air supplying line. The repeater receives sensing of the smoke from the fire sensing device and fire occurrence in the refrigeration warehouse to a control center or a manager terminal. The cyclone hopper is installed inside the enclosure unit, and removes dust included in the air while sucking the air to a direction of the enclosure unit through the air supplying line. The inline filter receives the air passing through the cyclone hopper, and removes the dust included in the air once more. The water trap collects moisture generated by condensation from the inside of the enclosure unit and drains the moisture to the outside of the enclosure unit.

title_en: Wearable system for detection of environmental hazards
abstract_en: The disclosed wearable device systems include several features for alerting and guiding persons who are approaching or near to potentially hazardous or high-risk conditions in their nearby environment. Sensor data from wearable devices (also referred to herein as “wearables”) are used to determine the presence of various unsafe environmental conditions and phenomenon, including dangerous terrain or other unusual conditions. The wearable would be used to warn a person, for example via auditory or haptic-based feedback, if the person is about to encounter an unsafe condition. In particular, the proposed systems can be of great benefit to the visually impaired, those persons with physical disabilities, or persons otherwise vulnerable to particular environmental conditions.

abstract_en: In an integrated emergency bell enclosure, camera sets consisting of a high-focal distance camera and a low-focal distance camera are installed to and monitor 90 degrees in all directions on all four sides on top of the enclosure, such that a total of eight emergency bell cameras are installed with a fixed camera function for 360-degree surveillance without blind spots. The integrated emergency bell enclosure consists of a switch hub, a power supply, a broadcasting device, a video storage memory, and an Eve SERVER, wherein the Eve SERVER and a Bob SERVER communicate through an unlicensed frequency wireless communication device, videos from crime prevention surveillance cameras are transmitted to an integrated crime prevention center through the switch hub for real-time monitoring, and videos from emergency bell cameras are stored in the video storage memory. In a wireless integrated enclosure, four wireless cameras with a low focus distance are installed to monitor each 90 degrees in all directions on top of the enclosure, and the Eve SERVER and Bob SERVER communicate through the unlicensed frequency wireless communication device. When an emergency bell button is inserted in a front surface of the integrated wireless enclosure and the emergency bell button is activated, the Eve SERVER connects to a network with the Bob SERVER through an unlicensed frequency wireless private network and then establishes a two-way call with an Alice SERVER inside the integrated crime prevention center. Accordingly, performance is improved for surveillance without blind spots and distortion and effective dissemination of civil defense warnings.

abstract_en: A method for recognizing a dangerous situation of the present invention, which can recognize a dangerous situation even in a non-detected area such as a blind spot of a CCTV to quickly handle the situation, comprises: a step of receiving, by a signal processing unit, an audio signal collected by one or more sensor devices; a step of detecting, by the signal processing unit, an interested audio signal, which is an audio signal having a pre-set interested frequency band, from the received audio signal; a step of analyzing, by a situation recognition unit, the interested audio signal through a trained recognition model to check whether the received audio signal is a rescue request sound signal, which is a sound signal requesting rescue in a dangerous situation; and a step of sending, by a warning unit, a rescue request message requesting rescue to a pre-set contact number when the received audio signal is the rescue request sound signal as a checking result.

abstract_en: A user terminal for outputting a disaster alarm message comprises: a message receiving unit receiving a disaster alarm message from a disaster alarm message provision server; an extraction unit extracting, from the received disaster alarm message, at least one character included in a zero-padding area; a detection unit detecting, from the extracted at least one character, a recognized character and a keyword located next to the recognized character; a reconstruction unit determining specific display information corresponding to the keyword among predetermined display information, based on the recognized character, and performing reconstruction so that the determined specific display information is to be included in the disaster alarm message; and an output unit outputting the reconstructed disaster alarm message. Therefore, the user terminal enables vulnerable groups such as foreigners and illiterate people who are not familiar with the character of a corresponding country to recognize the text of a disaster text message.
abstract_ko: 재난 경보 메시지를 출력하는 사용자 단말은 재난 경보 메시지 제공 서버로부터 재난 경보 메시지를 수신하는 메시지 수신부, 상기 수신한 재난 경보 메시지로부터 제로 패딩 영역에 포함된 적어도 하나 이상의 문자를 추출하는 추출부, 상기 추출된 적어도 하나 이상의 문자로부터 인식 문자 및 상기 인식 문자의 다음에 위치한 키워드를 검출하는 검출부, 상기 인식 문자에 기초하여 기지정된 표출 정보 중 상기 키워드에 대응하는 특정 표출 정보를 결정하고, 상기 결정된 특정 표출 정보가 상기 재난 경보 메시지에 포함되도록 재구성하는 재구성부 및 상기 재구성된 재난 경보 메시지를 출력하는 출력부를 포함한다.

title_en: Early warning device for traffic blind area
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an early warning device for traffic blind areas, which comprises a mounting disc, wherein a loudspeaker is fixedly arranged on the rear side of the mounting disc, a wide-angle lens is fixedly arranged on the front side of the mounting disc, an early warning lamp belt is fixedly arranged on the outer side of the wide-angle lens, a bottom plate is arranged below the mounting disc, a plurality of threaded sleeves are arranged at the top of the bottom plate, and screw rods are fixedly arranged below the mounting disc and at the bottoms of the threaded sleeves; the utility model carries out early warning on passing vehicles and pedestrians in aspects of vision, hearing and the like through the wide-angle lens, the loudspeaker and the early warning lamp belt, and compared with the traditional passive vision early warning, the striking early warning lamp belt and the loudspeaker can play a better role, and the humidity sensor detects the humidity of the external environment and then the controller controls the electric heating plate to be opened to heat the mirror surface to remove water mist.
assignees: XINJIANG BEIDOU TONGCHUANG INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Driving blind area reminding system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of road surface warning equipment, in particular to a traveling blind area reminding system which comprises a road, a first support and a second support, wherein the first support and the second support are arranged at two ends of a corner of the road, a control box is arranged at the lower ends of the first support and the second support, a single chip microcomputer PLC or a raspberry pie is arranged in the control box, suspension brackets are arranged at the heads of the first support and the second support, an auxiliary frame is rotatably arranged at the lower end of each suspension bracket, a vehicle identification component and a warning component are fixedly arranged on each auxiliary frame, the first support and the second support are arranged at two ends of the corner of the road, and then the suspension brackets, the auxiliary frame, the vehicle identification component and the warning component are respectively supported and arranged through the first support and the second support, so that when a vehicle travels to one side, whether a traveling vehicle exists at the other side can be observed through the vehicle identification component at the other side.

title_en: Special system equipment for prompting dangerous actions through video analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a special system device for prompting dangerous actions through video analysis, which belongs to the technical field of dangerous action prompting devices, and particularly relates to special system device for prompting dangerous actions through video analysis, which comprises a box body and a prompting system, wherein a rotating mechanism is movably connected inside the box body, a supporting plate is movably connected at the top of the box body, the bottom of the rotating mechanism is fixedly connected with the top of the supporting plate, supporting mechanisms are movably connected at both sides of the box body, the input end of the prompting system is electrically connected with a power supply module in a unidirectional manner, the prompting system comprises a control module, the output end of the control module is electrically connected with a voice prompting module and an audible and visual alarm module in a unidirectional manner respectively, and the problem that the special system device for prompting dangerous actions is usually fixedly arranged at a certain position is solved, so that a certain monitoring blind area exists, the working quality of dangerous action prompts is reduced, the use position cannot be changed, and a certain limitation is caused to the working of dangerous action prompts is solved.

title_en: Fire control fire alarm flame detection device for tunnel
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire-fighting fire alarm flame detection device for a tunnel, which comprises a tunnel fire-fighting cabinet arranged in the tunnel, wherein a semi-arc-shaped strip is arranged at the front side of the top of the tunnel fire-fighting cabinet, and an arc-shaped sleeve block is sleeved on the semi-arc-shaped strip in a sliding manner; through the cooperation of the semi-arc strip that sets up, arc cover piece, triangle piece and flame detection device body, remove the position of arc cover piece on the semi-arc strip, thereby adjustable flame detection device's detection height in the tunnel, very big the condition that flame detection device in having avoided present tunnel is fixed and can't be adjusted, the detection effect of flame detection device has been improved, simultaneously, the piston rod of still accessible electric telescopic handle extends or shortens, the cooperation of rethread spliced pole and flame detection device, the different detection angles of flame detection device body are adjusted according to different tunnels and actual demand, the flexibility is strong, the detection effect of flame detector has been greatly improved.

title_en: Inner wheel difference warning risk avoiding method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to an inner wheel difference warning risk avoiding method and system, which belong to the field of inner wheel difference blind area risk avoiding, and the method comprises the following steps: when the vehicle starts to turn, starting a projection real-time display area blind area range, and detecting whether an object is positioned in an inner wheel difference blind area or not through an ultrasonic sensor; if yes, starting a primary alarm, and judging whether the object is a heat source entity by utilizing the infrared pyroelectric sensor; if yes, a secondary alarm is started, and whether the heat source entity is located within the dangerous distance limit is judged by the Beidou foundation enhancement system; if yes, starting an automatic emergency braking system of the vehicle-mounted terminal. The invention can display the blind area of the inner wheel difference in real time when the large truck turns right and can carry out multi-element and multi-level warning and danger avoidance aiming at each responsible party of traffic, solves the problem of hidden danger of traffic accident of each relevant party Shi Ce facing traffic and accurately 'perspective' the blind area of the inner wheel difference, and fundamentally solves the problem of hidden danger of traffic accident of the blind area of the inner wheel difference.

title_en: Railway line geological disaster early warning system adopting pressure and buoyancy omnibearing monitoring
abstract_en: The invention discloses a railway line geological disaster early warning system adopting pressure and buoyancy omnibearing monitoring, which comprises a disaster monitoring module, a disaster occurrence judging module, a signal processing and converting module and a disaster judging module; the disaster monitoring module comprises a flood disaster monitoring device and an omnibearing debris flow disaster monitoring device and is used for monitoring the track water accumulation condition and the invasion of foreign matters; the disaster occurrence judging module is used for judging whether a disaster occurs or not by using a rail disaster warning platform and signal mechanism hardware equipment; the signal processing and converting module is used for modulating, demodulating and analog-to-digital converting analog signals and judging the types and position signals of the sent alarm signals through the signals; the disaster distinguishing module is used for distinguishing the occurrence condition of the disaster and sending out an alarm signal to deal with the two disasters. The invention realizes the early warning of the torrential flood and the debris flow on the road sections with multiple accidents, such as tunnels or tunnel mouths, solves the problems of single monitoring function and limited monitoring direction, and ensures the safe operation of railways in the sections with multiple accidents.

title_en: Heat and humidity detection plant pot
title_ko: 온습도 감지 화분
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a heat and humidity detection plant pot, which is to detect changes in temperature and humidity through a plant pot body, and allows enough sound to be heard indoors through a speaker so as to solve the problem of difficulty in management by beginners and the visually impaired, such that the existing simple preservation function allows subjective observation of soil and plant conditions during cultivation, thereby solving the problem of difficulty in management by the beginners and the visually impaired. According to the present invention, the heat and humidity detection plant pot comprises: a pot body which is formed to turn red in the temperature and humidity environment set through LED lights to indicate changes in temperature and humidity detection in the plant pot; a soil temperature and humidity sensor designed to display real-time temperature and humidity values so that soil humidity and temperature can be measured; and a speaker configured to sound a notification at a set time and frequency intervals in a temperature and humidity environment in which the sound is set to be sufficiently audible indoors. Therefore, the present invention displays the detected changes in temperature and humidity by the pot body, and allows enough sound to be audible indoors through the speaker, thereby solving the problem of difficulty in management by the beginners and the visually impaired. Therefore, the existing simple preservation function allows subjective observation of soil and plant conditions during cultivation, thereby solving the problem of difficulty in management by the beginners and the visually impaired.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 온습도 감지 화분에 관한 것으로서 화분 본체에 의하여 온습도 감지 변화를 나타낼 수 있게 하고, 스피커에 의하여 실내에서 충분히 소리가 들릴 수 있게 함으로써 초보자 및 시각장애인이 관리하기에 어려운 문제점을 해소하도록 함으로써 기존의 단순히 보존하는 기능으로 재배 시 토양 및 식물 상태를 주관적으로 관찰하여 초보자 및 시각장애인이 관리하기에 어려운 문제점을 해소 하도록 한 것이다. 즉 본 발명은, 화분에 있어서 온습도 감지 변화를 나타낼 수 있게 LED등을 통해 설정된 온도, 습도 환경에서 붉은색을 띄도록 형성한 화분 본체, 토양의 습도와 온도 측정을 할 수 있게 실시간 온도와 습도 값이 보여질 수 있도록 형성한 토양온습도센서, 실내에서 충분히 소리가 들릴 수 있게 설정된 온도, 습도 환경에서 알림이 설정한 시간과 횟수 간격으로 울리도록 구성한 스피커로 구성한 것이다. 따라서, 본 발명은 화분 본체에 의하여 온습도 감지 변화를 나타낼 수 있게 하고, 스피커에 의하여 실내에서 충분히 소리가 들릴 수 있게 함으로써 초보자 및 시각장애인이 관리하기에 어려운 문제점을 해소하도록 함으로써 기존의 단순히 보존하는 기능으로 재배 시 토양 및 식물 상태를 주관적으로 관찰하여 초보자 및 시각장애인이 관리하기에 어려운 문제점을 해소하도록 한 효과를 갖는 것이다.

title_en: Pipeline regulating valve group
abstract_en: The utility model provides a pipeline regulating valve group, which comprises a regulating valve, wherein sealing rings are fixedly arranged on two sides of the regulating valve through a plurality of screws, one sides of the two sealing rings are respectively provided with a fixed ring, one sides of the plurality of screws are respectively connected with nuts in a threaded manner, the other sides of the plurality of screws are respectively provided with a fixer, and the middle parts of the two sides of the regulating valve are respectively provided with a leakage-proof mechanism: the cooperation of user accessible leak protection ring and go-between has avoided liquid to leak from the junction of governing valve and pipeline, and when transporting petroleum, the temperature in the pipeline can not surpass the combustion value of petroleum, if surpass will cause the disaster, when temperature detection stick detects that the temperature is too high, will transmit the information to the warning light and make it send out the police dispatch newspaper to transmit the information to the governing valve, make it close the valve, further reduction loss.

title_en: Intelligent earthquake early warning device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent earthquake early warning device, which sends early warning to an installation place after receiving earthquake information sent by an earthquake table network or an earthquake early warning center (for an area where the earthquake early warning center is built), and relates to the field of earthquake early warning. The system is characterized by comprising a signal receiving module, a satellite positioning module, a seismic data analysis module, an early warning signal output module, a system setting module and a dual-mode power supply module. The intelligent earthquake early warning device solves the defects that the coverage area of an earthquake early warning system is limited, an early warning blind area exists, terminal equipment can work only after the earthquake early warning information sent by an earthquake early warning center is passively received in the existing earthquake early warning mode through a ready-to-install and ready-to-use installation mode and the capability of independent analysis and operation of the earthquake information, thereby realizing full-coverage non-blind area early warning and being beneficial to popularization and application of earthquake early warning service in all areas.

title_en: Indoor mobile and positioning auxiliary system convenient for visually impaired people
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mobile and positioning auxiliary system convenient for visually impaired people to use indoors, which belongs to the field of mobile and positioning auxiliary, and comprises an indoor positioning module of WIFI, an RSSI indoor ranging module, an AI voice recognition and processing module, a YOLO V4 image recognition module, a deep learning-based obstacle recognition early warning algorithm module and handheld interactive induction equipment, wherein a WIFI-based fingerprint matching algorithm is adopted for the calculation of an initial position, and a user starts the handheld interactive induction equipment according to fingerprint matching, so that mobile and positioning auxiliary service is started; a mapping relation between a coordinate point and a WIFI signal intensity vector is established, so that a fingerprint library is established. The indoor positioning system and the indoor positioning method provide greater help for the mobility inconvenience of visually impaired people by combining a series of technical services from indoor positioning equipment, indoor positioning software to an indoor positioning solution and the like.

title_en: Fire disaster early warning equipment and system thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses fire disaster early warning equipment and a system thereof, wherein the fire disaster early warning equipment comprises an early warning equipment bottom plate, plug boxes positioned at the left side and the right side of the early warning equipment bottom plate, and an anti-drop assembly fixed in the plug boxes; the front end of the early warning equipment bottom plate is provided with a connecting base, the inside of the connecting base is provided with a waterproof shell, the inside of the waterproof shell is provided with an explosion-proof lampshade, the inside of the plug box is provided with a sensor main body, the output end of the sensor management module is connected with a control module, and the output end of the control module is respectively connected with an emergency response module and a wireless transmission module. This conflagration early warning equipment and system thereof can install the sensor main part fast through plug box to carry out spacingly to the sensor main part through the inside anticreep subassembly of plug box, avoid the sensor main part slippage plug box, at the in-process of sensor main part plug simultaneously, accessible sensor management module manages the sensor main part.

title_en: Water regime early warning device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a water condition early warning device which comprises a tubular pile, wherein the upper end of the tubular pile is fixedly connected with a threaded block, the threaded block is connected with a floating plate in a threaded manner, the upper end of the threaded block is provided with a clamping block, a tube seat is arranged on the clamping block, the lower end of the tubular pile is provided with a balancing weight, the tubular pile is provided with a first liquid level meter and a second liquid level meter, the first liquid level meter and the second liquid level meter are arranged on the tubular pile one by one, and the outer sides of the first liquid level meter and the second liquid level meter are respectively provided with a buffer cover. According to the utility model, the balancing weight is arranged at the bottom of the pipe pile, when the device is used, the balancing weight can enable the early warning device to be vertical to water through gravity, the possibility of rollover of the early warning device when encountering rapid flow is reduced, and the device is provided with the buffer cover outside the liquid level meter, so that foreign matters can be blocked, meanwhile, the water flow can be buffered, the impact force when the liquid level meter is contacted with water is reduced, and the possibility of measuring misalignment of the liquid level meter is reduced.

title_en: "wearable device for collecting physiological health data"
abstract_en: One or more techniques and/or systems are disclosed for collecting vital physiological health data from a user, using a wearable device, such as a watch. The data can comprise heart rate, blood oxygen, body temperature, blood pressure, and fall detection, amongst other. The collected data can be translated to information presented to the user on a local device, such as a smart phone, and/or provided to a remote device or service and integrated into an electronic medical record, be used by the user's clinicians, and can help detect alert situations of the user. Such a wearable device may also be used to detect user activity, and/or fall detection, and provide emergency alerts to medical and emergency personnel.
assignees: N SQUARED TECH LLC;N SQUARED TECH INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED

title_en: Substation live equipment overhauls regional safety device
abstract_en: A safety protection device for an overhaul area of a transformer substation live equipment comprises four supporting structures distributed in a quadrilateral manner and isolation belts arranged between two adjacent supporting structures; an audible and visual alarm is arranged at the top of the supporting structure; the upper part of the supporting structure and the lower part of the audible and visual alarm are provided with detection radars, and the detection radars on each supporting structure face to a middle area surrounded by the four supporting structures along the horizontal direction, so that the detection radars form a radar detection area which is horizontally unfolded at the top of the supporting structure; this radar detection area keeps 2 meters apart from electrified equipment of transformer substation, when the staff examine the maintenance activity, touches the safe distance of 2 meters distance, and audible and visual alarm at accessible bearing structure top sends the warning to the staff, reminds the staff to need keep 2 meters safe distances apart from electrified equipment to play safety protection's effect.
assignees: STATE GRID NINGXIA ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD NINGDONG POWER SUPPLY COMPANY

title_en: Intelligent voice response system and method for weather disaster early warning information
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent voice response system and method for weather disaster early warning information, which relate to the technical field of the release of the weather disaster early warning information and currently propose the following scheme, wherein the intelligent voice response system comprises an intelligent voice response Web front end for early warning information and is used for being responsible for the interactive operation of users; the intelligent voice call Web back end of the early warning information is used for being responsible for audience user management, call result inquiry, call policy configuration and early warning information message generation and pushing; the intelligent voice call terminal is used for carrying out audio generation and multi-line Cheng Yuyin outbound according to the pre-alarm text content. Before the occurrence of disastrous weather, intelligent voice response of early warning information is carried out for government decision-making layers, emergency contacts of related departments and emergency responsibilities of enterprises, the problems that the traditional early warning information mobile phone short message has low accessibility for audience users, lacks interaction, is unknown in conveying effect, has poor effectiveness of manual telephone call and the like are solved, and the intelligent voice response method is beneficial to supporting the related departments to timely develop disaster defense.
assignees: NINGXIA HUI AUTONOMOUS REGION METEOROLOGICAL SERVICE CENTER NINGXIA PROFESSIONAL METEOROLOGICAL FILM

title_en: Leak detection device for air suction pipe of compressor
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a leak detection device for an air suction pipe of a compressor, and relates to the technical field of vehicle air conditioners. Including fixed body, fixed body inside cavity just is provided with the moving structure, and moving structure is including inserting the moving pipe of locating fixed body both ends, and the outside one end of moving pipe is provided with the jam structure, and fixed body outside is provided with detection structure, and detection structure is including the slip lantern ring of cover locating the fixed body outside, and slip lantern ring one side is fixed with the handle, and opposite one side is fixed with the connecting block. According to the utility model, through the arrangement of the detection structure, the detection ring is sleeved outside the air suction pipe to be detected during detection and is used for moving detection along the air suction pipe, so that the whole air suction pipe can be detected to leak, when the air flow sensor detects leakage air, the warning lamp blinks and the voice broadcasting device generates larger sound, so that the air leakage position is convenient to determine, the problem of leak detection blind areas is not easy to exist, and the usability of the device is better improved.
assignees: SHANGHAI SENPU AUTO AIR CONDITIONER CO LTD

title_en: fire alarm apparatus for hearing impaired person
title_ko: 청각장애인용 화재 경보 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire alarm device. The fire alarm device according to the present invention comprises: an accommodation case accommodating a circuit board; a detachable case coupled with the accommodation case; a fixing case having one side formed to be detachable from the detachable case and other side formed to be fixable to a predetermined surface; a fire detection unit installed in the accommodation case and detecting a fire; a fire alarm output unit installed in the accommodation case and outputting an alarm signal through an LED module; and a control unit installed in the accommodation case and controlling operations of the fire detection unit and the fire alarm output unit. The control unit controls the output of the fire alarm output unit according to the fire detection by the fire detection unit. Accordingly, unexpected accidents caused by the fire to the hearing impaired can be prevented.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재 경보 장치에 관한 것으로, 본 발명에 따른 청각장애인용 화재 경보 장치는 회로기판을 수용하는 수용케이스; 상기 수용케이스와 결합되는 탈부착케이스; 일면이 상기 탈부착케이스와 탈부착되고, 타면이 소정 면에 고정 가능하도록 형성되는 고정케이스; 상기 수용케이스 내에 설치되고, 화재를 감지하는 화재감지부; 상기 수용케이스 내에 설치되며, LED모듈을 통해 경보신호를 출력하는 화재경보출력부; 및 상기 수용케이스 내에 설치되고, 상기 화재감지부 및 상기 화재경보출력부의 동작을 제어하는 제어부;를 포함하고, 상기 제어부는 상기 화재감지부가 화재를 감지하는 것에 따라 상기 화재경보출력부의 출력을 제어하는 것에 기술적 특징이 있다.

title_en: Wearable intelligent blind-assisting sports shoulder strap and blind-assisting interaction method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a wearable intelligent blind-assisting sports shoulder strap and a blind-assisting interaction method thereof, comprising the following steps: the system comprises an information acquisition module, a processor module, a voice feedback module and a vibration warning module. The information acquisition module sends acquired data information to the processor module for processing, the processor module sends processed information to the vibration warning module and the voice feedback module respectively, the voice feedback module converts the received information into audio frequency and transmits the audio frequency to the human ear in real time, and the vibration warning module carries out emergency reminding on visually impaired people through vibration. The intelligent shoulder strap is arranged in the intelligent shoulder strap and is worn on a human body. The invention processes the information by using the RGB-D camera to sense the external environment and by using the deep learning method, and navigates the visually impaired person by means of voice and vibration, thereby helping the visually impaired person to run on the sports ground and improving the sensing capability of the sports ground environment and the self action capability.
assignees: HEFEI COMPREHENSIVE NATIONAL SCIENCE CENTER ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE RES INSTITUTE ANHUI ARTIFICIAL I

title_en: Fire control is patrolled and examined and is dealt with integration robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a fire-fighting inspection and disposal integrated robot, which comprises a crawler base, wherein a robot main body is fixed on the upper surface of the crawler base, evacuation lamps are fixed at the front end and the rear end of the robot main body, an inspection camera and a smoke sensor are respectively fixed at the upper side and the lower side of the left end of the robot main body, an adjusting mechanism is arranged on the robot main body, and a spray pipe and an alarm are respectively arranged on the adjusting mechanism; the adjusting mechanism comprises a support fixed on the top wall of an inner cavity of the robot main body, and the bottom end of the inner side of the support is rotatably connected with a rotating rod penetrating to the outside of the robot main body. This fire control is patrolled and examined and is dealt with integrated robot through being equipped with adjustment mechanism in the robot main part, and adjustment mechanism links to each other with the spray tube, and after patrolling and examining camera and smoke transducer and detecting the condition of a fire, accessible adjustment mechanism drives the spray tube and carries out the multi-angle and adjust for spray tube subtend condition of a fire, and through spraying the fire extinguishing agent to the condition of a fire, thereby restrain the condition of a fire, convenient to use.

title_en: Multi-sensor integrated robot for intelligent cell patrol
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multisensor integrated form robot for district intelligence inspection, including patrolling and examining car subassembly and sensor module. The beneficial effects of the utility model are that: the system realizes integration of various sensors, has stronger environmental adaptability to community application scenes, has the functions of autonomous navigation, automatic obstacle avoidance, automatic alarm, automatic data uploading, video intelligent analysis and the like, solves the problems of current obstacle shielding and monitoring blind areas to a greater extent, further helps to timely discover special conditions different from industrial scenes, such as public facility damage, violation behaviors and the like in a community, and can replace security personnel in property, not only can avoid the conditions of abnormal personnel coming in and going out and fire disasters and the like in the community neglected by the monitoring blind areas, but also can make up the defect of patrol efficiency caused by the limitation of the working time of personnel, insufficient experience and the like, realizes key monitoring and patrol in the community, and timely processes the safety patrol and environmental maintenance problems in the community.

title_en: Automatic fire alarm control system
abstract_en: The utility model provides an automatic fire alarm control system which comprises a driving box, a lifting table and a sliding rail, wherein one end of the lifting table is fixedly connected with a lifting motor, the power output end of the lifting motor is fixedly connected with a transmission assembly, the power output end of the transmission assembly is fixedly connected with a rope reel, one end of the rope reel is fixedly connected with the driving box through a rope, a butt joint inserted link is fixedly connected above the driving box, a driving assembly is fixedly connected inside the driving box, a turntable is rotatably connected below the driving box, a detection assembly is fixedly connected below the turntable, a fire extinguishing bottle is fixedly connected above the driving box, one end of the fire extinguishing bottle is fixedly connected with an electromagnetic valve, one end of the electromagnetic valve is fixedly connected with a rotary joint, and one end of the rotary joint is fixedly connected with a nozzle; through when elevator motor during operation, accessible rope reel rotates and drives the drive case and reciprocate, just can overhaul at ground directly and need not personnel to use the ladder climbing, has improved maintenance efficiency and has reduced unexpected emergence.

title_en: Intelligent equipment capable of being used for monitoring special operation
abstract_en: The invention discloses intelligent equipment for monitoring special operation, which comprises a shell and a monitoring module, wherein the monitoring module is used for monitoring the personnel and the environment of the special operation, the monitoring module is arranged on the shell and comprises an explosion-proof camera, a gas sensor, an image acquisition unit, a gas concentration acquisition unit, a data acquisition module, an intelligent data acquisition unit, a data processing unit, a data display unit and a data storage unit, and the monitoring module is arranged to monitor the personnel and the environment of the operation through the explosion-proof camera and the gas sensor, so that the problems that only the personnel can know the alarm information when the gas alarms, the guardian cannot easily obtain the alarm information, blind rescue is easily caused, video signal shielding in a limited space cannot be transmitted in real time, video monitoring is not in time, no on-site monitoring display picture cannot be found in time, the storage space is small, and frequent export is required are avoided.
assignees: SHANDONG BAOJIN ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Safety warning indicator for power grid maintenance
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of power grid maintenance, and provides a safety warning indicator for power grid maintenance, which is shaped like a tablet and mainly comprises a near field communication module, an acousto-optic warning module and a controller, wherein the near field communication module is arranged on the front surface of the warning indicator, is electrically connected with the controller, and is used for acquiring user information through near field communication; the acousto-optic warning module is arranged on the front and/or the side of the warning device, is electrically connected with the controller and is used for making sound and emitting light; and the controller is arranged in the warning indicator and used for identifying the user information acquired by the near field communication module and controlling the working state of the acousto-optic warning module. The utility model discloses accessible near field communication module acquires user information to with this operating condition who controls reputation warning module, initiatively to staff's sound and light warning information, the suggestion staff is paid attention to the safety standard operation.

abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method and a system for delivering outdoor disaster notification signals for hearing-impaired people. The method comprises: a step in which a disaster management server obtains surrounding state data of the disaster management server; a step in which the disaster management server determines whether a disaster has occurred in an outdoor space where the disaster management server is located based on the surrounding state data; a step in which the disaster management server generates, when it is determined that a disaster has occurred, a disaster occurrence signal indicating that a disaster has occurred; a step in which the disaster management server outputs the disaster occurrence signal; a step in which a user terminal located around the disaster management server detects the disaster occurrence signal; and a step in which the user terminal outputs, when the disaster occurrence signal is detected, a disaster notification signal to inform a user of the user terminal that a disaster has occurred. Here, the disaster occurrence signal is output as an audio signal, and the disaster notification signal is output as a vibration or text. Accordingly, it is possible to effectively notify hearing-impaired people that a disaster has occurred.
abstract_ko: 청각장애인을 위한 실외 재난알림 신호 전달 방법 및 시스템에 관한 것으로, 재난관리서버에서 재난관리서버의 주변 상태 데이터를 획득하고, 주변 상태 데이터에 기초하여 재난관리서버가 위치하는 실외공간에서 재난이 발생하였는지를 결정하고, 재난이 발생하였다고 결정한 경우 재난이 발생하였음을 나타내는 재난발생신호를 생성하고, 재난발생신호를 출력하고, 재난관리서버 주변에 위치하는 사용자 단말에서 재난발생신호를 감지하고, 재난발생신호를 감지한 경우 사용자 단말의 사용자에게 재난이 발생하였음을 알리는 재난알림신호를 출력하고, 여기에서 재난발생신호는 오디오 신호로 출력되고, 재난알림신호는 진동 또는 문자로 출력됨으로써, 청각장애인에게 재난이 발생하였음을 효과적으로 알릴 수 있다.

title_en: Protection method of guard post for military

abstract_en: A method and a system for protecting a garrison for a military guard post are used to enhance the reliability of garrison protection by recognizing the entry and exit status of security guards working at the military guard post and remotely monitoring the intrusion through a perimeter network. More specifically, the system for protecting a garrison for a military guard post comprises: a guard post (100) which includes a guard shift switch (120) for detecting the shift changes of the security guards stationed at the guard post (100), an emergency switch (130) for alerting unauthorized intrusion of foreigners according to the selection of the security guards stationed at the guard post (100), and a surveillance control device (110) installed to transmit signals detected through the guard shift switch (120) and the emergency switch (130) to a central control server (300) located remotely via a communication network; and a perimeter network (200) which includes intrusion detection sensors (210), each of which has an identification code to detect the unauthorized intrusion of a foreigner through the perimeter network (200) and transmit the detected results to either the central control server (300) or the guard post (100) located in remote place via the communication network, thereby enabling the monitoring of the entry and exit status of security guards doing shift work at the military guard post and remotely monitoring the intrusion through the perimeter network.

상기 경계 교대 스위치(120)와 비상 스위치(130)를 통하여 검출되는 신호를 통신망을 통해 원격에 위치한 중앙관제서버(300)에 전송하는 감시제어장치(110)가 상기 경계초소(100)에 설치되고,

군사 경계초소의 교대 근무에 따른 경계병의 출입 현황을 파악하고, 경계망의 침입 여부를 원격에서 감시할 수 있도록 제공된다.

The application solves the problems of complex arrangement, high cost and monitoring blind areas of fire detection in the greenhouse, has unique flexibility, can increase functions required by fire extinguishment, irrigation and the like on a platform in the later stage, and realizes diversified purposes.

title_en: Public safety early warning method and system based on big data analysis
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of big data analysis, and discloses a public safety early warning method and a public safety early warning system based on big data analysis, wherein a thermal imaging module in an acquisition unit acquires thermal imaging image data of a public place and sends the thermal imaging image data to an analysis unit, the analysis unit calculates duty ratio data information ZB according to the received data, and a judgment unit receives the duty ratio data information ZB calculated by the analysis unit and compares the duty ratio data information with a dangerous threshold W and then sends a dangerous instruction to a processing unit; according to the application, the data information ZB, the sound information data SY and the people number information data RS are used for calculation, the people number information data RS can reflect the people number information in the public place in a future period of time to play a role in prediction, and the sound information data SY can reflect the order degree of the site, so that the calculated early warning value J can predict the situation in the public place to play a role in early warning, and can accommodate accessible people to the greatest extent.
assignees: TIANJIN CHENHANG SAFETY TECH SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Bus blind area pedestrian detection device with risk avoiding function
abstract_en: The utility model provides a bus blind area pedestrian detection device with risk avoids function, including power expansion bracket, pedestrian identification module, audible and visual alarm, environment identification module, geographical position identification module, urgent danger prevention module and embedded singlechip, power expansion bracket installs the outer roof of head at the bus, pedestrian identification module, environment identification module and urgent danger prevention module all set up on power expansion bracket, audible and visual alarm and embedded singlechip are all installed on the bus in the ceiling and are located the power expansion bracket under, geographical position identification module installs on embedded singlechip, embedded singlechip respectively with power expansion bracket, pedestrian identification module, audible and visual alarm, environment identification module, geographical position identification module and urgent danger prevention module signal connection. The invention can effectively identify pedestrians in the dead zone of the bus, reminds drivers of paying attention to driving safety through the audible and visual alarm, avoids traffic accidents, and also has a risk avoiding function and an emergency risk avoiding function.

title_en: Active earthquake early warning equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses active earthquake early warning equipment, and relates to the field of earthquake early warning. The system comprises a built-in signal receiving module, a satellite positioning module, a data analysis module, an early warning signal output module and a dual-mode power supply module. The active earthquake early warning device integrates the analysis processing of earthquake information, the output of early warning information and the early warning emission, obtains the early warning information after the analysis processing of the information by receiving the earthquake information sent by the earthquake table network and combining with positioning data, and emits the early warning to an installation place, thereby realizing the active earthquake early warning. The active earthquake early warning device solves the defects that the construction difficulty of an earthquake early warning system is high, the cost is high, the coverage area is limited, early warning blind areas exist, early warning terminal equipment can work only by passively receiving early warning information sent by an earthquake early warning center and the like in the existing earthquake early warning mode by a ready-to-install and ready-to-use working mode and analysis processing capability of earthquake information, so that full-coverage earthquake early warning without blind areas can be realized, and popularization and application of earthquake early warning service are facilitated.

title_en: Photoelectric fire detector comprising a plurality of dark chamber
title_ko: 다수의 암실을 구비하는 광전식 화재감지기
abstract_en: Disclosed is a photoelectric fire detector having a plurality of dark chambers. The photoelectric fire detector according to the present invention comprises: a first dark chamber and a second dark chamber surrounded by a base, a cover, and a plurality of outer walls protruding downward from the edge of the base and divided by an inner partition; a first light-emitting unit and a first light-receiving unit installed inside the first dark chamber; a first light-blocking wall installed between the first light-emitting unit and the first light-receiving unit; a second light-emitting unit and a second light-receiving unit installed inside the second dark chamber; a second light-blocking wall installed between the second light-emitting unit and the second light-receiving unit; and a control unit using the detection signals from the first and second light-receiving units to determine whether a fire has occurred. According to the present invention, since a fire detection signal is transmitted only when smoke is detected in the plurality of dark chambers, false fire warnings due to the inflow of foreign substances or temporary malfunctions can be prevented, thereby greatly increasing the detection accuracy of a fire detector. In addition, waste of firefighting manpower due to false fire warnings can be prevented and the reliability of firefighting facilities can be increased.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 다수의 암실을 구비하는 광전식 화재 감지기를 개시한다. 본 발명에 따른 광전식 화재 감지기는, 베이스, 커버, 및 베이스의 가장자리에서 하부로 돌출된 다수의 외벽으로 둘러싸이고, 내부 격벽에 의해 서로 분할된 제1 암실과 제2 암실; 제1 암실의 내부에 설치된 제1 발광부와 제1 수광부; 제1 발광부와 제1 수광부의 사이에 설치된 제1 차광벽; 제2 암실의 내부에 설치된 제2 발광부와 제2 수광부; 제2 발광부와 제2 수광부의 사이에 설치된 제2 차광벽; 제1 수광부와 제2 수광부의 감지신호를 이용하여 화재발생 여부를 판단하는 제어부를 포함할 수 있다.  
본 발명에 따르면, 다수의 암실에서 모두 연기가 감지된 경우에만 화재 감지신호를 송출하므로 이물질 유입이나 일시적인 오작동으로 인한 비화재보를 예방할 수 있고, 이를 통해 화재 감지기의 감지 정확도를 크게 높일 수 있다. 또한 비화재보로 인한 소방인력의 낭비를 방지하고 소방시설에 대한 신뢰성을 높일 수 있다.

title_en: Glasses for night driving
abstract_en: The utility model provides glasses for night driving, which belong to the technical field of glasses, and comprise two glasses frames, lenses, glasses legs and vibrators, wherein the two glasses frames are fixedly connected side by side, the lenses are fixed in the two glasses frames, the outer sides of the two glasses frames are respectively provided with the glasses legs, the tail ends of the glasses legs are fixedly provided with vibrators for reminding, the tail ends of the glasses legs are connected with wires, the other ends of the wires are connected with earphone reminding mechanisms which can be worn in ears, and the wires and the earphone reminding mechanisms can be fixed on the outer side walls of the glasses legs; the two mirror frames are provided with clamping mechanisms which are pulled outwards to clamp the corrective lenses placed in the mirror frames. Glasses wear in driving the in-process, and the vibrator on the accessible mirror leg and the earphone of extension remind the mechanism to realize the warning effect to the driver, wear timely musical reminding behind the earphone to can last the on-hearing function of reminding.
assignees: HEBEI SUPER VISION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Device and method for monitoring mountain tourist attraction based on radar
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of geological disaster early warning equipment, and provides equipment and a method for monitoring mountain tourist attractions based on radar, wherein the equipment comprises a support column, a spherical shell and related components; the support column is anchored in the slope bedrock and provided with a first blind hole, and a first negative pressure pipe and a negative pressure rod are connected inside the support column; the spherical shell consists of a hemispherical base and a cover body, and a sealing ring is arranged at the joint. The outer side of the base is provided with a limit column which is inserted into the first blind hole and is provided with a through hole and a one-way valve which are connected with the second negative pressure pipe; the equipment is internally provided with a lifting component, radar equipment, a GPS positioning module, a wireless communication module, a power supply and a central controller; the central controller is connected with each module to realize the monitoring function. The invention can monitor the condition of mountain tourist attractions by radar technology, and transmit data by wireless communication, and has higher reliability and stability.
assignees: UNIV LESHAN NORMAL;UNIV YUNNAN FINANCE & ECONOMICS;INST GEOGRAPHIC SCIENCES & NATURAL RESOURCES RES CAS

title_en: Decision-making assistance system for firefighting
abstract_en: The invention relates to a decision-making assistance system for firefighting (1), comprising: - a server (2) hosting at least one interactive digitized map (3) of a site (4) and a main interface (5) integrating said map (3), - at least one fire alarm (11), - at least one sensor (7), the main interface (5) making it possible to display or not display, on the map (3), relevant information comprising data dependent on the measurements of the sensor (7) and, in the event of a fire, at least one zone in which a fire has been detected. The system is special in that it further comprises a confirmation interface (17), wherein the confirmation interface (17) is accessible in the event of the fire alarm (11) being triggered, the confirmation interface (17) integrates a confirmation means (18) for confirming the alarm, and the means is configured to allow firefighters to access the main interface (5).

title_en: Fire control passageway occupies alarm device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire-fighting channel occupation alarm device, which relates to the technical field of monitoring equipment and comprises a device main body, wherein the device main body comprises a base, an adjusting component is arranged in the base, the upper surface of the device main body is movably connected with a connecting component, and one end of the connecting component is fixedly connected with the monitoring component; the adjusting component comprises a rotating rod. According to the utility model, the rotating rod in the adjusting component drives the worm gear to move, so that the connecting component is driven to move up and down, the height of the monitoring component can be adjusted according to actual conditions, when cleaning or maintenance is needed, the monitoring component can be directly lowered through the adjusting component, so that workers cannot climb to a high place to repair, the safety of the workers is ensured, the panoramic camera can prevent the occurrence of monitoring blind spots to a certain extent, the workers can be reminded through the alarm, and meanwhile, the workers can be reminded through the loudspeaker without occupying a fire-fighting channel.
assignees: MOBILITY & MOTIVATION SYSTEMS BEIJING CO LTD

title_en: Door-closing-free judging and alarming distribution box
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a door-unclosed judging and alarming distribution box, and belongs to the technical field of electrical equipment. The distribution box comprises: the box body is provided with an opening and closing door at one side; the controller is arranged in the box body; the alarm is arranged outside the box body; the mounting base is arranged in the box body; the proximity switch is connected in the mounting base and is used for judging the distance between the opening and closing door and the box body; the proximity switch and the alarm are electrically connected with the controller. The proximity switch judges whether the opening and closing door of the distribution box is closed in place or not, after maintenance, the opening and closing door is prevented from being not fully locked or locked, if the opening and closing door is not locked, the controller controls the alarm to alarm, reminds workers to close in time, prevents foreign matters from entering the distribution box to damage equipment, and prevents the box door from falling.
assignees: SHAANXI HUI QI ELECTRIC TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Alarm check valve that allows self-cleaning of foreign substances
title_ko: 이물질 자가 청소가 가능한 알람체크밸브
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an alarm check valve capable of self-cleaning foreign substances, which comprises: a valve body installed in a fire water line, having a first chamber and a second chamber which are partitioned by a seat ring and through which fire water passes, a plurality of seat holes formed in the seat ring, and a clapper to which elastic force is applied by an elastic member and which isolates the first chamber from the second chamber by being in contact with the seat ring; an alarm line connected to the seat holes and led outward; a pressure switch installed on the alarm line; a cleaning line connected from the front end of the primary side chamber to the alarm line in the fire water line; a cleaning valve installed on the cleaning line; and a switching valve switching the fire water supplied from the cleaning line to be supplied toward the seat holes, or switching the fire water supplied from the seat holes to be supplied toward the pressure switch. According to the present invention, the alarm check valve can remove foreign substances remaining between the clapper and the seat ring crucial for securing the reliability the reliability of operation, enable efficient removal of foreign substances, and enhance the reliability of operation during a fire, thereby preventing loss of life and property damage caused by fire.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 소방수라인에 설치되고, 소방수가 통과하기 위한 1차측챔버와 2차측챔버가 시트링을 사이에 두고 구획되도록 마련되며, 상기 시트링에 시트홀이 다수로 형성되고, 탄성부재에 의해 탄성력이 인가되는 클래퍼가 상기 시트링과의 접촉에 의해 상기 1차측챔버와 상기 2차측챔버를 서로 격리시키도록 하는 밸브바디; 상기 시트홀에 연결되어 외부로 인출되는 알람라인; 상기 알람라인에 설치되는 압력스위치; 상기 소방수라인에서 상기 1차측챔버의 전단으로부터 상기 알람라인에 연결되는 클리닝라인; 상기 클리닝라인에 설치되는 클리닝밸브; 및 상기 클리닝라인으로부터 공급되는 소방수가 상기 시트홀 측으로 공급되도록 전환하거나, 상기 시트홀로부터 공급되는 소방수가 상기 압력스위치 측으로 공급되도록 전환하는 전환밸브;를 포함하도록 한 이물질 자가 청소가 가능한 알람체크밸브에 관한 것이다. 본 발명에 따르면, 동작의 신뢰성 확보를 위해 중요한 클래퍼와 시트링 사이에 잔존하는 이물질을 제거할 수 있고, 이러한 이물질의 제거가 효율적으로 이루어지도록 할 수 있으며, 이로 인해 화재시 동작의 신뢰도를 높임으로써, 화재로 인한 인명 및 재산 피해를 방지하도록 하는 효과를 가진다.

title_en: Wireless voice alarm device for blind area
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a blind area wireless voice alarm device which comprises a wireless voice alarm arranged at the blind area and a wireless transmitter arranged at the top of a vehicle, wherein the wireless voice alarm and the wireless transmitter are in data connection through Bluetooth data transmission, the wireless voice alarm comprises a shell, a control main board and a transformer, wherein the control main board and the transformer are arranged in the shell, first brackets for being fixedly connected at the blind area are arranged at four corners of one side of the shell, a voice loudspeaker is arranged at the other side of the shell, and an alarm lamp with a flashing reminding function is arranged at the upper end of the shell. The utility model discloses a wireless voice alarm device of blind area receives wireless transmitter's signal when the vehicle goes to the blind area, and wireless voice alarm can in time send voice alarm and light scintillation and remind the driver when the vehicle reaches the distance of settlement, has improved the vehicle and has gone safely in producing mill and workshop, has reduced the potential safety hazard.
assignees: WENZHOU YIHE ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Detection method for near-ground detection blind area range of weather radar
abstract_en: The application relates to a detection method of a near-ground detection blind area range of a weather radar, belonging to the technical field of radar detection, comprising the following steps: acquiring radar site information and topographic data of the range of the radar site; calculating the altitude of a radar feed source, the altitude of each distance library, the longitude and latitude of each distance library and the terrain height of the position of each distance library; and judging the actual maximum detection distance of each azimuth angle of the radar by using the lowest elevation angle in the radar body scanning mode, and obtaining the shielding range close to the ground in the radar theoretical maximum detection range according to calculation. The application has guiding function for adjacent radar site selection and radar networking jigsaw work, and provides reference information for solving the problem of compensating detection blind areas in low altitude when constructing adjacent radars; the automatic rainfall station is distributed in the detection blind area to provide important information, the effect of certain blind supplement can be achieved, the accuracy of quantitative rainfall estimation is improved, and accordingly the response time of mountain torrent disaster early warning in mountain areas is prolonged.

title_en: Intelligent anti-collision system of road roller
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of road construction, in particular to an intelligent anti-collision system of a road roller. The utility model provides a road roller intelligence collision avoidance system, includes power, vehicle control ware, anticollision controller, light curtain sensor, radar induction system, image acquisition device, video display, light curtain display, vehicle arresting gear and alarm device, power and vehicle control ware are connected with anticollision controller electricity respectively, and the input of anticollision controller is connected with light curtain sensor, radar induction system and image acquisition device electricity respectively, and the output of anticollision controller is connected with video display, light curtain display, vehicle arresting gear and alarm device electricity respectively. The utility model adopts the camera, the ultrasonic radar and the light curtain sensor to detect the obstacle simultaneously, and detects the surrounding environment through the complementary fusion of the multiple sensors, thereby realizing the detection of no blind area in a certain range, effectively improving the detection reliability and the construction safety of engineering mechanical equipment, effectively avoiding personal injury and reducing equipment injury.
assignees: DALIAN YILUDA ENG MACHINERY CO LTD

title_en: Fire-fighting manual alarm abnormality detection method and system based on inspection robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-fighting manual alarm abnormality detection method and system based on a patrol robot, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring point location data of the fire-fighting manual alarm, wherein the point location data comprises coordinate positioning parameters, installation type parameters and wall-attached position parameters of the fire-fighting manual alarm; controlling the inspection robot to move to the corresponding point position based on the point position data so as to acquire the visual data of the fire-fighting manual alarm, wherein the control of the inspection robot comprises aligning a camera of the inspection robot when the inspection robot moves, and performing translation calibration and/or scaling calibration when the visual data is acquired; and carrying out anomaly detection based on the acquired video data to acquire an anomaly result and carrying out output alarm, wherein the actual flicker frequency and/or the actual flicker frequency of the alarm indicator lamp are specifically detected. The invention breaks through the traditional scheme of detecting by using security personnel, has higher overall detection efficiency, and can reduce the occurrence of the problems of false alarm, missing alarm and the like.

title_en: Platform door detection device based on photoelectric sensor
abstract_en: The platform door detection device based on the photoelectric sensor comprises an internal interface and an external interface, wherein the internal interface comprises a signal processing circuit, a central processing unit, a communication circuit, an audible and visual alarm circuit and a power supply circuit; the signal processing circuit, the central processing unit and the audible and visual alarm circuit are electrically connected with the power supply circuit; the signal processing circuit, the communication circuit and the audible and visual alarm circuit are electrically connected with the central processing unit; the external interface comprises a gate control unit, a bypass switch and a photoelectric sensor; the gate control unit, the bypass switch and the photoelectric sensor are connected with the internal interface; the invention detects the foreign matters of the platform door through the photoelectric sensor, improves the safety and reliability of the platform door system, and provides a safe and comfortable riding environment for passengers.
assignees: CSSC HAIWEI HIGH TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent greenhouse
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent greenhouse, which comprises a first supporting rod, wherein a second supporting rod is arranged on one side of the first supporting rod, a first sliding groove and a second sliding groove are respectively formed in the upper surfaces of the first supporting rod and the second supporting rod, a first arc-shaped rod and a second arc-shaped rod are respectively connected to the inner walls of the first sliding groove and the second sliding groove in a sliding mode, and an arc-shaped supporting plate is arranged between the first arc-shaped rod and the second arc-shaped rod. This intelligent greenhouse, through the setting of LED human body induction lamp, controller and alarm, when someone got into warmhouse booth at night, LED human body induction lamp lights and sends the signal to the controller sends the signal and then the alarm lights and send the sound to the alarm, thereby the manager accessible bluetooth of alarm and mobile phone are connected and thereby warmhouse booth's accessible mobile phone learn that someone breaks into warmhouse booth at night inside, thereby can in time know warmhouse booth's condition and can in time seek to support, the security performance is high.

title_en: Mine dynamic disaster early warning method based on microseism monitoring
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mine early warning, and particularly discloses a mine dynamic disaster early warning method based on microseism monitoring, wherein the mine dynamic disaster early warning device comprises a mounting base, a supporting frame is fixedly arranged at the top of the mounting base, and a mounting mechanism is arranged on the inner side of the supporting frame; through adjusting the slide in the inboard slip of spout, slide inboard through the slide and slide into the spout, and then alright install the inboard of vertical guide rail with the microseism detector, the clamping spring resets and drives the fixture block and insert to the draw-in groove is inboard this moment, and then alright supplementary closure fixed slide, when the microseism detector needs to overhaul, the accessible pulling pull ring drives the even axle and draws the fixture block and contradicts clamping spring shrink, clamping spring shrink while the fixture block leaves the draw-in groove, the slide has lost the prescribing a limit this moment, alright be quick with the microseism detector follow vertical guide rail's inboard and take out for this equipment is wholly convenient for quick assembly disassembly overhauls.

title_en: real time diaster information service system for the diaster weak
title_ko: 재난 약자를 위한 실시간 재난정보 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates a real-time disaster information system for disaster-vulnerable individuals. In a disaster information service method, the system comprises: a service server (100) comprising a subscriber information storing part (110) for storing subscriber information storing information on whether a user who uses an application is a hard-of-hearing person or a foreigner, a disaster information collecting part (130) receiving disaster information including a disaster text message, a sign language video generating part (140, a sign language video processing part, a sign language video storing part) generating sign language video information (I1) to be transmitted to the hard-of-hearing person terminal based on the disaster information, a foreign language translation service part (150, a foreign language translation server) generating disaster information (I2) translated in foreign languages to be transmitted to foreigners based on the disaster information; and a user terminal (200) which receives sign language video information (I1) or the translated disaster information (I2) from the service server (100) and displays the same on a display, and has an application program (200a) installed to generate a user interface (UI) for interfacing with the service server (100). According to the present invention, provided is a real-time disaster information system for disaster-vulnerable individuals and a disaster information service method providing a sign language video to a hard-of-hearing person and an online disaster notification service based on a native language for each country to foreigners.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 재난정보 서비스 방법에 있어서, 애플리케이션을 사용하는 사용자의 청각 장애인 여부, 외국인 여부에 관한 정보를 저장하는 가입자 정보를 저장하는 가입자 정보 저장부(110)와, 재난문자를 포함하는 재난정보를 입력받는 재난 정보 수집부(130)와, 상기 재난 정보에 기초하여 청각 장애인 단말기에게 전송될 수어 영상 정보(I1)를 생성하는 수어 영상 생성부(140, 수어 영상 처리부, 수어 영상 저장부 )와, 상기 재난 정보에 기초하여 외국인에게 전송될 외국어로 번역된 재난 정보(I2)를 생성하는 외국어 번역 서비스부(150, 외국어 번역 서버)로 구성된 서비스 서버(100)와; 상기 서비스 서버(100)로부터 수어 영상 정보(I1) 또는 번역된 재난 정보(I2)를 수신하여 디스플레이에 표출하고 상기 서비스 서버(100)와 인터페이스 하기 위한 유저 인터페이스(UI)를 생성하는 애플리케이션 프로그램(200a)이 설치된 사용자 단말기(200);를 포함하여 구성되는 것을 특징으로 하는 재난 약자를 위한 실시간 재난정보 시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: User preferences in responder network responder selection
abstract_en: Methods, user interfaces and systems are described that enable responder preferences to be considered during deployment of a public responder network. In some embodiments, a user is able to set preferences such as a mobility status, a public accessibility preference, a incidents notifications preference or a geographic preference associated with a medical device that is a part of the public responder network. In some embodiments, the user is able to select or define an area for which incident notifications are desired or are to be restricted in some manner. The described approach is well suited for public responder networks that include medical devices such as defibrillators (e.g., AEDs) in the network.

title_en: Blind zone induction alarm for highway engineering construction machinery
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of blind area induction and discloses a blind area induction alarm for highway engineering construction machinery. The intelligent alarm device comprises a base, wherein a standing groove is formed in the top of the base, a motor is fixedly connected to the bottom of the base and arranged in the middle of the base, the output end of the motor is fixedly connected with a rotating shaft, the rotating shaft penetrates through the base and extends to the inside, the outer surface of the rotating shaft is fixedly connected with a rotating ring, the rotating ring is of a concave structure, and the inner wall of the rotating ring is provided with a box body.

title_en: Fire piping structure for building
title_ko: 소방 배관 설치구조
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a firefighting piping installation structure, which connects pipes for piping discharged to a building. The firefighting piping installation structure comprises: a pipe with a first O-ring and a first stopper ring joined at each end by an outer circumferential surface; a connection pipe which allows the ends of the pipes inserted from both sides to be spaced apart by a certain length, and allows the pipes to be movably coupled to a certain length while preventing the pipes from both sides from deviating to the outside; a heat dissipation sheet which surrounds the outer peripheral surface of the connection pipe to block heat transfer to the pipe through the connection pipe; a heat-resistant pipe made of heat-resistant material to block heat transfer to the heat dissipation sheet; a buffer member which prevents moisture from flowing into the connection pipe from the outside and absorbs shock from the outside; and a pair of pipe caps in which a seal ring is inserted between flange surfaces on both sides and are pressed together by fastening nuts and bolts between the flange surfaces. According to the present invention, the firefighting piping installation structure ensures a tight connection between pipes, prevents the inflow of any foreign substances from the outside, provides buffering against earthquakes or shocks generated from the outside, prevents heat transfer to the pipe by the heat dissipation sheet and heat-resistant pipe even if high temperature heat is applied due to a fire, and prevents damage to pipes and poor connections due to pipe deformation, contraction, or expansion.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 소방 배관 설치구조에 관한 것으로서, 건물에 배설되는 배관용 파이프들간을 연결하는 구성에 있어서, 각 단부에는 외주면으로 제1 오링과 제1 스토퍼 링이 결합되는 파이프; 내주면의 길이 중간부에는 상기 파이프의 외경보다 작은 내경으로 일정 길이의 걸림돌기가 형성되도록 하여 양측으로부터 각각 삽입되는 파이프들간의 단부가 일정 길이로 이격되도록 하고, 양측단부의 내주면에는 파이프들의 외주면에 밀착되도록 하는 제2 오링과 함께 상기 제1 스토퍼 링의 외경보다 작은 내경을 갖는 제2 스토퍼 링이 결합되도록 하여 양측으로부터 파이프들이 외측으로 이탈되지 않도록 하면서 일정 길이가 이동 가능하게 결합되도록 하는 연결 파이프; 상기 연결 파이프의 외주면을 감싸도록 하여 상기 연결 파이프를 통해 파이프로의 열전달이 차단되도록 하는 방열 시트; 상기 연결 파이프의 길이와 동일한 길이로 형성하고, 상기 방열시트의 외주면을 감싸면서 밀착되도록 하여 방열시트로의 열전달이 차단되도록 내열성 소재로 형성하는 내열 파이프; 반원형으로 분할되도록 하여 단면간 맞춤돌기와 맞춤홈간 맞춤결합에 의해 상기 내열 파이프의 외주면과 동시에 양측단면에 밀착되게 하면서 양측단부의 내주면은 상기 연결 파이프의 양측으로 삽입되는 각 파이프들의 외주면에 밀착되도록 하여 외부로부터 상기 연결 파이프의 내부로 물기가 유입되지 않도록 하고, 외부로부터의 충격에 대해 흡수할 수 있도록 하는 완충부재; 상기 완충부재의 양측으로부터 각각 상호 마주보는 방향으로 상기 완충부재의 외주면과 양측단면을 감싸도록 하면서 상호 마주보는 단부에는 각각 플랜지면을 형성하고, 양측의 플랜지면 사이에는 시일 링이 삽입되도록 하여 플랜지면간 너트와 볼트 체결에 의해 압착 결합되도록 하는 한 쌍의 파이프 캡의 결합으로 이루어지는 구성이다.

title_en: Rain and flood drainage road risk early warning method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of traffic flood early warning, in particular to a method and a device for early warning of risk of a rainfall flood drainage road. The rainfall flood drainage road risk early warning method is applied to a risk early warning device and comprises the following steps: acquiring a water depth value; judging whether the water depth value is larger than the first water depth value, if so, acquiring the water flow velocity; determining a risk level according to the water depth value and the water flow velocity; according to the risk grades, grading risk alarm is carried out, monitoring of the rain and flood drainage road water conditions is achieved, corresponding alarm is carried out on different risk grades, and the situation that pedestrians cannot accurately judge the water conditions and blindly wade water brings risks to self safety is avoided.

title_en: Rail transit anomaly analysis system false alarm elimination method, device and medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method, a device and a medium for eliminating false alarms of a rail transit anomaly analysis system, which comprise the following steps: in the defined detection area, detecting the foreground of the image to obtain a moving target existing in the image; detecting the moving target by an image illuminance algorithm and a linear programming algorithm, and determining whether the moving target is an interfering object; detecting the moving target with the interference removed by a target detection algorithm to determine whether the moving target is an intrusion foreign matter, and giving an alarm if the moving target is determined to be the intrusion foreign matter. According to the method for detecting the all-weather multi-category interferents along the railway based on the image illumination and the linear programming and combined with the deep learning target detection, the disaster detection system can be effectively assisted to accurately detect abnormal conditions, and the real railway intrusion foreign matters can be identified.

title_en: Method and system for monitoring environment and foreign matter invasion of equipment and facilities along railway
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for monitoring the environment of equipment along a railway and monitoring the invasion of foreign matters, which are characterized in that the condition of the roadbed and the track along the railway and the comprehensive perception of the surrounding environment and the facilities along the railway are realized through a space-based remote sensing platform, an air-based remote sensing platform, a track moving platform detection, a fixed detection platform and a direct steel rail condition detection device singly or in combination, an expert diagnosis system is formed through data accumulation, hidden danger and fault recognition capability are improved through establishing deep learning training, maintenance and repair are reasonably arranged, the condition of the railway along the roadbed and the track along the railway and the early warning and warning of the hidden danger of the surrounding environment and the facilities are realized, the foreign matters invaded into the track are timely warned, the geological disasters along the railway are early warned and warned in combination with weather, and on-site rescue after the guiding faults and disasters are guided, and the running safety of a train is ensured.

title_en: Marine alarm system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of alarm systems, and discloses a marine alarm system which comprises an alarm lamp and an alarm lamp protection device, wherein when equipment senses an abnormal environment, a smoke detector and a temperature detector can sense the detected information to the equipment through an induction module and a control module in a main board module, and an alarm lamp body carries out flashing alarm and can protect the alarm lamp body from entering the foreign matters in the alarm lamp body. This marine alarm system makes the detection accuracy of equipment obtain improving through setting up the response detector in the outside of equipment, compares with leading-in equipment, and the response detector is circumference array form and distributes at the outer wall of sensing intercommunication ware and make the equipment obtain improving to the accuracy that external environment detected, has reduced the probability that equipment detected the mistake.
assignees: HUBEI GUOYANG ELECTRICAL ENG CO LTD

title_en: Building fire alarm intelligent alarm device
