abstract_en: An objective of the present invention is to provide an inboard automatic broadcasting system capable of clearly transmitting warning information from a long distance through a communication network without noise, and allowing a sailor to recognize and cope with a dangerous situation and an accident occurrence source when an alarm is generated and to avoid the dangerous situation to make an emergency escape by allowing a converted digital voice signal to include accident occurrence source information, corresponding emergency zone information, corresponding dangerous situation information, countermeasure instruction information, and emergency escape information. The inboard automatic broadcasting system comprises: a sensor unit; a monitoring server; an inboard broadcasting server; a plurality of IP speakers; an inboard network broadcasting unit; and a TCP/IP-based communication network, thereby replacing any one of the IP speaker and the analog speaker in case of an error thereon to propagate an emergency situation. According to the present invention, when an alarm is generated, a sailor can recognize and respond to a dangerous situation and an accident occurrence source and avoid the dangerous situation to make an emergency escape, and a network-based system can enable inboard broadcasting through satellite communication even on land.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 항해정보와 환경정보와 모션정보와 선내상황정보를 계측하는 센서부(110), 계측값을 모니터링하고 분석하여 경고정보를 생성하는 모니터링서버(120), 이벤트신호에 따라 네트워크 제어 음원소스(137)를 추출하여 TTS 프로그램 모듈(138)을 통해 경고정보를 디지털음성신호로 변환하는 디지털음성변환모듈(139)로 구성되어, 스케쥴방송과 마이크방송과 전화방송에 해당하는 디지털음성신호 및 경고정보에 해당하는 디지털음성신호를 비상구역정보에 포함된 해당 방송구역 또는 콜 스테이션(134)에 의해 선택된 해당 방송구역으로 전송하는, 선내 방송 서버(130), 선내 방송 서버(130)에 연결되어 디지털음성신호를 출력하는 다수의 IP 스피커(140), 증폭된 음성신호를 출력하는 다수의 아날로그 스피커(153)로 구성되는, 선내 네트워크 방송부(150), 및 센서부(110)와 모니터링 서버(120) 사이, 모니터링 서버(120)와 선내 방송 서버(130) 사이, 선내 방송 서버(130)와 IP 스피커(140) 사이, 및 선내 방송 서버(130)와 선내 네트워크 방송부(150) 사이를 유무선 네트워크로 연결하는 TCP/IP 기반의 통신망(160);을 포함하여, IP 스피커(140) 또는 아날로그 스피커(153) 중 어느 하나의 오류시에 대체하여 노이즈없이 비상상황을 전파하도록 하는, 선내 자동 방송 시스템을 개시한다.

title_en: Ship fire monitoring system using drones
title_ko: 드론을 활용한 선박 화재 감시 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed is a ship fire surveillance system using a drone. A ship fire surveillance system using a drone includes: an access point; a plurality of drones that fly over blind spots of multiple CCTV cameras in an autonomous ship and perform filming to create images of the blind spots; an alarm generator that generates audible and visual fire alarms; and a controller that performs communication with multiple drones through the access point, sets flight paths of multiple drones so that multiple drones fly over blind spots and perform filming to acquire images of the blind spots, determines whether a fire has occurred through image analysis of the acquired images of the blind spots, and controls the alarm generator to generate a fire alarm if it is determined that a fire has occurred.
abstract_ko: 드론을 활용한 선박 화재 감시 시스템이 개시된다. 드론을 활용한 선박 화재 감시 시스템은, 액세스 포인트, 자율운항선박 내에서 복수의 CCTV 카메라의 사각지역을 비행하면서 촬영을 수행하여 사각지역 영상을 생성하는 복수의 드론, 화재경보를 청각적 및 시각적으로 발생시키는 경보 발생기 및 액세스 포인트를 통해 복수의 드론과 통신을 수행하고, 복수의 드론이 사각지역을 비행하면서 촬영을 수행하도록 복수의 드론의 비행경로를 설정하여 사각지역 영상을 획득하고, 획득된 사각지역 영상에 대한 영상분석을 통해 화재발생 여부를 판단하고, 판단 결과, 화재가 발생한 것으로 판단한 경우, 경보 발생기가 화재경보를 발생시키도록 제어하는 제어기를 포함한다.

title_en: Fire extinguisher for the blind
title_ko: 시각 장애인용 소화기
abstract_en: Provided is a fire extinguisher for a blind person, which comprises: a flame reaction sensor for detecting a fire in a direction to which a hose head is directed; an infrared sensor for detecting an obstacle in the direction to which the hose head is oriented; an alarm sound generator for generating an alarm sound according to the flame reaction sensor; a vibration handle vibrated according to the infrared sensor; a lever for spraying a fire extinguishing agent; a body for storing the fire extinguishing agent; a handle on which the flame reaction sensor, the infrared sensor, and the lever are mounted; and a hose for connecting the body and the handle. The fire extinguisher for a blind person according to the present invention has an effect of effectively suppressing the fire by accurately informing a blind person of the position of the fire through sound and vibration by mounting a flame detection sensor. In addition, the fire extinguisher has an effect of enabling smooth movement by informing the blind person of an obstacle in the process of using the fire extinguisher in the event of a fire by mounting an infrared sensor.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 소화기에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 시각 장애인이 화재 발생 시 소화기로 앞의 장애물의 유무를 적외선 센서를 통해 판단하고, 화재를 불꽃 감지 센서로 감지해 화재의 위치에 소화기를 분사할 수 있도록 하는 소화기에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Intelligent early warning, prevention and control device for mechanical equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent early warning, prevention and control device for mechanical equipment, which comprises: the intelligent mechanical early warning system comprises an early warning monitoring device, an audible and visual alarm and a display, wherein the early warning monitoring device is arranged at the top of the cockpit, and the audible and visual alarm is arranged on the surface of a body of the crane. The intelligent mechanical early warning system is arranged on the crane body and consists of a BSD camera, a display and an audible and visual alarm, wherein the system can preset the working radius range, and the BSD camera is used for collecting personnel information in the working radius range; when personnel enter the working radius range, the audible and visual alarm warns to drive away the entering personnel, and the visual blind area of the driver is developed through the assistance of the display, the driver is prompted to operate carefully through the alarm, the safety of mechanical operation is improved through double warning, and the risk of mechanical injury is reduced.
assignees: QINGDAO MUNICIPAL CONSTRUCTION GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Railway line foreign matter intrusion monitoring alarm device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a foreign matter intrusion monitoring alarm device along a railway, which belongs to the technical field of railway alarm devices and aims at the problem of railway operation safety, and the device comprises a data acquisition and processing device and a core control unit, wherein the data acquisition and processing device is electrically connected with the core control unit, the data acquisition and processing device is electrically connected with a control center and a monitoring center through the core control unit, the data acquisition and processing device is electrically connected with alarm equipment and drives the alarm equipment after data analysis, and the alarm equipment is reserved to be electrically connected with a driving warning and a working warning; the method mainly aims at sudden dangerous situations such as collapse of tunnel openings, landslide, falling rocks, entrance and exit of wild animals and the like, realizes an advanced forecasting function through corresponding data processing of an early warning platform by means of technologies such as online monitoring and early warning, ensures railway operation safety, has the characteristics of high alarm accuracy, zero missing report and the like, and provides technical guarantee for driving safety of high-risk road sections.
assignees: SHANXI DAQIN TIANCHUANG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Smartphone-based portable emergency pager equipped with emergency medicine storage box and emergency call method using the same
title_ko: 응급약보관함이 구비된 스마트폰 기반의 휴대용 응급비상호출기 및 그를 이용한 응급비상호출 방법
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide a smartphone-based portable emergency pager equipped with an emergency medicine storage box, and an emergency call method using the same, wherein the emergency pager is linked to a smartphone and allows users to request assistance through emergency calls to acquaintances, public officials in public institutions or fire stations through the smartphone without separate equipment like repeaters or gateways. Provided is a portable emergency pager (100), which includes: an emergency medicine storage box (180) which has upper and lower surfaces each formed in a semicircular shape, and is configured to store emergency medicine at the bottom thereof; a volume output unit (110) for producing a warning sound, a call button (120) for emergency calls, and a call cancel button (140) for call cancel which are configured to be exposed to a front cover (101) of the portable emergency pager (100); and a charging indication LED (160) for notifying the charging status and a charging port (170) which are configured to be located on the side of the portable emergency call device (100). The portable emergency call device (100) is paired with a smartphone via Bluetooth, and when the call button (120) for emergency calls is pressed, the device is configured to sound a warning sound through the volume output unit (110) and transmit the GPS information of the paired smartphone to a plurality of pre-set contacts to request rescue.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 기본적으로는 응급약을 보관하면서도 응급이나 비상상황 시 주변에 도움을 요청할 수 있는 경고음을 출력하도록 하면서도 스마트폰과 연동되어 중계기나 게이트웨이등 별도 장비없이도 스마트폰을 통해 지인이나 공공기관의 공무원이나 소방서 등에 도움을 응급비상호출을 통해 도움을 요청할 수 있으며, 시각장애인을 위한 점자표를 각인하여 시각장애인들도 유용하게 이용할 수 있고, 상시휴대가 가능한 응급약보관함이 구비된 스마트폰 기반의 휴대용 응급비상호출기 및 그를 이용한 응급비상호출 방법에 관한 것이다.  이러한 본 발명은 응급약보관함이 구비된 스마트폰 기반의 휴대용 응급비상호출기로써, 상기 휴대용 응급비상호출기는, 상부면와 하부면은 각각 반원형 형태로 구성되고, 저면부에는 응급약을 보관하도록 구성된 응급약 보관함(180); 상기 휴대용 응급비상호출기의 전면에 노출되도록 구성된 것으로, 경고음을 출력하는 음량 송출부(110), 비상호출을 위한 호출버튼(120) 및 호출취소를 위한 호출취소 버튼(140); 상기 휴대용 응급비상호출기의 측면에 구성되는 것으로 충전표시를 알리는 충전표시 LED(160) 및 충전포트(170); 스마트폰과 블루투스 페어링되어 상기 비상호출을 위한 호출버튼(120)이 눌려지는 경우 상기 음량 송출부(110)를 통해 경고음을 송출함과 함께 미리 설정된 복수의 연락처로 상기 페어링된 스마트폰의 GPS 정보를 송출하여 구조를 요청하는 것을 특징으로 하는 응급약보관함이 구비된 스마트폰 기반의 휴대용 응급비상호출기를 제공한다.

title_en: Strong and weak electricity integrated building equipment control cabinet
abstract_en: The application provides a strong and weak electricity integrated building equipment control cabinet which comprises a control cabinet body, wherein a radiating device is arranged on the side wall of the control cabinet body, an anti-collision buffer device and an alarm device are fixedly arranged on the control cabinet body, a waterproof plate and a rubber plate are fixedly arranged at the top of the control cabinet body, and alarm lamps are arranged around the control cabinet body; the electric appliance control cabinet is safer in protection, if a high-altitude falling object is crashed and falls on the top rubber plate of the electric appliance control cabinet to protect and play a role in buffering, the controller is not damaged, when a large-scale vehicle is backed up, even if a worker encounters a vision blind area and cannot see the vision blind area, if the vehicle bumps the anti-collision buffer device to a certain position, the alarming device is triggered to remind the worker, even if the worker does not see the vision blind area, property loss cannot be caused, and the heat dissipation device is arranged, so that short circuit cannot occur due to overhigh temperature, and the service life of the electric appliance control cabinet is prolonged.
assignees: ZHEJIANG PROVINCE INSTITUTE OF ARCHITECTURAL DESIGN AND RES

title_en: Novel functional fire prevention valve actuating mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel functional fire-proof valve actuating mechanism, and belongs to the technical field of fire-proof valves. Including the main part, place the intracavity portion and be provided with the fire tank, the main part inner wall still is provided with the fire sensor, the protective housing the place ahead is provided with the alarm, the water storage chamber has been seted up to the main part inside, the joint board outer wall is provided with the exhaust fan, available fire tank cooperation fire pump and burst pipe are erupted the fire disaster area and are put out a fire, effectively control the intensity of a fire and spread, because extinguishing device's increase can improve the whole fire prevention ability of fire damper, further protect personnel life safety and property safety, and still accessible a plurality of induced draft pumps cooperation guide fan inhale inside smog or harmful gas, utilize the water pump cooperation to change fog shower nozzle and spray smog, effectually still can discharge smog when preventing that the flame from spreading, keep the ventilation situation inside the building, make things convenient for rescue personnel to evacuate and rescue to the crowd, ensure personnel's safety.

title_en: Building evacuation stairwell evacuation indication system and evacuation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building evacuation stairwell evacuation indication system and an evacuation method, comprising a smoke detector, a temperature sensor and an electric roller shutter which are arranged at the top of each layer of evacuation stairwell, and the evacuation indicator lamps above each layer of fireproof door and in each room are connected with audible and visual alarms. According to the invention, whether smoke exists in the evacuation stairway or not is judged by the smoke detector, the evacuation indicator light indicates that smoke exists when the smoke exists, and the audible and visual alarm is used for assisting in alarming, so that the rolling curtain is lowered to the height that evacuation personnel can stop the smoke from spreading through the stairway, and the personnel can evacuate orderly under the ground projection indication of the evacuation indicator light in the stairway; when the temperature sensor detects high temperature, the evacuation indicator light indicates danger, the roller shutter is lowered to the bottommost part, smoke spreading in the evacuation stairwell is limited while personnel are prevented from entering by mistake, the personnel close the entrance door to wait for rescue in a room when the audible and visual alarm gives an alarm, the smoke of strong airflow is prevented from flowing backwards, and personnel injury caused by blind escape is reduced.
assignees: SCEGC EQUIPMENT INSTALLATION GROUP COMPANY LTD;SHAANXI CONSTRUCTION ENG GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Power grid safety warning device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of power grid alarms, in particular to a power grid safety alarm, which comprises a base and a dynamic alarm structure, wherein the dynamic alarm structure is arranged at the top of the base; the dynamic warning structure comprises a driving motor which is arranged at the top of the base at intervals, a rotating rod is arranged at the output shaft end of the driving motor, three warning signs are uniformly distributed on the surface of the rotating rod, warning slogans are arranged on two sides of each warning sign, alarms are fixedly connected with the surface of the driving motor, and the number of the alarms is four and uniformly distributed on the surface of the driving motor. The utility model discloses a power grid safety warning ware, accessible pivoted three warning sign and alarm carry out effectual warning to different positions to improve the conspicuous degree of whole alarm, reach efficient warning, compare in current warning sign, this device has and can carry out obvious warning effect to multi-direction masses.
assignees: INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION BRANCH STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID INFORMATION & TELECOMMUNICATION CO LTD;AOSTAR INF TECH CO LTD

title_en: Blind crutch capable of emitting light through body
abstract_en: The invention relates to a blind crutch capable of emitting light through a whole body, which comprises a blind crutch main body, a warning component, a control module and a battery. The whole crutch body of the blind crutch provided by the invention can emit light, and can transmit audible prompts to other people by using the loudspeaker, thereby obviously improving the visibility of the blind person to the blind person user, and further greatly improving the travel safety of the blind person. The lamp strip used by the invention can emit light with various colors, and has the applicability in daytime and at night, so that the blind can travel in all weather.
assignees: SUZHOU XINXINLIAN INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: AI algorithm blind area early warning method
abstract_en: The invention relates to an AI algorithm blind area early warning method. The method comprises the following steps of S1, image acquisition and input, S2, image detection of a target object in a road blind area needing early warning, S3, image tracking of the target object in an early warning area, S4, drawing a line parallel to the early warning area to determine a direction L1, S5, drawing an early warning area to determine an area m, S6, determining a moving direction L2 of the target object, S7, calculating an included angle theta of the L1 and the L2 and judging whether the included angle theta is larger than a threshold value C, S8, judging whether the target object is far away in an area m of the current early warning area or near the area m of the current early warning area if the target object passes through the early warning blind area, wherein the target object can be judged to be near or far away by comparing position changes of the target object in continuous frames, and sending out early warning signals if the threshold value of the target object near or far away in the early warning area reaches an early warning value, and S9, and outputting results.

title_en: Intelligent anti-collision early warning protection system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent anti-collision early warning protection system, and relates to a man-vehicle anti-collision terminal applied to an operation area. Comprising the following steps: the system comprises a plurality of mobile tags, an intelligent anti-collision terminal and an engine server. The intelligent anti-collision terminal provided by the utility model integrates all functional modules, supports various communication modes, is convenient to install and is plug and play; the anti-collision early warning device realizes anti-collision early warning between the working vehicle and the working personnel, and avoids unnecessary loss caused by factors such as blind areas of the working vehicle, blocked sight of the driving personnel and the like.

title_en: Point cloud data transmission method and system for foreign matter monitoring
abstract_en: The invention discloses a point cloud data transmission method and a system for foreign matter monitoring, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the laser radar scans initial point cloud data and subsequent point cloud data corresponding to the environment, and the data acquisition terminal correspondingly acquires the initial point cloud data and sends the initial point cloud data to the data analysis server; the data acquisition terminal correspondingly acquires subsequent point cloud data, cuts the subsequent point cloud data to obtain differential point cloud data, compresses the differential point cloud data and sends the differential point cloud data to the data analysis server; the data analysis server integrates the real-time point cloud data and sends the real-time point cloud data to the data center for storage; meanwhile, performing foreign matter analysis on the real-time point cloud data, sending an analysis result to a platform server, and performing audible and visual alarm and displaying a point cloud picture by the platform server according to the foreign matter analysis result; the data center station classifies the real-time point cloud data and analyzes the reasons of abnormal analysis results. According to the invention, through cutting and compressing the difference point cloud data, the data can be quickly, stably and efficiently transmitted, and meanwhile, the networking cost is reduced.
assignees: NANJING PAI SMART PERCEPTION INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Voice signal-vibration signal conversion device for the hearing impaired person
title_ko: 청각장애자를 위한 음성신호-진동신호 변환장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a voice signal-vibration signal conversion device for a hearing-impaired person and, more specifically, to a voice signal-vibration signal conversion device for a hearing-impaired person, which converts information provided by various voices into a digital code, and converts the converted digital code into vibration at a level that the hearing-impaired person can detect, so that the hearing-impaired person can recognize voice information. According to the present invention, the voice signal-vibration signal conversion device for the hearing-impaired person enables the hearing-impaired person to equally recognize voice information with the general public in real time, thereby promoting convenience of life and, in particular, actively coping with public transportation and disaster warning. In addition, the voice signal-vibration signal conversion device for the hearing-impaired person according to the present invention utilizes vibration that can be detected by the skin of the hearing impaired person, thereby improving information recognition ability that can be easily missed by sight, and contributing to popularization with optimal expenses by using a personal smart device.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 청각장애자를 위한 음성신호-진동신호 변환장치에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 각종 음성으로 제공되는 정보들을 디지털 코드로 변환하고, 변환된 디지털 코드를 청각장애자가 감지할 수 있는 수준의 진동으로 변환하여 시정착 장애자가 음성 정보를 인식할 수 있도록 하는 청각장애자를 위한 음성신호-진동신호 변환장치에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따른 청각장애자를 위한 음성신호-진동신호 변환장치는 청각장애자들이 음성정보를 일반인과 대등하게 실시간으로 인식할 수 있어 생활의 편리함 도모할 수 있고, 특히, 대중교통 및 재난 경보에도 능동적인 대처가 가능하다. 
또한, 본 발명에 따른 청각장애자를 위한 음성신호-진동신호 변환장치는 청각장애자들의 피부로 감지 가능한 진동을 활용함으로서 시각에 의한 놓치기 쉬운 정보인지능력을 개선하고, 개인 소지의 스마트기기를 활용함으로 최적의 경비로 대중화에 기여할 수 있다.
assignees: IND ACADEMIC COOPERATION SUNCHEON FIRST COLLEGE

title_en: Expressway traffic condition evaluation and early warning integrated system based on distributed optical fibers
abstract_en: The invention relates to an expressway traffic condition evaluation and early warning integrated system based on a distributed optical fiber, which comprises a sensing optical fiber, a sensor optical fiber and a sensor optical fiber, wherein the sensing optical fiber is paved along the extending direction of an expressway road to capture sound waves or vibration signals; the distributed optical fiber signal receiving assembly and the data processing module are used for receiving sound waves or vibration signals transmitted by the sensing optical fibers and processing the signals into practical information; the input end of the expressway traffic condition evaluation module receives the practical information transmitted by the distributed optical fiber signal receiving assembly and the data processing module, and the practical information is output as an expressway traffic condition evaluation result of each road section; and the expressway traffic early warning response module receives the evaluation result transmitted by the expressway traffic condition evaluation module and controls the alarm lamps on the expressway to display different colors and flashing frequencies or simultaneously give out alarm sounds according to the evaluation result. The invention is a monitoring mode which has low cost, is not influenced by external conditions such as weather and the like and has no blind area, and effectively monitors the traffic condition of the high-speed road section.
assignees: NINGBO DIGITAL TWIN DONGFANG INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE AND TECH

title_en: Portable high-integration emergency evacuation broadcasting system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a portable high-integration emergency evacuation broadcasting system, which comprises a portable shell, wherein the portable shell is provided with a first evacuation module and a second evacuation module; portable shell: the middle part of the front wall of the portable shell is provided with a loudspeaker, the left and right ends of the upper side of the portable shell are respectively provided with a variable focus searchlight and a super-bright explosion flash warning lamp, the bottom wall of the portable shell is provided with a storage battery, the rear wall of the portable shell is respectively provided with a wireless transmitter and a Bluetooth module, the left side of the portable shell is provided with a voice remote controller, and the voice remote controller is matched with the wireless transmitter; wherein: still include the singlechip, the singlechip is located the left side of portable shell, the input of singlechip is connected with the output electricity of battery, the output of singlechip is connected with megaphone, but varifocal searchlight and super bright explosion flash warning lamp's input electricity respectively, this portable high integration emergent evacuation broadcasting system, the system is succinct, easy operation, the function is abundant, convenient to carry, high integrated control, the multi-functional switching is realized to the accessible wireless remote control, environmental suitability is strong.
assignees: HENAN SMART TRAFFIC RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Train traveling disaster early warning analysis system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of train early warning analysis, in particular to a train traveling disaster early warning analysis system, which comprises a support main rod, wherein an early warning component is arranged on one side of the support main rod, a photovoltaic component is arranged above the support main rod, a mounting component is arranged at the bottom of the support main rod, and the early warning component comprises a sleeving frame body. This disasters nature early warning analysis system that marches of train through the cooperation between parts such as installation early warning subassembly, the accessible cup joints components such as framework and terminal storehouse, can realize bearing the weight of the record camera of loop bar top and can carry out the circuit monitoring with the district that easily appears the calamity to on the terminal module in the terminal storehouse is passed through the transmission line with the record picture transmission, then terminal module can analyze the picture, realizes the rating of calamity, then shows and broadcast through display screen and the sound production stereo set in the display storehouse, has avoided the alarm part to expose in the external world for a long time, has promoted its life.
assignees: URBAN VOCATIONAL COLLEGE OF SICHUAN;CHENGDU CHENGYUAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Protective helmet for blind person based on big data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent helmets for blind persons, and discloses a protective helmet for blind persons based on big data, which comprises an AI model, wherein the protective helmet module comprises: sensor integration module: a microprocessor integrating a high-speed GPU and an environment sensor, and collecting environment and position data; and a language interaction module: a microphone array integrating noise suppression and echo cancellation technology captures user voice, and an AI model is used for voice recognition; and an intelligent planning module: combining GPS positioning data, a map AP I and an AI model, and dynamically planning a safe and convenient route; anti-tracking security module: the camera captures a rear image, the AI face recognition algorithm recognizes and analyzes the facial expression and the behavior mode of the follower, and judges whether tracking behaviors exist or not by combining the position and time data; an emergency alert and communication module.

title_en: Fire protection facility shielding prevention alarm system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fire protection facility shielding alarm system, which comprises: the radar detection system comprises a 220V power supply, an air switch, a 220V-to-12V transformer, a relay, a radar host, a detection radar and a proximity switch, wherein the 220V power supply, the air switch, the 220V-to-12V transformer and the relay are electrically connected in sequence, the relay is electrically connected with the radar host and the proximity switch respectively, and the radar host is electrically connected with a buzzer and at least one detection radar; the invention has the advantages that: by introducing the intelligent real-time monitoring device, the monitoring of the fire fighting facilities, especially the hidden areas and the easily-shielded parts, is obviously improved. The problem of the monitoring blind area that leads to because of the operation is busy has not only been effectively solved, the hidden danger that fire control facility sheltered from for a long time has been prevented, still through strengthening the cognition of on-the-spot personnel to the fire control safety, cultivated must not shelter from the consciousness of fire control facility to provide powerful support for promoting the whole safe management level of enterprise and building safe cultural environment.
assignees: CHANGCHUN FAWAY TONG YANG AUTOMOBILE COMPONENTS CO LTD

title_en: Method, apparatus and computer program for providing hazard detection notification service to people with hearing impairments
title_ko: 청각 장애인에게 위험 감지 알림 서비스를 제공하기 위한 방법, 장치 및 컴퓨터 프로그램
abstract_en: According to the present disclosure, disclosed is a method for providing a dangerous situation detection notification, which comprises the steps of: receiving an auditory notification generated from the outside; identifying a situation corresponding to the auditory notification by analyzing the auditory notification; and outputting a visual notification and a tactile notification corresponding to the identified situation.
abstract_ko: 본 개시에 따르면, 위험 상황 감지 알림을 제공하는 방법으로서: 외부에서 발생하는 청각적 알림을 수신하는 단계; 상기 청각적 알림을 분석하여 상기 청각적 알림에 대응하는 상황을 식별하는 단계; 상기 식별된 상황에 대응하는 시각적 알림 및 촉각적 알림을 출력하는 단계를 포함하는, 위험 상황 감지 알림을 제공하는 방법이 개시된다.

title_en: Wearing device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a wearing device, which comprises a shell, a processing system arranged on the shell, a camera module, a sensor module and a loudspeaker module, wherein the camera module is connected with the processing system; the camera module is used for picking up the environment image and sending the environment image to the processing system; the sensor module is used for detecting the gesture information of a wearer and the distance information between the wearing device and an object in the environment and sending the gesture information to the processing system; the processing system is used for determining action guidance and early warning according to the environment images, the gesture information and the distance information, and sending the action guidance and the early warning to a wearer through the loudspeaker module. By utilizing the utility model, accurate navigation can be provided for the blind and the use comfort of the user is improved.

title_en: Foreign matter prevention control area access control equipment
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of nuclear power maintenance and discloses foreign matter prevention control area access control equipment, which comprises a door frame, a grating module, a face recognition module, an article recognition module, a controller and an alarm module, wherein a channel for personnel to pass through is formed inside the door frame; the grating module is arranged on the inner side of the portal frame and used for judging whether personnel pass through the channel or not; the face recognition module is arranged on the door frame; the article identification module is arranged on the door frame and used for identifying articles carried by personnel; the controller is in communication connection with the grating module, the face recognition module and the article recognition module; the alarm module is in communication connection with the controller, and when a setting condition occurs, the alarm module gives an alarm to a manager, and the setting condition means that any recognition result in the face recognition module and the article recognition module does not meet a preset condition. The foreign matter prevention control area access control equipment can automatically detect whether personnel belong to authorized personnel and articles carried by the personnel, and is high in detection and reliability.

title_en: Remote control fireproof door
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of fireproof doors, in particular to a remote control fireproof door which is installed in a building factory building, and comprises a fireproof door, wherein a personnel entrance is formed in the front side of the building factory building, the fireproof door is arranged on one side of the personnel entrance through a remote control mechanism, the remote control mechanism comprises a monitoring component, a driving component and an alarm component, the monitoring component is arranged in the building factory building, the driving component and the alarm component are both arranged on the front side of the building factory building, the fireproof door is fixedly arranged on the driving component, and the driving component and the alarm component are both electrically connected with the monitoring component, and the remote control mechanism has the beneficial effects that: the fire disaster emergence in the accessible monitoring assembly real-time supervision building factory building, then prevent fire door automatic movement shutoff personnel access & exit through the drive assembly drive to effectively isolated fire smoke and flame, and accessible alarm assembly in time warns external personnel, need not more intelligent device, and the cost is lower promptly, suitable popularization.
assignees: FUZHOU HUAMIN CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD

title_en: Server cabinet with intelligent protection alarm function
abstract_en: The invention relates to a server cabinet with an intelligent protection alarm function, which belongs to the field of server cabinets, and comprises a main cabinet body, wherein a plurality of partition plates which are uniformly distributed are arranged in the main cabinet body, and a sub-frame is arranged between two adjacent partition plates; the sub-frame comprises a pair of vertical supports, a plurality of supporting plates are arranged between the pair of vertical supports, and heat exchange tubes are arranged in the supporting plates in a penetrating manner; the server main body is arranged on the supporting plate; the division board includes the main baffle, installs a pair of water conservancy diversion pipeline in the main baffle, and the closing frame is installed to the lower extreme of main baffle, and the closing frame includes the C type roof beam with a pair of perpendicular support sliding connection, and fluid regulation and control portion is installed to the bottom of the main cabinet body, through real-time supervision, realizes the comprehensive control and the warning to server main part and operational environment in the rack, and when detecting server work abnormality or operational environment abnormality, all accessible closing frame seals the server of this subregion, realizes the isolation protection of local server.

title_en: Forest fire early warning method, system and equipment based on satellite Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of satellite Internet of things, in particular to a forest fire early warning method, a forest fire early warning system and forest fire early warning equipment based on the satellite Internet of things, wherein the method specifically comprises the following steps: according to a data fusion algorithm, carrying out fusion processing on the monitoring data of different monitoring devices in each target overlapping area to generate a data fusion model; deducing to obtain the monitoring data of the potential monitoring blind area by analyzing the monitoring data of the adjacent area of the potential monitoring blind area, and predicting the long-term change trend of the monitoring data of the potential monitoring blind area by a time sequence prediction algorithm; and transmitting the monitoring data of each monitoring device, the analysis result of the target overlapping area and the prediction result of the potential monitoring blind area to a data center through the satellite Internet of things. The invention obviously improves the coverage and the data accuracy of the forest monitoring system and effectively reduces the problems caused by monitoring blind areas and data overlapping.
assignees: SHENZHEN WEIXING WULIAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Blind guiding auxiliary system and helmet
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of electronic circuits, and particularly discloses a blind guiding auxiliary system and a helmet, the intelligent remote control system comprises a main control chip, a sound detection module, a light detection module, a camera module, an ultrasonic ranging module, a vibration module, a voice module, a light warning module and a help-seeking key module which are electrically connected with the main control chip. The utility model can realize the blind guiding assistance of the visually impaired in different scenes through effective environment detection, improves the blind guiding efficiency, and improves the safety and reliability of blind guiding; the blind guiding prompt requirements in different scenes can be met through the sound and vibration prompt function, so that visually impaired people can receive prompt information effectively; the acousto-optic help seeking information can be rapidly sent out under emergency through the help seeking key and the acousto-optic warning function, so that visually impaired people can obtain help in time.
assignees: CHENGDU GUOXINAN INFORMATION IND BASE CO LTD

title_en: National provincial road traffic incident early warning gridding information release method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for issuing early warning gridding information of national provincial road traffic event, which comprises determining time type, determining issuing medium, dividing gridding area, making rules for issuing plans and generating management and control plans, and a system for issuing early warning gridding information of national provincial road traffic event, comprising a video traffic event detection system, an information board, a speed limit sign, an induction lamp and a directional loudspeaker, the operability and the effective accessibility of the early warning plan are enhanced, more early treatment time is obtained for road smoothness, the unified and standard and efficient management and control plan is established mainly aiming at typical traffic event prevention and short-term traffic control such as road occupation, congestion, bad weather and the like, and aiming at typical emergency events possibly happening on national provincial roads, the occurrence of secondary accidents is effectively prevented in time, casualties and property loss are avoided and reduced to the maximum extent, and road safety is guaranteed to be smooth.
assignees: ZHEJIANG SCIENTIFIC RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF TRANSP

title_en: Monitoring device for solar photovoltaic equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides a monitoring device for solar photovoltaic equipment, which relates to the technical field of monitoring and comprises a support column, wherein three groups of spherical cameras are arranged in the middle of the upper end of the support column, the three groups of spherical cameras are distributed in a triangular shape, and a lifting mechanism is arranged in the middle of the top end of the spherical cameras and comprises a first telescopic rod; the spherical camera comprises three groups of spherical cameras, wherein searchlight is arranged in the middle of the upper end of each spherical camera, a turntable is arranged in the middle of the bottom end of each searchlight, mounting frames are arranged on two sides of the upper end of each turntable, and the searchlight is movably mounted in the middle of the inner sides of the two groups of mounting frames. The utility model can track and monitor pedestrians or animals entering the monitoring range, and effectively avoid the occurrence of the condition of blind areas during monitoring; meanwhile, through the cooperation of the searchlight and the buzzer alarm, pedestrians in the intrusion monitoring range can be warned, or animals can be driven, so that the safety of the solar photovoltaic equipment is protected.
assignees: QINGDAO HUASHENG INFORMATION ENG CO LTD

title_en: Long tunnel fire control pipeline multi-risk early warning system based on optical fiber sensing
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of tunnel pipeline monitoring, and aims to solve the problems that a traditional fire-fighting pipeline detection system cannot acquire various risk information on a fire-fighting pipeline and a detection blind area exists. The multi-risk early warning system for the long tunnel fire-fighting pipeline based on optical fiber sensing is provided, the brillouin light and Rayleigh light detection unit is used for realizing combined detection of the brillouin light and the Rayleigh light on an optical fiber group based on a dual-wavelength laser, and the common detection of the strain, vibration and temperature signals is realized by combining an optical and electric modulation device; the optical fiber group is tightly attached to the fire-fighting pipeline and comprises a tight optical fiber and a loose optical fiber, wherein the tight optical fiber is used for detecting a strain signal at the fire-fighting pipeline, and the loose optical fiber is used for detecting a temperature and a vibration signal at the fire-fighting pipeline; the fault judging unit judges the fault type of the fire-fighting pipeline based on the output signals of the optical fiber groups. The invention can realize the common detection of deformation, vibration and temperature of the fire-fighting pipeline and has high detection precision and efficiency.

title_en: Be used for public broadcasting and general alarm device in sea
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a device for public broadcasting and general alarming at sea, which comprises a stabilizing plate and an alarming lamp, wherein the bottom of the alarming lamp is fixedly connected with the middle of the top of the stabilizing plate, one side of the stabilizing plate is fixedly connected with a protection component for protecting an alarming structure, the protection component comprises a connecting block fixedly connected with one side of the stabilizing plate, and one side of the connecting block is fixedly connected with a movable sleeve. This a setting that is used for marine public broadcasting and general alarm device utilizes protective component, through the setting of protection casing and embedded groove, when the protection casing covers outside the alarm lamp, the protection casing keeps off comprehensively the alarm lamp and protects, keeps apart alarm lamp and external world physically, directly avoids any foreign matter to erode the alarm lamp to when the protection casing is impaired, the staff can the direct rotatory screw quarter butt, with screw quarter butt and the whole dismantlement of protection casing change, convenient quick maintenance.
assignees: HANGZHOU HUAYAN DIGITAL ELECTRON CO LTD

title_en: Liquid chromatography waste liquid level monitoring device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a liquid level monitoring device for liquid chromatography waste liquid, and belongs to the technical field of liquid chromatography. Comprising the following steps: unable adjustment base, fixed bolster, liquid sensor, liquid level detector, fixation clamp, control panel and computer, liquid sensor sets up in the waste liquid bottle side, the fixation clamp can with liquid sensor with the waste liquid bottle presss from both sides tightly, the waste liquid bottle sets up on the unable adjustment base. The problem of solvent waste liquid overflows and causes environmental pollution can be solved, can also automatic comparison waste liquid production and waste liquid bottle residual volume before the analysis experiment, make the prejudgement to waste liquid overflow risk, the experimenter accessible cell-phone end inquires the waste liquid bottle state in real time in the system operation in-process, and the device triggers audible and visual alarm when the liquid level exceeds maximum threshold value, suggestion experimenter in time handles the waste liquid.
assignees: YILITE SUZHOU ANALYSIS APPARATUS CO LTD

title_en: Multifunctional real-time power network monitoring alarm device
abstract_en: The invention provides a multifunctional real-time power network monitoring alarm device which comprises a bearing plate and is characterized in that a guide groove is formed in the middle upper side of the inside of the bearing plate, and a rack is fixedly connected to the bottom of the inner side of the guide groove; the middle part of the bottom of the bearing plate is fixedly connected with a plurality of L-shaped brackets in an arrangement way, the rear ends of the L-shaped brackets are respectively and fixedly connected with a first fixing plate, and first bolt holes are respectively formed in four corners of the inner part of the first fixing plate; and the meshing transmission on the rack is connected with a meshing transmission translation monitoring alarm assembly. The rack is not required to be emptied, so that the problem that the rack deforms due to dead weight is not required to be considered after the rack is installed, and compared with a screw transmission mode, the cooperation of the rack and the gear is more suitable for long-distance transmission, the effect of long-distance mobile monitoring is achieved, and the application range of the monitoring alarm device can be effectively improved.
assignees: NANJING GENGSHUO ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Alarm system for railway line foreign matter intrusion
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an alarm system for railway line foreign matter intrusion, which belongs to the technical field of railway disaster prevention and early warning and comprises a voice alarm switching signal transmitting module, a voice alarm switching signal receiving module, an MCU module, a USB alarm transmission module and an audible and visual alarm module, wherein the voice alarm switching signal transmitting module is in communication connection with the voice alarm switching signal receiving module, the voice alarm switching signal receiving module is connected with the MCU module, the MCU module is connected with the USB alarm transmission module, the USB alarm transmission module is connected with the audible and visual alarm module, and the audible and visual alarm module is used for switching and broadcasting voice alarm contents. The utility model solves the problem that the foreign matter limit intrusion of the railway line can not accurately alarm information by adjusting the voice alarm content by arranging the voice alarm switching signal transmitting module, the voice alarm switching signal receiving module and the audible and visual alarm module.
assignees: SHAANXI JINGSHEN RAILWAY CO LTD;RESEARCH AND TECH SUPERVISION INSTITUTE CHINA RAILWAY LANZHOU GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Charging pile collision warning device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of charging piles, in particular to a charging pile collision warning device which comprises a mounting base, wherein a charging pile main body is fixedly arranged at the top of the mounting base, a positioning clamping frame positioned in front of the charging pile main body is fixedly arranged at the top of the mounting base, two groups of first guide rods are movably arranged on the positioning clamping frame, one end of each first guide rod is in threaded connection with a transmission clamping frame, and two groups of transmission rollers are movably arranged on the transmission clamping frame. This fill electric pile collision warning device, when the vehicle is backing a car the in-process, tire accessible driving roller promotes transmission card frame and guide bar first removal, until connecting contact first and connecting contact second contact back, circuit board and audible and visual alarm, the return circuit intercommunication between the buzzer, circuit board steerable audible and visual alarm, buzzer start and warn the driver, the driver of being convenient for in time control distance parks, the security is higher.

title_en: Ground monitoring device and method for multi-base-point friction type overburden rock migration
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ground monitoring device and method for multi-base point friction type overburden rock migration, and belongs to the technical field of ground monitoring. According to the invention, the steel wire rope can drag the tool cavity to move through the movement of the rock stratum, and the second spring drives the piston to slowly reset due to the small caliber of the air outlet, so that the sliding seat drives the writing pen to perform translational movement through the magnetic attraction of the second magnet and the first magnet, so that the writing pen can perform linear marking on the carrier plate, the rock stratum migration track can be accurately described, the monitoring of the movement track of the rock stratum is ensured, the monitoring device can operate and run on the ground, the operation is simple, the safety and reliability are realized, the cost is reduced, the difficulty of rock stratum migration volume and the separation layer position before and after the mining can be effectively and dynamically monitored in real time, and technicians can be helped to obtain the time-space evolution law of the rock stratum migration under the influence of the mining, so that data support is provided for subsequent actual production and disaster early warning.
assignees: HUANGYUCHUAN COAL MINE OF GUONENG YILI ENERGY CO LTD

title_en: Blind-assisting cap
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of blind guiding devices, and provides a blind assisting cap, A forward ultrasonic sensor is added on the cap body to perform real-time distance measurement, and the forward ultrasonic sensor can measure the forward distance in real time so as to detect obstacles. The device can provide timely warning and obstacle avoidance guidance to help the blind avoid collision and accidents. The warning lamp is arranged, the warning lamp can flash when the warning is carried out, and especially under the night or low light condition, the warning lamp can attract the attention of others, so that the blind people can know that the blind people are approaching and need to avoid. This can improve the visibility of the blind in traffic and people.
assignees: SHANGHAI CITY YANGPU DISTR PINGLIANG ROAD NO 3 PRIMARY SCHOOL

title_en: System and method for broadcasting alarm using ai-based multilingual voice conversion function
title_ko: Ai 기반 다국어 음성변환기능을 이용한 경보방송시스템, 및 경보방송방법
abstract_en: The present invention provides an alert broadcasting system and alert broadcasting method utilizing AI-based multilingual voice conversion, which can quickly and accurately convey disaster or alert information to not only Koreans but also foreign residents and tourists by converting input voice data into multiple languages in real time to provide disaster safety-related information. Provided is an alert broadcasting system utilizing AI-based multilingual voice conversion comprising: a characterization information storage unit for storing characterization information for converting silent intervals into characters differently according to the lengths thereof; a voice recognition module configured to perform voice recognition on the input voice data and generate a text file obtained by characterizing the voice data; a multi-lingual translation module configured to translate the text file into at least one foreign language to generate a multi-lingual translation; a multi-lingual broadcasting module configured to convert the multi-lingual translation into voice streaming composed of at least one corresponding foreign language and output the same through a speaker unit; and an output control unit configured to control real-time output, through a display unit, of at least one of the text file generated by the voice recognition module and the multi-lingual translation generated by the multi-lingual translation module.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 경보방송시스템은, 디스플레이부 및 스피커부를 구비하고, 상기 디스플레이부 및 상기 스피커부를 통해, 재난 또는 안전사고로 인한 경보상황 발생시 이를 알리기 위한 경보방송데이터를 출력하는 경보방송시스템에 있어서, 상기 경보상황을 알리기 위한 화자의 육성데이터가 입력되면, 상기 육성데이터에 대한 음성인식을 수행하여 상기 육성데이터를 문자화한 텍스트파일을 생성하는 음성인식모듈; 상기 텍스트파일을 적어도 하나의 다른 나라 언어로 번역하여 다국어번역문을 생성하는 다국어번역모듈; 상기 다국어번역문을 대응된 적어도 하나의 다른 나라의 언어로 구성된 음성스트리밍으로 변환하여 상기 스피커부를 통해 출력하는 다국어방송모듈; 및 상기 음성인식모듈에서 생성된 텍스트파일, 및 상기 다국어번역모듈에서 생성된 다국어번역문 중 적어도 하나를 상기 디스플레이부를 통해 실시간으로 출력하도록 제어하는 출력제어부를 포함함으로써, 재난안전에 관련된 정보를 제공하기 위해 입력되는 육성데이터를 실시간으로 다국어로 변환하여 제공할 수 있고, 이로 인해, 외국인 거주자 또는 외국인 관광객들에게도 재난 또는 경보상황을 신속하고 정확하게 전달하여, 외국인 거주자 또는 외국인 관광객들도 재난 또는 경보상황에 안전하게 대처할 수 있도록 하는 장점이 있다.

title_en: Multifunctional sickbed alarm
abstract_en: The utility model provides a multifunctional sickbed alarm, which relates to the technical field of sickbed alarms and comprises an alarm main body, wherein a plurality of control buttons are distributed on the front surface of the alarm main body, blind operation points are arranged on the front surface of the control buttons, and a main board is arranged in the alarm main body. According to the utility model, a plurality of control buttons are distributed on the front surface of the alarm main body, so that a patient can conveniently press different buttons according to different requirements, and further different alarm sounds can be sent out, different requirements (such as continuous and rapid two-sound drop = salt water change, drop = fall, click = other help and the like) can be conveniently replaced by different alarm sounds, meanwhile, a movable calling bell can be installed at the head of the patient, different buttons are arranged on the calling bell according to different requirements, different sounds generated by pressing different buttons can be transmitted to a nurse station, and in addition, each nurse is provided with a bracelet, so that information can be directly sent to the bracelet, and the convenience of operation is improved.
assignees: THE FIRST PEOPLES HOSPITAL OF KUNSHAN

title_en: Mine geological environment early warning device
abstract_en: The application discloses a mine geological environment early warning device, and belongs to the technical field of environment early warning. The application comprises a supporting rod, a control box, a camera, a rotary translation table, a displacement sensor, an inclination sensor, a controller and a rainwater detection sensor, wherein the control box is arranged above a supporting rod, the displacement sensor, the inclination sensor and the controller are arranged in the control box, the rotary translation table is arranged at the top of the control box, the camera is arranged on the rotary translation table, a support baffle is arranged at the top of the control box, and the rainwater detection sensor is arranged at the top of the support baffle. The mine geological environment early warning device can enable mine management staff to monitor the change of geological environment in real time, directly observe the surrounding environment through the camera, early warn the occurrence of geological disasters in time, and has the advantages of real-time monitoring, direct observation and early warning in advance.
assignees: YUNNAN YONGCHANG PB & ZN CO LTD

title_en: Rear warning device for deaf-mute
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rear warning device for the deaf-mute, which belongs to the technical field of warning devices and comprises a main body, wherein the main body is arc-shaped, two ends of the main body are connected with elastic rods, one end of each elastic rod is connected with a mounting block, and a vibrating groove is formed in each mounting block. According to the utility model, the outside of the main body is connected with the radio, the radio is used for collecting sound at the rear, the higher position is connected with the radio on the main body, the radio is prevented from being shielded by clothes, when the sound collected by the radio exceeds eighty decibels of sound emitted by a common loudspeaker, the control equipment enables the vibrating motors at the two ends to rotate, the output ends of the vibrating motors drive the semicircular vibrating blocks to rotate so as to generate vibration, meanwhile, the eccentric holes on the vibrating blocks drive the touch pad to eccentrically rotate, the touch pad is contacted with a user, vibration generated by the vibrating motors and the eccentrically and reciprocally rotated touch pad vibrate and touch the alarm, and the touch pad performs body-sensing contact alarm, so that an alarm blind area does not exist, and the alarm effect is good.

title_en: Blind curve sight dead angle warning system
abstract_en: A blind curve sight dead angle warning system comprises a processor, at least one warning lamp, at least one cat eye lamp, at least one warning loudspeaker and a wireless communication frequency module. The processor calculates a start distance time by the speed measurement value of the first vehicle speed sensor and the speed measurement value of the second vehicle speed sensor, and the processor starts at least one of the at least one warning lamp, the at least one cat eye lamp, the at least one warning horn and the wireless communication frequency module.

title_en: Anti-theft structure of database all-in-one machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of database integrated machines, in particular to an anti-theft structure of a database integrated machine, which comprises a protection frame body, wherein a monitoring assembly is arranged above the protection frame body, a control assembly is arranged inside the protection frame body, a protection assembly is arranged on the front surface of the protection frame body, the monitoring assembly comprises a rotary chassis, and the rotary chassis is movably arranged at the top of the protection frame body. This database all-in-one's theftproof structure, through the cooperation between parts such as installation monitoring module, accessible rotation chassis and bracing piece, can realize rotating the chassis and drive the surveillance camera head of bracing piece top and rotate, the surveillance camera head will focus the record when someone is close to the data all-in-one to store the video of record through the transmission line, then when the personnel that is close to appear destroying the theft such as protection framework, flash lamp and the sounder of alarm module one side will start, and then reminds the staff to prevent that internal data from being stolen.
assignees: BEIJING JINSHENG CLOUD PHARMACEUTICAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire-fighting lifesaving illumination line with two-way information transmission alarm function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire-fighting lifesaving illumination line with a bidirectional information transmission alarm function, which relates to the technical field of fire-fighting lifesaving equipment and comprises a power control box, a winding reel and a color-changing luminous body, wherein an operation interface of the power control box is provided with a first alarm loudspeaker, an evacuation alarm switch, a first communication microphone and a color-changing luminous body connector, an operation interface of the winding reel is provided with a corresponding second alarm loudspeaker, a distress alarm switch, a second communication switch and a second communication microphone, a green illumination line, a red illumination line and a communication cable are arranged in the color-changing luminous body, the mechanical information transmission is realized by changing the luminous color of the illumination line and adding the bidirectional alarm device, the real-time intercom in a communication blind area of a complex building is realized on the premise of not changing the portability and the working mode of the conventional fire-fighting lifesaving illumination line, the timely receiving of early-warning information is ensured, and the life safety of fire-fighting rescue workers is ensured.

title_en: Gas leakage detection device for gas transmission station
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a gas leakage detection device of a gas transmission station, which comprises an alarm shell, wherein an indicator lamp is arranged on the front surface of the alarm shell, a horn mouth is arranged at the edge of the lower end of the alarm shell, a gas inlet is arranged at the edge of the upper end of the alarm shell, a gas inlet component is arranged at the gas inlet in the alarm shell, the gas inlet component comprises a component shell fixed in the alarm shell, and a dustproof mechanism is arranged on the component shell. According to the gas leakage detection device for the gas transmission station, disclosed by the utility model, after the electromagnet is started, the armature is adsorbed, so that the sealing block leaves the gas inlet, the gas inlet is opened for gas suction detection, then the electromagnet can be periodically closed, and the spring can push the sealing block to move forwards after the electromagnet is closed, so that the sealing block is pushed into the gas inlet, foreign matters in the gas inlet are extruded, the purpose of periodically cleaning the gas inlet is achieved, and the gas inlet is prevented from being blocked by the foreign matters.
assignees: HENAN JINKONG TIANQING COAL CHEMICAL CO LTD

title_en: Tobacco leaf warehouse tobacco worm monitoring and early warning system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of deinsectization, and discloses a tobacco leaf storage tobacco insect monitoring and early warning system. The system comprises a high-definition intelligent camera, a tobacco insect trapping plate, a processor and an early warning device, wherein the tobacco insect trapping plate traps tobacco insect samples, the high-definition intelligent camera collects images of the tobacco insect samples on the tobacco insect trapping plate and sends the images to the processor, the processor is provided with an AI self-learning algorithm of vision technology, tobacco insects and other insect foreign matters are distinguished, the image samples are processed, tobacco insects are identified and counted, and the early warning device carries out early warning of different grades according to the tobacco insect numbers. The invention can timely and effectively reflect the pest situation in the reservoir area, early warning is carried out before the disaster is formed, economic loss caused by the pest can be effectively avoided, the system networking function can feed the pest situation back to the command center in real time, the monitoring result data is visually displayed through the system display board, and a data base is created for the establishment of pest control measures.
assignees: CHINA TOBACCO HENAN IND CO LTD

title_en: Sea condition early warning system of deep sea fan
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of offshore wind turbine safety equipment, and discloses a sea condition early warning system of a deep-sea wind turbine, which comprises a control device, an image acquisition device, a distance measurement device and an alarm device which are arranged on a supporting body, wherein the image acquisition device, the distance measurement device and the alarm device are all in communication connection with the control device, and the sea condition early warning system also comprises a power supply device which is electrically connected with the control device, the image acquisition device, the distance measurement device and the alarm device, wherein the control device is used for controlling the image acquisition device to acquire field images in real time to realize monitoring, and the control device is used for controlling the alarm device to alarm when the distance of an external object detected by the distance measurement device is smaller than a distance threshold value. The sea condition early warning system of the deep-open sea fan can monitor the running condition of the offshore wind farm in real time, monitor, early warn and drive foreign objects entering the offshore wind farm field and the submarine cable sea area, and improve the safety and reliability of the offshore wind farm.
assignees: YUNDA ENERGY TECH GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Early warning device
abstract_en: The utility model provides an early warning device which comprises a clock body and a hanging piece, wherein the hanging piece is fixed on a wall surface, the lower end of the hanging piece is connected with a vertical plate, the upper end of the clock body is connected with a connecting rod, the connecting rod penetrates through the vertical plate to hang the clock body on the vertical plate, a first spring is connected with a first ball body, a second ball body is placed on a table top, the first ball body and the second ball body are positioned right above a groove, a transverse plate is connected with a vertical rod, two ends of the second spring are respectively connected with the transverse plate and the bottom of the groove, a first contact piece is arranged on the side surface of a blind hole, when the second ball body falls on the transverse plate, a second contact piece arranged at the lower end of the vertical rod is contacted with the first contact piece, and a buzzer is connected with the second contact piece and the first contact piece. When an earthquake and the like occur, the clock body swings around the connecting rod so as to drive the first spring to move, so that a second sphere positioned on the first sphere falls on the transverse plate in the groove, and the vertical rod moves downwards so that the first contact piece and the second contact piece are in contact, and the buzzer buzzes.
assignees: CHONGQING TRADITIONAL CHINESE MEDICINE ORTHOPEDICS HOSPITAL CHONGQING CITY YUZHONG DISTRICT PEOPLES;NANFANG HOSPITAL

title_en: Smart fire notification system
title_ko: 스마트 화재 알림 시스템
abstract_en: An object of the present invention is to solve the problem that a fire alarm system for the hearing and visually impaired does not exist. A fire alarm system comprises: an elastic band (1) which is composed of a length-adjustable elastic band to be conveniently worn regardless of the thickness of a wrist; a vibration module (2)which can be detected by the hearing and visually impaired and has wide usability through vibration signal education such as a Morse code; a display (3) which can be used by people other than the hearing and visually impaired and indicates a fire occurrence location; an AA battery (4) which can be easily obtained at a low price to be economically used in a place with a large floating population such as a hospital; and a Wi-Fi communication module (5) which can perform Wi-Fi communication. The present invention provides effects of enabling the hearing and visually impaired to be promptly notified of a fire and being efficiently used at a low price in a place with a large floating population such as a hospital as well as the disabled.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 스마트 화재 알림 시스템에 관한 것으로서 시청각 장애인에게 신속한 화재 알림이 가능하고, 장애인 뿐만 아니라 병원 등의 유동 인구가 많은 장소에서 저렴한 가격에 효율적으로 이용가능하도록 함으로써 기존의 시,청각 장애인을 위한 화재 알림 시스템이 존재하지 않는 문제점을 해소 하도록 한 것이다. 즉 본 발명은, 화재 알림 시스템에 있어서 손목 두께에 상관없이 편리한 착용이 가능할 수 있게 길이 조절 가능한 탄력 밴드로 구성한 탄력 밴드, 시청각 장애인이 감지 가능하고, 모스 부호 등의 진동 신호 교육을 통해 넓은 활용성을 가질 수 있게 진동 모듈을 장착하여 구성한 진동 모듈, 시청각 장애인 이외의 사람들도 이용이 가능하고, 이 때 화재 발생 위치를 나타낼 수 있게 디스플레이를 장착하여 구성한 디스플레이, 병원 등 유동인구가 많은 장소에서 보다 경제적인 활용이 가능할 수 있게 저렴한 가격에 쉽게 구할 수 있는 AA배터리를 활용하여 구성한 AA배터리, 각각의 건물에서 사용하는 Wi-Fi에 접속하여 해당 건물의 화재 감지 센서와 연동할 수 있게 Wi-Fi 송수신이 가능한 통신 모듈을 장착하여 구성한 Wi-Fi 통신모듈으로 구성한 것이다. 따라서, 본 발명은 시청각 장애인에게 신속한 화재 알림이 가능하고, 장애인 뿐만 아니라 병원 등의 유동 인구가 많은 장소에서 저렴한 가격에 효율적으로 이용가능하도록 함으로써 기존의 시,청각 장애인을 위한 화재 알림 시스템이 존재하지 않는 문제점을 해소하도록 한 효과를 갖는 것이다.

title_en: Parking lot vehicle management method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a vehicle management method for a parking lot, which is characterized by comprising the steps of identifying license plates and vehicle types of vehicles, carrying out risk assessment on the vehicles according to the vehicle types, determining the risk level of the vehicles according to the risk level, determining an optimal parking space for the vehicles by adopting a greedy algorithm based on the risk level of the vehicles, generating a moving path, pasting a patrol device on the vehicles, guiding the vehicles to run along the moving path, collecting environmental information around the vehicles, and sending the environmental information to a main control system, wherein the main control system judges whether fire disasters occur in the parking lot according to the received environmental information. The invention solves the problems that when a new energy automobile in the prior art breaks out a fire, fire information cannot be timely transmitted to the outside, meanwhile, a certain blind area exists in manual inspection and video early warning, a fire vehicle cannot be timely and effectively found in the early stage of the fire, and fire protection measures are started.
assignees: CHINA MERCHANTS GROUP TESTING VEHICLE TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Method for assisting visually impaired people to walk crosswalk line
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of traffic signal control, in particular to a method for assisting visually impaired people to walk through a crosswalk line. The data processing terminal is used for receiving real-time motion data acquired by the 360-degree thermal imaging holder and the laser radar. Under the effect of the control signal sent by the data processing terminal, the road warning screen can remind a driver to pay attention to visually impaired people by means of displaying text contents in real time, the voice broadcasting equipment can remind the driver to pay attention to visually impaired people by means of real-time voice broadcasting contents, and the visually impaired people know that the voice broadcasting equipment is located in a pedestrian crosswalk line area according to the voice broadcasting content. Therefore, on one hand, the technology conversion from ' people's air defense ' to ' technical defense ' is realized, the problem that people with vision impairment safely pass through crosswalk lines is solved, the technology can be widely applied to crosswalk line scenes with poor street-crossing vision distance, the visual defect of people is made up by ' technical defense ', and on the other hand, people with vision impairment can be intelligently screened out and tracked in real time.
assignees: CCDI SUZHOU EXPLOR & DESIGN CONSULTANT CO LTD

title_en: Mountain road sharp turn warning system based on photovoltaic power generation
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of traffic safety, and particularly relates to a mountain road sharp turning warning system based on photovoltaic power generation, which comprises a detection device, a control system, a warning device and a photovoltaic energy supply system, wherein the detection device comprises two pairs of photoelectric switches respectively arranged at blind areas of visual fields at two sides of a corner of a mountain road; the warning device comprises an LCD display screen, a warning signal lamp and a sound warning module which are connected with the control system, and the photovoltaic energy supply system is used for converting solar energy into electric energy for storage and supplying power for other devices. The photoelectric switch converts signals of whether pedestrians or vehicles pass into voltage signals and transmits the voltage signals to the control system, and the control system controls the LCD display screen, the warning signal lamp and the sound alarm module to enter corresponding working states. According to the utility model, through comprehensive application of the photovoltaic technology, the photoelectric sensor technology and the singlechip technology, vehicles and pedestrians coming and going are timely and effectively warned, and the safety of mountain road turning is improved.

title_en: Railway perimeter disaster protection method, system, processing equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to a railway perimeter disaster protection method, a system, processing equipment and a storage medium, which are characterized by comprising the steps of acquiring a video stream of continuous image frames along a railway, defining a detection defense area along the railway, detecting coordinate points of all moving targets in the detection defense area corresponding to each frame of image of the video stream by adopting a front background detection algorithm in a preset detection time period, detecting all the moving targets obtained by front background detection by adopting a target detection method, eliminating interference objects, outputting a target detection result, alarming by taking the identified other moving targets as invasion foreign matters, and detecting the existence of the invasion foreign matters identified by the target detection result, detecting other foreign matters and driving safety by adopting a picture-text large model when the invasion foreign matters are identified by the target detection method, and outputting the target detection result or alarming according to the detection result.

title_en: Nuclear fuel pool foreign matter fall detection system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a nuclear fuel pool foreign matter falling detection system, and belongs to the technical field of target detection. The system comprises an industrial camera, a millimeter wave radar, a grating sensor, an exchanger, an upper computer, a server and an alarm system, wherein the industrial camera, the millimeter wave radar and the grating sensor can acquire different information from different heights and angles through reasonable installation and arrangement so as to perform multiple detection, the detection range is large, the exchanger, the server and the upper computer receive acquired data and analyze and process the acquired data, and the alarm system is responsible for sending alarm signals when foreign matters fall. Compared with the manual inspection mode, the system can realize real-time detection and automatic alarm of the falling condition of the foreign matters in the nuclear fuel pool, improves the detection accuracy and efficiency, avoids false detection due to missing detection, has higher detection accuracy, can detect micro foreign matters in millimeter level, reduces the interference of human factors, and ensures the safe operation of the nuclear fuel pool.
assignees: UNIV DALIAN TECH;HAINAN HANWU ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Earthquake geomagnetic detection device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of detection equipment, in particular to an earthquake geomagnetic detection device, which comprises a lower shell and an upper shell, wherein a geomagnetic sensor, an MCU device, a wireless transmission module and a power module are arranged in the lower shell, a cover plate is connected in a sliding manner in the upper shell, and a protection component is arranged on the cover plate; according to the utility model, the geomagnetic sensor is used for detecting the change rate of the geomagnetic field in the placement area of the geomagnetic detection device, the pressure sensor is used for detecting the pressure above the upper shell, when the pressure sensor detects a short-time large value due to the fact that the pressure sensor is stepped on above the upper shell, a transmission signal is used for controlling the alarm to operate so as to warn, the protection effect of the device is improved, when the pressure sensor is extruded by a foreign object for a long time, the pressure sensor is used for transmitting a signal to the MCU device, and the MCU device remotely reminds maintenance personnel to conduct timely treatment through the wireless transmission module.

title_en: Method, device, equipment and storage medium for detecting falling in vehicle running
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for detecting falling in vehicle running. The method comprises the steps of extracting acceleration data and GPS track data of a vehicle based on a preset time interval when the vehicle enters a disaster early warning road section, judging whether a falling condition is met based on the acceleration data change characteristic, determining falling start time and falling end time based on the acceleration change time when the falling condition is met, stopping updating or enabling the vehicle speed to be zero based on the GPS track data in a falling start time-falling end time period, and judging that the vehicle falls. The application can still quickly find the falling behavior of the vehicle no matter in severe weather conditions or in environments with poor light, and fills the problem of road condition perception blind areas caused by video detection failure and portal flow feedback delay.

title_en: Fire disaster prevention monitoring method and system for old wind turbine based on wireless temperature measurement technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire hazard prevention monitoring method and a fire hazard prevention monitoring system for an old wind turbine based on a wireless temperature measurement technology, and relates to the technical field of automatic monitoring. Through real-time monitoring and dynamic analysis of temperature and current data, the invention can rapidly and accurately identify potential fire risks, and obviously reduce accidents caused by equipment overheating or current abnormality. And secondly, the real-time performance of data acquisition and the maintenance convenience of the system are improved by utilizing a wireless technology, monitoring blind spots caused by equipment aging are reduced, and the integrity and real-time updating of monitoring data are ensured. In addition, the dynamic threshold adjustment and abnormal mode recognition functions in the invention further enhance the adaptability of the system to environmental changes and the prospective of early warning, and effectively avoid false alarm and missing report.
assignees: HUANENG JIUQUAN WIND POWER CO LTD

title_en: Alarm device for monitoring rainfall of geological disasters
