abstract_en: According to embodiments of the present invention, an automated fire extinguishing system can comprise: a fire receiver sensing a fire to generate a fire warning linking signal, an odorant emission signal, and a fire extinguish agent emission signal and outputting a delay fire extinguish agent emission signal; and an advance withdrawal guiding device opening a discharge valve of an odorant storage container storing a high-pressure inert gas, a high-pressure gas, and a liquid odorant or a powder odorant in accordance with the odorant emission signal to enable an odorant to be operated to be emitted from a nozzle connected to the discharge valve by expansion of the high-pressure inert gas.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시예들에 따른 자동화 소화 시스템은 화재를 감지하여 화재 경보 연동 신호, 부취제 방출 신호 및 소화 약제 방출 신호를 생성하고, 지연 소화 약제 방출 신호를 출력하는 화재 수신기 및 고압의 가스, 액상 또는 분말 형태의 부취제와 고압의 비활성 가스를 저장하는 부취제 저장 용기의 배출 밸브를 부취제 방출 신호에 따라 개방하여, 부취제가 고압의 비활성 가스의 팽창에 의해 배출 밸브에 연결된 노즐로부터 방출되도록 동작하는 사전 퇴거 유도 장치를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Personal emergency triggering, notification and communication for smartwatches
abstract_en: A wearable mobile device executes a personal safety service client application to detect a triggering event indicating an emergency, wherein the triggering event is detected from user input received by the wearable mobile device. The application determines a location of the wearable mobile device, the location of the wearable mobile device corresponding to a location of the emergency, and provides an indication of the emergency and the location of the emergency to a personal safety service server. The personal safety service server sends a notification message via a push notification displayed on user devices of a predefined group of emergency contacts indicating the occurrence of the emergency and periodically receives updates to the location of the wearable mobile device from the personal safety service client application.

title_en: Method for guaranteed delivery of alert notifications through chain-of-command escalation procedures
abstract_en: Computer (server)-based system for detecting anomalous data patterns and generating alert notifications and guaranteeing delivery by soliciting acknowledgement by end-users. If acknowledgement is not obtained within a pre-determined timeframe, the notification is escalated to managing authority and the process repeats until acknowledgement is obtained or the full chain of command is exhausted.

title_en: Mobile phone, safety information server, and safety confirmation method
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a technique capable of transmitting safety information on a mobile phone with its access regulated to a safety information server without providing an exclusive communication function or communication facility.SOLUTION: A safety information creation unit 8 creates safety information on a user of a mobile phone 1 after access regulation is imposed after receiving an emergency warning. A safety notification unit 7 notifies a server of the created safety information after the access regulation is cancelled.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Method for Providing Location Based Service by using Bluetooth
title_ko: 블루투스를 이용한 위치 기반 서비스 제공 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for providing a location-based service using Bluetooth. The method for providing a location-based service using Bluetooth includes: a first step of requesting a confirmation process to a serve confirming whether or not a Bluetooth module having transmitted or broadcasted a Bluetooth-based wireless frequency signal is a Bluetooth module mapped with one or more designated location areas or performing the confirmation process; a second step of activating a positioning function of a location positioning module prepared in the terminal; and a third step of providing a location-based service for the location areas mapped with the Bluetooth module.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 블루투스를 이용한 위치 기반 서비스 제공 방법에 관한 것으로, 본 발명에 따른 블루투스를 이용한 위치 기반 서비스 제공 방법은, 블루투스(Bluetooth)를 처리하는 블루투스부를 구비하고 위치 측위모듈을 구비한 단말기를 통해 실행되는 방법에 있어서, 상기 블루투스부를 통해 수신된 블루투스 기반 무선 주파수 신호에 포함된 코드 값을 이용하여 상기 블루투스 기반 무선 주파수 신호를 송출 또는 방송한 블루투스모듈이 하나 이상의 지정된 위치 영역과 매핑된 블루투스모듈인지 인증하는 서버로 인증 절차를 요청하거나 또는 상기 인증 절차를 수행하는 제1 단계와, 상기 인증 절차를 통해 상기 블루투스모듈 인증 시, 상기 단말기에 구비된 위치 측위모듈의 측위 기능을 활성화하거나 또는 활성화 상태를 확인하는 제2 단계와, 상기 위치 측위모듈의 측위 기능을 통해 측위된 위치 정보를 통해 상기 블루투스모듈과 매핑된 위치 영역에 대한 위치 기반 서비스가 제공되게 제어하는 제3 단계를 포함한다. 
한편 본 발명에 따른 블루투스를 이용한 위치 기반 서비스 제공 방법은, 블루투스(Bluetooth)를 처리하는 블루투스부를 구비한 사용자의 단말기와 통신하는 서버에 의해 실행되는 방법에 있어서, 지정된 코드 값을 포함하는 블루투스 기반의 무선 주파수 신호를 송출 또는 방송하는 블루투스모듈 중 특정한 모듈 이용처에서 보유한 블루투스모듈을 상기 모듈 이용처와 관련된 위치 영역과 매핑되게 처리하는 제1 단계와, 상기 단말기의 블루투스부를 통해 수신된 블루투스 기반 무선 주파수 신호에 포함된 코드 값의 유효성을 인증하여 상기 블루투스모듈이 상기 위치 영역과 매핑된 블루투스모듈인지 인증하는 인증 절차를 수행하거나 또는 상기 인증 절차의 인증 결과를 확인하는 제2 단계와, 상기 블루투스모듈 인증 시, 상기 인증된 블루투스모듈과 매핑된 위치 영역에 대한 정보 또는 상기 인증된 블루투스모듈과 매핑된 위치 영역에 대한 위치 기반 서비스를 위한 서비스 관련 정보를 상기 단말기의 프로그램으로 제공하는 제3 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: powerless patch device announcing position of safty tool in disaster status, and method of the same
title_ko: 재난상황에서 안전도구의 위치알림 무전원 패치 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to technology, reporting a position of a safety tool (example: a fire extinguisher, an oxygen mask) to prevent secondary damage in an area, shaded by a disaster situation. The technology is capable of attaching a patch, operated by generating power from surrounding environmental energy (example: light energy, temperature energy) without an extra power supply unit, to a safety tool, and reporting a disaster situation in an externally recognizable format (example: voice alarm, light source blinking) by identifying the patch when the disaster situation occurs. According to the present invention, since the patch device, attached to a safety tool, generates operational power from surrounding environmental energy without an extra power supply unit, the device is able to be used without expiration date unless the device is broken. Moreover, since the formation of power supply and the formation of disaster detection are integrated, malfunction occurs in power supply when malfunction occurs in a disaster detecting function, and then the display of the patch device becomes abnormal, and therefore, the malfunction of the disaster detecting function is not hidden and is determined to be immediately repaired.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 재난상황 발생으로 음영 상태가 된 지역에서 2차 피해 방지를 위해 안전도구(예: 소화기, 산소마스크)의 위치를 알려주는 기술로서, 별도의 전원공급수단 없이 주변 환경에너지(예: 빛에너지, 온도에너지)로부터 전원을 생성하여 동작하는 패치를 안전도구에 부착하고 이 패치에서 재난상황시 이를 식별하여 외부에서 인식가능한 형태(예: 음성 알람, 광원 블링킹)로 알리도록 하는 기술에 관한 것이다.  본 발명에 따르면, 안전도구에 부착되는 패치 장치가 별도의 전원공급수단 없이 주변 환경에너지로부터 동작 전원을 생성하기 때문에 패치 장치가 망가지지 않는 한 유효 기간 없이 사용할 수 있는 장점이 있다.  또한, 본 발명에 따르면 전원공급 구성과 재난검출 구성이 일체화되어 있어 재난검출 기능에 고장이 발생한 경우에는 전원공급에도 장애가 발생하여 패치 장치의 표시에 이상이 나타나게 되므로 재난검출 기능의 고장이 숨겨지지 않고 그때그때 판별하여 즉시 수리할 수 있는 장점이 있다.

title_en: Mobile receiver for dmb disaster broadcasting and method using the same
title_ko: 이동형 dmb 재난방송 수신장치 및 이를 이용한 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a mobile digital multimedia broadcasting (DMB) disaster broadcast receiver and a reception method using the same. The mobile DMB disaster broadcast receiver comprises: a disaster message reception unit which distinguishes and receives two or more DMB disaster broadcast messages transmitted from a plurality of channels; a location information generation unit which determines its own location information; a control unit which extracts a location information ID indicating location information from the received two or more disaster messages, and selects a disaster message to be output by referring to the extracted location information ID and its own location information; and an output unit which outputs the disaster message in accordance with instructions of the control unit. The control unit monitors its location information while outputting the disaster message, and when an area where the control unit is located has been changed, selects the disaster message to be output again.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 이동형 DMB 재난방송 수신장치 및 이를 이용한 수신방법에 관한 것으로, 이동형 DMB 재난방송 수신장치는 복수 채널로부터 전송되는 둘 이상의 DMB(Digital Multimedia Broadcasting) 재난 방송 메시지를 구분하여 수신하는 재난 메시지 수신부와, 자신의 위치정보를 확인하는 위치정보 생성부와, 수신된 둘 이상의 재난 메시지로부터 지역정보를 의미하는 지역정보 식별자를 추출하고, 추출된 지역정보 식별자 및 자신의 위치정보를 참조하여 출력할 재난 메시지를 선정하는 제어부 및 상기 제어부의 지시에 따라 재난 메시지를 출력하는 출력부를 포함하고, 상기 제어부는 재난 메시지를 출력하는 중에 자신의 위치정보를 모니터링하여, 자신이 위치하는 지역이 변경되면, 출력할 재난 메시지를 재 선정하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Mobile with function of nfc communication and safety aboarding service system
title_ko: 엔에프시 통신 기능을 가진 모바일 및 안전승차 서비스 시스템
abstract_en: The objective of the present invention is to provide a mobile device with an NFC communication function and a safe taxi service system enabling a user to safely use a taxi anytime anywhere. A mobile device transmits user identification information and current location information to a taxi system when get-on and get-off tagging is made. The mobile device displays taxi information received from the taxi system when get-on tagging is made and transmits a get-on notice message to a mobile device of a specific person. The taxi system sets valid multi-route to a destination by using the destination input after get-on tagging, and informs the mobile device of the specific person and/or a taxi server of an emergency situation when the taxi is out of the valid multi-route over a set time. The mobile device displays fare information received from the taxi system when a get-off tagging is made. The taxi system exchanges information with the mobile device through NFC communication, generates get-on notice information including the user identification information, a get-on time and the current location information, transmits the same to the taxi server when a get-on tagging is made, and transmits, to the taxi server, get-off information including the user identification information, the current location information, a get-off time and taxi fare information when a get-off tagging is made.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 모바일에서는 NFC 통신을 이용한 승차 태깅 및 하차 태깅시에 탑승자 식별정보와 현재위치정보를  택시 시스템에 전송하며,  승차 태깅시에  택시 시스템으로부터 수신된 차량정보를 표시하고 승차 알림 메시지를 특정인 모바일로 전송하며,  승차 태깅 후에 입력된 목적지를 이용하여  목적지까지의 유효 다중 경로를 설정하고  택시가 설정시간 이상  유효 다중 경로를 벗어난 경우에 비상상황을  특정인 모바일 및 택시 서버 중 적어도 하나에 알리며,  하차 태깅시에  택시 시스템으로부터 수신된 요금정보를 표시하고, 택시 시스템에서는  모바일과 NFC 통신으로 정보를 교환하며,  승차 태깅시에  탑승자 식별정보, 탑승시간 및  현재위치정보를 포함하는 탑승 알림 정보를 생성하여 택시 서버로 전송하고,  하차 태깅시에  탑승자 식별정보,  현재위치정보, 하차시간 및 택시요금을 포함하는 하차 알림 정보를 택시 서버로 전송한다.

title_en: Situation awareness system based on intelligent video analysis technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a situation awareness system based on an intelligent video analysis technology. The situation awareness system disclosed by the invention has the beneficial effects that: the system collects, transmits, processes and displays situation information for an abnormal disaster site, realizes target detection, abnormality identification, threat analysis, risk early warning and other functions, has an open system structure, and can access other situation awareness means and realize information interaction and sharing. The application of the system in the field of disaster prevention and mitigation can not only promote the upgrade and update of the current widely used video monitoring systems, but also can realize the information fusion processing of various means mainly depending on videos to form an overall situation of an event site, and can compensate the shortcomings of the traditional video monitoring and effectively improve the handling ability of a commander on the scene situation.
assignees: TIANJIN ZHONGKE INST OF INTELLIGENT IDENTIFICATION IND TECH CO LTD

title_en: An monitoring system using dual wire and wireless monitor device
title_ko: 유무선 듀얼 감지장치를 이용한 보안 감시 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a security monitoring system using a wired and wireless dual-sensing device. The configuration of the present invention is characterized in comprising: a dual-sensing device which includes elements for detecting heat rays and microwaves and is formed as a console or control box to be fixed and installed on a predetermined location such as houses, shopping centers, buildings, etc., wherein the dual-sensing device monitors a body and temperature information of an intruder or an unauthorized object and calls up corresponding state information; a user terminal configured to operate by executing operation applications, wherein the user terminal receives the body and the temperature information of the intruder or the unauthorized object according to the operation of the dual-sensing device, acknowledges the corresponding state information, or provides a voice conversation according to an emergency call based on an emergency situation or an emergency state; and an operation server which, as the dual-sensing device operates, receives transmission information of the dual-sensing device transmitted through a communication network according to a monitoring signal of the body and the temperature information of the intruder or the unauthorized object, and transmits an emergency situation notification to a police station and a fire station to support a quick response to the emergency situation. Accordingly, the security monitoring system can be used as a power saving sensing device installed outside a building or in a parking lot, etc. to save energy, which can reduce the price. Also, since a unified controller is provided to receive signals from the sensing device through wired and wireless communication and generate an alarm on its own, the security monitoring system can be linked with a home network device or an unmanned security terminal. Furthermore, since a wireless signal anti-collision technology and a digital processing technology are secured, more wireless signals can be processed as marketability increases.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 유무선 듀얼 감지장치를 이용한 보안 감시 시스템에 관한 것으로 그 구성은 열선 검출 및 마이크로웨이브 검출을 위한 소자로 구성되어 가정, 상가, 건물 등의 일정지역에 고정설치되도록 콘솔, 컨트롤 박스 형태로 구성되어 침입자 또는 비인가된 물체의 인체감시 및 온도정보를 감시하여 해당 상태정보를 호출하는 듀얼감지 장치; 구동 앱을 실행하여 동작되도록 구성되고, 감시신호에 따라 통신망을 통해 듀얼감시 장치의 동작에 따라 침입자 또는 비인가된 물체의 인체감시 및 온도정보를 수신하거나, 해당 상태 정보를 확인하거나, 긴급상황 또는 비상상태에 따라 긴급호출에 따른 음성통화를 제공하는 사용자 단말; 및 듀얼감시 장치의 동작에 따라 침입자 또는 비인가된 물체의 인체감시 및 온도정보의 감시신호에 따라 통신망을 통해 전송되는 듀얼감시 장치의 전송정보를 수신하여 경찰서, 소방서에 긴급상황을 전송하여 비상시 신속한 대응을 지원하는 운영서버;을 포함하여 구성되는 것을 특징으로 한다. 이에 따라, 에너지 절약을 위한 옥외나 지하 주차장 등의 저소비전류의 절전감지기로 활용하여 단가 경제성을 확보하고, 유무선을 통해 감지기의 신호를 수신하는 통합 콘트롤러를 제공하여 자체 경보를 발생시켜 홈네트워크 기기나 무인경비 단말기와 연동이 가능하여 무선신호 충돌방지, 디지털 처리기술을 확보함으로써 시장성 확대에 따라 무선신호 처리에 확장성을 제공할 수 있다.

title_en: Personalized real time outdoor guidance application for mass evacuation
abstract_en: A system including a cloud app executing on a cloud processor that detects an evacuation message, a portable device that receives a notification from the cloud app of the evacuation message, a processor of the cloud app that determines a current geographic location of the portable device and an evacuation destination for the portable device and that downloads a map to the portable device showing a route from the current location to the evacuation destination and a processor that updates the map based upon real-time events occurring along the route.

title_en: User treminal for interwoking with gateway installed in a vehicle and and method for guiding a change of traffic signal using smartphone application
title_ko: 차량 내에 설치된 게이트웨이와 연동하는 사용자 단말 및 스마트 폰 애플리케이션을 이용한 교통 신호 변경 안내 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and a method for notification of a change in a traffic signal by using a smartphone application, which notify a change in a traffic signal to a driver via a user terminal, such as a smartphone, operating in conjunction with a wired or wireless gateway by using the Wi-Fi wired or wireless gateway without installing an additional device in a vehicle in the case of a low-cost vehicle in which an AVN is not installed. The user terminal comprises: a wireless communication module which receives image information, in which a traffic signal is photographed, from a gateway installed in a vehicle via short-distance wireless communication; an image processing unit which receives the image information from the wireless communication module, detects a pattern indicating the traffic signal from the image information by using an image processing algorithm, and recognizes a change in color of the detected pattern; a control unit which determines a change in the traffic signal based on a result of the recognition of the image processing unit; and an output unit which outputs an alarm notifying the change of the traffic signal, based on a result of the determination of the control unit.
abstract_ko: 차량의 게이트웨이와 연동하는 사용자 단말이 개시된다. 이 사용자 단말은, 차량에 설치된 게이트웨이로부터 교통 신호등을 촬영한 영상 정보를 근거리 무선 통신으로 수신하는 무선 통신 모듈과, 상기 무선 통신 모듈로부터 상기 영상 정보를 전달받고, 영상 처리 알고리즘을 이용하여 상기 영상 정보로부터 상기 교통 신호등을 나타내는 패턴을 검출하고, 검출된 패턴에 대한 색 변화를 인식하는 영상 처리부와, 상기 영상 처리부의 인식 결과에 따라 교통 신호의 변경을 판단하는 제어부 및 상기 제어부의 판단 결과에 따라 상기 교통 신호의 변경을 알리는 경보를 출력하는 출력부를 포함한다.

title_en: Pro-active building protection system
abstract_en: An automated, computerized, method of pro-active building protection from weather condition damage involves: receiving a weather alert indicating a particular weather condition will be occurring within an area encompassing a perimeter about a building established by multiple sensors positioned around the building; in response to the weather alert, automatically executing a specific protocol to cause at least some actuators connected to protective devices of the building to change at least one protective device from a non-protective to a protective position; receiving a signal that is one of: a) a cancellation signal that the weather alert is no longer in effect, or b) an indication from at least some of the sensors that the particular weather condition is no longer endangers the building; and in response to receipt of the signal, automatically signaling the at least some actuators to return the at least one protective device to the non-protective position.

title_en: DWR-based message pushing method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a DWR-based message pushing method. During the software application process in the prior art, the real-time updating of the service state or an abnormal emergency often occurs. When data are generated in the above condition, updated data are usually required to be sent to a client in real time by a system for facilitating users to obtain service messages in real time and handle with various emergency situations. The invention provides a DWR-based system, wherein the message of a server is pushed to the client in the reverse direction. Therefore, the client can receive a message notification in real time. Through updating data in a database in real time, the data of messages in the database are updated and transmitted to the client, so that users can conveniently check the data.

title_en: Wearable healthcare safety belt
title_ko: 웨어러블 헬스케어 안전벨트
abstract_en: Proposed is a wearable healthcare safety belt which collects various information on subjects to be protected such as children, the old and the infirm, women, etc. who are weak and subjected to crimes to determine whether the subjects are in danger, and transmits a message wirelessly to a recipient. The proposed wearable healthcare safety belt comprises: a pulsation measuring sensor which measures a pulsation of a user; a body temperature measuring sensor which measures a body temperature of the user; a position acknowledging sensor which measures a current position of the user; a circumstance recognizing sensor which collects information used for recognizing a current circumstance of the user; a message output unit which sends a danger notification message to a recipient; and a control unit which determines whether the user is in danger based on information from the pulsation measuring sensor, the body temperature measuring sensor, and the circumstance recognizing sensor, and controls the message output unit to output the danger notification message.
abstract_ko: 어린이, 노약자, 부녀자 등과 같이 범죄 또는 건강에 취약한 보호대상에 대한 각종의 정보를 수집하여 위험 여부를 파악하고 무선으로 수신대상에게로 메시지를 전송해 줄 수 있는 웨어러블 헬스케어 안전벨트를 제시한다. 제시된 웨어러블 헬스케어 안전벨트는 사용자의 맥박을 측정하는 맥박 측정 센서, 사용자의 체온을 측정하는 체온 측정 센서, 사용자의 현재 위치를 측정하는 위치 확인 센서, 사용자의 현재 상황을 인지할 수 있는 정보를 수집하는 상황 인지 센서, 위험 알림 메시지를 수신대상에게로 보내는 메시지 출력부, 및 맥박 측정 센서와 체온 측정 센서와 위치 확인 센서 및 상황 인지 센서로부터의 정보를 근거로 사용자의 위험 여부를 판단하고 메시지 출력부를 제어하여 위험 알림 메시지를 출력하도록 하는 제어부를 포함한다.

title_en: Power transmission line forest fire dynamic prediction early warning method based on time sequence change
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power systems, and particularly relates to a dynamic prediction and early warning method for power transmission line forest fires based on time sequence change. It is characterized by that firstly, according to the initial position F of mountain fire point 0 Wind direction, wind speed and gradient information, and constructing an initial moment t 0 Calculating the maximum spreading speed V of the mountain fire at the current moment by using the mountain fire spreading elliptic model max (ii) a Calculating t 0 Time F 0 The shortest distance D from the transmission line L 0 And a propagation velocity V in that direction L0 Determining t 0 The early warning level of the power transmission mountain fire at the moment; determining the next time t 1 Fire point F 1 Speed in the direction of propagation to the transmission line; calculate from t 1 A mountain fire spreading model after delta t time from moment; repeating the steps until a series of mountain fire point positions related to the time sequence are obtained; when receiving the fire point F at any time 0 And the information of spreading and the change of the surrounding environment updates a new mountain fire spreading path diagram from the moment in time. The method can correct the forest fire spreading predicted path in time, has the characteristics of small calculated amount and clear target, and avoids the simulation of irrelevant directions.

title_en: Method and apparatus for sending uplink data in wireless communication system
abstract_en: Disclosed herein is a method of sending UL data in a wireless communication system supporting low latency service. The method is performed by an eNB, and includes receiving an urgent signal providing notification of the generation of an event related to an emergency situation from a first UE, determining a point of time at which and/or a section in which an UL grant to be transmitted to a second UE is canceled, wherein the UL grant includes resource allocation information for sending, by the second UE, UL data, cancelling the UL grant to be transmitted to the second UE based on a result of the determination, and receiving an urgent message including the detailed information related to the generated event from the first UE.

title_en: Learning type emergency detection system with multi-sensor and that method
title_ko: 학습형 다중센서 재난감지 시스템과 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a learnable emergency detection system which detects a fire, an earthquake and others, and transmits alarm messages. An emergency detecting server receives data from various types of sensors. When a signal equal to or more than a value set by an administrator of spaces and facilities is transmitted, the server transmits the alarm message. When the alarm message is transmitted, the facility administrator connects the message to an input value of the multi-sensor, evaluates the kinds and the degree of risks, inputs and saves the evaluated result, repeatedly updates conditions of the alarm message generation, a setting value and others, and controls the content of the alarm message and a transmission range according to the degree of risks.

title_en: Surveillance Robot System for abnormal behavior detection

abstract_en: The present invention relates to a robot surveillance system for detecting abnormal behaviors capable of improving the reliability of surveillance by recognizing the current location of a robot and if any abnormal signal occurs due to a dynamic obstacle or moved static obstacle at the location delivering the location information and the abnormal signal to a situation room. The system includes: an abnormal behavior surveillance module which detects any abnormal behavior of a dynamic obstacle or due to a moved static obstacle, transmits images in real time, and sends a warning if any problem; an AGV location movement control module which controls the movement of the location of an AGV; an AGV location measurement module which measures the location following the movement of the location of the AGV by the AGV location movement control module; a command execution control unit which checks a movement command from a situation management and control server and executes the movement command; and the situation management and control server which designates and inputs a route in advance, controls autonomous driving and driving route change in case of an obstacle, detects a dynamic obstacle by the abnormal behavior surveillance module, identifies a case where a static obstacle is moved on a map environment, and controls surveillance of abnormal behaviors.

title_en: A kind of vehicle collision avoidance method based on truck traffic
abstract_en: A kind of vehicle collision avoidance method based on truck traffic, comprises the following steps：1) initialize；2) self-position coordinate is calculated, and broadcasts own location information bag；3) the positional information bag of other vehicles is monitored, updates neighbours' vehicle positional information table；4) next second transport condition, and m=1 are predicted using Kalman prediction algorithms respectively；If 5) m ＞ N m , step 1) is jumped to, otherwise vehicle and vehicle m running data are judged in advance；6) safe distance of prediction level direction and vertical direction；7) distance between two vehicles of prediction horizontally and vertically；8) Optimized model is established；9) solving-optimizing model, judge whether to alarm according to solution to model, m=m+1, jump to step 5).The present invention can accurately calculate the prediction of collision time, so as to improve the probability that collision avoids, reduce collision accident incidence, the number of casualties and economic loss.

title_en: Method of preventing traffic accidents in crossroad for signal violation and overspeed, and system of the same
title_ko: 과속 및 신호위반에 의한 교차로 교통사고 방지 방법 및 그 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for preventing traffic accidents in an intersection and a system thereof. When signals change abruptly near an intersection, a vehicle approaching the intersection after a straight or left turn signal at the intersection frequently crashes into another vehicle entering the intersection after receiving a signal in another road while approaching the intersection without being able to stop at a stop line of the intersection due to the acceleration of the vehicle. To solve the problem, the intersection traffic accident prevention method and the system thereof according to the present invention are configured to sense an approaching vehicle, which travels at a speed equal to or greater than a predetermined speed while ignoring signals, or a vehicle, which enters the intersection in a straight path or after taking a left turn, through an image camera and sense the warning light and siren of an emergency vehicle through the image camera and a sound sensor in order to operate the warning lights or secondary traffic lights arranged on the traffic lights in each road and output warning text through electrical signs. The present invention can prevent a collision accident between a vehicle, which approaches the intersection while ignoring signals in the intersection and a vehicle entering the intersection in advance.
abstract_ko:
[기술분야/해결과제]   
본 발명은 교차로 교통사고 방지 방법 및 그 시스템에 관한 것으로, 교차로에서 직진 또는 좌회전 신호를 받고 교차로를 향하여 달려가고 있는 차량이 교차로 부근에서 갑자기 신호가 변경된 경우 차량의 가속도 때문에 교차로의 정지선에 정지하지 못하고 그대로 교차로를 통과하다가 다른 차도에서 신호를 받고 교차로로 진입하는 차량과의 추돌 사고가 빈번히 일어나는 문제점이 있었다. 
 [해결수단]   
본 발명의 교차로 교통사고 방지 방법 및 그 시스템은, 교차로에서 신호를 위반하고 소정의 속도 이상으로 달려오는 차량이나 교차로로 진입하는 직진 및 좌회전 차량을 영상카메라를 통해 감지하고, 영상카메라와 소리감지센서를 통해 긴급자동차의 경광등과 싸이렌을 감지하여, 각 차도의 신호등에 배치된 경광등 또는 보조신호등을 작동시키고 전광판을 통해 주의 문자를 출력하도록 구성하였다. 
 [기대효과]   
본 발명에 따르면, 교차로에서 신호를 무시하고 교차로로 달려오는 차량과 교차로로 진입하는 차량 간의 충돌사고를 미연에 예방할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Apparatus and method for handling emergency situation of wheel chair a passenger
title_ko: 휠체어 탑승자의 위급 상황 처리 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention provides an apparatus and a method for handling an emergency situation of a passenger of a wheel chair. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the apparatus for handling an emergency situation is allowed to be carried by a passenger boarding a wheel chair or is able to be mounted on the wheel chair. The apparatus for handling an emergency situation comprises a data obtaining module, a data processing module, an emergency situation recognition module and an emergency situation responding module. The data obtaining module obtains a data packet from a wheel chair apparatus including a wheel chair. The data processing module classifies the data packet into a bio signal measurement packet, a situation measurement packet and a bio signal analysis packet, corrects data values of the bio signal measurement packet and the situation measurement packet to generate a bio signal measurement valid packet and a situation measurement valid packet. The emergency situation recognition module receives the bio signal measurement valid packet, the situation measurement valid packet and the bio signal analysis packet from the data processing module and determines whether the passenger boarding the wheel chair is in an emergency situation based on the bio signal measurement valid packet, the situation measurement valid packet and the bio signal analysis packet to generate emergency situation determination information. The emergency situation responding module performs an alarm process in accordance with a degree of an emergency situation depending on the emergency situation determination information.

title_en: Emergency system using set-top box and control method thereof

abstract_en: The present invention relates to an emergency system using a set-top box. When an ON signal is received, a set-top box outputs images for channels, which are transmitted from a broadcasting station, to a display and is driven in a watching mode. When the ON signal is not received, the set-top box is driven in a standby mode. When the set-top is not switched from the standby mode to the watching mode for a preset time period, the set-top box transmits an acknowledgement request signal to a subscriber terminal whereas the set-top transmits an emergency signal when an acknowledgement signal is not received from the subscriber terminal. Also, when a manipulation signal is not applied to the set-top box for a preset time period in the watching mode, the set-top box transmits the acknowledgement request signal to the subscriber terminal, and transmits the emergency signal when the acknowledgement signal is not received from the subscriber terminal. According to the present invention, user safety is improved by detecting all of various types of emergency situations.

title_en: System and method for implementing personal emergency response system based on UWB interferometer
abstract_en: A non-wearable Personal Emergency Response System (PERS) architecture is provided, having a synthetic aperture antenna based RF interferometer followed by two-stage human state classifier and abnormal states pattern recognition. In addition, it contains a communication sub-system to communicate with the remote operator and centralized system for multiple users' data analysis. The system is trained to learn the person's body features as well as the home environment. The decision process is carried out based on the instantaneous human state (Local Decision) followed by abnormal states patterns recognition (Global decision). The system global decision (emergency alert) is communicated to the operator through the communication system and two-ways communication is enabled between the monitored person and the remote operator. In some embodiments, a centralized system (cloud) receives data from distributed PERS systems to perform further analysis and upgrading the systems with updated database (codebooks).

abstract_en: A remote monitoring system for a landslide and a debris flow of the present invention includes: a data logger which is installed in soil, and receives self-supporting power to measure rainfall and pore water pressure of the ground and transmit data; and a remote server which receives data regarding the measured rainfall and the pore water pressure of the ground to calculate a first pore water pressure increase rate by using precipitation duration time, rainfall intensity, and soil moisture percentage, and estimates a second pore water pressure increase rate after a predetermined time by using the calculated first pore water pressure increase rate to transmit a warning. The present invention can, in a mountainous area in which power is not constantly supplied, provide against a disaster by monitoring a possibility of a landslide or a debris flow occurring during sudden rainfall and heavy rainfall by using the relationship among rainfall, pore water pressure, and effective stress.

abstract_en: The present invention relates to a surge protecting device and a method thereof. The surge protecting device according to an embodiment of the present invention can previously prevent a risk of a fire and a frequent breaker trip. The present invention can reduce costs by not installing a short circuit fuse or a thermal fuse in the surge protecting device additionally.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 서지 보호 장치 및 그 방법에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세하게는 서지 보호기의 열폭주를 예방하기 위한 단락 과전류 퓨즈나 열 폭주 방지회로를 추가로 설치할 필요가 없고, 사용 환경적 요인에 의한 서지의 강도에 따라 절연 파괴나 성능 저하로 교체 비용의 상승과 화재의 위험을 미리 예방할 수 있으며, 전력선 통신 등을 통해 기본 통신 정보에 포함되는 일반 통신 정보과 조건 통신 정보를 특정인에게 전송하고, 일정 시간 간격을 두고 일정치 이상의 통신 정보를 특정인에게 전송한 경우 상기 통신 정보를 중지하는 등의 다양한 기능을 포함하고, 맵 응용 API를 활용한 GUI를 통하여 각 정보에 대한 용이한 접근이 가능한 서지 보호 장치 및 그 방법에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명은 과를 개폐함과 함께 과부하, 단락 등의 이상 상태에 대해 를 차단하는 트립구동부를 포함하는 배선 차단기; 배선 차단기와 병렬로 연결되어 전기 계통에 흐르는 서지를 차단하는 서지 보호기; 서지 보호기의 접지선을 주회하여 형성되는 서지 보호기 차단용 감지 회로부; 서지 보호기 차단용 감지 회로부의 신호를 전달받아 디지털 서지 신호로 변환하는 신호변환부; 상기 디지털 서지 신호를 전달받아 기준치 이상의 디지털 서지 신호인 경우에만 상기 배선 차단기와 연동되어 서지 보호기를 차단하기 위해 상기 트립구동부를 트립시키도록 제어하는 마이크로 프로세서로 구성되되, 상기 마이크로 프로세서는, 전원선에 공급되는 전원의 정전, 누전 및 서지 횟수를 각 측정회로에서 감지하여 합한 값을 비휘발성 메모리에 저장한 후 표시장치에 디스플레이하는 측정값디스플레이모듈; 서지전류 측정회로에서 측정한 서지전류와, 영상변류기를 통한 누설전류 및 변류기를 통한 사용전류와, RTC에서 전송 받은 날짜와 시간 정보를 실시간 확인할 수 있도록 비휘발성 메모리에 저장한 후 표시장치에 디스플레이하는 실시간디스플레이모듈; 조건 통신 정보, 일반 통신 정보를 전송하고 일정 횟수 이상 통신 정보를 전송한 경우 통신 정보 전송을 중지하도록 제어 스위치를 작동시키는 통신 정지 모듈; 전송 조건을 변경하면 조건에 따른 통신 정보를 전송하는 조건 변경 통신 모듈; 현재 전원의 정전, 누전 및 서지 횟수 통신 정보 설정이 미리 되고, 전송 조건이 변경 안되는 경우 미리 정하여진 일반 통신 정보를 전송하는 일반 통신 모듈; 기존 전원선에 공급되는 전원의 정전, 누전 및 서지 횟수를 전달한 각 통신 정보를 현재 상태와 동일 상황인지 확인하여, 동일하면 미리 저장된 통신 정보 설정 조건에 따른 통신 정보를 전송하는 동일 상황 비교 모듈; 이기종간에도 일반 또는 조건 통신 정보 전송이 가능하도록 하는 이기종통신모듈; 일반 통신 정보 또는 조건 변경이 되어 새로운 조건에 따른 통신 정보의 인터럽트 알림(interruptive notification)을 사용하기 위해, 인터럽트 메시징(interruptive messaging) 모듈;을 포함한다.

title_en: A kind of weighting markov landslide method for early warning based on mean-standard deviation
abstract_en: A kind of weighting markov landslide method for early warning based on average value standard deviation, belongs to landslide disaster forecasting and warning field；This method includes：Landslide monitoring point velocity of displacement is collected, forms velocity of displacement set；Each affiliated state of velocity of displacement in velocity of displacement set is determined using average value standard deviation method, and build velocity of displacement status switch；Use weighted Markov chain predictive displacement speed next day predicted state；Landslide early warning is carried out to judge；Update velocity of displacement set；Landslide early warning result is evaluated；The stochastic behaviour of displacement parameter that the present invention is obtained from the evolution process of landslide, based on Markov chain theory, integrated use Landslide Evolution three-stage theory and average value standard deviation classification have surmounted understanding of the previous engineering circles to early warning of coming down；Specific prealarming process is given, available for the landslide early warning from displacement monitoring data Angle.

title_en: Post-verification support system, medical institution server, fire fighting server, post-verification support method, and program
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To achieve high efficiency of post-verification of rescue work.SOLUTION: Transported person information on a transported peron who was transported emergently is stored in a fire fighting database (DB) 10. A fire fighting server 20 notifies a medical institution server 40 of transported person information designated as a case to be post-verified. The medical institution server stores the transported person information stored in the fire fighting DB in a medical institution DB 30, receives a notification indicating the transported person information designated as a case to be post-verified, and sets a fact of being the case to be post-verified to corresponding transported person information in the medical institution DB. Regarding the transported person information to which the fact of being the case to be post-verified is set, a medical institution terminal 50 accepts input of verification information and transmits the input verification information to the medical institution server. The medical institution server stores in the medical institution DB the verification information received from the medical institution terminal. The fire fighting server updates the transported person information in the fire fighting DB on the basis of the verification information stored in the medical institution DB.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Building rescue information system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a building rescue information system, comprising: the wireless receiving and transmitting devices are arranged in escape tunnels or escape exits of each floor of the building and comprise receiving and judging units connected with the signal transmitting units and information transmitting units in signal connection with the receiving and judging units; after the receiving and judging unit receives the distance signal sent by the signal transmitting unit, at least judging the number of people trapped on each floor and the search and rescue information of the position where the people are located, converting the search and rescue information into a notification signal and transmitting the notification signal to the information transmitting unit; after the information transmitting unit receives the notification signal, the search and rescue information is uploaded to the building search and rescue information cloud server and is continuously updated. Before the rescue workers leave or arrive at the disaster site of the building (such as fire and earthquake), the correct number and position of the trapped persons in each floor can be immediately mastered to serve as important reference basis for rescue priority.

title_en: Methods and systems for managing alert messages
abstract_en: A method and a system for managing Cell Broadcast (CB) alert messages are provided. The method sends a CB alert message to a plurality of communication devices in an alert area through a wireless communication channel. The CB alert message is sent by a CB alert system. Further, each of the plurality of the communication devices includes a CB message handling application for handling such CB alert messages. The method further receives one or more acknowledgement messages from one or more communication devices. The one or more acknowledgement messages are received in response to receipt of the CB alert message at the plurality of communication devices. The one or more acknowledgement messages are received from the CB message handling application in respective communication devices.

The utility model discloses can be when the disaster takes place timely early warning and provide for handicapped people and can take the initiative and remove near the manned device of withdrawing that need withdraw the people, great reduction the casualties that causes during the calamity emergence.

title_en: Method and apparatus for notifying si update, eab update and pws message in wireless communication system
title_ko: 무선 통신 시스템에서 si 업데이트, eab 업데이트 및 pws 메시지를 통지하기 위한 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: A method and apparatus for receiving system information (SI) in a wireless communication system is provided. A user equipment (UE), which may be in an enhanced coverage or operate with a narrower bandwidth than a cell bandwidth, receives an indication of at least one of SI update, earthquake and tsunami warning system (ETWS) notification, commercial mobile alert system (CMAS) or extended access barring (EAB) modification via a physical downlink control channel (PDCCH) from a network, and receives system information according to the received indication from the network.
abstract_ko: 무선 통신 시스템에서 시스템 정보(SI; system information)를 수신하는 방법 및 장치가 제공된다. 향상된 커버리지 내에 있거나 셀 대역폭보다 좁은 대역폭에서 동작하는 단말(UE; userequipment)은, SI 업데이트, 지진 및 쓰나미 경보 시스템(ETWS; earthquake and tsunami warning system) 통지, 상용 모바일 경보 시스템(CMAS; commercial mobile alert system) 통지 또는 확장된 접속 차단(EAB; extended access barring) 수정 중 적어도 하나에 대한 지시를 PDCCH(physical downlink control channel)를 통해 네트워크로부터 수신하며, 네트워크로부터 수신된 지시에 따라 시스템 정보를 수신한다.

title_en: Stage setting apparatus of motor control method
title_ko: 모터구동방식 무대장치의 부하변동 모니터링 및 비교 분석 장치 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus and method for monitoring, comparing, and analyzing a change in load of a motor drive-type stage setting, which apply an algorithm, adapted to constantly monitor, compare and analyze the amount of load applied to a motor, to a motor drive-type stage setting, and thus the apparatus and method for monitoring, comparing, and analyzing change in load of motor drive-type stage setting can induce a user to check and maintain the stage setting in advance, thereby preventing inconvenience and cancelation of performance from being caused by a sudden mechanical failure, protecting people from a safety accident and the like, and contributing to success of performance. For this purpose, the method for monitoring, comparing, and analyzing a change in load of a motor drive-type stage setting according to the present invention comprises the steps of: determining whether an instruction for moving a batten is present; when the instruction for moving the batten is present, checking a moving direction, and performing a location moving instruction and residual distance calculation; determining whether a location of the moved batten corresponds to a limit location; stopping when the location of the moved batten corresponds to the limit location; and determining again whether the instruction for moving the batten is present. The method for monitoring, comparing, and analyzing a change in load of a motor drive-type stage setting monitors a load factor from a start of lifting or lowering of a batten, calculates and backs up an average value or maximum value of the load factor, provides a warning to a stage director or stage setting administrator in advance when a load factor higher than a preset load factor is detected, induces the stage director or stage setting administrator to perform regular check when the warning is a minor warning, induces the stage director or stage setting administrator to perform emergency checking when the warning is a strong warning, and executes a forced stop when the warning is an urgent warning.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 모터구동방식 무대장치에 있어서 항상 모터의 부하량을 모니터링 및 비교 분석하는 알고리즘을 적용하여 사전에 무대장치를 점검 및 정비를 유도함으로써 갑작스런 기계 고장으로 인한 불편과 공연의 취소, 안전사고 등으로부터 인명을 보호하고 성공적인 공연에도 기여할 수 있도록 한 모터구동방식 무대장치의 부하변동 모니터링 및 비교 분석 장치 및 그 방법에 관한 것이다. 
이를 위해 본 발명은  배튼의 이동지령 여부를 판단하여 배튼의 이동 지령이 있는 경우 이동방향 확인, 위치이동 지령 및 잔여 거리 연산을 실행한 후 이동한 배튼 위치가 규정위치인가 여부를 판단하여 규정위치이면 일단 정지한 후 배튼의 이동지령 여부를 재차 판단하는 단계를 포함하는 모터구동방식 무대장치의 관리방법에 있어서, 배튼이 상승 또는 하강을 시작할 때부터 부하율을 모니터링하고 평균값 또는 최대값을 연산 및 백업하여 미리 설정된 부하율 보다 높은 값이 측정될 경우 무대 감독이나 무대장치 관리자에게 이 사실을 사전에 경고하여 경경고일 경우 정기점검의 유도를, 중경고일 경우는 긴급 점검의 유도를, 중대경고일 경우에는 강제정지를 실행하도록 이루어진 것이다.

title_en: Disaster prevention information notification system and program
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To enable prompt provision of a disaster information notification service at low cost, to a telephone terminal of a general and wide use having no special function.SOLUTION: A disaster prevention information notification system includes: notification destination information storage means for stores a plurality of notification destination information sets; notification destination search means for searching, by referring to the notification destination storage means, for a notification destination of searching located in a designation area; call control means for establishing a call with a notification destination telephone terminal of a successful search; voice disaster prevention information notification means for reproducing a voice guidance which includes an inquiry of an acknowledgment to disaster prevention information and disaster measures, to transmit to the telephone terminal having the call established by the call control means; and response result recording means for recording a response result which includes an incoming response result of each telephone terminal and the obtained acknowledgement result to the disaster measures.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: A kind of emergency lighting controller able circuit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of emergency lighting controller able circuit.Including main control CPU and the fire-fighting link telecommunication circuit of main control CPU control, display screen telecommunication circuit, terminal communication circuit, power-switching circuit, information storage circuit, active node testing circuit, external drive circuit；Power-switching circuit is divided into first order Power convert, second level Power convert, third level Power convert；Active node testing circuit is used for detecting external active signal；Externally drive circuit is used for driving external equipment.The present invention is by " guiding " principle to be converted into " safety guides " principle nearby original emergency evacuation display lamp worked alone.When a fire, emergency lighting controller able circuit and fire alarm warning system carry out coordinated signals, according to on-the-spot fire information intelligentized control emergency evacuation light fixture, adjust its channeling direction, dynamically guide personal security, withdraw deathtrap accurately and rapidly.

title_en: Accident information offering system using mobile with transponder, and the operating method thereof
title_ko: 모바일과 트랜스폰더를 이용한 재난 정보 제공 시스템 및 그 구동 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a disaster information providing system and an operating method thereof. The present invention relates to a disaster information providing system using a mobile and a transponder, and an operating method thereof. The mobile not only provides disaster information but also receives disaster information transmitted from an adjacent mobile or transponder. The transponder broadcasts information included in the disaster information in an RF communication region valid for a providing time and region, provides disaster information inputted through an input device and disaster information sensed by an external sensors to the RF communication region.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 재난 정보 제공 시스템 및 그 구동 방법에 관한 것으로서, 모바일이 재난 정보를 제공할 뿐만 아니라 인접한 모바일이나 트랜스폰더로부터 전송되는 재난 정보를 제공받을 수 있으며, 트랜스폰더는 재난 정보에 포함된 정보를 제공하는 시간과 제공 영역에 대해 유효한 RF 통신 영역에서 브로드캐스팅하고, 입력 장치를 통해 입력되는 재난 정보 및 외부의 센서들로써 감지되는 재난 정보를 RF 통신 영역에 제공하는 모바일과 트랜스폰더를 이용한 재난 정보 제공 시스템 및 그 구동 방법을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Mobile terminal emergency alarm method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a mobile terminal emergency alarm method and device. In one aspect, there is provided a mobile terminal emergency alert method, including: setting triggering alarm conditions; storing personal information of a user, and acquiring fingerprint information of the user according to the triggering alarm condition; inputting a fingerprint; identifying fingerprint information; judging whether the trigger signal is consistent with the stored user fingerprint information; and if the trigger signal is consistent with the stored user fingerprint information, sending an alarm signal, wherein the alarm signal contains the personal information of the user. According to the invention, the fingerprint information is set according to the needs of the user, the updated real-time geographical position information is obtained, the site is really recorded, and the problem that the information of the alarm person cannot be effectively identified is solved.

title_en: The system informs the driver signal change
title_ko: 신호등 신호 감지에 의한 신호변경 운전자 알림 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for informing a driver about signal change by sensing of a traffic light signal. The preset invention comprises: a mount unit (110) attached with a front glass of a vehicle; a signal aspect sensor having a sensing angle; a speaker; an alarm lamp which turns off a lamp when the signal is changed; and a transceiver which receives a signal of the outside. The present invention has an effect of informing the driver of the remaining time of the signal to a display unit (240) so that the user can previously prepare for the signal.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 신호등 신호 감지에 의한 신호변경 운전자 알림 시스템은, 차량의 대쉬보드 상단 또는 차량의 전면유리에 부착되는 마운트부(110); 상기 마운트부(110)의 상면에 고정되고, 차량의 주행방향 상단을 지향하는 감지각을 가지는 신호현시 감지센서(100); 상기 신호현시 감지센서(100)와 연결되어, 신호 변경시 알람을 송출하는 스피커(210, 미도시); 상기 신호현시 감지센서(100)와 연결되며, 차량의 핸들 내부에 장착되어 신호 변경시 진동을 발생하는 진동 발생기(220, 미도시); 상기 신호현시 감지센서(100)와 연결되어, 신호 변경시 램프를 점등하는 알림 램프(230, 미도시); 상기 신호현시 감지센서(100)와 연결되어 외부의 신호를 수신하는 송수신기(300); 상기 스피커(210, 미도시), 진동 발생기(220, 미도시), 알림 램프(230, 미도시)는 알림부(200)로 통칭할 수 있으며, 상기 알림부(200) 및 송수신기(300)와 연결되어 제어명령을 수행하는 제어부(400); 를 포함하여 구성되며, 또한 신호등에 장착되고 신호등 제어판(500)과 연결되어 신호등의 신호변경 시간을 신호등 전방의 차량에 송출하는 신호 송출기(510); 를 더 포함하고, 상기 송출기(510)에서 송출하는 신호변경 시간 데이터를 상기 송수신기(300)에서 제어부(400)로 전송하여 현재 신호의 남은 시간을 파악할 수 있도록 사용자에게 시각적으로 표출하는 디스플레이(240)를 더 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하며, 신호등의 신호변경을 감지하는 신호현시 감지센서(100)를 장착하고, 신호등의 신호 변경을 운전자에게 진동, 알람, 플리커링으로 알려 주지시킴으로써 신호대기 동안의 운전자의 행동에 제약을 없애고 신호변경에 대비할 수 있게 하는 효과를 부여하며, 상기와 같이 신호등의 신호변경 시간을 신호등 전방의 차량에 송출하는 신호 송출기(510)에 의하여, 신호등에 근접한 차량의 신호변경 운전자 알림 시스템의 송수신기(300)에서 이를 감지하여 운전자에게 신호의 남은 시간을 디스플레이(240)로 알려 줌으로써 신호에 미리 대비할 수 있도록 하는 효과를 가진다.

title_en: Gust front automatic recognition method based on Doppler weather radar data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a gust front automatic recognition method based on Doppler weather radar data, and the method comprises the following steps: 1), extracting a weak narrow band echo suspected area according to the radar performance characteristics of gust front through employing a local binaryzation algorithm; 2), carrying out the segmentation, connection and screening of the weak narrow band echo suspected area, and obtaining a skeleton image corresponding to a weak ridge-shaped belt; 3), obtaining an optical flow field through two low-pitching-angle radar images at a current moment and a former moment, supposing the matched skeletons at the former and latter moments in the skeleton images corresponding to the weak ridge-shaped belt obtained at step 2) as the suspected gust front, and recognizing the gust front according to the relation between the position and speed of the suspected gust front and the position and speed of a windstorm cell and the relation between the direction and speed of the suspected gust front. The method achieves the automatic detection of the gust front, achieves the timely early warning of disasters, and reduces the economic loss and casualty. Moreover, the validity of the method is verified.

title_en: Reception of emergency messages in mobile devices
abstract_en: Methods for receiving emergency messages on a mobile communication device having a first subscription and a second subscription sharing a radio frequency (RF) resource may include prioritizing, by a processor of the mobile communication device, the first subscription for a predetermined time period in order to receive an emergency message, determining, by the processor, whether the first subscription should be de-prioritized before the predetermined time period expires based on a reception history of the first subscription during the predetermined time period, and tuning the RF resource to the second subscription before the predetermined time period expires in response to determining that the first subscription should be de-prioritized before the predetermined time period expires.

title_en: Method and device for stopping scptm transmission
title_ko: Scptm 전송을 중단하는 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: Provided is a method for a base station performing a multimedia broadcast multicast service (MBMS) session update in a wireless communication system, and a device supporting same. The base station may comprise: receiving, from a multi-cell coordination entity (MCE), a MBMS session update request message comprising a single-cell point-to-multipoint (SCPTM) transmission stop indication; and transmitting, to the MCE, a MBMS session update response message as a response to the MBMS session update request message.
abstract_ko: 무선 통신 시스템에서 기지국이 MBMS 세션 업데이트(Multimedia Broadcast Multicast Service Session Update)를 수행하는 방법 및 이를 지원하는 장치가 제공된다. 상기 기지국은 SCPTM 전송 중단 지시(Single Cell Point to Multipoint Transmission Stop Indication)를 포함하는 MBMS 세션 업데이트 요청 메시지(MBMS Session Update Request Message)를 MCE(Multi-cell Coordination Entity)로부터 수신하고, 상기 MBMS 세션 업데이트 요청 메시지에 대한 응답으로 MBMS 세션 업데이트 응답 메시지(MBMS Session Update Response Message)를 상기 MCE로 전송하는 것을 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Automatic Extinguishing System for Kitchen Fire cause by Electrics and Gas
title_ko: 전기 또는 가스로 인한 주방 화재의 자동 소화 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an automatic extinguishing system for a kitchen fire caused by electricity or gas. The system comprises a sensor device, a control device, an extinguishing device, a ventilating device, and a key operating device. Accordingly, by detecting and analyzing smoke, gas, flame, and temperature around a heating tool in a kitchen, fire preparation, fire notification, and protection execution are sequentially performed to automatically operate the extinguishing device after detecting a fire suspicious situation or a fire occurring situation early, so that a fire can be extinguished in an initial state.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 전기 또는 가스로 인한전기 또는 가스로 인한 소화 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 음식 조리용 가열 기구가 사용되는 실내 일측에 설치되고, 상기 가열 기구 주변의 온도, 불꽃, 가스, 연기 중 적어도 하나 이상을 감지하는 센서 장치; 상기 센서 장치로부터 감지된 센서 데이터를 수집하고, 상기 수집된 센서 데이터를 분석하여 화재 레벨을 설정하며, 상기 설정된 화재 레벨에 따라 화재 제어 신호 또는 환풍 제어 신호를 발생하는 제어 장치; 상기 가열 기구의 상부 측에 설치되고, 상기 화재 제어 신호에 따라 소화약재를 분사 노즐을 통해 방출하는 소화 장치; 상기 가열 기구의 상부 측에 설치되고, 상기 환풍 제어 신호에 따라 실내 공기를 실외로 강제 배출시키는 환풍 장치; 및 상기 소화 장치 또는 환풍 장치의 구동시 자동 모드 및 수동 모드에 대한 모드를 결정하며, 상기 가열 기구 또는 화재와 관련한 사용자 조작 정보를 입력하는 키조작 장치를 포함한다. 따라서, 본 발명은 주방의 가열 기구 주변에서 발생하는 연기, 가스, 불꽃, 온도를 감지 및 분석함으로써 화재 의심 상황이나 화재 발생 상황을 조기에 발견한 후 화재 예비, 화재 경보, 방호 실행을 단계적으로 수행하여 자동으로 소화 장치가 작동되어 화재를 초기에 소화할 수 있으며, 음식물 가열시 발생하는 연기나 가스와 혼동하여 소화 장치가 오작동되는 것을 방지하면서 침착한 화재 대응을 수행할 있고, 온도 감지 데이터를 분석하여 화재 발화 지점에 대한 예측이 가능하고, 이 화재 발화 지점을 기준으로 분사 노즐의 분사 각도를 자동으로 조정하여 유효 방호 면적에 소화약제가 정확히 방출될 수 있도록 수 한다.

title_en: automotive notification information device
title_ko: 자동차 알림 정보판
abstract_ko: 본 고안은 자동차 부착용 안전용품으로, 자동차의 고장이나 사고시 자동차의 트렁크를 열어 방향표시를 위한 도형 및 문자 등을 다양하게 표출하여 비상상황을 후방 차량의 운전자에게 신속 정확하게 알려줌과 동시에 방향표시에 의해 후방 차량이 변경해서 주행해야 하는 차선을 지시하여 차량의 운전자가 보다 안전하고 신속하게 비상 상황에 대처할 수 있도록 한 자동차 알림 정보판을 제공한다.

title_en: A kind of landslide alarm system
abstract_en: This utility model is related to a kind of landslide alarm system, including ultrasonic monitor device, infrared monitoring device, PLC and sound and light alarm instrument, the ultrasonic distance determines device includes some ultrasonic range finders, and the monitoring feedback mechanism corresponding with ultrasonic range finder, the infrared monitoring device includes base plate, side plate, top board, baffle ring, elastic threads and active infrared alarm, ultrasonic range finder, wireless data receiver, sound and light alarm instrument is connected with PLC, can be existing to landslide as making early warning in time, prompting personnel withdrawn in time, ensure that the safety of people's lives and properties.

title_en: Multimedia Alert and Response System for Urgent and Local Requests
abstract_en: A Multimedia Alert and Response System for Urgent and Local Requests have been disclosed. In one version when an urgent request is received urgent rules are applied, a reverse call center is applied, and a service provider is connected telephonically with a live service provider person.

title_en: A method and apparatus for transmittng an warning message by using v2x services in a wireless access system
abstract_en: The present invention provides methods and apparatus for transmitting and receiving warning messages by using Vehicle to Everything (V2X) services. One of embodiments of the present invention is performed by a vehicle user equipment (VUE) and comprising steps of receiving a first Message transmission Guideline Package (MGP) message including geographical coordination information related with an MGP area and a value tag indicating time information for updating the MGP message; checking the value tag is changed or not; and transmitting a first warning message based on the first MGP message when the value tag is not expired; or transmitting a second warning message based on a second MGP message when the value tag is expired, wherein at least a transmission frequency or a transmission power for the second warning message are determined base on the second MGP message, and wherein the MGP area represents where MGP profiles are the same.

title_en: System for monitoring flooding of road and its method
title_ko: 도로침수 모니터링 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and method for monitoring flooding on a road. Provided is the system for monitoring flooding on a road, the system comprising: a water level meter which is disposed in a predetermined position inside a manhole and which measures a water level of rainfall or sewage flowing through a sewer; a rainfall meter which is installed at a predetermined location around the manhole and which measures the amount of rainfall at the location; a flooding prediction and warning server which calculates a speed of a rise in the water level in the sewer by using water level data transmitted by the water level meter, which predicts a rise in a water level inside the manhole by using an SWMM model when rainfall occurring at the location is determined to continue by using rainfall data transmitted by the rainfall meter, and which generates flooding prediction data when a back flow to the manhole is predicted; an image acquisition means which is installed at a predetermined location on a road, which performs photographing for a traffic safety or crime prevention purpose under the control of a CCTV management server in an ordinary situation, and which photographs a water depth indicator installed on a facility of the road when a predetermined control right has been changed; and a monitoring server which receives image data acquired by the image acquisition means and which performs image detection and analysis regarding the water depth indicator. Furthermore, also provided is the method for monitoring flooding on a road. According to the present invention, provided is an advantage of provision of the system and method for monitoring flooding on a road, which can minimize installation of unnecessary CCTVs for the sole purpose of monitoring of the flooding on a road and which can improve accuracy.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 도로침수 모니터링 시스템 및 그 방법에 관한 것이다. 개시된 도로침수 모니터링 시스템 및 그 방법은, 맨홀 내 소정 위치에 설치되고, 관거 내를 흐르는 우수 또는 하수의 수위를 측정하는 수위계, 상기 맨홀 근처의 소정 지점에 설치되고, 상기 지점의 강우량을 측정하는 강우량계, 상기 수위계로부터 전송되는 수위데이터를 이용하여 상기 관거의 수위 상승 속도를 계산하고, 상기 강우량계로부터 전송되는 강우 데이터를 이용하여 상기 지점에 강우가 지속되는 것으로 판단되면, SWMM 모형을 이용하여 상기 맨홀 내 수위 상승을 예측하고 상기 맨홀로 역류가 예측되면 침수예보 데이터를 생성하는 침수예경보서버, 도로의 소정 위치에 설치되고, 평상시에는 CCTV관리서버의 관리에 따라 평상시에는 도로교통안전용 내지 방범용으로 촬영을 수행하다가, 소정의 제어권 변경시 도로의 시설물에 설치된 수심 표지물을 촬영하는 영상획득수단 및 상기 영상획득수단으로부터 촬영된 영상데이터를 전달받아 수심표지물에 대한 영상 감지 및 분석을 수행하는 모니터링서버를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 도로 침수 모니터링 시스템 및 그 방법을 제공한다. 본 발명에 의하면, 도로 침수 모니터링을 위한 불필요한 CCTV의 설치를 최소화하고 정확도를 향상할 수 있는 도로침수 모니터링 시스템 및 그 방법을 제공할 수 있다는 이점이 있다.

title_en: Automated detection of an emergency by a user device
abstract_en: A user device may determine that an environmental parameter, sensed by the user device, satisfies a condition, and may detect an emergency based on detecting that the environmental parameter satisfies the condition. The user device may output, via the user device, an alarm notification, and may determine whether an input is received by the user device to cancel the alarm notification. The user device may notify an emergency device when the user device determines that input is not received by the user device to cancel the alarm notification.

title_en: Method for presence detection
abstract_en: A method for verifying the presence of users running a status check application on their wireless transceiver units is provided. The method comprises a presence check comprising setting up a group list of wireless transceiver units specific to the status check application. Each wireless transceiver unit having a group list ID. The method further comprises broadcasting an application specific presence check signal including a command message, from the initiating wireless transceiver unit and receiving the broadcast presence check signal including the command message, at the additional wireless transceiver unit. The method further comprises listening for a broadcast presence check acknowledgement, in the initiating wireless transceiver unit using the local network transceiver, and upon receipt of a presence check acknowledgement, including the group list ID from the additional wireless transceiver unit, updating the group list by marking the additional wireless transceiver unit as present.

title_en: Aircraft flight itinerary alerting system
abstract_en: A flight itinerary alerting system for monitoring a flight itinerary includes a monitoring system storing flight itinerary data like pilot contact data, first tier contact data, and second tier contact data. An alert routine executable on the monitoring system i) determines first or second tier alert conditions if no deactivation message is received upon expiry of a respective first or second duration following the expected arrival time, and ii) send an alert message through a communication network to a computer device of a corresponding first or second tier contact person upon determination of the respective alert condition. The multiple tiers of contact data with respective alerting criteria allows quick determination if search and rescue should be contacted with inherent redundancy, thus preventing overdue aircraft from being overlooked, while also minimizing false alarms in reporting overdue aircraft to search and rescue which might reasonably be accounted for by responsible persons.

title_en: Apparatus and method for preventing disaster caused by short-circuit in electric power systems
title_ko: 전력계통에서의 단락 발생시 재해 방지장치 및 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are an apparatus and a method to prevent a disaster when a short circuit occurs in a power system, using fail power short-circuited when a short circuit occurs on a load side of a power distribution line installed in a power system to decrease a short circuit current of a supply power side and decrease an output voltage of the load side, so as to prevent an electric accident due to the short circuit current. According to the present invention, the apparatus comprises: a warning generator to interlink with the power system (power distribution line) for supplying power to a single or three-phase, and to warn occurrence of a short circuit; a warning release signal input unit to release a warning; and a short circuit correction device. The short circuit correction device comprises: a short circuit power converter to generate a short circuit signal simultaneously with the occurrence of the short circuit when the short circuit occurs, to prevent a casualty accident due to an electric shock, reduce the output value of the load side while changing an electric connection position of a coil connected to a power input terminal, distribute the voltage inputted to the power input terminal to the coil of which the position is changed to reduce the short circuit current when earth fault occurs due to a short circuit as a ground potential difference of the short-circuited power is reduced more than a potential difference of the power, and to allow a harmonic wave to flow once in normal and inverse phases which are converted by 180 angular degrees when the harmonic wave is generated on the load side; a switch to transfer the short circuit signal; and a switch to output power cut-off and warning signals in accordance with an electric signal outputted from the switch.
abstract_ko: 전력계통에 구비된 배전선로의 부하측에서 단락시에 단락된 고장전력을 이용하여 공급전원측 단락전류를 감소시키고, 부하측 출력전압을 감소시켜, 단락전류로 인한 전기사고를 방지할 수 있도록 한 전력계통에서의 단락(합선)시 재해 방지장치 및 방법이 개시된다. 개시된 전력계통에서의 단락(합선)시 재해 방지장치는, 단상 또는 3상을 통해 전력을 공급해주는 전력계통(배전선로)과 연계하고, 단락(합선) 발생을 경보하는 경보 발생기와; 경보해제를 위한 경보해제 신호 입력부와; 단락보정장치를 포함하며 상기 단락보정장치는, 상기 단락이 발생하면 단락 발생과 동시에 단락전기신호를 발생하고, 단락 된 전력의 대지 전위차를 전원의 전위차보다 감소하여 단락으로 인한 지락(누전)이 발생하면 감전에 의한 인명사고를 예방하며, 전원입력단자에 연결된 코일의 전기적인 연결 위치를 변경하고 전원입력단자에 입력되는 전압을 상기 위치를 변경한 코일로 분산시켜 단락전류를 감소시키면서, 부하측의 출력전압을 감소시키며 부하측에서 고조파가 발생하면 상기 고조파를 180도 변환되는 정상위상과 역상위상에 한 차례 흐르게 하여 발생한 고조파를 상쇄하는 단락전력변환기와; 상기 단락 전기신호를 전달하기 위한 스위치와; 상기 스위치에 의해 출력되는 전기신호에 따라 전력차단 및 경보신호를 위한 스위치를 포함한다.

title_en: Fire fighting apparatus
title_ko: 소방배관의 누수를 감지할 수 있는 소방장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a firefighting device capable of sensing a leakage of a firefighting pipe. The firefighting device includes a connection pipe (10) and a leakage sensing unit (20). The connection pipe (10) comprises: a pipe body (11) wherein the inside is penetrated and a protrusion (11a) is integrally formed on both ends; a nut (12) installed on the circumference of the pipe body (11) to rotate and having a hanging protrusion (12a) integrally formed and corresponding to the protrusion (11a); an elastic ring (13) installed between the protrusion (11a) and the hanging protrusion (12a) and pushing the hanging protrusion (12) in one direction; and a water inlet (14) collecting water leaking from the firefighting pipe (P) by being integrally formed on the circumference of the pipe body (11). The leakage sensing unit (20) comprises: a water sensor (21) installed in the water inlet (14) and sensing and outputting the water; an alarm unit (22) operated by the water sensor (21) and installed in the water inlet (14), wherein the alarm unit (22) emits light and warning sound to a periphery; a battery (23) supplying power to the water sensor (21) and the alarm unit (22); and a protective cover (24) covering the alarm unit (22) and the battery (23) and protecting the same from external force. According to the embodiment of the present invention, the firefighting device can largely reinforce a coupling force of the connection pipe and the firefighting pipe by the elastic ring and can inform a manager of the leakage of the firefighting pipe by rapidly sensing the leakage of the firefighting pipe by a leakage sensor. Therefore, the firefighting device facilitates management of a facility.

abstract_en: A system and method for integrated emergency notification is provided. Accordingly, in the event of an active threat or other emergency at a location (i.e., a building), the system and method according to embodiments of the present disclosure may provide an immediate, effective way to simultaneously notify/alert users that may be on-site as well as first responders and other interested parties of emergencies and provide a means of communicating site-specific information to one another, such as through a real-time chat feature. The system and method may provide color-coded floor plans that may be updated to show user status, automatically detect inactivity, and provide easy-to-use reference materials for standard response procedures that may be employed depending on the type of alert situation.

title_en: Systems for tracking medications
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to integrated systems, methods and apparatuses for assisting individuals in managing acute life-threatening conditions. A system in accordance with the current disclosure may comprise an electronic circuit configured to be attached to a container of a medication and one or more devices in communication with the electronic circuit in a private network. In an aspect, the one or more devices may work in concert to determine the safety level of an individual based on predetermined usage settings. In some aspects, the system may be configured to determine whether a medication would expire before its manufactured expiry date. In another aspect, the system may assist an individual in locating a medication. In a further aspect, the system may determine whether an individual is having an anaphylactic reaction. In some aspects, the system may detect a known allergen and alert the individual.

title_en: Warning Broadcasting System Using Two-Way Radio Transceiver
title_ko: 무전기를 이용한 경고방송 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed is a warning broadcast system comprising a situation monitoring and warning broadcast output device, an emergency situation monitoring device, and a radio. According to the warning broadcast system of the present invention, the situation monitoring and warning broadcast output device transmits a video of a surrounding situation in real time in a radio communications scheme using a first channel. Also, the emergency situation monitoring device receives the video of the surrounding situation in real time through the first channel, and outputs the received video of the surrounding situation on a display unit. When a security guard determines that an emergency situation occurs in the surrounding of the situation monitoring and warning broadcast output device by the video of the surrounding situation output by the display unit, the radio transmits a warning voice of the security guard in a radio communications scheme using a second channel. Furthermore, the situation monitoring and warning broadcast output device receives a signal of the warning voice in real time through the second channel, and outputs the received signal of the warning voice to a speaker unit as a warning broadcast. Therefore, according to the warning broadcast system of the present invention, a conventional system can be used by slightly changing the configuration of a conventional system installed in an apartment complex, thereby constructing and efficiently operating the same with the low costs.

abstract_en: Disclosed are a disaster alarm system including a low-power set-top box capable of context-based operation mode control, and a method thereof. The disaster alarm method performed by a set-top box can comprise the steps of: switching to a network-assisted passive standby mode among operation modes of a set-top box in accordance with preset conditions; transmitting information on an operation mode of the set-top box and context information around the set-top box to a wake-up server; receiving a wakeup data packet generated based on the transmitted information; and switching the operation mode of the set-top box based on the received wakeup data packet.
