title_en: The apparatus of smart instrumentaion for radiation exposure with dose area product meter sft
title_ko: “sft”형 dap 계측기·유기섬광체형 방사선센서부로 이루어진 하이브리드형 스마트 방사선피폭 계측장치
abstract_en: Disclosed is a hybrid-type radiation exposure measurement apparatus comprising an SFT-type DAP measuring instrument and an organic scintillator-type radiation sensor part. The hybrid-type radiation exposure measurement apparatus comprises: the SFT-type DAP measuring instrument (100) of primarily measuring dose change according to the change of a cross-sectional area of an X-ray beam and transmitting the measured dose change to a smart control part; the organic scintillator-type radiation sensor part (200) of radiating the X-ray beam to the organic scintillator to reflect light of a specific wavelength, secondarily measuring a scintillation light signal according to the X-ray beam, and transmitting the secondarily measured scintillation light signal to the smart control part; a battery part (300) supplying power to each device; a short-distance communication module (400) of transmitting current effective dose exposure data and emergency situation notification messages; a display part (500) of displaying the current effective does exposure data and the emergency situation notification messages in real-time; a wired/wireless communication module (600) of transmitting the current effective does exposure data and the emergency situation notification messages, receiving a control instruction signal as a response signal for the transmission, and transmitting the received signal to the smart control part; and the smart control part (700) of controlling to transmit the current effective dose exposure data and the emergency situation notification messages to the short-range communication module and the wired/wireless communication module when the current effective dose exposure data is compared with a reference dose, and it is determined that the current effective dose exposure data is equal to or greater than the reference value. According to the present invention, the relationship between an X-ray dose and the obtained charge quantity counter can be clearly distinguished.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에서는 종래 면적선량계를 내장하는 X선 조사야 제한장치의 구성요소 중 면적선량 센서를 외국에서 수입해서 사용하므로, 비용이 비싸고, 주변의 환경에 영향을 받아 정확한 선량 측정이 어려운 문제점과, 환자에게 조사되는 피폭선량이 기준치 이상일 경우에, 실시간으로 부저음을 통해 외부에 알림과 동시에, 기준치 이상의 현재 유효선량피폭데이터를 근거리 또는 원거리의 중앙관리서버로 전달시키는 장치가 없어, 그대로 환자 뿐만 아니라 방사선사에게 노출되어, 제2의 방사선 피폭사고가 발생되는 문제점을 개선하고자, "SFT"형 DAP 계측기(100), 유기섬광체형 방사선센서부(200), 배터리부(300), 근거리통신모듈(400), 디스플레이부(500), 유무선통신모듈(600), 스마트제어부(700)로 구성됨으로서, 엑스레이(X-ray) 장비의 분광기 선단에 탈부착 설치되어, 단면적의 변화에 따른 선량변화를 통해 1차 측정하고, 방사선피폭객체쪽을 바라보는 후단에서 유기섬광체의 섬광빛 신호를 2차 측정한 후, 1차방사선측정데이터와 2차방사선측정데이터를 기준으로 연산하여 현재 유효선량피폭데이터를 표출시킬 수 있어, 하이브리드식 측정방식으로 기존보다 80% 향상된 센싱정확도를 가지면서 방사선량피폭을 실시간 측정할 수 있고, 투명유연전극판의 금속물질이 ITO 또는 탄소나노튜브(CNT)로 금속 코팅되어, 엑스선 선량과 획득된 전하량 카운터의 관계를 뚜렷하게 식별할 수 있어, 전하량 획득율을 기존에 비해 80% 향상시킬 수 있으며, 모든 부품 구성과 설계를 국내 순수기술로 제작할 수 있어, 기존의 수입 면적선량계보다 50% 저렴한 가격으로 소비자들에게 제공할 수 있고, 현재 유효선량피폭데이터를 기준치 이상일 경우에, 부저음을 통해 외부에 알림과 동시에, 기준치 이상의 현재 유효선량피폭데이터를 근거리의 스마트 디바이스 및 원거리의 중앙관리서버로 전송시킬 수 있어, 기존에 비해 방사선피폭사고를 80%이하로 낮출 수 있고, 무엇보다 환자와 방사선사의 건강을 모니터링하면서 스마트 원격관리해줄 수 있는 "SFT"형 DAP 계측기·유기섬광체형 방사선센서부로 이루어진 하이브리드형 스마트 방사선피폭 계측장치를 제공하는데 그 목적이 있다.

title_en: Device for preventing deformation of spring seat for sprinkler head
title_ko: 스프링클러 헤드용 스프링시트 변형방지장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a device for preventing deformation of a spring seat for a sprinkler head installed on a ceiling so as to scatter a fire-extinguishing liquid in four directions when a fire occurs such that it is possible to fundamentally prevent water leakage caused by deformation of the spring seat due to excessive fastening in the process of assembling the sprinkler head. To this end, the present invention is characterized in that, in connection with assembling a spring seat (3) in a concave groove (2c) formed on an orifice portion (2b) of a body (2) and pressurizing the spring seat (3) by the orifice portion (2b) such that the assembly load of the spring seat (3) is adjusted, the height (H) of the orifice portion of the body (2) is set to be larger than the height (h) from the upper surface of a deflector (20), the concave groove (2c) formed on the orifice portion (2b) has a depth (d) at which the maximum effective load of the spring seat (3) has a maximum value when the head (100) is assembled such that the bottom surface of an inner loading plate (9) abuts the bottom surface of the deflector (20), and an upward protruding ledge (9a) is formed on the upper surface of the inner loading plate (9) so as to have a size smaller than the inner diameter of a water discharge opening (2a) such that the upward protruding ledge (9a) is connected to the bottom surface of the deflector (20).
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 천장에 설치되어 화재 발생 시 소화액을 사방으로 살수하는 스프링클러 헤드(sprinkler head)용 스프링시트 변형방지장치에 관한 것으로, 스프링클러의 헤드를 조립하는 과정에서 과잉 체결로 인해 스프링시트가 변형됨에 따른 누수현상을 근본적으로 해소할 수 있도록 한 것이다. 이를 위해, 본 발명은 바디(2)의 오리피스부(2b)에 형성된 요입홈(2c)에 스프링시트(3)를 조립하여 오리피스부(2b)에 의해 스프링시트(3)를 가압하여 스프링시트(3)의 조립하중을 조절하는 것에 있어서, 상기 바디(2)의 오리피스부 높이(H)를 디플렉터(20)의 상면으로부터의 높이(h)보다 높게 설정하고 오리피스부(2b)에 형성된 요입홈(2c)의 깊이(d)는 인너 로딩 플레이트(9)의 저면이 디플렉터(20)의 저면에 닿도록 헤드(100)를 조립하였을 때 스프링시트(3)의 최대유효하중이 최대치가 되는 깊이로 설정하며, 인너 로딩 플레이트(9)의 상면에 출수구(2a)의 내경보다 작은 크기로 상향돌출턱(9a)을 형성하여 상기 상향돌출턱(9a)이 디플렉터(20)의 저면에 접속되도록 한 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Landslide, avalanche precaution device installation method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to disaster alarm field, especially a kind of landslide, avalanche precaution device installation method.Step is as follows：A, massif is observed, selects easy slide strip that monitoring unit is installed；B, level land, build template by laying bricks or stones, pour out concrete casing, pre-buried installation foot, concrete casing is installed inner chamber carry out it is smooth；C, after after concrete casing completely solidification, level meter and signal projector are installed；D, according to the position of monitoring unit install signal in capstan head, capstan head in signal is covered all monitoring unit, after after all monitoring unit installations, communication connection set up between monitoring unit and warning center by capstan head in signal；E, the foundation communication connection between warning center and local household.By setting monitoring unit to send pre-warning signal by signal projector in massif danger zone, after warning center receives pre-warning signal, danger zone resident is directly notified by modes such as broadcast, bulk SMSs, helps resident to withdraw in time.

title_en: Providing status information for secondary devices with video footage from audio/video recording and communication devices
abstract_en: Systems and methods for communicating in a network using share signals in accordance with various embodiments of the present disclosure are provided. In one embodiment, a method for communicating in a network may include receiving, from a first client device, a share signal including image data captured by a camera of a first audio/video (A/V) recording and communication device; transmitting, to a second A/V recording and communication device, a secondary device state request signal; receiving, from the second A/V recording and communication device a secondary device update signal that includes a status of the at least one secondary device in network communication with the second A/V recording and communication device; and generating and transmitting an alert to a second client device associated with the second A/V recording and communication device, wherein the alert includes the image data and the status of the at least one secondary device.

title_en: A Closed wet sprinkler heads that can prevent damage due to shocks
title_ko: 충격파손 방지구를 구비한 폐쇄형 습식 스프링클러헤드
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a closed wet sprinkler head with an impact-breakage prevention device, preventing breakage due to an impact when a sprinkler head installed in an indoor golf training room is hit by a strong hitting ball of users, thereby preventing an undesired damage due to unexpectable spray of fire water. According to the present invention, the sprinkler head (A) comprises a frame assembly (1), a heat detection unit (2), and a spray unit (3). The frame assembly (1) includes: a frame (100); a circular frame fixation plate (200) formed with a circular steel plate of a ring shape wherein a central part is perforated, having a plurality of piece coupling holes (210) perforated along the ring shape, and coupling the frame (100) to a ceiling finishing material (C) through a shock absorption material (B) by a piece (230); an impact receiving member (300) formed based on a circular rubber plate with a predetermined thickness; a support bush (400); and a head protection device (500).

title_en: CAE mechanical simulation method based on BIM information model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a CAE mechanical simulation method based on a BIM information model, which comprises the steps of reconstructing a BIM building three-dimensional geometric model through a grid simplification system, and importing the simplified BIM three-dimensional model into a CAE mechanical simulation system; extracting data information in a BIM information model system, judging the attribute of the change information, transmitting data influencing the mechanical simulation to a CAE mechanical simulation system, and driving the CAE mechanical simulation system to update; and feeding back the mechanical information obtained by the updated CAE mechanical simulation model to the BIM information model, and displaying the calculated mechanical information from the BIM information model. When building designers design on the BIM by applying the method, the mechanical information can be referred to, the design efficiency is improved, in addition, the effective early warning can be carried out on the disasters caused by stress damage in the construction process in the later period, meanwhile, the repeated modeling is avoided, and the cost is saved.

title_en: System for providing one touch multi-type integrated broadcasting against fire and earthquake
title_ko: 화재 및 지진에 대비한 원터치 멀티타입 통합방송 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an one-touch multi-type integrated broadcasting system against a fire and an earthquake. The system can continuously perform broadcasting without any interruption even if some errors of hardware or software occur through integrated broadcasting control defined by the hardware and the software while performing integrated broadcasting by quickly and accurately designating in an one-touch operation a type and a range of broadcasting which provides information on an earthquake or a fire even if an emergency situation like the earthquake or the fire, can change configuration of an input/output port, and can perform the integrated broadcasting by being synchronized even if a plurality of users are interacted.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재 및 지진에 대비한 원터치 멀티타입 통합방송 시스템에 관한 것으로, 지진이나 화재와 같이 긴급한 상황이 발생되는 경우 해당 지진이나 화재에 대한 정보를 제공할 방송의 타입과 범위를 원터치로 신속하고 정확하게 지정하여 통합방송을 수행하는 것이 가능하도록 하면서, 하드웨어 및 소프트웨어로 정의된 통합방송 제어를 통하여 하드웨어 또는 소프트웨어의 일부 오류가 발생하더라도 끊어짐이 없이 방송을 지속적으로 수행할 수 있고, 입출력포트의 구성을 실시간으로 변경할 수 있으며, 복수의 사용자가 인터랙션을 하더라도 동기화되어 통합방송이 가능하도록 한다.

title_en: Smart surfaces for visuo-haptic notifications
title_ko: 시각-촉각 알림을 위한 스마트 표면
abstract_en: Disclosed are examples of a device, a system, and a method for providing a visuo-haptic notification. In one example, a visuo-haptic notification is provided using a surface. A signal for causing an actuator to change a position of a notification unit on the surface from an original position to a notification position is generated and outputted to the actuator to provide the visuo-haptic notification. In some examples, the notification unit on the surface has a display. The display may be visible when the notification unit on the surface is in the notification position and may not be visible when the notification unit on the surface is in the original position. At least a part of the visuo-haptic notification may be provided on the display.
abstract_ko: 시각-촉각 알림을 제공하기 위한 장치, 시스템, 및 방법의 예가 개시된다.  일 예에서, 표면을 사용하여 시각-촉각 알림이 제공된다.  액추에이터로 하여금 상기 표면의 알림부의 위치를 원래 위치로부터 알림 위치로 변경하게 하기 위한 신호가 생성되어 액추에이터에 출력되어 상기 시각-촉각 알림을 제공한다.  일부 예에서, 상기 표면의 알림부는 디스플레이를 갖는다.  상기 디스플레이는 상기 표면의 알림부가 상기 알림 위치에 있을 때 보이고 상기 표면의 알림부가 상기 원래 위치에 있을 때 보이지 않을 수 있다.  상기 시각-촉각 알림의 적어도 일부가 상기 디스플레이 상에 제공될 수 있다.

title_en: Emergency responder routing system for cardiac emergencies
abstract_en: A method and system for locating a nearest available responder to an emergency event. The method comprises determining a location of an emergency event by a central dispatch server. At least one responder is then identified based on an at least one responder data, which includes location proximity data, traffic congestion data, and time availability data. Then, an emergency request and routing data is sent from the central dispatch server to the at least one identified responder. After receiving the emergency request and routing data, the acceptance signal of the at least one identified responder is transmitted to the central dispatch server. When the at least one identified responder arrives at the determined location of the emergency event, a confirmation alert from the at least one identified responder's portable device is received, and a cancellation alert is sent to one or more other responders.

title_en: A kind of flood warning information real-time publishing system
abstract_en: A kind of flood warning information real-time publishing system, it includes flood signal acquisition terminal, flood signal acquisition terminal includes controller, the input of controller and the output end of sensor assembly are connected, sensor assembly includes flow sensor, level sensor, flow sensor, and the data output of controller is connected with communication module, and communication module is connected with cloud platform input, cloud platform output end is connected with monitoring client, and the power end of controller is connected with power supply.The utility model can solve existing flood warning device information and update slower, and Flood Information, which is communicated to masses, needs longer time, it is possible to flood damage emergency response occur not in time, causes the problem of certain people, wealth lose.

title_en: Stage setting apparatus of motor control method
title_ko: 모터구동방식 무대장치의 부하량 변동 모니터링 및 비교 분석 장치 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a device and a method for load fluctuation monitoring and comparative analysis for a motor-driven stage setting. According to the present invention, an algorithm is applied for constant motor load monitoring and comparative analysis in a motor-driven stage setting. As a result, pre-inspection and pre-repair can be performed for the stage setting, persons can be protected from an accident, inconvenience and performance cancelation attributable to sudden mechanical malfunction can be prevented, and a contribution can be made to a successful performance. The motor-driven stage setting management method of the present invention includes a step in which the presence or absence of a batten movement command is determined. In a case where the command is present, movement direction confirmation, position movement commanding, and remaining distance calculation are performed, and then it is determined whether or not the position of the moved batten is a specified position. In the case of the specified position, a temporary stop is performed and then the presence or absence of a batten movement command is determined again. According to the present invention, load monitoring starts at batten ascent or descent initiation and an average or maximum value is calculated and backed up. In a case where a value that exceeds a preset load rate is measured, a stage director or a stage setting manager is pre-notified of the fact so that regular inspection, emergency inspection, and forced stop can be performed in the case of mild, heavy, and serious warnings, respectively.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 모터구동방식 무대장치에서 항상 모터의 부하량을 모니터링 및 비교 분석하는 알고리즘을 적용하여 사전에 무대장치를 점검 및 정비를 유도함으로써 갑작스런 기계 고장으로 인한 불편과 공연의 취소, 안전사고 등으로부터 인명을 보호하고 성공적인 공연에도 기여할 수 있도록 한 모터구동방식 무대장치의 부하량 변동 모니터링 및 비교 분석 장치 및 그 방법에 관한 것이다. 
이를 위해 본 발명은  배튼의 이동지령 여부를 판단하여 배튼의 이동 지령이 있는 경우 이동방향 확인, 위치이동 지령 및 잔여 거리 연산을 실행한 후 이동한 배튼 위치가 규정위치인가 여부를 판단하여 규정위치이면 일단 정지한 후 배튼의 이동지령 여부를 재차 판단하는 단계를 포함하는 모터구동방식 무대장치의 관리방법에서, 배튼이 상승 또는 하강을 시작할 때부터 부하량을 모니터링하고 평균값 또는 최대값을 연산 및 백업하여 미리 설정된 부하율 보다 높은 값이 측정될 경우 무대 감독이나 무대장치 관리자에게 이 사실을 사전에 경고하여 경경고일 경우 정기점검의 유도를, 중경고일 경우는 긴급 점검의 유도를, 중대경고일 경우에는 강제정지를 실행하도록 이루어진 것이다.

title_en: Electric wire tray having alarm function of fire
title_ko: 화재경고기능을 구비한 공동주택용 배전선 설치트레이
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 화재경고기능을 구비한 공동주택용 배전선 설치트레이에 관한 것으로서, 사이드레일(11)과 렁(12)으로 구성된 메인바디(10)와: 베이스(21)와 연결구(22), 탄성바인더(23) 그리고 전선고정구(24)로 구성된 서브바디(20); 및 케이스(31)와 연기감지부(32), 열감지부(33), 제어부(34) 그리고 경보부(35)로 구성된 화재감지겸용 경보기(30)로 구성된다. 
본 실시 예에 의하면 천정을 따라 설치되어 전선을 쉽고 간편하게 고정할 수 있으면서도 인출되는 전선의 가설경로를 필요에 따라 쉽고 간편하게 변경할 수 있으며, 화재발생시 즉각적으로 감지 및 이를 주변으로 경고하여 실내에 있는 사람들이 신속하게 대피하도록 유도해 줌에 따라 화재에 따른 피해발생을 최소화할 수 있는 이점이 있다.

title_en: Gateway system of attachable type
title_ko: 탈부착형 게이트웨이 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a detachable gateway system. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the detachable gateway system includes: a worker terminal (100); a detachable gateway (200); and a manager terminal (300). The detachable gateway system enables a long-distance communication operation even in a closed workspace such as a manhole or the like. More specifically, the detachable gateway system can install detachably gateway units in each workspace path section to enable a worker to execute a long-distance communication operation to communicate with the outside in a relay hopping manner.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 탈부착형 게이트웨이 시스템은, 작업자가 휴대하며, 작업자 주변의 작업환경 정보를 수집하도록 변경 가능한 교체형으로써 가스감지, 온/습도 감지, 산소포화도 감지, 분진 감지와 같은 환경감지를 작업 환경에 따라 선택하는 센서(110)를 장착하고, 상기 센서(110)로부터 수집되는 데이터를 실시간으로 외부로 송출하는 무선통신 모듈(120)을 포함하는 작업자 단말기(100); 데이터 수신과 데이터 송출을 수행하는 무선통신 모듈(120)과, 자체적으로 전력을 공급하는 배터리(210)와, 부착 마운트(220)를 구비하여 다수가 작업장 경로마다 장착되고, 상기 작업자 단말기(100)에서 송출되는 데이터를 수신하여 각 경로에 위치한 다음 무선통신 모듈(120)로 데이터를 송출하는 탈착형 게이트 웨이(200); 상기 탈착형 게이트 웨이(200)에서 송출되는 데이터를 수신하고, 작업자의 현재 상황을 모니터링하는 관리자 단말기(300);를 포함하고, 상기 센서(110)는, 작업자 단말기(100)의 센서(110)에서 이상상황을 감지하는 이상상황 감지단계(S100); 상기 이상상황 감지단계(S100)에서 감지된 센싱 데이터를 관리자 단말기(300)로 송출하는 이상 데이터 관리자 단말기 송출단계(S200); 작업자 단말기(100)에서 작업자에게 경고음을 표출하는 작업자 경보단계(S300); 탈착형 게이트 웨이(200)가 발광하여 작업자의 탈출로를 확보하는 탈출로 안내단계(S400); 관리자 단말기(300)에서 현재 이상상황이 감지된 작업자 단말기(100) 의 위치와 근처의 작업자를 서칭하는 작업자 서칭단계(S500); 상기 작업자 서칭단계(S500) 후 서칭된 근처의 타 작업자 단말기(100)에 대피신호를 송출하는 주변 작업자 대피신호 송출단계(S600);를 포함하는 알고리즘을 가져, 수집되는 데이터에서 작업자의 안전을 보장할 수 없는 데이터가 센싱된 경우 처리되도록 하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: System and method for preventing false alarm of fire detection device
title_ko: 화재 감지 장치의 오경보 방지를 위한 화재 감시 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire detection system. More particularly, the present invention relates to a fire detection system for preventing a fire detection device from a false alarm by determining a situation as a fire even if the situation is not a real fire. The fire detection system is composed of a plurality of fire detection devices and an integrated controller wirelessly or wired connected to the fire detection device. Especially, the plurality of fire detection devices are installed in a space to have the same effective detection area, and the integrated controller waits for fire alarm execution during a predetermined time period (T1-T2) when a first fire detection signal is received from any one fire detection device of the plurality of fire detection devices, and executes a fire alarm when a second fire detection signal is received from the other fire detection apparatus within the predetermined time.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재 감시 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 화재 감지 장치가 실제 화재가 아닌 경우에도 화재인 것으로 판단하여 오경보하는 것을 방지하기 위한 화재 감시 시스템에 관한 것으로, 복수의 화재 감지 장치 및 화재 감지 장치에 무선 또는 유선으로 연결된 통합 제어기로 이루어지고, 상기 복수의 화재 감지 장치의 오경보 방지를 위한 화재 감시 시스템이 제공된다. 특히 복수의 화재 감지 장치는 동일한 유효 감시 영역을 갖도록 공간 내에 설치되고, 통합 제어기는, 복수의 화재 감지 장치 중 어느 하나 화재 감지 장치로부터 제1 화재 감지 신호를 수신한 경우 미리정해진 시간 구간(T1~T2) 동안 화재 경보 실행을 대기하고, 상기 미리정해진 시간 내에 다른 하나의 화재 감지 장치로부터 제2 화재 감지 신호를 수신한 경우 화재 경보를 실행하도록 구성된다.

title_en: Information display system
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To allow for reliable recognition of emergency information by a viewer.SOLUTION: An information display system includes an image mixer 5 provided for each television receiver 4, and connected in a free-communication state with a television broadcasting apparatus 2, an information providing server 3 and the television receiver 4, and a cancel button 6 connected in a free-communication state with the image mixer 5, and detecting a predetermined operation by a viewer. Upon receiving emergency information from the information providing server 3 while receiving a television video from the television broadcasting apparatus 2, the image mixer 5 transmits a synthesized image where a television video and emergency information are synthesized to the television receiver 4, and when the predetermined operation is detected by the cancel button 6 while displaying the synthesized image, the image mixer 5 cancels synthesized image display state and transmits a television video to the television receiver 4.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: System, method, and recording medium for geolocation data discovery in streaming texts
abstract_en: A geolocation data discovery method, system, and non-transitory computer readable medium, include mining a textual alert message of an event from secure source data for a geolocational indicator, a temporal indicator, and a type of alert, embedding a geolocational tag location and a temporal tag time to the event based on the geolocational indicator and the temporal indicator mined from the textual alert message by the secure text mining, mapping the event with an icon related to the type of alert at the geolocational tag location on a navigational map at a time associated with the temporal tag time of the event, learning a false-positive event by comparing a secure sensor with an unsecure sensor as the secure source data, and removing updates to the icon on the map based on the learned false-positive event.

title_en: Safety system of Cross walk
title_ko: 횡단보도 안전시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a crosswalk safety system which can: calculate a passage forecast time (T) by a calculated movement speed (WV) after calculating the movement speed (WV) of a pedestrian; solve problems in which a movement speed is excessively delayed while securing the safe passage of the pedestrian by determining a display period of a pedestrian signal according to the calculated passage forecast time (T); accurately detect a display period by corresponding to the movement speed (WV) of the pedestrian by calculating the movement speed (WV) and the passage forecast time (T) with components of an X-axis direction which is a longitudinal direction of a crosswalk after detecting a movement vector of the pedestrian; secure a safe passage of a new pedestrian while minimizing delay of a vehicle by resetting the display period by calculating a change forecast time (T) by multiplying the calculated passage forecast time (T) with a multiple which becomes lower according to the set number of the display period while resetting the display period when a new pedestrian is detected after setting the display period of the pedestrian signal; and completely prevent an accident in advance by being formed to display warning data when the movement of a vehicle stopping on a stop line is sensed when a pedestrian signal is turned on or a vehicle violating a speed limit is sensed by being formed to sense a vehicle in real time. The crosswalk safety system includes: a crosswalk traffic light; a pedestrian detecting radar which senses a waiting area (S1) formed in a crosswalk or in both sides of the crosswalk; a vehicle detecting radar which senses a vehicle; and a traffic signal controller.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 보행자의 이동속도(WV)를 산출한 후 산출된 이동속도(WV)에 따라 통행예측시간(T)을 산출하며, 산출된 통행예측시간(T)에 따라 보행자신호의 현시주기를 결정함으로써 보행자의 안전한 통행을 보장함과 동시에 이동속도가 과도하게 지체되는 문제점을 해결할 수 있으며, 보행자의 움직임벡터를 검출한 후 횡단보도의 길이 방향인 X축 방향의 성분을 가지고 이동속도(WV) 및 통행예측시간(T)을 산출함으로써 보행자의 이동속도(WV)에 대응하여 현시주기를 더욱 정확하게 검출할 수 있고, 보행자신호의 현시주기를 설정한 이후, 신규보행자가 감지되는 경우 현시주기를 재설정하되, 현시주기의 설정 회수에 따라 낮아지는 배수를 산출된 통행예측시간(T)에 곱하여 변경예측시간(T`)을 산출하여 현시주기를 재설정함으로써 차량의 지체를 최소화하면서 신규보행자의 안전한 통행을 보장할 수 있으며, 실시간으로 차량을 감지하도록 구성되어 제한속도를 위반한 차량이 감지되거나 또는 보행자신호 점등 시 정지선에 정차 중인 차량의 움직임이 감지되는 경우 경고데이터를 표출하도록 구성됨으로써 안전사고를 사전에 철저하게 방지할 수 있는 횡단보도 안전시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Short message communication within a mobile graphical map
abstract_en: In one embodiment, a computer-implemented process is programmed or configured to allow a first mobile device to generate and send enriched pin data to a geographical messaging system. Enriched pin data may include latitude and longitude data, a timestamp, and a media element. Media elements may include image data, video data, text data, drawing data that defines a geographic location, route data that defines a geographic travel path, and/or pin expiration data. The geographical messaging system may then broadcast the enriched pin data to a second mobile device belonging to a team member in the same geographical region as the first mobile device. The second mobile device may then use the enriched pin data to display, on a geographical map, a map pin that corresponds to the enriched pin data. In one embodiment, the second mobile device may also use the enriched pin data to display, in a message chain, a message related to the enriched pin data.

title_en: Wired and wireless voice guiding terminal with multiple sensor and method for emergency message transmitting
title_ko: 유무선 음성안내 복합센서 단말기 및 이를 이용한 비상대피 음성안내 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a wired and wireless voice guide terminal with a composite sensor and a voice guide method for emergency evacuation using the same, which can automatically select and play a voice file in adaptation to current locations and situations or can select and play the voice file from the outside based on detection information including a body detection sensor, a temperature and humidity sensor, a gas sensor, a smoke sensor, etc. The wired and wireless voice guide terminal of the present invention comprises: a sensor detection unit selectively including the body detection sensor, the smoke sensor, the gas sensor, and the temperature and humidity sensor, etc.; a voice file storage unit having a USB or an SD memory which can store a plurality of voice files and music files such as an MP3 or the like; a voice output unit including a speaker, an amplifier, and an MP3 play circuit; a wired and wireless communication unit connecting to an external server to transmit and receive data; and a microprocessor connected to the sensor detection unit to convert a sensor detection value into a digital value and transmit the same to an external server through the wired and wireless communication unit, receiving an external server command through the wired and wireless communication unit to select the voice files of the voice file storage unit, transmitting a command to play the voice files through the voice output unit, and renewing the MP3 files of the voice file storage unit with MP3 files provided from the external server through the wired and wireless communication unit.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 인체감지센서, 연기센서, 가스센서, 온습도센서 등으로 선택 구성되는 센서 감지부와 MP3 등의 복수의 음성 파일, 음악 파일을 저장할 수 있는 USB 또는 SD 메모리로 구성되는 음성 파일 저장부, 스피커와 앰프, MP3 플레이 회로로 구성되는 음성 출력부, 외부 서버에 연결하여 데이터를 송수신할 수 있는 유무선 통신부, 상기 센서 감지부와 연결되어 센서 감지값을 디지털 값으로 변환하여 유무선 통신부를 통하여 외부 서버로 전송하고, 유무선 통신부를 통하여 외부 서버 명령을 수신하여 음성 파일 저장부의 음성 파일을 선택하고, 음성출력부를 통하여 재생할 수 있도록 명령을 송신하고, 유무선 통신부를 통하여 외부 서버에서 제공하는 MP3파일로 음성 파일 저장부의 MP3 파일을 갱신할 수 있는 마이크로프로세서로 구성되는 것을 특징으로 하는 유무선 음성안내 복합센서 단말기와 이를 이용한 비상대피 음성안내 방법에 관한 것이다.

title_en: System and method for managing mobile device alerts based on user activity
abstract_en: A system and method for managing alerts of a mobile communications device is provided. The system includes the device, a processor, and a sensor for monitoring activity of a user and generating sensor data indicative of the activity. The processor is configured for processing the sensor data to determine a current activity of the user; detecting an alert corresponding to an incoming communication; classifying the alert as being immediate or deferred based at least in part on the current activity. If the alert is immediate, the processor is configured to announce the alert without delay; otherwise, the processor is configured to announce the alert after a delay. The delay can terminate when a holdback timer expires or the current activity changes to an activity that indicates that the user can be notified.

title_en: Managing evacuation of a building in real time
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to an evacuation management system, EMS, (40, 52, 60, 100, 200) operative to provide real-time evacuation information for evacuation of a building triggered (S202) by an alarm notification, based on determining (S214) the precise real-time location of a personal ultra-wideband UWB device, as determined by a UWB real-time location system, RT L S, a controller determines (S210) a real-time evacuation plan specific to the personal UWB device, based on the individual evacuation plan and input from the building facility, defines (S208) and sends to each personal UWB device real-time guidance information providing to the person carrying the personal UWB device which direction to move to reach a guided safe area (S212). then, based on the location signal, UWB RT L SA calculates the updated location of the personal device and sends it to the evacuation management system.

title_en: Device, system and method for crowd control
abstract_en: A device, system and method for crowd control is provided. An aural command is detected at a location using a microphone at the location. A computing device determines, based on video data received from one or more multimedia devices, whether one or more persons at the location are not following the aural command. The computing device modifies the aural command to generate a second version of the aural command based on one or more of the video data and multimedia data associated with the location. The computing device causes the second version of the aural command to be provided, to the one or more persons who are not following the aural command at the location, using one or more notification devices.

title_en: A risk information spread method for guranteeing reliable emergency service
title_ko: 비상 서비스의 신뢰성을 보장하는 비상 정보 확산 방법
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to efficiently support a risk information push service in a mobile device which has difficulties like unexpected delays and acknowledgment. According to the present invention, provided is an emergency information spreading method using an information spreading system which comprises: a risk sensing device which is installed in a place where disasters are expected; an application server of a push message providing side which receives event information from the risk sensing device and generates a push message based on the event information; a push server which is connected to the application server via a network; and a plurality of user terminals which are connected to the push server via a network, and comprise a wired or a wireless device. The method comprises the steps of: registering the plurality of user terminals which want to receive a push notification to the push server; the application server receiving the event information detected from the risk sensing device; the application server generating a push message to transmit the same to the push server; and the push server transmitting the push message to the registered user terminals.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 재해 발생 가능성이 있는 장소에 설치되는 위험 감지 장치, 위험 감지 장치로부터 이벤트 정보를 수신하고 이벤트 정보에 근거하여 푸쉬 메시지를 생성하는 푸쉬 메시지 제공측의 어플리케이션 서버, 어플리케이션 서버와 네트워크를 통해 결합되는 푸쉬 서버, 및 푸쉬 서버와 네트워크를 통해 연결되고 유선 또는 무선 장치로 이루어진 복수의 사용자측 단말을 포함하는 정보 확산 시스템을 이용하여 비상 정보를 확산하는 방법이 제공되고, 이 방법은, 푸쉬 알림을 받고자하는 복수의 사용자측 단말을 푸쉬 서버에 등록하는 단계; 상기 어플리케이션 서버가 위험 감지장치로부터 검출된 이벤트 정보를 수신하는 단계; 상기 어플리케이션 서버가 푸쉬 서버로 푸쉬 메시지를 생성하여 전송하는 단계; 및 푸쉬 서버에서 등록된 복수의 사용자측 단말에 푸쉬 메시지를 전송하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: The APP for Smart-Phone that have the function for the emergency rescue request and the emergency warning
title_ko: 긴급구조요청 및 긴급경보기능을 가진 스마트폰 앱의 구성
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a configuration of an application for a smartphone having a function for emergency rescue requesting and emergency alerting, which automatically activate an alerting siren, a warning lamp screen, and an emergency rescue requesting voice function when a user feels a risk and simultaneously touches an emergency rescue request application for three seconds when a robber, kidnapper, sex offender or the like approaches the user in a secluded alley or a dark place. According to the present invention, when an SOS icon installed on a locked screen is immediately touched for 3 to 5 seconds when the user faces a robber, kidnapper, sex offender or the like, the alarm siren, warning light screen, and urgent emergency rescue voice are automatically activated to notify that the user is in a dangerous situation, thereby obtaining help from other persons near the user. In addition, the alarm siren, warning light screen, and urgent emergency rescue voice are automatically activated such that a perpetrator shrinks psychologically and stops committing the crime or escapes the area, thereby providing the user with a measure of safety.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 후미진 골목이나 으슥한 장소에서 강도나 유괴범 또는 성폭행범등이 접근할 경우 위협을 느낌과 동시에 긴급구조요청앱인 3초간 누르게 되면 자동으로 경보싸이렌 및 경광등화면 및 긴급긴급구조요청음성 기능이 작동되는 긴급구조요청 및 긴급경보기능을 가진 스마트폰 앱의 구성에 관한 것이다

; 상기의 스마트폰(1)의 잠금화면(100)상에 SOS아이콘(101)을 3~5초간 누름과 동시에 잠금화면(100)이 경광등화면(101b)으로 전환되는 구성을 가지는 것이 특징인 단계와 ; 상기 경광등화면(101b)상에서는 적색램프(201) 와 청색램프(202)가 반복적으로 점멸을 반복하는 구성을 가지는 것이 특징인 것과,

title_en: Systems and methods for managing service log information
abstract_en: Methods and systems for processing insurance policies associated with properties may be provided. A home may be populated with smart devices that are connected to, or in communication with, a central (or “smart home”) controller, such as via wired or wireless communication. The smart devices are covered by an insurance policy, such as homeowners, renters, or personal articles insurance. The central controller may receive, with customer permission, service log information for the devices, and update an inventory list to include the service log information. The controller may detect that a smart device has been repaired, and then generate and transmit a notification to the customer. In some cases, the notification may prompt the customer to schedule a future repair event. The smart devices may be associated with appliances, electronics, computers, televisions, jewelry, vehicles, furniture, or other personal belongings. Insurance discounts may be provided based upon the service log/maintenance functionality.

abstract_en: The present invention provides a method and system for early warning device abnormality including decisions of device importance and warning validity. title_en: Warning of spectrum access revocation
abstract_en: Various communication systems may benefit from improved signaling. For example, certain communication systems may benefit from improved signaling before network access is revoked through a citizens broadband radio service. A method may include receiving at a network entity from a citizens broadband radio service device a warning message. The warning message may include a drop time after which communication between a network and a user equipment using the citizens broadband radio service will terminate. The method may also include triggering the performing of an action based on the warning message by the network before the drop time.

title_en: Safety detector and system for multi dwelling units and the like
abstract_en: An alarm system for detecting alarm conditions in a security group with a plurality of security zones. Such a system may include a plurality of sensor units each with at least one sensor, a first communication interface for broadcasting messages to other sensor units and a second communication interface for transmitting data packets over a computer network. A back end server is connected to a computer network. Each sensor unit is configured to, upon detection of an alarm condition, generate an alarm message, broadcast the alarm message over the first communication interface and transmit the alarm message over the second communication interface addressed to the back end server. The sensor units, upon receipt of an alarm message, rebroadcast the received alarm message over the first communication interface and transmit the alarm message over the second communication interface addressed to the back end server The back end server is configured to, upon receipt of an alarm message, update a list of alarm messages and retransmit the received alarm message to the plurality of sensor units.

title_en: Method, system, and device for protecting vehicle occupants
abstract_en: A system, method, and device for protecting a vehicle occupant over a computerized network. There is an electronic seat pad with an occupant sensor, a driver sensor control module that detects proximity a driver's portable electronic computing device relative to the vehicle; and a key-location sensor that detects proximity of a vehicle key to the vehicle. title_en: System for capsize warning of ship

abstract_en: The present invention relates to an overturn warning system (1000) for vessels. According to the present invention, the system (1000) includes: an information collecting part (100) pre-storing vessel specification information; 6-degrees-of-freedom movement information of a vessel from a frequency area and a time area; an overturn predicting part (300) predicting an overturn of the vessel by consecutively updating the 6-degrees-of-freedom movement information to overturn warning algorithm; and a distress signal generating part (400) generating a distress signal for dispatch to the scene of the accident when the overturn predicting part (300) determines that the vessel is overturned. As such, the present invention is capable of making a warning for danger and automatically transmitting a distress signal by predicting an overturn of a vessel losing its stability, thereby minimizing marine accidents and damage to people.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 선박용 전복경보 시스템(1000)에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 선박의 복원성 상실에 따른 전복위험을 예측할 수 있는 선박용 전복경보 시스템(1000)에 관한 것이다. 본 발명에 따른 선박용 전복경보 시스템(1000)은, 기상청(500)을 통해 지역별 해상의 파랑 및 해상풍의 정보를 연속적으로 수집하고, 운항이 가능한 선박들을 적재중량별로 분류하여 각각에 대한 선박제원정보를 미리 저장해놓은 정보수집부(100); 상기 파랑 및 해상풍의 정보를 기반으로 미리 산출된 RAO(Response Amplitude Operator)와 운동스펙트럼, 방향분포함수를 기반으로 얻은 제1 6자유도 계측데이터 또는 관성측정센서(210)로부터 얻은 제2 6자유도 계측데이터 중 적어도 하나를 통해 주파수 영역 및 시간영역에서 선박의 6자유도 운동정보를 수집하는 운동계측부(200); 상기 정보수집부(100)에 저장된 상기 선박제원정보와 상기 운동계측부(200)에서 수집한 상기 선박의 6자유도 운동정보를 기반으로 미리 저장한 선박의 전복경보 알고리즘 및 상기 운동계측부(200)에서 수집한 상기 선박의 6자유도 운동정보를 상기 전복경보 알고리즘에 연속적으로 갱신하여 선박의 전복을 예측하는 전복예측부(300); 및 상기 전복예측부(300)에서 선박의 전복을 판단하면 사고현장출동을 위한 구조신호를 발생하는 조난신호발생부(400);를 포함한다. 이에 따라, 운항 중인 선박의 복원성을 연속적으로 분석하고, 선박의 복원성 상실에 따른 전복위험을 예측하여 위험경보를 알리고 자동으로 구조신호를 송신함으로써 해양사고 및 인명피해를 최소화할 수 있다.

title_en: A Dual Preamble Random Access Protocol for Reducing Access Congestion in Disaster Situations
title_ko: 재난상황에서 액세스 혼잡을 줄이기 위한 듀얼 프리앰블 랜덤 액세스방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a dual preamble random access method for reducing access congestion in disaster situations in which a terminal (UE) can increase the number of logically possible preambles by transmitting two different preambles to a base station (eNB), thereby reducing the collision probability and access delay between the terminals (UEs). The dual preamble random access method for reducing access congestion in disaster situations comprises the steps of: constructing a valid preamble pair by a terminal to transmit the pair to a base station; calculating, by the base station, an optimal ACB parameter on the basis of the number of terminals successfully accessed and the number of unnecessary response messages; generating a response message including the optimal ACB parameter calculated by the base station and broadcasting the response message to the terminal; requesting a connection by using resource allocation information included in the response message in the terminal that has received the response message; and when receiving a connection request message transmitted from the terminal by the base station, transmitting a connection completion message to the terminal.
abstract_ko: 단말기(UE)가 서로 다른 두 개의 프리앰블(preamble)을 동시에 기지국(eNB)으로 전송하여 논리적으로 가능한 프리앰블의 수를 늘리고, 이를 통해 단말기 간의 충돌 확률과 접속 지연을 줄일 수 있도록 한 재난상황에서 액세스 혼잡을 줄이기 위한 듀얼 프리앰블 랜덤 액세스방법에 관한 것으로서, 단말기에서 유효한 프리앰블 쌍을 구성하여 기지국에 전송하는 단계, 기지국에서 접속에 성공한 단말기 수와 불필요한 응답 메시지 수를 고려하여 최적의 ACB 파라미터를 산출하는 단계, 기지국에서 산출한 최적의 ACB 파라미터를 포함한 응답 메시지를 생성하여 단말기로 방송하는 단계, 응답 메시지를 수신한 단말기에서 응답 메시지에 포함된 자원 할당 정보를 이용해 연결을 요청하는 단계 및 기지국에서 단말기로부터 전송된 연결 요청 메시지를 수신하면 연결 완료 메시지를 상기 단말기로 전송하는 단계를 포함하여, 재난상황에서 액세스 혼잡을 줄이기 위한 듀얼 프리앰블 랜덤 액세스방법을 구현한다.

title_en: safety home using a location-based service applications
title_ko: 위치기반 서비스를 이용한 안심귀가 어플리케이션
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a safety home return application using a location-based service, capable of solving problems, caused when there is not any solution to a danger signal delivery button malfunctioning in case of an emergency, by reporting the emergency to a desired contact through a wrong route display function even without pressing an emergency reporting button. According to the present invention, the safety home return application includes: an address book setting button formed as an UI button to set contacts to report an emergency; a service on/off button formed as an UI button to start and terminate the service; a route changing button formed as a UI button to change a route as a user wants; a home button formed as a physical button to send a danger signal by being consecutively pressed; a destination setting function formed by a touch to set a destination; a route mark formed on a map to indicate a red route on the map; a wrong route mark formed on the map and generated to deliver a dangerous situation and a current position to the address book in case of entering a wrong route; a departure setting function formed by a touch to set a desired departure spot; and a GPS display window located on the top of the screen to check whether GPS is on/off. As such, the present invention is capable of solving problems, caused when there is not any solution to a danger signal delivery button malfunctioning in case of an emergency, by reporting the emergency to a desired contact through a wrong route display function even without pressing an emergency reporting button.

abstract_en: The cable machine cage for merging D GPS and RFID causes calamity method for prewarning risk, includes the following steps：Judge region residing for construction personnel with prior-warning device, when worker is located in dangerous region, carry out phonetic warning；Real-time spatial position coordinate (the X of measuring cable machine cage 1 , Y 1 , Z 1 ), speed of service v and worker spatial position coordinate (X 2 , Y 2 , Z 2 ), compare the horizontal displacement between cable machine cage and worker and cable machine cage object strike influence area, take the form apart from early warning, early warning is carried out to construction personnel；When worker enters in cable machine cage object strike influence area, buzzer warning is carried out, until worker is withdrawn to safety zone.The method of the present invention calculates the influence area of cable machine cage object strike by location technology, effectively reduces Steric clashes and causes calamity risk, improves operating personnel's safety in work progress.

title_en: Incident Broadcast Retransmission in a Vehicular Network
abstract_en: A system for transmission of incident information includes maintaining a table of RSSI values for a plurality of stations. When an incident is detected, the system first sends a broadcast packet with incident information, and next sends a unicast packet to any station below a particular RSSI threshold until the unicast packet is acknowledged or a retransmission interval passes.

title_en: A kind of medical crutch with warning function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of medical crutchs with warning function, including cane head and cane leg, range sensor and control button area are provided on cane leg, cane leg is internally provided with GPS positioning module, control chip and power supply, GPS positioning module connect to realize data transmission and communication with control chip, chip is controlled by wirelessly being connect with PC/ mobile monitorings end, the control chip is connect respectively with power supply, control button area and range sensor.There are certain distances with ground for range sensor under normal circumstances, when there are emergency situations in the person that holds crutch, crutch was dropped in ground moment, range sensor and ground reduce apart from moment, this situation is transferred to control chip by range sensor, at this point, control chip will alarm to PC or mobile monitoring end and the location information for the person that sends crutch.The utility model can realize automatic alarm, manual alarm and cancel the function of alarming and transmit patient or old man present position；It is alternatively arranged as infusion support use.

title_en: A kind of side slope real-time stability monitoring and warning system based on rainfall
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of side slope real-time stability monitoring and warning systems based on rainfall, module, rainfall infiltration model building module and controller are established including data acquisition module, static flow model in porous media, data acquisition module is used for soil strength parameter and soil body penetration parameter；Data acquisition module is additionally operable to obtain the displacement variable of ground at each coordinate after different rainfalls；Static flow model in porous media establishes module for establishing the static flow model in porous media of side slope according to the soil strength parameter and soil body penetration parameter of ground at each coordinate；Rainfall infiltration model building module is used for the parameter in the static flow model in porous media of displacement variable update according to ground at each coordinate after different rainfalls, to obtain rainfall infiltration model；Controller is used to calculate the stationary value of the ground after rainfall, and the alert when stationary value is more than pre-determined stability value.The all sequencing of all modeling process, easy to operation and programming greatly reduced artificial calculation amount, and prediction result is more reliable by the present invention.

title_en: A kind of earthquake alarm system and its device based on wireless internet of things

title_en: A kind of folding Non-barrier armrest

title_en: A kind of safety reminding device that billboard falls

title_en: Disaster control communication system
title_ko: 재난발생 자동 검지 및 피난 관제 통신 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an automatic disaster occurrence detection and evacuation control communication system. The automatic disaster occurrence detection and evacuation control communication system can detect disasters through double tracks between fire receivers and fire detectors, analyze the communication traffic in a disaster site, and guide a user through an evacuation route. According to the present invention, the automatic disaster occurrence detection and evacuation control communication system includes: multiple fire detectors which are installed in a building in a distributed manner to detect a fire on the site; multiple evacuation lamps being installed in the site to display the evacuation route; multiple CCTVs which are installed on the site to record the disaster situation and transmit the recording to a remote location; the fire receivers which can detect the location of the fire and report and initiate an alarm indicating the occurrence of a fire when the fire detectors sense the fire; on-site control terminals which operate the corresponding CCTVs to receive the on-site images and transmit the on-site images to the disaster control server in the remote location upon receiving the indication that a fire has occurred from the fire receivers as well as controlling the evacuation guide lamps in accordance with preset scenarios to guide the evacuation path; and the disaster control server which analyzes the traffic in the corresponding area to determine the validity of the disaster while storing the received disaster images to a database upon receiving the disaster information from the on-site control terminals as well as transmitting the disaster text to the mobile phones in the corresponding area. The automatic disaster occurrence detection and evacuation control communication system can sense the disaster precisely through the redundant tracks between the fire receivers and fire detectors as well as analyzing the communication traffic in the disaster site to prevent false alarms, thereby responding to disasters quickly.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재수신기와 화재감지기 사이의 이중화된 선로를 통해 재난을 감지하고 재난 현장의 통신 트래픽을 분석하여 신속하게 피난 경로를 안내할 수 있는 재난발생 자동검지 및 피난 관제 통신 시스템에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 시스템은, 건물에 분산설치되어 현장의 화재를 감지하기 위한 복수의 화재 감지기; 현장에 설치되어 피난 경로를 표시하는 복수의 피난 유도등; 현장에 설치되어 재난상황을 촬영하여 원격지로 전송하기 위한 복수의 CCTV; 상기 화재 감지기로부터 화재가 감지되면, 화재 위치를 판별하여 화재발생을 보고하고 경보하는 화재 수신기; 상기 화재 수신기로부터 화재발생을 수신하면, 해당 CCTV를 작동시켜 현장 영상을 수신받아 원격지의 재난 관제 서버로 전송하고, 미리 설정된 시나리오에 따라 상기 피난 유도등을 제어하여 피난 경로를 안내하는 현장 관제 단말; 및 상기 현장 관제 단말로부터 재난정보가 수신되면, 해당 지역의 트래픽을 분석하여 재난 허위 여부를 판단함과 아울러 수신된 재난 영상을 데이터베이스에 저장하고, 해당 지역의 휴대폰으로 재난문자를 전송하는 재난 관제 서버로 구성된다. 본 발명에 따르면, 화재수신기와 화재 감지기 사이의 이중화된 선로를 통해 재난을 정확하게 감지하고, 재난 현장의 통신 트래픽을 분석하여 오 경보를 방지함으로써 재난에 신속하게 대응할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Elevator rescue method based on user calling, elevator rescue device and intelligent equipment
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of communication, and provides an elevator rescue method based on user calling, an elevator rescue device and intelligent equipment, wherein the elevator rescue method based on user calling comprises the following steps: detecting whether an emergency rescue call button in an elevator is triggered; when detecting that an emergency rescue call button in the elevator is triggered, judging whether the emergency rescue call button is triggered by mistake; if the trigger is false trigger, sending a prompt to an emergency rescue center, and canceling a rescue instruction; and if the trigger is not false trigger, sending a maintenance rescue notification to an intelligent terminal of the maintenance personnel, and notifying the maintenance personnel to carry out rescue. By the method, the response speed of the emergency rescue call can be greatly improved, and the maintenance rescue efficiency is improved.

title_en: System for controlling signal lamp and the method thereof
title_ko: 교통신호등 제어 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are a traffic light control system and a method thereof. The traffic light control system which allows a connection between a mobile device of a vehicle in which an emergency has occurred and a traffic light controller, comprises: a mobile device for receiving an emergency notification message and destination information from a user through an application; a traffic control application server for setting a current location of the mobile device as a starting point when the emergency notification message is received from the mobile device, and relaying a connection between a traffic light controller located within a predetermined distance from the starting point and the mobile device; and a traffic light controller for changing a mode into a traffic signal control mode for supporting a movement of the vehicle in which an emergency has occurred when connected to the mobile device through the traffic control application server. Therefore, an emergency response time of a vehicle in case of emergency can be shortened by controlling a traffic signal to a destination using a smartphone application.
abstract_ko: 교통신호등 제어 시스템 및 그 방법이 개시된다. 교통신호등 제어시스템은 응급상황이 발생한 차량의 모바일 기기와 신호등 제어기 사이의 접속을 허가하는 교통신호등 제어 시스템으로서, 어플리케이션을 통해 사용자로부터 응급상황알림 메시지와 목적지정보를 입력받는 모바일기기, 모바일기기로부터 응급상황알림 메시지가 입력되면, 해당 모바일기기의 현재위치를 출발지로 설정하고, 출발지로부터 소정 거리 내에 위치한 신호등 제어기와 해당 모바일 기기 사이의 접속을 중계하는 교통제어 앱서버 및 교통제어 앱서버를 통해 모바일 기기와 접속되면, 응급상황이 발생한 차량의 이동을 지원하기 위한 교통신호 제어모드로 변경하는 신호등 제어기를 포함한다. 따라서, 스마트폰 어플리케이션을 이용하여 목적지까지 교통신호 제어를 통해 응급상황시 차량의 응급출동시간을 단축시킬 수 있다.

title_en: Method for calculating rip current warning index and apparatus thereof, computer program
title_ko: 이안류 경보 지수 산출 방법 및 장치, 컴퓨터 프로그램
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method, a device, and a computer program to calculate an offshore current warning index. The method includes: a step in which a nearshore current vector data generating part generates nearshore current vector data, which is a group of vectors having a flow direction and flowrate of a preset position on the target sea as components, by using wave prediction information of the target sea, which is an offshore current warning target, and a preset numerical simulation model; a step in which an effective vector extracting part extracts an effective vector satisfying a preset shore area condition from the generated nearshore current vector data; a step in which a vector diagram generating part generates a vector diagram indicating flowrate information by flow direction by using the extracted effective vector; and a step in which a velocity radius index calculating part calculates a velocity radius index, which becomes nearshore current generation determination criteria, based on each flow direction component of the effective vector and the flowrate information determined through the vector diagram. As such, the present invention is capable of practically preventing casualties caused by offshore currents.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 이안류 경보 지수 산출 방법 및 장치, 컴퓨터 프로그램에 관한 것으로서, 해빈류 벡터 데이터 생성부가, 이안류 발생 경보 대상이 되는 대상 해역의 파랑 예측 정보 및 미리 설정된 수치모의 모형을 이용하여, 대상 해역 상에 미리 설정된 위치에서의 유향 및 유속을 성분으로 갖는 벡터의 집합인 해빈류 벡터 데이터를 생성하는 단계, 유효 벡터 추출부가, 생성된 해빈류 벡터 데이터로부터 미리 설정된 해안 영역 조건에 부합하는 유효 벡터를 추출하는 단계, 벡터 다이어그램 생성부가, 추출된 유효 벡터를 이용하여 대상 해역의 유향별 유속 정보를 나타내는 벡터 다이어그램을 생성하는 단계, 및 속도 반경 지수 산출부가, 벡터 다이어그램을 통해 판단되는 유향별 유속 정보, 및 유효 벡터의 각 유향 성분에 기초하여 이안류 발생 판단 기준이 되는 속도 반경 지수를 산출하는 단계를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Autonomous, solar-powered, vessel tracking and safety beacon devices and methods thereof
abstract_en: An autonomous, solar-powered, vessel tracking and safety beacon device includes a global positioning system coupled to at least a solar power system, one or more communication systems coupled to the solar power system, and a vessel tracking and safety beacon microcontroller system. The microcontroller system is coupled to the global positioning system, the one or more communication systems, and the solar power system. The microcontroller system comprises a memory coupled to a processor which is configured to be capable of executing programmed instructions comprising and stored in the memory to provide vessel location information from the global positioning system, detect when an emergency alert has been activated, determine based on the vessel location information from the global positioning system, and transmit the emergency alert, and other messages, such as text messages, email, weather updates, revisions to geo-zones, or notifications of nearby mariners in distress, using the determined one of the one or more communication systems.

title_en: City VANET multi-hop broadcasting method based on competition and finite state machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a competition and finite state machine based urban VANET multi-hop broadcasting method, wherein the state of each node comprises the following steps: n is a message which is not received; p is a possible received message; and R is the confirmed received message. A source node which learns the emergency constructs an emergency message with a sending node list and broadcasts the emergency message, and the state of the source node is set as R; if the state of the neighbor node is N, the state is changed to P; the node receiving the emergency message finds the message sending node and the nodes in the sending node list contained in the message in the local neighbor table, and if the nodes exist, the states of the nodes are set to be R. The receivers then calculate their own latencies based on the relative distances to the last hop node, the quality of the communication, etc. The node whose waiting time is first ended updates the urgent message and broadcasts it, and the new message can be regarded as an implicit ACK. If there is a neighbor with a state other than R, the sender will retransmit overtime. The invention is suitable for various network topologies, and ensures the real-time reliable transmission of the emergency message in the whole network.

title_en: System and method for real-time classification of notams messages
abstract_en: Methods and systems are provided for classifying notice to airmen (NOTAM) alerts to a pilot of an aircraft. First, bundled NOTAMs are received during the flight planning process for the aircraft. A domain rules set for a filter engine on board the aircraft is created that prioritizes the bundled NOTAMs based on their criticality. The domain rules set is updated with weather data and day/night visibility analysis. The prioritized critical NOTAMs are stored on board in an electronic database and retrieved during the relevant phase of the flight path of the aircraft. The NOTAM messages are then displayed to the pilot on a graphical display device on board the aircraft.

title_en: A kind of stone pit safety monitoring system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of stone pit safety monitoring system and methods, subsystem is detected including control backstage and landslide, control backstage is connected with landslide detection subsystem communication, prediction and early warning are carried out for receiving detection data and showing million property to disaster, landslide detection subsystem includes stone pit ontology landslide module and dump slide module, stone pit ontology landslide module includes several sensor detection units being arranged in side slope, and dump slide module includes the monitoring unit for detecting roach mobile range.It the advantage is that, the roach situation of the rocky condition and refuse dump of the stone pit ontology of subsystem detection is detected by landslide, and carry out the aobvious million property analysis of disaster by controlling backstage, judge the dangerous situation being likely to occur, and dangerous situation content and the doubtful coordinate of dangerous situation are sent to alarm module in time, it notifies the operating personnel of the doubtful nearby coordinates of dangerous situation to withdraw or reinforce slope monitoring and management in time by alarm module, pinpoints the problems and take preventive measures in time.

title_en: Systems and methods for interactive emergency response systems
abstract_en: Systems and methods for interactive emergency response systems are provided. Some methods can include retrieving a building information model of a monitored region stored in a database device, receiving real time data related to an occupant in the monitored region, receiving real time ambient condition signals from a plurality of devices in the monitored region that identify current conditions in the monitored region, dynamically generating and updating an evacuation plan for the occupant from the monitored region based on the building information model, the real time data, and the real time ambient condition signals, and dynamically transmitting a notification of the evacuation plan as updated to a user device carried the occupant for use in exiting the monitored region and moving to a safe assembly area.

title_en: Alert control program, information processing device, and alert control method

title_ko: 비상경보 사용자 시스템 및 방법
abstract_ko: 경고 시스템 및 방법은 타켓된 경고 메시지를 전송하는 운전자를 검증할 수 있다. 통보 서버는 고객 장치로부터 비상 메시지를 수신할 수 있다. 비상 메시지는 1차 비상 경고 및 지리적 관심 영역의 사양을 포함할 수 있다. 통보 서버는 비상 메시지가 유효한지 여부를 판별하도록 구성될 수 있다. 전송 시스템은, 비상 메시지의 검증시, 비상 메시지를 경고 가능 장치로 전송하도록 구성될 수 있다. 경고 가능 장치는 비상 메시지를 수신하고, 경고 가능 장치가 지리적 관심 영역 내에 있는지 여부를 결정하고, 경고 가능 장치가 지리적 관심 영역 내에 위치할 경우에만 사용자에게 비상 메시지를 제시하도록 구성될 수 있다.

title_en: Electronic Vehicle Tag Collection System
abstract_en: An electronic vehicle tag collection system that provides a decal chip for a motor vehicle license plate registration tag that stores information of the registered motor vehicle and the owner and has notification and calling capabilities to activate itself and provide location of the vehicle. The device can also self-activate if the license plate is taken off the vehicle. This thin decal chip, comprising of a tiny GPS locator, will be programmed to communicate with local law enforcement and is capable of receiving and sending out updates and alerts from the authorities regarding amber alerts, all-points bulletins, person of interest and/or any traffic law violations committed by the driver or owner of the motor vehicle. It further provides a reader device with corresponding software that can be installed in an authorized vehicle of the law enforcement agencies and the corresponding software to receive updates and alerts from the decal chip.

title_en: Disaster forecasting and warning system capable of active adjustment of output sound
title_ko: 능동형 방송 출력 조정이 가능한 재난 예경보시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a disaster forecasting and warning system capable of actively adjusting a broadcast output, which can actively adjust the broadcast output of a message for each step according to a power consumption amount to be anticipated in future so as to output the message to be broadcasted for each step with a time interval according to the progress of a disaster situation without interruption through a speaker. A broadcast type of a message to be currently broadcasted is changed into a low power broadcast type according to an available power amount of a battery, a predicted charging amount which is generated by a solar cell from a current step to a final step and to be charged, and a total predicted power consumption amount from the current step to the final step, thereby adjusting the broadcast output.

title_en: Robotic companion device
abstract_en: Embodiments described herein relate to a robotic companion device for assisting a patient with daily tasks and/or medical emergencies. A robotic companion device may have sensors, actuators, and a computer system. The robotic device maybe able to receive sensor data, such as environmental information and a patient location. As the robotic device receives more data, it can learn (i.e., update decision tables) from the environment or patient in order to guide future actions. Additionally, based on the received sensor data, the robotic device is able to determine whether an emergency situation has occurred related to one or more patients and move to an area adjacent to the patient. Once near the patient, the robotic device can transmit a communication to a third party alerting them of the emergency situation. To improve patient interactions, the robotic device may mimic the gender, voice, lip movement, or facial appearance of a familiar individual.

abstract_en: An objective of the present invention is to provide an information providing system using a LoRa-based portable alarm technology for real-time location tracking and a pedestrian safety service and a device thereof. abstract_en: This application discloses the monitoring data processing methods and landslide forecasting procedure for landslide, are related to disaster alarm field, by laying monitoring point in premonitoring region, obtain the multi -components monitoring data of monitoring point.Multi -components monitoring data include the variation of physics-mechanics character at monitoring point, the Characters of Geographical Environment of monitoring point and weather condition.Multi -components monitoring data are handled, the changing features of multi -components monitoring data are obtained.This feature variation is input in tree-model again, exports the landslide risk index of the monitoring point.Since the proposition of innovation is handled the multi -components monitoring data of the monitoring point in premonitoring region using tree-model, and then realize to the round-the-clock monitoring of landslide and the real-time update of data, early warning can be issued to the dangerous of landslide in time by the analysis to data.

title_en: A kind of closely horizontal supporting rod piece of side slope and its side slope pre-add solid method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of closely horizontal supporting rod piece of side slope and its side slope pre-add solid method, the closely horizontal supporting rod piece of side slope includes slope protection cast, mobile jib, pillar, connection bar, warning device；Supporting rod piece and ground level are installed at less than 30 degree angles, supporting is carried out to tall and big side slope with nearly horizontal supporting way, shearing resistance greatly reinforces, and improves the barrier effect to landslide；And entire support system is pre-installed in mining activity area before mining, plays the role of protection and pre- landslide-proofing in advance, is made tall and big side slope not occur to come down or occur to issue clear early warning before landslide, is withdrawn personnel and the equipment of lower part in time；In the environment, without burying underground, design, construction, maintenance are easy for entire support system leakage；In addition, fast, easily group is built up at the construction field (site) by support system the present invention also provides a kind of side slope pre-add solid method, under the major premise for guaranteeing production safety, construction efficiency is turned up.

title_en: Landslide disaster forecasting procedure based on deepness belief network
abstract_en: Landslide disaster forecasting procedure disclosed by the invention based on deepness belief network, initially sets up Landslide Monitoring early warning system, acquires a large amount of disaster incitants, screens with MIV algorithm, filters out major casualty incitant；The disaster incitant filtered out is standardized process, is divided into test sample and training sample in specific proportions；Then, the landslide disaster forecasting model based on deepness belief network is constructed, setting structure is two layers of RBM and three layer of BP network composition；Using CD algorithm to RBM pre-training, network parameter is updated；Learnt using genetic algorithm supervised training, guarantees DBN network total optimization；Finally, the landslide disaster forecasting model that reconstruct has optimized, carries out landslide grade classification to output result, forecasts landslide possibility occurrence.Method disclosed by the invention accelerates convergence rate, prevents from falling into local optimum, promote landslide disaster forecast precision by extracting feature disaster incitant.

abstract_en: Monitoring data processing method, method for forecasting earthquake and system for earthquake prediction, it is related to disaster alarm field, by laying earthquake monitoring point in premonitoring region, a variety of physical quantitys and chemical quantity for monitoring earthquake monitoring point are monitored, and obtain multi -components monitoring data.Multi -components monitoring data at the earthquake monitoring point because the variation characteristic of physical field and chemical fields caused by underground activities is related.Multi -components monitoring data are handled, the changing features of multi -components monitoring data are obtained.This feature variation is input in tree-model again, exports the earthquake monitoring point or the Earthquake risk index in the premonitoring region.Since the proposition of innovation is handled the multi -components monitoring data of the earthquake monitoring point in premonitoring region using tree-model, and then realize to the round-the-clock monitoring of earthquake and the real-time update of data, early warning can be issued to the danger that earthquake occurs in time by the analysis to data.

title_en: Method for early warning of urban rainfall flood inundated area
abstract_en: A method for early warning of urban rainfall flood inundated areas is characterized by comprising the following steps: the system comprises four functional modules: (M1) real-time observing water level in urban rainfall flood inundation area; (M2) a sensor layout module for municipal pipelines in urban rainfall flood flooding areas; (M3) an early warning indicator calculation module; (M4) a live and early warning plane domain output module. The invention has the beneficial effects that: 1. during the rain flood period, a city manager can mutually verify the water level data and the water surface image of the rain flood submerging area, so that the measured data is more convincing and effective; 2. a novel device and a method for measuring the water level of an urban rainfall flood flooding area are provided; 3. the water withdrawal process line of the rain flood inundated area can be accurately predicted.

title_en: A kind of more place gas monitor systems
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of more place gas monitor systems, it include: control centre's host computer, it is set to the host of different mine laneways and is uniformly arranged on multiple slaves of each mine laneway bottom, control centre's host computer is wirelessly communicated with host, multiple slaves connect the host of corresponding mine laneway by CAN communication bus, slave is used to generate warning information according to gas concentration data in collected mine laneway, host is for receiving gas density data and warning information and being sent to control centre's host computer, control centre's host computer is used to be arranged by host the gas density alarm threshold value of slave and transmits gas density data and warning information to command centre.The gas monitor system of the utility model realizes the automatic remote monitoring of more place coal mine gas concentrations to a certain extent, once gas density somewhere is more than threshold value, just will call the police, notifies miner to withdraw in time, reduces casualties.

title_en: Methods and apparatus for updating system information
abstract_en: According to embodiments described herein there is provided methods and apparatus for receiving notifications at a wireless device from a base station of upcoming system information (SI) updates. The wireless device is communicating with the base station using a contiguous subset of physical resources on a first carrier. A method in a wireless device comprises obtaining an indication of a subset of a plurality of paging occasions in a SI modification period that the wireless device is configured to monitor, wherein responsive to an upcoming update of SI the base station is configured to transmit a notification on each of the plurality of paging occasions in the SI modification period; and monitoring the subset of the plurality of paging occasions for notifications of upcoming SI updates.

title_en: Device and method for validating a public safety agency command issued to a vehicle
abstract_en: A process for validating a public safety agency command issued to a vehicle. In operation, a public safety agency controller receives a public safety agency command validation inquiry from a vehicle communication device. The inquiry indicates that the vehicle communication device has detected a public safety agency command issued to the vehicle and includes a first vehicle identifier and a first vehicle location. The controller receives a public safety agency command information including a second vehicle identifier and a second vehicle location from a public safety agency communication device. The validity of the public safety agency command is determined based on comparing the first vehicle identifier with the second vehicle identifier and comparing the first vehicle location with the second vehicle location. The controller then transmits a notification to the vehicle communication device identifying the validity of the public safety agency command.

title_en: Fine dust alarm broadcasting system

abstract_en: The present invention provides a fine dust notification broadcasting system which facilitates maintenance and repair. The fine dust notification broadcasting system comprises: a fine dust notification device including an environment measurement unit installed in an arbitrary area to measure outside environment information, a lighting module to emit light in multiple colors, and a control module to light the lighting module in a preset color if a measurement value of the environment information received from the environment measurement unit is higher than or equal to a prescribed value, and maintain or change the color by lighting of the lighting module if the measurement value of the environment information is changed to the prescribed value or higher or the prescribed value or lower at the lit time; a broadcast control server to receive the environment information from the environment measurement unit, and use the environment information to generate an announcement if the measurement value of the environment information is higher than or equal to the prescribed value; and a plurality of media output units which are installed in an arbitrary area, and receive the announcement from the broadcast control server to output the announcement. The broadcast control server includes: a broadcast generation unit to receive the environment information from the environment measurement unit, and use the environment information to generate an announcement if the measurement value of the environment information is higher than or equal to the prescribed value; and a mixing console for broadcasting to receive the announcement from the broadcast generation unit, and edit and control audio data of the announcement to transmit the audio data in a wired and a wireless manner.

title_en: A kind of distributed implementation of the algorithm on ZigBee of escaping

abstract_en: The present invention relates to a sound wave device for a vehicle to provide a traffic accident emergency rescue service, which comprises: a short-range module including at least one short-range wireless communication unit; a location module including a positioning module; a sensor module including one or more sensor units; and a control module. abstract_ko: 본 발명의 교통사고 긴급출동 서비스를 제공하는 차량용 음파장치에 따르면, 음파신호를 입력받는 음파 입력부와 음파신호를 출력하는 음파 출력부를 구비한 음파모듈과, 통신망에 연결하는 적어도 하나의 통신부를 구비한 통신모듈을 포함하는 음파장치에 있어서, 근거리 무선 통신을 처리하는 적어도 하나의 근거리 무선부를 구비한 근거리모듈과 GPS를 통해 측위된 위치좌표를 획득하는 위치 측위부를 구비한 위치모듈과 가속도를 센싱하는 가속도 센서부와 방향을 센싱하는 자이로 센서부와 지자기 센서부 중 하나 이상의 센서부를 구비한 센서모듈 및 상기 근거리 무선부를 통해 차량 OBD와 연결된 OBD모듈과 근거리 무선 통신하여 상기 차량 OBD로부터 차량의 운행정보 또는 상태정보를 획득하는 OBD 연동부와, 상기 음파 입력부를 통해 입력되는 가청 주파수 대역의 음파신호에 대응하는 음파데이터를 판독하여 사용자의 발화를 인식하고 자연어 처리한 발화내용인식정보를 획득하는 절차를 수행하는 발화 인식부와, 상기 위치 측위부를 통해 획득된 위치좌표에 대응하는 위치정보를 확인하는 위치 확인부와, 상기 가속도 센서부를 통해 센싱된 가속도정보와 상기 자이로 센서부와 지자기 센서부 중 하나 이상을 통해 센싱된 방향정보를 하나 이상 포함하는 센싱정보를 확인하는 센서 확인부와, 상기 OBD 연동부를 통해 차량 OBD로부터 획득된 차량의 운행정보 또는 상태정보와 상기 발화 인식부를 통해 인식되어 자연어 처리된 사용자의 발화내용인식정보와 상기 센서 확인부를 통해 확인된 센싱정보 중 하나 이상의 정보를 통해 차량의 실제 교통사고 발생 상황을 파악하기 위한 절차를 수행하는 상황 파악부와, 지정된 연락처를 이용하여 교통사고 발생 상황에 따른 긴급출동 요청 상황을 알림하기 위해 사용자에게 발화 출력할 발화정보나 상기 긴급출동 요청의 취소를 위한 사용자 발화를 유도하기 위해 사용자에게 발화 출력할 발화정보를 확인하는 음파 확인부와, 상기 음파 출력부를 통해 상기 확인된 발화정보를 발화한 가청 주파수 대역의 음파신호를 출력하고 상기 확인된 위치정보를 포함하는 긴급출동요청정보를 구성하여 상기 통신부를 통해 지정된 연락처로 통지하는 절차를 수행하는 서비스 처리부를 구비한 제어모듈을 포함한다.
