title_en: eCall Plus to eCall Only transition and recovery path
abstract_en: Responsive to detecting transition from an eCall Plus mode to an eCall Only mode, and to acknowledgement from a service delivery network (SDN) of an alert of the transition sent to the SDN by a telematics controller, the telematics controller reattaches to a network in eCall Only mode. Responsive to transition from eCall Only mode to eCall Plus mode, the controller reattaches to the network in eCall Plus mode.

title_en: Tunnel disaster prevention system
abstract_en: To make it possible to adequately determine a situation of insulation deterioration by continuing measurement and recording of line current without being disturbed by warning of current value abnormality even when the warning of current value abnormality is obtained via periodical measurement of current of a signal line to which a terminal apparatus is connected.SOLUTION: A tunnel disaster prevention system performs monitoring by connecting a terminal apparatus including a notification device and detector 16, 18 to a signal line drawn out from a disaster prevention reception board 10 into a tunnel. The disaster prevention reception board 10 includes line current monitoring means 72 for measuring and recording, in each predetermined period, a value of current flowing through the signal line to which the terminal apparatus is connected, determining current value abnormality and originating warning before notifying an external remote supervisory control facility 27 of the current value abnormality to make the facility originate warning when the measured value of current is equal to or larger than a predetermined threshold or exceeds the threshold, and canceling the current value abnormality before resuming current value measurement in each predetermined period when recovery operation by the disaster prevention reception board 10 or the remote supervisory control facility 27 is detected.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Firefighting alarm system using electricity device of apartment house
title_ko: 공동주택의 전기장치를 이용한 소방용 경보시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a firefighting alarm system using an electric device of an apartment house, wherein, when a fire extinguisher is separated from a holder for use because of a fire outbreak, an alarm is sounded from the holder to notify the fire outbreak to unspecified individuals. In addition, the present invention allows a user to input the inspection time and the expiration date of the fire extinguisher in person, in order to automatically inform the user when the inputted set values are reached. Moreover, when a fire extinguisher which has come to the end of the expiration date is replaced, information regarding the fire extinguisher is checked in a management server, such that the same may be replaced with a reliable fire extinguisher. To this end, the present system comprises: a fire extinguishing means including a mounting unit on which a fire extinguisher (F/E), which is operated after receiving power from an electricity terminal box of an apartment house and has unique information, is mounted, and which has a control means therein which notifies inspection information and expiration period information of the fire extinguisher by a control signal, and can change the inspection information and the expiration period information; and a management server which is connected to the control means through a communication network, checks whether information inputted by the control means matches the unique information of the fire extinguisher, and transmits check information to the control means.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재의 발생으로 인하여 소화기를 사용하기 위해 거치대에서 분리하면 해당 거치대에서 경고음이 발생하여 화재가 발생하였음을 불특정 다수인에게 알려줌과 동시에 사용자가 직접 소화기의 점검시간과 유효기간을 입력하되 그 입력된 설정값에 도달하면 자동으로 사용자에게 알려주며, 특히 유효기간에 도달한 소화기를 교체시에 해당 소화기에 대한 정보를 관리서버에서 확인하여 신뢰성이 있는 소화기로 교체할 수 있도록 하는 공동주택의 전기장치를 이용한 소방용 경보시스템에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 공동주택의 전기단자함에서 전원을 인가받아 동작하되 고유정보를 갖는 소화기(F/E)가 거치되며, 그 내부에는 제어신호에 의해 상기 소화기의 점검정보와 유효기간정보를 알려 줌과 동시에 상기 점검정보와 상기 유효기간정보를 변경할 수 있는 제어수단이 구비된 거치부를 포함하는 소화수단 및 상기 제어수단과 통신네트워크에 의해 연결되되 상기 제어수단에 의해 입력된 상기 소화기 고유정보와의 일치 여부를 확인하며, 그 확인정보를 상기 제어수단에 전송하는 관리서버를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Endoscope system
abstract_en: There is provided an endoscope system that appropriately gives a notification of the result of detection of a region of interest. The above-described issue is addressed by an endoscope system that is an endoscope system for performing an examination of a lumen of a patient, the endoscope system including: an insertion part that is inserted into the lumen; a camera that performs image capturing of the lumen to obtain an endoscopic image; a region-of-interest detection unit that detects a region of interest from the endoscopic image; a detection result notification unit that gives a notification of a result of detection of the region of interest; an insertion-withdrawal determination unit that determines whether a step in the examination is an insertion step or a withdrawal step; and a notification control unit that causes the detection result notification unit to give the notification in accordance with the step determined by the insertion-withdrawal determination unit.

title_en: Medication reminder
abstract_en: A device comprising a substrate including a processor, and the substrate is configured to couple to a container. A sensor is coupled to the processor and configured detect a change in a parameter of an environment including the container, and to generate a sensor signal in response to the detected change. An application running on the processor is configured to receive an input comprising a time interval corresponding to content of the container, track elapsed time of the time interval, and generate an alert signal upon detecting expiration of the time interval and the sensor signal. An indicator is coupled to the processor and configured to activate in response to receiving the alert signal. The activated indicator is configured as an alert to administer at least a portion of the content.

title_en: Industrial fire alarm system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an industry fire alarm system, include: the fire alarm unit is configured to be arranged in a plurality of fire alarm devices of the workshops and used for detecting fire conditions in the workshops and providing alarm signals; the signal transmission unit is configured as a wireless communication module and used for transmitting the alarm signal to the control unit; the monitoring unit is configured as monitoring equipment arranged in the workshop, collects video picture information in a plurality of workshops and transmits the picture information to the control unit; and the control unit is arranged in the monitoring center, receives the alarm signal transmitted by the fire alarm unit and extracts the video picture information corresponding to the alarm signal. The utility model discloses a smoke transducer with address code accurately gathers the fire information and the fire takes place the place to monitor on every side that corresponds according to the warning point of computer internal storage, withdraw and monitor picture information on every side, for the rescue personnel provide the concrete information of fire fast, be convenient for implement rescue and personnel sparse.

title_en: Method for automatically acquiring and processing disaster prevention early warning information by high-speed railway CTC system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for automatically acquiring and processing disaster prevention early warning information by  high-speed railway CTC systems, which is used for getting through data barriers between the CTC systems and disaster monitoring system equipment and transmitting the warning information of the disaster monitoring system to the CTC systems by utilizing the existing system functions and expansion interfaces, and comprises the steps of 1) obtaining disaster prevention warning information from the disaster monitoring systems by the CTC systems, 2) displaying the disaster prevention warning, utilizing a visualization means to ensure that the disaster prevention data are visually and accurately displayed to a dispatching terminal and inquiring historical warning data, and simultaneously having the function of automatically generating a speed limit command on a disaster prevention monitoring interface, 3) automatically matching a high-speed train in an affected area according to the disaster prevention warning detailed information, 4) automatically generating a speed limit command according to the disaster prevention warning detailed information, and automatically generating a speed limit cancellation command after receiving the warning cancellation information.

title_en: Agricultural meteorological disaster early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an agricultural meteorological disaster early warning method and system, the system applies the method, the method comprises: the method comprises the steps of acquiring meteorological data, and acquiring meteorological grid data and forecast grid data of the day of meteorological data generation; the method comprises the steps of configuring agricultural meteorological disaster rules, forming a series of meteorological disaster rule set configuration data of various crops and each growth and development period according to national standards, industry standards and agricultural meteorological disaster classification and disaster degree evaluation documents, and configuring the data into a rule base; the method comprises the steps of carrying out early warning analysis on agricultural weather disasters, acquiring weather disaster rule set configuration data of crops in a current development period according to the current development period of the crops, and judging whether the acquired weather data and weather forecast data accord with the weather disasters or not to obtain weather disaster early warning information; and updating the weather disaster analysis result, writing the early warning information into a weather disaster analysis result database, checking all early warning information in the validity period, and updating the early warning information state.

title_en: Intelligent vehicle-mounted fire extinguisher
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a fire-fighting equipment technical field, specifically speaking relates to an intelligent vehicle-mounted fire extinguisher. Comprises a fire extinguisher and an intelligent controller which starts the fire extinguisher to spray fire extinguishing agent by sensing temperature change. The utility model discloses need not on duty, detect in all weather, can make personnel in time withdraw by the early warning when taking place the condition of a fire in advance to in time deal with, automatic fire extinguishing, thereby avoid the vehicle burning, take place to trample or burn and die the incident. Proved by a large number of experiments, the utility model discloses can effectively put out transversely, indulge the condition of a fire such as mechanical equipment in rearmounted engine and the electric box of putting or the bus, boats and ships.
assignees: ZIBO YUYAN ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Risk response and communication system
abstract_en: Disclosed herein are system, method, and computer program product embodiments for p providing a risk response and communication system. An embodiment operates by determining that a workflow associated with an organization indicates an action to be taken by a role within the organization upon the detection of an organizational risk. An organizational risk is detected. Contact information associated with the role is determined, wherein the contact information includes a user account. A message notifying the user account associated with the role of the organizational risk is sent, wherein the notification includes an indication to take the action. It is determined whether a response indicating the action has been completed is received within a time threshold. The user account is monitored until either the response is received or the expiration of the time threshold.

title_en: Fire rescue marker light
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fire rescue marker light, which comprises a base, a shell, a warning device and a switch, wherein the shell is arranged on the base, the lower part of the base is provided with an adhesion device, the upper part of the base is provided with an electric power storage device, the shell is provided with the warning device, the electric power storage device is electrically connected with the warning device, and the switch is in control connection with the electric power storage device. The fire rescue identification lamp has an identification guiding function, can facilitate rescue exploration and fire rescue personnel withdrawal when fire fighters cannot see the surrounding clearly due to a large amount of smoke when the fire fighters enter a strange environment for rescue, and has the advantages of simple structure, easiness in manufacturing and operation and the like.
assignees: HENAN YONG GRANVILLE EQUIP CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent identification and early warning method and system for air-space-ground universe monitoring during emergency electric power emergency disposal
abstract_en: The invention relates to an air-space-ground universe monitoring intelligent recognition early warning method and system for electric emergency handling of emergency events, which are used for carrying out universe detection and data acquisition based on disaster sites, sending the acquired data to a server of a rear command center, giving out early warning levels based on meteorological information and environmental information of the sites, and giving out nearest withdrawing points and withdrawing paths based on longitude, latitude and altitude of the sites, so that field emergency handling personnel can master the surrounding environment conditions of the sites, risk pre-control of the emergency handling personnel is facilitated, and emergency handling of the emergency events is facilitated.

title_en: vehicle and method for controlling the same
title_ko: 차량 및 그 제어 방법
abstract_en: According to the present invention, when a firmware-over-the-air (FOTA) update notification message is received in a standby mode for performing a remote service mode, only an update file for updating is downloaded while the remote service mode is normally performed, thereby saving power in the standby mode. In addition, the present invention can update corresponding software using the downloaded file when the mode is switched from the standby mode to a normal mode. Accordingly, the present invention can minimize cases in which the update is not performed as the update notification message is not received. In addition, the present invention checks whether software to be updated is present by automatically accessing a server at a preset time (e.g., diagnostic time, periodic inspection time, etc.) in the normal mode, and updates the checked software, thereby performing the update without missing even for the software which has not received the update notification message from the server due to an off mode.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 원격 서비스 모드를 수행하는 대기 모드 시에 FOTA(Firmware Over The Air) 업데이트 알림 메시지를 수신 받을 경우, 원격 서비스 모드를 정상적으로 수행하면서 업데이트를 위한 업데이트 파일만을 다운로드함으로써 대기 모드 시 전력을 절감할 수 있다. 
또한 본 발명은 대기모드에서 일반 모드로 전환되면 다운로드된 파일을 이용하여 해당 소프트웨어를 업데이트할 수 있다. 이에 따라, 업데이트 알림 메시지의 미수신으로 인해 업데이트가 미수행되는 것을 최소화할 수 있다. 
또한 본 발명은 일반 모드 시 미리 설정된 시점(예, 진단 시점, 정기 점검 시점 등)에 자동으로 서버에 접속하여 업데이트할 소프트웨어가 존재하는지 확인하고 확인된 소프트웨어를 업데이트함으로써 오프 모드로 인해 서버로부터 업데이트 알림 메시지를 수신받지 못한 소프트웨어에 대해서도 빠뜨림 없이 업데이트를 수행할 수 있다.
assignees: HYUNDAI MOTOR CO LTD;KIA MOTORS CORP

title_en: Power supply for driving dental x-ray cameras with comprehensive status detection, indication and notification
title_ko: 종합상태 검출과 표시 및 알림 기능을 갖는 치과 x선 촬영기 구동용 전원공급장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a power supply device for driving a dental X-ray photographing device performing comprehensive status detection, display and notification functions and, particularly, to a power supply device for driving a dental X-ray photographing apparatus comprising: a filter; a surge protective circuit (1); a PFC converter (2); a high voltage portion electrolytic capacitor (3); a DC-DC converter (4); and a low voltage portion electrolytic capacitor (5). The power supply device for driving a dental X-ray photographing device further comprises: a peripheral temperature detection sensor (6); high voltage portion and low voltage portion capacitor temperature detection sensors (7, 8); high voltage portion and low voltage portion ripple current detection units (9, 10); high voltage portion and low voltage portion overcurrent detection units (11, 12); high voltage portion and low voltage portion overvoltage detection units (13, 14); a capacitor data memory unit (15); a capacitor driving time counting unit (16); a microcomputer (17); a notification unit (18); and a comprehensive status display unit (19). Therefore, according to the present invention, maintenance can be performed in advance by predicting a replacement and failure period of an internal component such as an electrolytic capacitor and the like as well as the power supply device for driving a dental X-ray photographing device itself, thereby preventing a damage to an electrolytic capacitor due to expiration of lifespan of a phase advance electrolytic capacitor including failure of each component due to overvoltage and overcurrent and the like, and power failure and fire risk by explosion.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 종합상태 검출과 표시 및 알림 기능을 갖는 치과 X선 촬영기 구동용 전원공급장치에 관한 것으로 특히, 필터 및 서지 보호회로(1)와 PFC 컨버터(2), 고압부 전해 콘덴서(3), DC-DC 컨버터(4) 및 저압부 전해 콘덴서(5)를 구비한 공지의 치과 X선 촬영기 구동용 전원공급장치에 있어서,  주변온도검출센서(6)와 고압부 및 저압부 콘덴서 온도검출센서(7)(8), 고압부 및 저압부 리플전류 검출부(9)(10). 고압부 및 저압부 과전류 검출부(11)(12), 고압부 및 저압부 과전압 검출부(13)(14), 콘덴서 데이터 기억부(15), 콘덴서 구동시간 계수부(16), 마이컴(17), 알림부(18) 및 종합상태 표시부(19)를 더 구비시킨 것을 특징으로 한다. 
따라서, 치과 X선 촬영기 구동용 전원공급장치 자체는 물론 전해 콘덴서 등과 같은 내부 구성부품의 교체 및 고장 시기를 예측하여 사전에 유지보수가 가능하게 함으로써 과전압 및 과전류로 인한 각 구성품의 고장 등을 포함하여 진상용 전해 콘덴서의 수명 만료로 인한 전해 콘덴서의 손상 및 폭발에 의한 정전 및 화재 발생 위험을 미연에 방지할 수 있다.

title_en: Arm type terminal comprehensive sensing and intelligent interaction emergency disposal method based on ubiquitous power Internet of things
abstract_en: The position of each arm type interactive terminal is interacted with real-time information of a central server side, global monitoring and data acquisition based on a disaster situation site are carried out, the acquired data are sent to a rear server, an early warning grade is given based on meteorological information and environmental information of the site, a nearest withdrawing point and a withdrawing path are given based on longitude, latitude, altitude and direction of the site, and emergency disposal of emergency events is facilitated. The wireless communication module is provided with communication modes such as 4G, 5G, WIFI, DMR and LORA, and the design has the advantage that in places without networks and base stations, field personnel can contact other equipment through the communication module under any emergency.

title_en: Novel intelligent early warning road cone and remote control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel intelligent early warning road cone and a remote control method, comprising a road cone body and a remote controller; a top touch switch is arranged at the top of the road cone body; a display is arranged below the top touch switch; the lower part of the road cone body is provided with a power switch and a charging interface; the display, the touch switch, the power switch and the charging interface are respectively electrically connected with the power supply; the road cone body is wirelessly connected with a remote controller; the remote controller comprises a disarming module key, a arming module key, a mode module key and a control element; the defense withdrawing module key, the defense deploying module key and the mode module key are respectively electrically connected with the control element. The intelligent road cone warning device can effectively solve the problems of few functions, insufficient warning effect and the like of the existing road cone, improves the warning effect of the road cone, and enables workers to know the condition of the road cone at any time by adopting an intelligent design; the control method for the remote control road cone is provided, has relatively comprehensive coverage on the possible warning effect required by the road cone, and has very high practicability.
assignees: GUANGZHOU CTRLPA ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Disaster prevention support server and disaster prevention support system
abstract_en: To provide a server and a system for sharing image data between mobile terminals carried by each member of a self-defense fire brigade and for supporting information sharing between the members.SOLUTION: In a disaster prevention support system 1, a support server 3 includes a first synchronization unit and a second synchronization unit. When the first synchronization unit identifies a synchronization destination, the first synchronization unit transmits a synchronization notification including an ID of a photograph to be published as a push notification to a mobile terminal 2 carried by each member. Then, when a file request is received from the mobile terminal 2, a requested image file is read from a photograph folder of the own terminal and transmitted to the mobile terminal 2. When the second synchronization unit of the support server specifies the synchronization destination, the second synchronization unit transmits a synchronization notification including a file name and version information of an updated file to the mobile terminal 2 carried by each identified member as a push notification. Then, when the file request is received from the mobile terminal 2, the requested image file is read from the disaster prevention information folder of the own terminal and transmitted to the mobile terminal 2.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Disaster prevention system
abstract_en: To provide a disaster prevention system capable of delivering information effective for self-protective fire-fighting activities.SOLUTION: A server can create role selection promotion information for causing a terminal 20 to display a role selection promotion screen in which roles of self-protective fire-fighting members are displayed for each role as the role selection promotion screen to promote selection of the role on the basis of information stored in a role table associating and storing identification information on the terminal 20 with a role selected by an owner of the terminal 20 and transmit it to the corresponding terminal 20. The terminal 20 includes an operation unit that can be operated by the user, and can transmit role notification information notifying a selected role to the server when any of the roles of the self-protective fire-fighting members indicated in the role selection promotion screen is selected by operating the operation unit. The server can update the role table on the basis of the role notification information, create the role selection promotion information on the basis of the role table after update, and transmit it to the corresponding terminal.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 9

title_en: Bridge crosswind detection safety warning device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a bridge crosswind detects safety warning device belongs to crosswind and detects and warning technical field. The influence of crosswind on the driving safety of roads such as bridges cannot be ignored. The utility model discloses a wind-force conversion device, notice the sucking disc support of crosswind luminous marking device, novel alarm sound generating mechanism, manual formula telescopic link and bottom. Aim at provides a bridge crosswind detects safety warning device, notices crosswind luminous sign and novel alarm sounder and opens simultaneously, realizes the purpose of real-time detection bridge crosswind intensity, the device member withdraw with folding realization be convenient for install the purpose of transportation. The sound and the image are displayed simultaneously to remind the driver of paying attention to crosswind, and the warning effect can be still achieved when the visibility is low, so that the driving safety is guaranteed. The wind energy realizes autonomous power generation, and the mutual conversion among the wind energy, the mechanical energy and the electric energy realizes the operation and the work of the device, and is clean, environment-friendly and efficient. Further ensuring the driving safety of the bridge and other road sections.

title_en: Method, system and program product for monitoring and managing emergency alert system devices
abstract_en: A method of monitoring and managing Emergency Alert System/Common Alerting Protocol (EAS/CAP) devices includes providing a system, the system including processor(s) in communication with memory(ies) storing instructions for execution by the processor(s), the instructions enabling the monitoring and assisting with managing EAS/CAP devices, monitoring by the system a status of the EAS/CAP devices, the status relating to configuration settings and updates to software and firmware for the EAS/CAP devices, aggregating by the system government required compliance logs for the EAS/CAP devices, resulting in aggregated compliance logs, generating report(s) regarding the EAS/CAP devices with assistance from the system, the report(s) including a consolidated compliance report for providing to government agency(ies), the consolidated compliance report including the aggregated compliance logs, and managing the configuration settings and updates to software and firmware for the EAS/CAP devices with assistance from the system.

title_en: Commodity state management system of disaster prevention commodity
abstract_en: To provide a system which enables information sharing for disaster prevention commodities that are saved for emergency by managing commodity state data for the disaster prevention commodities that are saved for emergency and allows a user to perform management such that the replacement of the disaster prevention commodities that are stored in a home or the like can be correctly executed and stockpiles can be maintained in the correct state at all times.SOLUTION: A system comprises: a commodity database which stores commodity information including the expiration date and user information in association with a specific ID given to a disaster prevention commodity; replacement notice notification means which monitors the expiration date in a prescribed monitoring schedule, determines whether the replacement timing of the disaster prevention commodity has come, and transmits a replacement notice notification when it is determined that the replacement timing has come; and a software program which is installed in a portable terminal and realizes, in cooperation with the portable terminal, notification reception means for automatically receiving the replacement notice notification, replacement command means for transmitting an order request of the disaster prevention commodity relevant to the replacement notice notification and browsing means connected to the commodity database for browsing the commodity information.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Acoustic-optical-electronic map system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an acousto-optic electronic map system, including 36 way linkage modules, voice module, passive loudspeaker, active loudspeaker, air brushing plastics printing plate, LED total alarm indicator, LED running state indicator, LED walk word screen, LED cloth defence indicator, LED withdraw of garrison indicator and a plurality of LED branch alarm indicator, 36 way linkage modules include main chip, 32 way output terminal, 485 bus data interface, alarm host data interface, serial data interface and state data interface, voice module links to each other with 36 way linkage modules's main chip; the 485 bus data interface, the alarm host data interface and the serial port data interface are respectively externally connected with an alarm host. The utility model discloses an acousto-optic electronic map system, existing light has sound again, can directly indicate the dangerous situation kind, need not rely on computer control, breaks away from software, accomplishes to report to the police synchronous broadcast pronunciation, and one shot forming need not to maintain in the future for the alarm technique is more humanized.

title_en: Emergency message dissemination method and system based on trust cascade in Internet of vehicles
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency message dissemination method and system based on trust cascade in Internet of vehicles, wherein the system comprises an authority mechanism, a road side unit and a vehicle: the authority mechanism is responsible for providing registration and revocation services for the vehicle, and storing and updating trust information of the vehicle; the road side unit provides a communication interface for the vehicle and the authority; the vehicle-mounted unit is mounted on the vehicle and can communicate with the adjacent road side unit and other vehicles; when an emergency occurs, the emergency message can be disseminated among nearby vehicles in a trust cascade, wherein entity-oriented trust values (which can be evaluated and updated by and included in the trust certificate) are taken as important weights; the method and the system efficiently apply the entity-oriented trust value to the data-oriented trust evaluation, compared with the existing message dissemination mode, the method and the system have more accurate evaluation result, and have good excitation mechanism, error tolerance, compatibility and robustness.

title_en: Prevention of Bird-Strike using GNSS and SBAS
title_ko: 항법위성시스템과 위성기반 오차보정시스템을 활용한 버드 스트라이크 예방시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a bird strike prevention system using a global navigation satellite system (GNSS) and a satellite-based augmentation system (SBAS). According to the present invention, the bird strike prevention system detects birds (4) through the GNSS (1), increases accuracy through the SBAS (5), and transmits a warning signal to an aircraft (3). According to the present invention, aircraft flight cancellation and casualties caused by bird strikes can be prevented.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 공항용(空港用) 버드 스트라이크(Bird Strike) 예방에 관한 것으로서, 조류는 자연상태에서 천적이 접근한다 해도 크기와 속도에 상관없이 일정 거리 이내에 접근해야 피하는 습성이 있다. 대체로 30m 정도에 반응을 보이는데 그보다 멀면 상대속도가 빠르건 느리건 굳이 피하려 들지 않고 가까워진 다음에야 피하려 들어서 항공기 상대로도 똑같은 반응을 보이기 때문에 피하지 못하고 버드 스트라이크가 일어난다.  
기존의 버드 스트라이크 대책은 대부분 BAT반이라고 불리는 조류통제요원들로 해결한다. 하지만 대부분의 활주로들은 개활지인데다 사람의 입장이 통제되어 새들이 살기 좋은 환경이다. 또한 통제요원들은 습지 같은 곳처럼 가지못하는 곳이 많다. 밤에는 조류관측 조차 어려우며, 공항이 넓은 경우에는 인력 부족 및 Manhour의 문제까지 발생한다. 
어느정도 충돌사고는 대부분 대비할 수 있는 방법이 마련되어 있지만, 조류의 경우 하늘에서 고속으로 날고 있다면 육안으로 확인하는 것은 거의 불가능하고 작아서 레이더로도 발견이 어려운 경우가 많아 항공 관계자들 사이에서 문제가 되고 있다.  
이를 해결하기 위해 새들의 전체적인 움직임을 AI나 빅데이터를 활용해 한번 필터링을 하여 관측 해야 하는 범위를 줄이고, 항법위성시스템(GNSS)과 위성기반 오차보정시스(템SBAS)을 활용해서 기존의 GPS의 정밀도를 높이고 활주로 및 임무형상 내에 있는 새들의 위치를 파악하여 사전에 파일럿, 관제탑, 지휘통제실에 알려주는 시스템을 사용하여 버드 스트라이크를 방지한다. 나아가 미사일, 전투기 등의 국방 및 방산부문에서의 사용도 기대할 수 있다.

title_en: Automobile tracking and notification device and service
abstract_en: An automobile tracking and notification device and an associated communication system provide numerous safety and convenience features that ease the stress of daily operation of an automobile. The device provides functionality for monitoring the location of the vehicle and providing real-time location updates to the user; detecting when the vehicle is being towed or stolen and providing real-time alerts to the user and/or to local authorities; detecting when the vehicle is involved in an accident and alerting nearby authorities; and providing information and guidance relating to diagnostic trouble codes.

title_en: Task scheduling management system, method, device and storage medium thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses a task scheduling management system, method, device and storage medium thereof, compared with the prior art: configuring task parameters and task scheduling on a visual interface; standardizing a standard task interface, providing a platform-level task scheduling center, and improving the development efficiency of engineers; the task execution log is recorded, so that the log can be conveniently tracked by related responsible persons, an early warning threshold value is provided, different early warning mechanisms are dynamically configured, and the method is flexible and universal; the cluster deploys a task executor to ensure high availability of tasks; the disaster recovery mechanism is independently researched and developed, the state of a task executor is monitored through a heartbeat packet, a platform automatically processes a disaster recovery server, faults are transferred, and the usability of a program is improved; the method has the advantages that a gray scale upgrading mechanism is realized, the concept of version numbers is provided, developers can smoothly upgrade the task version, dynamic routing strategies are configured on the bottom layer through Socket communication, the purpose of smooth upgrading is achieved, and the situations of task execution loss and the like caused by upgrading are avoided.

title_en: Method and system for sharing private video stream assets with first responders
abstract_en: A private video surveillance service shares an image stream through an asset lock with government agencies in the event of emergency. Nominated agencies establish access credentials at the surveillance service data center. A camera is shared by a facility administrator's selection of permissions on each camera via privileged web-browser or mobile device. A government agency receives an electronic notification from the administrator to operate an agency dedicated application programming interface. A notification may be customized for each responding agency and each event by dynamically generating a transient link to a secure webserver which expires to limit exposure to ranges of date-time. Video servers remain controlled by the facility administrator.

title_en: Event notification and time awareness system
abstract_en: Disclosed is an event notification and time awareness system having a caregiver computing device and a user notification device, each coupled to a computer server. The user notification device displays event information pertaining to the user, who may have cognitive impairment, including diminished comprehension of time, resulting in difficulty remembering appointments, or basic events related to routine daily living. The computer server is programmed to send event information to the user notification device, including appointments, daily routine activities, or other special messages, in response to data input to the caretaker computing device by a caretaker that may be located remotely from the user. The user notification device includes a grayed-out screen to partially obscure past events while leaving current and future events unobscured.

title_en: Fire rescue marker light
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a fire rescue marker light, including base, shell, warning device and switch, the shell setting is on the base, and the base lower part is provided with the adhesion device, and power storage device is installed on base upper portion, and shell department is provided with warning device, and power storage device and warning device electricity are connected, switch and power storage device control connection. The utility model has the advantages of simple structure also has, easily make and operate, when the fire fighter got into this strange environment and rescues, a large amount of flue gases lead to the fire fighter to see the circumstances on every side unclear, can be convenient for the rescue explore and make things convenient for the fire rescue personnel to withdraw, and this fire rescue identification light is convenient for the fire fighter to make simultaneously.
assignees: HENAN YONG GRANVILLE EQUIP CO LTD

title_en: Quartz clock with early warning function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a quartz clock with early warning function belongs to quartz clock technical field, including shell and angle bead, the shell surface is inlayed and is connected with the electronic quartz table, shell inner chamber bottom surface mounting has the support, fretwork board is installed to support one side, fretwork board top surface mounting has the control panel, the welding of control panel surface has WIFI antenna panel, loudspeaker are all installed to electronic quartz table bottom both sides. The utility model discloses a WIFI antenna panel can be so that control panel connecting network, thereby can receive earthquake alarm information in real time, and update the display time on the electronic quartz table, when the control panel passes through WIFI antenna panel and receives earthquake alarm information, loudspeaker and the operation of LED flashing light strip can be controlled to the control panel, thereby can send the alarm of thorn ear and the light of scintillation, thereby provide near personnel and in time take refuge, and dustproof heat dissipation window can dispel the heat to the quartz clock internal plant again.

title_en: Landslide protection alarm device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a landslide protection alarm device, which comprises a stop block, a buffer rod connected inside the stop block, a pressure sensor arranged below the buffer rod, and a soil discharge groove below the stop block; stop the piece inboard and be connected with the buffer beam, buffer beam below fixed connection pressure sensor, stop the piece top and be equipped with solar cell, the vertical face top that stops the piece is equipped with high pitch warning loudspeaker and LED alarm lamp, it is equipped with the soil discharge groove to stop the piece below, the utility model discloses a design that stops the piece, when landslide appears in the massif, earth slides in stopping the piece, buffer beam buffering partial energy through being connected with the spring from top to bottom, earth gliding speed slows down, earth covers the pressure sensor of buffer beam below, make high pitch warning loudspeaker and LED alarm lamp report to the police simultaneously, earth will stop the piece and push left, make and stop the piece displacement to the left side in soil discharge groove, earth slides in soil discharge groove this moment, further slow down the speed that earth slided, make the resident have more time to withdraw.

title_en: Communication control device, emergency call originating method, and emergency call originating program
abstract_en: The present invention enables emergency notification to a plurality of emergency-notification-accepting systems. Provided is a communication control device 2 that accommodates a subscriber terminal 1, wherein: the communication control device 2 comprises a call control unit 21 for connecting an emergency call originated from the subscriber terminal 1 to an emergency call attendant board 5, and an incoming/outgoing call suppression unit 22 for suppressing an incoming or outgoing call to or from the subscriber terminal 1 for a prescribed period when the emergency call is disconnected by the subscriber terminal 1; and when a call is originated from the subscriber terminal 1 in the prescribed period, the incoming/outgoing call suppression unit 22 assesses whether the call is an emergency call or a general call, cancels the suppression of incoming/outgoing calls to and from the subscriber terminal 1 and connects the call using the call control unit 21 in the case of an emergency call, and does not connect the call in the case of a general call.

title_en: Alarm valve group without hydraulic alarm bell
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a name is [ a class of warning valves that do not have water conservancy alarm bell ], belongs to fire control professional technical field, the problem of solution: the hydraulic alarm bell is easy to block, so that the alarm is failed; the length of a connecting steel pipe between the hydraulic alarm bell and the alarm valve is limited; the installation position of the hydraulic alarm bell is limited by the ambient temperature; the hydraulic alarm bell is additionally provided with a drainage facility and the like. The key points of the scheme for solving the problem are as follows: 1. the fire-fighting electric bell 6 replaces a hydraulic alarm bell to send out an alarm signal; 2. a double-contact pressure switch 5 is adopted to replace a single-contact pressure switch; 3. one contact of the double-contact pressure switch 5 is connected with a fire-fighting electric bell 6 through a wire 7, and the other contact is connected with a fire-fighting water pump control cabinet to control the operation of the fire-fighting water pump; 4. an automatic exhaust valve 4 is additionally arranged at the interface of the hydraulic alarm bell without the existing alarm valve group to exhaust air in an alarm pipeline; 5. because the hydraulic alarm bell is cancelled, no drainage facility is needed to be additionally arranged at the place where the fire-fighting electric bell 6 is arranged.
assignees: THE FOURTH CONSTRUCTION OF CHINA MACHINERY IND CO LTD

title_en: Emergency management system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides an emergency management system and a method, which comprises an information acquisition module, an information reporting module and an information screening module, wherein the personal data information of a managed person is mapped onto a digital map through a digital map meshing technology, and the personal data information is subjected to data screening; screening out data abnormal information according to a preset mechanism; the information early warning module sends early warning to a system manager according to the data abnormal information, so that the system manager can make corresponding decisions conveniently; the information notification module notifies the related party to complete further processing in cooperation with the system manager after the system manager makes a decision; the information tracking module is used for continuously updating information after the managed person arrives at the association party and providing the updated information for the system manager to follow up, so that the problem that the efficiency of the existing top-down troubleshooting mode is too low is solved, the manager of the emergency management system can timely acquire the real-time information of the managed person, and the important emergency can be timely and effectively managed.
assignees: GEOVIS SHENZHEN DIGITAL TECH INDUSTRIAL RESEARCH AND DEVELOPMENT CENTER CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent central signal alarm device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent central signal alarm device, including the organism, one side of organism is connected with the warning board through the hinge rotation, and there is the warning electric bell inside of organism through bolted connection, and the inside one side of organism that is close to the warning electric bell is provided with bee calling organ, and there is the controller bottom of organism through bolted connection, and the inside of warning board all is provided with the light word tablet, and the both sides of warning board are provided with work warning light and cancellation button respectively, and one side of warning board is provided with the display screen. The utility model discloses an alarm electric bell and the bee calling organ that set up, when electrical equipment breaks down, the alarm electric bell sounds, when the circuit breaker breaks down, the bee calling organ sounds the warning when carrying out the circuit breaker trouble, through the relevant equipment of controller control, intelligent degree is higher, the simple operation, the one-level of public address pipe inside is inhaled the sound cotton and is inhaled the sound cotton with the second grade and carry out twice and inhale the sound, make the great outside defeated of sound put through the public address cover, make the great defeated of volume of reporting to the police put, the warning effect is better.
assignees: XINXIANG TAIHANG JINRI POWER EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Safety detection device of fire-fighting equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a safety detection device of fire-fighting equipment, which comprises a base, four corners of the bottom of the base are provided with idler wheels, the top of the base is provided with a first placing groove, an electric telescopic rod is hinged in the first placing groove, the telescopic end of the electric telescopic rod is fixedly connected with a combustion box, the top of the base is provided with a second placing groove, the base is fixedly connected with a detection cylinder, the inner bottom wall of the detection cylinder is fixedly connected with a spring, the top end of the spring is abutted with an insulation board, the insulation board is fixedly connected with a metal sheet, the left side and the right side of the inner wall of the detection cylinder are respectively provided with a first contact point and a second contact point, the left side of the top of the base; the utility model is not only novel structure, through the height of the adjustable combustion chamber of electric telescopic handle, be convenient for detect smoke and fire alarm, detect the dry powder fire extinguisher through detecting a section of thick bamboo, when the dry powder surplus in the dry powder fire extinguisher is less, the warning light can light, reminds the staff fire extinguisher that updates.
assignees: TAIXING CITY CHENGHUA FIRE FIGHTING EQUIPMENT FACTORY

title_ko: 스마트 배리어 경보 장치
abstract_ko: 가정용 또는 사업용 보안 시스템에서 발생할 수 있는 허위 경보의 수를 줄이기 위한 배리어 경보 장치를 제공한다.  하나의 실시례에서는, 문 또는 창문 센서와 같은, 배리어 경보 장치가 문 또는 창문과 같은 배리어가 개방되어 있는지 여부를 판단하고, 사람이 문 또는 창문에 근접하여 구내의 안에 사람이 있는지 여부를 판단한다.  문 또는 창문이 개방되어 있을 때 사람이 감시되는 구내의 안에 있으면, 이것은 그 사람이 감시되는 구내의 안에 있는 것을 허가받은 것을 나타내며, 배리어 경보 장치가 시한 경보 신호를 중앙 보안 패널에 전송하여, 사용자가 보안 대응을 취소하지 않고 미리 결정된 기간이 경과하면 중앙 보안 패널에 의해 보안 대응이 생성되게 한다.

title_en: Apparatus for fine dust broadcastring
title_ko: 미세먼지 방송 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus for broadcasting atmospheric information such as fine dust. More specifically, the present invention relates to a fine dust broadcasting apparatus e for guiding children to understand easily. The fine dust broadcasting apparatus of the present invention can guide the atmospheric quality through a lighting, so that children can easily recognize the atmospheric quality, and can provide the children with interactive contents, so that the children can easily understand interactive learning contents in relation to general atmospheric quality information for air pollution caused by fine dust, ultrafine dust, and ozone. In addition, it is possible to visually guide the atmospheric quality through a lighting or a display device. After allowing children who are focusing on play to pay attention to the broadcasting by reproducing children′s favorite music and theme songs through a speaker, atmospheric quality information and action tips are also transmitted through sound according to the status of the atmospheric quality, so that it is possible to deal with situations corresponding to the change in the atmospheric quality. When the state of the atmospheric quality becomes worse to poor or very poor, the lighting or the display is flickered to allow the children to pay attention to the atmospheric quality, thereby guiding the children to return to home. The apparatus for broadcasting atmospheric information includes: a control unit; a wireless transmission/reception unit for wirelessly transmitting and receiving data by the control unit; a lighting that emits color set by the control unit; a display for outputting an image by the control unit; a speaker for outputting sound by the control unit; a microphone that receives ambient sound by the control unit; a camera for photographing the surroundings by the control unit as an image; and a motion detection sensor unit that detects a user′s motion around the control unit.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 미세먼지 등의 대기정보를 방송하는 장치로 더 구체적으로는 어린이도 쉽게 이해할 수 있도록 안내하는 것을 특징으로 하는 미세먼지 방송 장치로서 본 발명의 미세먼지 방송 장치는 조명을 통해 대기질상태를 안내할 수 있으므로 어린이가 쉽게 대기질상태를 인식하도록 할 수 있으며, 어린이에게 인터렉티브 컨텐츠를 제공하므로 미세먼지, 초미세먼지, 오존 등에 의한 대기오염과 관련하여 종합적인 대기질정보와 관련하여 인터렉티브 학습 콘텐츠를 어린이 사용자가 쉽게 이해할 수 있는 장점이 있다. 또한 조명 또는 디스플레이 장치를 통해 시각적으로 대기질상태를 안내할 수 있으며, 스피커를 통해 어린이들이 좋아하는 음악, 주제가 등을 송출하여 놀이에 집중하고 있는 어린이들의 주의를 집중시킨 뒤 대기질 상태에 따라 대기질정보 및 행동요령을 소리로도 전달하여 대기질변화에 따른 상황 대처가 가능하도록 하는 장점이 있다. 대기질 상태가 나쁨이나 매우 나쁨으로 악화되면 송출불륨이 커지고 시각적 표현수단인 조명 및 디스플레이를 점멸시켜서 주의를 환기하여 어린이들이 집으로 귀가할 수 있도록 유도하는 장점이 있다.

title_en: System for fine dust broadcastring
title_ko: 미세먼지 방송 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention is a device for broadcasting atmospheric information such as fine dust and, more specifically, is a fine dust broadcasting device which guides children to allow them for ease of understanding. The fine dust broadcasting device of the present invention can guide air quality through lighting, so that the children can easily recognize the air quality. By providing interactive content to the children, children users can easily understand the interactive learning content in relation to comprehensive air quality information related to air pollution caused by fine dust, ultrafine dust, ozone, and the like.

title_en: Mountain area small watershed mountain torrent early warning system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mountain area small watershed mountain torrent early warning system relates to mountain torrent early warning technical field, and its technical scheme main points include water level monitoring module, entry early warning module, video module and monitor terminal. The utility model has the effect of early warning by sending early warning information to the home-entry early warning module to start the mountain torrent abstaining early warning after the water level depth of the small watershed in the mountain area is monitored to exceed the maximum threshold value by the water level monitoring module; and meanwhile, the instruction sent to the monitoring terminal enables the staff at the monitoring terminal to carry out remote video monitoring through the video module, observe the actual situation of the site, make corresponding decisions, and further send an emergency evacuation instruction or a cancellation instruction of early warning misinformation to the home-entry early warning module, so that timely, effective and accurate early warning effect is realized, and the lives and properties of related staff are effectively protected.

title_en: Intelligent fire-fighting early warning Internet of things system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of Internet of things, and discloses an intelligent fire-fighting early warning Internet of things system which comprises an intelligent fire-fighting early warning Internet of things cloud platform, a data comprehensive collector and a fire-fighting equipment sensor, wherein the data comprehensive collector is installed on a fire-fighting site and is connected with the fire-fighting equipment sensor in a 485 wired transmission mode, a 433 wireless transmission mode or an LORA wireless transmission mode, the intelligent fire-fighting early warning Internet of things cloud platform comprises an MQTT message queue server and a service server, the data comprehensive collector is connected with the MQTT message queue server through a 3G network, a 4G network or a 5G network, and the MQTT message queue server is connected with the service server. According to the intelligent fire-fighting equipment access control method, different transmission modes and transmission strategies are adopted, and access of part types of traditional fire-fighting equipment is supported, so that the entrance threshold of intelligent fire fighting is reduced, deployment of the Internet of things is promoted, construction of a smart city is accelerated, and defense deployment and defense withdrawal can be carried out on the fire-fighting equipment remotely.

title_en: Emergency alert setting control based on location change
abstract_en: An electronic apparatus for emergency alert setting control based on a location change, is provided. The electronic apparatus stores emergency alert setting and location information associated with a known location of the electronic apparatus. The electronic apparatus detects a change in the known location of the electronic apparatus from the known location to a different location. The electronic apparatus outputs notification information to update the stored emergency alert setting based on the detected change in the known location of the electronic apparatus. The electronic apparatus receives a first user input corresponding to at least one emergency setting parameter of the stored emergency alert setting based on the output notification information. The electronic apparatus updates the emergency alert setting based on the received user input and receives new emergency information, included in multimedia content, from a different broadcast station via a different broadcast channel based on the updated emergency alert setting.

title_en: Device for automatically deciding of carrying-in/carrying-out proscribed goods using machine learning
title_ko: 머신 러닝을 이용한 반입/반출 금지물 자동 판별 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a device for automatically distinguishing a carry in-out prohibited item by using machine learning. The present invention includes: a baggage image generation unit generating a transmission image with respect to baggage by scanning the baggage; a generalized image generation unit generating a generalized image of the baggage by machine learning from the transmission image of the baggage generated by the baggage image generation unit; a prohibited item image storage unit storing an image of a carry in-out prohibited item in the baggage; an image determination unit comparing the image of the prohibited item with one among the transmission image of the baggage and the generalized image and determining the baggage as a prohibited item when the degree of similarity between the prohibited item image and the baggage image is equal to or higher than a set value; a prohibited item notification unit notifying a user of the fact that the baggage is a prohibited item when the baggage is determined as a prohibited item; and an image update unit updating the prohibited item image storage unit when the baggage is a prohibited item such that one among the transmission image of the baggage and the generalized image is additionally stored as an image of a prohibited item matching the baggage stored in the prohibited item image storage unit.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 머신 러닝을 이용한 반입/반출 금지물 자동 판별 장치에 관한 것으로, 본 발명은 수하물을 스캔하여 해당 수하물에 대한 투과 이미지를 생성하는 수하물 이미지 생성부; 상기 수하물 이미지 생성부에서 생성된 수하물의 투과 이미지를 머신 러닝을 이용하여 해당 수하물에 대한 일반화 이미지를 생성하는 일반화 이미지 생성부; 상기 수하물 중 반입 및 반출 금지물의 이미지를 저장하는 금지물 이미지 저장부; 상기 수하물의 투과 이미지 및 일반화 이미지 중 어느 하나의 이미지와, 상기 금지물의 이미지를 서로 비교하여 수하물 이미지와 금지물 이미지의 유사도가 설정값 이상인 경우 해당 수하물을 금지물로 판별하는 이미지 판별부; 상기 수하물이 금지물로 판별된 경우, 사용자에게 해당 수하물이 금지물임을 알리는 금지물 알림부; 및 상기 수하물이 금지물로 판별된 경우, 상기 수하물의 투과 이미지 및 일반화 이미지 중 어느 하나를 금지물 이미지 저장부에 저장된 해당 수하물과 매칭되는 금지물의 이미지로 추가 저장하도록 해당 금지물 이미지 저장부를 업데이트하는 이미지 업데이트부;를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Systems and methods for completing accepted alerts
abstract_en: A system including an alert owner system and an alert communicator system. The alert owner system may include executable instructions to: generate an alert message by defining at least one acceptable message type attribute acceptable in a type attribute field for alert status update messages. The alert communicator system may include executable instructions to: receive an input after receipt of the alert message, the input including one of a first input or a second input, and wherein: after receiving the first input, present the alert message in an alert list on a GUI, and after receiving the second input: open an audio link to a device at a location associated with the alert message, and generate at least one alert status update message by inserting a message type attribute of the at least one acceptable message type attribute in the type attribute field of each respective alert status update message.

title_en: Validating and supplementing emergency call information removing private information
abstract_en: The present invention extends to methods, systems, and computer program products for validating and supplementing emergency call information removing private information. A probability that an emergency call originated from a location is derived from features of a normalized signal version of the emergency call. An additional normalized signal is accessed within a specified distance of the location. The location is validated from features of the additional signal. An event is detected from the features of the normalized signal version of the emergency call based on the validated location. The validated location is associated with an obtained event truthfulness probability for the event. The event is sent to a Public Safety Answering Point (PSAP). A privacy infrastructure spans signal ingestion, event detection, and event notification and protects the integrity of private information.

title_en: Method for informing location of immersed device and electronic device thereof
title_ko: 침수에 대응하여 알람을 발생시키기 위한 방법 및 그 전자 장치
abstract_en: The present disclosure is to inform a user of a location of an electronic device which has been flooded. An operating method of the electronic device comprises the processes of: detecting whether the electronic device is flooded; displaying a notification notifying flooding when the flooding is detected and operating a timer which expires within a predetermined time; and operating an alarm when the timer expires.
abstract_ko: 본 개시(disclosure)는 사용자에게 침수된 전자 장치의 위치를 알리기 위한 것으로, 전자 장치의 동작 방법은 상기 전자 장치의 침수 여부를 감지하는 과정과, 침수가 감지되면 침수 여부를 알리는 알림(notification)을 표시하고 소정 시간 내 만료되는 타이머를 동작시키는 과정과, 상기 타이머가 만료되면, 알람(alarm)을 동작시키는 과정을 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Watching management device, control method thereof, and watching system
abstract_en: To provide a watching management device, its control method, and a watching system for providing appropriate information to each staff.SOLUTION: In a watching system, a management device 200 for managing a monitored person and a staff of a facility includes: a communication unit 204 for communicating with the other device; each terminal equipment 300 held by a plurality of staffs; a staff management table owned by a storage device 220 for managing a communication history with the management device; and a control unit 201 for controlling the management device. The communication unit communicates with each terminal equipment. The control unit updates the staff management table on the basis of a history of communication of each terminal. The communication unit further receives an event from a monitoring device 100 for monitoring the monitored person. The control unit selects the staff estimated to stay in the facility from the history of communication by referring to the staff management table on the basis of the reception of the event. The communication unit transmits a notification associated with the event to the terminal equipment of the selected staff.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_ko: 회로 차단기를 사용하여 부하가 걸린 회로를 모니터링하는 장치 및 방법
abstract_ko: 방법 및 장치는 회로 차단기가 회로에 대해 트립되기 전에 조치가 취해질 수 있도록 열화에 대해 회로를 모니터링하고 열화의 사전 경보를 획득하는 개선된 방법을 제공한다. 이 방법은 회로에 대한 기준선을 설정하고, 회로에 대한 전압 및 전류에 대한 제로 교차점을 모니터링하는 단계를 포함한다. 동작 중에, 회로는 제로 교차점을 사용하여 모니터링되고, 이러한 정보는 변경이 발생했는지를 결정하기 위해 기준선과 비교된다. 기준선 정보는 적절한 신호가 제공되어 적절한 조치가 취해지고, 회로를 중단하며, 교정 조치를 취할 수 있도록 회로가 열화하고 있음을 나타내는 임계값을 설정한다.

title_en: Fire detection device and control method thereof
title_ko: 화재 감지장치 및 이의 제어방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire detection device and a method for controlling the fire detection device, in which a temperature sensing cycle setting unit lengthens or shortens the cycle of temperature sensing based on the temperature sensed by a temperature sensing unit so that fire detection can be performed in a more efficient, more economical, and safer manner. The present invention includes: the temperature sensing unit sensing the intra-building temperature at regular intervals; a control unit determining whether a fire has occurred based on the temperature sensed by the temperature sensing unit; and an alarm unit outputting an alarm by receiving an alarm output signal from the control unit. The control unit includes: a reference temperature setting unit setting a fire occurrence reference temperature; the temperature sensing cycle setting unit setting the sensing cycle of the temperature sensing unit; and a fire occurrence determination unit determining whether a fire has occurred by comparison with the fire occurrence reference temperature based on the temperature sensed by the temperature sensing unit. The temperature sensing cycle setting unit sets the initial sensing cycle of the temperature sensing unit as a first cycle. When the temperature sensed by the temperature sensing unit using the first cycle and for a certain period of time is measured to be equal to or lower than the fire occurrence reference temperature, the temperature sensing cycle setting unit of the fire detection device changes and sets the sensing cycle of the temperature sensing unit to a second cycle, which is greater in time interval than the first cycle.
abstract_ko:

title_en: Data updating method and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a data updating method and a storage medium, which are applied to a data updating system, wherein the data updating system comprises a database server, disaster recovery library equipment, message subscription management equipment and terminal equipment, and the method comprises the following steps: after detecting the update of the target database log file, the database server sends the target database log file to the disaster backup library equipment so that the disaster backup library equipment can identify the processing type corresponding to the log file label, and if the processing type is the designated forwarding processing type, the target database log file is sent to the message subscription management equipment; the message subscription management device writes the target database log file into the partition of the topic corresponding to the target database log file, determines the application program subscribed to the topic, and sends a notification message to the terminal device running the application program. By adopting the method and the device, the working pressure of the database server can be reduced, and the data of the application program can be changed more timely.

title_en: Smart speaker system
abstract_en: A smart speaker system is used as an emergency notification system. The smart speaker has a loudspeaker, a microphone, a visual display, processing capability, and an emergency flasher in the same enclosure. The smart speaker is in communication with a network-connected server providing at least distribution of emergency notification messages to appropriate clients. The amount of audio processing shared between the smart speaker and the server may vary, depending on the requirements of the installation site. Once an emergency voice communication is detected in the microphone output, the system generates a confirmation message that is played over the loudspeaker. Upon detection of an appropriate voice response from the user, the system generates an emergency response message, sends it to the distribution network, and activates the visual display, loudspeaker, and emergency flasher. Noise cancellation circuitry prevents loudspeaker interference with microphone output.

title_en: Core network disaster recovery backup service recovery method and core network

title_en: Safety apparatus for CO2 fire extinguishing facility
title_ko: 이산화탄소 소화설비의 안전장치
abstract_en: According to the present invention, a safety apparatus installed on a fire extinguishing facility of a carbon dioxide medium comprises: an olfactory means (20) to accommodate an odorizer (23) on a chemical container (21) coupled to a fire pipe (10), and cause withdrawal of the odorizer (23) through a rupture film (25); and a visual means (30) to accommodate the rupture film (25) on a storage container (31) coupled to the fire pipe (10), and cause withdrawal of a color adding agent (33) through a rupture film (35). The visual means (30) uses the color adding agent (33) formed in at least one of gas and powder while having noninflammability and harmlessness to a human body. The safety apparatus further comprises an acoustic means (40) linked to the fire pipe (10) as a modified example of the present invention. Accordingly, even if a defect is present on the pipe or carbon dioxide is leaked by malfunction, a warning is olfactorily created by the odorizer and a color identified by naked eyes is added to notify whether carbon dioxide exists to induce quick escape to promote safety improvement by preventing a suffocation accident or the like.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 이산화탄소 매개의 소화설비에 설치되는 안전장치에 있어서: 소화배관(10)에 결합되는 약제통(21) 상에 부취제(23)를 수용하고, 파열막(25)을 통하여 부취제(23)의 인출을 유발하는 후각수단(20); 및 소화배관(10)에 결합되는 저장통(31) 상에 파열막(25)을 수용하고, 파열막(35)을 통하여 부색제(33)의 인출을 유발하는 시각수단(30);을 포함하여 이루어진다. 상기 시각수단(30)은 인체무해성과 불연성을 지니면서 기상 및 분말상 중 적어도 하나로 구성되는 부색제(33)를 사용한다. 본 발명의 변형예로서, 상기 소화배관(10)에 연동하는 청각수단(40)을 더 구비하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: On-demand emergency management operations in a distributed computing system
abstract_en: Various methods and systems are provided for providing on-demand emergency management. On-demand emergency management includes emergency management operations (e.g., certificate update operations or managed-secrets rollover operations) for accelerated deployment and expedited installation of certificates or secrets. In operation, a host secret manager on a host machine communicates with client secret managers on virtual machines running the host machine, to provide expedited installation of secrets on the virtual machines. During the certificate update operations, the host secret manager communicates the certificate update secret package having a new secret state to a client secret manager that installs the new certificate state on the virtual machine. And, during managed-secrets rollover operations, based on accessing a managed-secrets rollover secret package having a notification-based new secret state, the host secret manager polls a dSMS service, and communicates with a client secret manager, such that client secret manager installs the new secret on the virtual machine.

title_en: Remote monitoring control apparatus for unmanned pumping station operation and control method thereof
title_ko: 무인 펌프장 운용을 위한 원격감시 제어장치 및 그 제어방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a remote monitoring control device for operating an unmanned pumping station and a control method thereof. The remote monitoring control device for operating unmanned pumping station comprises: a pump station (10); an event capturing vibration sensor (40); a plurality of event capturing cameras (50); an event capturing noise analyzer (55); and a safety inspection wireless service unit (60). The safety inspection wireless service unit (60) is configured to connect to a central monitoring station (90) to wirelessly transmit an inspection event capturing unexpected video along with an inspection event unexpected report, and the safety inspection wireless service unit (60) and a manager mobile terminal (91) are configured to be connected to each other via Bluetooth to transmit an inspection event and an inspection schedule. According to the present invention, the pumping station is operated manlessly, is conveniently maintained, and provides alarms quickly and accurately in case of an emergency situation.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 무인 펌프장 운용을 위한 원격감시 제어장치 및 그 제어방법에 관한 것으로 펌프장을 무인으로 운용하되 유지관리의 편의성 및 긴급상황 발생 시 경보제공이 신속하고 정확하게 전달이 가능하도록 함과 아울러, 지하 무인 펌프장에서의 내부침수, 기기고장, 화재발생 등의 사고상황 발생이나 발생 조짐시에 점검이벤트 돌발경고 보고와 함께 사고상황이 사고발생 조짐 관련영상 보고가 가능하도록 하기 위하여, 배수지에 저류된 정수를 급수구역으로 이송하기 위해 지면(2) 아래의 지중에 내실(11)을 갖도록 설치되는 펌프장(10); 상기 펌프장(10)의 내실(11) 일측에서 타측으로 정수를 이송하도록 송수배관(21)이 구비되고, 상기 송수배관(21)을 통해 이송되는 정수의 펌핑공급을 위해 송수배관(21) 상에 송수펌프(23)가 구비되며, 상기 송수펌프(23)를 통해 이송되는 정수의 완충을 위한 압력조절탱크(25)가 송수펌프(23)의 후방측 송수배관(21) 상에 구비되고, 상기 펌프장(10)의 내실(11) 바닥부(13)에는 내실(11)에서 발생되는 불필요한 물이 수거되는 수거공간부(32)가 함몰 형성되고, 상기 수거공간부(32) 내에는 수거된 고인물을 펌프장(10)의 외부로 배출하기 위한 배수펌프(34)가 구비되며, 상기 송수펌프(23) 및 압력조절탱크(25) 사이의 송수배관(21) 상에 결합 구비되는 이벤트포착용 진동센서(40); 상기 이벤트포착용 진동센서(40)는 지면(2) 상에 구비된 현장제어반(80)에 연결되어 상기 현장제어반(80) 내에 구비된 송신기(82)를 통해 상기 이벤트포착용 진동센서(40)로부터 감지된 발생진동값이 허용기준진동값의 80％∼90％미만의 범위내에 도달하면 중앙감시국(90)에 1차로 진동경계알림을 전송하고, 상기 발생진동값이 허용기준진동값의 90％∼100％미만의 범위내에 도달하면 중앙감시국(90)에 2차로 진동위험알림을 전송하며, 상기 발생진동값이 허용기준진동값의 100％에 도달하면 중앙감시국(90)에 3차로 진동현장출동알림을 전송하도록 구성하고, 상기 펌프장(10) 내실(11)의 내부침수, 기기고장, 화재발생이나 발생 조짐을 포함하는 점검이벤트를 포착하기 위해 내실(11)의 천정부(15) 및 측벽부(16)에 설치되는 다수개의 이벤트포착용 카메라(50); 상기 이벤트포착용 카메라(50)는 현장제어반(80)에 연결되어 상기 현장제어반(80) 내에 구비된 송신기(82)를 통해 상기 이벤트포착용 카메라(50)로부터 녹취된 목적용 촬영영상을 미리 설정된 허용기준영상과 비교하여 이벤트가 발생할 경우 중앙감시국(90)에 영상경고알림을 전송하도록 구성하며, 상기 펌프장(10) 내실(11)의 기기파손, 충격발생을 포함하는 점검이벤트를 포착하기 위해 내실(11)의 천정부(15) 또는 측벽부(16)에 설치되는 이벤트포착용 소음분석기(55); 상기 현장제어반(80)에 구비되어 펌프장(10)의 관리자 이동단말기(91)에 대응된 이동단말고유식별자번호를 할당 받는 안전점검 무선서비스 유니트(60); 상기 안전점검 무선서비스 유니트(60)는 상기 이벤트포착용 진동센서(40), 이벤트포착용 카메라(50) 및 이벤트포착용 소음분석기(55)로부터 송신기(82)로 전달되는 신호를 분석하여 펌프장(10) 내실(11)의 내부침수, 기기고장, 화재발생, 기기파손, 충격발생에 관련되는 상태 변경을 파악하고, 점검이벤트의 돌발여부를 판정하며, 점검이벤트 돌발 판정에 따라 무선모뎀으로 이동단말고유식별자번호 저장부의 이동단말고유식별자번호를 이용해 호(call)를 생성하여 이동통신망(98)을 통해 중앙감시국(90)에 접속하여 점검이벤트 돌발보고와 함께 점검이벤트 포착 돌발영상 저장부로부터의 점검 이벤트 포착 돌발영상을 무선전송하도록 구성하고, 상기 이동단말기(91)에 이벤트포착용 진동센서(40), 이벤트포착용 카메라(50) 및 이벤트포착용 소음분석기(55)를 통해 발생되는 점검이벤트 및 점검일정을 전송하도록 안전점검 무선서비스 유니트(60)와 관리자의 이동단말기(91)는 상호간에 블루투스로 연결되도록 구성하는 것을 포함하여 이루어짐을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Apparatus and method of notifying interested event using machine learning model
title_ko: 기계 학습 모델을 이용한 관심 이벤트의 알림 제공 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: Provided is a notification providing device, which comprises: a microphone detecting an external audio signal; a memory storing information on a sound of interest; an output interface outputting a notification; and a processor performing an operation of detecting the sound of interest based on a machine learning model including a plurality of convolutional-rectified linear unit (ReLU) layers. The notification providing device detects the sound of interest using a machine learning model, and retrains the machine learning model through transfer learning when noise environment information is changed by a reference value or more.
abstract_ko: 외부의 오디오 신호를 검출하는 마이크로 폰; 관심 소리에 대한 정보를 저장하는 메모리; 알림을 출력하는 출력 인터페이스; 및 복수의 컨벌루션-ReLU(Rectified Linear Unit) 레이어를 포함하는 기계 학습 모델에 기초하여, 상기 관심 소리를 검출하는 동작을 수행하는 프로세서를 포함하고, 기계 학습 모델을 이용하여 관심 소리를 검출하고, 노이즈 환경 정보가 기준 값 이상 변경되는 경우 트랜스퍼 러닝을 통해 기계 학습 모델을 재학습하는 알림 제공 장치가 제공된다.

title_en: Vehicle accident management using peer-to-peer networks and systems
abstract_en: Computing nodes in a peer-to-peer network that can receive data about an accident in response to a vehicle having an accident. A computing device in the peer-to-peer network can generate a record of the data and store, in persistent storage, a copy of the record. The computing device can also transmit the record, via peer-to-peer connections, to other computing nodes in the network. The nodes in the network, when receiving the record, can each store a copy of the record and broadcast the record to one or more additional computing nodes in the network to cause the one or more additional computing nodes to store one or more additional copies of the record. Also, in response to an inquiry about the accident, the node can provide the record. And the node can participate in a determination of a network consensus in the network about validity of the record.

title_en: Piezoelectric induction earthquake alarm
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to earthquake alarm field to specifically disclose a piezoelectricity response earthquake alarm, it includes alarm system, earthquake detecting system and control system, wherein: the alarm system comprises a direct current power supply, an alarm bell, an alarm lamp and a switch, wherein the direct current power supply, the alarm bell and the switch are connected in series, and the alarm lamp and the alarm bell are connected in parallel; the earthquake detection system comprises a base, a cantilever beam, piezoelectric patches and a voltmeter, wherein the cantilever beam is fixed on the base, the piezoelectric patches are attached to the upper surface and the lower surface of the cantilever beam and are close to one side where the cantilever beam is contacted with the base, and the voltmeter is connected to the piezoelectric patches; and the control system is respectively connected with the switch and the voltmeter. The utility model discloses an earthquake alarm collects earthquake detection and alarm in an organic whole, can not only detect out the earthquake, can also in time early warning simultaneously, reminds people to withdraw rapidly danger area, increases the user and withdraws the time, avoids causing the casualties.

title_en: Artificial intelligence risk management and control system based on scene recognition drive
abstract_en: The invention discloses a risk management and control system based on scene recognition driving, which comprises a data resource library, an inspection terminal system, a risk management system and an interface standard specification. The safety production risk grading management and control system is based on a data resource platform, based on SOA architecture design, combines the advanced technologies of wireless communication, geographic information service, big data analysis, computer network safety and the like, realizes system data transmission by relying on local area network (intranet) and 4G/WIFI network communication, forms two functional interfaces of mobile terminal application and platform service application based on application support, adopts a standard multi-level system, strictly defines interfaces among the levels, and realizes seamless integration of the system through overall design deployment. The invention can be applied to multi-platform equipment such as mobile phones, tablets, computers and the like, meets the application in environments or places with higher risks, can be remotely used through a public wide area network or a local area network, collects dangerous point data through mobile inspection equipment and uploads the dangerous point data to the database in time, so that the data resource library can update dangerous information data in time and helps enterprises to dynamically master safe production dynamic information anytime and anywhere. Meanwhile, the risk management system carries out early warning management according to data of the data resource library, and meanwhile, by combining a data mining analysis method, artificial intelligence is adopted to predict the risk accident trend, so that an enterprise is helped to make effective decisions. The invention can also be applied to the field of fire fighting, and helps the emergency department to manage and control risks and respond in time.
assignees: TADUN INFORMATION TECH SHANGHAI CO LTD

title_en: Aging management method and aging management terminal for storage materials
abstract_en: An aging management method and an aging management terminal for storage materials are used for carrying out aging management on disposable medical and food materials; the method comprises the following steps of managing the effective period of the original packaging material: the user registers and logs in to clarify a manager and the responsibility thereof, associates or inputs material valid information including material name, specification, manufacturer, production date, validity period and the like, automatically generates a two-dimensional code, collects and counts the valid period and the expiration period of each material in real time, and automatically discriminates and sends out a warning; the method for managing the valid period of the opened materials comprises the following implementation steps: the user registers and logs in to clarify a manager and the responsibility thereof, the code two-dimensional code is scanned, whether the system collects the materials which gradually fail in an effective period or not is identified, and the materials are automatically distinguished and sent out a warning; the invention aims at effectively using and managing materials and supplies which need to be effectively used for packaging and unsealing, and avoids the loss of personnel, assets and even public safety caused by using invalid materials.
