title_en: Evacuation guidance apparatus using led display
title_ko: 엘이디 디스플레이를 이용한 대피안내장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an evacuation guidance apparatus which broadcasts evacuation signal information through first and second display units when a fire occurs and lowers an elevation-type display unit through an elevation unit when the vision of an evacuee can be secured and the evacuation signal information is difficult to be recognized due to smoke caused by the fire, such that the corresponding evacuation signal information can be recognized and a fixed display unit is used as lighting to enable the evacuee to safely escape from the fire. More specifically, the evacuation guidance apparatus comprises: the fixed display unit fixed and installed to a wall surface to detect smoke caused by fire and displaying an evacuation signal by an applied control signal; the elevation type display unit disposed on the lower part of the fixed display unit to display an evacuation signal by an applied control signal and guided and elevated to the fixed display unit; and the elevation unit fixed and installed to a wall surface and connected to a wire rolled or unrolled from a roll by rotation to elevate the elevation type display unit in accordance with the rotation direction of the roll. The evacuation signal displayed through the fixed and elevation type display units is displayed by a plurality of LEDs emitting light by applied power. When detecting smoke, the fixed display unit transmits detection information to the elevation unit to lower the elevation type display unit by a control signal of the elevation unit.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재가 발생시에 대피신호정보를 제1 및 제2영상부에 이해 송출하되 화재로 인한 연기로 인해 대피자의 시야 확보 및 대피신호정보의 인식이 용이하지 못하면 승강부를 통해 승강형 영상공급부를 하강시켜 해당 대피신호정보의 인지는 물론, 고정형 영상제공부가 조명으로 활용되어 대피자가 안전하게 대피할 수 있는 대피안내장치에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 벽면에 고정 설치되어 화재로 인한 연기를 감지하되 인가되는 제어신호에 의해 대피신호를 디스플레이하는 고정형 영상제공부와, 상기 고정형 영상제공부 하부에 위치하되 인가되는 제어신호에 의해 대피신호를 디스플레이하며, 상기 고정형 영상제공부에 안내되어 승강할 수 있도록 구비되는 승강형 영상공급부 및 상기 고정형 영상제공부 상부에 위치하도록 벽면에 고정 설치되되 회전에 의해 권취 또는 권출되는 롤러에 감겨진 와이어와 연결되어 상기 롤러의 회전방향에 따라 상기 승강형 영상공급부를 승강시키는 승강부를 포함하되, 상기 고정형 영상제공부와 상기 승강형 영상공급부를 통해 디스플레이되는 대피신호는 인가되는 전원에 의해 발광하는 다수의 엘이디이며, 상기 고정형 영상제공부는 연기를 감지하면 그 감지정보를 상기 승강부에 전송하여 상기 승강부의 제어신호에 의해 상기 승강형 영상공급부를 하강시키는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: PLC Floor recessed type lead lamp
title_ko: 전력선 통신 바닥 매립형 유도등
abstract_ko:
본 고안은 화재발생이나 정전, 지진 등의 위험한 상항에서 위험지역의 사람들을 안전한 지역으로 유도하고 적절한 경로를 선택하여 방향을 지시하는 방향 변경이 가능한 매립형 바닥유도등 시스템에 관한 것이다. 상세하게는 지하철이나 창이 없는 건물 내부에 설치되어 화재발생이나 정전 등의 상황에서 비상구 또는 출구의 위치를 표시하여 선택적으로 안전한 방향으로 표시하고 순차적으로 비상구나 출구방향으로 표시하여 사람들에게 위험 회피 방향을 알려주는 매립형 바닥유도등과 이를 이용한 비상 유도등 관리 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
 본 고안의 매립형 바닥유도등 시스템에 있어서 위험발생시 상황을 전파하는 비상벨본체; 비상벨 본체 내에 수동으로 방향 선택 할 수 있는 방향선택 스위치장치; 비상벨 본체와 연결되어 있고, 중앙으로 위험발생을 전달하고, 위험지대를 회피하여 안전한 방향으로 선택적으로 표시 할 수 있게 하고 전력선 통신모뎀이 내장되어 있고, 정전 시 일정한 시간동안 동작하게 할 수 있는 충전지가 내장되어 있어서 방향 선택 표시가 가능하고 비상안내 방송이 가능한 매립형 바닥유도등본체; 매립형 바닥유도등 본체와 연결되어 중앙 관리자가 제어하는 중앙 본체; 중앙 본체와 연결된 안내방송 시스템; 구성되어 있는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Information display method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to an information display method and device and electronic equipment. Wherein, the method comprises the following steps: receiving new information to be displayed when the first information is displayed on the display interface; when the new information to be displayed is received, determining the next information to be displayed; if the determined next information to be displayed is the new information to be displayed, taking the new information to be displayed as the next information to be displayed; and if the priority of the new information to be displayed is higher than that of the first information, canceling the display of the first information and broadcasting the new information to be displayed. In the embodiment of the disclosure, when new information to be displayed is available, the new information to be displayed has a priority higher than that of the currently displayed information, the currently displayed information can be cancelled immediately, so that the new information to be displayed can be displayed in time, and the instantaneity of emergency information display and the timeliness of the information can be effectively guaranteed.
assignees: BEIJING DAJIA INTERCONNECTION INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power plant equipment fault early warning method and system based on dual networks
abstract_en: The invention provides a power plant equipment fault early warning method and system based on dual networks, which comprises the following steps: determining working condition parameters of real-time operation of power plant unit equipment; inputting the working condition parameters into the trained double-network model to calculate sample energy corresponding to the working condition parameters; the dual network model includes: a self-encoding network and an estimation network; the self-coding network is used for extracting depth characteristic data of working condition parameters; estimating the distribution probability of the network estimation depth feature data under the Gaussian mixture model, updating the parameters of the Gaussian mixture model based on the distribution probability, and determining the sample energy corresponding to the working condition parameters based on the updated parameters of the Gaussian mixture model; and when the sample energy is greater than the early warning threshold value, the corresponding power plant unit equipment is considered to be in fault. The method can extract the characteristics of the high-dimensional data so as to avoid the dimension disaster problem which is difficult to process by the traditional machine learning method; the time cost of network training and use is reduced without affecting the decoding capability.

title_en: Sound-light alarm device for reversing of development machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a heading machine audible and visual alarm that backs a car, comprising a supporting seat, the last fixed surface of supporting seat installs the warning base, the cavity has been seted up to the inside of warning base, the top fixed mounting of cavity has the controller, the bottom fixed mounting of cavity has the speaker, the surface side of warning base is opened and is equipped with the mounting groove, the inside embedding fixedly connected with infrared distance meter of mounting groove. The utility model discloses in, when the entry driving machine is backed a car, the controller controls the start-up of speaker and alarm lamp simultaneously, the speaker sends audible alarm, remind personnel to withdraw, avoid causing the accidental injury to operation personnel on every side, it finishes to back a car, the signal of telecommunication disappears, the end is reported to the police, the infrared distance meter can measure the people behind the entry driving machine and the distance of automobile body, when the distance is too little, pass the signal to the controller, controller control speaker and alarm lamp send out stronger alarm signal to further promote alarming function.

title_en: Disaster prevention system
abstract_en: To provide a disaster prevention system capable of easily and surely confirming a correspondence between a disaster prevention terminal such as a fire sensor indicated in a plan view of a warning area and a disaster prevention terminal installed at a site.SOLUTION: The present invention relates to a disaster prevention system including fire notification facilities 1 each comprising a receiver 10 and fire sensors 14. When a plan view of a warning area in which sensor symbols indicating the fire sensors 14 is disposed is displayed on a portable telephone terminal 30, and a sensor symbol desired to be confirmed is selected and operated, a confirmation signal designating an address of the corresponding fire sensor 14 is transmitted to the receiver 10 via a portable telephone network 28, an internet 24 and a server 26. The receiver 10 transmits a confirmation control signal to a signal line 12-1 based on the confirmation signal received from the portable telephone terminal 30, and an acknowledgement is notified by lighting or flickering an alarm indication light 14a provided in the fire sensor 14 of which the address matches.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Security systems and methods of operation
abstract_en: A security system and methods for managing same are disclosed. The security system include an on-site security system including one or more alarm condition sensors and at least one site control unit configured to communicate with the alarm condition sensors, and a security management service located remotely from the on-site security system and configured to communicate with the site control unit and at least one authorised user associated with the on-site security system. The service issues an alarm notification to at least one authorised user, the alarm notification identifying at least a sensor triggering issuance of the alarm notification, a location of the sensor, and a time of the sensor being triggered. The service monitors for acknowledgement of the alarm notification from the authorised user, and issues a response request to at least one security responder in the absence of an acknowledgement.

title_en: Highway electronic early warning device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a highway electron early warning device, the on-line screen storage device comprises a first base, the fixed pneumatic cylinder that is provided with in first base top, the fixed casing that is provided with in pneumatic cylinder top, the fixed display screen that is provided with in casing one side, a plurality of first recesses have all been seted up to the casing both sides, the inside fixed laser emitter that is provided with of first recess, first base is inside to have seted up first storehouse of placing, the first inside bottom mounting in storehouse of placing is provided with first battery, the first storehouse bottom of placing is at the fixed control box that is provided with in first battery one side, first battery is connected with laser emitter, pneumatic cylinder, display screen and control box, the control box includes processing module, wireless transmission module, alarm module. The utility model discloses simple structure in time reminds the staff through alarm device to road surface operation personnel have enough time to withdraw to safe region, avoid owing to avoid the personal casualties that causes untimely.

title_en: Hidden culvert water level and gas monitoring alarm device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a hidden culvert water level and gas monitoring alarm device, which comprises a water immersion detector, a safety power supply, a power switch, a junction box, a plurality of gas detectors and an acousto-optic alarm; the water immersion detector is arranged at the corresponding set safe water level height of the upper stream culvert side wall of the construction working surface; the plurality of gas detectors are mounted upstream of the operating location to the operating location; the audible and visual alarm is arranged on the side wall of the dark culvert on the downstream working surface; the connecting lines of the water immersion detector, the safety power supply, the gas detector and the audible and visual alarm are connected with the wiring structure arranged in the junction box. The utility model discloses to the dark culvert that the condition such as rain, upper reaches reservoir drain, municipal pipeline wash or other upper reaches are not clear to come water and rise in water level and monitor and the inside poisonous and harmful gas of dark culvert along the line of construction, withdraw rapidly for dark culvert construction operation personnel and mechanical equipment and provide more sensitive early warning signal, reach the purpose of guarantee personnel and mechanical equipment safety.

title_en: A fire rescue system that uses 3d mapping signals from an air purifying device to detect and locate fires
title_ko: 공기 정화 디바이스로부터 3차원 맵핑된 구조 신호를 이용하는 화재 구조 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire and rescue system using a 3D mapped rescue signal from an air purification device and, more specifically, to a fire and rescue system which safely protects a user from toxic gas in case of fire, allows the user to easily replace a filter when the life of the filter expires during the use of the device, can continuously and hermetically protect the user′s respiratory system from external harmful substances and fine dust even while the filter is being replaced, detects whether the user is wearing the air purification device normally, and determines whether or not airtightness is maintained and generates a notification so that the user can recognize the determination. Therefore, the fire and rescue system can maximize the effect of wearing and, in case of fire, can quickly rescue the user by accurately grasping the location of the user waiting for rescue. The fire and rescue system comprises a main body, a purification unit, a discharge unit, a face cover, a binding member, and a sensing means.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 공기 정화 디바이스로부터 3차원 맵핑된 구조 신호를 이용하는 화재 구조 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 화재 발생 시 유독가스로부터 사용자를 안전하게 보호하고, 사용 중에 필터의 수명이 다할 경우, 사용자가 손쉽게 필터를 교체하고, 필터를 교체하는 중에도 사용자의 호흡기관계를 외부 유해물질 및 미세분진으로부터 지속적으로 기밀하게 보호할 수 있으며, 사용자가 공기 정화 디바이스를 정상적으로 착용하였는지 여부를 감지하고, 기밀을 유지하였는지의 여부를 판별하여 사용자가 인지할 수 있도록 알림을 발생시킴으로써, 착용에 따른 효과를 극대화할 수 있고, 더불어 화재의 발생 시, 구조를 기다리는 사용자의 위치를 정확하게 파악하여 신속하게 구조할 수 있는 화재 구조 시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Earthquake broadcasting method, system, electronic equipment and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides an earthquake broadcasting method, an earthquake broadcasting system, electronic equipment and a readable storage medium, and relates to the technical field of disaster early warning, wherein the embodiment of the invention updates the current earthquake early warning information into the Nth earthquake early warning information according to the received Nth earthquake early warning information, wherein N is a positive integer greater than or equal to 1; and then generating an Nth report voice broadcast content aiming at the updated Nth report earthquake early warning information, and broadcasting the Nth report voice broadcast content, so that more accurate earthquake early warning content can be broadcast to users in real time within earthquake early warning time, and more reasonable risk avoidance measures can be taken for people within a short time.
assignees: CHENGDU MEIHUAN TECH CO LTD;INST OF CARE LIFE

title_en: Public early warning broadcasting method, system and base station equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a public early warning broadcasting method, a public early warning broadcasting system and base station equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: enabling the AMF to send a write-in replacement early warning request message to the gNB-CU-CP through the NG interface; enabling the gNB-CU-CP to generate an F1 interface message according to the replacement indication written in the replacement early warning request message and the new public early warning information, and sending an F1 interface message to the gNB-DU, wherein the F1 interface message comprises a replacement indication bit and the new public early warning information; and enabling the gNB-DU to replace the current public warning broadcast information by the new public warning information in the F1 interface message according to the replacement indication bit in the F1 interface message. By the scheme, F1 interface signaling can be reduced, repeated cancellation and restarting of resource scheduling are avoided, and the problems of early warning information transmission delay and the like can be reduced.

title_en: Geological disaster prevention and control full-flow management system, method and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a geological disaster prevention and control full-flow management system, a geological disaster prevention and control full-flow management method and a geological disaster prevention and control full-flow management storage medium, wherein the geological disaster prevention and control full-flow management system comprises a hidden danger point adding unit, a hidden danger point adding unit and a hidden danger point storing unit, wherein the hidden danger point adding unit is used for; the hidden trouble point processing unit is used for determining a hidden trouble point processing scheme; the hidden danger point processing result determining unit is used for determining a hidden danger point processing result; the hidden danger point management unit is used for verifying and canceling or recording hidden danger point information according to a processing result of the hidden danger point; the hidden danger point monitoring and early warning unit is used for acquiring hidden danger point monitoring information and generating early warning; and the maintenance management and maintenance unit is used for acquiring and storing the maintenance data of the processed hidden danger points. The problem of can't carry out orderly improvement to the easy point of sending out of geological disasters is solved, this application has the effect of comparatively orderly improvement geological disasters easy point of sending out.
assignees: REAL ESTATE ASSESSMENT CENTER SHENZHEN SHENZHEN GEOLOGICAL ENV MONITORING CENTER

title_en: Automatic anti-theft alarm device for oil tank operation well of gas station
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of gas station anti-theft, in particular to an automatic anti-theft alarm device for a gas station oil tank operation well, which comprises a wireless remote control alarm controller provided with an antenna, wherein the wireless remote control alarm controller is electrically connected with a sound and light alarm box, the wireless remote control alarm controller is also electrically connected with a remote controller for controlling the wireless remote control alarm controller, a wireless vibrating bar and a wireless infrared detector, the wireless repeater and the emergency alarm, wireless vibrting spear is installed inside the oil tank cover of oil tank, is equipped with a plurality of wireless infrared fences around the oil tank, and the periphery of wireless infrared fence is equipped with a plurality of wireless infrared detection instruments, the inside group battery that is equipped with of wireless vibrting spear, be equipped with on the remote controller to be used for removing the alert key of withdrawing the guards and set up the alert key of deploying the guards, and this device has solved traditional automatic burglar alarm of filling station oil tank operation well problem that the output is single.

title_en: Disaster information contribution processing system, disaster information contribution processing method, and disaster information contribution processing server device
abstract_en: To secure reliability of disaster information contributed by a viewer side and provide it for a specific area in television broadcasting.SOLUTION: According to an embodiment, a disaster information contribution processing system is applied to a television broadcasting system for performing bidirectional information exchange between a broadcasting station and a television terminal whose broadcasting jurisdiction area is registered. The disaster information contribution processing system is configured to: contribute disaster information from the television terminal to the broadcasting station; distribute, from the broadcasting station to a television terminal in the area including the television terminal having contributed the disaster information, information confirmation information for inquiring correctness of the contributed disaster information and a disaster situation; reply to the information confirmation information from the television terminal in the area; determine reliability of the contributed disaster information and the disaster situation from a reply result to the information confirmation information; distribute a disaster corresponding content including the disaster situation to the television terminal in the area on the basis of a determination result; display the disaster corresponding content on the television terminal in the area to promote disaster corresponding processing; and notify the broadcasting station of the disaster corresponding content to update the disaster situation.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Disaster recovery backup method, device, equipment and machine readable storage medium
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a disaster recovery backup method, apparatus, device and machine-readable storage medium, the method comprising: broadcasting disaster recovery backup information so that other servers connected with local communication can obtain the backup information; selecting a disaster tolerance mirror server from other servers which have acquired the backup information; and according to the fault state, notifying the selected disaster recovery mirror server to start disaster recovery backup. According to the technical scheme, the server broadcasts disaster tolerance backup information generated according to local BMC version information and/or hardware resource information to other servers in the cluster, so that the other servers backup the disaster tolerance backup information of the local server, then one server which backups the disaster tolerance backup information is selected as a disaster tolerance mirror server, and the disaster tolerance mirror server is notified to start disaster tolerance backup when a fault occurs, and therefore important services are guaranteed not to be interrupted.

title_en: Autonomous Robot system imposed life­saving in invisible area
title_ko: 비가시 영역 내 인명 유무를 고려한 자율형 로봇 시스템 및 인명 유무 판단방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an autonomous robot system considering whether a person exists in an invisible area and a method for determining whether a person exists. More specifically, the autonomous robot system considering whether a person exists in an invisible area includes: an autonomous robot platform including an image photographing means photographing image information; and a person existence determination system including an image information obtaining part obtaining the image information, a possible person existence area extraction part extracting a possible person existence area from the image information obtained from the image information obtaining part; a person existence determination part determining whether a person exists in the possible person existence area; and a work plan change notification part transmitting work change and notification information to the autonomous robot platform if the person existence determination part determines that a person exists.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 비가시 영역 내 인명 유무를 고려한 자율형 로봇 시스템 및 인명 유무 판단방법에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 영상정보를 촬상하는 영상촬상수단이 구비되는 자율형 로봇 플랫폼; 및 상기 영상정보를 획득하는 영상정보획득부와, 상기 영상정보획득부에서 획득된 영상정보에서 인명존재 가능 영역을 추출하는 인명존재가능영역추출부와, 상기 가능 영역에서 인명존재유무를 판단하는 인명존재여부판단부와, 상기 인명존재여부판단부에 의해 인명이 존재한다고 판단되면 작업변경, 알림정보를 상기 자율형 로봇 플랫펌으로 전송하는 작업계획 변경 알림부를 갖는 인명존재여부판단시스템;을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 비가시 영역 내 인명 유무를 고려한 자율형 로봇 시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Disaster broadcasting system
title_ko: 재난 방송 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a disaster broadcasting system and, more specifically, to a disaster broadcasting system capable of bidirectional communications with a TV system installed in a home, which forcibly turns on the TV system even when the TV system is off to provide a disaster response broadcast. According to one aspect of the present invention, provided is a disaster broadcasting facility for receiving a TV broadcast signal and a signal including disaster information from an external signal source and transmitting a disaster response broadcast to a home terminal. The disaster broadcasting facility comprises: a receiver for receiving a broadcast signal including the disaster information from the external signal source; a signal analysis unit for analyzing the disaster information from the broadcast signal: a control signal generation unit for generating a TV control signal; and a control unit for controlling the disaster broadcasting facility. When the signal analysis unit determines that the broadcast signal includes the disaster information, the control unit generates the TV control signal including at least one of a TV turn-on signal and a TV channel change signal through the control signal generation unit and transmits the generated TV control signal to the home terminal installed in the home together with the disaster response broadcast.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 재난 방송 시스템에 관한 것으로 가내에 설치된 TV 시스템과 양방향으로 통신이 가능한 재난 방송 시스템에 관한 것으로, 본 발명의 하나의 양태에 따르면, 외부 신호원으로부터 TV 방송 신호 및 재난정보 포함하는 신호를 수신하고 재난대응방송을 가내 단말기에 전송하기 위한 재난방송설비가 제공되고, 재난방송설비는, 외부의 신호원으로부터 재난정보를 포함하는 방송 신호를 수신하는 수신부; 상기 방송 신호로부터 재난 정보를 분석하기 위한 신호분석부: TV 제어 신호를 생성하는 제어신호 생성부; 및 재난방송설비를 제어하기 위한 제어부를 포함하고, 제어부는 신호분석부로부터 방송 신호에 재난 정보가 포함된 것으로 판단된 경우 제어 신호 생성부를 통해 TV 턴온 신호 및 TV 채널 변경 신호 중 적어도 하나 이상을 포함하는 TV 제어 신호를 생성하고, 생성된 TV 제어 신호를 재난대응방송과 함께 가내에 설치된 가내 단말기에 전송하도록 구성된다.

title_en: Fire alarm apparatus
title_ko: 화재 경보 장치
abstract_en: According to one embodiment of the present invention, provided is a fire alarm device including a plurality of sensing modules and a repeater. When receiving a fire alarm signal from each of the plurality of sensing modules, the repeater transmits a signal to each of the plurality of sensing modules after a first time has elapsed. The signal includes an acknowledgment response to the fire alarm signal and a control signal for controlling each of the plurality of sensing modules. The acknowledgment response and the control signal may be integrally transmitted.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 화재 경보 장치는 복수의 센싱 모듈들 및 중계기를 포함할 수 있다. 상기 중계기는 상기 복수의 센싱 모듈들 각각으로부터 화재 경보 신호를 수신하면 상기 복수의 센싱 모듈들 각각에 제1 시간 경과 후 신호를 전송하며, 상기 신호는 상기 화재 경보 신호에 대한 확인 응답 및 상기 복수의 센싱 모듈들 각각을 제어하는 제어 신호를 포함하고, 상기 확인 응답 및 상기 제어 신호는 일체로 전송될 수 있다.

title_en: Intelligent fire-fighting data visual monitoring system and monitoring method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent fire-fighting data visual monitoring system and a monitoring method thereof, relating to the technical field of fire-fighting safety, wherein the system comprises: a data analysis module; a data model comprising a device model and an interface model; wisdom screen. The method comprises the following steps: s1, analyzing and classifying the specific content of the fire fighting equipment in response to the received fire fighting equipment state message; s2, responding to the classified fire fighting equipment status messages to monitor the fire fighting equipment status messages, and triggering early warning when the status messages change or are abnormal; s3, responding to the early warning to update the state of the fire fighting equipment; and S4, displaying the message processed in the step S3. The invention realizes the real-time monitoring of the state of the fire-fighting facility through the remote multi-dimensional visual monitoring technology; the life cycle and the state information of the fire-fighting equipment are analyzed in real time by using a data model analysis technology, so that the safety diagnosis, intelligent early warning and accurate maintenance of the fire-fighting equipment are realized, and the fire-fighting guarantee cost is reduced.
assignees: JIANGXI INTELLIGENT INDUSTRIAL TECH INNOVATION RESEARCH INSTITUTE

title_en: Dark water level monitoring reputation early warning device of containing
abstract_en: The utility model provides a sound and light early warning device suitable for monitoring the water level of a hidden culvert, which consists of a water immersion detector, a junction box, a safety power supply, a power switch and a sound and light alarm; the water immersion detector, the junction box, the safety power supply, the power switch and the audible and visual alarm are all arranged on the side wall of the culvert; the water immersion detector is arranged at the height of the hidden culvert side wall at the upstream of the construction working surface, which corresponds to the set safe water level; the safety power supply is a 12V mobile power supply; the audible and visual alarm is arranged on the side wall of the dark culvert on the downstream working surface; the safety power supply is connected to the junction box through the power switch, and the water immersion detector, the safety power supply and the audible and visual alarm are connected together through the junction box. The utility model discloses to rain, upper reaches reservoir turn on the water, municipal pipeline wash or other upper reaches do not come the water condition that arouse dark culvert internal water level rise monitor, withdraw rapidly for dark culvert construction operation personnel and mechanical equipment and provide more sensitive early warning signal, reach the purpose of guarantee personnel and mechanical equipment safety.

title_en: Space-time intensity online early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a space-time intensity online early warning method and a system, comprising the following steps: calculating a landslide hazard index based on gridding, and determining a landslide-prone area according to the landslide hazard index; constructing a dynamically updated accumulated effective rainfall model, and calculating a landslide probability for predicting the landslide activity time; obtaining the power transmission tower fault probability caused by landslide, which reflects the damage degree of the power transmission tower in the area easy to landslide from the functional angle; and calculating the probability of tower and line faults when the landslide disaster caused by rainfall and the landslide effect power transmission tower occur. The method tracks weather forecast information in real time, dynamically evaluates the influence of the activity time of the slope and the downslide of the slope on the fault rate of the power transmission tower on the basis of determining the position of the slope in a gridding manner, and achieves online early warning of the fault of the power transmission tower.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV SOUTHEAST;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Intelligent movable fire station
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent movable fire station, the structure of which comprises a miniature fire station, a placing cavity, universal wheels, a plate door, a glass window, a handle, a control panel, a main board, a processor, a communication module, a battery bin, a storage battery, a warning lamp and a layering mechanism, the utility model discloses a layering mechanism is arranged at the middle part of the rear side of the placing cavity, when large-scale fire-fighting equipment is needed to be placed, a rotary knob is rotated to enable a rotary rod to withdraw a lug into the inner side of a spring groove through a steel cable, thereby the fixation of a division plate is released, and the division plate can be placed back into the inner side of a groove; the second step, it is inboard that the pulling bolt breaks away from the connecting piece to remove the fixed of first plywood and second plywood, rotate first plywood and second plywood to and place the laminating of chamber rear side, can be with the space adjustment who places the chamber to the biggest, the convenience is accomodate large-scale fire-fighting equipment, provides convenience for the user.
assignees: NANJING ENZE ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Network security monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a network security monitoring system, which comprises an acquisition unit, a component unit and a monitoring and protecting unit, wherein the acquisition unit comprises a data updating module and a data processing module, wherein the data updating module is used for downloading updated security protection codes and firewall codes in a network, and the data processing module is used for processing data downloaded by the data updating module; the component module comprises a data building module for receiving the primarily processed data output by the data processing module, and the data building module is used for building the received data into a network framework; by the design of the invention, multi-point early warning monitoring can be carried out in network security, security problems occur, the position of a fault can be timely and accurately reflected, automatic virus killing and firewall construction can be simultaneously carried out, the security problems are rapidly solved, the protection module can be updated in real time through the designed updating module, and special protection codes can be input, so that the overall security is improved.
assignees: HEBEI HONGLIAN 95 INFORMATION IND CO LTD

title_en: Hydrological model segmented screening method suitable for forecasting and early warning of torrential rain, torrential flood and flood in small watershed of mountainous area
abstract_en: The invention provides a hydrological model segmented screening method suitable for forecasting and early warning of torrential rain and torrential flood in small watershed of mountainous area, which divides actual measurement flood and flood simulated by adopting a hydrological model into an expansion section, a steep expansion section, a disaster forming section and a water withdrawal section, screens the hydrological model by comparing the calculation results of the hydrological model on the steep expansion section and the disaster forming section with the actual measurement flood, fully considers the early catching capacity of the hydrological model on certain key disaster-causing early warning moments of the steep expansion section, can catch the torrential rain and torrential flood disaster-causing moment in advance, can avoid alarm leakage, improves the accuracy and reliability of the forecasting and early warning of the torrential rain and torrential flood in the small watershed of mountainous area, and can provide more scientific guidance and technical support for the forecasting and early warning of the torrential rain and torrential flood disaster in the small watershed of mountainous area.

title_en: Geological disaster early warning management system and method for three gorges reservoir area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster early warning management system and method in a three gorges reservoir area, which comprises a detection device, a power supply box, an alarm device and a control box, wherein a rainfall detection unit, a soil humidity detection unit, a displacement detection unit and a first wireless communication unit are arranged in a mounting seat of the detection device, the power supply box is electrically connected with a plurality of detection devices, the control box is electrically connected with the alarm device, a loudspeaker and an alarm lamp of the alarm device are distributed in a village and a town, and a plurality of indicator lamps form an escape path. Can detect the geological conditions of each position of massif and upload central control platform through detection device, when the dangerous situation appears, central control platform sends radio signal, is received by second wireless communication unit, then starts speaker and the alarm lamp that distributes in the village and small town and warn, and light the pilot lamp, make people can follow the instruction of pilot lamp and withdraw fast, thereby avoid needing to guide by the family by the manpower, the propaganda promotes the efficiency of fleing.

title_en: Method for tracking laser breakpoint by using particle filtering algorithm
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for tracking laser breakpoints by using a particle filter algorithm, which comprises 6 steps of establishing a state space model, initializing targets and particles, measuring similarity, updating weights, determining breakpoint states and judging resampling; describing breakpoint monitoring by adopting a dynamic state space model, wherein the dynamic state space model of the time-varying problem comprises a state transition model and an observation model, and determining the dynamic state space model; initializing a breakpoint target and sample particles; updating the weight of the particles through similarity measurement, wherein each particle has different weights; based on a particle filtering algorithm, acquiring a particle update weight according to an observation likelihood function of the target region characteristics; and correcting the particles with different weights, performing recursive prediction and updating on the breakpoint state, and determining the breakpoint state. The invention can detect the laser breakpoint in the video screen in real time, thereby giving real-time early warning to the landslide, and the tracking process is accurate, stable and real-time.

title_en: Safety warning device for blasting operation
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a safety warning device is used in blasting operation, including holding tank and warning light, the inside of holding tank is provided with the water pump, water pump one end is provided with the inlet tube, the other end of water pump is provided with the outlet pipe, the outlet pipe runs through the one end of holding tank upper surface is provided with flexible pipe, the top of outlet pipe is provided with the shunt tubes, the top of shunt tubes side is provided with the shower nozzle, the last fixed surface of holding tank is connected with the bracing piece. This safety warning device is used in blasting operation, through the setting of warning light, protective housing and speaker, the warning light can arouse people's attention, and the speaker can be convenient for blasting personnel suggestion people around, guarantees that the blasting information can both be clear to know of all people, and timely withdraws safe position, has ensured people's safety, and the protective housing has played the guard action to the speaker, has guaranteed the normal use of speaker, has prolonged the device's life.
assignees: WUXI MUNICIPAL FACILITY CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD

title_en: Independent area wireless networking type fire alarm system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fire alarm, and discloses an independent area wireless networking type fire alarm system, which solves the problem that residents cannot remind the residents on the floor in time at present and cannot withdraw from the safety range in time when a fire occurs, thereby causing hidden danger to the safety of the residents, and comprises a box body, wherein the bottom of the inner wall of the box body is connected with a first motor; the utility model discloses, first motor drives the bull stick and rotates, thereby can drive the box and remove, warn the inside resident of floor, make the resident learn the emergence of conflagration in the very first time, the second motor drives first bull stick and rotates, thereby it rotates to drive the warning light, alarm box during operation, warn the inside resident of floor through the speaker, thereby play the effect of warning, make the resident know the condition of outside in the very first time, can be timely make the judgement, reduce the loss that the conflagration brought, thereby the problem of potential safety hazard has been solved.
assignees: JIANGXI SECURITY TECH ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Handling a request to initiate a call
abstract_en: There is provided a method for handling a request to initiate a call. The method is performed by a server entity. In response to receiving a first request for a first client entity to initiate a call to a second client entity without the second client entity rendering a notification of the call, transmission of a first message is initiated towards one or more third client entities to inform the one or more third client entities of the first request. The first client entity is authorised to initiate the call only if a second message, acknowledging the first request, is received from at least one of the one or more third client entities.

title_en: Configuration method and device of disaster recovery main and standby equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a configuration method and a device of disaster recovery main and standby equipment, the method is applied to first vBRAS-CP equipment, and the method comprises the following steps: receiving a first heartbeat notification message which is sent by a second vBRAS-CP device and comprises a first identification list; acquiring a second identifier list in the first vBRAS-CP device, and judging whether a first UP device identifier exists in the second identifier list; if the first UP device identifier exists, identifying the configuration states of the first UP device corresponding to the first UP device identifier in a first identifier list and a second identifier list; if the first UP device is in the configured state in the second identification list and is updated from the configured state to the unconfigured state in the first identification list, the user access function of the first UP device is forbidden; and sending a first notification message to the first UP device so that the first UP device does not send a user service message to the first vBRAS-CP device.
assignees: H3C LARGE DATA TECH CO LTD

title_en: One-key arming/disarming system for transformer substation
abstract_en: The embodiment of the utility model discloses a one-key arming/disarming system of a transformer substation, which belongs to the field of power systems and comprises a processing host, an alarm keyboard, an entrance guard, an alarm device, a video device and a light central control; the processing host is connected with the access control, the alarm device and the light central control through control lines respectively, and the host is connected with the video device through signal lines; the alarm keyboard is connected to the processing host and used for triggering the arming/disarming system by one key. The utility model discloses an alarm, light, video tracking and entrance guard's linkage through warning keyboard, carry out a key arming/withdrawing to the control of transformer substation, have reduced staff's work load, and the reaction of making arming/withdrawing is more timely, has improved work efficiency.
assignees: BEIJING RONGTONG WISDOM TECH CO LTD;STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CO;BEIJING JINDIANLIAN POWER SUPPLY AND CONSUMPTION CONSULTATION CO LTD;BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER ECONOMIC TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Liftable traffic LED sign
abstract_en: The invention discloses a liftable traffic LED indicating board, which comprises a stand column, wherein the upper end of the stand column is rotatably provided with a driving column, the driving column comprises a rotation control cavity, a rotation mechanism is arranged in the rotation control cavity, a lifting control box is fixedly arranged at the right end of the driving column, the lifting control box comprises a lifting control cavity, the lifting control box has simple structure and higher integration degree, the LED display screen can realize the notification of emergency information or the update of the latest road information without manually replacing an iron plate, when the lamp plate needs to be maintained or cleaned, the invention can be controlled to rotate away from the upper part of the lane and fall downwards to the upper part of a sidewalk or a green belt, and then the vehicle does not need to be lifted, the orderly passing of the lane under the lamp plate is not influenced, the danger of high-altitude operation is effectively avoided, and the invention can automatically ascend, position and fix on the upright post again after the work is finished.

title_en: Multipurpose smart warning lighting appatatus and controlling method thereof
title_ko: 다목적 스마트 경광장치 및 그 제어방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are a multi-purpose smart warning light device and a control method thereof. The multi-purpose smart warning light device of the present invention comprises: a case unit; a battery unit disposed inside the case unit; a distance detecting unit installed in the case unit so as to detect the distance of an accessing object; a tilt detecting unit for detecting an amount of tilt of the case unit; a transceiving unit disposed in the case unit, and performing transmission and reception with a manager terminal; a voice generating unit for outputting a voice message; a warning light module for generating a warning light; a control unit for controlling the voice generating unit and the warning light module to be driven when a signal received in the distance detecting unit and the tilt detecting unit is included in a preset danger signal, and controlling the transceiving unit to transmit a danger signal to the manager terminal; and an information input unit installed in the control unit to change the danger signal preset in the control unit. According to the present invention, potential accidents at a site can be prevented.
abstract_ko: 다목적 스마트 경광장치 및 그 제어방법에 대한 발명이 개시된다. 본 발명의 다목적 스마트 경광장치는: 케이스부; 케이스부의 내부에 배치되는 배터리부; 접근대상의 거리를 감지하도록 케이스부에 설치되는 거리 감지부; 케이스부의 기울기를 감지하는 기울기 감지부; 케이스부에 배치되고, 관리자용 단말기와 송수신하는 송수신부; 음성멘트를 출력하는 음성 발생부; 경고용 광을 발생시키는 경광등 모듈; 거리 감지부와 기울기 감지부에서 수신된 신호가 미리 설정된 위험 신호에 속하는 경우, 음성 발생부와 경광등 모듈을 구동시키도록 제어하고, 관리자용 단말기에 위험 신호를 송신하도록 송수신부를 제어하는 제어부; 및 제어부에 미리 설정된 위험 신호를 변경하도록 제어부에 설치되는 정보 입력부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: A transfer method for service request information
title_ko: 서비스 요청 정보 전달 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a service request information transmission system which comprises: a service reception/management terminal connected to a cloud service server connected via a wireless Internet communication means; a customer terminal; and an employee terminal, and to a service request information transmission method. The service request information transmission method comprises the steps of: determining, by the service reception/management terminal, when a specific event such as a room service request and an emergency situation generated from the customer terminal and the employee terminal occurs, an employee at the shortest distance from the location where the event occurs; transmitting a room service message or an emergency message to an employee terminal of an employee who is determined to be at the shortest distance from the location where the event occurs; checking whether the employee who has received the room service message or the emergency message accepts the message; repeatedly determining, when the employee rejects the message, a recipient who can be added and transmitting the message to an employee terminal of the recipient; and updating, when the message is accepted, state information with respect to the employee terminal and completing the transmission of the message. According to the present invention, it is possible to efficiently provide a service.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 무선 인터넷 통신수단을 통해서 접속되는 클라우드 서비스 서버와 연결되는 서비스 접수/관리 단말기, 고객용 단말기, 직원용 단말기를 포함하되, 상기 서비스 접수/관리 단말기는, 고객용 단말기 및 직원용 단말기로부터 생성된 룸서비스 요청 및 위급 상황과 같은 특정 이벤트가 발생될 경우, 상기 이벤트가 발생된 위치와 최단거리에 있는 직원을 판별하는 단계; 이벤트가 발생된 위치와 최단거리로 판별된 직원의 직원용 단말기로 룸 서비스 메시지 또는 위급 메시지를 송신하는 단계; 상기 룸 서비스 메시지 또는 위급 메시지를 수신받은 직원의 메시지 수락 여부를 확인하는 단계; 메시지가 거부된 경우, 추가 가능한 수신자를 반복적으로 판별하여 상기 수신자의 직원용 단말기로 메시지를 송신하는 단계; 메시지가 수락된 경우, 직원용 단말기에 대한 상태정보를 갱신하고 메시지 전달을 종료하는 단계;를 포함하는 서비스 요청 정보 전달 방법에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Elevator fire emergency device
abstract_en: The utility model provides an elevator conflagration emergency device, including controller, signal transmission module, elevator running state detection module, sedan-chair door switch detection module, human infrared detection module and voice broadcast system, the controller is used for receiving place building fire alarm signal, generates elevator control signal, elevator running state detection module for detect the up-and-down state of elevator, human infrared detection module for whether someone is detected the elevator, the voice broadcast system is used for reporting promptly to withdraw the early warning to the passenger. The elevator fire emergency device provided by the scheme has the advantages that the installation is simple, the fire emergency response is rapid, and casualties caused by taking the elevator in a fire disaster can be reduced to the maximum extent.
assignees: GUANGZHOU LORD ELEVATOR SERVICES CO LTD

title_en: Fire alarm siren detection real-time fire situation transmission robot
title_ko: 화재경보기 사이렌 감지 실시간 화재 상황 전송 로봇
abstract_en: The present invention can recognize a loud sound, such as the sound of a fire alarm siren and the sound of an explosion, or an alarm sound from a fire detector, move to the place where the loud sound is generated by using a noise direction sensor when an accident occurs, photograph an accident situation and transmit a photographed image to enable rapid identification of an accident situation, report the accident, and distinguish it as a non-fire report. The present invention comprises: a noise direction sensor for recognizing the arrival time of sound through three microphones; a calculation part for calculating the direction of the sound by calculating the time difference obtained through the sensor; a robot driving part which enables a robot to navigate in the direction of the sound recognized by a motor and a wheel and changes the angle of a camera through a servo-motor; the camera capable of photographing a site; and a transmitting/receiving part capable of controlling the robot by using a signal received through an external WIFI server according to a user′s need and transmitting the image photographed by the camera.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재경보기 사이렌 및 폭발 등 큰소리 또는 화재감지기의 경보를 인식하여 안전사고 발생 시 소음 방향 감지 센서를 통해 큰소리가 나는 곳으로 이동 후 사고 상황을 촬영, 영상을 전송하여 빠른 안전사고 현장 파악과 신고, 비화재보 구분이 가능하도록 한다. 본 발명은 세 개의 마이크를 통해 도착하는 소리의 시간을 인식하는 소음 방향 감지 센서; 센서를 통해 들어온 시간 차이를 계산해 소리의 방향을 계산하는 연산부; 모터와 바퀴로 인식한 소리의 방향으로 찾아가도록 해주고, 서보모터를 통해 카메라의 구도를 변경하는 로봇 구동부; 현장을 촬영할 수 있는 카메라; 사용자가 필요할 때 외부 WIFI 서버를 통해 받은 신호로 로봇을 제어하고, 카메라로 촬영한 영상을 송신할 수 있는 송수신부를 포함한다.

title_en: Method of determining vehicle accident, server device for performing the same, and vehicle electronic device and operation method thereof
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the disclosure, a method of determining a vehicle accident comprises: receiving, from a vehicle, first information including a speed and a location of the vehicle for a communication period having variable value; obtaining second information including environment information of a trail of the vehicle; updating the communication period based on the first information and the second information such that a moving range of the vehicle during the communication period corresponds to a reference value; determining whether an accident involving the vehicle has occurred based on whether updated first information is received from the vehicle for the updated communication period; and transmitting a notification, responsive to determining an accident involving the vehicle.

title_en: Fault fracture zone tunnel construction early warning system
abstract_en: The application relates to a fault broken zone tunnel construction early warning system which comprises a sensor, a data processor and a receiver, wherein the sensor, the data processor and the receiver are electrically connected in sequence; the sensors comprise a displacement sensor, a stress sensor, a water pressure sensor, a monitoring camera and a geological forecasting module, and are arranged around a fault fracture zone in the tunnel; the receiver is arranged on equipment carried by constructors. The change of the fault fracture zone in the tunnel construction and the change process of the nearby geological environment is monitored in real time, the related information is transmitted to the data processor, the risk of disaster generation is predicted according to the analysis of the data processor, if the risk exists, the information is transmitted to tunnel constructors through the corresponding communication modules, the constructors can conveniently withdraw from the site in time or search nearby safe places to avoid, and casualties in the construction process are reduced.
assignees: CHINA CONSTR 7TH ENG DIVISION CORP LTD;SICHUAN YANGHUA TUNNEL BRIDGE ENG CONSULTING CO LTD

title_en: Experimental method and device for dynamic disaster of rock burst in roadway excavation
abstract_en: A method and apparatus for dynamic disaster experiment of tunnel driving rock burst is characterized in that the experiment method includes an experiment for simulating tunnel driving under normal geological conditions and an experiment for simulating tunnel driving under abnormal geological conditions; both of them comprise (1) preparing a sample; (2) applying a static load to the sample, and simulating the actual stress environment of rock mass around the underground tunneling working face of the coal mine; (3) controlling the motion track of a cutter to simulate tunneling through a computer program, and collecting acoustoelectric and mechanical signals fed back in the tunneling process of a sample; (4) withdrawing the cutter from the sample, and collecting acoustoelectric and mechanical signals fed back in the process of stopping digging the sample; (5) respectively in step 2 and step 3, applying dynamic load, and controlling dynamic loading waveform characteristics and application time parameters by a computer; (6) and changing the form and the strength of the dynamic load waveform until the sample is subjected to impact damage, obtaining the condition criterion of the roadway impact damage and the like. The method can provide theoretical reference and scientific countermeasures for early warning and prevention of coal mine roadway excavation rock burst.

title_en: Event-driven natural catastrophe modeling and model refinement for insurance and risk management
abstract_en: A system and method for event-based modeling and model refinement for natural catastrophe related risks, including but not limited to fires, floods, earthquakes, and hurricanes/tornados. The system and method feature simultaneous simulation of a plurality of industry models using a variety of risk information, including but not limited to real-time data, recent and historical event data, hypothetical data, and crowd-sourced data. The system and method use a variety of data sources in conjunction with machine learning to continuously and in real-time update and tune the simulated models performance and sensitivity to provide useful risk assessment and risk management data. Based on these model assessments, the system can produce notifications that can be made to enable automated and human actions.

title_en: Composing and transmitting customized alert messages to responders
abstract_en: Systems and methods for directing an alert to responders are provided. Upon activation of an alert application on a user device, an options screen is displayed to a user. The user can select a report option, and a screen is displayed for the user to enter information into one or more required and optional fields regarding a threat or a risk event. Once the system determines that the required fields have been filled, the system automatically composes a customized alert message based on the received information, automatically determines appropriate responders to notify. The customized alert message is transmitted to the determined responders, and acknowledgement messages are received from the responders.

title_en: Wireless Emergency Alert End Determination
abstract_en: Embodiments are presented herein of apparatuses, systems, and methods for a user equipment device (UE) to determine whether or not a mobile alert message is in effect. Such a determination may be based on a cancellation message (or other message(s) received from the network, possibly in response to a query from the UE. Alternatively or additionally, such a determination may be based on monitoring rebroadcasts of the alert and/or determining that no rebroadcast has been received for a period of time.

title_en: Disaster prevention alarm device for FM Alert radio
abstract_en: The utility model provides a disaster prevention alarm device of FM Alert radio relates to the radio field. The portable radio comprises a radio body, wherein a portable handle is fixedly arranged on the upper surface of the radio body. This FM Alert radio disaster prevention alarm device, through setting up the pivot mount, the apparatus further comprises a rotating shaft, telescopic antenna and activity fixture block, can adjust telescopic antenna through the pivot, collect the signal, rotate post and hand power generation handle through setting up, can carry out hand power generation to the device after all electric quantities of device run out, can rotate the inboard with hand power generation handle when not using and withdraw, through setting up the reserve battery case, the electrode slice, battery and reserve battery lid, can supply power for the device as stand-by power supply after the inside electric quantity of device runs out, through setting up the interface that charges, can charge for device internal power supply, through setting up the alarm lamp spread groove, alarm bulb and bulb protection casing, can report to the police to the disaster through the bulb flashing light.

title_en: Wireless fire alarm system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire fighting, in particular to a wireless fire alarm system, which comprises a monitoring end, a server and a management end, wherein the monitoring end is connected with the server; the monitoring end comprises a smoke acquisition unit and a thermal imaging unit, and the smoke acquisition unit is used for acquiring the environmental smoke concentration and sending the environmental smoke concentration to the server; the server is used for judging whether a fire exists according to the received smoke concentration, sending an early warning signal to the management terminal when the fire exists, and sending a detection signal to the monitoring terminal; the monitoring end is also used for starting the thermal imaging unit and sending the detection data to the server after receiving the detection signal; the server is also used for analyzing whether a fire exists according to the feedback data of the thermal imaging unit, and sending an alarm signal to the management terminal when the analysis result shows that the fire exists; and when the analysis result is that the early warning cancellation signal does not exist, the server sends an early warning cancellation signal to the management terminal. By using the system, the condition that the working personnel do too much idle work due to false alarm can be effectively avoided.

title_en: Electric power emergency automatic management system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of electric power emergency management, and relates to an electric power emergency automatic management system which comprises a real-time monitoring module, a central processing unit and a display module, wherein the real-time monitoring module is used for monitoring the equipment state and the line state in real time; the real-time monitoring module outputs monitoring signals, the monitoring signals are analyzed and processed by the central processing unit and then output control signals, and the central processing unit operates and controls the early warning reminding module, the emergency grade evaluation module, the emergency guarantee module and the display module through the control signals. The invention realizes real-time monitoring of monitoring item data, sets various early warning forms, sets emergency event grade evaluation, and scientifically dispatches emergency resources according to the severity grade of the emergency event; and the emergency resources are updated in real time, so that the capability of the power system for preventing and treating the power emergency is improved.
assignees: YANGXIN POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Information pushing method and device and fire fighting system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an information pushing method and device and a fire fighting system. Wherein, the method comprises the following steps: receiving early warning information, wherein the early warning information is generated by fire early warning equipment during early warning; the method comprises the steps of pushing early warning information to a first preset object, and adding a first expiration mechanism for pushing operation; based on the feedback state of the first predetermined object to the early warning information within the time period corresponding to the expiration mechanism, sending the first predetermined information to the second predetermined object, and adding a second expiration mechanism for the sending operation; and determining whether to send the second predetermined information to the third predetermined object based on the feedback state of the second predetermined object to the first predetermined information within a time period corresponding to the second expiration mechanism. The invention solves the technical problem that the fire monitoring center in the related technology can not efficiently acquire the warning situation because the fire alarm hierarchical pushing can not be realized.
assignees: ZHONG XIAO YUN BEIJING IOT TECH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Scheduling platform and method for ensuring safe production of enterprise master control center
abstract_en: The application discloses a dispatching platform and a method for ensuring safety production of an enterprise master control center, wherein the platform comprises: version management unit, change management unit, emergency management unit, production dynamic broadcast unit, wherein: the version management unit is used for collecting and collecting version information; the change management unit is used for extracting and displaying changed items in stages; the emergency management unit is used for starting a corresponding emergency flow and carrying out emergency treatment when an emergency happens suddenly, and simultaneously recording the treatment process and carrying out subsequent fault review summary; and the production dynamic broadcasting unit is used for collecting and distributing relevant event information influencing production. The system and the method realize all-chain digitalization of production information acquisition, confirmation and release, daily routing inspection recording, tracking, version application, release, circulation, review, change centralized implementation, emergency disposal release, organization, closing, tracking review and the like, and realize information sharing and unified scheduling command.

title_en: Automatic analysis device for power grid alarm
abstract_en: The invention provides an automatic power grid alarm analysis device which comprises a host, an indicator light, a display screen, a key and a power socket, wherein the internal components of the host comprise a cable pipe, a main block, a core bar, a gate valve, a gate row block and an internal groove, the cable pipe is arranged at the top end of the outer wall of the host, the main block is arranged below the cable pipe, the core bar is arranged in the main block, the gate valve is arranged below the main block, and wiring ports and communication cable fastening mechanisms are arranged at two ends of the cable pipe. The substantial effects of the invention are as follows: 1) the whole power system flow structure updated in real time is stored in the cloud, the influence degree of the fault on the power system can be automatically analyzed when the fault occurs, and the technical problem that the existing power system warning device cannot analyze the severity degree of the influence of the abnormal condition causing the warning on the power grid according to the power grid condition is solved; 2) a cable fastening mechanism is introduced to solve the technical problem of interruption or misinformation of power grid detection caused by poor contact at a wiring position.
assignees: STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD KAIHUA POWER SUPPLY COMPANY

title_en: Pile foundation static load test safety device and system thereof
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a pile foundation static load test safety device, which comprises a plurality of deep learning cameras, at least one set of first alarm device and a plurality of movable bases; the movable base is arranged at the periphery of the test bed; the deep learning camera is connected with the first alarm device. In addition, the pile foundation static load test safety system comprises the pile foundation static load test safety device, a monitoring host, a monitoring screen and a second alarm device; the deep learning camera is connected with the monitoring host computer or wirelessly connected with the monitoring host computer, and the monitoring host computer is respectively connected with the monitoring screen and the second alarm device. The utility model discloses a whether the balancing weight that piles up on the camera real time monitoring test bench of degree of depth learning inclines or collapses to whether the control someone is close to the test bench, and the warning will be triggered to appear in arbitrary condition, and the warning personnel do not near or in time withdraw from danger area, have ensured personnel's safety.
assignees: XIAMEN MUNICIPAL ENGINEERING RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;XIAMEN MUNICIPAL ENG CO LTD

title_en: Expressway accident site intrusion prevention early warning device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of traffic safety protective equipment, especially, relate to highway accident scene prevents rushing into early warning device, including the road cone, alert shoulder lamp, alarm and containing box, the road cone outward appearance is equipped with reflection of light subsides and LED lamp area, and the road cone lateral part is equipped with wireless infrared detector and wireless signal processor, the bottom is equipped with the road cone battery in the road cone, and the road cone top is equipped with the through-hole, the bottom is equipped with the road cone switch, the road cone battery is connected with LED lamp area electricity, wireless infrared detector passes through radio signal with wireless signal processor and is connected, the alarm is placed on the road cone, and remind passing vehicle through light and voice broadcast, alert shoulder lamp is fixed on police officer's shoulder, and be connected with wireless signal processor through radio signal. title_en: Security system and method of transmitting distress signal
abstract_en: A method of transmitting a distress signal is disclosed. The method includes receiving a distress signal triggered by a device A (20) at an application server (10) by a security system (50) along with location of the device A (20). Subsequently, the method involves identifying at least one device B (30) present within a predefined distance from the device A (20) by the security system (50). A notification is then transmitted to the at least one device B (30). The notification includes type of distress and distance of the device A (20) from the at least one device B (30). Further, an acknowledgement is received from the at least one device B (30) at the application server (10) by the security system (50). Lastly, the location of the device A (20) is transmitted to the at least one device B (30).

Data acquisition module on the monitoring pole carries out real-time supervision to mountain body each side data, if data take place unusually, alarm module sends the police dispatch newspaper with the voice broadcast module, and the suggestion community people withdraws fast, has the intelligence to mountain region calamity monitoring, high-efficient and quick early warning's characteristics.

title_en: Broadcasting facility control system with selective blocking function and speaker control method using the system
title_ko: 선택적인 차단 기능을 갖는 방송설비 제어시스템 및 그 시스템을 이용한 스피커 제어방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a broadcasting facility control system with a selective blocking function and a speaker control method using the system. More specifically, the broadcasting facility control system includes a normal broadcasting equipment device and additionally includes a control-on/off switch enabling a user to selectively output signals transmitted from output devices only to necessary speakers and to block the signals to unnecessary speakers. Accordingly, when a signal such as a scheduled broadcast is output during broadcasting, the signal can only be output through the unblocked speaker, and thus broadcasting can be smoothly performed. When a specific signal (disaster broadcast) is output, blockage to the blocked speaker is canceled and all signals except for the specific signal are interrupted, so that the specific signal (disaster broadcasting) can be output to all connected speakers with priority.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 선택적인 차단 기능을 갖는 방송설비 제어시스템 및 그 시스템을 이용한 스피커 출력차단방법에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는, 통상의 방송설비 장치를 포함하되, 출력장치들로부터 전송되는 신호를 사용자가 선택적으로 그 필요한 스피커로만 출력 및 불필요한 스피커로는 신호를 차단할 수 있는 콘트롤온오프스위치를 추가 구성하여, 방송 진행 중, 예약방송 등의 신호가 출력될 시, 그 신호가 차단되지 않은 스피커로만 출력될 수 있어 원활한 방송진행이 가능하고, 특정신호(재난방송)가 출력될 시, 신호를 차단한 스피커로의 차단을 해지 및 상기 특정신호를 재외한 모든 신호를 차단하고, 상기 특정신호(재난방송)를 우선순위로 하여 연결된 모든 스피커로 출력될 수 있도록 하는 유용한 발명이다.

title_en: Application that enables car alarm to send signals to cell phone

abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system connected via Bluetooth. More specifically, it is possible to cancel the alarm sound through a video and a notification sent to a mobile phone of a false vehicle theft alarm. Through the present invention, it is possible to prevent an attempt to steal a vehicle, and to quickly respond to annoying people around by the false alarm sound. The present invention connects the smart key of the vehicle, the sensor, and the mobile phone of the user through the application, so that the image and notification recorded in a black box are transmitted to the mobile phone of the user, when the theft attempt or a big shock is received through the sensor.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 블루투스를 통해 연결된 시스템에 대한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 잘못된 자동차 도난 경보를 영상과 휴대전화로 전송되는 알림을 통해 경보음을 해제시킬 수 있는 것이다. 이 발명을 통해 자동차 도난 시도를 막고, 잘못된 경보음에 의해 주변인들에게 민폐를 끼치는 것에 빠르게 대처할 수 있는 효과가 있다. 본 발명은 애플리케이션을 통하여 자동차의 스마트키, 센서, 사용자의 휴대전화를 연결함으로써 도난 시도나 큰 충격이 센서를 통하여 접수될 경우 블랙박스에서 녹화한 영상과 알림이 사용자의 휴대전화로 전송된다.

title_en: Fall detection - audio looping
abstract_en: Techniques are provided for contacting emergency response services when certain conditions are met. In some instances, it may be determined, by a wearable device, whether a user has responded to a first user interface prompt displayed in response to detection of a physical event associated with the user. In accordance with a determination that the user has not responded to the first user interface prompt after expiration of a first time period, certain actions may be performed. For example, a countdown timer may begin to run for a second timer period. During the second period, an audio alert and a haptic alert may be output by the wearable device. In accordance with a determination that the user has not responded to a second user interface prompt prior to expiration of the second time period, a communication channel request may be transmitted to an emergency response service by the wearable device.

title_en: Citizen participating type public order monitoring and warning system and service system using thereof
title_ko: 시민 참여형 공공질서 감시경고시스템 및 이를 활용한 서비스 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a citizen participation type public order monitoring and warning system and a service system using the same. The present invention comprises: a terminal for requesting a public institution to install a monitoring device in a place where violations of public order have occurred or are likely to occur, controlling the monitoring device through an application, setting and changing the type of broadcasting and display of a warning sound and a warning message, the type of warning light, the number of times, and the time for violations of public order, and receiving the broadcasting and display of the warning sound and the warning message, lighting of the warning light, and the number and time related thereto from the monitoring device; a control server for providing an application that can set and change the number and time related to the broadcasting and display of the warning sound and the warning message emitted from the monitoring device for the terminal and the lighting of the warning light, receiving a monitoring signal from the monitoring device, and transmitting a set or changed recording file to the monitoring device when a request to set or change the warning message is received from the terminal; a monitoring device installed in a specific place at the request of the public institution from the terminal, monitoring violations of public order to broadcast and display the warning sound and the warning message according to the type and turn on the warning light, and transmitting signals thereof to the terminal and the control server; and a public institution server for receiving the request to install the monitoring device for a specific place through the terminal and receiving information on violations of public order by communicating with the terminal and the control server. Accordingly, it is possible to improve the effect of prohibiting violations of public order.

title_en: Energy-saving tunnel safety lighting control system and intelligent dimming control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an energy-saving tunnel safety lighting control system and an intelligent dimming control method thereof, and belongs to the field of traffic lighting. According to the invention, the moving object at the entrance of the tunnel is remotely detected and collected and transmitted to the central control unit in real time so as to control the lighting unit in the tunnel to be turned on and off, so that the energy loss can be effectively reduced, and the purpose of energy saving is realized; simultaneously, the scene detection unit is utilized to update the scene in the middle section of the tunnel in real time, if accidents or disasters occur, the scene is timely transmitted to an early warning module outside the tunnel through the central control unit to play a role in prompting, and the traffic safety of the tunnel can be effectively ensured.
