title_en: Apparatus for smart processor with transmitting emergency broadcasting and operation method thereof
title_ko: 비상방송 송출용 스마트 프로세서 장치 및 그 운용방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a smart processor device for transmitting emergency broadcasts and an operating method thereof. The smart processor device independently controls driving of an emergency broadcast transmitting system including an amplifier, a speaker, a line and the like installed in each broadcast region (eg, one floor of a building, an apartment, or an area of a certain range). The smart processor device collects information on emergency situations or failures to confirm that emergency situations such as fires, earthquakes and the like or failures occur in the emergency broadcast transmitting system and reflects information on the failures according to a variety of types and forms of the emergency situations to change settings of the emergency broadcast transmitting system, thereby easily coping with failures due to emergency situations.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 비상방송 송출용 스마트 프로세서 장치 및 그 운용방법에 관한 것으로, 각 방송지역(예: 빌딩, 아파트 등의 하나의 층, 또는 일정 범위의 구역)에 구비된 앰프, 스피커, 선로 등을 포함한 비상방송 송출 시스템의 구동을 독립적으로 제어하는 스마트 프로세서 장치에서, 비상상황이나 장애에 대한 정보를 수집하여 화재, 지진 등의 비상상황이나 비상방송 송출 시스템에 장애가 발생한 것을 확인하고, 상기 비상상황의 다양한 종류 및 형태에 따라 상기 장애에 대한 정보를 반영하여 상기 비상방송 송출 시스템의 설정을 변경함으로써, 비상상황에 따른 장애 대처를 용이하게 수행할 수 있는 비상방송 송출용 스마트 프로세서 장치 및 그 운용방법에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Infotainment system for notifying emergency rescue request and method thereof
title_ko: 긴급 구조 요청 알림 인포테인먼트 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method and a system for notifying an emergency rescue request using an infotainment system. An emergency rescue request notification method in a vehicle according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises the steps of: detecting an accident of the vehicle; collecting information corresponding to the detected accident; generating an emergency rescue request message based on the collected information; searching for an FM radio channel with the highest reception sensitivity; changing the program type of the searched FM radio channel to a specific value using an FM radio data system message and transmitting the same; and transmitting the emergency rescue request message through the discovered FM radio channel. Accordingly, the present invention has the advantage of being able to provide a vehicle emergency rescue service more safely and inexpensively.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 인포테인먼트 시스템을 이용한 긴급 구조 요청 알림 방법 및 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 본 발명의 일 실시 예에 따른 실시 예에 따른 차량에서의 긴급 구조 요청 알림 방법은 상기 차량의 사고를 감지하는 단계와 상기 감지된 사고에 상응하는 정보를 수집하는 단계와 상기 수집된 정보에 기초하여 긴급 구조 요청 메시지를 생성하는 단계와 수신 감도가 최상위인 FM 라디오 채널을 탐색하는 단계와 상기 탐색된 FM 라디오 채널의 프로그램 타입을 FM 무선 데이터 시스템 메시지를 이용하여 특정 값으로 변경하여 전송하는 단계와 상기 탐색된 FM 라디오 채널을 통해 상기 긴급 구조 요청 메시지를 전송하는 단계를 포함할 수 있다. 따라서, 본 발명은 보다 안전하고 저렴하게 차량 긴급 구조 서비스를 제공할 수 있는 장점이 있다.

title_en: Linkage alarm for residential building
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fire-fighting equipment, in particular to a linkage alarm for residential building, which comprises a property computer and a plurality of alarms, wherein each alarm comprises a shell, a smoke induction sensor, a temperature induction sensor, an earthquake detector, a circuit board, a processor, a networking module, a storage battery and a loudspeaker, which are arranged in the shell, and the networking module is in communication connection with the property computer; in practical application, a plurality of alarms are installed in a public area of a community, the smoke content in the air is detected through a smoke induction sensor, the vibration condition of a house is detected through a seismic detector, and when the smoke content of the building is abnormal or the vibration is abnormal, a processor sends abnormal hidden danger information to a property computer through a networking module; the utility model discloses can give the property with potential safety hazard information automatic feedback, quick early warning and automatic linkage are reported to the police, assist the resident to withdraw, and it is reliable and stable to use, protects resident life and property safety.
assignees: NANJING ZHIAN INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: High formwork bearing structure safety precaution equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high formwork bearing structure safety precaution device, including the pillar, the middle part fixedly connected with bracing piece of pillar, the one end fixedly connected with casing of bracing piece, the equal fixedly connected with fixing device in both ends of pillar. Through the pillar, the setting of devices such as lamp area and fixture block, make when the pillar takes place certain settlement and displacement because pressurized, make the bearing diagonal pole under the effect of pressure, promote the fixture block and slide on the bracing piece, make the fixed block of fixture block both sides touch first switch or second switch under the effect of thrust, when the fixture block touches first switch, first switch is opened, start bee calling organ, make bee calling organ sound, thereby avoided sheltering from the difficult discovery device early warning of sight because of the supporting structure subassembly is intensive, when the fixture block touching is when the second switch, the second switch is opened, thereby start the lamp area, and then reach the effect of early warning through the scintillation in lamp area, and then make constructor in time withdraw after the discovery early warning.

title_en: Intelligent fence laser column, intelligent anti-intrusion system and safety protection method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent fence laser column, an intelligent anti-intrusion system and a safety protection method, and aims to solve the technical problems of inconvenience in movement, poor protection warning effect and insufficient durability of the existing protection fence. The intelligent gate control system comprises an intelligent authorized door lock, an electronic fence and an LED display terminal, wherein a gate control unit comprises a mechanical lock and a recognizer for controlling the opening and closing of the mechanical lock, the fence comprises a boundary line and a warning line, the boundary line is connected end to form a closed protection area, the gate control unit is arranged on a path formed by the boundary line, intelligent fence laser columns are arranged on the boundary line at intervals and used for forming the warning line in the protection area, and an electronic display screen is arranged and used for playing warning information in a rolling mode. The invention has the beneficial effects that: the structure is light, the management is fine, the real-time recording is realized, and the content can be updated in time.
assignees: ZHENGZHOU JINGCHENG ELECTRIC POWER EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Access control system with fire-fighting warning function and fire-fighting warning method
abstract_en: An access control system with fire warning and a fire warning method are provided. The sensing device senses an environment and outputs a plurality of environmental parameters. The entrance guard device comprises a wireless communication unit, an entrance guard storage unit, an entrance guard communication unit and a control unit, wherein the control unit calculates the dangerous state according to the environmental parameters, the weight of a plurality of parameters and the dangerous threshold value. The cloud device comprises a cloud communication unit, a cloud storage unit, an artificial intelligence unit and a processing unit, the processing unit outputs a warning signal according to the dangerous state, and the artificial intelligence unit calculates new parameter weights according to the dangerous state and the corresponding environment parameters and updates the parameter weights to the access control device. Therefore, the early warning accuracy can be improved.

title_en: Disaster monitoring system and method based on data analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster monitoring system and a disaster monitoring method for data analysis, wherein the disaster monitoring system comprises a landslide data storage module, a three-dimensional visualization module, a slope crack detection module, a crack propagation speed analysis module, a landslide slip surface prediction analysis module, a slip surface inclination angle analysis module, a landslide volume prediction analysis module, a landslide early warning grade evaluation module and a landslide early warning module, and the disaster monitoring system has the beneficial effects that: the method comprises the steps of obtaining crack data on a slope, screening the data, carrying out inclination analysis on cracks meeting the conditions, predicting a landslide surface of the landslide through inclination analysis, predicting the volume of the landslide and the inclination angle of the landslide surface according to the landslide surface, calculating the time for the crack to expand to the landslide surface according to the expansion speed of the crack, evaluating the early warning grade through the landslide volume, the landslide inclination angle and the shortest expansion time, timely issuing early warning, and taking preventive and therapeutic measures according to the early warning grade or informing people to withdraw as soon as possible, so that the life and property safety of people is ensured.

title_en: Fire extinguisher indicator lamp control system for tunnel
title_ko: 터널용 소화기 표시등 제어시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire extinguisher indicator lamp control system for a tunnel. The fire extinguisher indicator lamp control system for a tunnel may notify a driver of the occurrence of fire or an accident. The fire extinguisher indicator lamp control system for a tunnel comprises: a speed measurement sensor (100) for generating speed data of a vehicle traveling inside a tunnel; fire detection sensors (200) installed in every predetermined area of the tunnel; a control server (300) in which identification information of the fire detection sensors and information of a fire extinguisher indicator lamp are stored; and the fire extinguisher indicator lamp (400) for emitting an LED.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 터널 내부에 설치된 소화기 표시등의 시인성을 높여주면서 터널 내부를 주행하는 차량의 속도에 따라 소화기 표시등의 색상을 변경하여 운전자에게 화재나 사고발생을 알림할 수 있는 터널용 소화기 표시등 제어시스템에 관한 것이다. 본 발명은 터널 내부를 주행하는 차량의 속도데이터를 생성하기 위한 속도측정센서(100)와, 상기 터널의 일정 구역마다 설치되어 화재를 감지하여 식별정보가 포함된 화재발생신호를 생성하기 위한 화재감지센서(200)와, 미리 터널의 구역별로 설치된 화재감지센서의 식별정보와 소화기 표시등의 정보가 저장된 관제서버(300)와, 상기 속도데이터와 미리 저장된 터널 내의 규정속도를 비교하여 LED를 발광시키기 위한 소화기 표시등(400)을 포함하는 터널용 소화기 표시등 제어시스템에 있어서, 상기 관제서버(300)는, 상기 화재감지센서(200)로부터 수신받은 화재발생신호의 식별정보와 동일한 구역에 설치된 소화기 표시등으로 소화기알림신호를 전송하여 소화기 위치를 안내하기 위한 소화기알림부(330)를 포함하고, 상기 소화기 표시등(400)은, 상기 속도데이터가 비정상으로 판단될 경우에 미리 설정된 속도별 색상 중 상기 비정상으로 판단된 속도데이터에 대응되는 색상의 LED를 발광시키는 경고부(440)와, 상기 관제서버(300)로부터 상기 소화기알림신호를 수신받을 경우에 소화기의 시인성을 향상시킬 수 있으면서 소화기의 위치를 표시하도록 해당 LED를 점멸시키는 소화기안내부(450)를 포함하며, 상기 경고부(440)는, 미리 설정된 시간동안 상기 비정상으로 판단된 속도데이터에 대응되는 색상의 LED를 발광시킨 후 기본색상의 LED를 발광시키고, 상기 속도데이터가 정상으로 판단될 경우에 기본색상인 LED의 발광을 유지하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Car Rear Safety Stationery Device
title_ko: 자동차 후방 안전문구 생성 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a device for generating words of safety on the rear of a vehicle. The device comprises: a display panel and a sunshade installed on the back glass of a vehicle; a rear horn unit installed on the rear end of the vehicle; and a control unit provided in the interior space of the vehicle, and communicatively connected to the display panel, the sunshade, and the rear horn unit to control the operation of each device. The device can request, from vehicles behind or pedestrians a danger signal including an accident situation in front of the driving vehicle or a vehicle breakdown condition, a rescue request signal in case of kidnapping or illness occurrence, lane change, and restraints on retaliatory driving, can store, in a memory, text and voice messages corresponding to a notification signal to report to the public office as needed, and can select and print the stored message.
abstract_ko:
자동차 후방 만전문구 생성 장치에 관한 것으로, 자동차의 후측 윈드글라스에 설치되는 디스플레이 패널과 햇빛 가리개, 자동차의 후단부에 설치되는 후방 경적 유닛 및 자동차의 실내 공간에 마련되고, 상기 디스플레이 패널과 햇빛 가리개 및 후방 경적 유닛과 통신 가능하게 연결되어 각 장치의 구동을 제어하는 제어부를 포함하는 구성을 
마련하여, 후방의 차량이나 행인들에게 주행 차량의 전방 사고 상황이나 차량 고장 상태를 포함하는 위험신호, 납치나 환자 발생에 따른 구조 요청신호, 차선 변경, 보복운전의 자제를 요청하고 필요 시 관공서에 신고를 알리는 알림 신호에 대응되는 문자 및 음성 메시지를 메모리에 저장하며, 저장된 메시지를 선택해서 출력할 수 있다.

title_en: Slope landslide early warning method based on NPR cable slip force monitoring
abstract_en: The invention discloses a slope landslide early warning method based on NPR cable slip force monitoring. Firstly, constructing an evidence reasoning model for predicting the sliding force of the side slope, wherein input variables of the evidence reasoning model are a sliding force monitoring value acquired by an NPR anchor cable sensor at the current moment and a difference value between the sliding force monitoring value at the current moment and a sliding force monitoring value at the historical moment, and output variables of the evidence reasoning model are predicted values of the future sliding force of the side slope; then constructing a Reference Evidence Matrix (REM) to model a mapping relation between input and output variables; when the input variable samples are acquired online, the evidence of activation of the input variable samples is obtained through REM, all the evidences of activation of the input variable samples are fused through an evidence reasoning algorithm to obtain a fusion result, the predicted value of the slope sliding force at the future moment is calculated through the fusion result, and an alarm threshold value is set to implement out-of-limit alarm; by utilizing a sequential linear programming method, REM is updated in real time for predicting the sliding force at the next moment, and the predicted value of the method has higher prediction precision.

title_en: Aircraft on-site state warning interaction device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an aircraft on-site state warning interaction device, which comprises a base, universal wheels are fixedly connected at four right angles at the bottom of the base, a fixed frame is fixedly connected at the top of the base, a control box is fixedly connected at the top of the fixed frame at the bottom, a LED display control panel is fixedly connected at the front of the control box, a monitoring interaction camera is fixedly connected at the middle part of the bottom of the fixed frame, information notification can be changed at any time, when the aircraft state changes, the display information of an aircraft state display board only needs to be updated at a control end, the change of the display information can be completed within 1 second at the fastest, safety and high efficiency are realized, the information notification form is diversified, besides character information, optical information and sound voice broadcast can be provided by a warning lamp system, sound, light and electricity are combined, information bidirectional notification is realized, the technology of the Internet of, the manager can obtain the field situation through the carried camera and timely receive the feedback of the field personnel to form a closed loop.

title_en: Marine information early warning method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device and electronic equipment for early warning marine information, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring ocean data acquired by shipborne equipment in real time through a communication unit; based on a preset data processing algorithm, carrying out data processing on the ocean data to obtain data keywords; obtaining a prediction rule matched with the data keyword based on the data keyword and the real-time prediction model; the real-time prediction model is updated in real time based on data collected by each channel; generating target early warning information according to the prediction rule and the ocean data; and sending the target early warning information to the shipborne equipment. The invention can improve the accuracy of the early warning information.
assignees: CMA PUBLIC METEOROLOGICAL SERVICE CENTRE NAT EARLY WARNING INFORMATION PUBLISHING CENTER

title_en: Systems and methods of security system access and sharing temporal event-based notifications and access to devices of designated persons
abstract_en: Implementations of the disclosed subject matter provide systems and methods of granting temporary control access of a home security system of a first user to a second user, where the temporary control access is for at least a portion of a home security system for a predetermined period of time. One or more tasks to be completed for the first user may be completed by the second user while having temporary control access to the home security system. The temporary control access of the second user to the at least a portion of the home security system of the first user may be revoked when the predetermined period of time has elapsed. The second user may receive a notification may be received for a security event, a safety event, a home event, and a package delivery event after the predetermined period of time has lapsed.

title_en: Alarm device for petroleum and natural gas downhole operation
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an oil and gas is alarm device for borehole operation, including warning monitoring devices, the warning monitoring devices upper surface passes through bolt and upper cover meshing, and warning monitoring devices upper surface both sides are provided with the installation ear seat respectively, and the warning monitoring devices front side passes through the screw thread and meshes with the protecgulum, installs the display screen on the protecgulum. This alarm device is used in oil and gas borehole operation, after the data that gas sensing module received the sensor reached the standard of settlement, bee calling organ carried out the police dispatch newspaper, the pilot lamp glimmers simultaneously, in time remind borehole operation personnel in time to withdraw safely, avoid the production incident to take place, further strengthen the safety guarantee, confirm when remote alarm device that oil and gas concentration exceeds standard data and positional information report to the police, intelligent degree is high, the reliability of use is high, it is more humanized, it wastes time to cause when avoiding personnel in the pit to look for the leakage mouth, thereby lead to leaking more seriously, prevent that the unexpected condition from taking place.
assignees: XINXIANG CITY XIAFENG ELECTRICAL APPLIANCES CO LTD

title_en: Real-time monitoring system for deformation of construction support
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a real-time supervision system for construction support warp, including ground monitoring system, data control center, suspension system and alarm device, suspension system can deviate ground monitoring system's central point when the support warp and put, and ground monitoring system's sensor can monitor the position of round steel on the calibrated scale to transmit measured data to data control center, when exceeding the alarm value on the calibrated scale, alarm device's warning light can flash, and the megaphone can generate audio alert. The utility model discloses the development achievement of make full use of modern science and technology gets rid of the error of people's observation simultaneously, can accomplish real-time supervision and dangerous early warning again, and the notice operation personnel withdraw to safe region before danger comes, thoroughly solves the drawback that traditional support body was surveyd, guarantees the safety of job site and operation personnel's life safety furthest.
assignees: CCTE3 INFRASTRUCTURE CONSTR INVEST CO LTD;CHINA CONSTRUCTION 3RD ENG BUREAU GROUP CO LTD

title_en: The disaster response rescuer location prediction system using the artificial intelligence
title_ko: 인공지능을 이용한 재난대응 피구조자 위치예측시스템
abstract_en: The present invention implement a system, which utilizes the characteristic of generating or receiving a frequency signal in a state in which the rescued possesses various sensors using various radio frequencies, when performing positioning, parses the position value of the rescued person through the application of a receiving terminal, so that the parsed frequency data is used to position the rescued, and converts various position values used for positioning of the rescued into tagged data and then predicts a future predictable position, that is, the position of the rescued, through machine learning. According to the present invention, it is possible to derive a predicted position of the rescued in the future by applying the reuse of position data and machine learning.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 다양한 무선주파수를 이용하는 다양한 센서를 피구조자가 소지한 상태에서 주파수 신호를 발생 혹은 수신하는 특성을 이용하여 그 측위를 수행할 때 피 구조자의 위치값을 수신단의 애플리케이션을 통해 파싱 하고, 그 파싱된 주파수 데이터를 이용하여 피 구조자의 위치측위를 하게 된다. 이렇게 피구조자의 측위에 사용되는 다양한 위치 값들을 Tagging된 데이터로 변환 후 기계학습을 통해 미래의 예측 가능한 위치 즉, 피구조자의 위치를 예측하는 시스템을 만드는 것이 본 발명의 핵심 내용으로써 주파수를 발생 혹은 수신하는 피구조자의 센서의 위치측위에서의 파원과 관측자인 수신센서 사이에서 발생하는 주파수 왜곡과 도플러 효과에 의한 오차를 감안하여 피구조자 센서의 미래 위치를 예측하는 시스템을 만드는 것을 목적으로 하며 그 방식은 위치측위에 사용되는 무선신호 데이터를 맵에 매핑하여 그 데이터를 통한 위치값을 Tagging된 데이터로 변환한 후 기계학습을 통해 피구조자의 미래 예측 위치를 산출해내는 방법을 기술한 것이다. 
본 발명에 대해 보다 상세하게 설명을 하면 3차원의 공간에 존재하는 피구조자 즉, 파원을 특정 공간에 위치시킨 후 주파수를 일정한 주기로 방송토록 하고, 구조자를 통해 파원의 위치를 측위 하는 데이터를 얻고, 그 위치데이터를 통해 미래의 그 피구조자가 위치하게 될 위치데이터를 예측하는 방법을 기술한 발명이다. 구체적으로는 피구조자의 현재 위치데이터에 대하여 Tagging하게 되는데 그 Tagging하는 방법이 피구조자 위치측위 알고리즘이며,Tagging된 데이터를 이용하여 예측모형을 구현하는 것이 인공지능 피구조자 위치예측 알고리즘이다. 본 발명에서는 예측가능한 모형의 생성 및 훈련 및 학습 그리고 예측평가 부분을 융합한 것으로써 슈퍼바이즈드 러닝의 추상화와 일반화 모델을 통한 예측 모형으로 저장된 데이터를 좀 더 포괄적 형태와 개념으로 변환하고, 또한 그 저장된 데이터에 숨겨져 있는 패턴을 구체적으로 예측하도록 하는 방식을 표현하는 것이다.  
본 발명을 구체화 하기위해 피구조 대상자의 주파수 인식단계, 피구조자 소유 센서의 3차원 위치값 부여단계, 2차원 센서 위치값으로 변환단계, 2차원 위치값에 대한 예측변수포함단계, 2차원 위치값을 데이터베이스에 저장단계, 머신러닝을 통한 위치 예측값 도출단계, 위치 예측값의 데이터베이스에 저장하는 단계, 피구조자 센서의 위치예측값 도출단계, 피구조자 위치 예측값과 실제값 확인단계로 구현할 수 있으며, 
첫 단계인 피구조자로부터 발생되는 주파수의 발생과 인식단계부터 마지막 단계인 피구조자의 위치예측값과 실제 현재 위치값 확인단계를 통해 보다 높은 정확도의 위치예측 값을 계속적으로 도출해내는 과정을 반복함으로써 위치데이터가 많이 쌓이면 쌓일수록 피구조자의 위치예측의 정확도가 높아진다. 이것을 구체화하기 위해 3차원 공간에서 센서네트워크를 형성함으로서 그 공간을 측위를 위한 환경으로 구성하는 것이고, 스캐너를 통해 그 피구조자의 현재 위치를 측위 할 수 있게 된다. 이런 센서네트워크에서 공간의 인식을 3차원 즉, 실제 공간 그 자체로 그대로 2차원 좌표값을 부여하며, 그 2차원 좌표값이 실제 3차원 좌표 값이 되는 것을 증명한다. 이 실제 좌표 값은 본 발명에서 최종적으로 위치예측데이터의 예측 값과 비교되어 미래의 가장 정확성이 높은 예측 값을 다시 채택하여 위치예측의 정확도를 높인다. 구체적으로는 3차원의 큐브로 도출한 큐브는 V0부터 V7까지의 꼭짓점 값으로 함축하여 위치데이터를 표현할 수 있다. 즉, V0,V1,V2,V3,V4,V5,V6,V7이 V0,V1,V2,V3,V6,V7로 데이터 값을 함축할 수 있다. 또한 V0,V1,V2,V3,V6,V7는 다시 V0,V1,V6,V7로 사각형을 형성하며 4개의 값을 가지는 2차원 위치데이터로 변환할 수 있다. 이때 이 위치데이터는 실제 위치데이터가 아닌 실제 센서가 위치한 3차원 좌표값의 전체 큐브 중 피구조자가 포함되어 있는 큐브의 위치데이터가 된다. 이렇게 도출된 큐브의 꼭짓점 값인 V0,V1,V6,V7은 2차원 좌표값에 표시하기 위해 사용되어 지는데, 이것은 본 발명에서 피구조자의 실제 위치인 3차원의 위치값을 2차원의 위치값으로 변환하는 방법에 대한 발명이다. 즉, 3차원의 위치측위값은 큐브의 재 정의를 통해 2차원의 위치값으로 변경된다.  
변경되는 방식은 A=V0,V1,V6,V7 로서 2차원 좌표값에서 A의 값을 지정한다. A의 좌표값은 가로축인 VX와 세로축인 VY가 교차하는 점으로써 A=V0,V1,V6,V7 은 AVX, AVY로 치환할 수 있다. 
즉, V0,V1,V2,V3,V4,V5,V6,V7의 꼭짓점을 갖는 3차원의 큐브가 V0,V1,V6,V7의 꼭짓점을 갖는 2차원의 평면으로 변경되었다. 이 변경된 위치값은 2차원의 평면에서 위치값으로써 도면의 교차점에 좌표로 표시할 수 있다. 2차원 공간의 B의 위치값 V0,V1,V6,V7은 V0,V1,V2,V3,V4,V5,V6,V7의 꼭짓점을 갖는 3차원의 큐브에 속한 위치값을 가지게 된다. 
본 발명에서는 일반적인 좌표값이 교차되는 지점이 아닌 피구조자가 존재하는 큐브를 3차원 좌표값 큐브를 예측 위치값으로 가정할 수 있다. 이것이 위치예측을 위한 2차원과 3차원의 위치측위를 위한 데이터의 전환 알고리즘이다. 
실제로 3차원에 존재하는 피구조자의 위치값을 2차원으로 변환하여 예측데이터를 생성하고 그것을 다시 실제 3차원데이터로 변환하여 실제 위치와 비교하여 실제 위치를 측위 함으로써 위치예측데이터를 쉽게 도출할 수 있다.  
만약 현재의 3차원에서의 피구조자의 위치가 A라는 값을 가진다면 이 피구조자의 향후 위치는 A나 B나 C로 이동할 수 있다는 것이고, 그 이동경로는 기준점인  를 기준으로 설정된  1,  2,  3을 기준으로  A,  B,  C로 그 경로를 예측할 수 있다. 그렇게 이동할 수 있는 기준점과 기준선 그리고 기준경로가 정해져 있으므로 A에서 B 그리고 C로 이동하여 A의 향후 예측위치가 A , B , C중 한곳으로 정해질 수 있음을 반증한다. 
3차원 공간에서 A의 위치가 A, B, C로 변경되는 예측모델은 기준점   와 기준선  1,  2,  3 그리고 기준경로  A,  B,  C 에 예속될 수밖에 없다. 즉,  의 방위각을 갖는 3차원에서 A의 위치이동은 기준점과 기준선 그리고 기준경로에서 벗어날 수 없으므로 그 예측위치 또한 벗어날 수 없다.  
이상과 같이 설정된 기준점과 기준선 그리고 기준경로는 최초 A의 위치측위로부터 시작된다.  
2차원 좌표값에서 기준점과 기준선 그리고 기준경로 및 현재의 위치를 정의한 후 실제 피구조자의 위치를 관측하는 스캐너(스마트폰)에서는 수신 위치데이터를 기준으로 학습을 위한 데이터를 Tagging하는데, 현재의 위치값과 미래의 위치값을 Clustering = > Classification => Decision Tree를 통해 얻어진 데이터는  1,  2,  3 범위 안에 포함되므로, 예측값의 범위 안에 존재하게 된다는 결론을 얻은 부분에 대해서 최종적으로 기계학습을 통한 위치예측을 수행할 수 있다. 
도3의 302그림은 2차원도면위에 존재하는 현재 A의 위치에 존재하는 피구조자의 위치는  Deep Learning을 통해 현재 위치가 A일 경우, A가 아닐 경우, B일 경우, B가 아닐 경우, C일 경우, C가 아닐 경우 의 경우의 케이스를 비 학습데이터를 삽입하여 그것이 위치예측을 위한 기준점  와 근접관계를 형성하는지  A와 근접관계를 형성하는지  B와 근접관계를 형성하는지  C와 근접관계를 형성하는지 판단한다.  ,  A,  B,  C로 부터 얻은 데이터를 기반으로 위치의 이동 범위를 설정할 수 있는 가능성을 
판단하는 있는 기준선인  1,  2,  3를 재 매핑시킴으로써 최종적으로 현재 피구조자의 위치인 A는 주어진 일정시간 후에 V의 값을 가지게 된다. 이 V는 현재 2차원 좌표값에서 X, Y, Z의 위치값을 가지며, 위치와 시간과 주파수 및 측정시점을 기준으로 현재와 과거 그리고 미래를 아우르는 가능성 높은 위치예측값을 도출할 수 있다. 이렇게 도출된 V의 값은 2차원의 V0,V1,V6,V7이므로 도2에서 기술한 것처럼 V0,V1,V2,V3,V4,V5,V6,V7의 꼭짓점을 갖는 3차원의 큐브에 속한 위치값으로 변환된다. 
이상이 본 발명의 두 번째 알고리즘인 인공지능 기계학습의 예측가능한 모형의 생성 및 훈련 및 학습 부분이다.  
서두에서 밝힌바와 같이 본 발명은 위치측위 알고리즘과 인공지능의 학습 및 예측을 융합한 발명이다. 측위알고리즘을 통해 얻어진 데이터에 대하여 데이터 Tagging작업을 수행하고, 그 Tagging된 데이터를 기반으로 어떤 방식으로 학습과 예측모델을 구현해 내는지가 본 발명의 인공지능 예측 알고리즘이다. 
본 발명은 위치데이터의 재사용 및 기계학습을 적용함으로써 향후 피구조자의 예측위치를 도출할 수 있으며, 이 기술은 관찰대상자(노약자, 어린이, 범죄자)의 예상동선과 목적지 추적 및 재난안전 대피기술, 피구조자 탐색기술, 해양수중 어로탐지예측기술, 자율주행차 사고예측기술 또한 공장자동화의 작업위치에 대한 생산성증대 기술까지 광범위하게 활용될 수 있다.

title_en: Power Cable Waterproof Device
title_ko: 건축 배전용 케이블 침수 방지장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a cable flooding prevention device for building power distribution which can automatically block water infiltrating into a waterproof housing enclosing a power cable connection unit. The cable flooding prevention device for building power distribution comprises: a reinforcing sleeve (80, 90) enclosing the outer circumferential surface of a cable support pipe (31, 41); lead pins (50p, 51p, 52p, 53p) connected to conductive rubber rings (50, 51, 52, 53); lead withdrawal holes (81, 82, 91, 92) formed in the reinforcing sleeve (80, 90) to withdraw the lead pins (50p, 51p, 52p, 53p) to the outside, and having an inner diameter larger than the diameter of the lead pins (50p, 51p, 52p, 53p); and an insulation filling material (81s, 82s, 91s, 92s) filling the space between the lead withdrawal holes (81, 82, 91, 92) and the lead pins (50p, 51p, 52p, 53p).
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 전력케이블 접속부를 감싸고 있는 방수하우징 내부로 침투하는 수분을 자동으로 차단할 수 있도록 한 건축 배전용 케이블 침수 방지장치에 관한 것으로, 케이블 지지관(31)(41)의 외주면을 감싸는 보강슬리브(80)(90); 도전성 고무링(50)(51)(52)(53)에 각각 접속되는 리드핀(50p)(51p)(52p)(53p); 리드핀(50p)(51p)(52p)(53p)을 외부로 인출하기 위해 보강슬리브(80)(90)에 형성되고, 리드핀(50p)(51p)(52p)(53p)의 직경보다 큰 내경을 갖는 리드인출구멍(81)(82)(91)(92); 리드인출구멍(81)(82)(91)(92)과 리드핀(50p)(51p)(52p)(53p) 간의 공간을 메우는 절연충진재(81s)(82s)(91s)(92s)를 포함한다.

title_en: Emergency call method, and electronic apparatus
abstract_en: The present application provides an emergency call method and an electronic apparatus. The method is applicable to electronic apparatuses, and comprises: detecting, while an electronic apparatus is in a locked screen state, a first operation of a user on a display screen; the electronic apparatus displaying, in response to the first operation, an emergency call interface via the display screen, wherein the emergency call interface comprises one or more emergency call numbers and notification information, the notification information is used to notify that a call to a first emergency call number is to be automatically made after a first preset duration expires, and the one or more emergency numbers comprise the first emergency call number; after the first preset duration expires, automatically making a call to an alarm station if the electronic apparatus does not detect a user operation on the display screen; and after a call connection between the electronic apparatus and the alarm station is disconnected, the electronic apparatus displaying a locked screen interface via the display screen. Embodiments of the present application facilitate quick emergency calls for users in emergency conditions.

title_en: Anti-collision network construction method based on TDMA networking technology
abstract_en: The invention provides an anti-collision network construction method based on a TDMA networking technology, which comprises the following steps. And respectively configuring an airborne node and a handheld node, and electing a central node in the airborne node according to a self-adaptive election strategy, wherein other nodes in the airborne node are common nodes. The central node issues network access broadcast messages to the common nodes, allocates time slots for the common nodes and issues network setting information, and therefore network access design is completed. And the central node deletes the ordinary nodes to be quitted from the network node table, updates and transmits the information of each node, and finishes quitting the network of the ordinary nodes. The method effectively avoids the problem of disordered collision of signals with the same frequency in the air through the design of effective time slot and channel allocation, and improves the timeliness of search and rescue signals.

title_en: Method for preventing a risky situation for a parked vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for preventing a risky situation for a parked vehicle, comprising the steps of obtaining a first parking location of the vehicle, obtaining an indication according to which the first location is a risky location, broadcasting a warning message for the attention of the occupants of the vehicle, detecting a movement of the vehicle upon the expiration of a predefined time period after broadcasting the message and, when it is determined that the vehicle has not been moved, a step of triggering a call to an emergency call centre. The invention also relates to a device capable of implementing such a method.

title_en: Methods, systems, and apparatuses for edge based notification through crowdsourced live fleet streamed communications
abstract_en: Apparatuses, methods, and systems of an edge server communicating with vehicles by continuously receiving messages which include data of state transitions of Electronic Control Units (ECUs) contained in each vehicle; monitoring in real-time the streamed message data from each vehicle for detection of updates of data about state transitions of ECUs used in the vehicular operations; crowdsourcing in real-time the state transition data of the ECUs during the vehicular operations to group together state transition data having commonality as crowdsource transition data; processing, using a machine learning model, the crowdsource transition data, to classify the crowdsource transition data of an anomaly event; and transmit in advance to an identified vehicle an alert of the anomaly event in order for a driver or ADAS to execute a response.

title_en: Intelligent early warning safety fire control unit
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent early warning safety fire-fighting device, which comprises a control box, a controller, a storage battery, an alarm, a manual alarm button, a heat dissipation mechanism and a first induction mechanism; the controller and the storage battery are both arranged in the control box; the alarm, the manual alarm button and the heat dissipation mechanism are all arranged on the outer side of the control box; the first induction mechanism comprises a first induction box, a smoke sensor and a first alarm; the smoke sensor and the first alarm are both arranged below the first induction box; the storage battery, the alarm, the manual alarm button, the smoke sensor and the first alarm are electrically connected with the controller, when the smoke sensor senses fire, the alarm and the first alarm can send out fire early warning signals through the controller, so that the alarm can send out alarm sound to remind residents of withdrawing a fire scene in time, and fire fighters can take fire extinguishing measures in time.

title_en: Cantilever system having vibration damping
title_ko: 진동 완충 기능을 구비한 캔틸레버 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a cantilever system having a vibration buffering function. In accordance with one embodiment of the present invention, there can be an effect of facilitating installation through an insertion coupling structure of first and second cantilever parts. Moreover, as the first and second cantilever parts are elastically combined with each other through an elastic body and a buffer spring part, vibrations or impacts generated from a structure are absorbed and dispersed, and, as a result, there can be an effect of increasing stability, and effectively handling the deformation of a deck load structure caused by an earthquake or the like. Moreover, as a guide bracket is installed between the elastic body and the second cantilever part, there can be an effect of increasing vibration absorption and buffering efficiency. Moreover, as an elastic support part is added to an upper part of a side plate part of the guide bracket, there can be an effect of increasing vibration absorption and buffering efficiency. Moreover, as a sensor part for sensing vibrations is provided in a cantilever part, there can be an effect of accurately measuring vibrations delivered through the structure in case of an earthquake. Moreover, as a vibration warning display part for transmitting a warning message in accordance with a value measured by the sensor part is provided, there can be an effect of quickly warning pedestrians in case of an earthquake.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 진동 완충 기능을 구비한 캔틸레버 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명의 일실시예에 의하면, 제1캔틸레버부와 제2캔틸레버부의 끼움결합구조에 의해 설치가 용이한 효과가 있다. 
또한, 탄성체와 완충스프링부에 의해 제1캔틸레버부와 제2캔틸레버부가 상호 탄력적으로 결합함으로써 구조물에서 발생하는 진동이나 충격을 흡수 및 분산시킴으로써 안정성을 높이고, 지진 등으로 인한 데크로드 구조물의 변형에 유효하게 대응할 수 있는 효과가 있다. 
또한, 탄성체와 제2캔틸레버부 사이에 가이드브라켓을 설치함으로써, 진동 흡수 및 완충 효율을 높일 수 있는 효과가 있다. 
또한, 가이드브라켓의 사이드플레이트부 상부에 탄성지지부를 더 부가함으로써, 진동 흡수 및 완충 효율을 더욱 높일 수 있는 효과가 있다. 
또한, 캔틸레버부에 진동을 센싱하는 센서부가 구비됨으로써, 지진 발생시 구조물을 통해 전달되는 진동을 정확하게 측정할 수 있는 효과가 있다. 
또한, 센서부에서 측정된 값에 따라 경고메시지를 송출하는 진동경고표시부가 구비됨으로써, 지진 등 발생시 보행자에게 신속하게 지진 발생 상황을 알릴 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Next-generation forecast and alarm integrated control module
title_ko: 차세대 예/경보 통합관제 모듈
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a next-generation forecast/alarm integrated control module capable of transmitting disaster information using a plurality of mediums, wherein provided is a graphic user interface (GUI) capable of reviewing, changing, and approving disaster contents generated from a disaster content generation module.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 복수의 매체들을 이용하여 재난 정보를 전송할 수 있는 차세대 예/경보 통합관제 모듈에 관한 것으로, 재난 콘텐츠 생성 모듈로부터 생성된 재난 콘텐츠들을 검토, 변경 및 승인할 수 있는 그래픽 유저 인터페이스(GUI; Graphic User Interface)를 제공한다.

title_en: Management system of wisdom fire control warehouse based on RFID technique
abstract_en: The utility model provides a management system of wisdom fire control warehouse based on RFID technique, includes controller, inventory robot, RFID label, PC end and a plurality of multilayer goods shelves, all evenly be equipped with the pilot lamp on every layer of roof of multilayer goods shelves, and install RFID reader in the middle of every layer of roof of multilayer goods shelves, the touch-sensitive screen is installed in the place ahead of multilayer goods shelves, the controller respectively with RFID reader, PC end, pilot lamp and touch-sensitive screen electricity are connected, the utility model discloses a verify to fire control warehouse entry kind, quantity and carry out real-time warning and automatic correction to the regular check maintenance of fire-fighting equipment etc.; the checking robot scans, so that the cost of manual inspection is reduced, the warehouse management efficiency is improved, and equipment is maintained and updated; the goods shelf is provided with the touch screen and the voice broadcasting module, so that the problems of wrong taking, missing taking and multiple taking are solved.

title_en: Intelligent tripod
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent tripod, which comprises a moving frame and two frame plates, wherein the two frame plates are rotatably arranged at the top of the moving frame, the top of each frame plate is provided with a connecting rod which penetrates through two sides of the frame plate and is in sliding connection with the frame plate, and the frame plates are provided with reflective belts; a central controller is arranged in the movable frame, a plurality of flashing lamps are arranged on the frame plates, a laser lamp is fixed on one frame plate, an ultrasonic ranging sensor is arranged on the other frame plate, and the flashing lamps, the laser lamp and the ultrasonic ranging sensor are all electrically connected with the central controller; the central controller comprises a controller; the device carries out the high-speed vehicle in intelligent response rear through well accuse ware and ultrasonic ranging sensor to carry out the warning of multimode to accident vehicle and high-speed vehicle in rear through alarm module and dangerous feedback module, effectively avoid accident vehicle to take place the possibility of secondary accident, and effectively remind accident vehicle driver and crew to withdraw, reduce the production of casualties.
assignees: JUNIOR HIGH SCHOOL AFFILIATED TO CHONGQING NORMAL UNIV

title_en: Wisdom building site construction monitoring system based on BIM
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wisdom building site construction monitoring system based on BIM, including BIM management module, BIM management module's input electric connection has the video management platform, the input electric connection of video management platform has information processing module, information processing module's input electric connection has the thermal imaging detection instrument, information processing module's input electric connection has alarm sounder. The utility model discloses a thermal imaging detection instrument is convenient for at the construction picture that provides the scene that is clear at night, is convenient for send out sound and warn constructor when harm appears in the construction at night through the alarm sounder and withdraws the scene, is convenient for provide the illumination for constructor at night and can alternate red light suggestion constructor when the alarm sounder rings and withdraw the scene through the light module, has solved common problem that does not possess night warning function based on wisdom building site construction monitoring system on the market simultaneously.
assignees: HENAN QINGHONG CONSTRUCTION CONSULTING CO LTD

title_en: Fire alarm apparatus for unwanted alarm
title_ko: 비화재보 방지 기능을 갖는 화재 경보기
abstract_en: A fire alarm having a false alarm preventing function in accordance with an embodiment of the present invention comprises: multiple sensing units having different address information and sensing at least one of smoke, temperature, humidity, and gas, and generating a fire detection signal when it is determined as a fire situation; a repeater performing wireless communications with each of the multiple sensing units; a receiver performing wireless communications with the repeater; and a first server performing wireless communications with the receiver and determining the fire situation based on the fire detection signal. The first server includes a big data receiving unit receiving big data from an external second server, and a false alarm determining unit configured to determine the validity of the fire detection signal using different criteria for each situation based on the big data and values sensed by each of the multiple sensing units.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 비화재보 방지 기능을 갖는 화재 경보기는 서로 다른 어드레스 정보를 갖고, 각각이 연기, 온도, 습도, 및 가스 중 적어도 어느 하나를 감지하여 화재상황으로 판단되는 경우, 화재감지신호를 생성하는 복수의 센싱 유닛들, 상기 복수의 센싱 유닛들 각각과 무선 통신을 수행하는 중계기, 상기 중계기와 무선 통신을 수행하는 수신기, 및 상기 수신기와 무선 통신을 수행하고, 상기 화재감지신호를 근거로 상기 화재상황을 판단하는 제1 서버를 포함하고, 상기 제1 서버는 외부의 제2 서버에서 빅 데이터를 수신하는 빅 데이터 수신부 및 상기 빅 데이터 및 상기 복수의 센싱 유닛들 각각이 감지한 값을 근거로 상기 화재감지신호의 유효성을 상황 별로 상이한 기준으로 판단하는 비화재보 판단부를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Collision avoidance method between multiple air mobilities and air mobility implementing the same method
title_ko: 복수의 비행체 간 충돌 회비 방법 및 그것을 구현하기 위한 비행체
abstract_en: A collision avoidance method performed by a first aircraft flying in close proximity to a plurality of aircrafts according to an embodiment of the present invention may include the steps of: receiving an alert propagation message including the identification number of a second aircraft that is out of track from one of the plurality of aircrafts through a wireless communication interface; transmitting the alert propagation message changed by adding information of the first aircraft to the alert propagation message to the plurality of aircrafts when the alert propagation message does not correspond to the predefined maximum number of propagation; and correcting the navigation path of the first aircraft based on information included in the alert propagation message when the alert propagation message corresponds to the predefined maximum number of propagation.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 복수의 비행체와 근접하여 비행하는 제1비행체에 의해 수행되는 충돌 회피 방법은, 무선 통신 인터페이스를 통해 복수의 비행체 중 하나로부터, 궤도 이탈된 제2비행체의 식별번호를 포함하는 경고 전파 메시지를 수신하는 단계와, 경고 전파 메시지가 기 정의된 최대 전파 횟수에 대응하지 않는 경우, 경고 전파 메시지에 제1비행체의 정보를 추가하여 변경된 경고 전파 메시지를 복수의 비행체로 전송하는 단계, 및 경고 전파 메시지가 기 정의된 최대 전파 횟수에 대응하는 경우, 경고 전파 메시지에 포함된 정보에 기초하여 제1비행체의 운항 경로를 보정하는 단계를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Identifying emergency response validity and severity
abstract_en: One example method of operation may include identifying a plurality of emergency reporting entities located at an emergency location based on one or more received emergency communications, determining whether one or more of the emergency reporting entities have provided valid emergency response data, determining a level of severity of the emergency response data, and transmitting one or more notifications to one or more emergency response entities based on the level of severity and a type of emergency.

title_en: Processing method for grading early warning
abstract_en: The invention provides a processing method of grading early warning, which comprises the following specific steps: installing a monitoring device; performing a normal distribution test on all the measured data-time information, and dividing all the data into a plurality of normal distribution sets; temporarily fixing the result of the normal distribution test, selecting a nearest normal distribution data set for operation processing, and performing grading early warning according to the operation result; and by plotting a data-time plot; drawing a numerical value-date curve graph and a landslide speed-date curve; and fitting the numerical value-date curve graph into a function curve, and performing regression analysis by using the curve to predict subsequent landslide displacement and time points. The method adopts a statistical method and a mode of introducing data set segmentation, and carries out early warning sending, early warning cancellation judgment and regression analysis respectively through two parameters with different statistical meanings, thereby realizing the prediction of the slope landslide trend.
assignees: HUNAN LIANZHI MONITORING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Automatic parking tracker
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to managing and performing vehicle parking. The system may receive at least one parking message from the sensor. The parking message may indicate whether the vehicle is in the parking space and then track a duration of the vehicle in the parking space based on the at least one parking message. Some embodiments relate to starting a timer in response to receiving a parking request, wherein the timer is set to expire according to a requested parking duration. Further, a first alert signal may be generated in response to the duration exceeding a predetermined threshold and in response to no parking request being received; and the second alert signal may be generated in response to an indication that the vehicle is in the parking space and in response to expiration of the timer.

title_en: Disaster broadcasting device using fm signal and dmb
title_ko: Dmb 및 fm 신호를 이용하는 재난방송중계장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a disaster broadcast relay device using FM and DMB signals, which significantly increases a reception S/N ratio of a T-DMB signal. According to the present invention, the disaster broadcast relay device comprises: a noise cancelation unit receiving RF signal components of FM and T-DMB frequency bands and removing noise included in the RF signal components; a main variable attenuation unit adjusting the attenuation amount so that output of the FM signal is constant with respect to the RF signal component output from the noise cancelation unit; a first amplification unit low-noise amplifying the output of the main variable attenuation unit; a separation unit separating the FM signal and the DMB signal from the RF signal component output from the first amplification unit and outputting the signals through signal paths, respectively; an FM output unit amplifying the FM signal separated by the separation unit and wirelessly transmitting the amplified FM signal to the outside; an FM output control unit comparing the level of the FM signal transmitted from the FM output unit with a first set reference level to check a variation value of the FM signal and controlling the attenuation amount of the main variable attenuation unit according to the variation value of the FM signal; a DMB variable attenuation unit receiving the DMB signal separated by the separation unit and adjusting an attenuation amount so that output of the received DMB signal is constant; a DMB output unit amplifying the DMB signal output from the DMB variable attenuation unit and wirelessly transmitting the amplified signal to the outside; and a DMB output control unit comparing the level of the DMB signal transmitted from the DMB output unit with a second set reference level to check a variation value of the DMB signal and controlling the attenuation amount of the DMB variable attenuation unit in response to the variation value of the DMB signal.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 FM과 T-DMB 주파수 대역의 RF 신호 성분을 수신하고 RF 신호 성분에 포함된 잡음을 제거하는 잡음제거부, 잡음제거부에서 출력한 RF 신호 성분에 대하여 FM 신호의 출력이 일정하도록 감쇠량을 조절하는 메인 가변감쇠부, 상기 메인 가변감쇠부의 출력을 저 잡음 증폭시키는 제1 증폭부, 상기 제1 증폭부에서 출력한 RF 신호 성분에서 FM 신호와 DMB 신호를 분리하여 각각의 신호 경로로 출력하는 분리부, 상기 분리부에 의해 분리된 FM 신호를 증폭하여 외부로 무선 송출하는 FM 출력부, 상기 FM 출력부에서 송출하는 FM 신호의 레벨을 제1 설정 기준레벨과 비교하여 FM 신호의 변동값을 파악하고 FM 신호의 변동값에 따라 상기 메인 가변감쇠부의 감쇠량을 제어하는 FM출력 제어부, 상기 분리부에 의해 분리된 DMB 신호를 수신하고 수신한 DMB 신호의 출력이 일정하도록 감쇠량을 조절하는 DMB 가변감쇠부, 상기 DMB 가변감쇠부에서 출력하는 DMB 신호를 증폭하여 외부로 무선 송출하는 DMB 출력부, 그리고 상기 DMB 출력부에서 송출하는 DMB 신호의 레벨을 제2 설정 기준레벨과 비교하여 DMB 신호의 변동값을 파악하고 DMB 신호의 변동값에 대응하여 상기 DMB 가변감쇠부의 감쇠량을 제어하는 DMB출력 제어부를 포함하는 DMB 및 FM 신호를 이용하는 재난방송중계장치에 관한 것이다.
assignees: HANSOL 21 CO LTD;DONG YANG ITEL CO LTD

title_en: Multi-state triggered system and method for remote automatic monitoring and early warning of landslide mass
abstract_en: The present disclosure belongs to the technical field of monitoring landslide mass geological disasters, and discloses a multi-state triggered system and method for remote automatic monitoring and early warning of a landslide mass. The multi-state triggered system for remote automatic monitoring and early warning of a landslide mass includes: a landslide mass monitoring module, a data preprocessing module, a communication module, a central control module, a displacement monitoring module, a stability evaluation module, an abnormality early warning module, a power supply module, a data storage module and a display update module. In the present disclosure, through the displacement monitoring module and the stability evaluation module, long-term automatic monitoring of the landslide mass can be realized, and the displacement change of the landslide mass can be grasped so as to evaluate the stability of the landslide mass.

title_en: Disaster prevention supply stockpile management system
abstract_en: To facilitate management of an expiry date or the like of stored disaster prevention supplies.SOLUTION: Provided is a disaster prevention supply storage management system 1 for managing a stock status of disaster prevention supplies used at a time of disaster, the disaster prevention supply storage management system being provided with a product name storage unit 12 for storing product name information including a product name and price of the disaster prevention supplies, a location storage unit 13 for storing a site where the disaster prevention supplies are stockpiled as location information, a person-in-charge storage unit 14 for storing persons in charge of respective sites where the disaster prevention supplies are stored as the person-in- charge information, an item information control storage unit 11 for storing which product name of the disaster prevention product is stockpiled by which person at which site and the number of days remaining until the expiration date of the disaster prevention product acquired by calculation, as item information, a remaining days notification unit 15 for notifying the person in charge of the remaining days, a display unit 10 for displaying at least the item name, quantity, and number of remaining days of the item information on a screen, and an item information sorting unit for sorting in ascending order or in descending order of the number of remaining days contents displayed on the display unit.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Temporary emergency access to arbitrary network for medical implanted device
abstract_en: An emergency token for one-time, highly restricted, access to an arbitrary WiFi network, while maintaining full network security and integrity, is disclosed. When an IoT medical device (MD) detects failure in the IMD, or detects the patient having a medical emergency, IMD detects local active WiFi networks, and attempts connecting to a monitoring center through one of the networks. If the network is password protected, the connection may fail. The IMD retries the connection request using factory-installed one-time use token that is only for emergency calls only. If successful, the IMD sends an emergency message to the monitoring center, which dispatches emergency responder to the location of the IMD. Monitoring center invalidates the token with the central on-line token registrar when both the IMD and the monitoring center acknowledges that the notification is successful. A person having the proper security authorization can install a new one-time use token.

title_en: Notification message for backhaul radio link faliure in wireless relay networks
abstract_en: An integrated access and backhaul (IAB) parent node comprises a first radio interface and a radio second interface. The first radio interface is configured to establish a radio resource control (RRC) connection with a donor node; the second radio interface is configured to serve a cell to communicate with a wireless terminal. The wireless terminal may be a user equipment (UE) or a child IAB node. The IAB parent node comprises processor circuitry and transmitter circuitry. The processor circuitry is configured to: detect a radio link failure (RLF) on an upstream path to the donor node, provide updated system information based on the RLF, the updated system information comprising at least one cell status indicating that the cell is not allowed to camp on; and, generate a notification message comprising notification information configured to indicate whether the wireless terminal is to initiate an acquisition procedure to acquire the system information (a) immediately, or (b) after a next modification period boundary. The transmitter circuitry is configured to transmit, using the second interface, to the wireless terminal: the notification message and the updated system information.

title_en: Chest card with beeper
abstract_en: The utility model discloses can only show and update personal information to electron chest card among the prior art, the problem of function singleness provides a chest card of taking the calling set, belongs to chest card technical field, draws together chest card body and calling set, the lower extreme at the calling set is hung to the chest card body, the preceding display screen that is equipped with of calling set, the display screen is OLED display screen module, the calling set still includes power, wireless receiver, singlechip, voice broadcast system and vibrating motor, the power respectively with wireless receiver, singlechip, voice broadcast system, vibrating motor, OLED display screen module electricity are connected, and this chest card of taking the calling set can not only show medical personnel's personal information, can also play the effect of removing the calling set.

title_en: Mining safety inspection terminal
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mining safety inspection terminal, main content is: the gas sensor is connected with the first signal conditioning module, the carbon monoxide sensor is connected with the second signal conditioning module, the wind speed sensor is connected with the third signal conditioning module, the first signal conditioning module, the second signal conditioning module and the third signal conditioning module are all connected with the A/D conversion module, the A/D conversion module and the temperature sensor are all connected with the main controller, the memory and the wireless communication module are all connected with the main controller, the LCD display module and the acousto-optic alarm module are all connected with the main controller, and the main controller adopts an STC89C52 single chip microcomputer chip. The utility model discloses can gather mine gas and carbon monoxide gas concentration in real time, still gather temperature and tunnel wind speed simultaneously, when gas and carbon monoxide gas concentration reach and preset the alarm value, automatic alarm and warning personnel in the pit withdraw safe and reliable at once.

title_en: Control device and power storage system
abstract_en: To provide, for example, a control device and a power storage system that can control the charge and discharge of the power storage device in an optimum mode even when a power failure occurs after a weather warning is canceled.SOLUTION: A control device includes an acquisition unit that acquires weather information, and a mode switching unit that switches the charge/discharge control mode of a power storage device. When weather information acquired by the acquisition unit is issuance of weather warning, the mode switching unit switches the charge/discharge control mode from the normal mode to the disaster mode. When the weather warning continues before a first switching time elapses since switching of the charge/discharge control mode to the disaster mode, the mode switching unit switches the charge/discharge control mode from the disaster mode to the normal mode after the first switching time elapses from a time when the weather warning is determined to continue.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Glue room and use fan power failure alarm device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of alarm equipment, in particular to a fan power failure alarm device for a rubber chamber, which comprises two sets of symmetrically arranged U-shaped mounting seats and is characterized in that the inner sides of the U-shaped mounting seats are provided with mounting blocks, one sides of the mounting blocks, which are far away from each other, are provided with threaded grooves and guide grooves, a guide rod fixedly connected with the inner sides of the U-shaped mounting seats is sleeved in the guide grooves in a sliding manner, and the guide rod is connected with a threaded rod rotatably connected with the inner sides of the U-shaped mounting seats in the threaded grooves in a threaded manner; one side that two sets of installation pieces are close to each other all is equipped with the arc recess, and its inboard center department at the arc recess all bonds and has pressure sensor, and is equipped with the cover between the installation piece and establishes the ring, and the outside symmetric welding that the ring was established to the cover has two sets of connecting rods. The utility model discloses make fan in case stall, then can communicate to alarm device department through the signal of telecommunication, play better warning effect to gluing indoor staff, withdraw for maintenance and personnel's safety and provide the signal.

title_en: Fire-fighting equipment placing cabinet and system
abstract_en: The application relates to a cabinet is placed to fire-fighting equipment, include: the intelligent cabinet comprises a cabinet body, and a communication module, a timing module and a PLC module which are arranged in the cabinet body; the timing module is used for recording the valid period information of the fire-fighting equipment; the communication module and the timing module are respectively connected with the PLC module; the PLC module is used for sending the timing data in the timing module to an external server through the communication module. So, through the date of production of typeeing fire-fighting equipment, PLC module control timing module takes notes the validity of fire-fighting equipment, and send the warning before exceeding the validity, supply relevant personnel to change fire-fighting equipment, and in sending the server with validity information through communication module, supply relevant supervise personnel to carry out remote supervision to the fire-fighting equipment who controls management enterprise or place, solved prior art, only through manual record fire-fighting equipment validity period, the reliability is poor, fire control supervision managers can't carry out the shortcoming of management and control.
assignees: NINGBO YINGDAKESI ELECTROMAGNETIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Real-time location and alert system
abstract_en: A device, method, and system for providing initial and on-going tracking and location information in real-time for individuals and items within a predetermined area. A plurality of tracking devices are connected to at least one remote server. The remote server provides geofencing and location of all tracking devices within a pre-configured physical area. The tracking devices provide real-time location updates to the at least one remote server including proximity information to established physical locations within the physical area. The tracking devices are also operable to provide transactional and personal information to the at least one remote server.

title_en: Routing method of post-earthquake emergency communication network based on four-quadrant mobile model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a routing method of an emergency communication network after earthquake based on a four-quadrant mobile model, which comprises the following steps: step S1, the current node judges whether the current node contains a route line to the emergency communication vehicle node, if one or more routes to the emergency communication vehicle do not exist, the current node broadcasts an RREQ message to the neighbor nodes; step S2, after receiving the RREQ message, the neighbor node acquires the node information of the broadcast message, judges whether the node sending the RREQ message is a valid node, if the node is an invalid node, discards the received RREQ message, otherwise, updates the routing table of the neighbor node; and S3, the neighbor node judges whether a route line to the emergency communication vehicle node is included, if one or more routes to the emergency communication vehicle do not exist, the received RREQ message is forwarded, and the step S2 is returned until one or more effective routes to the emergency communication vehicle are finally found.

title_en: Risk assessment and monitoring early warning system for shallow landslide of line engineering corridor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for establishing a system for assessing, monitoring and early warning the risk of shallow landslide of a line engineering corridor. Firstly, determining a line engineering corridor evaluation area, comprehensively analyzing and determining landslide and disaster pregnancy key influence factors of a corridor area by combining basic and comprehensive data such as terrain and landform, remote sensing information, seismic geology, soil, vegetation, hydrology, climate, regional investigation and the like, and constructing a corridor slope stability evaluation model; and then, carrying out initial landslide risk assessment on the line corridor area. And secondly, aiming at the precipitation of main characteristic factors inducing the shallow landslide hazard, performing sectional evaluation on the risk of the shallow landslide of the line corridor under different precipitation conditions, and determining key monitoring and early warning line sections in the landslide hazard area. And finally, establishing a WebGIS system for evaluating and early warning the geological disaster risk of the line engineering corridor shallow landslide, and realizing data query, update and information publishing, intercommunication and sharing of the multi-platform terminal.

title_en: Audible and visual alarm system for power plant

The acousto-optic alarm system for the power plant, provided by the invention, distinguishes alarm types by setting the display of different page surfaces and distinguishes the importance degree of alarm by different colors, the alarm system achieves the effects of practically helping and reminding operators through a reasonable man-machine interaction interface of the alarm system, and invalid alarm rejection is realized by optimizing alarm classification, alarm sound and alarm light-character cards, so that the alarm system is slimmed, and thus more accurate, clear and efficient alarm can be realized.

title_en: Movie room environmental monitoring and early warning device

title_en: An experimental method for measurement of seasonal human heat adaptation and assessment method of the acclimation model using the same
title_ko: 계절 별 인체 열 적응 측정을 위한 실험 방법 및 이를 이용한 한국형 기후적응모델의 평가 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an experimental method for measuring seasonal human heat adaptation and a Korean climatization model evaluation method using the same. According to the present invention, the Korean climatization model is a modified German climatization model in consideration of the climate environment of Korea and warm and cool sensations for Koreans. The method comprises: a step a of setting health warning standards due to heat waves based on the Korean climatization model; a step b of setting experimental conditions of a seasonal human body heat adaptation experiment; a step c of when the experiment is performed according to the experimental conditions, receiving a result of warm/cool vote by examining the warm/cool vote from subjects of the experiment; a step d of predicting a result of the warming/cooling vote on the basis of the experimental conditions and health warning criteria; and a step e of evaluating the Korea climatization model by comparing the result of the warming/cooling vote with predicted values.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 계절 별 인체 열 적응 측정을 위한 실험 방법 및 이를 이용한 한국형 기후적응모델의 평가 방법에 관한 것으로, 계절 별 열 적응 측정을 위한 실험을 기반으로 한국형 기후적응모델을 평가하는 방법에 있어서, 상기 한국형 기후적응모델은 독일형 기후적응모델을 한국의 기후환경 및 한국인의 온냉감 특성을 고려하여 변경한 것이며, 상기 한국형 기후적응모델을 기반으로 폭염으로 인한 건강 경고 기준을 설정하는 a 단계, 계절 별 인체 열 적응 실험의 실험 조건을 설정하는 b 단계, 상기 실험 조건에 따라 실험을 수행하면, 상기 실험의 피험자로부터 온냉감투표를 조사하여 온냉감투표 결과 값을 수신하는 c 단계, 상기 실험 조건 및 건강 경고 기준을 기반으로 온냉감투표 결과를 예측하는 d 단계 및 상기 온냉감투표의 결과 값 및 예측 값을 비교하여 상기 한국형 기후적응모델을 평가하는 e 단계를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Infrared thermal imaging double-light monitoring-gas detection multifunctional early warning device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an infrared thermal imaging double-light monitoring-gas detection multifunctional early warning device, wherein an opening at one end of an explosion-proof shell of a double-light monitoring mechanism is provided with a visible light module and an infrared thermal imaging module, a circuit board is provided with an image processor and an SD card slot, and the circuit board is connected with a GPS positioning module and an audible alarm module; the gas detection mechanism comprises an explosion-proof power box and a wireless communication module, a data display module is connected above the explosion-proof power box, the data display module is connected with a gas detection sensor and a gas pump, an acousto-optic alarm module is arranged at the upper end of the gas pump, and the acousto-optic alarm module is connected with the gas detection sensor; the air pump is connected with the gas detection sensor through an air duct. The utility model discloses be equipped with infrared thermal imaging module, visible light module, gaseous detection mechanism simultaneously, monitor dangerous factors such as the dangerous heat source of overtemperature, dangerous operation state, poisonous and harmful gas simultaneously, in time report to the police, improved control validity, guarantee the safe operation of site area.

title_en: Systems and methods for contact avoidance for preventing epidemics
abstract_en: Embodiments described herein are directed to a contact avoidance system for preventing epidemics. A database maintains a record for each person enrolled in the system. The record comprises a risk level identifier that indicates a disease infection risk for the user. When devices carried by users are proximate to each other, the devices exchange identifiers that uniquely and anonymously identify the users. At least one device provides the identifier received thereby to the database, which retrieves the record associated with the identifier and determines a risk level for the user associated with the identifier. The risk level is returned to the device, which issues an alert if the risk level indicates that the other user is or may be infected with a disease. The database also updates the risk level associated with users that were determined to be proximate to a user determined to be infected with the disease.

title_en: System automatically updating database information based on a user's specified geographical location
abstract_en: A critical alert notification system includes a mobile device and software and is used to trigger a preselected communication scenario in the event an emergency scenario has been selected. The software includes a database and automatically updates information in the database when a user of the critical alert notification system crosses a preset geographic boundary or perimeter. Panic buttons or icons are swiped, tapped, clicked or pressed to alert people and organizations of an emergency situation with a preselected communication scenario. The critical alert notification system tracks the user's geographic location in real time and triggers two events when the user crosses a preset geographic boundary. The first event is the mobile user interface automatically adjusts to reflect key details based on their current location and the second event turns on the ability to display their location to other users of the system when a user enters a geographic boundary.

title_en: Method for monitoring communication link optimization of early warning and emergency command scheduling system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention relates to the technical field of communication, and particularly discloses a method, a device and a system for monitoring communication link optimization of an early warning and emergency command scheduling system. According to the method for monitoring the communication link optimization of the early warning and emergency commanding and dispatching system, the communication link library is established by initializing each communication link, the state of each communication link is monitored, the scoring coefficient of each communication link is updated, the reliability value of each communication link is calculated, the communication link is selected according to the reliability value or the communication surrogate value of each communication link, data transmission is completed through the selected communication link, after a disaster occurs, the emergency rescue and dispatching commanding communication system can automatically calculate the communication link with the highest reliability or the communication link with the high reliability and the low transmission cost according to the communication links supported by the system for communication, manual intervention is not needed, and the communication link is guaranteed to be normal under the extreme condition.
assignees: SICHUAN AEROSPACE SUNKUN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Driver assistance system and control method for the same
title_ko: 운전자 보조 시스템 및 그 제어 방법
abstract_en: A vehicle in accordance with one embodiment of the present invention comprises: a camera arranged in the vehicle so as to have an external field of view of the vehicle and capturing image data; a radar arranged in the vehicle so as to have an external sensing field of view with respect to the vehicle and acquiring radar data; and a control unit including at least one processor which processes the image data captured by the camera and the radar data acquired by the radar, wherein the control unit, in the case of sensing a lane change attempt of the vehicle, senses the other vehicle on a change target lane side based on the radar data, determines whether the vehicle may collide with the other vehicle based on driving information received from the other vehicle through a communication module of the vehicle, and in the case that a collision with the other vehicle is predicted, transmits a warning signal for controlling the warning system of the vehicle to the vehicle. The present invention can prevent vehicles from colliding.

title_en: Early warning device and method for unsafe behaviors of foundation pit construction site
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unsafe behavior early warning device and method for a foundation pit construction site, and the device comprises a main body rod, wherein the lower end face of the main body rod is fixedly connected with a first round seat, a second round seat is also arranged below the first round seat, the central position of the lower end face of the first round seat is fixedly connected with a ball sleeve, the upper end face of the second round seat is fixedly connected with a universal ball, the universal ball is arranged in the ball sleeve, springs are arranged between the side positions of the first round seat and the second round seat, and a fixing assembly is arranged on the second round seat and used for installing and fixing the second round seat; according to the invention, the safety of the foundation pit can be detected in real time through the arranged copper ball and the conductive cylinder, when the soil layer around the foundation pit collapses, the main body rod can be deflected to realize an early warning function, and an alarm can be given out at the first time when the soil layer around the foundation pit collapses to remind foundation pit constructors to withdraw or reinforce the foundation pit in time, so that the safety of foundation pit construction is greatly improved.

title_en: Cluster working method and device based on open virtual network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cluster working method and a device based on an open virtual network, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining a second gateway node from all active gateway nodes to provide backup service for the failed first gateway node; creating a backup gateway port on a second gateway node based on the medium access control address and the network address of the first gateway node, and broadcasting a reverse address resolution protocol to the cluster to update the medium access control table and the address resolution protocol table of the reachable link of the cluster for the first time; providing L3 forwarding services through a backup gateway port in place of a first gateway node using a pre-synchronized network address translation table; link routes directed to the first gateway node are deleted from the virtual router of the physical host node and upstream traffic is migrated to other active gateway nodes. The invention can provide high-performance disaster-tolerant backup function and multiply expandable forwarding performance, and solves the bottleneck of the forwarding performance in the north-south direction.

title_en: Location information updating method of wireless emergency alarm, mobile terminal and network equipment
abstract_en: Provided are a location information updating method of a wireless emergency alert, a mobile terminal, a network device, and a computer-readable medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a first geographical position where a mobile terminal is currently located; sending a request message to a network side through an IMS network via a Wi-Fi hotspot, wherein the request message is used for initiating a subscription service of a wireless emergency alarm and carries a first geographical position; receiving a response message sent by a network side; checking whether the response message carries a location updating parameter of the wireless emergency alarm, if so, storing the location updating parameter and acquiring a second geographic location where the mobile terminal is currently located according to the location updating parameter; and sending an update message to the network side, the update message including the second geographic location. The method realizes that the geographical position information is simply, timely and accurately updated to the network by carrying the geographical position information in the request message and the updating message for initiating the wireless emergency alarm subscription service.

title_en: Mine disaster early warning method and device, storage medium and electronic device
abstract_en: The application discloses a mine disaster early warning method and device, a storage medium and an electronic device. The method comprises the steps of obtaining initial data in the GIS system; inputting updated data of the GIS system in the mine operation process into a preset digital twin mine system, wherein the preset digital twin mine system is obtained by modeling digitally based on initial data of the GIS system, and the modeling is used for simulating mine disasters based on the preset digital twin mine system; and carrying out early warning on the mine disasters which possibly occur through the simulation result of the preset digital twin mine system. The method solves the technical problem that real-time monitoring and management and control cannot be carried out on the mine disaster early warning. The safety monitoring and early warning of mine disasters are realized through the method and the device.

title_en: Mounting apparatus for installation of evacuation guidance lights and audio-visual alarms
title_ko: 피난유도등 및 시청각 경보기 설치용 마운팅 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus for mounting evacuation guidance lights and audiovisual alarms, the apparatus comprising: a top bracket mounted on a ceiling; a bottom bracket disposed on the lower side of the top bracket; a skirt bracket disposed on one end or the other end of the lower surface of the bottom bracket; connecting means for coupling the top and bottom brackets to each other; and holding means for coupling the bottom and the skirt brackets to each other. Accordingly, since the upper surface of a main body of an evacuation guidance light is mounted on the opposite end part, where the skirt bracket is not disposed, on the lower surface of the bottom bracket and a main body of an audiovisual alarm is mounted on the front surface of the skirt bracket, the evacuation guidance light and the audiovisual alarm can be mounted and installed at the same time and the location of the evacuation guidance light and audiovisual alarm can be changed depending on an installation area. In addition, an installation configuration of the apparatus is formed in one set, thereby facilitating installation and purchase.

title_en: Multi-parameter Internet of things monitoring system and method for power transmission line
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-parameter Internet of things monitoring system and a multi-parameter Internet of things monitoring method for a power transmission line, wherein the system comprises a three-dimensional model building module, an error factor generating module and an early warning and routing inspection module; the three-dimensional model building module is used for obtaining parameters to build a three-dimensional model and judging whether the distance between the tower and the reference platform generates deviation or not so as to enable the tower to be in a settlement state; the error factor generation module is used for acquiring local terrain and weather factors, establishing a distance vector according to the distance between the tower and the reference station, and analyzing whether the local terrain and the weather factors are the reasons for causing the offset distance, so that the distance vector is updated; the early warning routing inspection module is used for acquiring a distance vector influenced by weather in the historical record, comparing the distance vector stored in the historical record with the updated distance vector, and analyzing whether the tower can generate large-amplitude settlement and early warning; therefore, the problem that the tower cannot be overhauled due to sudden large-amplitude settlement of the tower is solved.

title_en: Landslide geological disaster automatic monitoring and early warning device
