title_en: Device and method for detecting defects of circuit breaker with vacuum or gas interrupter using electromagnetic waves in real time
title_ko: 차단기 밸브의 결함 검출을 위한 실시간 전자기파 측정장치 및 이를 이용한 진단방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a real-time electromagnetic wave measuring device for detecting a fault of a circuit breaker valve, and a diagnosis method using the same, which secure facility reliability. The real-time electromagnetic wave measuring device of the present invention comprises: an electromagnetic wave measuring sensor (100); a display unit (101) for displaying an electromagnetic wave measurement value and a set value; an operation unit (102) for various settings; and an input/output unit (104) connected to a computer to analyze a spectrum of electromagnetic waves.
abstract_ko:
발전소 및 화학플랜트 등 산업설비에는 수많은 차단기가 사용되고 있다. 차단기의 주 접촉자(Main Contactor)가 위치한 밸브(Interrupter)(1)는 절연매체(13)로서 진공 또는 육불화유황가스(SF6)가 사용된다. 밸브(1)의 진공도가 저하되거나 가스 압력이 저하된 상태에서 차단기가 개폐 동작하는 경우 과도전압(Transient Voltage)으로 인해 절연(Insulation)이 파괴되고 고장전류(Fault Current)로 인해 화재로 이어지는 중대한 고장이 발생할 수 있다. 따라서 차단기의 신속하고 정확한 동작은 매우 중요한다. 

차단기의 주 접촉자(Main Contactor)는 고정접촉자(11)와 가동접촉자(12)로 밀폐된 구조의 밸브(1)에 내장된 구조이다. 차단기 밸브(1)에 대한 건전성 시험을 수행하기 위해서는 차단기(5)를 수배전반(4) 설비에서 인출해야만 하고, 밸브(1) 외부에서 가동접촉자(12)의 간극을 측정하거나 밸브(1)에 고전압을 인가하여 절연상태를 점검하는 방식으로 수행된다. 따라서 차단기가 운전되고 있는 활선 상태에서는 차단기 밸브(1)에 대해 건전성은 확인 할 수 없는 문제가 있다. 

본 발명은 차단기 밸브(1)가 개폐 동작할 때 발생하는 전자기파를 실시간으로 측정하여 차단기 밸브(1)의 건전성을 확인할 수 있으므로 기존에 수행하고 있는 차단기 밸브(1)에 대한 시험 방법을 보완할 수 있다. 측정장치(2)는 전자기파 센서(100)와 연결되고, 측정치를 정량화하여 나타내는 표시부(101), 경보의 취명, 설정치 변경을 위한 조작부(102), 경보의 취명, 제어신호 출력 및 원격종합제어장치(3)와 통신으로 연결하기 위한 입·출력부(103)로 구성된다. 여기서 표시부(1)와 조작부(1)는 사용자 인터페이스로서 터치스크린을 사용하는 경우 일체형으로 구성된다.  

정상 운전상태에서 발생하는 전자기파를 기준값으로 설정하고 주기적으로 측정된 자료와 비교하여 상태를 판정할 수 있다. 또한 유사한 부하 종류별로 분류하여 상호 대비하여 판정치를 수립함으로서 비정상적으로 높게 검출되는 전자기파에 대해 비교 평가할 수 있다. 이러한 새로운 진단기법을 통해 차단기가 운전되고 있는 활선 상태에서 실시간으로 전자기파를 측정함으로서 차단기 밸브(1)의 결함을 조기에 검출하여 선제적으로 예측정비를 통해 설비신뢰도를 확보하는 이점이 있다.

title_en: Fire protection device capable of early warning high temperature and early warning system thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire protection device for high-temperature early warning, which comprises a fire protection monitoring box, an intelligent data processing device and an external manual repositor, wherein the intelligent data processing device comprises a PCB integrated board, an alarm timing pusher, an integrated processing chip, an alternating current/direct current converter, a charging device, a data transmitter, a remote networking monitoring element and a fire alarm processor are arranged on the PCB integrated board, the alarm timing pusher is electrically connected with the external manual repositor, when the fire protection device is used in combination with a corresponding early warning system, a local server in a monitoring system platform is synchronously butted with a cloud server and is remotely connected with a network generated by the intelligent data processing device, the early warning effect of fire is improved, meanwhile, under the help of the set timing function, under the condition that the safety can be rapidly processed and confirmed in the early stage of fire outbreak, alarm information can be timely withdrawn, and the alarm ring can be better avoided, thereby avoiding the occurrence of trample events caused by panic of the public and reducing the alarm cost of fire departments.

title_en: Data disaster recovery processing method, server, live broadcast system and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a processing method, a server, a live broadcast system and a storage medium for data disaster recovery, which relate to the technical field of live broadcast, and the processing method for the data disaster recovery comprises the following steps: the server acquires a request instruction sent by the client; the server determines data to be returned based on the request instruction; the server determines the data quantity of important data in the data to be returned; if the data quantity is not greater than the first preset value, the server acquires backup data corresponding to the request instruction from the backup end and sends the backup data to the client; if the data quantity is larger than the second preset value, the server sends the data to be returned to the client and sends the important data to the backup end so as to update the backup data; wherein the first preset value is smaller than the second preset value. Based on the mode, the user experience is improved.

title_en: Lithium battery energy storage management system and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lithium battery energy storage management system and a lithium battery energy storage management method, which relate to the technical field of lithium battery management and comprise a cloud service platform, an EMS energy management module, a BMS battery management module, a current transformer, a fire control management module, a temperature control module, a warning module and an intelligent terminal. The invention carries out charging energy storage at the time of low peak of electricity utilization, discharges at the time of high peak of electricity utilization, can carry out emergency power supply and fire control filling, reserves fire control electricity utilization lithium batteries every day, changes every day, and reserves two groups of fire control lithium batteries every day; the position of the lithium battery for fire fighting is ensured to be randomly updated every day, the lithium battery for fire fighting also participates in normal charging and discharging work, the running state of the lithium battery for fire fighting can be ensured to be mastered in time, and the lithium battery for fire fighting is prevented from being in a full-charge state or a non-power state for a long time; the reserve lithium cell of fire control designs spatial distance, guarantees no matter which direction receives the damage from the lithium cell, guarantees at least that a set of reserve lithium cell of fire control can supply to use.

title_en: Electric gate for operation railway line
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an electronic gate for operating on railway line, including installing at the gate basis of rail both sides, the gatepost of installing on the basis, from the gate track that crosses under the rail and along orbital motion's electronic gate, set up gate transformer case and electronic gate control cabinet respectively on the gate basis of one side, set up the railway traffic number circuit in the gate basis, the traffic number circuit links to each other with railway dispatch system, railway dispatch system with the switch board link to each other. title_en: Method, system and program product for monitoring EAS devices
abstract_en: A method of monitoring Emergency Alert System (EAS) devices includes providing a system, the system including processor(s) in communication with memory(ies) storing instructions for execution by the processor(s), the instructions enabling monitoring of EAS devices, monitoring by the system the EAS devices for all changes to configuration settings and updates to software and firmware for the EAS devices (“changes”), the system further including database(s) automatically storing data regarding the changes, wherein data regarding changes to configuration settings comprises a copy of the configuration settings, wherein the copy is stored chronologically, and the monitoring includes avoiding use of a threshold. The system creates secondary instance(s) of the database(s), monitors for failures of the database(s) and automatically fail(s) over to the secondary instance(s) when fail(s) occur, notifying by the system designated receiver(s) of the changes, and assisting with filtering and/or sorting of selected data from the database.

title_en: System and Method for Measuring and Monitoring Seismic data Applied to the City Building
title_ko: 건축물에 적용되는 지진데이터 측정 및 감시 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and a method for measuring and monitoring seismic data applied to a building, which can rapidly inspect rapidity of seismic event detection and effectiveness of an occurrence event and prevent wrong detection and wrong warning in order to construct a rapid seismic warning system for alleviation of a seismic disaster of the building, wherein the system for measuring and monitoring the seismic data comprises: multiple seismic data measurement systems positioned at different distances from a monitoring object, each including a GPS receiving module and a seismic accelerometer, and performing previous detection for a seismic event; and a seismic monitoring system processing visual synchronization for data transmitted by the multiple seismic data measurement systems to remove noises and reconfigure the data into single merged data, performing post-process detection for checking whether the seismic event occurs and finally determining whether a seismic event occurs by using the previous detection result for the seismic event in each seismic data measurement system and the post-process detection result.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 건축물의 지진재해경감을 위한 지진신속경보체계 구축을 위하여 지진 이벤트 감지의 신속성 및 발생 이벤트의 유효성을 빠르게 검사하고 오검출 및 오경보를 방지할 수 있도록 한 건축물에 적용되는 지진데이터 측정 및 감시 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 감시 대상물과 서로 다른 거리에 위치하고, GPS 수신모듈과지진가속도센서를 포함하고 지진이벤트의 사전 검출을 수행하는 복수 개의 지진 데이터 측정시스템들 상기 복수개의 지진 데이터 측정시스템들로부터 전송된 데이터를 시각 동기화 처리하여 잡음제거 및 단일 중합데이터로 재구성하고, 지진이벤트 발생 여부를 확인하기 위해 후처리 검출을 하여 각각의 지진 데이터 측정시스템에서의 지진이벤트 사전검출 결과와 후처리 검출결과를 활용하여 지진이벤트 발생 여부를 최종 판별하는 지진 감시시스템 을 포함하는 것이다.

The longitude and latitude position of the user can be acquired in real time through the positioning chip, the weather rainfall data of the weather monitoring station can be acquired through the server according to the longitude and latitude position wireless transmission chip of the user, the weather rainfall data are displayed on the display screen in real time, the user can conveniently know the weather information, the weather information is updated more timely, the user is not required to screen in a large amount of weather information, and the information acquisition efficiency is improved.

title_en: Smart user situation monitoring system and method for landscaping based on artificial intelligence using drone
title_ko: 드론을 이용한 인공지능 기반의 조경작업용 스마트 사용자 상황 감시 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a smart user situation monitoring system and method for landscaping based on artificial intelligence using a drone. The system includes: an unmanned flight terminal implemented to monitor a situation in the vicinity of a user while autonomously flying a flight area that is dynamically set based on a location of the user according to an operation mode; and a user terminal interworking with the unmanned flight terminal to generate an update signal for the flight area based on the location of the user, and analyzing a risk level of the situation while receiving an image related to the situation and environmental data to provide a notification for the user. Therefore, the present invention relates to a technology for monitoring the risk. More specifically, the present invention can recognize and notify the user of risk factors that may occur in advance through autonomous flight during a landscaping operation of the user, such as mowing, tree pruning, tree trimming, tree limbing, and tree management, and can effectively cope with dangerous situation notification, accident situation propagation, emergency rescue response, and the like through interworking with the system.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 드론을 이용한 인공지능 기반의 조경작업용 스마트 사용자 상황 감시 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 상기 시스템은 동작 모드에 따라 사용자의 위치를 중심으로 동적 설정되는 비행 영역을 자율 비행하면서 사용자 인근의 상황을 감시하도록 구현되는 무인 비행 단말; 및 상기 무인 비행 단말과 연동하고 상기 사용자의 위치를 기초로 상기 비행 영역에 관한 갱신 신호를 생성하며 상기 상황에 관한 영상 및 환경 데이터를 수신하면서 상기 상황의 위험도를 분석하여 상기 사용자를 위한 알림을 제공하는 사용자 단말;을 포함한다. 따라서, 본 발명은 본 발명은 위험 모니터링 기술에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 사용자의 예초작업, 나무전지, 수목전정, 가지치기, 수목관리 등의 조경작업 중에 자율 비행을 통해 사용자에게 발생 가능한 위험 요소를 사전에 인지하여 알릴 수 있으며, 시스템 연동을 통해 위험상황 알림, 사고상황 전파, 긴급구조 대응 등에 효율적인 대처가 가능할 수 있다.

title_en: Dual system of public address based on cloud server
title_ko: 클라우드 서버 기반 전관방송 이원화 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a cloud server-based public address dualization system which is improved to include a disaster information reception function and an emergency broadcasting function, which are basic functions of a public address system, in a public address system installed in buildings, and dualize new demands, such as local disaster information collection through a national disaster network, and extended functions, such as announcements and reservation broadcasting, in a cloud server. According to the present invention, the cloud server-based public address dualization system comprises a public address system installed in a building to receive disaster information and perform emergency broadcasting; and a cloud server performing network communication with the public address system and collecting regional disaster information through a national disaster network. The cloud server performs announcement and reservation broadcasting through the public address system so that public address broadcasting is dualized, and an operating system is embedded in the public address system to enable network communication with the cloud server. The cloud server manages local disaster information receiving subscribers, and the public address system receiving disaster broadcasting from the cloud server determines whether to transmit emergency broadcasting on the basis of an installation location. In addition, the cloud server modifies the set reservation broadcasting to change reservation broadcast setting.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 전관방송 시스템의 기본 기능인 재난수신과 비상방송은 건물에 설치되는 전관방송 장비에 내장하고 국가재난망을 통한 지역적 재난정보 수집과 같은 새로운 요구와 안내방송과 예약방송 등 확장기능은 클라우드 서버로 이원화되도록 개선된 클라우드 서버 기반 전관방송 이원화 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명은 건물에 설치하여 재난 정보를 수신하고, 비상 방송을 실시하는 전관방송 시스템과; 상기 전관방송 시스템과 네트워크 통신을 하고, 국가재난망을 통하여 지역적 재난정보 수집을 하는 클라우드 서버;를 포함하되, 상기 클라우드 서버는 상기 전관방송 시스템을 통해 안내방송 및 예약방송을 실시하도록 하여 전관방송이 이원화되도록 하고, 상기 전관방송 시스템에는 상기 클라우드 서버와 네트워크 통신이 가능하도록 운영체제가 내장되고, 상기 클라우드 서버는 지역적 재난정보 수신 가입자를 관리하며, 상기 클라우드 서버로부터 재난방송을 수신한 상기 전관방송 시스템은 설치된 위치를 기반으로 비상방송 송출 여부를 결정하며, 또한, 상기 클라우드 서버는, 세팅된 상기 예약방송을 수정하여 상기 예약방송의 설정을 변경할 수 있는 클라우드 서버 기반 전관방송 이원화 시스템을 제공한다.

abstract_en: The utility model discloses a farmland calamity early warning device for agrometeorology, including the assembly jig, the top of assembly jig is fixed with temperature and humidity alarm, and temperature and humidity alarm's surface mounting has the controller, the sensor is installed to temperature and humidity alarm's lower extreme, and the lower extreme of sensor is connected with electric telescopic handle, electric telescopic handle's lower extreme outer wall installs protection frame mechanism, and electric telescopic handle's lower extreme inner wall installs built-in protecting box, the mounting hole frame has been seted up to the bottom of protection frame mechanism. title_en: Event-driven model refinement for insurance and risk management
abstract_en: A system and method for event-based modeling and model refinement, for natural catastrophe related risks, including but not limited to fires, floods, earthquakes, and hurricanes/tornados. The system and method feature simultaneous simulation of a plurality of industry models using a variety of risk information, including but not limited to real-time data, recent and historical event data, hypothetical data, and crowd-sourced data. Tire system and method use a variety of data sources in conjunction with machine learning to continuously and in real-time update and tune the simulated models performance and sensitivity to provide useful risk assessment, and risk management data. Based on these model assessments, the system can produce notifications that can be made to enable automated and human actions.

title_en: Warning isolation device capable of being opened for warning isolation area in building
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a warning isolation device for an openable warning isolation area in a building, wherein a plurality of accommodating cavities are distributed on the building along the periphery of the warning isolation area, a liftable warning isolation column is arranged in each accommodating cavity, the warning isolation column is hidden in the accommodating cavity when descending to the lowest position from the inside of the accommodating cavity, the warning isolation column is protruded from the periphery of the warning isolation area when ascending to the highest position from the inside of the accommodating cavity, and the raised warning isolation column forms a warning isolation perimeter at the periphery of the warning isolation area. Aiming at the particularity of the openable warning isolation region in the building, the warning isolation pillar for warning isolation is formed on the periphery of the warning isolation region of the building, can be descended and hidden and can be ascended and formed, and the warning isolation perimeter formed on the periphery of the warning isolation region can be conveniently and efficiently established/cancelled, and is standard and stable in warning and good in warning isolation protection technical effect.
assignees: GUONENG DADU RIVER JINCHUAN HYDROPOWER CONSTRUCTION CO LTD

title_en: Double-channel audible and visual alarm
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a double-channel audible and visual alarm which comprises a main control module, a power supply module, an optical alarm module, a buzzer alarm module, a horn alarm module and a communication module, wherein the power supply module, the optical alarm module, the buzzer alarm module, the horn alarm module and the communication module are connected with the main control module; the communication module is connected with the cloud server and receives the update sent by the cloud server, pre-stored voice data is covered, and the latest alarm voice information is broadcasted in real time through the horn alarm module; the buzzer alarm module is used for alarming by a buzzer; the light alarm module is used for giving out light alarm; through above-mentioned structure can make the alarm have buzzer warning and loudspeaker warning binary channels audible alarm to come to be connected with high in the clouds server and update latest warning pronunciation through communication module, with the cooperation of light warning, can improve the alarm effect of alarm, accord with the user demand.

title_en: Method and device for analyzing risk distribution of power distribution network tower under flood
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for analyzing the risk distribution of a power distribution network tower under flood, wherein the method comprises the steps of establishing a tower flood disaster evaluation index system; establishing a historical data evaluation rule base according to a pole tower flood disaster evaluation index system and historical characteristic disaster information; responding to the disaster data index information of a certain tower obtained in real time, and inputting the disaster data index information of the certain tower into a historical data evaluation rule base to enable a risk factor of the certain tower to be output; updating the risk factor of a certain tower according to the risk factor of at least one tower associated with the certain tower; and judging whether the updated risk factor of a certain tower is greater than a preset threshold value or not, so as to determine the risk level of the certain tower. Risk grids are screened out by calculating risk factors according to a historical flood disaster information base, disaster risk information around the line tower can be mastered accurately, and a basis is provided for analyzing and early warning of flood disaster risks of the power distribution network line tower.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENT RES INST STATE GRID JIANGXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;UNIV NANCHANG HANGKONG

title_en: Method and apparatus for handling mission critical services in a wireless communication network
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a communication method and system for fusing a fifth generation (5G) communication system supporting higher data rates than a fourth generation (4G) system with internet of things (IoT) technology. The present disclosure may be applied to intelligent services based on 5G communication technology and internet of things related technology, such as intelligent home, intelligent building, intelligent city, intelligent car, networking car, healthcare, digital education, intelligent retail, security and security services. A method performed by a mission critical push-to-talk (MCPTT) server for processing a Mission Critical Service (MCS) in a wireless communication network is provided. The method includes receiving a ticket queuing cancellation request message from a first MCPTT client to cancel at least one ticket request, wherein the at least one ticket request is associated with at least one second MCPTT client; determining whether at least one queued talk burst request associated with at least one second MCPTT client is to be cancelled based on the received talk burst cancellation request message; performing one of the following operations: the method comprises the steps of sending a first notification that at least one queuing talk burst request is cancelled to at least one second MCPTT client, or sending the first notification and a second notification that at least one queuing talk burst request is not cancelled to at least one second MCPTT client.

title_en: Intelligent warning device and system for construction site management based on AI video technology
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent warning device and system for construction site management based on an AI video technology, and relates to the field of construction security. This intelligent warning device is used in job site management based on AI video technique, which comprises a housin, casing diapire center fixed connection slide bar, the solid fixed ring of upper portion fixed connection in the slide bar, gu the fixed ring lateral part rotates the cradling piece of connecting three group's annular align to grid, the equal a set of seat that rotates of lower part in the cradling piece inside wall, the cradling piece rotates through a set of seat that rotates respectively and connects a set of two-way dwang. assignees: SHANGHAI MOERDUO NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: Stand-up vehicle
abstract_en: In a stand-up vehicle having a vehicle upper part having a riding surface configured for a user to stand on, one or more electronic control units execute emergency situation detection processing for detecting an emergency of the user when receiving notification from the user or based on information from one or more sensors, safety posture determination processing for determining whether or not the user takes a safety posture based on information from one or more sensors after detecting the emergency, and upper limit speed management processing executed when detecting the emergency and determining that the user takes the safety posture. The upper limit speed management process increases the upper limit speed to be higher than the basic upper limit speed selected when the safety posture determination process determines that the user is not in the safety posture, or cancels the upper limit speed.

title_en: Alarm method, monitoring device, monitoring system and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides an alarm method, a monitoring device, a monitoring system and a readable storage medium, which are based on the acquisition of an initial trend data template; acquiring to-be-analyzed monitoring parameter data for alarm analysis monitored in a to-be-analyzed time window; processing the monitoring parameter data to be analyzed to construct trend data to be analyzed; matching the trend data to be analyzed with the initial trend data template to obtain a matching result; comparing the matching result with a preset condition to obtain a comparison result; presenting the matching result and/or the comparison result; or, the matching result satisfies when predetermineeing the condition, control guardianship equipment produces the warning, not only can prevent the emergence of wrong report police, and has improved the security and the validity of guardianship to reduce medical personnel's working strength and the degree of difficulty, can also effectively and select patient's key alarm information fast in addition, thereby reduced the risk of state of an illness delay.

title_en: Disaster early warning system and method based on gateway equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster early warning system based on gateway equipment, which comprises a disaster early warning issuing system front end: the system comprises a sub-control center of a disaster early warning release system or a private early warning system which can be accessed by a network in a certain area; information table update server: the disaster early warning issuing system is used for issuing the front-end information table of the disaster early warning issuing system after digital signature and providing information table updating service for gateway equipment; the Web server: a server providing a web service through HTTP/HTTPs; gateway device: the network access equipment is used for enabling a user to access the Internet through the gateway equipment in daily life; and (5) surfing equipment: any device capable of accessing the Internet can be used by a user for web browsing and video playing operations; the invention also discloses a disaster early warning method based on the gateway equipment, which has great significance for disaster early warning and has extremely high advancement and application popularization value.

title_en: Underground air stop alarm device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an underground wind-stopping alarm device, which relates to the technical field of security engineering design and comprises an installation and stabilization chassis, wherein a fastening limiting backing ring is fixedly installed at the top end of one side of the installation and stabilization chassis, a movable column is detachably installed in the fastening limiting backing ring, and a soil drilling fixing cone is fixedly welded at the bottom end of the movable column. Through the wind-force monitoring install bin, the sensor install bin, buzzer siren, the phonate hole, the spliced pole, the warning light, the connecting rod, rotary disk and wind-force leaf cooperate, the sensor install bin has been installed simultaneously in four directions of wind-force monitoring install bin, thereby can detect the wind-force of every direction, the wind-force leaf stall of equidirectional, at this moment, the buzzer siren of this direction will automatic alarm, the warning light can become the red light simultaneously, more conspicuous, sufficient alarming has been played, let timely the withdraw of staff, avoid appearing the problem of accident in the pit.

title_en: Notification upgrade based on visual identification
abstract_en: A method may include obtaining notification data for a user, and obtaining a first set of images of the user from one or more cameras. The method may include identifying a first state of a user and generating a set of notification options based on the first state. The method may include selecting a first notification option, and initiating a first notification through the first notification option. The method may include determining that the first notification is not acknowledged by the user, and obtaining a second set of images from the one or more cameras. The method may include identifying a second state of the user and selecting a second notification option of the set of notification options. The method may include initiating a second notification through a second notification option.

title_en: Parking area intelligence banister
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of intelligent parking lot management equipment, and discloses an intelligent barrier gate of a parking lot, which automatically captures a picture of a vehicle through a camera, identifies a license plate number, verifies the identity information of the vehicle, drives a driving shaft to rotate through a motor, so as to automatically lift a brake lever, the vehicle can enter the parking lot without obstacles, simultaneously uploads the information of the license plate number, the color, the license plate, the time of entering the parking lot and the like to a background management system, automatically times and charges, improves the efficiency and simultaneously reduces the management cost of the parking lot, enables the camera to capture a clear license plate picture at night through a built-in LED light supplement lamp and an infrared LED lamp, can display the license plate, the rest parking places, the charge amount, the validity period and the like through an LED display screen, can send a traffic signal through an indicator lamp plate, and can send voice broadcast through a loudspeaker to prompt a driver, thereby realizing the unattended intelligent traffic of the parking lot, effectively improve the speed of passing, the practicality is strong.

title_en: Movable safety fence
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power equipment, in particular to a movable safety fence which comprises a fence main body, a driving assembly and a movable base, wherein the fence main body comprises a soft fence and a control cabinet, the soft fence is arranged in the control cabinet, a retractable opening for extending the soft fence is formed in the control cabinet, the driving assembly comprises a rotating rod and a motor, the rotating rod is in transmission connection with an output shaft of the motor, the movable base comprises a bottom plate and a driving wheel, the driving wheel is arranged below the bottom plate, the control cabinet is fixedly arranged on the bottom plate, the soft fence is wound on the rotating rod, and the rotating rod is vertically arranged in the control cabinet. This security fence has functions such as automatic receive and release net, warning suggestion, removal use, alone alright accomplish laying of security fence and withdraw work, can improve artifical transport, lay, withdraw security fence's efficiency, alarming function then can send the early warning to the personnel of mistake income charged area, and the suggestion personnel keep away from to guarantee safety.

title_en: Hammer-withdrawing warning device for pile sinking by hammering method
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a hammer-sinking pile hammer-receiving warning device in the technical field of pile foundation construction. A data processor: receiving the hammering number recorded by a hammering counter and pile body displacement data measured by a displacement measuring device, and when the data processor receives the total hammering number, the penetration data and the pile design elevation which reach the preset standard, an alarm receives the hammer and gives an alarm; a hammer counter for recording the number of hammers; the displacement measuring device is used for measuring the displacement of the pile body and providing original data for the data processor to calculate the penetration and the pile design elevation; and the alarm is used for giving an alarm for prompting after reaching the preset hammering total number or penetration standard, and the hammer is collected after the constructor sees that the prompting lamp is turned on. Compare present manual number per meter heavy pile hammer number and manual work and carry out the penetration and rule out the measuring mode, receive the hammer, the device can objective, accurate, safe record data, reduces the cost of labor.

title_en: Vehicle with automatic notification function
abstract_en: To provide a method of immediately transmitting emergency notification to a server device using alternative means other than normal communication means of a vehicle itself in the vehicle in which an emergency situation has occurred.SOLUTION: In an automatic emergency notification system, a vehicle with automatic notification function collects emergency information ST3 when an emergency situation occurs ST1Y; determines whether or not it is possible to transmit the collected emergency information through a base station using normal communication means ST4 when transmitting the collected rich emergency information to a server device of the automatic emergency notification system; and transmits the rich emergency information to the server device by the normal means ST5 when it is possible ST4Y. abstract_en: Techniques for management of links related to public safety incidents within a window displayed in a graphical user interface are provided. Creation of a plurality of links associated with public safety incidents is monitored. When each of the links is shared is monitored. With whom each of the links is shared is monitored. The graphical user interface displays a list of the created links, the links created by an agency. User input selecting a created link from the list of created links is received. title_en: Full-automatic intelligent inspection well cover
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a full-automatic intelligent inspection well cover which comprises a well cover body, wherein the well cover body is provided with a hinge hole, the full-automatic intelligent inspection well cover further comprises an installation box body, the installation box body is detachably arranged on a fixed seat, the fixed seat is used for fixing the installation box body on a well wall, a movable ejector rod device and an intelligent control system are further arranged in the installation box body, the output end of the movable ejector rod device penetrates through the upper side of the installation box body to be abutted against the bottom of the well cover body, and an acousto-optic alarm device is further arranged at the output end of the movable ejector rod device. title_en: Landslide disaster point big data acquisition and sample library updating method based on event triggering
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide disaster point big data acquisition and sample library updating method based on event triggering. And after big data fusion is carried out on the heterogeneous data, the heterogeneous data is stored in a landslide geological disaster sample library, so that the data of the sample library is updated, and the aim of improving the landslide geological disaster monitoring and early warning data quality is fulfilled. According to the method, the timeliness of large-data acquisition of landslide disaster points is improved, the problem that the existing geological disaster reporting site is not accurate enough is solved, the accuracy of obtaining the topographic data of the disaster point area is improved, and large-area and low-cost calculation processing of the surface deformation data of the disaster point area is realized.

title_en: On-line monitoring, flood and injury prevention warning and blocking device for accumulated water in culverts of railway network and highway network
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of intelligent culvert monitoring, and discloses an online monitoring and anti-flooding warning and blocking device for accumulated water in culverts of a railway network and a highway network. The method is applied to detecting and reminding the water level in the culvert, monitoring the culvert in real time, and transmitting data to the terminal through the Internet of things. According to the utility model, the approaching vehicle is detected by infrared rays and is broadcasted by voice, the water depth data of the culvert is updated in real time, and the intelligent protection and the real-time broadcast are realized; the system is simple to operate, efficient and intelligent in prevention and control.
assignees: SHAANXI TIANLIE GENERAL SOURCE INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-point monitoring visual phased array type fire alarm system
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of fire alarm, and provides a multipoint monitoring visual phased array type fire alarm system, when at least one smoke concentration data exceeds a preset concentration, first alarm information is generated based on the current smoke concentration data, and a heat source in the current environment is detected in real time; when the temperature of the heat source is higher than the preset temperature, second alarm information is generated based on the current temperature of the heat source, and the intelligent alarm is used for determining an alarm instruction according to the alarm information and executing the alarm instruction when the first alarm information and/or the second alarm information are/is received. According to the fire alarm system provided by the embodiment of the invention, the smoke concentration and the heat source are detected, the on-site warning and the remote alarm can be timely carried out, the warning in on-site personnel and the notification of the off-site workers can be timely processed on site, the alarm strategy can be timely updated according to the situation of the fire scene, and the situation of false alarm after the dangerous case is processed is avoided.
assignees: GUANGDONG NEW SCIENCE AND TECH INDUSTRY LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Audio matrix employing emergency broadcasting
title_ko: 비상방송 기능을 가진 오디오 매트릭스
abstract_en: The present invention is to provide an audio matrix with an emergency broadcasting function which is connected to a fire receiver, a voice recognition board for recognizing fire voice, an earthquake sensor, etc., so that in the event of an emergency such as fire or earthquake, all broadcasts such as performances/events are terminated, and fire and disaster broadcasts can be given top priority. The audio matrix with an emergency broadcasting function includes: an input port unit which has n input ports for receiving n broadcasting signals, respectively; a switch unit which distributes broadcasting signals selected for each region/group/channel among the n broadcasting signals received through the input port unit to corresponding output ports among m output ports; an output port unit which has m output ports for respectively outputting the broadcasting signals distributed by the switch unit; and an extension port unit which outputs the broadcasting signals to other audio matrix devices.
abstract_ko:
실시예는 비상방송기능을 가진 오디오 매트릭스에 관한 것이다. 
구체적으로, 이러한 오디오 매트릭스는 먼저 화재수신기와 화재음성을 인식하기 위한 음성인식 보드, 지진센서 등과 연결되어서 화재, 지진 등의 비상상황 발생시, 공연/행사 등의 모든 방송을 종료하고, 화재, 재난 방송을 최우선으로 내보내는 방식을 전제로 한다. 
그리고, 또한 이러한 기능은 오디오 매트릭스을 적절히 설계하여 주 제어부에서 오디오 매트릭스를 제어함으로서, 달성하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
따라서, 이를 통해 기본적으로는 여러 가지의 다양한 정보를 방송할 경우에, 각각의 그룹별로 또는 개별적으로 같은 시간에 네트워크 방송을 수행하므로, 다채널 다중 교차방송을 한다. 
그리고, 이러한 경우에 이렇게 네트워크 방송을 하는 상황하에서 주변의 화재수신기와 화재감지센서 등에서 재해와 재난 등을 감지할 경우, 해당하는 영역/그룹/ 채널에서 선택적으로 절체 방송을 수행해서, 긴급 상황에서 즉각 방송을 제공한다. 
& 구성적 특징 
n개의 방송 신호를 각각 입력받는 n개의 입력 포트를 구비한 입력 포트부; 
상기 입력 포트부를 통해 입력받은 n개의 방송 신호 중에서 영역/그룹/채널별로의 선택받은 방송 신호를 m개의 출력 포트 중에서 대응하는 출력포트로 각기 분배하는 포함하는 스위치부; 
상기 스위치부에 의해 분배받은 방송 신호를 각각 출력하는 m개의 출력 포트를 구비한 출력 포트부; 및 
다른 오디오 매트릭스 장치의 입력 포트부의 n개의 입력 포트와 각각 연결되는 n개의 확장 포트를 구비하여, 다른 오디오 매트릭스 장치로 방송 신호를 출력하는 확장 포트부; 를 포함하고 있으며, 
상기 스위치부는, 
a) 상기 방송 신호를 분배할 경우에, 아래의 등록 포트테이블을 기초로 상이한 영역/그룹/채널별로 온 또는 오프함으로써, 매트릭스화하고, 
b) 상기 포트테이블은 다수의 상이한 영역/그룹/채널별로 매트릭스형 I/O포트를 상이하게 조합 매칭해서 이루어지고, 
상기 스위치부는, 
a) 주변의 화재수신기와 화재 음성인식 보드, 지진센서를 포함한 다수의 상이한 재해/재난 감지 센서와 관리자 모바일 단말기에서 원격 재해/재난 감지 여부에 관한 정보를 전송받고, 
b) 상기 재해/재난 감지 여부에 관한 정보를 전송받을 경우에, 상기 포트테이블의 온/오프 동작을 제어하여 상기 방송 신호를 원격 재해/재난 감지 여부에 따라 해당하는 영역/그룹/채널별로 상이하게 절체해서 방송하도록 하며, 
상기 스위치부는, 
a) 상기 포트테이블을 동일형식으로 해당하는 관리 정보처리장치와 관리자 모바일 단말기(관리자 측)에도 구비하고, 영역/그룹/채널별로 입/출력(I/O) 포트설정에 대한 정합 관계를 미리 설정해서, 
b) 상기 영역/그룹/채널 정보를 방송상황에 따라 변경할 경우, 상기 포트테이블 내의 정보를 상기 정합 관계에 따라 변경된 정보로 실시간 동기화해서 관련 DB를 일치, 유지하는 것;

title_en: Server, vehicle terminal and method for providing emergency notification
title_ko: 서버, 차량용 단말 및 이를 이용한 긴급 상황 알림 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed is a server emergency notification method. The method includes the steps of: receiving emergency situation information from a vehicle terminal for a vehicle, when a vehicle emergency event occurs; starting a standby count for emergency cancellation with respect to a vehicle terminal; determining whether there is an emergency situation depending on whether cancellation for the emergency situation is made until the standby count for the emergency cancellation ends; and performing a report on the emergency situation of the vehicle to an emergency reporting organization using the received emergency situation information, in case of emergency. Accordingly, it is possible to take measures corresponding to a driving state of the vehicle more appropriately and quickly.

title_en: Intelligent emergency lighting and evacuation indicating system

title_en: Parking managemnet system for enhancing safety of immersion
title_ko: 침수 안전성을 높인 주차장 관리시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a parking lot management system. According to the present invention, each parking lot is operated in a normal, forecast, or emergency mode as an operating mode in accordance with inundation prediction information. At the same time, the operating process of a parking facility is optimally set and operated in accordance with the operating mode. In the forecast or emergency mode, an emergency alert text is transmitted to a parked vehicle driver's portable terminal. As a result, inundation-attributable vehicle damage can be effectively forestalled and parking lot management can be improved in terms of efficiency and convenience. When the forecast or emergency mode is determined by an integrated management server, phone number information in parking status information on the parking lot is searched for and text transmission is performed. In the presence of a parked vehicle with no written phone number, a missing vehicle detection unit and a missing vehicle phone number search unit are executed to separately detect the number of the phone number-less parked vehicle. Accordingly, the rate of parked vehicle text transmission can be considerably raised and service accuracy and reliability can be further improved. The integrated management server generates, updates, and stores a separate use history DB by parking lot. In the event of missing vehicle detection, the server primarily searches the use history DB regarding the corresponding parking lot to detect a missing vehicle phone number. In the event of primary detection failure, the server searches the use history DB regarding every parking lot to detect a missing vehicle phone number. Accordingly, unnecessary computational processing consumption attributable to DB search can be reduced and missing vehicle number detection can be performed with speed and accuracy.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 침수예측정보에 따라 각 주차장의 운영모드를 평시모드, 예보모드 및 비상모드로 운영함과 동시에 운영모드에 따라 주차설비의 동작 프로세스를 최적으로 설정하여 운영하되, 예보모드 또는 비상모드 시 주차차량 운전자의 휴대단말기로 비상경보 문자를 전송하도록 구성됨으로써 침수로 인한 차량의 피해를 미연에 효과적으로 방지함과 동시에 주차장 관리의 효율성 및 편의성을 높일 수 있으며, 통합관리서버가 예보모드 또는 비상모드 판단 시, 해당 주차장의 주차현황정보의 전화번호 정보를 탐색하여 문자를 전송하되, 전화번호가 기입되지 않은 주차차량이 존재할 때, 누락차량 검출부 및 누락차량 전화번호 탐색부를 실행시켜 이들에 의해 전화번호가 기입되지 않은 주차차량의 차량번호을 별도로 검출하도록 구성됨으로써 주차차량의 문자전송률을 획기적으로 높일 수 있어 서비스 정확성 및 신뢰도를 더욱 개선시킬 수 있고, 통합관리서버가 별도의 각 주차장별 이용내역DB를 생성 및 갱신하여 저장하되, 누락차량이 검출될 때, 1차적으로 해당 주차장의 이용내역DB를 탐색하여 누락차량의 전화번호를 검출하되, 1차 검출 실패 시, 전체 주차장의 이용내역DB를 탐색하여 누락차량의 전화번호를 검출하도록 구성됨으로써 DB 검색으로 인한 불필요한 연산처리 소모를 줄여 신속하고 정확하게 누락차량의 번호를 검출할 수 있는 주차장 관리시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: V2X Messaging in 5G/6G with Simultaneous GPS Reception
abstract_en: Wireless communication in 5G or 6G, between vehicles (V2V) and other entities (V2X), offers vast opportunities for collision avoidance and improved traffic flow. Many of these opportunities depend on localizing and identifying particular wireless entities (vehicle, pedestrian, base station, toll booth, security gate, among innumerable others). However, due to vehicle motion, the spatial resolution achievable with satellite signals such as GPS, is generally too poor (several meters) to reliably localize a particular wireless entity, inhibiting many applications. Greatly improved localization may be achieved by arranging for multiple vehicles to acquire the satellite signals at the same time from the same satellites. They then transmit parameters of the satellite signals to a calculating entity (such as one of the vehicles) which then processes the data differentially, determining the relative distances between vehicles. Many errors and uncertainties may thereby cancel. The calculating entity can then broadcast a message indicating the coordinates and wireless addresses of the vehicles. With sub-meter spatial resolution, vehicle localization may be improved, cooperation between vehicles may be enabled, and many collisions may be avoided, saving countless lives, according to some embodiments.

title_en: Disaster and emergency surveillance using a distributed fleet of autonomous robots
abstract_en: The disclosed technology provides solutions for performing disaster and emergency surveillance and in particular, for maintaining a Common Operating Picture (COP) using a fleet of distributed robots. A COP maintenance process can include steps for receiving a disaster notification identifying an affected area, and deploying autonomous robots to a map location corresponding with the disaster location. In some aspects, the process can further include steps for receiving updated map information from the one or more autonomous robots. Systems and machine-readable media are also provided.

title_en: System and Method for Electronically Consenting to Engage in Sexual Activity
abstract_en: A system and method for electronically consenting to engage in sexual activity enables two people, the consenters, to use their mobile communication devices to generate and execute a sexual consent contract, and to withdraw consent. The system and method verifies that the consenters would like to engage in the sexual activity and are in proximal communication and cooperating with each other. A sexual consent contract is electronically generated, which includes a consent period during which the sexual activity may take place. The contract is electronically signed by the consenters and a fully executed sexual consent contract is stored. The parties may withdraw their consent for a limited period of time after the contract is electronically signed. A withdrawal of consent by one person alerts the other person. Upon withdrawal, both people can provide notes as to the nature of their encounter. Those notes are stored with the fully executed sexual consent contract. The contract and additional information stored with it, such as notes, may be accessed by investigators in a legal or procedural proceeding for use as evidence to aid in the adjudication of any dispute as to the consensual nature of the sexual encounter.

abstract_en: The present invention relates to a touch-type air fryer with an ignition sensor to solve a problem of fire in the air fryer. According to the present invention, the touch-type air fryer comprises: a main body of the air fryer; an outer pot formed in a circular shape; an inner pot formed in the shape coupled to a handle; a heat detection sensor consisting of a system for automatically sending real-time fire notifications to an air fryer user and a fire station through a fire sensor installed between a heating wire and the inner pot; and a touch dial.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 발화감지센서가 달린 터치형 에어프라이어 에 관한 것으로서 발열감지 센서에 의하여 에어프라이어 내에서의 화재발생을 사전에 감지하여 에어프라이어 사용자의 스마트폰으로 화재 발생 감지 알림이 빠르게 전달되고, 화재 발생시에 소방서에게 알림 문자가 자동으로 보내질 수 있게  함으로써 에어프라이기의 열선이 낮게 달려있고, 바스켓이 낮아서 종이호일이 열선에 닫는 경우, 발열점이 낮은 식품을 에어프라이어로 가열하는경우, 에어프라이어를 과열하는 경우 등에 에어프라이기에서 불이 발생 문제점을 해소하도록 함으로써 기존의 에어프라이기의 열선이 낮게 달려있고, 바스켓이 낮아서 종이호일이 열선에 닫는 경우, 발열점이 낮은 식품을 에어프라이어로 가열하는경우, 에어프라이어를 과열하는 경우 등에 에어프라이기에서 불이 발생 문제점을 해소 하도록 한 것이다. 즉 본 발명은, 에어프라이어에 있어서 제품의 겉면을 구성하며, 제품의 디자인이 소비자에게 시각적으로 보여지는 부분으로서 제품구매시에 매우 중요하고  달걀형으로 형성한 에어프라이어 몸통(본체), 식품으로부터 유출됨 기름이 담겨질 수 있게 구멍이 없고 높은 온도로 가열된 식품이 닿아도 제품의 성상이 유지되는 원형으로 구성한 외솥, 가열된 식품으로부터 유출되는 드립, 기름 등을 잘 걸러져서 담백한 맛의 식품을 만들 수 있게 구멍이 여러개 있는 원형이며, 외솥과 분리가 가능한 결합형태오 제품을 여닿을 수 있는 손잡이가 결합된 모양으로 구성한 내솥, 에어프라이어 내에서의 화재발생을 사전에 감지하여 에어프라이어 사용자의 스마트폰으로 화재 발생 감지 알림이 빠르게 전달되고, 화재 발생시에 소방서에게 알림 문자가 자동으로 보내질 수 있게  에어프라이기의 열선과 내솥 사이에 화재 발생 감지 센서를 부착하고, 이를 통해 화재가 발생하거나 발생할 것 같을 때를 감지하여 에어프라이어 사용자와 소방서에 자동으로 실시간 알림이 가는 시스템을 구성한 발열감지 센서, 제품의 가열 온도와 시간을 조절할 수 있으며 시간과 온도가 써져있는 부분을 눌러 이를 변경할 수 있게 터치형으로 구성한 터치 다이얼으로 구성한 것이다. 따라서, 본 발명은 발열감지 센서에 의하여 에어프라이어 내에서의 화재발생을 사전에 감지하여 에어프라이어 사용자의 스마트폰으로 화재 발생 감지 알림이 빠르게 전달되고, 화재 발생시에 소방서에게 알림 문자가 자동으로 보내질 수 있게  함으로써 에어프라이기의 열선이 낮게 달려있고, 바스켓이 낮아서 종이호일이 열선에 닫는 경우, 발열점이 낮은 식품을 에어프라이어로 가열하는경우, 에어프라이어를 과열하는 경우 등에 에어프라이기에서 불이 발생 문제점을 해소하도록 함으로써 기존의 에어프라이기의 열선이 낮게 달려있고, 바스켓이 낮아서 종이호일이 열선에 닫는 경우, 발열점이 낮은 식품을 에어프라이어로 가열하는경우, 에어프라이어를 과열하는 경우 등에 에어프라이기에서 불이 발생 문제점을 해소하도록 한 효과를 갖는 것이다.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted traffic accident intelligent alarm system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a vehicle-mounted traffic accident intelligent alarm system, including independent power module, MCU little the control unit, signalling module, bee calling organ and LED lamp, independent power module's electric power input passes through the power cord and is connected with car storage battery electric power output. This on-vehicle traffic accident intelligence alarm system, detect vehicle collision through key switch or collision switch and realize automatic alarm, MCU little the control unit is after detecting the signal that collision switch passes back, can realize the autoalarm function, dial 120 promptly, 110, send distress signal, a key distress function through integrated key switch, under emergency, for example under the circumstances that the driver is in a short time to be stupor or the health is uncomfortable, can trigger MCU little the control unit's autoalarm function through key switch, simultaneously for reducing unnecessary wasting of resources, the condition that reduces the wrong report is alert appears, can be in triggering the 15 seconds of autoalarm through pressing key switch cancellation autoalarm's function once more.
assignees: URBAN COLLEGE OF EASTERN AQUILARIA SINENSIS ENG;JI CHONGXING

title_en: Disaster early warning method, terminal equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a disaster early warning method, terminal equipment and a storage medium, which are used for solving the problem that a user cannot accurately and timely receive disaster early warning information in the related technology. If the appointed message is received, determining an operation mode of the position label based on the message type of the appointed message, wherein the operation mode comprises not updating the position label or determining the updating time of the position label, and the appointed message is ticket information or cross-market reminding information; when the update time is reached, positioning operation is executed, and a position label of the current position is obtained and sent to a server; and receiving disaster early warning information of the position label of the current position sent by the server. Therefore, regional distribution of the early warning information is realized by reporting the position label, the cost of sending the information is saved, the position label of the current position can be timely and accurately updated by using ticket information or cross-market reminding information, the influence of position change is reduced, and the accuracy and instantaneity of receiving disaster early warning information can be increased.

title_en: Integrated flood disaster accurate monitoring and early warning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an integrated flood disaster accurate monitoring and early warning method, which belongs to the field of disaster monitoring and comprises the following specific steps: (1) collecting information of each area; (2) flood disaster information prediction; (3) performing statistical planning on each region; (4) analyzing and optimizing the information prediction; according to the invention, the water level information is monitored in real time by arranging the laser radar, so that the estimation accuracy of the water level can be greatly improved, the collection can be kept stable under different illumination conditions, the prediction neural model can be automatically updated, the manual update of workers is not needed, the workload of the workers is reduced, and the working efficiency of the workers is improved.

title_en: Smart safety information board with emergency alert function
title_ko: 위급상황 경보기능이 구비된 스마트 안심 정보안내판
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a smart safety information guide plate with an emergency situation warning function which realizes a warning device for an emergency situation by using a road sign or a building number plate installed on a road or a building or a separate safety information guide plate to provide a safety function even in a secluded area or a dark alley to prevent crimes, and can notify an emergency situation in real time even in a situation in which a user cannot press an emergency button by emergency situation recognition through voice recognition. The smart safety information guide plate recognizes a voice around an area in which the smart safety information guide plate or an emergency button generating an emergency situation signal or an emergency situation cancelation signal in accordance with an operation of a user is installed. An emergency situation is determined if an emergency situation signal is generated by a voice recognition unit generating an emergency situation signal if a recognized voice is an emergency situation voice. If an emergency situation is determined, an LED driving control signal, an emergency warning signal, and emergency situation information for an emergency situation warning are generated and outputted. A warning for an emergency situation is provided audio-visually. The emergency situation information is transmitted to a control center through a gateway to allow a related agency to quickly respond to the emergency situation.
abstract_ko: 도로나 건물에 설치된 도로명판이나 건물번호판 또는 별도의 안심 정보 안내판을 이용하여 위급 상황에 대한 경보장치를 구현하여, 인적이 드문 곳이나 어두운 골목길에서도 안심 기능을 제공하여 범죄를 사전에 예방하고, 음성 인식을 통한 위급 상황 인식으로 사용자가 비상버튼을 누르지 못하는 상황에서도 위급 상황을 실시간으로 알릴 수 있도록 한 위급상황 경보기능이 구비된 스마트 안심 정보안내판에 관한 것으로서, 사용자의 조작에 따라 위급 상황 신호 또는 위급 상황 해제신호를 발생하는 비상 버튼 또는 스마트 안심 정보안내판이 설치된 주변 음성을 인식하고, 인식한 음성이 위급 상황 음성이면 위급 상황 신호를 발생하는 음성 인식부에서 위급 상황 신호가 발생하면 위급상황으로 판단하고, 위급상황으로 판단되면, 위급상황 경보를 위한 LED 구동 제어신호와 위급 경보 신호 및 위급상황정보를 생성하여 출력하며, 위급상황을 시청각으로 경보해주고, 게이트웨이를 통해 위급상황정보를 관제센터 서버에 전송하여, 관계기관에서 신속하게 대응하도록 한다.

title_en: System and method for improving network connection reliability of iot tracking and emergency response devices
abstract_en: A method for testing a network connection of an emergency response system at least including a remote device and a central station includes: receiving, by the remote device, a user's instruction or an automatically triggered event for initiating a test of the network connection between the remote device and the central station; in response to the user's instruction or the automatically triggered event, sending, by the remote device, a first test signal to the central station; receiving, by the remote device, a first response signal sent from the central station for acknowledging the first test signal; and in response to receiving no first response signal from the central station for acknowledging the first test signal, alerting, by the remote device, a user of the remote device about a failure of the network connection.

title_en: Systems and methods for providing recording of a blacked-out media content item
abstract_en: Systems and associated methods are described for providing recording of a blacked out media content item. A system receives a request from a first user device associated with a profile to record a media content item scheduled to broadcast on a second user device (different from the first user device) associated with the profile, at a second location. The system determines that the media content item is subject to a blackout during a blackout period within a blackout region. The system determines that the first user device and the second user device are associated with the same profile and that the first user device is at a first location outside the blackout region. The system then accesses the media content item for recording on the second user device during the blackout period. The system further transmits the recorded media content item to the first user device after expiry of the blackout period.

title_en: Gas detection alarm
abstract_en: The application discloses gaseous detection alarm relates to alarm device's technical field. The alarm comprises a mounting box and an alarm body arranged in the mounting box, wherein a pressure sensor is arranged on the alarm body, a supporting rod and a driving rod are arranged in the mounting box, one end of the supporting rod is abutted with a pressing mechanism abutted against the pressure sensor, the limiting mechanism is used for limiting the displacement distance of the supporting rod, and the resetting mechanism is used for resetting the supporting rod. Pressing means drive branch and pressure sensor butt to make the gas detection alarm report to the police, the displacement distance of spacing subassembly restriction branch, pressure when control branch and pressure sensor butt reduces pressure sensor and transships and receive the possibility of damage, and canceling release mechanical system can realize button mechanism automatic re-setting and stop the warning, need not that the staff is manual to reset, operates when being convenient for next report to the police, has guaranteed the normal use of gas detection alarm.
assignees: SHENZHEN LANGXIN INTELLIGENT SCIENCE AND TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent fire alarm device for buildings
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent fire-fighting alarm device for buildings, which comprises a fixed shell and a transparent rotating cover, the transparent rotating cover is movably inserted at the bottom of the fixed shell, the outer side of the transparent rotating cover is fixedly embedded with a dynamic alarm device, the dynamic alarm device comprises a dynamic reflector and a fixed seat, wherein the fixed seat is provided with a medium-sized telescopic hole, the intelligent fire-fighting alarm device for the building has reasonable design, when the transparent rotating cover rotates, the transparent alarm cover of the dynamic alarm device can be thrown out and emits light, and the cleaning pad is arranged in the middle-sized telescopic hole of the fixed seat, on one hand, the dynamic alarm effect can be achieved, and then improve the effect of reporting to the police, on the other hand, when transparent warning cover withdrawed, the clearance pad can be cleared up transparent warning cover to can prevent effectively that smog from covering and leading to the warning effect to reduce.

title_en: Smart video projector and system and method for disaster warning using the same
title_ko: 단계별 교육 및 평가를 기반으로 하는 반려동물 보호자 교육 시스템 및 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 기술적 측면에 따른 반려동물 보호자 교육 시스템은, 반려동물 보호자 교육 서비스를 제공받기 위하여, 사용자 및 사용자의 반려동물에 대한 정보를 제공하는 사용자 단말 및 공통 교육 분야 및 사용자 맞춤형 교육 분야를 포함하여 반려동물 보호자 교육 커리큘럼을 구성하고, 반려동물 및 반려동물의 보호자의 상황에 따라 능동적으로 학습 대상을 변경 설정하여 학습 서비스를 제공하는 서비스 서버를 포함한다. 상기 공통 교육 분야 및 사용자 맞춤형 교육 분야는 각각 복수의 세부 과목을 포함한다. 상기 서비스 서버는, 상기 사용자에게 복수의 평가를 수행하여 상기 복수의 세부 과목 각각에 대하여 상기 사용자 별 학습자 레벨을 설정하고, 설정된 학습자 레벨을 기초로 상기 사용자에게 제공될 학습 대상을 설정 할 수 있다.

title_en: Roaming network selection method, system, electronic device and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a roaming network selection method, a system, an electronic device and a storage medium, which are suitable for a terminal in a connected state in roaming, and the method comprises the following steps: setting the timing duration of a timer; and issuing roaming guide information to a terminal, wherein the roaming guide information comprises a PLMN list and the timer, so that the terminal starts the timer when the current service is a non-emergency service, simultaneously outputs notification information to notify that network switching is to be performed after the timer expires, and performs network selection according to the PLMN list after the timer expires when a switching rejection command responding to the notification information is not received. The invention can enable the UE in the connection state in roaming to access the VPLMN with higher priority without influencing the running high-priority service.

title_en: Fire safety monitoring system capable of starting emergency lighting
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire safety monitoring system capable of starting emergency illumination, which comprises: the fire control safety intelligent supervision unit monitors the operation, faults and alarm conditions of the fire control facilities in the monitoring area in real time, the manager checks the real-time monitoring data through the fire control monitoring terminal, and if an alarm or an early warning prompt occurs, the fire control emergency lighting control unit starts an emergency lighting channel to guide the personnel in the monitoring area to withdraw rapidly and safely. The fire safety monitoring system with the emergency lighting effectively monitors the fire disaster in the monitoring area, and guides the escape path of the evacuee more accurately, safely and effectively when the fire disaster occurs, so that the larger loss caused by the situation that personnel enter the accident place by mistake is prevented.

title_en: Old person's discernment protection device that tumbles
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an old person's discernment protection device that tumbles belongs to human protector field, including shell and hou gai, the front and back end of shell is equipped with the protection and fills up, the one end that the protection was kept away from to the shell is located the hou gai and is equipped with the control panel, the one end that the control panel is close to the shell is equipped with GSM control module. The utility model discloses, when detecting the old man when will tumble, the sensor can be quick make the reaction, whether detect the old man and will fall, when the sensor processing result can fall for the old man when, the control panel can be quick opens air bag, thereby utilize the old man that air bag protection fell, avoid the old man to fall to hinder, the old man does not report to the police through the switch cancellation after falling in the certain time after the old man falls, protection device can send the location message of asking for help through GSM control module, protection device detects the back that the old man tumbles, the scintillation that the warning light can not stop, the warning that bee calling organ can not stop, thereby arouse passerby to notice to send out the old man who has held up the tumble fast.

title_en: Systems and methods to retrigger detection based proximity alarm systems
abstract_en: A proximity warning system including cameras positioned on a machine, processors, and one or more memory devices including instructions for execution by the processors. The system includes instructions to receive, from the cameras, image data depicting an object within a field of view of the cameras. The system includes instructions to derive a first distance between the object and the machine based on the image data and an alarm is triggered when the first distance is less than a first threshold distance. The system can include instructions to receive a request to snooze the alarm and discontinue the alarm. Additional image data can be received from the cameras and a second distance between the object and the machine is derived based on the additional image data. The system includes instructions to cancel the snooze and retrigger the alarm when the second distance is less than a second threshold distance.

title_en: Information processing program, information processing method and information processing device
abstract_en: To identify a target person to be rescued at an early stage.SOLUTION: In response to simultaneous notification of disaster information encouraging each of a plurality of users to take evacuation actions, an information processing device 101 starts monitoring an update situation of disaster victim information of each of the plurality of users. At a predetermined time interval from the simultaneous notification of the disaster information, the information processing device 101 provides a notification encouraging a user whose update situation of the disaster victim information satisfies a predetermined notification condition, to update the disaster victim information. The information processing device 101 determines the user for which the number of times of performing the notification encouraging the user to update the disaster victim information becomes equal to or more than a threshold, as a target person to be rescued. The information processing device 101 outputs information indicating the determined target person to be rescued.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Fm remodulator
title_ko: Fm 재변조기
abstract_ko: FM 재변조기에 관한 것이며, FM 재변조기는, 라디오에서 FM 방송신호의 수신이 가능한 FM 전 채널 중 적어도 일부의 채널을 유효 채널로 선정하는 채널 선정부; FM 안테나를 통해 수신된 FM 방송신호 중 상기 유효 채널 각각으로 송출되는 송출 방송신호의 레벨을 조정하여 레벨 조정된 방송신호를 상기 유효 채널 각각에 대하여 재송출하는 제어부; 및 재난 관련 비상상황의 발생을 감지하는 비상상황 감지부를 포함하고, 상기 제어부는, 상기 비상상황 감지부에서 비상상황이 발생한 것으로 감지된 경우, 상기 채널 선정부에서 선정된 상기 유효 채널 각각에 대하여 데이터베이스부에 기저장된 재난 방송신호가 송출되도록 제어할 수 있다.

title_en: Child location monitoring method and system using beacons
title_ko: 비콘을 이용한 아동 위치 모니터링 방법 및 시스템
abstract_ko: 비콘을 이용한 아동 위치 모니터링 방법 및 시스템이 개시된다. 본 발명의 일측면에 따른 비콘을 이용한 아동 위치 모니터링 시스템은, 아동이 휴대하는 아동단말, 비콘신호를 이용하여 유효범위 내의 아동단말을 식별하는 복수개의 비콘기기, 아동단말을 식별한 비콘기기로부터의 정보를 기반으로 아동단말의 위치를 모니터링하는 메인서버 및 아동단말이 유효장소를 이탈한 비상상황 시 메인서버로부터 알림정보를 수신하는 보호자단말을 포함한다. 본 발명에 따르면, 아파트 단지와 같은 특정한 공간에서 아동의 위치 현항을 실시간으로 모니터링할 수 있어 아동에 대한 안심 서비스를 제공할 수 있고, 이동형 비콘기기들을 활용함으로써 음영지역 위치 또는 외부로의 이탈과 같은 문제발생 시에도 재빠르게 아이의 위치를 확인하여 안내할 수 있다.

title_en: Flood prevention rainfall early warning monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rainfall early warning systems, in particular to a flood prevention rainfall early warning monitoring system which comprises a meteorological information module, a rainfall display module, a rainfall report module, a rainfall comparison module, a rainfall early warning module, a data screening module and a short message management module. The invention has the advantages that the weather information is updated timely, and the early warning can be automatically realized when the rainfall threshold is reached; rainfall data of the weather monitoring station is acquired through an external link and is pushed and displayed in the system in real time, so that a user can conveniently know the rainfall data, the rainfall information is updated more timely, the user does not need to screen a large amount of weather information, and the information acquisition efficiency is improved; the rainfall threshold is set or modified in the system according to the permanent brightness requirement, and when the current rainfall data is monitored to exceed the rainfall threshold, the rainfall data is pushed to related personnel in a short message mode, so that users in the rainfall sensitive industry are reminded and warned.
assignees: SHANDONG CTRL CLOUD COMPUTING CO LTD

title_en: Warning device and warning method for converter station electronic fence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a warning device and a warning method of a converter station electronic fence, and the warning device comprises a bottom plate, wherein the top of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with two support rods, one opposite side of the two support rods is fixedly connected with a warning plate, the tops of the two support rods are fixedly connected with a top plate, the top of the top plate is provided with a warning mechanism, the top of the top plate is provided with a power supply assembly, the warning mechanism comprises a first fixed bin fixedly connected with the top of the top plate, and a first sliding rod is fixedly connected inside the first fixed bin. This warning device of converter station fence and warning method thereof is through setting up warning mechanism to can warn daytime passerby through the warning board, can warn night passerby through the warning light, through first motor, can withdraw the warning light when daytime, thereby protected the warning light, through setting up the wheel, thereby removal warning device that can be better. Suitable for use in a converter station.
assignees: STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD DC COMPANY

title_en: Alert systems for senior living engagement and care support platforms
abstract_en: Provided herein is an engagement and care support platform (“ECSP”) computer system including at least one processor in communication with at least one memory device for facilitating senior user engagement. The processor is programmed to: (i) register a user through an application, (ii) register a caregiver associated with the user through the application, (iii) generate a senior profile based upon user personal and scheduling data, (iv) build a daily interactive user interface that reflects the senior profile, (v) display the daily interactive user interface at a first client device associated with the user, (vi) cause the first client device to initiate a daily interaction prompt to the user, (vii) determine whether any user interaction was received in response to the daily interaction prompt, and (viii) transmit a daily update message to a second client device associated with the caregiver, including an indication of whether any user interaction was received.
assignees: STATE FARM MUTUAL AUTOMOBILE INSURANCE CO

title_en: Monitoring device for early warning of dangerous rock deformation
abstract_en: The application provides a monitoring devices for early warning dangerous rock mass deformation belongs to rock mass monitoring technology field. This a monitoring devices for early warning dangerous rock mass warp, including coupling assembling and monitoring components. Strain type sensor install in the mounting hole, the monitoring pole activity run through in the mount pad, splint with monitoring pole butt, multiunit the monitoring subassembly passes through the connecting rod install in coupling assembling. This a monitoring devices for early warning dangerous rock mass deformation is through the produced meeting an emergency of stress deformation of strain gauge sensor real-time supervision monitoring lever, through the monitoring lever alright carry out synchronous monitoring to multi-point circumference directional stress distribution on the rock mass single axis and deformation, only need a small amount of drilling simultaneously, the linkage of multiunit monitoring subassembly is monitored, monitoring validity has been guaranteed, avoid causing great disturbance to dangerous rock mass, the risk that dangerous rock mass warp and collapse has been reduced, provide technical support for accurate early warning rock power calamity.
assignees: GUIZHOU TRANSPORTATION PLANNING SURVEY & DESIGN ACADEME CO LTD

title_en: Drought early warning, calculation and updating method for full-type water supply source
abstract_en: The invention discloses a drought early warning, measuring, calculating and updating method for a full-type water supply source. The invention provides a unified drought early warning standard parameter and a measuring and calculating method for water supply source areas with different types and large quantity, measures and calculates the number of days of accumulative drought bearable of the water supply source areas by collecting basic or drought actual monitoring data, sets the days as red early warning, and sets orange and yellow early warning standards by reserving lead; when the observation accumulated rainless day reaches the early warning standard, early warning corresponding color; after the rainfall is observed, the direct water supplement amount of the rainfall falling into the open area of the water source area and the indirect water supplement amount of the rainfall falling into the rain collecting area are calculated, and the total soil accumulative drought degree is offset, so that the accumulative drought days are offset, and the drought early warning condition is updated. The invention obtains the per capita drought data of the water source area in each scale range through the weighted calculation of the water supply population of the water source area, is convenient for relevant departments to master the drought condition and provides a reference basis for implementing drought control measures.
assignees: ZHEJIANG INST OF HYDRAULICS & ESTUARY ZHEJIANG MARINE PLANNING AND DESIGN INST

title_en: Dynamic integrated natural disaster remote sensing monitoring method and system and cloud platform
abstract_en: The dynamic integrated natural disaster remote sensing monitoring method, system and cloud platform can respectively carry out environment updating and early warning degree updating on disaster area remote sensing monitoring information and influence area remote sensing monitoring information, when the environment is updated, a plurality of geological interference states of influence area environment conditions/disaster area environment conditions are obtained through analysis, so that different information updating strategies can be adopted to carry out environment updating on the remote sensing monitoring information in different geological interference states, and the actual monitoring change conditions of all the geological interference states can be obtained through disaster area information and influence area information in the remote sensing monitoring information comprehensively and intelligently as far as possible. Therefore, the updating of the environment angle and the early warning degree angle of the remote sensing monitoring information can be realized, the dynamic remote sensing monitoring updating information can reflect the monitoring result correlation condition among the remote sensing monitoring devices from the actual geological environment change angle as far as possible, and an accurate and reliable decision basis is provided for the subsequent natural disaster early warning.
assignees: GUANGDONG RUZINIU GEOGRAPHIC INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Geological disaster monitoring and early warning method based on big data and image recognition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster monitoring and early warning method based on big data and image recognition, which belongs to the technical field of computers, and is characterized in that big data analysis is carried out through historical disaster images filed by the existing professionals, so that an image change key dimension trend of disaster occurrence and an image database of critical disaster occurrence are obtained; the method and the system have the advantages that various preconditions of disaster occurrence under various scenes are obtained based on big data analysis, the data are more accurate, a disaster critical big database is created, the site conditions and the threshold value of the disaster can be calculated in a closed loop mode, the data comparison is automatic, the efficiency is higher, the accuracy is higher, the threshold value can be automatically updated in a closed loop mode, and various disasters can be tracked and simulated. Under certain condition judgment, the disaster occurrence can be early-warned and forecasted in real time.
assignees: BEIJING ZHIXIANG BEIDOU TECH CO LTD
