abstract_en: The utility model discloses a well site wind direction early warning device which comprises a base, wherein a vertical rod is fixed at the upper end of the base, a movable rod is arranged above the vertical rod, a bearing at the upper end of the movable rod is connected with a mounting block, and a wind vane is mounted on the mounting block; further comprises: the mounting table is connected to the movable rod through a bearing, a hydrogen sulfide detector is further mounted on the movable rod, an alarm is fixed to the upper end of the hydrogen sulfide detector, a fixed rod is fixed to the right side of the mounting table, a photovoltaic power supply system is mounted on the left side of the upper end of the mounting table and used for supplying power to the whole device, and a control device is further fixed to the mounting table. This well site wind direction early warning device adopts and detects alarm mechanism, can in time remind the staff to withdraw when hydrogen sulfide concentration exceeds standard, guarantees staff safety, and the indicating mechanism of cooperation again can make things convenient for the staff to in time judge the wind direction, and the guide staff flees to the exact direction to guarantee staff's escape time.

title_en: Vehicle-event application notifications
abstract_en: Vehicles may be associated with a variety of different types of events, including events associated with vehicle operations and/or events associated with vehicle passengers. The present disclosure is related to, when an event is detected, exchanging information with a vehicle passenger, such as via the passenger's mobile device and/or wearable device. In some instances, an event may be detected, and examples of the present disclosure may provide an application notification presenting various information. The notification may, in some examples, be configured to help the passenger locate the passenger device, to alert the passenger to the event, to provide instructions, and/or to provide a control interface for controlling a vehicle operation. In some examples, the notification may supersede operations of the passenger device, such as by being presented even if the device is in a locked state or has an unrelated application open and in the foreground.

title_en: Intelligent management method and system for paint warehouse-in and warehouse-out and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent management method for paint warehouse-in and warehouse-out, which comprises the following steps: step S1, inspecting and archiving the paint raw materials, wherein the paint raw materials are required to be subjected to qualification product quality inspection, detection and authentication and purchased according to the standard; s2, processing the paint raw materials after passing inspection, detection and authentication, inputting and storing various information of the paint, and generating a unique label serving as quality tracing; step S3, monitoring the service time and the residual storage time of the paint in real time according to various recorded information of the paint, and triggering early warning when the preset threshold value is reached; and S4, reminding a manager to timely process the coating which is about to be or has expired through an acousto-optic or electronic notification mode. Also disclosed are a paint warehouse-in and warehouse-out intelligent management system and an electronic device. The quality of the paint is controlled and traced, so that the physical health and the environmental quality of consumers are further ensured.

title_en: Semi-supervised landslide early warning method integrating concept drift detection and marker migration
abstract_en: The invention discloses a semi-supervised landslide early warning method integrating concept drift detection and marker migration, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a source domain history data set and current landslide data of a target domain; performing feature derivation on the two-domain data, clustering the source domain data, performing feature derivation on clusters generated by clustering, and finally storing the clusters and the features thereof as an initial early warning model; taking the cluster centroid as a training set to train K KNN models; EMD filtering is used for the target domain data stream, and ADWIN algorithm is used for detecting concept drift points of the filtered data, namely data points to be migrated; taking the reciprocal speed and tangential angle characteristics closely related to the landslide curve as the historical label migration basis; and aiming at the classified data, judging the consistency of the migration label and the classification label to update the model. According to the method, the characteristics and the labels of the historical landslide data are utilized to transfer the historical labels to the current data, and the semi-supervised learning is used for carrying out classified early warning, so that the accuracy of landslide early warning is improved.

title_en: Smart automatic braking for forklifts system to prevent industrial accidents
title_ko: 산업재해 예방을 위한 지게차용 스마트 자동 제동시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a smart automatic braking system for forklifts to prevent industrial accidents, which analyzes videos captured by AI cameras to detect objects around a forklift (C) and calculates a distance (D) from the objects, and controls the speed of the forklift in response to the calculated distance (D), while controlling the recognition distance (d1), the stop distance (d2), and the deceleration rate (r) using a dip switch button, thereby drastically preparing and preventing industrial accidents caused by forklift collisions, and increasing the accuracy and reliability of judgment regarding alarm situations. Further, the system can maximize the distribution rate and interoperability by interworking with forklifts of various manufacturers and models without changing the structure of the forklift.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 AI 카메라들에서 촬영된 영상을 분석하여, 지게차(C) 주변의 객체(Object)를 감지함과 동시에 객체와의 거리(D)를 산출하여, 산출된 거리(D)에 대응하여 지게차의 속도를 제어하되, 딥-스위치 버튼을 이용하여 인식-거리(d1), 정지-거리(d2) 및 감속률(r)을 제어하도록 구성됨으로써 지게차 충돌로 인한 산업재해를 획기적으로 예방 및 방지할 뿐만 아니라 경보 상황에 관한 판단의 정확성 및 신뢰도를 높일 수 있으며, 지게차의 구조 변경 없이도, 다양한 제조사 및 모델의 지게차와 연동되므로, 보급률 및 연동성을 극대화할 수 있는 산업재해 예방을 위한 지게차용 스마트 자동 제동시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Efficient Proximity-Based Alerting
abstract_en: An example embodiment may involve: determining that a requester device is in a state for a response; based on the requester device being in the state for the response, determining respective values for each of a plurality of potential responder devices, wherein for a particular responder device of the potential responder devices, a particular value is based on a weighted combination of: physical distance between the requester device and the particular responder device, temporal recentness of location updates received from the particular responder device, and similarity of affiliations of the requester device and the particular responder device; determining that the particular value for the particular responder device meets a threshold criterion; and transmitting a notification to the particular responder device indicating that a responder associated with the particular responder device should provide the response to a requester associated with the requester device.

title_en: Method for predicting multi-factor landslide settlement by gradient lifting regression optimization model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of landslide monitoring and early warning, in particular to a method for predicting multi-factor landslide settlement by a gradient lifting regression optimization model. The method comprises the steps of training a gradient lifting regression optimization model according to multi-factor sample data to predict landslide settlement, wherein the gradient lifting regression optimization model is formed by a plurality of gradient lifting regression trees in parallel, the model improves model classification strength by training a plurality of weak classifiers, the prediction capacity of the model is improved, in order to enable parameters of each weak learner to be different, a training set is updated in the training process of the model, the plurality of weak learners are learned, the prediction capacity of the model is improved, landslide settlement prediction is carried out according to current multi-factor sample data to obtain a current landslide settlement prediction value, a threshold value of a landslide risk level is determined based on landslide history data, geological conditions, soil types and the like, and the landslide risk level is accurately estimated by comparing the threshold value with the prediction value.
assignees: JIANGSU NANJING GEOLOGICAL ENGINEERING SURVEY INST;UNIV NANJING INFORMATION SCIENCE & TECH

title_en: Intelligent firefighting visual platform
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of visual monitoring, and discloses an intelligent firefighting visual platform which comprises a facility monitoring module, a firefighting resource adjusting module, an emergency response module, a combustion rate identifying module, a dynamic early warning module and a firefighting guiding module; according to the intelligent firefighting visual platform, the distribution and the running state of firefighting facilities are monitored in real time, the signal intensity and the transmission delay are analyzed, the response speed and the efficiency of the intelligent firefighting visual platform are effectively improved, the state data of the firefighting facilities can be updated in time, accurate basis can be provided for optimizing a resource network, a water supply distribution route is adjusted, the maximized resource utilization rate is achieved, the understanding of the development of the fire is enhanced, scientific basis is provided for early warning of the fire, and in the aspect of personnel evacuation, an evacuation route is adjusted according to a real-time building structure and people flow data, so that a more efficient and safe solution strategy is provided for firefighting safety.
assignees: WEIFANG PINGAN FIRE PROT ENGINEERING CO LTD;UNIV WEIFANG

title_en: Slope displacement monitoring and early warning method and inclinometer
abstract_en: The invention provides a slope displacement monitoring and early warning method and an inclinometer, and belongs to the field of slope displacement monitoring and disaster early warning. Before the inclinometer is installed, the GPS positioning device is embedded into a top monitoring point of the inclinometer connecting rod, namely a monitoring zero point. When the inclinometer is installed, the monitoring zero point is located on the ground surface, and the GPS positioning device automatically acquires real-time dynamic three-dimensional coordinate information of the monitoring zero point. And obtaining measurement data of the deep part of the landslide based on the inclinometer, carrying out conversion processing on the measurement data according to the monitoring zero point, automatically obtaining the displacement quantity in the direction of the effective deep part X, Y, Z and the accumulated total displacement, and obtaining the actual displacement and movement trend of each monitoring point of the deep part of the landslide. And comparing the detected information with the proposed early warning threshold value, and if the detected information exceeds the early warning threshold value, automatically sending early warning information by the system so that on-site constructors can timely judge and withdraw. The invention provides powerful technical support for safe operation, production informatization and automation of mine engineering.

title_en: Information processing apparatus, information processing system and program
title_ko: 정보 처리 장치, 정보 처리 시스템 및 프로그램
abstract_en: It makes it possible to detect a person who seems to commit a harmful act with high accuracy and notify it in an easy-to-understand form. An information processing apparatus according to an embodiment includes an acquisition unit, a recognition unit, a detection unit, a generation unit, and a notification unit. The acquisition unit acquires an image including a person from a camera installed in the facility. A recognition unit derives second text information by inputting an image captured by a camera into a trained model trained to derive second text information describing characteristics of a person included in an image included in the image from the image, based on an image including the person and a teacher data set including first text information describing characteristics of at least one of an expression, an appearance, and an action of the person included in the image. The detection unit detects an important person related to a harmful action based on the second text information. Based on the detection result, the generation unit generates third text information including the characteristics of the detected key person. The notifying unit notifies the third text information to the worker of the facility.
abstract_ko:
유해 행위를 범할 것 같은 인물을 고정밀도로 검출하여, 이해하기 쉬운 형태로 통보하는 것을 가능하게 한다. 
실시 형태에 관한 정보 처리 장치는, 취득부와, 인식부와, 검출부와, 생성부와, 통보부를 구비한다.  취득부는, 시설 내에 설치된 카메라로부터 인물을 포함하는 화상을 취득한다.  인식부는, 인물을 포함하는 화상과, 당해 화상에 포함되는 인물의 표정, 외견 및 행동 중 적어도 하나의 인물의 특징을 기술한 제1 텍스트 정보를 포함하는 교사 데이터 세트에 기초하여, 화상으로부터 당해 화상에 포함되는 인물의 특징을 기술한 제2 텍스트 정보를 도출하도록 학습된 학습 완료 모델에, 카메라로 촬상된 화상을 입력함으로써 제2 텍스트 정보를 도출한다.  검출부는, 제2 텍스트 정보에 기초하여 유해 행위에 관계되는 요주의 인물을 검출한다.  생성부는, 검출 결과에 기초하여, 검출한 요주의 인물의 특징을 포함하는 제3 텍스트 정보를 생성한다.  통보부는, 제3 텍스트 정보를, 시설의 종사자에게 통보한다.

title_en: Flood disaster risk monitoring system, method and storage medium based on distributed hydrologic model
abstract_en: The invention provides a flood disaster risk monitoring system, method and storage medium based on a distributed hydrological model, relating to the technical field of flood disaster risk monitoring and comprising the steps of dividing a target area into a plurality of sub-area modules and collecting meteorological data, soil data and hydrological data of the target area; the acquired real-time data of all subdomains are input into a meteorological evaluation model, a soil evaluation model and a hydrological evaluation model, the outputs of the three models are combined to comprehensively generate a distributed hydrological model, a corresponding flood risk index is obtained, the flood risk index is compared with a preset risk threshold, and early warning is automatically triggered when the flood risk index exceeds an early warning threshold. According to the invention, the target area is divided into a plurality of sub-field modules, and the corresponding evaluation model is constructed by combining the meteorological data, the soil data and the hydrological data, so that the comprehensive analysis of complex topography and variable meteorological conditions is realized. The accuracy of flood risk assessment is improved, and model output can be updated in real time.
assignees: GUANGXI TRANSP SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Ocean early warning intelligent question-answering method based on large language model and related device
abstract_en: The application discloses a large language model-based ocean early warning intelligent question-answering method and a related device, which relate to the technical field of ocean early warning intelligent question-answering, match a question input by a user with each type of task chain and each vectorized corpus in a vector database, fill the question and target vectorized corpus into a prompt word template of a target task chain, output answers to the question by utilizing an ocean early warning large language model, be applied to ocean early warning business work, realize the ocean early warning intelligent question-answering, vectorize the ocean early warning corpus, construct the vector database, search and reorder the question input by the user in the vector database to obtain the target vectorized corpus, restrict and trace the answer of the ocean early warning large language model, update the vector database when the ocean early warning corpus is updated, and meet the accuracy and timeliness requirements of the ocean early warning business.

title_en: Buffering formula city flood control wall
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of flood control facilities, and discloses a buffer type urban flood control wall which comprises a bottom plate, wherein one side of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with a reinforcing assembly. This buffer type city flood control wall, through lifting unit and warning subassembly, integrated panel's setting, when using, when the position of water level detection piece is reached to the water level, warning lamp can sound and remind, can send the warning to the public, remind the public personnel to withdraw, avoid receiving the flood influence, help reducing casualties and loss of property, when warning lamp is sounded, integrated panel control positive and negative motor rotates, positive and negative motor rotates and drives the transfer line and rotate, the transfer line rotates and drives the threaded rod and rotate, when the threaded rod rotates, the draw runner goes up and down on the threaded rod, drive the baffle goes up and down, increase the length of flood control wall, make it cover more extensive region, thereby provide the flood control protection of wider scope, in order to satisfy city specific flood control requirement and functional requirement.

title_en: Urban multi-class security risk early warning method and system based on federal super network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a city multi-category security risk early warning method and system based on a federal super network, comprising the steps of receiving first information, updating model parameters corresponding to all risk early warning clients through the super network to obtain updated parameters, sending the updated parameters to the corresponding risk early warning clients, and obtaining second information, wherein the model parameters are obtained by training a preset SC Nor-transducer model through historical data collected by a sensor group corresponding to risks, the SC Nor-transducer model is used for sequentially processing input through a sequence normalization layer, a sequence conversion layer, an encoder, a feature mapping layer and a sequence solution normalization layer to obtain output, and the model parameters corresponding to all risk early warning clients are updated through the super network to obtain updated parameters. The invention can effectively influence the increase of the city scale, the increase of the data volume and the data isomerism, and determine the occurrence type or cause of the disaster.
assignees: UNIV XIHUA;CHINA UNITED NETWORK COMMUNICATIONS CO LTD SICHUAN BRANCH;SICHUAN ACADEMY OF SAFETY SCIENCE AND TECH

title_en: Analysis processing method and system for water level signal
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water level signal analysis processing method and system, and relates to the technical field of water level signal analysis processing. The method comprises the steps of placing a plurality of water level meters, collecting water level signals of the water level meters, carrying out primary processing on the collected water level signals, verifying the validity of sampling points and the validity of measured values of the water level signals, carrying out secondary processing on the water level signals, and carrying out automatic early warning according to the secondary processing results. The invention improves the accuracy and timeliness of water level prediction, is beneficial to flood control and reservoir management, can discover and process abnormal water level conditions in time, and reduces disaster risks.
assignees: SICHUAN HUANENG FUJIANG HYDROPOWER CO LTD

title_en: Port infrastructure marine environment disaster early warning platform construction method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of early warning platform construction, and discloses a method and a system for constructing a harbour infrastructure marine environment disaster early warning platform, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining the current time point, the current position and the current speed of typhoons, and the air density and the gravity acceleration of the height of the typhoons; the method comprises the steps of constructing a motion equation, calculating the speed of typhoon at the next time point, calculating the adjacent value between the current time point and the next time point of typhoon, updating the position and the speed between the current time point and the next time point of typhoon occurrence to obtain an updated position and an updated speed to obtain a typhoon path, calculating the typhoon wave height according to the typhoon path and typhoon intensity, and more accurately reflecting the actual movement condition of typhoon by updating the typhoon path in real time, so that the fine change of the typhoon path can be captured, real-time monitoring is realized, and strong data support is provided for construction of an early warning platform.

title_en: System and method for emergency vehicle location system
abstract_en: A method for facilitating sharing location between an emergency responder and a requester is disclosed. The method comprises initiating an emergency request using a means for alerting to alert an emergency responder  102 . Further receiving live location update by the requestor, of the emergency responder  102 . Determining proximity of the emergency responder  102  by the first processor  120  provided within the means for alerting  106 . The method further comprises sending a signal to the controller  126  via the first network  130  to activate the speaker system  122 , and/or the at one light source  124 , based on the proximity of the emergency responder  102 . Further changing the intensity of the speaker system  122  and/or the at one light source  124 , based on the proximity of the emergency responder  102  so as to facilitate or assist the emergency responder  102  to locate the requestor  104.

title_en: Fire disaster early warning method, system and medium based on multi-source information fusion
abstract_en: The scheme discloses a fire early warning method, a fire early warning system and a fire early warning medium based on multi-source information fusion, which comprise single vehicle model training, model deployment, fire risk assessment, BIM modeling display and abnormal information notification. According to the fire disaster early warning method, system and medium based on multi-source information fusion, through deep fusion and model training of images, positioning and temperature information of the vehicle, the temperature fault mode of the vehicle can be quickly and accurately identified, the accuracy of fire disaster early warning is improved, when the vehicle has an overtemperature phenomenon, workers can quickly position the vehicle and the vicinity, measures can be timely taken for the overtemperature vehicle, the occurrence of fire disaster is prevented, the disaster damage degree of the fire disaster is reduced, and powerful support is provided for fire disaster prevention and control work. Through setting up bridge BIM model, show bridge fire risk map at display device or user terminal, command department, staff and driver can grasp the information such as disaster site, fire cause, disaster degree, vehicle intensive degree of current bridge fire rapidly through bridge fire risk map, the environmental adaptation ability of system is strong, can evaluate the fire risk under different environment, improve command department's decision-making efficiency, the staff can arrive the rescue scene fast and expand fire extinguishing and rescue work, the driver in low risk area can withdraw the bridge or assist the staff to carry out personnel evacuation promptly, casualties and economic loss that the biggest reduction conflagration caused.
assignees: GUANGDONG JIAOKE TESTING CO LTD;GUANGDONG WANQU TRAFFIC CONSTRUCTION INVEST CO LTD;GUANGDONG PROVINCIAL HIGHWAY CONSTRUCTION CO LTD;JIANGSU CUMT DAZHENG SURFACE ENGINEERING TECH CO LTD;GUANGDONG HUALU TRANSP TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: AI-based intelligent restoration method and system for wind direction and wind speed history data in alpine region
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses an AI-based intelligent restoration method and system for wind direction and wind speed history data in alpine regions, and belongs to the technical field of data processing. The embodiment of the application aims to effectively improve the timeliness and accuracy of meteorological data by updating a meteorological monitoring data set, applying an advanced data restoration algorithm and carrying out multi-round wind load state vector mining based on a characteristic focusing strategy. By applying the embodiment of the application, the problem of delayed update of the meteorological data can be solved, the whole quality of the meteorological monitoring data can be obviously improved through deep data mining and intelligent restoration, thereby providing a more reliable data base for meteorological prediction, disaster early warning and the like, and having obvious technical progress and application value.
assignees: METEOROLOGICAL DATA CENTER OF HEILONGJIANG PROVINCE HEILONGJIANG METEOROLOGICAL DETECTION CENTER HEI

title_en: Method and system for monitoring and early warning convective strong precipitation based on satellite remote sensing
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster monitoring, in particular to a method and a system for monitoring and early warning convective strong precipitation based on satellite remote sensing, which comprise the following steps: based on the detection data of GPM, FY-3G and H8 satellites, calculating the change of the bright temperature of the cloud top of the streaming cloud cluster in the image data, and analyzing the time sequence of the bright temperature of the cloud top according to the dynamic tracking data of the cloud cluster to obtain a cloud top temperature characteristic set. According to the invention, by utilizing time series analysis of the cloud top bright temperature, tiny weather changes can be rapidly captured, the capability of early identifying potential rainfall risks is enhanced, the introduction of main component analysis optimizes the classification process of weather conditions, the accuracy of risk assessment is improved, dynamic tracking of cloud clusters is more accurate by applying a Kalman filter, a VAR model provides higher reliability in predicting future weather thresholds, and a depth Q network is combined with real-time satellite data, so that early warning information is updated in real time, and timely and effective disaster prevention countermeasures are provided.
assignees: NANJING METEOROLOGICAL SCIENCE AND TECH INNOVATION RESEARCH INSTITUTE

title_en: Coupled meteorological hydrologic hydrodynamic force-based super-standard flood forecasting and early-warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for forecasting and early warning based on coupling meteorological hydrologic power superstandard flood, which are used for collecting historical hydrologic data of monitoring stations in a research area, screening superstandard flood climate early warning indexes, constructing a superstandard flood climate early warning index chart, constructing a topological relation of a research area, constructing a flood evolution model and a hydrologic forecasting model, constructing a river basin superstandard flood forecasting scheme system, constructing a meteorological hydrologic coupling river basin superstandard flood forecasting model, solving the river basin superstandard flood forecasting model based on the superstandard flood forecasting scheme system and combining expert experience to correct in real time to obtain a river basin superstandard flood forecasting scheme updated in real time. Compared with the traditional super-standard flood forecasting and early-warning method, the method can meet the requirements of a modern disaster prevention, reduction and relief system in aspects of flood forecasting precision, forecasting period and the like.
assignees: BUREAU OF HYDROLOGY CHANGJIANG WATER RESOURCES COMMISSION;CHINA YANGTZE POWER CO LTD

title_en: Three-dimensional collaborative multi-type label plotting system and method based on fire alarm condition
abstract_en: The invention provides a three-dimensional collaborative multi-type label plotting system and method based on fire alarm conditions, and relates to the technical fields of geographic information systems and alarm condition processing. The system comprises a warning receiving platform, a warning condition receiving end, a plotting service end, a plotting cache end, a plurality of three-dimensional plotting client ends and a plurality of user ends, wherein the warning condition receiving end is respectively in communication connection with the warning receiving platform and the plotting service end, the plotting service end is respectively in bidirectional communication connection with the plotting cache end and the three-dimensional plotting client ends, the user ends are in communication connection with the corresponding three-dimensional plotting client ends, the warning condition receiving end receives warning condition information of the warning receiving platform, pushes the warning condition information to the plotting service end, interacts with the three-dimensional plotting client ends and the plotting cache ends, and the plotting cache ends are used for caching data and are displayed to the corresponding user ends after being updated. When the fire-fighting police condition is processed, the three-dimensional situation plotting, commanding and dispatching and information sharing can be carried out on the disaster site, and the processing efficiency is effectively improved.
assignees: FUJIAN SIXIN DIGITAL TECH GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Landslide collaborative monitoring and early warning method and system for high-risk zone of ground disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for collaborative monitoring and early warning of landslide in a disaster high-risk area, which are applied to the technical field of intelligent monitoring and early warning, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring landslide surface data and landslide geological structure data of a target landslide; setting a plurality of monitoring devices, acquiring landslide movement type data and landslide deformation type data, acquiring prediction displacement data, calculating first correction weights, correcting the first correction weights to form second correction weights, updating a second neural network model, and judging whether a target landslide is safe or not according to the prediction displacement data output by the updated second neural network model. According to the invention, different landslide movement types and landslide deformation types are analyzed, and the analyzed results are applied to the updating process of the neural network model, so that the model prediction precision is effectively improved, the iteration efficiency is improved, the prediction model can be timely updated to the latest state after various emergency conditions, and the safety and applicability are effectively improved.

title_en: Chemical industry storage fire disaster early warning method based on data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a chemical storage fire early warning method based on data fusion, which comprises a data acquisition module, a data fusion module and a data transmission module. The data acquisition module is composed of a plurality of sensor terminals, uploads data acquired by the sensors to a OneNET platform through a core chip and a WiFi module, and gives an alarm when detecting that the data is abnormal or does not meet a preset value, the data fusion module is composed of the sensor terminals needing to be acquired and a data fusion algorithm LHEA-CNN-DELM-SE_Attention, the data fusion algorithm carries out fire prediction on acquired chemical storage real-time environment data, and the established LHEA-CNN-DELM-SE_Attention model is trained to verify the validity of the model in chemical storage fire prediction. Compared with the prior art, the invention improves the accuracy and the reliability through the cooperative work of a plurality of modules, reduces the requirement of artificial monitoring and reduces the risk of human errors.

title_en: Intelligent early warning terminal system for self-adaptive adjustment of sensitivity of earthquake sensor
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent early warning terminal system for self-adaptive adjustment of sensitivity of an earthquake sensor, which comprises a data acquisition module, a preprocessing module, a database module, a data processing module, an early warning module and a data output module, wherein the preprocessing module is used for generating a warning report when an earthquake occurs, the database module is used for judging the dangerous degree of the earthquake and adjusting the sensitivity of the earthquake sensor, the intelligent early warning terminal system is used for acquiring the seismic wave data when the earthquake occurs, analyzing the earthquake magnitude, analyzing and quantifying the dangerous degree of the earthquake according to the earthquake magnitude and the occurrence frequency, and reducing the sensitivity of the earthquake sensor when the earthquake dangerous degree is low and insufficient to cause damage, so that the earthquake sensor is insufficient to accurately detect the occurrence of the earthquake, and meanwhile, canceling warning, shielding the earthquake with lower destructiveness on the premise of ensuring the safety, so as to avoid causing social panic and ensure the social order and the safety.

title_en: Intelligent fire-fighting automatic fire alarm device and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire alarm devices, in particular to an intelligent automatic fire alarm device for fire protection and a use method thereof, comprising a mounting seat, wherein smoke sensors are fixedly arranged on two sides of the mounting seat, a communication module is fixedly arranged in the mounting seat, a connecting cavity is formed in the upper end of the mounting seat, the upper end of the connecting cavity is fixedly connected with a plastic sheet, and a T-shaped connecting seat is internally connected in the connecting cavity; the control pulls the mechanism and starts behind detecting smog through smoke transducer, and first baffle removes to cancel the blocking to the air guide chamber, and the gas in the carbon dioxide gas pitcher enters into the connection intracavity to promote the upward movement of T type connecting seat, make LED alarm lamp warning speaker and camera stretch into in the external environment and start, prevent lighting device's light by mud or dust blocking, can ' T illuminate around the alarm device, and the speaker in the alarm device probably can be because of dust or the adhesion of mud, and can ' T carry out the condition emergence of normal work.

title_en: Airplane slide pre-positioning indicator lamp with ranging and acousto-optic warning functions
abstract_en: The utility model provides an aircraft slide pilot lamp of taking range finding and audible and visual warning function, belongs to civil passenger plane avionics system and hatch door signal system technical field. Including casing and lamp shade, the inside main control circuit board, lamp plate, the reflector of being provided with of casing, main control circuit board fixes in casing inner chamber lower part, and the lamp plate is fixed in the casing inner chamber of main control circuit board portion, and the reflector is fixed on lamp plate upper portion, and the lamp shade cover is in reflector upper portion, and lamp shade border and casing upper portion opening border fixed connection are equipped with distance detection sensor on the lamp shade. The invention can make the crew quickly and accurately prepare and deploy the slide equipment through visual and audible alarm signals in emergency, ensure passengers to quickly and safely withdraw the aircraft, and prevent serious economic loss and aircraft delay caused by careless opening of the slide equipment due to misoperation in normal conditions.
assignees: SHAANXI BAOCHENG AVIATION INSTR CO LTD

title_en: Barrier lake dam break analysis system and method based on barrier erosion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a barrier lake dam break analysis system and a barrier lake dam break analysis method based on corrosion inhibition, which relate to the technical field of water conservancy and geological engineering disaster prediction and comprise a user interface module, wherein the user interface module allows a user to input parameters, starts each functional module and visualizes results; the dam breaking system comprises a data processing module, a data management module and a data processing module, wherein the data processing module is responsible for simulating a dam breaking process considering the erosion blocking effect, the data management module is responsible for checking, storing and exporting data, and in the data processing module, related parameters are called, the lake water level change is updated according to a time step, corresponding breaking parameters are calculated through an established model, meanwhile, the stability of a broken slope is verified, and a critical elevation and a critical slope foot are judged. Therefore, by adopting the dam break analysis system and method based on barrier lake erosion, the accuracy of water level, break flow, dam body and break geometric change data can be improved, and meanwhile, smooth parameter interaction and data visualization are realized through modular design, so that the dam break analysis system and method based on barrier lake dam break has good disaster early warning application prospect.

title_en: Method and system for monitoring and optimizing state of three-dimensional intelligent park
abstract_en: A three-dimensional intelligent park state monitoring and optimizing method and system comprise the steps of 1, obtaining a park image video, extracting unit areas in the park image by using a management prediction model, giving dynamic identifiers to the unit areas, constructing a time sequence of the dynamic identifiers of the unit areas according to the time sequence of each frame, judging the real-time state of the unit areas by combining the state change quantity of the unit areas in the current frame sequence, analyzing the state change trend of the unit areas by using the management prediction model, generating optimization suggestions according to analysis results, associating the optimization suggestions with the dynamic identifiers of the unit areas to generate an optimized data sequence, mapping the dynamic identifiers, the real-time state and the optimization suggestions of the unit areas to corresponding unit areas in a three-dimensional real-scene model, highlighting abnormal areas in a dynamic identification mode in the three-dimensional model by combining dynamically updated unit area state data, synchronously updating remote notification content, and triggering a corresponding emergency management mechanism.
assignees: ZAOZHUANG POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Electric power geological environment early warning system and method
abstract_en: A power geological environment early warning system and method, it is a geological environment early warning technical field, it uses two transfer channels, store the power address environmental value to be transmitted through waiting for pipeline PIPE of the transmission, add the pipeline PIPE of the duplicate value to carry out registration to the power address environmental value already transmitted, do the duplicate storage, confirm whether the power address environmental value in the environment value monomer at present is already all arrived at the control center according to whether it is the acknowledgement message that is received the control center to return, if arrive, remove the power address environmental value this time in pipeline PIPE of the duplicate value, when the channel is restored to be normal, if have already transmitted the power address environmental value in pipeline PIPE of the duplicate value, remove the power address environmental value, if not, add the duplicate power address environmental value in pipeline PIPE of the duplicate value into the header of pipeline PIPE used for transmitting waiting for transmitting again, can guarantee the completeness of the power address environmental value transmission, is suitable for the early warning to the power address environmental value.
assignees: STATE GRID JIBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD TANGSHAN POWER SUPPLY CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Water level early warning device for flood prevention
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of flood prevention early warning and discloses a water level early warning device for flood prevention, which comprises a supporting pipe, wherein a controller is fixedly arranged on the top wall surface of the supporting pipe, an alarm is fixedly arranged on the top wall surface of the controller, a sensing device capable of sensing the water level is arranged on the side wall of the supporting pipe, the sensing device comprises a plurality of air bags, and an alarm device is arranged on the top wall surface of the supporting pipe and comprises a sensing piece. The water level ring can be always positioned on the water surface through the air bag and the first spring, so that the water level is measured, when the water level ring moves up and down according to the water level, the trigger rod can be driven to move up and down, when the trigger rod moves to a corresponding position, the alarm device can be triggered through the upward movement of the trigger rod, the alarm can be automatically canceled when the water level descends, the structure can be automatically reset, and the protective shell plays a role in protecting the sensing piece and the controller.
assignees: HUNAN HONGXIN CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD

title_en: Pacing ventricular tachycardia detection
abstract_en: The invention relates to pacing ventricular tachycardia detection. The physiological monitoring system collects electrocardiogram ("ECG") data from the passing monitoring sensors via the sensor interface. The machine learning model identifies characteristics of the ECG data attributable to the cardiovascular device used by the patient. The machine learning model will create and continuously update at least one normal ECG template for the individual patient. An abnormal ECG data set is analyzed using a knowledge-based heartbeat classifier to identify a particular arrhythmia. The data structure stores responses to specific arrhythmias based on their likely impact on the patient. For example, the response to a dangerous arrhythmia may be an emergency alert, while the response to a temporary arrhythmia being rapidly corrected by the patient's pacemaker may be a non-urgent message or annotation to archive.

title_en: Geological disaster pregnancy environment health monitoring and early warning method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disasters, in particular to a method for monitoring and early warning the health of a geological disaster pregnancy environment, which acquires the influence factors updated in real time such as the topography factors, the geological structure factors, the hydrologic factors, the engineering factors, the historical disaster conditions and the like of an evaluation area by utilizing the Internet of things, and by constructing a health assessment index system of the disaster recovery environment, the regional health risk fine assessment of the disaster recovery environment is completed by utilizing the powerful geographic analysis function of the GIS, and the geological disasters are prevented and treated.

title_en: Fire alarm notification and fire extinguisher that informs the expiration date
title_ko: 유통기한을 알려주는 화재경보 알림 겸용 소화기
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire extinguisher (1) combined with a fire alarm notifying expiration date. More specifically, the fire alarm notifying expiration date sounds an alarm through a speaker when the expiration date passes, and when a fire occurs, the fire alarm (1) transmits the fire alarm to a speaker (2) to notify that the speaker (2) has a fire.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 유통기한을 알려주는 화재경보 알림 겸용 소화기(1)에 관한 것으로,더욱 상세하게주는 화재경는 유통기한이 지나면 스피커를 통해 알람이 울리고 화재가 발생하면 화재경보기(1)가 스피커(2)로 전달하여 스피커(2)가 화재가 발생했습니다라고 알려준다.

title_en: Natural gas pipeline leakage monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a natural gas pipeline leakage monitoring system applied to the field of gas monitoring, which comprises a gas pipeline management platform body, wherein the gas pipeline management platform body comprises a gas pipeline monitoring network system, a monitoring data transmission system, an emergency management system and a remote control system, an early warning valve well lid is additionally arranged on the basis of the existing monitoring system, the early warning valve well lid adjacent to the natural gas pipeline is immediately triggered to warn outwards when the natural gas pipeline leaks, firstly, the concentration of leaked gas is effectively reduced by utilizing the water spraying effect of a water spraying head, the probability of natural gas deflagration is effectively reduced, the water spraying head can also warn the passing pedestrians and vehicles when spraying water, prompt the passing pedestrians and vehicles to withdraw to a safe area as soon as possible, meanwhile, the probability of accidental ignition of the leaked natural gas can also be effectively avoided, in addition, the lifted protective cover and the light effect of a warning lamp can also warn the people and the vehicles, residents around the valve well are warned as soon as possible, and the casualties are effectively reduced.
assignees: YIZHOU TANGSHAN NEW ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-point off-site synchronous geological disaster early warning method and system based on rainfall observation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multipoint off-site synchronous geological disaster early warning method and system based on rainfall observation, belonging to the disaster early warning field, wherein the method comprises the steps of dividing a target area into a plurality of monitoring nodes, arranging a rainfall detection station and a soil humidity sensor at each monitoring node, and installing a gradient sensor in a landslide sensitive area; the method comprises the steps of carrying out time coupling on collected data, then sending the collected data to a cloud platform, decompressing the data after the cloud platform receives sensor data, inputting the collected sensor data into a comprehensive prediction model to dynamically update soil humidity, and evaluating geological disaster risks based on the change of the soil humidity and the data of the geological condition database in various geological disaster prone areas in the cloud platform. The method and the system can fully utilize multi-source heterogeneous data so as to comprehensively evaluate the risk of geological disasters.
assignees: INST OF AGRICULTURAL RESOURCES AND ENVIRONMENT SICHUAN ACADEMY OF AGRICULTURAL SCIENCES

title_en: Tunnel gushing water automatic identification method and system based on gushing water target detection model
abstract_en: The invention provides a tunnel water inrush target detection model-based automatic identification method and system, and belongs to the technical field of tunnel water inrush disaster monitoring, prevention and control. The method comprises the steps of extracting video image features in a tunnel, mixing the spatial attention weight and the channel attention weight of the features, updating the features, fusing the updated features, and decoding the fused features to obtain a target frame and a category result. The method and the system have the advantages that through a content-aware attention mechanism and coupling with the context characteristics, the generalization force of the monitoring model is improved, the accurate identification of the tunnel surge water under various tunnel conditions is guaranteed, the omnibearing high-precision detection and statistical analysis of the tunnel surge water are further realized, whether early warning prompt in the tunnel is carried out or not is judged, the evolution condition of the surge water is predicted, and the guarantee is provided for the tunnel safety construction.

title_en: Method of synchronizing local codes in emergency disaster text service
title_ko: 긴급재난문자서비스에서의 지역코드 동기화 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for synchronizing a local code in an emergency disaster text service, which synchronizes an administrative district code version between a 5G emergency disaster text administrative district code distribution system (10) for transmitting the latest administrative district information to a currently operating 5G emergency disaster text administrative district code reception system (20) and the 5G emergency disaster text administrative district code reception system (20). The 5G emergency disaster text administrative district code distribution system (10) responds to an administrative district code version when the 5G emergency disaster text administrative district code reception system (20) requests the administrative district code version using a common alarm protocol, but responds to the version of the current administrative district information and the updated past date when there is no information scheduled to be updated in the future, and responds to the version of the corresponding administrative district information and the scheduled update date when there is an administrative district code scheduled to be updated.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은, 
현재 운영중인 5G긴급재난문자 행정구역코드 수신시스템(20)에 최신 행정구역 정보를 전달하는 5G긴급재난문자 행정구역코드 배포시스템(10)과 상기 5G긴급재난문자 행정구역코드 수신시스템(20) 간에 행정구역코드 버전을 동기화하는 긴급재난문자서비스에서의 지역코드 동기화 방법으로서, 
상기 5G긴급재난문자 행정구역코드 배포시스템(10)은 상기 5G긴급재난문자 행정구역코드 수신시스템(20)이 공통경보프로토콜을 이용하여 행정구역코드 버전을 요청하면 행정구역코드 버전을 응답하되, 향후 업데이트가 예정된 정보가 없는 경우 현재 행정구역정보의 버전과 갱신했던 과거의 날짜를 응답하고 업데이트 예정인 행정구역코드가 존재하는 경우 해당 행정구역정보의 버전과 갱신 예정일을 응답하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Intelligent situation management and decision support system and method for wide-area disaster situation support
title_ko: 광역 재난 상황 지원을 위한 지능형 상황 관리 및 의사 결정 지원 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed is a method for providing integrated situation management when a wide area disaster situation occurs through a big data management system, a first device for controlling a platform of a disaster management agency, and a second device for controlling a platform of a local government. According to an embodiment of the present disclosure, the method may include the steps of: generating and constructing, by the big data management system, a database related to disaster situation management based on receiving disaster report information related to a specific disaster; transmitting, by the big data management system, a notification message including the disaster report information to the first device and the second device; updating, by the first device and the second device, the database based on a change in the disaster situation; transmitting, by the big data management system, the disaster termination information to the first device based on reception of the disaster termination information of the local government from the second device; and updating, by the first device, the disaster termination information on the database based on termination of all disasters caused by the specific disaster.
abstract_ko: 빅데이터 관리 시스템, 재난관리주관기관의 플랫폼을 제어하는 제1 장치, 및 지역자치단체의 플랫폼을 제어하는 제2 장치를 통해 광역 재난 상황 발생시 통합 상황 관리를 제공하는 방법이 개시된다. 본 개시의 일 실시예에 따른, 상기 방법은, 상기 빅데이터 관리 시스템이 특정 재난과 관련된 재난 신고 정보를 수신함에 기반하여 재난 상황 관리와 관련된 데이터베이스를 생성 및 구축하는 단계; 상기 빅데이터 관리 시스템이 상기 재난 신고 정보가 포함된 알림 메시지를 상기 제1 장치 및 상기 제2 장치로 전송하는 단계; 상기 제1 장치 및 상기 제2 장치가 재난 상황이 변경됨에 기반하여 상기 데이터베이스를 업데이트하는 단계; 상기 제2 장치로부터 상기 지역자치단체의 재난 종료 정보가 수신됨에 기반하여, 상기 빅데이터 관리 시스템은 상기 재난 종료 정보를 상기 제1 장치로 전송하는 단계; 및 상기 제1 장치는 상기 특정 재난에 의해 발생된 모든 재난이 종료됨에 기반하여, 상기 데이터베이스 상에 재난 종료 정보를 업데이트하는 단계를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: The Monitering Control System of RF filter for Semiconductor
title_ko: 반도체용 rf 필터 모니터링 제어 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an RF filter monitoring control system for a semiconductor, which measures the temperature of an RF filter used in semiconductor deposition equipment to be checked from the outside, and can warn when a dangerous temperature is reached. The present invention includes an RF filter temperature monitoring device (100) which is located in an RF filter (500) and measures the temperature in the RF filter (500); a display device (200) which receives power from the RF filter temperature monitoring device (100), displays temperature information measured by a temperature sensor (130) on a screen to be checked from the outside when the temperature information is received, and changes the color of the screen or outputs a warning sound when a dangerous temperature display signal is received; and an interface connection device (300) which supplies power to the RF filter temperature monitoring device (100), receives temperature information and a dangerous temperature signal from the RF filter temperature monitoring device (100) and provides them to a main computer (400), and provides a heater OFF signal to the RF filter (500) when the heater OFF signal is received.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 반도체 증착장비에 사용되는 RF 필터의 온도를 측정하여 외부에서 확인할 수 있도록 하고, 위험온도에 도달하면 경고할 수 있는 반도체용 RF 필터 모니터링 제어 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명은, RF 필터(500) 내부에 위치하며 RF 필터(500) 내부의 온도를 측정하는 RF 필터 온도 모니터링장치(100)와; RF 필터 온도 모니터링장치(100)로부터 전원을 공급받고, 온도센서(130)에서 측정된 온도정보가 수신되면 외부에서 확인할 수 있도록 화면에 표시하고, 위험온도 표시신호가 수신되면 화면의 색상을 변경하거나 경고음을 출력하는 디스플레이장치(200)와; RF 필터 온도 모니터링장치(100)에 전원을 공급하고, RF 필터 온도 모니터링장치(100)로부터 온도센서(130)에서 측정된 온도정보, 위험온도신호가 수신되면 메인 컴퓨터(400)로 제공하고, 히터 OFF신호가 수신되면 RF 필터(500)로 제공하는 인터페이스 접속장치(300)를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Marine fire alarm device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of marine fire alarm, in particular to a marine fire alarm device. The fire extinguishing system comprises a signal wire, a power wire, a broadcasting wire, a telephone wire and a linkage control wire, wherein the signal wire is used for connecting each detector to carry out signal transmission, a fire extinguishing device is started by a fire extinguishing host according to signal feedback to extinguish fire, the power wire provides power for a module and the fire extinguishing device to ensure the normal operation of the system, the broadcasting wire is used for broadcasting emergency escape and evacuation when a fire disaster occurs, the telephone wire is used for timely carrying out remote communication and alarming and seeking help, and the linkage control wire is used for directly starting the fire extinguishing device by the fire extinguishing host to directly extinguish fire. The equipment connected with the telephone line comprises a cancellation control host, a telephone manual alarm and a telephone, wherein the cancellation control host is sequentially connected with the telephone manual alarm and the telephone. The device can be controlled well through a signal line, a power line, a broadcasting line, a telephone line and a linkage control line, so that control is realized.
assignees: CSSC JIUJIANG CHANGAN FIRE PROT EQUIPMENT COMPANY LTD

title_en: Intelligent terminal for realizing risk detection based on hong Mongolian system
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of risk detection and discloses an intelligent terminal for realizing risk detection based on a hong Mongolian system. According to the application, the physiological monitoring module is utilized to generate corresponding physiological data through data preprocessing and multi-period segmentation and recombination, then the physiological data is compared with a dynamically updated physiological threshold value to generate physiological early warning, the high-inverse evaluation module is utilized to combine altitude data and historical high-inverse records to carry out high-inverse evaluation through similarity analysis and generate warning, the safety perimeter module is utilized to integrate individual position and overall distribution evaluation position risk to generate early warning or warning, and the warning module is utilized to integrate various information and push warning according to priority, so that the defects of the traditional technology in aspects of data integration analysis, high-inverse evaluation scientificity, position evaluation comprehensiveness, warning information processing and the like are overcome, and the safety monitoring level of personnel in complex operation environments is improved.
assignees: GUO NENG LONG YUAN ELECTRIC CO LTD

title_en: Real-time monitoring-based natural disaster early warning and responding method and device for electric power system
abstract_en: The invention provides a real-time monitoring-based power system natural disaster early warning and responding method, which relates to the technical field of power early warning response and comprises the following steps of data analysis and processing, wherein the data analysis and processing utilizes a long-short-period memory network to combine with a Bayesian network to analyze and process real-time monitoring data in a power system, a scheduling scheme is generated, the state of the power system is updated in real time and an optimal scheduling scheme is generated based on a multi-source data fusion and optimization method combining a Kalman filter and a genetic algorithm, an emergency response strategy is generated, the influence of a natural disaster on the power system is simulated in real time in a virtual model through a digital twin technology and a self-adaptive dynamic programming method, and an emergency response strategy is provided, and anomaly detection and self-healing are performed by combining big data analysis with edge calculation to perform anomaly detection and self-healing on the running state of the power system.
assignees: TIELING POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Intersection short-time traffic flow prediction method based on quantile regression and Bayesian network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a short-time traffic flow prediction method for intersections based on quantile regression and a Bayesian network, which relates to the technical field of intelligent traffic and comprises the following steps of constructing a Bayesian network, analyzing traffic flow data by adopting a quantile regression method, determining probability space distribution of traffic flow under abnormal traffic conditions, and determining parameters in the Bayesian network by utilizing the quantile regression result; the invention accurately grasps the space-time and nonlinear characteristics of traffic flow, provides support for policy formulation and signal optimization of a management department, effectively dredges blockage and improves efficiency, ensures reliable prediction for emergency management and accident early warning based on various abnormal conditions by quantile regression of determined network parameters, reduces the risk of confusion and loss, acquires updated data in real time and optimizes a model, flexibly adjusts according to scene change, enables intelligent fine energization for traffic management, improves system performance and service quality, meets multiple requirements and drives traffic to continuously develop.

title_en: Geological investigation safety monitoring method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological exploration safety monitoring method and a geological exploration safety monitoring system, which relate to the technical field of geological exploration monitoring, and are characterized in that a data collection monitoring module is utilized to conduct exploration monitoring on a current geological region, an early warning calculation module is utilized to sequentially calculate and output a ground settlement rate CJ, a landslide early warning index HP and a debris flow early warning grade NL, in the process of calculating the landslide early warning index HP and the debris flow early warning grade NL, critical values of parameters are required to be updated in real time according to the latest geological disasters, and an early warning display module is utilized to display and early warn the recent debris flow early warning grade NL in the form of a line graph and judge the dangers of the current geological region.

title_en: Modularized vehicle system compatible with existing track circuit
abstract_en: The application discloses a modularized car system compatible with an existing track circuit, which is characterized in that an ID command frame is broadcast to a track circuit reader according to a preset period after a car-mounted operation center is electrified, the track circuit reader receives ID information after checking, then receives an information frame and analyzes the information frame, then sends the track circuit frame to the car-mounted operation center, if the track circuit reader receives the ID command frame, the ID information is updated, a car-mounted protection system receives carrier frequency and low-frequency information through an interface of the track circuit reader, the validity of a speed code and the safety information of a section where the speed code is located are judged, and when the data of the track circuit reader is valid and the carrier frequency information accords with a preset rule, the speed information is obtained according to the low-frequency information, and corresponding safety measures are executed. By introducing a communication mechanism of the vehicle-mounted operation center and the track circuit reader, the newly manufactured train can utilize an advanced train-to-train system and be compatible with the existing track circuit system, and the reliability and flexibility of the existing system are improved.

title_en: Urban power grid fault early warning method and system based on expected fault set
abstract_en: The application provides an urban power grid fault early warning method and system based on an expected fault set, wherein the method comprises the steps of combining meteorological data with real-time monitoring data and operation data of a power grid to judge the type of disaster where the power grid is currently located; the method comprises the steps of receiving a target prediction model corresponding to a current disaster type, calling the target prediction model corresponding to the current disaster type to predict whether the power grid can fail, predicting the failure type after judging that the power grid can fail, optimizing super parameters of the target prediction model through a parameter adjusting tool, carrying out global risk assessment and disaster early warning on the power grid through an expected failure set, dynamically updating the model through an online learning algorithm and a model parameter self-adaptive adjustment algorithm based on real-time data flow, and carrying out failure prediction and risk assessment again based on the dynamically updated model. According to the method, prediction uncertainty is reduced through staged model prediction, and accurate fault prediction can be realized under various disaster scenes by combining dynamic updating of a prediction model and an expected fault set.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD WUXI POWER SUPPLY CO;UNIV CHINA AGRICULTURAL

title_en: Tunnel disaster risk intelligent early warning method and system with self-learning capability
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent tunnel disaster risk early warning method and system with self-learning capability, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the risk degree index of various ground disasters is defined as the four arithmetic results of the corresponding advanced detection/monitoring index value and the correction term, so that the coupling of an experience method and a detection/monitoring method is realized. The detection/monitoring index value is derived from advanced detection or monitoring methods adopted by specific engineering, the correction term depends on geological conditions affecting specific disaster types, and the correction term is derived from advanced detection/monitoring geological interpretation. The initial value of the correction term is obtained by experience judgment and is calculated and obtained according to the matching degree of the actual situation revealed afterwards and the predicted result in advance in the tunnel construction process, so that the correction coefficient value can be continuously learned and updated according to the actual situation in the tunnel circulation tunneling process, and the reliability of the early warning result is improved.

title_en: Simple landslide monitoring and early warning device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a simple landslide monitoring and early warning device, which relates to the technical field of landslide early warning and comprises symmetrically arranged supporting rods, wherein a plurality of transverse pipes are fixedly connected between the two supporting rods, an alarm assembly is arranged in the middle of each transverse pipe, steel wire ropes are respectively arranged at two ends of the alarm assembly, a steel plate is fixedly connected with one end of each steel wire rope, which is far away from the alarm assembly, of each steel wire rope, telescopic assemblies are respectively arranged at two sides of each alarm assembly, two ends of each telescopic assembly are respectively fixedly connected with the transverse pipe and the steel plate, and the steel wire ropes are arranged in the transverse pipes and the telescopic assemblies. The utility model drives the steel wire rope to move through the steel plate, so that the steel wire rope can sound the alarm assembly, the ordinary people can receive the dangerous signal of the landslide at the first time through the alarm, the people can withdraw in time, the casualties and the property loss are reduced, specialized high-cost equipment such as GPS, remote sensing, a displacement sensor, an optical fiber sensor and the like is not needed, the manufacturing cost is low, the installation is easy, and the monitoring principle is simple.
assignees: CHENGDU VOCATIONAL & TECHNICAL COLLEGE OF IND

title_en: Laboratory safety precaution system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of laboratory safety, in particular to a laboratory safety early warning system, which comprises a naming registering module, a portrait tracking module, a digital twin module, a common monitoring module, a monitoring analysis module for determining a monitoring mode of a laboratory and a monitoring control module, wherein the monitoring control module determines a safety warning library according to experimental contents of each laboratory so as to identify abnormal behaviors of the laboratory, determines operation experimental equipment according to the experimental contents and experimental videos so as to monitor and update partial digital twin models corresponding to the operation experimental equipment in real time, and controls the common monitoring module to perform common monitoring on an experimental area so as to determine an influence characterization trend of a non-experimental area on the experimental area so as to determine whether safety early warning is performed. The invention solves the problems of incomplete monitoring, untimely early warning, difficult accident cause tracing and unreasonable resource utilization in the aspect of laboratory safety management in the prior art.
assignees: GUANGZHOU AOPEIKE LABORATORY EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Fire control facility remote monitoring and intelligent management and control system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote monitoring and intelligent management and control system for a fire-fighting facility, which belongs to the technical field of fire-fighting early warning, and concretely comprises the steps of deploying a multi-parameter sensor array, enabling sensor nodes to form a redundant monitoring network in a honeycomb topology structure, conducting real-time fusion analysis on sensor network data through an edge computing gateway, triggering an abnormal region positioning module when any monitoring parameter is detected to exceed a preset dynamic threshold value, constructing a three-dimensional thermodynamic diagram model based on parameter gradient changes of adjacent sensor nodes by the abnormal region positioning module, dynamically computing the diffusion direction and potential risk level of an abnormal region, enabling a mobile inspection robot cluster to receive coordinates and risk parameters of the abnormal region, automatically generating a multi-stage response path based on a real-time updated building digital twin model, enabling a primary path to be quickly abutted to a preset main road, enabling a secondary path to be dynamically adjusted according to the distribution of field obstacles, and enabling a terminal path to be rechecked by adopting a contact type detection module.
assignees: LINYI NEW SMART CITY OPERATION CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent forest fire prevention monitoring and early warning method and device based on unmanned aerial vehicle group
abstract_en: The application discloses a smart forest fire prevention monitoring and early warning method and device based on unmanned aerial vehicle groups, and relates to the technical field of forest fire prevention monitoring, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a patrol topological graph, real-time map information, starting positions of unmanned aerial vehicles and current observation states of the unmanned aerial vehicles of a current environment; the method comprises the steps of establishing an unmanned aerial vehicle environment space model based on acquired information, inputting the current observation state of the unmanned aerial vehicle into a trained multi-agent reinforcement learning model, determining optimal patrol nodes of each unmanned aerial vehicle at the next moment, controlling each unmanned aerial vehicle to execute patrol tasks, updating the position and the current observation state of each unmanned aerial vehicle in the unmanned aerial vehicle environment space model, and re-determining the optimal patrol nodes at the next moment based on the updated current observation state of each unmanned aerial vehicle until all patrol nodes in a patrol topological graph are covered. The application solves the problems of low patrol efficiency of the unmanned aerial vehicle and non-robust patrol algorithm, and improves patrol efficiency.
assignees: UNIV SHANXI;SHANXI LINGXIAOXI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire evacuation path optimization method for personnel-intensive places
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fire evacuation path optimization method for a personnel-intensive place, which comprises a sensor module, an image acquisition module, a personnel counting module, a voice broadcasting module and a data processing module, wherein the method comprises the steps of analyzing monitoring pictures acquired by the image acquisition module in real time, extracting visual feature vectors aiming at each detected personnel target, modeling and predicting the movement track of personnel by combining space-time context information, realizing a globally optimal evacuation strategy, and broadcasting the real-time evacuation strategy obtained by the cooperative evacuation model by voice until all personnel are evacuated safely. In the evacuation process, personnel states of all areas are obtained in real time, evacuation decisions are dynamically updated, and voice broadcasting guidance is conducted. The intelligent and personalized evacuation guiding of large-scale crowds is realized through the multi-mode information fusion and the deep learning algorithm, and the evacuation efficiency and the safety are effectively improved.
assignees: FUJIAN PROVINCIAL INSTITUTE OF ARCHITECTURAL DESIGN AND RES CO LTD

title_en: Landslide monitoring and early warning method and system based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide monitoring and early warning method and system based on a digital twin technology, which belong to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and early warning, and concretely comprise the steps of collecting geographical information data of landslide in real time, constructing a dynamically updated multi-source space database, constructing a landslide simulation model, conducting grid subdivision on the landslide simulation model, carrying out solving based on the landslide hydraulic coupling model by introducing a stress field and seepage field numerical coupling algorithm, accurately analyzing landslide to represent a state, acquiring a safety coefficient of the landslide in real time by adopting an intensity folding method, establishing a disaster analysis model, deducing a landslide disaster forming range if the safety coefficient reaches a preset alarm threshold, calculating a disaster risk index, evaluating a risk level according to the disaster risk index, and carrying out early warning on the landslide disaster if the risk level is higher than the preset level. The intelligent landslide monitoring system and the intelligent landslide monitoring method realize accurate monitoring and intelligent safety early warning of landslide.
assignees: SUZHOU TURUISI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Meteorological-assisted mountain fire high-efficiency early warning and scheduling system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mountain fire early warning, in particular to a weather-assisted mountain fire high-efficiency early warning and scheduling system. According to the invention, through the application of real-time monitoring and data analysis, the reaction speed and accuracy of mountain fire early warning are greatly improved, the real-time measurement and analysis of meteorological variables enable the fire early warning to be independent of a traditional probability model, the early warning threshold value can be dynamically adjusted based on real-time data, the early warning is more timely and has strong pertinence, the problem of data update delay is solved, accurate risk assessment is provided, the fire alarm is issued immediately, the real-time optimization of a rescue path is ensured, the quick response of rescue resources through the shortest path is ensured, the success rate and efficiency of rescue actions are directly influenced, and the fire prediction model utilizes continuous data training, so that the adaptability and prediction capability to fire change are further enhanced.

title_en: Mountain torrent is with protection early warning equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a protection early warning device for mountain floods, which belongs to the technical field of mountain floods and has the technical scheme that the protection early warning device comprises a support column and an early warning mechanism, wherein the early warning mechanism is clamped at the top of the left side of the support column, a water leakage hole is formed in the surface of the support column, the support column can support and limit the early warning mechanism and the water leakage hole through the arrangement of the support column, flood can be stored in the inner side of the support column, the water leakage hole can enable the flood to enter the inner side of the support column, the flood in the inner side of the support column can be discharged when the flood is withdrawn, a floating ball can float towards the top of the inner side of the support column along with the flood, the floating ball can support and limit a floating plate, the floating plate can be driven by the floating ball when the floating ball floats upwards, the bottom of an alarm can be pressed through buoyancy when the water level rises too high, and the alarm can alarm a monitor.

title_en: Geological engineering integrated gas storage risk early warning method and system based on microseism
abstract_en: The invention discloses a risk early warning method and a risk early warning system for a geological engineering integrated gas storage based on microseism, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a geological engineering integrated environment, and constructing a basic geological engineering integrated environment model according to basic data fusion; analyzing small faults and cracks which cannot be identified in a three-dimensional earthquake scale according to actual measurement microseism event data, using the small faults and cracks to update a geological model, loading and updating the small faults and cracks into a geological engineering integrated environment model, re-planning a risk identification area in the updated geological engineering integrated environment model according to guidance of historical risk data, and performing early warning and identification on the microseism risk of the gas storage, wherein the early warning and identification are based on the geological engineering integrated environment model, combining microseism dynamic data and injection and production dynamic data, performing fusion analysis on the running condition of the gas storage, and performing risk identification and early warning. The method solves the problem of single risk identification of the prior gas storage, and carries out risk identification early warning from the point of multi-source data fusion.

title_en: Cultural relic safety evaluation analysis system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The present invention discloses an artificial intelligence based cultural relic security assessment and analysis system, comprising a data collection module, a data analysis module, a scheme generation module, a user interaction interface, an execution and monitoring module, and a maintenance and update module. Through the use of this system, real-time monitoring and adjustment of environmental information in museums can be achieved, ensuring that cultural relics are stored in a good environment and improving their safety.
