At the same time, it can also provide early warning of external disasters to enhance the protection effect of cultural relics.

title_en: Mountain crack geological disaster information monitoring and early warning method
abstract_en: The application provides a mountain crack geological disaster information monitoring and early warning method which comprises the steps of obtaining crack form data of a mountain crack area, wherein the crack form data comprise crack length, width, depth and trend, acquiring geological feature parameters of the crack area in real time through a preset sensor network, wherein the geological feature parameters comprise lithology, structure and stress state, acquiring data through a pre-arranged geological sensor network, transmitting the crack form data and the geological feature parameters acquired in the wild to a monitoring platform in real time, designing a visual display module according to a dynamically updated crack dividing result, generating a crack space distribution map and an attribute feature map, and performing correlation analysis on the visually displayed crack dividing result and monitoring information such as rainfall, earth surface displacement and the like in the monitoring platform to generate a disaster early warning report.
assignees: SHANDONG PROVINCIAL BUREAU OF GEOLOGY & MINERAL RESOURCESNO 801 HYDROGEOLOGICAL ENG GEOLOGICAL BRIGA

title_en: Mine geological disaster early warning method based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of mine geological disaster monitoring and early warning, and discloses a mine geological disaster early warning method based on artificial intelligence, wherein dynamic changes of state variables and multi-physical field coupling effects in a disaster evolution process are described by constructing a dynamic model; the method comprises the steps of carrying out discrete solution on a model by a numerical method to obtain a disaster evolution path, combining a bifurcation theory and Lyapunov stability analysis to accurately identify a disaster instability critical point, designing an optimal early warning strategy by a reinforcement learning algorithm, dynamically selecting an alarm signal triggering time, fusing monitoring data and the model in real time to dynamically update disaster states and risk grades, outputting alarm signals and providing emergency suggestions. The method realizes accurate disaster prediction and real-time response of early warning, and improves the mine geological disaster prevention and control capability.

title_en: Slope deformation real-time early warning algorithm and system based on deep reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of deep learning, in particular to a slope deformation real-time early warning algorithm and system based on deep reinforcement learning, wherein the method comprises the steps of generating a standardized state characterization vector and establishing a state quality evaluation index; the method comprises the steps of receiving a state characterization vector as input, constructing a dual-mode strategy architecture, generating a preliminary decision and confidence level assessment thereof to form a quantitative index of decision reliability, forming a final early warning instruction and strategy updating suggestion, generating a strategy performance assessment report, continuously tracking the change trend of state feature distribution, constructing a strategy degradation early warning system, triggering a model reconstruction mechanism, feeding back updated strategy network parameters to the dual-mode strategy architecture, and feeding back optimized feature extraction suggestion to an established state quality assessment index. The system comprises an index establishment module, a report generation module and a reconstruction mechanism module. The slope deformation real-time early warning algorithm realizes a monitoring-decision-optimizing end-to-end closed-loop control system through a deep reinforcement learning framework.
assignees: UNIV CHENGDU TECHNOLOGY;ANHUI CONSTRUCTION ENG ROAD & BRIDGE CONSTRUCTION GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Satellite communication-based offshore emergency information transmission method and system
abstract_en: The application provides a satellite communication-based offshore emergency information transmission method and system. The method comprises the steps of constructing a temporary special satellite communication link, conducting parameter optimization on the temporary special satellite communication link to obtain an optimized communication link, conducting three-dimensional reconstruction on site environment, analyzing severity description of illness state, predicting illness state development to generate illness state prediction results, conducting optimization processing on distribution strategies of special medical materials by considering factors of weather change and ocean current direction to obtain an optimal distribution path plan, conducting pattern recognition and trend prediction to generate potential risk early warning to form updated medical requirements, and reevaluating and optimizing the optimal distribution path plan to generate the updated optimal distribution path plan. The technical scheme provided by the application improves the efficiency and accuracy of the response of the offshore emergency, and ensures that medical materials can be timely and accurately delivered to the emergency site.

title_en: Server, program, monitoring assistance system, and monitoring assistance method
abstract_en: To provide a server or the like capable of ensuring safety of patrol monitors.SOLUTION: A server is a server that communicates with a sensor terminal carried by a monitor and includes a storage unit that stores the monitor's patrol route, a zone information acquisition unit that acquires information on an alert zone, an update unit that updates the patrol route so as not to include the alert zone when the information on the alert zone is acquired while the monitor patrols the patrol route, and a notifying unit that notifies the monitor of the updated patrol route.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 7

title_en: Anorectal ward monitoring system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anorectal department ward monitoring system based on the Internet of things, which relates to the technical field of intelligent monitoring and comprises an acquisition module, an analysis module, an early warning module and a query module, wherein first illness state development information is judged through emotion information of a patient, relevant information of the patient is compared with an electronic fence to obtain a first comparison result, an illness state early warning signal is sent out according to a second comparison result, an environment early warning signal is obtained according to a third comparison result, a sign early warning signal is sent out according to a third comparison result, the illness state early warning signal is updated according to a detection result, and ward information is updated in real time according to authority of a medical care account. The invention is beneficial to improving the comfort level of the patient by monitoring and early warning the emotion and disease development of the patient in real time, the system can quickly respond, effectively cope with various emergency situations, more accurately formulate personalized treatment schemes, improve the treatment success rate and the recovery speed of the patient, realize high automation and reduce the overall cost of medical service.

title_en: Landslide instability time prediction method and product based on dynamic selection of landslide early warning model
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a landslide instability time prediction method and a landslide instability time prediction product based on dynamic selection of a landslide early warning model, and relates to the technical field of landslide monitoring and early warning. In the embodiment of the invention, the uncertainty of the candidate model is quantified by adopting a Bayesian method, and the most suitable model with the largest occurrence probability is objectively selected, so that reliable destabilization time probability prediction is provided. For continuous monitoring scenarios, further incorporating sequential Bayesian updates and parallel computation into the above-described approach allows for efficient dynamic updating of destabilizing time predictions when new monitoring data is available. The prediction method for the integrated model selection provided by the invention can achieve reasonable balance between prediction uncertainty and prediction precision, and the average absolute prediction error of the most probable destabilization time of the prediction is obviously lower than that of the prediction method based on a single model. In summary, the present invention proposes a practical, probabilistic framework to predict landslide destabilization time aimed at supporting proactive landslide risk management.

title_en: Led lighting device with emergency notification and its location indication functions
title_ko: 비상상황 알림 및 발생위치 표시 기능이 포함된 led 조명기기
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an LED lighting device including an emergency situation notification and occurrence position display function. more specifically, the present invention relates to an LED lighting device which receives detection information from at least one motion detection sensor, detects motion through the received detection information, recognizes an emergency situation through the speed of change of the motion of an object according to the result of detecting the motion and the repeatability of the motion, notifies the surroundings of the occurrence of the emergency situation while variously changing the color or blink change cycle of the lighting, and displays the occurrence position of the corresponding emergency situation.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 비상상황 알림 및 발생위치 표시 기능이 포함된 LED 조명기기에 관한 것으로, 적어도 하나 이상의 움직임 감지센서로부터 감지정보를 수신하고, 상기 수신한 감지정보를 통해서 움직임을 감지하며, 상기 움직임을 감지한 결과에 따른 물체의 움직임의 변화속도와 움직임의 반복성을 통해서 비상상황을 인식하여, 조명의 색깔이나 깜박임의 변경 주기를 다양하게 바꿔가면서 비상상황의 발생을 주변으로 알리며, 해당 비상상황의 발생 위치를 표시해 주는 LED 조명기기에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Safety precaution system for highway construction
abstract_en: The invention relates to a safety early warning system for highway construction, which is applied to the technical field of safety early warning, and comprises a construction fence wall, an early warning column module, an acousto-optic early warning board, a ranging camera module, a vehicle deflection module, a deflection roller, a broken wall cylinder, a winding wheel net and a reverse hook nail, wherein the ranging camera module is used for carrying out camera shooting monitoring on abnormal vehicles which drive to the construction fence wall, and the acousto-optic early warning board is used for warning the vehicles and constructors according to the monitoring condition, the staff of being convenient for makes the correct safe action of withdrawing, before unusual vehicle is about to collide to construction fence wall simultaneously, utilize the rolling ability of deflection roller, change the direction of travel of unusual vehicle, thereby effectively avoid the direct striking construction fence wall of vehicle, and in the wheel is pinned into through the barb, thereby realize breaking of broken wall section of thick bamboo, the wheel is locked in the parcel of the winding wheel net that is pulled out, realize the braking effect to unusual vehicle, effectively reduce the destructive power of vehicle striking, realize providing the protection for the driver of vehicle.
assignees: CHINA CONSTRUCTION FIFTH ENG BUREAU SICHUAN CONSTRUCTION DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Mountain engineering slope real-time monitoring and early warning method and system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of information data processing technology, in particular to a mountain engineering slope real-time monitoring and early warning method and system based on digital twinning. The method comprises the steps of obtaining original slope real-time monitoring data, carrying out standardization processing to obtain standardized slope real-time monitoring data, constructing a digital twin model by utilizing the standardized slope real-time monitoring data to obtain a preliminary slope digital twin model, and dynamically updating the preliminary slope digital twin model by utilizing the standardized slope real-time monitoring data and slope history multi-source monitoring data to obtain a real-time updated slope digital twin model. According to the invention, by updating the digital twin model in real time and combining multi-physical field coupling analysis and nonlinear stability prediction, the dynamic monitoring, stability evaluation, risk prediction and emergency response of the slope can be ensured to reflect the actual conditions in time, so that the scientificity and timeliness of disaster prevention and control are improved.

title_en: Landslide deformation ground settlement monitoring method and system based on weak grating array monitoring
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of landslide deformation ground settlement monitoring, in particular to a landslide deformation ground settlement monitoring method based on weak grating array monitoring. According to the method, the grating is arranged in the monitoring area of the ground, the grating is illuminated to excite the reflection signals of the grating array, the data information of the ground can be rapidly obtained by periodically receiving the reflection signals, meanwhile, whether the data information meets the standard or not is determined by the average value of strain forces born by the optical fibers in the data information, the validity of the data information can be rapidly determined, and under the condition that the data information is determined to be inconsistent with the standard, the reason that the data information is inconsistent with the standard can be initially determined by utilizing the average value of the strain forces, so that the reason that the data information is inconsistent with the standard can be accurately determined, a corresponding processing mode can be generated according to the reason that the data information is inconsistent with the standard, and a corresponding adjustment notification can be sent according to the processing mode, further the accuracy of monitoring the ground subsidence can be improved, and the misjudgment rate is further reduced.

title_en: AI-based coal mine underground and roadway three-dimensional earthquake dynamic monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of dynamic monitoring, in particular to an AI-based coal mine underground and roadway three-dimensional earthquake dynamic monitoring system which comprises an underground edge computing node cluster module, a multi-source heterogeneous data fusion processing module, a three-dimensional geological dynamic modeling module, an abnormal feature evolution analysis module, a visual early warning decision module and a three-dimensional visual interface, wherein the underground edge computing node cluster module is used for laying edge computing nodes on a mining working face and a transportation roadway, the multi-source heterogeneous data fusion processing module is used for receiving an original signal data set, performing space-time alignment and feature decoupling processing to generate a standardized seismoelectric feature matrix, the three-dimensional geological dynamic modeling module is used for generating a three-dimensional geological dynamic model updated in real time through a dynamic voxel compensation algorithm based on the standardized seismoelectric feature matrix, and the abnormal feature evolution analysis module is used for receiving time sequence data of the three-dimensional geological dynamic model to construct a space-time two-dimensional abnormal degree evolution map. According to the invention, through creatively designing a six-level progressive processing architecture, the performance of the coal mine underground and roadway three-dimensional earthquake dynamic monitoring system is obviously improved.
assignees: RES INSTITUTE OF COAL GEOPHYSICAL EXPLORATION OF CHINA NATIONAL ADMINISTRATION OF COAL GEOLOGY

title_en: Trend analysis system and method based on multidimensional disaster warning data
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of disaster warning analysis, and particularly relates to a trend analysis system and method based on multidimensional disaster warning data. According to the invention, the accuracy and timeliness of disaster prediction are obviously improved through optimizing the matching rules and the threshold values in real time, the deep fusion and the efficient utilization of multi-source data are realized, scientific basis and technical support are provided for disaster early warning and emergency response, meanwhile, the system has self-adaptive learning capability, a model can be continuously optimized in continuously updated data, the dynamic accuracy of a prediction result is ensured, and the disaster prevention and reduction capability is effectively improved.

title_en: Dam safety multi-source data sensing and early warning terminal with multi-monitoring element acquisition function
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of dam safety early warning, and particularly relates to a dam safety multi-source data sensing and early warning terminal with a multi-monitoring element acquisition function. The interior of the monitoring terminal is provided with a containing cavity and a driving mechanism, so that the position of the radar water level sensor can be dynamically adjusted to update real-time water level data. When the dam is abnormal, the system automatically sends out an early warning signal and transmits an alarm to a remote monitoring center through a communication module. In addition, the structural design of the monitoring terminal adopts an elastic connecting piece and a special-shaped connecting rod, so that the stability and the anti-interference capability of the equipment are enhanced. Through first touch switch and second touch switch and alarm lamp linkage, the system can in time send out the warning at sensor adjustment in-process, improves emergency response ability. The method effectively solves the problems of low data precision, slow response, inflexible monitoring equipment and the like in the traditional dam monitoring system.

title_en: Distributed optical fiber sensing mass target data screening method based on image processing
abstract_en: A distributed optical fiber sensing mass target data screening method based on image processing is characterized in that space-time two-dimensional vibration signals are mapped into gray images, a multi-mode fusion technology is utilized, a lightweight convolutional neural network is combined to achieve efficient classification, a dynamic increment learning mechanism and a spatial propagation attenuation correction algorithm are introduced, and the problems of single characteristic representation, model update lag and insufficient positioning accuracy of a traditional method are solved. The method is suitable for the fields of perimeter security protection, pipeline monitoring, geological disaster early warning and the like, and can be used for screening and target recognition of mass vibration data under complex environment interference in real time. The invention breaks through the limitation of traditional time-frequency domain analysis through signal imaging characterization, obviously improves the distinguishing capability of similar events, simultaneously reduces the false alarm rate and the operation and maintenance cost by depending on a dynamic model optimization technology, effectively suppresses the influence of optical fiber attenuation on the positioning precision by combining a space correction algorithm, and provides reliable technical support for intelligent upgrading of a distributed optical fiber sensing system.

title_en: Geological disaster monitoring early warning threshold self-adaptive generation device and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a geological disaster monitoring early warning threshold self-adaptive generation method which comprises the following steps of collecting historical collected data X  t‑n ...X t‑1 ,X t  of observed quantity, calculating an initial early warning threshold th  0  according to extremum theorem fitting, judging that the current state is an early warning state if X  t+1  is larger than the initial early warning threshold th  0  when the latest collected data X  t+1  of the observed quantity is reported, updating the initial early warning threshold th  0  to be th  1  if X  t+1  is smaller than the initial early warning threshold th  0  but larger than a peak value pe, and not performing any special treatment if X  t+1  is smaller than the peak value pe. According to the invention, through automatic updating of the early warning threshold value, in the subsequent monitoring process of geological disasters, if the rule and mode of the observed quantity change, the early warning threshold value generated at first can be updated dynamically and adaptively, so that the effectiveness of the early warning threshold value is effectively improved.
assignees: AEROSPACE SCIENCE AND INDUSTRY INERTIAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Temporary traffic restrictions for autonomous vehicle routing
abstract_en: Vehicles detect temporary traffic restrictions and provide information describing the traffic restrictions to a remote computer system. The remote computer system can determine a routing cost for the traffic restriction and alert other vehicles in a fleet of vehicles about the traffic restrictions. The other vehicles can account for the routing cost when determining a route to follow; the route may avoid the traffic restriction. Vehicles in the fleet, when driving near a particular traffic restriction, may perceive the area where the traffic restriction was detected and provide updates about the traffic restriction, e.g., whether the boundaries of the TTR have changed (e.g., a construction area or emergency response has expanded or moved), or the TTR has been removed (e.g., a construction area has reopened, or a stopped vehicle has left the roadway).

title_en: Disaster risk assessment method, early warning equipment and system based on big data model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster risk assessment method, early warning equipment and a disaster risk assessment system based on a big data model, and relates to the technical field of disaster monitoring and early warning; the method comprises the steps of obtaining basic area parameters of a target monitoring area, determining a bearing base line of each risk factor by combining cloud historical disaster data, deploying early warning equipment according to acquisition density, dividing a coverage unit, cleaning multi-source data according to a sampling period, performing time alignment and space aggregation to form the environmental existence quantity of the coverage unit, generating a bearing interval by combining soil, vegetation, gradient and rainfall characteristics, calculating a normalized change index in a preset time window, marking a risk unit by a super threshold, and performing regional assessment and early warning according to the area ratio of the risk unit and the change quantity thereof. The invention realizes end cloud coordination and threshold rolling update, and is suitable for multi-disaster scenes such as waterlogging, landslide and the like.
assignees: SICHUAN ACADEMY OF SAFETY SCIENCE AND TECH;GUIZHOU BEIDOU SPACE INFORMATION TECH CO LTD;CHINA BROADCASTING & TELEVISION SICHUAN NETWORK CO LTD

title_en: Network version digital ocean ball public application and development integration method and system
abstract_en: The application provides a network version digital ocean ball public application and development integration method and system. The intelligent buoy provided with the laser communication device, the scanning device and the processor is used as a dynamic node to construct an self-organizing communication network to share underwater position and ocean current data. When multiple nodes detect abnormal targets at the same time, a cooperative authentication mechanism is triggered. The system drives the nodes to adjust the layout by using a dynamic sphere model, and controls at least three nodes to move towards the center of the target along a spiral path, so that a multi-layer spherical monitoring structure is formed. And finally, uploading the three-dimensional coordinate data code to a shore-based platform to generate an updated digital ocean ball map. The technical scheme provided by the application realizes the accurate positioning and three-dimensional visual monitoring of the abnormal targets of the marine environment, obviously improves the sex and space coverage precision of marine ecological monitoring, and provides three-dimensional data support for marine environment protection and disaster early warning.

title_en: Digital twinning-based large-dip-angle stope coal rock dynamic disaster monitoring and early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a digital twinning-based large-dip-angle stope coal rock dynamic disaster monitoring and early warning method and system, comprising the steps of acquiring sensor installation parameters and large-dip-angle stope geological environment information, establishing a correction model, and correcting large-dip-angle stope geological exploration data acquired by a sensor; the method comprises the steps of establishing a digital twin model of a large dip angle stope according to corrected parameters, establishing a coal-rock dynamic disaster early warning index system based on historical coal-rock disaster case data and expert experience, establishing a coal-rock dynamic disaster early warning model based on a machine learning algorithm, integrating the coal-rock dynamic disaster early warning model into the digital twin model, and carrying out real-time evaluation and early warning on the large dip angle stope dynamic disaster risk by the coal-rock dynamic disaster early warning model when the digital twin model is updated. The invention effectively reduces the occurrence risk of coal and rock dynamic disasters, ensures the life safety of stope operators and the normal operation of equipment, and improves the safety and economic benefit of coal exploitation.
assignees: UNIV XIAN SCI & TECHNOLOGY;TAIPING COAL MINE OF SICHUAN CHUANMEI HUARONG ENERGY CO LTD

title_en: Monitoring method for landslide and slump stones on side slope
abstract_en: The invention discloses a monitoring method for landslide and falling rocks of a side slope, which relates to the technical field of monitoring of the falling rocks of the side slope. According to the invention, through the multi-source sensor real-time monitoring and the signal filtering technology based on the environmental noise model, false alarm caused by natural interference and non-dangerous interference is effectively reduced, the multi-mode data fusion algorithm combines sensor data and camera images, the authenticity of risk signals is verified from multiple dimensions, and the reliability of the system is improved. By combining the dynamically updated slope collapse feature library and the intelligent algorithm, the system can accurately identify key parameters of slope instability and predict risks, flexibly respond based on a hierarchical early warning mechanism, improve disaster prevention and control capability, reduce resource waste caused by false alarm, simultaneously reduce threat of disasters to lives and properties, and provide sufficient time for managers to take measures.
assignees: CHANGRUI SHUZHI TECH SICHUAN CO LTD

title_en: Mountain torrent mud-rock flow early warning system based on multisource data comprehensive analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mountain torrent mud-rock flow early warning method and system based on multi-source data comprehensive analysis. The monitoring system carries out multi-source monitoring on rainfall, material source and mud level change characteristics of the ditch. Based on the double-threshold rainfall intensity parameters, a quantitative analysis model of channel mud position and flow is superimposed on a blockage mechanism of deformation of an object source. And determining the threshold value of each element according to the disaster history, establishing a probability formula of disaster outbreak, and screening the key factor weight through a random forest algorithm. Preprocessing of the data is performed through cross-validation and dynamic adjustment. And substituting the monitoring data into an analysis model, and comprehensively judging the early warning level of the mountain torrent mud-rock flow. And issuing an early warning signal of a corresponding grade to the object in the power-assisted region through the early warning system. After operation, the model is updated by online learning by adopting an incremental random forest method, data duplication is carried out, and model threshold correction and parameter inversion analysis are carried out. The early warning system establishes a comprehensive monitoring early warning evaluation system for quantitative analysis of the combined action of multiple indexes.

title_en: Phone Number-Based Digital Platform Integrated Management System and Method
title_ko: 전화번호 기반 사용자 인증 및 디지털 플랫폼 통합 관리 시스템
abstract_en: The digital platform integrated management system automatically detects changes in a user's phone number by linking in real-time with a telecommunications carrier's HLR (Home Location Register) or HSS (Home Subscriber Server) system, automatically synchronizes change information with multiple affiliate platforms through API and SDK-based interfaces, and includes a dual identifier structure that updates only the internal identifier (Num-ID) while maintaining the external user ID. According to the present invention, this is a technology that automatically links with various affiliate platforms upon detection of a phone number change or abnormal status to realize user information protection, ensure authentication reliability, and prevent misdelivery.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 사용자 전화번호를 기반으로 다양한 디지털 플랫폼을 통합적으로 관리하고, 사용자 상태에 따른 인증 처리 및 이상 상황 대응이 가능한 시스템에 관한 것이다. 특히, 전화번호 변경 시 이를 자동으로 감지하고, 제휴 플랫폼에 정보 변경을 실시간 동기화함으로써 사용자 정보의 최신성을 유지하고 오도착이나 인증 오류를 방지할 수 있도록 설계되었다. 
또한, 사용자의 앱 이용 로그, 메시지 응답률, 로그인 빈도 등의 데이터를 기반으로 인공지능(AI)이 행동을 예측하고, 번호 변경 또는 서비스 해지 가능성을 점수화하여 선제적으로 사용자에게 안내함으로써 불필요한 서비스 유지 비용을 줄인다. 
비정상 상태가 감지될 경우, 보호자 또는 최근 이용 제휴 플랫폼에 사전 알림을 전송하고, 다회 응답 실패 시에는 공공기관(경찰, 소방 등)에 사용자 정보, 최종 위치, 로그인 기록 등을 자동 전송하는 기능도 포함한다. 이 때 사용자의 사전 설정 및 개인정보 보호법을 기반으로 전송 정보는 필터링 처리된다. 
또한, 사용자가 사망하거나 인지 능력 저하 등으로 직접 시스템을 제어할 수 없는 경우, 사전 등록된 대리인에게 열람, 수정, 해지 등의 권한이 자동으로 이관된다. 모든 정보 변경 이력 및 인증 활동은 위변조 방지 기능이 적용된 인증서 형태로 발급된다. 
본 시스템은 제휴 플랫폼에 SDK 또는 API 형태로 제공되며, 인증 마크를 UI에 표시하거나 메시지 전송 시 오도착 방지 필터를 적용할 수 있도록 구성된다. 전체 구조는 다양한 응용 시나리오에 대응 가능하도록 설계되어 있으며, 고령화 사회의 긴급 대응, 계정 정리, 정보 갱신 등 다양한 사회적 니즈를 충족시킬 수 있다.

title_en: Patrol management equipment, method, system, server and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides inspection management equipment, an inspection management method, an inspection management system, a server and a storage medium. The device comprises a main control module, an image acquisition module, a positioning module, a data analysis monitoring server, a warning information sending module and a warning information receiving module, wherein the main control module is used for acquiring a map marked with line information to be inspected and triggering the display module to display, the image acquisition module is used for acquiring audio and video data of the line to be inspected, the positioning module is used for acquiring current position information of the inspection management device, the main control module is used for sending the audio and video data and the current position information to the data analysis monitoring server through the communication module, when the data analysis monitoring server determines that a warning event exists, the generated warning information is sent to the inspection management device, the state of a warning point on the line to be inspected is updated according to the current position information, the updated state of the warning point is sent to the inspection management device, the map marked with the line information to be inspected is correspondingly updated and displayed through the display module, and the warning light warning module is touched according to the warning information to carry out warning.

title_en: Beam column node structure with steel structure section
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a beam column node structure with a steel structure section, and relates to the field of beam column structures. Including the box section post, detection through-hole has been seted up to steel connecting plate both sides, detection through-hole department on the steel connecting plate is equipped with detection mechanism, detection mechanism is including fixing the mechanism casing in detection through-hole department, movable mounting has the spring holder in the mechanism casing, spring holder one side fixed mounting has the detection pillar, and spring holder opposite side fixed mounting has the insulating column, threaded mounting has the metal contact on the insulating column, is equipped with reset spring in the mechanism casing, mechanism casing rear end fixed mounting has two sets of wire pins, mechanism casing rear end is connected at alarm mechanism. According to the beam column node structure with the steel structure section, the detection mechanism can detect whether the fixed plugboard is deformed, and once the fixed plugboard is deformed, the buzzer and the explosion flash warning lamp on the warning mechanism send warning signals to remind on-site personnel to withdraw.
assignees: ZHEJIANG PROVINCE SANJIAN CONSTRUCTION GROUP CO LTD

title_en: System and method for rapidly preparing geological disaster weather risk early warning multi-level early warning map
abstract_en: The invention relates to a rapid preparation system and a rapid preparation method of a geological disaster weather risk early warning multi-level early warning map, which comprise a space vector data acquisition module, an early warning map generation module and a man-machine interaction module, wherein the space vector data acquisition module is used for acquiring space vector data of an early warning unit and space vector data of the management unit, the early warning unit comprises a slope unit and a micro-basin unit, the management unit comprises a small basin unit, a village unit and a village street unit, the early warning data acquisition module is used for acquiring early warning data of the early warning unit, the table mapping module is used for constructing a mapping relation table between each management unit and each early warning unit and a mapping relation table between the management units according to the space vector data of the early warning unit and the space vector data of the management unit, the early warning map generation module is used for generating an early warning map of each management unit according to the mapping relation table between each management unit and each early warning unit and the early warning data of the early warning unit, the man-machine interaction module is used for acquiring modification information of early warning of an external user, and the early warning map modification module is used for responding to the modification information of the early warning of the user, and the early warning map of the management unit is updated. The method can realize the modification of different-level early warning diagrams, comprehensively support the early warning treatment work of the geological disaster weather risk, and promote the standardized and procedural management of geological disaster prevention and control.
assignees: CHONGQING GEOMATICS AND REMOTE SENSING CENTER CHONGQING SURVEYING AND MAPPING PRODUCT QUALITY INSPEC;CHONGQING GEOLOGICAL ENV MONITORING STATION

title_en: Landslide deformation stage self-adaptive judging method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-adaptive judging method and a self-adaptive judging system for a landslide deformation stage, which take a global average displacement rate as a sample, calculate a landslide deformation displacement rate threshold sequence by using a mean value and a standard deviation from the perspective of statistics, dynamically update thresholds in the sequence along with the increase of monitoring data, and indicate that the current landslide displacement rate is obviously larger than the global average displacement rate when the displacement rate exceeds a corresponding threshold value, and perform self-adaptive landslide deformation grading early warning by combining an improved tangential angle. The method takes the global average displacement rate and the standard deviation as statistical references, so that threshold setting has statistical basis and can reflect geological condition differences of individual landslide features, and meanwhile, the improved tangent angle is calculated through dynamic mixing processing of displacement data fitting and original data, so that landslide stages are identified, and the robustness and instantaneity of discrimination results are improved.
assignees: SHAOXING KEZHU EXPRESSWAY CO LTD;ZHEJIANG SHUZHI JIAOYUAN TECH CO LTD;UNIV CHENGDU TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Factory personnel gathers alarm system
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of factory safety production, in particular to a factory personnel gathering alarm system which comprises a personnel positioning module, a dynamic area dividing module, a gathering judging module and an alarm processing module. The system divides the virtual grid area by collecting positioning data in real time, judges personnel gathering events by combining preset parameterization indexes, and generates an emergency response path or a daily monitoring path. The data center records environment information and updates a database, and the risk assessment model is utilized to predict the potential safety hazard development condition so as to generate a scheduling strategy. According to the application, the fine warning is realized by quantifying the aggregation index, the accuracy and timeliness of potential safety hazard warning in a complex production environment are improved, and the safety production requirement of a factory is met.
assignees: HANGZHOU XINKE INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Dangerous chemical safety production risk monitoring and dynamic early warning system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dangerous chemical safety production risk monitoring and dynamic early warning system, which particularly relates to the technical field of industrial safety monitoring, and is used for solving the monitoring failure problem caused by signal interference or cancellation in a mixed leakage scene of various dangerous chemicals in the prior art, acquiring multisource monitoring data such as gas concentration and temperature in real time through a data acquisition module, detecting reverse fluctuation characteristics of sensor data by a conflict recognition module, reversely positioning a leakage source and verifying path shielding interference by a leakage verification module based on production pipe network topology and real-time flow data, analyzing signal cancellation characteristics of a dangerous chemical combination and verifying matching performance of a diffusion path and sensor layout by a materialization analysis module after physical shielding is eliminated, dynamically correcting the monitoring data by a dynamic compensation module according to a materialization reaction mechanism, generating a mixed leakage risk level and triggering a grading emergency response instruction by a risk assessment module, and realizing accurate recognition and dynamic early warning of the mixed leakage risk.

title_en: Method and device for maintaining high-altitude network service
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of high-altitude network communication, and discloses a high-altitude network service maintaining method, which specifically comprises the following steps: step one, networking and chain construction, step two, disaster recovery module pretreatment, step three, return core network pretreatment, step four, service maintaining specific process. The invention solves the problems that the existing high-altitude base station can not keep the terminal network connection and the service continuously when the return link is interrupted by various technical schemes such as networking and link establishment, disaster recovery and return core network preprocessing, service maintenance process and the like, improves the fault tolerance and the service continuity by monitoring the link state, interacting information, broadcasting and updating the link information, signaling forwarding and other measures, ensures the continuous availability of the terminal service when the link is interrupted through flashing and link breaking processing, and avoids the conditions of service cell service withdrawal and inaccessible users.
assignees: CHENGDU TONGSUAN YITI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire detector equipped with AI-based video module and broadcasting equipment
title_ko: 인공지능(ai)을 갖춘 영상 모듈과 방송장비가 구비된 화재감지기
abstract_en: The present invention is to provide a fire detector having an image module with artificial intelligence (ai) and broadcasting equipment, which can be expected to improve safety as well as economic feasibility and efficiency by remotely controlling several buildings at the same time, and serves as a security room for protecting factories on weekends. A fire detector equipped with an image module with artificial intelligence (ai) and broadcasting equipment comprises: a fire detector (100); and a relay (300). The fire detector (100) is equipped with a camera (10) for checking the speed of a disaster and a speaker (20). The relay (300) is equipped with an image module with artificial intelligence (ai) and broadcasting equipment, wherein a smoke detection sensor (21) and a smoke induction device fan (22) are further installed in the fire detector (100).
abstract_ko:
본발명은 인공지능(AI)을 갖춘 영상 모듈과 방송장비가 구비된 화재감지기에 관한 것으로, 재난신속확인용 카메라(10)와 스피커(20)가 구비된 소방용 감지기(100); 
화재수신기(200)와 원격접속하여 화재발생시 화재발생사실을 알리며, 얼람신호기에 화재신호를 전송하여 얼람이 작동하게 하는 중계기(300);로 
구성되는 것으로, 
본발명은 여러 건물을 동시에 원격 관제하여 경제성과 효율성 뿐 아니라 안전성 향상을 기대할 수 있으며 주말에 가동하지 않는 공장을 지키는 경비실 역할을 하며,  
 야간 근무자가 없는 학교등 공공기관 같이 스마트폰으로 설비의 상태를 실시간 모니터링하고 설비 이상이 감지되면 현장에 기 설치된 영상을 연동하여 안전을 미리 확보할 수 있으며, 야간 당직자가 없어도 지정된 관리자가 언제 어디서나 스마트폰 하나로 건물내 감지된 현장 확인이 가능하며, 
혹시 모를 상황에 잠시도 자리를 비울 수 없는 방재실, 감지기에 신호가 감지될 시 해당 위치를 영상을 통해 확인하고 바로 현장으로 이동 가능하고 필요시 방송을 하여 피해가  
발생하지 않도록 우선 조치가 가능하여 근무자가 효율적인 업무를 지원하는 잦은 감지시 오작동으로 민원이 쏟아지는 빌딩 관리실 같이 관리자가 소수인원이어도 경보로 인하여 달려갈 필요없이 감지된 현장을 영상을 우선 확인하여 신속 조치가 가능하며 소방 감지기 오작동시 원격으로 복구가 가능하고 불필요한 출동 및 민원으로 인한 스트레스를 줄일수 있으며, 감지를 통한 오작동과 주변환경을 신속하게 영상으로 확인하고 안내방송이 가능하며 1개이상의 광각렌즈와 다수의 카메라를 이용하여 어라운드 뷰 화면을 제공하여 전방위의 환경을 쉽고 빠르게 이해하고 모니터링을 통해 주변환경을 정확하게 파악하여 문제해결 방향을 빠르게 판단하여 재난 및 사고로 부터 신속하게 대응 조치하는 현저한 효과가 있다.

title_en: Devices, systems, and methods for hazard avoidance
abstract_en: In one aspect, an example method includes: (a) receiving geographic region data associated with a location of a wearable device; (b) collecting environmental data within the geographic region of the wearable device; (c) identifying one or more hazardous conditions within the geographic region; (d) determining an updated location of the wearable device within the geographic region; (e) determining an alert condition, wherein the alert condition comprises determining that the wearable device is within a threshold proximity to at least one area associated with a hazardous condition; and (f) selecting a computational action for alerting a user associated with the wearable device that the wearable device is within the threshold proximity to the at least one area associated with the hazardous condition.

title_en: Real-time monitoring system for deformation of coal mining and use method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a real-time monitoring system for coal mining deformation, which comprises a physical layer, a transmission layer, a processing layer and an application layer, wherein the using method of the system comprises the steps of laying a main optical fiber and a branch optical fiber, connecting a data processing unit with an optical fiber sensing head, collecting strain data, denoising, normalizing and constructing a sequence on the data, predicting the strain time sequence data of the optical fiber, carrying out discriminant analysis and hierarchical early warning on predicted value and actual value residual errors, triggering a three-dimensional visualization platform to update abnormal labels, inquiring historical deformation records, and practicing an emergency response plan. The system has the characteristics of strong continuous monitoring capability, strong real-time performance, high deployment flexibility and good visualization effect, and the safety and the production efficiency of the coal mine are obviously improved.
assignees: CHINA COAL XIAN DESIGN ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Mining earthquake early warning method, device and system based on microseism monitoring
abstract_en: The invention relates to a mine earthquake early warning method based on microseism monitoring, which comprises the steps of converting a current time monitoring signal into a frequency domain by adopting Fourier transformation to obtain current time frequency point data, judging whether the current time monitoring frequency point data is normal or not according to whether the energy value of the current time frequency point data and the stored change amplitude value of the energy value of the background field frequency point data of the current time exceed a set threshold value, judging whether a microseism event occurs or not according to the change amplitude value, and determining the position of the microseism event. According to the mining earthquake early warning method, the background field frequency point data are updated in real time, other gentle background field changes except sudden microseism time can be ignored in monitoring, and the small changes are added into the background field in time, so that the effect of continuously suppressing noise is achieved, and early warning judgment is more accurate.
assignees: FANKOU LEAD ZINC MINE SHENZHEN ZHONGJIN LINGNAN NONFEMET CO LTD;BEIJING PETROSOUND GEOSERVICES CORP

title_en: Ocean disaster risk prevention and control early warning system and method based on big data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a marine disaster risk prevention and control early warning system and method based on big data, and belongs to the technical field of marine disaster monitoring and early warning. A marine disaster risk prevention and control early warning system and method based on big data comprises a multi-source data fusion module, an intelligent modeling module and a real-time early warning module, wherein the method comprises the steps of cleaning and storing multi-source data after wavelet transformation downsampling through edge computing nodes, extracting space-time characteristics through a space-time transducer network, calibrating predicted values through a Coriolis force correction equation to generate future 24-hour disaster risk probability and tide level and wind speed key parameters, triggering hierarchical early warning based on a dynamic risk map, and pushing through a mobile network, emergency broadcasting and other multi-channel seconds. The method reduces the tide level prediction error to less than or equal to 0.2 meter, and effectively solves the problems of high false alarm rate and update hysteresis of the traditional system due to early warning response delay of <10 seconds.

title_en: Flood early warning simulation method based on dynamic self-adaptive differential algorithm
abstract_en: The invention relates to a flood early warning simulation method based on a dynamic self-adaptive differential algorithm, which comprises the steps of simulating a flood process based on a flood inundation model in a target time step, obtaining real-time water flow data and terrain elevation model data of a target area, determining a spreading state coefficient of the flood according to the flow rate of the flood and the interval distance between the target area and a block dike opening, clustering the terrain elevation model data to obtain a first clustering result, determining a stagnation area in a preset area according to the first clustering result, updating the target time step according to the area and the spreading state coefficient of the stagnation area to obtain an updated target time step, simulating the flood process by taking the updated target time step as the target time step of the next moment, and determining to send out early warning in response to the fact that the simulation result of the flood process reaches preset early warning conditions. The invention updates the time step of the model and solves the problem of unbalanced simulation precision and efficiency.

title_en: Goods expiration early warning method and system based on supply chain management system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for early warning of a commodity in a temporary period based on a supply chain management system, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a multidimensional dynamic feature vector by acquiring key features of the commodity in the supply chain system, carrying out standardized processing on the multidimensional dynamic feature vector, and then encoding the multidimensional dynamic feature vector into qubits; the method comprises the steps of constructing an energy function by utilizing a quantum-element model, solving and screening a candidate solution set through a quantum annealing algorithm to generate an early warning threshold value of the temporary period of goods, applying the threshold value to a lightweight neural network model, realizing model switching through loss function comparison, reducing calculation cost, avoiding dimension disasters through feature dimension reduction and selection, reducing model training complexity, improving real-time response capability, and meanwhile, dynamically optimizing model parameters to enhance generalization performance, adapting to market environment changes, thereby reducing the temporary period risk of goods, reducing inventory loss and improving economic benefit and market competitiveness of enterprises.
assignees: NANJING MUSHU HEALTH TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent construction management platform for city update
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent construction management platform oriented to city updating, which relates to the technical field of mineral screening and comprises the following steps of establishing a unified data standard and a data interface protocol, and ensuring that data of different systems, departments and enterprises in the platform can be subjected to seamless butt joint. The invention realizes the data sharing of different systems by unifying the data standard and the interface protocol, and improves the project management efficiency and the decision accuracy. The real-time data acquisition and intelligent analysis technology enhances the safety monitoring and intelligent early warning functions, and ensures that potential safety hazards in the construction process are recognized and processed in time. Meanwhile, the flexibility and emergency response capability of the project are improved by the dynamic adjustment and intelligent early warning mechanism, resources and construction plans can be automatically adjusted in project progress, sudden problems are guaranteed to be solved, progress delay and resource waste are reduced, and smooth project progress is guaranteed.

title_en: SAM-based remote sensing image pit water surface extraction method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote sensing image pit water surface extraction method and device based on SAM, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a proper SAM model version, configuring an operation environment, then carrying out pit target detection on a remote sensing image pit based on a YOLOv model after training, generating a target detection frame, and inputting the generated target detection frame as a boundary frame prompt (box prompt) and a remote sensing image into the SAM model together to obtain a remote sensing image pit segmentation result. The method can not only improve the precision and efficiency of pit extraction, but also adapt to the pit extraction requirements of different scales and complexity, provides powerful support for the fields of water resource management, environment monitoring, disaster early warning and the like, has higher accuracy in pit detection, has good robustness and high running speed, is light in weight and easy to deploy, and provides an innovative application for the field of pit water surface extraction.

title_en: Steel production risk dynamic early warning method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application provides a method, a device, equipment and a medium for dynamically pre-warning the risk of steel production, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining original data in the steel production process, carrying out fluctuation analysis and stability analysis on the original data, carrying out pairwise comparison on each dimension index based on the analyzed data to generate a weight matrix, calculating a comprehensive weight coefficient, inputting the comprehensive weight coefficient into a preset mixed model, calculating a comprehensive safety risk value of a region to be detected by combining a predefined membership function, triggering a pre-warning signal according to the comparison result of the risk value and a preset threshold value, executing an emergency response strategy, adjusting model parameters based on a verification data set after executing the response strategy, and realizing full life cycle management through time sequence version comparison.
assignees: CISDI INFORMATION TECH CHONGQING CO LTD

title_en: Rainfall-induced landslide prediction and early warning method and system
abstract_en: In order to improve the spatial and time resolution of rainfall type landslide prediction and early warning, the invention discloses a rainfall induced landslide prediction and early warning method and system, which adopts the fact that a side slope is stable through multiple rainfall fields, and converts historical rainfall into a large number of rainfall paths, thereby establishing a critical rainfall intensity-duration curve as a rainfall threshold of a side slope unit, and realizing single-side slope unit scale landslide prediction and early warning. The method is convenient to implement, does not need to measure any soil parameters or establish a slope stability analysis calculation model, avoids high cost of rock and soil investigation and errors existing in slope analysis, and can dynamically update the rainfall threshold established by the method along with actual observation, thereby improving landslide prediction early warning precision.

title_en: Firefighting signage for quick evacuation
title_ko: 신속한 안전대피를 위한 소방용 표시기구
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire hydrant box (10), a hose reel (20), an angle valve (30), a fire hose (40), an external guide roller (50), an internal guide roller (60), a latch (70), a transmitter push switch (80), a control unit (90), a solenoid (100), a speaker (110), a warning light unit (120), and a display (130). According to the present invention, in the event of a fire, the fire hose (40) can be withdrawn without opening a housing door (12) as a coffin window (41) is exposed to the outside through a coffin window withdrawal door (14) in the event of the fire, so that the fire hose (40) can be quickly moved to a fire area and extinguish the fire, rapid and safe evacuation can be induced according to the indication of the evacuation direction, and the fire hose (40) can be prevented from being damaged in the withdrawal process by minimizing the locking of the fire hose (40) when the fire hose (40) is withdrawn.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 소화전함(10)과 호스릴(20), 앵글밸브(30), 소방호스(40), 외부안내롤러(50), 내부안내롤러(60), 걸쇠(70), 발신기 누름스위치(80), 제어부(90), 솔레노이드(100), 스피커(110), 경광부(120) 및 디스플레이(130)로 구성된 에 관한 것으로, 이에 의하면 화재발생시 관창인출도어(14)를 통해 관창(41)이 외부로 노출됨에 따라 함체도어(12)를 열지 않고도 소방호스(40)를 인출할 수 있어 화재지역까지 신속하게 이동 및 화재를 진압할 수 있고, 대피방향의 표시에 따른 신속하고 안전한 대피를 유도할 수 있으며, 소방호스(40)의 인출시 소방호스(40)의 걸림이 최소화되도록 하여 인출과정에서 소방호스(40)가 손상되는 것을 방지할 수 있다.

title_en: On-Device AI-based Smart Safety Management and Prediction Conservation System
title_ko: 온디바이스 ai 기반의 스마트 안전관리 및 예지보전 시스템
abstract_en: Provided is the smart safety management and the predictive maintenance system of the on-device ai base including the sensor wire/wireless communications drive integrated sensor incorporating the on-device ai function which at the same time, can process result with data acquisition by integrating sensor and sensor wire/wireless communications drive and integrating. According to the present invention, the efficiency and effectiveness of self-inspection of elevator maintenance can be greatly improved by applying an interactive technology between a smart device sensing module installed for each elevator inspection position and a smart terminal of a safety inspector.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 온디바이스(On-device) AI 기반의 스마트 안전관리 및 예지보전 시스템에 관한 것으로, 시설물(스마트 승강기, 에스컬레이터, 스마트팜, 스마트팩토리, 스마트물류 등)에 센서를 설치하여 소음, 진동, 충격을 감지하고 이상 소음 진동 충격이 발생하면 스마트 센서 드라이브 모듈에 이벤트 발생 정보를 저장하며, 설정 기준값 이상의 충격값이 입력되면 승강기 안내 장치와 승강기 경고 장치의 음성과 경고음을 통해 안전사고를 예방 및 방지할 수 있고, 산업기반 시설물의 사회적 재난과 자연재해를 미연에 예방하고 방지할 수 있다. 본 발명에 의한 온디바이스(On-device) AI 기반의 스마트 안전관리 및 예지보전 시스템은, 센서와 센서 유무선 통신 드라이브를 통합하여 일체화함으로써 데이터 수집과 동시에 결과를 처리할 수 있는 온 디바이스 AI 기능을 내장한 센서 유무선통신 드라이브 일체형 센서를 포함하는 온디바이스 AI 기반의 스마트 안전관리 및 예지보전 시스템에 있어서, 상기 센서에 구비된 마이크로폰과 MEMS 기반 3축 가속도센서를 통해 측정 대상물의 소음 진동 충격원이 입력되고, 상기 센서에 구비된 외부 인터페이스의 런닝 버튼이 인터럽트되면 상기 센서의 AI가 동작하여 ANN 알고리즘의 머신 러닝을 통해 측정 대상물에 대한 소음 진동 충격원의 데이터를 연산 및 저장하고, 상기 ANN 알고리즘으로 머신 러닝을 통해서 측정 대상물에 대한 소음 진동 충격 상태를 스캔하고 데이터 필터링 및 레이블링하고, 상기 측정 대상물에 대한 정상 상태의 소음 진동 충격의 기준 데이터와 변화된 데이터를 머신 러닝을 통해 연산하여 이상 소음 진동 충격에 대한 정상과 비정상적인 조건을 구분하고 정상과 비정상 결과를 도출하여 사고를 예측하며, 상기 정상과 비정상의 결과 데이터를 상기 센서에 구비된 무선랜, 블루투스, USB 중 어느 하나를 통해서 에지 게이트웨이로 전송하며, 상기 에지 게이트웨이와 양방향 통신이 가능한 스마트 센서 드라이브 모듈; 상기 스마트 센서 드라이브 모듈로부터 측정 대상물의 정상과 비정상의 결과 데이터를 표준화된 이더넷 또는 무선랜을 통해 수신받아 중복데이터와 이상 잡음데이터를 필터링하는 데이터 전처리 및 후처리 과정을 수행하며, 상기 데이터 전처리 및 후처리 과정을 온디바이스 AI 프로세서에서 머신러닝으로 학습함으로써 통신데이터의 변경, 통신트래픽, 통신 장애, 경로 설정을 포함한 복수 에러 유형과 이상(Anomaly) 발생을 분석 및 도출하여 변화된 코드와 데이터를 자동으로 수정하며, 상기 데이터 전처리 및 후처리된 데이터를 라우팅 기능을 통해 표준화된 Modebus RTU 또는 Modebus TCP를 통해 원격 중앙관제센터 서버로 전송하고, 비정상의 결과 데이터가 수신되면 그 측정값에 따라 안내방송 장치와 경고 사이렌 장치를 선별적으로 제어하고, 상기 스마트 센서 드라이브 모듈 및 상기 원격 중앙관제센터 서버와 양방향 통신이 가능하며, RDBMS와 데이터베이스(DB)를 구비한 에지 게이트웨이; 및 상기 에지 게이트웨이로부터 수신받은 측정 대상물의 데이터와 상기 스마트 센서 드라이브 모듈의 이상 유무 상태를 원격 모니터링 플랫폼 앱을 통해 컬러로 시각화하여 표시하고, 상기 스마트 센서 드라이브 모듈의 데이터를 실시간으로 모니터링 및 확인하고 데이터를 설정하며, 상기 원격 모니터링 플랫폼 앱에서 상기 측정 대상물의 데이터와 과거 데이터의 비교 분석을 통해 예지보전 및 유지보수를 판단하는 원격 중앙관제센터 서버;를 포함한다.

title_en: Automated in-patient medical emergency management system
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a patient monitoring system (102) for monitoring health of hospitalized non-ICU patients. This system (102) includes a set of monitoring devices (104) for displaying a comprehensive set of vital parameters related to patients. Additionally, a set of cameras (106) is integrated into the system, continuously capturing images of each monitoring device (104). The system is powered by processors (202) that execute instructions for image analysis using an AI engine. Through seamless communication with computing devices, the processors (202) facilitate swift transmission of alert signals to healthcare professionals, offering real-time updates upon detection of critical patient conditions. These alert signals include essential information about the identified vital parameter, enabling healthcare professionals to promptly intervene and address the needs of hospitalized non-ICU patients.

title_en: Mining area catastrophe early warning method, device and equipment based on rock mass multidimensional quantitative characterization model
abstract_en: The application provides a mining area catastrophe early warning method, device and equipment based on a rock mass multidimensional quantitative characterization model, which inputs collected multi-field data of a stress field, a rock mass damage field and a permeation field into a multi-field co-evolution model to obtain corresponding multi-field evolution coefficients, and updates the output of the catastrophe early warning model by the evolution coefficients, so that a stress-rock mass damage-permeation co-evolution mechanism is constructed, the prediction precision of disasters such as rock burst, water burst mud burst and the like is ensured, and the advanced early warning and active control of catastrophe are realized.

title_en: Electrical fire early warning system based on multi-sensor fusion
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of multi-sensor fusion electric fire, and provides a multi-sensor fusion-based electric fire early warning system, which comprises the steps of deploying a sensor integration module to synchronously sample indexes of a plurality of electric appliance environments in the power utilization environment of an old community, embedding low-power consumption chip period acquisition information and data preprocessing in a sensor, deploying a lightweight early warning core module at an edge gateway to perform data collaborative analysis on a plurality of sensor channels, constructing standard score judgment abnormal event grades, and (3) carrying out notification reminding on the user by adopting an intelligent face brushing entrance guard and intelligent door lock sensing linkage mechanism according to the abnormal event level and pushing information of the property, setting tolerance of light abnormal co-occurrence of the user, carrying out label on feedback of the property and the user, carrying out expert classification and label reliability assignment, finishing preliminary training by using a decision tree, carrying out model training and iteration by using a semi-supervised learning strategy, issuing an updated data packet, and adopting an A/B test to select a stable model.

title_en: Multi-mode public opinion risk early warning system and method based on dynamic knowledge graph and federal reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-mode public opinion risk early warning system and method based on dynamic knowledge graph and federal reinforcement learning, and belongs to the technical field of public opinion analysis. The system comprises a data acquisition module, a mode fusion module, a knowledge graph construction module, a comparison learning module, a federal reinforcement learning modeling module and a response output module. The system realizes multi-mode semantic alignment of texts, images, videos and the like based on multi-source heterogeneous data, digs entity relations and propagation paths through dynamically updated knowledge maps, and fuses federal reinforcement learning to realize collaborative modeling under privacy protection among terminals, so that real-time perception of public opinion risks, grade early warning and multi-level response strategy recommendation are realized. Based on the system, the method has the advantages of high fusion precision, high response speed and strong visual propagation path, and is widely applicable to the fields of enterprise crisis management, government affair public opinion monitoring and public safety.

title_en: Article shelf life reminding device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of article management, in particular to an article shelf life reminding device. The device comprises an input module, an information acquisition module, a control processing module, a reminding module, a data input management module and a follow-up processing module. The device comprises an input module, an information acquisition module, a control processing module, a reminding module, a terminal screen display, a voice broadcast, a mobile application push or cloud applet and the like, wherein the input module is used for receiving basic information of an article to be monitored, supporting bar code scanning, voice input, image recognition and manual input modes, the information acquisition module is used for acquiring production date and validity period information related to the article, the control processing module is used for generating a validity period management plan according to the article information and triggering a reminding signal in combination with the rest of the validity period, the reminding module can carry out reminding in modes of terminal screen display, voice broadcast, mobile application push or cloud applet and the like, and the device is suitable for scenes such as families, super-business and warehouse and can realize intelligent management and timely reminding of the quality guarantee period of the article.

title_en: Power distribution network outage probability analysis and resource scheduling optimization method based on knowledge graph
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of smart power grids, and provides a power outage probability analysis and resource scheduling optimization method for a power distribution network based on a knowledge graph. The topology/environment dual-attention architecture is adopted to fuse multi-source features, so that the fusion efficiency of the equipment node features and the environment node features is improved, a fault deduction model with dynamic weight constraint is introduced, and the secondary fault early warning capability is enhanced. And in the resource scheduling link, integrating a mixed integer programming model of carbon-shift factors and island power balance constraint, and realizing pareto optimization of rush repair efficiency and environmental protection targets. And realizing the trans-regional adaptation of the knowledge graph through transfer learning, and controlling the reduction of the access error of the novel station area in the reconstruction scene of the distribution network. The method supports minute-level topology reconstruction and second-level weight update, has low delay and high expansion capacity, and is suitable for provincial power grid real-time deployment.
assignees: HONGHE POWER SUPPLY BUREAU YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Wireless Communication System and Method for Vehicles
abstract_en: This invention introduces a decentralized two-way communication system (DCS) for vehicles, operated by civilians and authorities, that complements existing Emergency Alert Systems (EAS) systems managed by governmental authorities, and the vehicle Vehicle-to-Everything (V2X) communications. The system allows vehicle drivers and occupants, pedestrians, authorities and other road users to transmit and receive messages and emergency alerts in between them, as well as to and from infrastructure. The DCS is linked to existing Vehicle Management Systems (VMS), and software applications for mobile devices. The DCS leverage the vehicle Vehicle-to-Everything (V2X) communication systems, and can be used in different communication embodiments such as: Vehicle-to-Vehicle (V2V); Vehicle-to-Infrastructure (V2I); Vehicle-to-Pedestrian (V2P); Vehicle-to-Cloud (V2C); and Vehicle-to-Network (V2N). An object of the DCS is to improve road safety, road awareness, sharing road conditions, weather updates, road hazard updates, emergency alert systems (EAS) and save lives.

title_en: Landslide disaster monitoring and early warning method for frozen soil area of Qinghai-Tibet plateau
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide disaster monitoring and early warning method for a Qinghai-Tibet plateau frozen soil area, which relates to the technical field of disaster monitoring and early warning methods and comprises the following steps of S1, multi-source data acquisition, acquisition of regional topography and vegetation coverage data by adopting a satellite remote sensing technology, collection of frozen soil temperature, humidity, displacement, underground water level and meteorological data by utilizing a ground sensor network, S2, data preprocessing, S3, feature extraction, S4, risk assessment, S5, early warning release, S6, dynamic update, and realization of accurate monitoring and timely early warning of landslide disasters in the Qinghai-Tibet plateau frozen soil area by adopting multi-source data acquisition, data preprocessing, feature extraction, risk assessment, early warning release and dynamic update, and reduction of loss caused by landslide disasters.
assignees: QINGHAI METEOROLOGICAL DISASTER PREVENTION TECH CENTER

title_en: Call response system based on public security field
abstract_en: The invention provides a call response system based on the public safety field, which relates to the technical field of public safety and comprises a monitoring module and a data acquisition module, wherein the monitoring module is used for collecting data collected by the monitoring module, the data analysis and processing module is used for analyzing and processing the primarily processed data, the AI intelligent emergency response module is used for automatically issuing accurate and clear information to the public through a preset trained AI model and a real-time updated machine learning algorithm, the early warning and alarm module is used for manually issuing an alarm through various communication channels, and the central control module is used for establishing a control center, the communication module and the management module.
assignees: HUAKE GUOXIN INT CULTURE BEIJING CO LTD

title_en: Double-layer cascading dynamic constraint optimization agricultural disaster prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a double-layer cascading dynamic constraint optimization agricultural disaster prediction method and a double-layer cascading dynamic constraint optimization agricultural disaster prediction system, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring and grading satellite remote sensing data and external reference data, and constructing a prediction center and an influence area data set; the method comprises the steps of utilizing a central data set to establish an early warning model to predict agricultural disasters and trigger alarms, combining the two data sets to establish a space-time diffusion model to predict development trend and make strategies, setting a dynamic optimization model and evaluating the dynamic optimization model, and dynamically adjusting sampling strategies. The invention adopts a double-layer cascade prediction model and a dynamic constraint optimization strategy to realize the balance of agricultural disaster prediction precision and efficiency, rapidly positions disaster hotspots and predicts global trend through the cooperative prediction of a hierarchical positioning early warning and a space-time diffusion model, reduces the dependence on full-dimension data, adopts a self-adaptive sampling strategy to reduce redundant calculation, keeps dynamic update in the high-incidence period of the disaster, and provides clear guidance for decision makers through the hierarchical early warning and prevention and control strategy and the interpretable output.

title_en: 30-60-Minute emergency evacuation scheme for influencing fire potential based on weather change
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of safety early warning, and discloses a 30-60-minute emergency evacuation scheme for influencing fire potential based on weather change, wherein early warning trigger logic is constructed based on weather mutation, a response level is dynamically regulated and controlled, and minute-level evacuation strategy linkage update is realized. According to the emergency evacuation scheme, by constructing the high-sensitivity index library of wind speed jump, humidity dip, lightning strike ignition and the like and combining microscale weather evolution trend and on-site situation data, the emergency evacuation scheme can quickly enter a forced response state 30-60 minutes before the wild fire is rapidly expanded, and the effectiveness and timeliness of evacuation decisions are obviously improved.

title_en: Risk management and control method, system and equipment based on hydraulic engineering project
abstract_en: The invention discloses a risk management and control method, a system and equipment based on hydraulic engineering projects, which relate to the technical field of risk management and control and calculate sensor data drift abnormality indexes by acquiring multisource monitoring data of a target hydraulic engineering project after an earthquake, and calculating an engineering structure change abnormality index based on a preset structure health model and a seismometer parameter, calculating an earthquake propagation influence index by combining a seismic source distance, further calculating an earthquake influence coefficient by combining the three, and judging whether the original risk early warning evaluation system needs to be updated according to the earthquake influence coefficient. The method can judge whether the risk early warning evaluation system needs to be updated according to the actual disaster degree after encountering a natural disaster event (such as a slight earthquake), ensure that early warning is not delayed or invalid, reduce the possibility of causing larger potential safety hazards, and judge whether the risk early warning evaluation system is updated or not reasonably according to the influence of the actual earthquake on the construction of hydraulic engineering projects, thereby reducing unnecessary waste of computing resources.
assignees: DONGHUA SOFTWARE INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Single-hole coal rock stress state acquisition method for drill-in sensing-drill-out correction
abstract_en: The invention relates to a single-hole coal rock stress state acquisition method for drill-in sensing-drill-out correction, and belongs to the technical field of mine dynamic disaster monitoring and early warning. The method comprises the steps of firstly obtaining wave speed and acoustic emission dynamic characteristics of coal and rock, determining a perception index threshold value, secondly selecting drilling engineering, installing a wave field acquisition tool, thirdly setting acquisition parameters, acquiring and transmitting wave field signals in real time, fourthly performing data noise reduction processing to obtain characteristic parameter values, fifthly selecting the index threshold value, dynamically perceiving an initial stress state of the coal and rock, sixthly, performing drilling-returning peeping scanning, correcting the stress state of the coal and rock in real time, and seventhly, performing inversion imaging to obtain a hole circumferential stress field. According to the invention, dynamic perception of the Kong Zhoumei rock initial stress state in the drilling process is realized, the hole circumference stress correction degree is provided, and the Kong Zhoumei rock initial stress state is objectively corrected in the drilling withdrawal process, so that a real basis is provided for comprehensively acquiring the underground coal rock stratum stress state.

title_en: Steel logistics whole-flow real-time dynamic management method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a device for dynamically managing a steel logistics whole process in real time, belonging to the technical field of steel logistics control methods and devices. The technical scheme includes data acquisition and monitoring, tracking of states of transportation vehicles and goods, demand prediction and stock dynamic adjustment, high-frequency goods allocation according to shipment frequency to respond to emergency orders, visual management of a supply chain, establishment of shared data of all links of the supply chain, construction of a 3D logistics map, real-time display of stock, transportation states and bottleneck nodes, risk control management and rapid starting of alternative schemes when early warning is triggered. The method has the beneficial effects of optimizing efficiency, reducing the limitation of the traditional single transportation mode, realizing the rolling update and emergency response of demand prediction, improving the data transparency and the trust degree, realizing the risk quick response, and having the advantage of realizing the whole life cycle management of logistics.
assignees: HANDAN IRON & STEEL GROUP CO LTD;HANGANG NENGJIA IRON AND STEEL CO LTD

title_en: Karst development area geological disaster identification method and system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a karst development area geological disaster identification method and system based on artificial intelligence, relates to the field of geological disaster early warning and risk assessment, and solves the technical problems that geology and related data are difficult to integrate, model prediction disaster types are difficult to construct based on historical disaster cases and real-time monitoring data, and a prediction result is lack of correlation with a geographic space so as to generate a risk distribution map and dynamically update a high risk area; the method comprises the following steps: introducing multi-source heterogeneous data and combining historical geological disaster cases; preprocessing data; extracting the characteristics of the change rate of the underground water level, the soil humidity and the vibration frequency; combining a plurality of features into a feature matrix, and projecting the feature matrix into a principal component space; after training a model by using a random forest algorithm, optimizing and constructing the model by combining cross verification and a Bayesian algorithm; converting the model prediction result into a risk grade value through a mapping rule; and generating a risk level distribution map based on the GIS data.
assignees: GUIZHOU BUREAU OF GEOLOGY AND MINERAL EXPLOR AND DEVELOPMENT 114 GEOLOGICAL BRIGADE

title_en: Method and apparatus for verifying emergency text message
title_ko: 재난 문자 검증 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: A method for verifying disaster text messages is provided.
