A method for verifying disaster text messages performed by a base station according to some embodiments may include the steps of: receiving an RRC restart request message from an inactive mobile communication terminal that has received a broadcast message related to disaster text messages; establishing a Radio Resource Control Connection (RRC) with the mobile communication terminal; receiving a message containing a hash value from the mobile communication terminal with which the RRC connection is established; verifying the validity of the hash value included in the message; and, if the hash is determined to be invalid, transmitting a message to the mobile communication terminal containing information indicating that a false disaster text message is being received.
abstract_ko: 재난 문자 검증 방법 제공된다. 몇몇 실시예에 따른 기지국에 의하여 수행되는 재난 문자 검증 방법은, 재난 문자 관련 방송 메시지를 수신한 비활성화(inactive) 상태의 이동통신 단말로부터 RRC 재시작 요청 메시지를 수신하는 단계, 이동통신 단말과 RRC 커넥션(Radio Resource Control Connection)을 수행하는 단계, RRC 커넥션이 설정된 이동통신 단말로부터 해시 값을 포함하는 메시지를 수신하는 단계, 메시지에 포함된 해시 값에 대한 유효성을 검증하는 단계 및 해시가 유효하지 않은 것으로 판정되는 경우, 허위 재난 문자가 수신되고 있음을 가리키는 정보를 포함하는 메시지를 이동통신 단말로 전송하는 단계를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Intelligent mine safety monitoring system and method
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of mine monitoring, and provides an intelligent mine safety monitoring system and method, comprising a path network modeling device, a multi-source risk monitoring device, a personnel positioning and tracking device, a dynamic path updating device and an intelligent evacuation guiding device; when the risk level of any path exceeds a preset safety threshold, an emergency evacuation instruction is triggered, wherein the emergency evacuation instruction is calculated and generated for each person based on a current updated three-dimensional topological model and person position information, evacuation information is output, the evacuation information comprises an emergency evacuation alarm of a whole mine broadcasting level, and a real-time dynamic pointing instruction facing each node is generated according to the personalized optimal evacuation path and is presented through a physical indicating device deployed at the node or terminal equipment carried by the person. The technical scheme disclosed by the application can timely guide staff in the mine to evacuate.
assignees: YANGCHENG BRANCH OF SHANDONG JIKUANG LUNENG COAL POWER CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic monitoring and early warning system for easily-made drugs based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses an artificial intelligence-based dynamic monitoring and early warning system for easily-made drugs, relates to the technical field of public safety supervision, and solves the technical problems that a corresponding knowledge graph is difficult to construct and is updated dynamically, and a multidimensional abnormal evaluation value is lack to be constructed for early warning analysis; the method comprises a multi-source heterogeneous data acquisition module, a data preprocessing and knowledge graph construction module and an abnormality evaluation and early warning module, wherein the knowledge graph is constructed by integrating ERP, logistics TMS, pharmacy HIS and pharmacy supervision office data of a production enterprise by utilizing a BERT model, a regular expression and a deep learning technology, the relation and the confidence coefficient existing between entity recognition probability and entity pairs are calculated, corresponding entity characteristics, relation characteristics and attribute characteristics are extracted from the constructed knowledge graph, corresponding abnormality evaluation values are constructed, and the comprehensive abnormality evaluation values are obtained after weighting addition, so that whether early warning is triggered or not is judged.
assignees: SHANGHAI HUANGPU DISTR XIANGSHAN HOSPITAL OF TRADITIONAL CHINESE MEDICINE

title_en: Coal face gas concentration dynamic distribution model determination method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a coal face gas concentration dynamic distribution model determining method, and belongs to the technical field of coal mine safety monitoring. The technical problem that the dynamic distribution of gas on a working face cannot be reflected in traditional single-point static monitoring and the prediction accuracy is low is solved. The technical scheme includes that an air inlet corner, a middle part of a working surface and an air return corner sensor network are deployed to collect data in real time, a gas distribution function model y=ae  b(l‑x)  is constructed, wherein a is an air return corner concentration value, b is a dynamic attenuation coefficient, measured data solving parameters are fitted through a least square method, and an update period t dynamic correction model is set. The technical effect is that the full-space dynamic mapping of the gas concentration of the working face is realized, the ventilation condition change is responded in real time, the disaster early warning capability is improved by combining the visual interface, the gas explosion risk is obviously reduced, and the coal mine safety production is ensured.
assignees: CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY ENG GROUP CHONGQING RES INST

title_en: Geotechnical engineering stability early warning system method combining slope deformation monitoring and numerical simulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geotechnical engineering stability early warning system method combining slope deformation monitoring and numerical simulation, which relates to the technical field of geotechnical engineering safety monitoring and disaster early warning, and comprises the steps of combining slope deformation monitoring and numerical simulation, wherein multisource real-time monitoring data of slope deformation and numerical simulation are fused, and a dynamically updated slope deformation evolution analysis system is constructed; and setting an automatic triggering grading early warning signal of a geotechnical engineering early warning index to finish slope risk dynamic assessment and early warning output of the geotechnical. The invention realizes automatic triggering of the grading early warning signals, obviously improves the response speed, judgment accuracy and risk assessment scientificity of the geotechnical engineering early warning system, and provides intelligent, dynamic and systematic technical support for slope safety prevention and control.

title_en: Method and system for observing earthquake response of existing building
abstract_en: The invention relates to an existing building earthquake response observation method and system, wherein the method comprises the following steps of collecting building vibration response data under micro vibration and strong vibration and high-definition video data under the strong vibration of a building in real time, carrying out second-level early warning and minute-level early warning based on the building vibration response data, calculating displacement of an observation floor relative to the ground based on the high-definition video data, constructing an adjacent matrix based on the building vibration response data, updating the adjacent matrix by utilizing real-time data and a graph convolution neural network when the minute-level early warning occurs, carrying out hour-level early warning based on edge characteristics of the updated adjacent matrix, and simultaneously updating a digital twin model of the existing building based on a finite element model based on the calculated displacement, and evaluating the earthquake resistance and the security of the structure after the earthquake. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of remarkably improving the state identification precision of the building strong earthquake response stage, the earthquake resistance evaluation efficiency after earthquake and the like.

title_en: Steam room and sauna emergency monitoring system and apparatus
abstract_en: A system for monitoring and responding to medical emergencies in high-humidity environments includes a processor, a memory storing computer-executable instructions, and a sensor array comprising motion detection, fall detection, and vital signs monitoring. The sensor array includes a steam-adaptive calibration configured to adjust detection thresholds based on vapor density and humidity levels. A privacy-preserving architecture processes non-identifiable inputs such as motion signatures, radar signals, or acoustic triggers without storing visual or audio recordings. When inactivity, collapse, or absence of respiration is detected for a predefined threshold period, the privacy-preserving architecture initiates a first notification to staff interface and response tools. If the first notification is not acknowledged within a predetermined escalation period, a secondary notification is transmitted. The system operates in real time to provide emergency alerts while preserving occupant privacy.

title_en: Portable movable acousto-optic early warning equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses portable movable acousto-optic early warning equipment, which relates to the technical field of acousto-optic early warning systems and comprises an early warning device, an alarm and a host machine for outputting early warning signals, wherein the early warning device comprises an early warning box, a supporting rod connected to the early warning box, a controller connected to the inside of the early warning box, a speed measuring radar connected to the inside of the early warning box and a power supply connected to the inside of the early warning box, the controller is used for outputting speed measuring signals, the speed measuring radar and the power supply are electrically connected with the controller, and the controller and the alarm are electrically connected with the host machine. When the application is used, the speed measuring radar acquires the speed of the train and outputs a speed measuring signal to the controller, the controller receives the speed measuring signal and outputs the speed measuring signal to the host, the host receives the speed measuring signal and outputs an early warning signal to the alarm, and the alarm reminds workers to withdraw in time.
assignees: ZHEJIANG TIETOU CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD

title_en: A method for measuring water level, and the emergency alerting system and method using an apparatus for measuring water level
title_ko: 가중치를 적용하는 수위 측정장치를 이용한 침수경보 시스템 및 방법, 그리고 이에 사용되는 수위 측정방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a water level measuring method having a plurality of sensors, and more specifically, to a water level measuring method for estimating a water level more accurately by applying different weights to a water level measurement value measured by each sensor, and a flooding alarm system and method using the same. The purpose of the present invention is to provide a novel technique for checking the validity of various data for each sensor, performing more accurate measurement through an error filtering process, estimating the reliability of each sensor in the process, and determining a weight according to the reliability.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 복수개의 센서를 갖는 수위 측정방법에 있어서, 각 센서에서 측정된 수위 측정값에 상이한 가중치를 적용하여 더욱 정확하게 수위를 추정하는 수위 측정방법, 그리고 이를 이용한 침수경보 시스템 및 방법을 제공하는 것이며, 각 센서별로 여러가지 데이터의 유효성 검사를 행하고 오차 필터링 과정을 거쳐서 더욱 정확한 측정이 이루어지도록 하며, 게다가 이러한 과정에서 각 센서의 신뢰도를 추정하고 그 신뢰도에 따라서 가중치를 결정하는 신규한 기법을 제공하기 위한 것이다.
assignees: HK SYSTEM CO LTD;LEE IL HWAN

title_en: Mud-rock flow formation mechanism analysis and risk assessment method based on multi-modal data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a debris flow forming mechanism analysis and risk assessment method based on multi-modal data fusion, which comprises the steps of S1, collecting debris flow multi-modal data and preprocessing, S2, constructing a condition vector, S3, generating debris flow risk scene data according to the condition vector, S4, utilizing a condition to generate authenticity probability of data generated by evaluating a discriminator in an antagonism network, S5, carrying out layering modeling on the generated debris flow risk scene data by adopting a multi-scale graph convolution layer, obtaining updated node characteristic representation, S6, calculating a global debris flow risk prediction result, generating a debris flow risk assessment report, S7, carrying out fine adjustment on a generator and the discriminator according to the occurrence condition of an actual debris flow event, and S8, carrying out real-time assessment and early warning on the debris flow risk. The method can provide an efficient and scientific optimization scheme in debris flow formation mechanism analysis and risk assessment, and brings remarkable technical value and economic benefit for practical application.

title_en: Safety and wellness system
abstract_en: A robust and easy-to-use health, safety, and wellness platform that focuses on individual safety and community safety. A cloud-based platform facilitates the health, safety, and wellness of individuals in a user community. The platform comprises at least several features, provided as modules within the platform, including an incident management feature having a centralized dashboard for collecting, tracking, managing, and responding to events, an anonymous reporting feature providing individual users in the user community with a safe and private means for reporting concerning behavior, a digital emergency alert button, a data collection feature including customizable surveys to collect information from community users, a communication management feature to keep community users informed with important update information, and a guest and visitor management feature to ensure all non-community users (guests or visitors) are properly managed through screening and tracking.

title_en: Point landslide debris flow potential degree self-adaptive monitoring and early warning method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring, and discloses a point landslide and debris flow potential degree self-adaptive monitoring and early warning method. The method comprises the steps of setting a lattice monitoring equipment array, collecting displacement data of multiple monitoring points and environmental parameters, analyzing a displacement data time stamp through a time axis analysis module, generating a dynamic time axis, marking geological event nodes, combining a geographic information system with space mapping of the displacement data, and fusing the environmental parameters to obtain a preliminary potential degree assessment result. The pattern recognition engine classifies displacement speed and deformation characteristics of the preliminary result to generate a deformation characteristic map with a space-time tag, the multi-factor weighted evaluation model calculates a dynamic potential evaluation map according to the deformation characteristic map, adjusts an early warning threshold according to a user instruction to generate a personalized early warning rule set, and the scanning map outputs a multi-stage early warning response scheme. Based on early warning feedback, the model and the engine are iteratively updated, newly added monitoring data trigger re-analysis in real time, related schemes are updated in a linkage mode, and different scene requirements are adapted.
assignees: ZHEJIANG CHENGAN BIG DATA CO LTD;ZHEJIANG INSTITUTE OF SURVEYING AND MAPPING SCIENCE AND TECH;UNIV ZHEJIANG;ZHEJIANG NATURAL RESOURCES GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Distributed optical fiber temperature-sensing fire detection algorithm based on CNN-LSTM and attention mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed optical fiber temperature-sensing fire detection algorithm based on a CNN-LSTM and an attention mechanism, and aims to solve the problems of high false alarm rate, response lag and poor scene adaptability in the traditional detection technology. The system collects temperature data at a space resolution of 0.5 m at intervals of 2 seconds through a distributed optical fiber sensing unit, inputs CNN-LSTM hybrid model to extract space-time characteristics after Z-Score standardization, db4 wavelet noise reduction and 12-dimensional characteristic enhancement pretreatment, and outputs fire risk indexes of 0-100 in combination with focusing key areas and moments of an attention mechanism. The model training adopts transfer learning and Focal Loss function to realize cross-scene rapid adaptation and sample imbalance treatment, and parameters are updated through incremental learning every 30 days. Practice shows that the false alarm rate of the method is reduced by more than 80 percent compared with that of the traditional threshold method, and the smoldering fire disaster early warning is advanced by 25 seconds, so that the method can be widely applied to fire safety monitoring of complex scenes such as tunnels, substations, comprehensive pipe galleries and the like.

title_en: Three-dimensional tunnel water burst analysis method and system based on autonomous control
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of tunnel engineering safety monitoring, in particular to an autonomous controllable three-dimensional tunnel water burst analysis method and system; the method comprises the steps of collecting multi-source heterogeneous geological, hydrologic and construction data, fusing and obtaining multi-source heterogeneous data, constructing a dynamically updated three-dimensional geological-construction coupling digital twin model after alignment coding, conducting water gushing evolution rolling prediction through multi-scale physical-AI mixed modeling and correcting real-time data, outputting prediction data, constructing a three-dimensional visual platform, starting multi-level linkage early warning based on a risk threshold, and enabling the system to comprise a data fusion module, a water gushing evolution rolling prediction module and a multi-level linkage early warning module, and meet the requirements of rapid early warning and timely decision making of water gushing disasters in the tunnel construction process by combining three-dimensional visual rendering and deep learning fluid simulation technology through fusion of geological data, hydrologic monitoring data and construction parameters.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY CHANGJIANG TRANSP DESIGN GROUP CO LTD;CHONGQING HIGH SPEED RAILWAY CONSTRUCTION WANKAIDA EXPRESSWAY CO LTD

title_en: Community emergency broadcast networking method and system based on edge algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a community emergency broadcast networking method and system based on an edge algorithm, and relates to the technical field of emergency systems. The community emergency broadcast networking method based on the edge algorithm solves the problems of high response delay, large coverage blind area, low resource utilization rate and high operation and maintenance cost of a traditional community emergency broadcast system, constructs a three-level edge architecture, dynamically constructs topology and calculates multipath routes, executes edge task scheduling, reasonably distributes calculation tasks to proper nodes and terminals, implements load balancing, triggers disaster recovery when nodes fail or are disconnected, and updates routes by using a reinforcement learning model based on data. The method greatly reduces the emergency response delay, meets the second-level response of an emergency scene, eliminates the communication blind area, realizes the full coverage of information, improves the resource utilization rate, reduces the operation and maintenance cost, and provides an efficient and reliable scheme for community emergency management.
assignees: SICHUAN BIHONG ELECTRONIC INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Flood inundation range prediction method, flood inundation range prediction system, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a flood inundation range prediction method, a flood inundation range prediction system, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of data processing. The method comprises the steps of determining a new basic flooding range according to a real-time SAR image and water surface fluctuation data when the new real-time SAR image is acquired, determining a current real-time water volume according to the new basic flooding range and a terrain digital elevation model, determining an actual water volume increment according to the current real-time water volume and a previous real-time water volume, updating a dynamic coefficient according to the actual water volume increment and the precipitation in a revisit period, determining a predicted water volume increment according to the acquired predicted precipitation volume and the updated dynamic coefficient, and determining a flood flooding prediction range according to the predicted water volume increment and the terrain digital elevation model by taking the new basic flooding range as an initial flooding range. The evolution of the flood inundation range can be predicted in time in the revisit period, the timeliness and the accuracy of prediction are considered, and early warning is carried out on a disaster-stricken area in advance.
assignees: ANHUI SURVEY & DESIGN INST OF WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER CO LTD;UNIV HOHAI;NANJING HYDRAULIC RES INST

title_en: Housing Management System for each stage of pig growth through temperature detection in the body
title_ko: 체내 온도 감지 통한 돼지 성장단계별 축사 관리 시스템
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 개별 축사 내의 돼지 개체에 대한 체온 측정을 성장단계별로 구분하여 실시하며, 이를 통한 축사의 설  
비 제어도 사육환경 제어데이터를 근거로 하여 성장단계별로 구분 관리하며, 개체의 질병상황을 나타내는 개체이  
상 보고메시지를 생성 및 전송하는 지역통제부(100);와, 상기 지역통제부(100)에서 전송된 상기 개체이상 보고메  
시지에 따른 이상개체비율값을 통해 연산코드를 산출하며, 상기 연산코드에 따라 질병 상황별 경보코드를 생성하  
여, 개체이상 경보메시지를 전송하되, 질병 상황에 따라 지역내 교통 통제와 비상연락을 실시하며, 축사 설비기  
기의 제어를 위한 사육환경 제어데이터를 상기 지역통제부(100)에 통보하는 광역통제부(200);와, 전체 축사의 개  
체 질병 현황을 파악하여 상기 다수의 광역통제부(200)에 개체이상 경보메시지를 전달하며, 전체 개체의 건강상  
태 및 질병 상황이 기록된 데이터베이스를 구비하며, 질병 발생 및 기상변화에 따라 변경된 사육환경 제어데이터  
를 상기 다수의 광역통제부(200)에 전달하며, 지역간 교통 통제가 종합적으로 가능한 시스템이 구비되어 종합적  
인 개체의 질병 상황 감지 및 관리가 가능하도록 구성되는 중앙관제부(300);로 구성되며, 상기 광역통제부(200)  
가 개체이상 경보메시지를 전송하는 대상 범위는 광역통제부(200)가 직접 관리하는 다수의 타  
지역통제부(100)와, 다수의 축사관리자나 다수의 방역당국 관련자가 소지한 이동단말기(400);와, 중앙관제부 
(300);로 선정되어 돼지의 질병 발생 및 확산을 방지하는 것을 특징으로 하는 체내온도감지를 통한 돼지의 성장  
단계별 축사관리시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: FM radio multi-channel automatic disaster warning receiver
title_ko: Fm 라디오 다채널 자동 재난경보 수신기
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 일반 방송채널을 듣고 있더라도 재난경보방송채널 또는 지역방송채널에서 재난경보방송의 수신되면 재난경보방송채널 또는 지역방송채널로 변경하여 재난방송을 출력할 수 있는 FM 라디오 다채널 자동 재난경보 수신기를 제공하고자 하는 것이다.  
본 발명의 제1 실시예는 일반 방송채널이 수신되는 제1FM튜너(110)와, 재난경보방송채널이 수신되는 제2FM튜너(210)와, 제1FM튜너(110)의 FM방송이나 제2FM튜너(210)의 재난경보방송을 출력하는 오디오앰프(310)와, 제1FM튜너(110)나 제2FM튜너(210)를 오디오앰프(310)에 선택적으로 연결하는 오디오스위치(410)와, 제2FM튜너(210)에서 일정 레벨 이상의 신호전력이 수신됨을 감지하면 오디오앰프(310)를 통해 출력되는 제1FM튜너(110)의 FM방송을 차단하면서 제2FM튜너(210)를 통해 수신되는 재난경보방송이 출력되도록 제어하는 제어부(510)를 포함하고, 제어부(510)는 제2FM튜너(210)에서 재난경보방송이 수신되는 신호전력에 대한 기준레벨을 설정하는 기준레벨설정부(511)와, 제2FM튜너(210)에서 수신되는 신호전력을 확인하고 기준레벨 이상인지 판단하는 전력레벨판단부(512)와, 전력레벨판단부(512)에서 신호전력이 기준레벨 이상인 것으로 판단하면 제2FM튜너(210)에서 수신되는 재난경보방송이 출력되도록 오디오스위치(410)를 조작하는 스위치조작부(513)를 포함한다.

title_en: Intelligent traffic evacuation method based on dynamic path optimization and multi-objective cooperation
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent traffic evacuation method based on dynamic path optimization and multi-objective coordination, which relates to the technical field of intelligent traffic and emergency management, and comprises the steps of establishing an improved HD-PSO model based on a traffic violation risk space-time distribution map, calculating a risk index of a path node through a dynamic congestion influence factor matrix, constructing a four-layer dynamic early warning mechanism, and outputting a real-time risk index and a grading response instruction; based on the optimized evacuation path weight parameters and the resource allocation factors, and by combining the real-time environment state, the invention predicts the people flow density through a DRL-LSTM hybrid model and dynamically updates the path weight parameters to generate an optimized evacuation strategy.

title_en: Real-time interaction method for MQTT interconnection of earthquake early warning terminal platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of earthquake early warning, in particular to a real-time interaction method for MQTT interconnection of an earthquake early warning terminal platform, which comprises the steps of constructing an MQTT middleware, defining a Topic according to administrative regions and terminal types, reporting the types after terminal initialization and subscribing to corresponding Topic, setting an update timer, detecting the change of the Topic and dynamically subscribing, monitoring the connection state, triggering reconnection when disconnected, guaranteeing reliable transmission of the information by adopting a QoS strategy, analyzing and processing the received early warning information, and converting the information processing flow by adopting an innovative three-layer Topic architecture, wherein the message processing flow is reduced, the delay is reduced, and the route based on geographic topology ensures that the key region receives the early warning information preferentially.

title_en: A combined process for detecting and predicting multiple medical episodes alone or in combination
abstract_en: A combined process for detecting and predicting multiple medical episodes—such as seizures, falls, and cardiac events—alone or in combination, using wearable sensor data. The system continuously collects physiological and movement data from one or more wearable devices and integrates it with personal historical data, including medical history, age, gender, and known conditions. User-specific settings define thresholds and emergency response preferences. Artificial Intelligence and machine learning models analyse the integrated data to detect and predict medical episodes by identifying patterns and refining accuracy over time through user feedback and updated historical data. The system also monitors deviations in Activities of Daily Life as indicators of potential risk. When a medical episode is detected or predicted, alerts are sent to caregivers or healthcare providers. This personalised, adaptive method enhances early intervention and real-time support, enabling improved healthcare outcomes through timely detection and prediction of medical episodes.
assignees: MY MEDIC WATCH PTY LTD;LAURIOU SERGE;BLANCHARD ANDREANNE;BLANCHARD ELIZABETH;BLANCHARD HELENE;BREW BRUCE;PARSY LAURENT

title_en: Method, system, equipment and medium for analyzing dangerous chemical accident investigation report based on large model
abstract_en: The application provides a method, a system, equipment and a medium for analyzing a dangerous chemical accident investigation report based on a large model, belonging to the technical field of dangerous chemical accident investigation report analysis; the method comprises the steps of carrying out entity labeling and relation labeling on a historical dangerous chemical accident investigation report, converting the historical dangerous chemical accident investigation report into an enumeration label sequence, constructing a training data set by combining the historical dangerous chemical accident investigation report, constructing a report analysis model by adopting a BiLSTM-CRF architecture, training by using the training data set, analyzing the dangerous chemical accident investigation report by using the report analysis model to obtain an analysis result characterized by the enumeration label sequence, and periodically optimizing the report analysis model. According to the method, the enumeration topology is constructed, unstructured text is converted into an enumeration label sequence, analysis accuracy is improved, the analysis model is reported to be related to accident elements and rule terms, and the model is updated regularly, so that accurate risk early warning and safety management are realized.
assignees: INSPUR CLOUD INF TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent mine water disaster early warning system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent early warning system and method for mine water damage, and relates to the technical field of mine water damage monitoring. The early warning method comprises water inrush risk early warning, well flooding risk early warning and water environment risk early warning, wherein the water inrush risk early warning is used for processing water inrush time sequence data through a sliding window, three-level water inrush risk early warning is excited continuously for three times in an abnormal mode, the water inrush quantity can be updated and predicted, the well flooding risk early warning is used for setting three-level thresholds based on the double ratio of water inrush quantity to water drainage capacity and water sump volume, the water environment risk early warning is used for monitoring water quality according to national standards, and early warning is carried out according to pollution risk indexes in three levels. The early warning system comprises a monitoring unit, a data management unit, a water damage early warning unit and a visualization unit. According to the invention, through multi-parameter collaborative monitoring, intelligent analysis and expert judgment, the accuracy, timeliness and intelligent level of water damage early warning can be obviously improved.

title_en: Transportation risk optimization method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent traffic and road disaster early warning, in particular to a transportation risk optimization method and system, comprising the following steps of S1 multimode event-infrared-optical fiber data acquisition and synchronous generation of a unified index data packet; the method comprises the steps of S2, combining energy conservation and causal inference assimilation, outputting a digital twin state tensor, S3, performing forward noise scheduling and reverse denoising by a conditional diffusion model, generating an icing probability field and extracting a high-frequency attention spectrum, S4, calculating road structure factors according to the probability field and the attention spectrum, constructing a binary unconstrained optimization model, mapping to an optical coherence Ising machine for solving, forming an interference scheduling scheme by strategy network soft update and safety verification, and performing effect write-back cyclic update. The invention realizes sub-second risk identification and millisecond optimization decision, and reduces accident rate and salt spraying cost.

title_en: Fire-fighting early-warning emergency response coordination method and system
abstract_en: The application provides a fire-fighting early-warning emergency response coordination method and a fire-fighting early-warning emergency response coordination system, which are applied to the technical field of information processing, wherein the platform can understand and process emergency data from different departments by converting original data into a standard data format, so that information islands are eliminated, the information in an emergency resource information base is always updated in real time, an accurate basis is provided for emergency decision, various factors can be comprehensively considered through a resource allocation algorithm based on a mathematical model, and the optimal resource combination, quantity and action path scheme can be calculated, so that the efficiency and accuracy of resource allocation are improved. And by updating the emergency resource information base, the accuracy and the instantaneity of the resource information are ensured, and support is provided for subsequent emergency response. Therefore, the scheme provided by the application has the advantage of realizing centralized and intelligent allocation of cross-department cross-regional emergency resources.
assignees: SHENZHEN ZHICHENG INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire-fighting early warning management and control integrated control method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire control and discloses a fire control early warning management and control integrated control method and a fire control early warning management and control integrated control system, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring global multi-mode data of a coverage target area; the method comprises the steps of carrying out initial situation assessment on fire according to the overall multi-mode data, generating an initial fire state vector, establishing and online updating a dynamic fire extinguishing efficiency model based on the initial fire state vector, and executing a self-adaptive optimal control process based on dynamic fire extinguishing efficiency model prediction to generate a control instruction for controlling fire resources in real time. The system comprises a data acquisition module, a data processing module and a control instruction generation module. According to the invention, by constructing the dynamic fire extinguishing efficiency model capable of being updated on line and combining the self-adaptive optimal control strategy, the technical span from passive early warning to active intelligent control is realized, a real-time optimal control instruction can be generated, and the accuracy of fire treatment and the final fire extinguishing efficiency are obviously improved.
assignees: BEIJING ZHONGDE QIRUI SAFETY EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Attribute revocation encryption access control method and system based on time tag
abstract_en: The invention relates to a time-stamp-based attribute revocation encryption access control method and a time-stamp-based attribute revocation encryption access control system, wherein the system comprises a time stamp definition module, an alarm trigger judgment module, a dynamic optimization module, a disaster tolerance path configuration module and an encryption revocation execution module, wherein the time stamp definition module is used for realizing accurate pre-judgment of authority invalidation time by constructing a three-level constraint structure of an early warning window, an intervention window and an execution window, the alarm trigger judgment module is used for dynamically generating a hierarchical alarm signal based on a time window inclusion relation to solve the problem of manual response hysteresis, the dynamic optimization module is used for adaptively adjusting a scanning strategy by combining a system load state to eliminate resource waste of a fixed scanning mechanism, the disaster tolerance path configuration module is used for guaranteeing reliable execution of revocation instructions under a high concurrency scene through a main-backup dual-path design, the encryption revocation execution module is used for thoroughly eliminating historical key decryption capability through a key update factor injection technology, and triple promotion of authority revocation is realized under the cooperation of a data communication module.

title_en: Comprehensive energy operation simulation method and system based on multi-objective optimization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive energy operation simulation method and system based on multi-objective optimization, belongs to the technical field of energy, and aims to solve the problem of equipment overload and discontinuous power supply caused by unbalance of supply and demand in extreme climates. The model is simulated by adopting an improved NSGA-III algorithm, and a scheduling scheme is generated, wherein the scheduling scheme comprises a start-stop time sequence of hydrogen production equipment. When typhoon warning signals are received, the seawater electrolysis hydrogen production equipment is locked forcibly, and the output power of the diesel generator is fixed in a preset interval. During the operation of the hydrogen production equipment, output fluctuation data of the wave energy generator are collected in real time, and the operation power of the reverse osmosis sea water desalination unit is adjusted through a dynamic correction algorithm. When the hydrogen storage amount of the hydrogen production equipment reaches a threshold value, the power locking of the diesel generator is released, the diesel generator is switched to a multi-energy coupling control mode, and the charging and discharging strategies of the energy storage equipment are synchronously updated.

title_en: System and method for automatically transmitting alert messages based on time and location monitoring in vehicle journey supervision
abstract_en: System and method adapted to: obtain a plurality of parameters for a planned journey of a vehicle associated with a computing device; determine, based on the plurality of parameters, whether the planned journey includes at least one special condition; when the planned journey includes at least one special condition, activating journey monitoring; the journey monitoring including: obtaining a location of the vehicle; comparing the obtained location to an expected location; when the obtained location exceeds a predetermined distance from the expected location, determining, in an iterative or recursive manner, whether an updated arrival time has been received from the computing device or the vehicle, when the updated arrival time has not been received after a predetermined time period, transmitting an alert to another computing device associated with an operator; and transmitting a request for emergency services when an iteration count for the determining is exceeded.

title_en: High-resolution low-air-image risk early warning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-resolution low-meteorological risk early warning method, which relates to the technical field of disaster early warning and comprises the following components of S1, a data acquisition and preprocessing step, S2, a multi-disaster correlation model building and training step, S3, a high-resolution grid risk calculation step, S4, a risk assessment and grading step, and S5, a linkage early warning release and dynamic updating step; according to the invention, by combining historical disaster data and real-time data, a correlation model of low weather risk and geological disasters and flood disasters and multiple disasters is constructed, linkage early warning of multiple disasters is realized, meanwhile, the correlation model of multiple disasters is dynamically updated and optimized by continuously collecting data in real time, the risk value and the early warning level of a grid unit are timely adjusted according to a new calculation result, and latest early warning information is issued.
assignees: CHONGQING YUNJI DIGITAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Alarm method and perimeter security system based on multi-technology fusion
abstract_en: The application provides an alarming method and a perimeter security system based on multi-technology fusion, which can reduce missing report and false report caused by animal activities and environmental interference, improve alarming accuracy and enhance system accuracy and reliability. The method comprises the steps of generating an event attribute set containing state information of the rechecking device and the type of the first detection result when the first detection result of the core detection device is received for the first time, and setting the initial type of an event corresponding to the event attribute set as early warning. If the event attribute set is not updated, triggering a corresponding alarm flow according to the initial type of the event. When the event attribute set is updated, if the event attribute set exists the type of the second detection result of the rechecking device, updating the type of the event according to the type of the first detection result and the type of the second detection result. If the second detection result type reported by the rechecking device does not exist in the event attribute set, the event type is updated based on the operation state of the rechecking device and the first detection result type.
assignees: HEFEI XINQIAO INT AIRPORT CO LTD;NEW SINGULARITY INT TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Slope rainfall infiltration stability dynamic evaluation and landslide prediction method
abstract_en: A dynamic evaluation and landslide prediction method for slope rainfall infiltration stability comprises the steps of constructing a numerical model coupling rainfall infiltration and slope stress field response, integrating multi-source data, updating model boundary conditions in real time, carrying out dynamic stability evaluation based on a local safety coefficient method, training a landslide prediction model and realizing intelligent early warning judgment. The invention provides a seepage-stress-intensity three-field coupling numerical model, which dynamically simulates the physical response process of an unsaturated soil body, can truly restore the precursor mechanism of rainfall induced landslide, improves prediction scientificity and accuracy, integrates remote sensing topographic data, soil property investigation parameters and real-time meteorological monitoring information, dynamically updates the boundary condition and initial state of the model through a system interface, realizes real-time response environment change, improves simulation reliability, introduces a local safety coefficient assessment mechanism, combines a continuous weak area discrimination algorithm, realizes space identification and time sequence tracking of a potential slippage area and a damaged area, and improves the analysis refinement level of slope stability.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY NO 2 GROUP;NATIONAL ENGINEERING RES CENTER FOR HIGH SPEED RAILWAY CONSTRUCTION;CHINA RAILWAY ERJU 6TH ENG CO LTD;UNIV CENTRAL SOUTH

title_en: Underground coal mine smoke concentration early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for early warning the concentration of underground smoke of a coal mine, and belongs to the technical field of fire disaster early warning. According to the method, the target Soxhlet particle size is calculated by adopting a statistical method through acquiring the first wavelength signal and the second wavelength signal of the underground coal mine, so that the data precision is improved. The first threshold value and the second threshold value are set, the section where the target Soxhlet particle size is located is judged, whether a roadway where the detection unit is located is normal is judged according to the section where the target Soxhlet particle size is located, a plurality of groups of continuous first gas concentration and second gas concentration are collected by combining the gas detector, the first concentration change rate and the second concentration change rate are calculated, and therefore the underground state of a coal mine is determined, and the accuracy of smoke alarm is improved. Further, the parameters of the smoke detector are updated periodically in combination with the equipment noise, so that the accuracy of the equipment for collecting data is improved, and the probability of false alarm is reduced.
assignees: SHANXI WANGJIALING COAL IND CO LTD

title_en: Mountain landslide grading early warning method based on multi-mode data change characteristics
abstract_en: The invention relates to a landslide grading early warning method based on multi-modal data change characteristics, which comprises the steps of establishing a mountain digital twin body, deploying a multi-node sensor network in a target area, configuring an edge calculation unit, collecting geological data in real time, screening the geological data based on the mountain digital twin body to form effective local data, constructing a lightweight multi-modal neural network model at each node, dynamically searching super parameters by utilizing an ant colony optimization algorithm to generate an encryption model weight update quantity package, dynamically calculating node weights by a central server according to disaster feature vectors output by the digital twin body, weighting and polymerizing to generate a global model and directionally distributing and updating, fusing real-time monitoring data and model prediction results, executing millimeter-level disaster evolution simulation through a variable-step physical engine, triggering advanced early warning signals when a deduction prediction risk exceeds a threshold value, and remarkably improving edge model adaptability, federal aggregation precision and early warning advance.

title_en: Mountain torrent disaster early warning index correction method under non-stationary condition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mountain torrent disaster early warning index correction method under a non-steady condition, which relates to the technical field of disaster early warning and comprises the following steps of firstly, collecting rainfall, river water level and branch inflow port water flow movement data in real time and preprocessing; step three, further calculating a hydrologic state model, predicting whether tributaries impact a bank, updating the threshold and early warning if impact, otherwise, returning to the step two. The invention adopts the ultrasonic sensor and the electromagnetic flow velocity meter to collect multiple data, models the prediction jacking effect, dynamically updates the critical rainfall, avoids the adaptation failure of the traditional fixed threshold value, prevents the aggravation of disasters caused by early warning lag, disassembles water flow data and partition differentiation weighting, improves hydrologic evaluation accuracy, combines data preprocessing, and provides reliable support for mountain torrent early warning and flood control decision under non-steady conditions.

title_en: Multi-source heterogeneous data fusion side slope digital twin modeling method
abstract_en: The invention provides a slope digital twin modeling method based on multi-source heterogeneous data fusion, which comprises the steps of obtaining slope multidimensional monitoring data through laying GNSS sensors, multipoint displacement meters, distributed optical fiber strain sensors, accelerometers, osmometers, monocular cameras and satellite remote sensing image equipment, converting the collected data into a unified format through time alignment, spatial registration and standardization processing to be used as modeling input, constructing an initial digital twin model reflecting the real form and physical characteristics of a slope by utilizing a three-dimensional modeling and finite element simulation technology, dynamically driving model evolution based on a space-time fusion algorithm by combining real-time perception data, automatically correcting boundary conditions and material parameters through actual measurement deviation feedback, realizing continuous twin iteration update of the model, finally extracting landslide risk indexes, and realizing real-time early warning of the slope. The invention realizes the integration of multisource perception and digital twin, and improves the accuracy, the instantaneity and the intelligent level of the monitoring of the side slope.

title_en: Intelligent management system for experiment dangerous waste
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of waste management, in particular to an intelligent management system for experimental dangerous waste, which comprises a waste liquid information identification module, an emission behavior identification module, a capacity state evaluation module, a multi-stage linkage early warning module and a flow compliance tracking module. According to the invention, the binding identification mark is constructed by utilizing the experiment task number and the container information, and the first node data is formed by registering, so that the waste liquid has traceability from collection, the discharge fluctuation state identification is realized by comparing the current flow rate data with the historical quartile interval, the full-level time is predicted by combining the liquid level change rate, the early warning is implemented by associating the discharge frequency, the notification priority is set, the audible and visual alarm is linked, the automatic dialing and the message pushing are linked, and various channels such as the closed loop response is formed, meanwhile, the RFID reading record is collected and constructed to construct a chain time sequence data structure, the path validity verification is executed, the dynamic identification precision of the waste liquid discharge behavior is improved, and the predictive management and control on the container capacity abnormality is enhanced.

title_en: Strong wind disaster monitoring and early warning method based on Beidou GNSS-R
abstract_en: The invention discloses a strong wind disaster monitoring and early warning method based on Beidou GNSS-R, which comprises the steps of 1, carrying out wind speed detection operation of the inner water surface of an unmanned aerial vehicle on the periphery of a strong water fall area by carrying out GNSS-R receiving equipment, carrying out data calculation on acquired satellite observables, 2, constructing an LSTM wind speed inversion model integrating double-factor decoupling, carrying out inversion prediction on the water surface wind speed of a reflection point area by inputting the received satellite observables and calculation results and carrying out error correction, obtaining future time step wind speed prediction based on the past time step wind speed inversion results, 3, establishing a boundary self-adaptive grid and a dynamically updated Kriging interpolation model, obtaining wind speed data of a specific signal reflection point missing area, assisting wind speed data supplement of the reflection point missing area, and 4, constructing a double-effect strong wind early warning strategy of the coordination of wind speed time sequence extrapolation and inversion stability, judging whether strong wind is about to appear or not, and carrying out early warning.

title_en: Device and system for identifying and early warning risks in expressway operation area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and a system for identifying and early warning risks in an expressway operation area. The system comprises a portable pressure-sensitive deceleration strip, an integrated intelligent traffic cone and an engineering pre-warning vehicle, wherein the two portable pressure-sensitive deceleration strips are respectively arranged at a first-stage early warning boundary and a second-stage early warning boundary in front of the integrated intelligent traffic cone at the upstream of an operation area and used for sending warning signals to other associated devices when detecting that a vehicle enters an early warning area on a high-speed early warning lane, the integrated intelligent traffic cone is used for automatically placing the integrated intelligent traffic cone at a preset position, configuring an integrated module such as a monitoring camera, an audible-visual alarm and a text prompt board according to the early warning effect so as to identify risks inside and outside the operation area and early warn, and the engineering pre-warning vehicle is used for assisting in identifying the risks inside and outside the operation area, processing early warning information and relieving collision. By constructing the device and the system for identifying and early warning the risks of people, vehicles and equipment in the expressway operation area, the risk of running in the vehicles outside the operation area and the risk of equipment in the internal personnel can be actively found, an alarm prompt is made before the risk comes, the workers in the operation area are guided to withdraw rapidly, and the casualties are reduced.

title_en: River information management system, river information system, and river information management control method
abstract_en: To provide a river information management system capable of improving efficiency of transmission of flood-protecting warnings.SOLUTION: According to an embodiment, a river information management system includes a telemeter monitoring device, a meteorological observatory system, a communication server, an outward provision server, and an inward provision server. The communication server transmits information related to flood protection to the outward provision server and the inward provision server on the basis of at least one of river data and meteorological data. The outward provision server transmits the information via the Internet to terminals connected to the outward provision server, receives, from the terminals, receipt confirmation data indicating that the information has been confirmed by users who use respectively the terminals, and transmits the receipt confirmation data to the inward provision server when transmission of the receipt confirmation data is requested by the inward provision server.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Systems and methods for AI-based real-time incident response intelligence
abstract_en: An emergency response data system (ERDS) provides AI-based real-time intelligence during a response to an incident. The system includes a monitoring module configured to receive and process incident metadata from an emergency system, such as a Computer-Aided Dispatch (CAD) system, wherein the incident metadata includes location, type of emergency, units dispatched, and comments. An analysis module analyzes the incident metadata and identifies changes in incident circumstances, including comparing current comments with historical comments corresponding to the location. A data retrieval module accesses and retrieves public record information corresponding to the location, including property data, tax records, real estate records, historical records, and permits. An insight generation module generates real-time insights and updates regarding the incident, including reclassifying the type of emergency based on the analyzed metadata and retrieved public records. An alert module transmits the real-time insights to emergency personnel, including field responders and Emergency Communication Centers (ECC).

title_en: Sea filling engineering three-dimensional geological data processing method and system integrating multi-source data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of sea filling engineering and digitalization, and discloses a sea filling engineering three-dimensional geological data processing method and system for fusing multi-source data, wherein the method determines first subsidence data by generating four-dimensional geological bodies, and (3) fusing the three-dimensional drilling data, the geophysical prospecting data, the oblique photography model and the real-time sedimentation data, constructing a dynamically updated three-dimensional geological model to determine second sedimentation data, and reflecting the geological deformation accumulation process of the sea-filled area in real time according to the first sedimentation data and the second sedimentation data. The crossing of the geological model from 'static snapshot' to 'dynamic deformation' is realized, the space-time deformation effect is improved, the risk prevention and control efficiency of the sea-filling engineering is improved, the engineering geological disaster early warning aging is advanced, and technical support is provided for engineering safety early warning.
assignees: CCCC THIRD HARBOR ENG CO LTD

title_en: Fire-fighting gas alarm method
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of fire protection early warning, and provides a fire protection gas alarm method, which comprises the steps of acquiring response time signal stability and detection precision data through a sensor to obtain a real-time monitoring sequence; the method comprises the steps of calculating a response time and a correlation coefficient of signal stability according to a real-time monitoring sequence, determining a change trend index, inputting a preset regression model by the change trend index to obtain a performance degradation predicted value, judging potential faults and generating an alarm signal if the performance degradation predicted value exceeds a preset threshold value, adjusting detection precision parameter to optimize sensor configuration through a threshold mechanism after the alarm signal is obtained, re-collecting gas concentration and concentration fluctuation data according to the optimized sensor configuration to determine an updated monitoring sequence, judging a gas leakage risk level by adopting the updated monitoring sequence to match with abnormal smoke characteristics, inputting a classification model through the risk level to obtain a fault predicted result and activating a maintenance system response, providing high-efficiency early warning for catering kitchen gas monitoring, and guaranteeing safety.

title_en: Graded early warning method for stability of toppling deformation body under multiple working conditions
abstract_en: The invention provides a grading early warning method for stability of a toppling deformation body under multiple working conditions, which comprises the steps of collecting real-time monitoring time sequence data and preprocessing, determining an analysis period according to the preprocessing data, extracting target monitoring data to calculate a stability grading label, generating a reinforced support strategy aiming at a high-risk label, generating a maintenance monitoring strategy aiming at the stability label, detecting abnormal deformation based on a current or updated strategy and combining an instability prediction model, and triggering personnel evacuation or disaster early warning through an emergency response decision tree if control abnormality exists. The invention can improve the accuracy and timeliness of the stability control of the dumping deformation body, reduce the risk of geotechnical engineering instability and optimize the distribution of supporting resources.
assignees: POWERCHINA KUNMING ENG CORP LTD;HUANENG LANCANG RIVER HYDROPOWER CO LTD;HUANENG LANCANG RIVER UPSTREAM HYDROPOWER CO LTD

title_en: Deformation monitoring system and method for engineering measurement
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deformation monitoring system and method for engineering measurement, which relate to the technical field of engineering measurement and comprise the following steps: acquiring basic parameters of an engineering structure, setting a deformation control threshold, deploying a static monitoring terminal and a mobile inspection vehicle to acquire multi-source monitoring data, constructing a historical deformation database, correcting the historical data through a linear regression model based on real-time environment parameters, fusing the static data and the dynamic data to obtain a deformation index value, and triggering grading early warning and emergency response through the comparison of the index value and the threshold. According to the invention, through a distributed monitoring and data fusion technology, comprehensive and efficient collection and intelligent analysis of engineering structure deformation are realized, monitoring precision and early warning prospective are improved by utilizing a historical database and an environment update model, and accurate risk assessment and decision are supported by a quantized index value and hierarchical response mechanism.

title_en: Scheme release method based on emergency state dynamic change
abstract_en: The invention discloses a plan release method based on dynamic change of emergency states, which relates to the technical field of intelligent emergency, and comprises the steps of activating a pre-built knowledge graph frame according to an emergency type identifier acquired in real time to form an initialized dynamic knowledge graph, capturing a feedback data stream in real time, importing the feedback data stream into a state update layer of a state evolution knowledge graph to generate an updated state evolution knowledge graph, generating an evacuation instruction based on the updated state evolution knowledge graph, switching to Mesh network broadcast path change information through a damaged base station to generate an execution effect, and re-triggering and activating the pre-built knowledge graph frame as a new emergency type identifier. According to the intelligent countermeasures, the dynamic generation of the intelligent countermeasures is realized by implanting the emergency situation disturbance nodes into the state evolution knowledge graph and deducing the diffusion paths.
assignees: CIETS DIGITAL INTELLIGENT TECH BEIJING CO LTD

title_en: Smart Power Disaster Prevention Device
title_ko: 스마트 전원 방재 장치
abstract_ko: 스마트 전원 방재 장치가 개시된다.  본 발명의 실시예에 따른 스마트 전원 방재 장치는, 설치지면으로부터 소정 높이만큼 연장된 지지대의 상단에 장착된 태양광패널을 통해 전력을 생산하여 저장하는 태양광발전 전력공급부; 상기 지지대의 상부에 장착된 카메라를 통해 주위를 실시간으로 촬영하고, 실시간 촬영 데이터를 중앙통제센터에 전송하며, 중앙통제센터로부터 제어신호를 수신하여 카메라의 방향, 각도를 변경하는 CCTV 보안수행부; 실시간 검출되는 주위 환경정보를 바탕으로 비상상황 여부를 판단하고, 비상상황 발생 시 기설정된 대피경고방송을 시각적 수단 및 청각적 수단을 통해 출력하는 방재 유도부; 및 실시간 검출되는 주위 환경정보를 바탕으로 작동하고, 중앙통제센터와 연계하여 기 설정된 스케쥴 및 패턴에 의해 작동하며, 지지대 내부에 저장된 살충제, 유해생물 기피제 및 곤충 기피제를 포함하는 약물질을 주위에 분사하는 방충 수행부;를 포함하는 것을 구성의 요지로 한다.

title_en: Fracturing construction monitoring and early warning system and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of safety monitoring and intelligent early warning of fracturing engineering, in particular to a fracturing construction monitoring and early warning system and a method thereof, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining initializing equivalent system resistance and flow state correction index; the method comprises the steps of constructing a reference physical model, calculating a theoretical pressure value, calculating a deviation index, triggering inversion of a geological state in response to the deviation index being larger than a preset dynamic judgment threshold, returning to execute the step of collecting the current real-time pressure value and the current real-time discharge value of the high-pressure grouting pump in real time in response to the deviation index being smaller than or equal to the dynamic judgment threshold, reversely solving to obtain updated equivalent system resistance, calculating to obtain a risk index, generating a grading early warning and decision instruction, and updating the initialized equivalent system resistance in the reference physical model to the updated equivalent system resistance in response to confirmation of an early warning event.
assignees: DONGYING HUAXING OIL & GAS ENG CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for realizing unmanned tunneling working face
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for realizing an unmanned tunneling working face, which comprise the steps of dividing equipment groups working on the tunneling working face into N rigid body groups which independently operate, installing an inertial navigation and a laser target on main rigid body equipment of each rigid body group, designing and installing a measuring and positioning robot, wherein the measuring and positioning robot comprises an inertial navigation and N automatic target-seeking total stations, establishing a digital twin platform of the unmanned tunneling working face, realizing pose calculation, fault diagnosis, disaster early warning, cooperative control, scene update, equipment start-stop and maintenance decision-making, and providing remote intervention and man-machine interaction interfaces to realize unmanned operation of the tunneling working face. The invention can realize the accurate measurement, positioning and attitude control of all equipment such as digging, drilling, anchoring, supporting, transporting, passing and the like in the tunneling working face, realize the unmanned operation of zero accident and zero fault of the tunneling working face, and provide technical support for avoiding personal injury and death and greatly improving the tunneling efficiency.

title_en: Rainfall threshold dynamic updating method for early warning landslide
abstract_en: The application belongs to the field of landslide early warning and risk management and control research, and particularly discloses a rainfall threshold dynamic updating method for serving landslide early warning, which comprises the steps of counting occurrence probability of landslide on an area according to area landslide record and rainfall data; extracting useful information in a real-time early warning record, wherein the useful information comprises a plurality of rainfall parameters and landslide triggering or not, then carrying out sample marking on the early warning record according to the landslide triggering or not, if the landslide occurs, marking the occurrence probability as 100%, otherwise marking as 0%, taking the occurrence probability of the landslide on the area as pre-training data, fitting the relation between the rainfall parameters and the occurrence probability of the landslide according to the occurrence probability of the landslide under a certain rainfall event in the slope through a machine learning model, dynamically updating the rainfall threshold of a risk slope, and issuing landslide early warning to the risk slope according to the updated rainfall threshold, so as to generate a new early warning record. The application has high early warning accuracy and can meet the disaster prevention and reduction requirements under the current weather change and earthquake frequency estrus.
assignees: UNIV CHINA GEOSCIENCES WUHAN;ZHEJIANG GEOLOGICAL INST

title_en: Hydraulic engineering construction operation parameter optimization and data management method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydraulic engineering construction operation parameter optimization and data management method and system, wherein the method comprises the following steps of 1, multi-source data access and vectorization; step 2, time sequence feature extraction and multi-mode fusion, step 3, interpretive influence factor identification, step 4, multi-task dynamic anomaly prediction, step 5, risk weighted fusion and uncertainty quantification, step 6, digital twin simulation verification, step 7, treatment strategy optimization and safety audit, and step 8, feedback acquisition and model self-adaptive update. The method has the advantages that the multi-mode unified characterization is constructed by fusing structured data such as water level, flow and the like with unstructured information such as meteorological images, operation and maintenance logs and the like, and the time sequence characteristic extraction is carried out by combining a space-time diagram neural network, so that the dynamic sensing and prediction capability of a complex hydrologic process is remarkably improved, the transition from static threshold alarming to multi-task and prospective abnormal early warning is realized, and the adaptability of the system to multiple scenes is enhanced.
assignees: HENGLONG GAOLU CONSULTING YINGJIANG CO LTD

title_en: Collaborative optimization and safety early warning system for building construction
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of building construction safety monitoring and management, and discloses a collaborative optimization and safety early warning system for building construction. The dynamic risk modeling module constructs a multisource risk factor matrix based on the standardized data and calculates a composite risk score. The dynamic threshold generation module generates a security load dynamic threshold in combination with the material process and the environmental data. The behavior risk identification module analyzes the relevance of the personnel behaviors and the risk areas. The response scheduling optimization module generates an optimal response path scheme based on the risk score and the early warning signal. The system linkage control module coordinates the multi-level control and dynamically updates the system parameters. According to the invention, through multi-source data fusion, dynamic threshold adjustment and self-adaptive weight algorithm, accurate risk assessment and intelligent emergency dispatch are realized, a closed-loop safety management system is constructed, construction monitoring instantaneity is improved, and accident rate is reduced.
assignees: ZHEJIANG PROVINCIAL ERJIAN CONSTRUCTION GROUP LTD

title_en: Energy gallery forest fire risk prediction method and system based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses an energy gallery forest fire risk prediction method and system based on multi-source data fusion, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a fusion data set and determining risk evolution parameters; triggering a vegetation difference analysis function if the risk evolution parameter exceeds a preset threshold value to obtain a section heterogeneity label, carrying out space-time heterogeneity compensation correction on historical data through a time sequence change tracking method after the section heterogeneity label is obtained, calculating the risk transition probability of each section, judging potential critical points, activating a difference early warning mechanism if the potential critical points are judged to be high probability, generating a targeted risk grade map according to the section heterogeneity label and the risk transition probability to obtain a dynamic early warning signal, carrying out iterative verification on the dynamic early warning signal by adopting a real-time update flow in a fusion data set, and combining the prediction output of a long-term and short-term memory network to adjust the risk grade to determine a final risk prediction result. The method and the device improve the timeliness and accuracy of fire risk prediction.

title_en: Method for building self-built unmanned aerial vehicle emergency command platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of live broadcasting of unmanned aerial vehicles, and particularly discloses a method for constructing an emergency command platform of a self-built unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises the following steps of generating a logic channel according to a mobile network interface which is identified and connected with available mobile network interfaces; the method comprises the steps of generating a push code which is associated with a task session and limits the validity period and distributing the push code to an unmanned aerial vehicle remote control equipment end application program, wherein the unmanned aerial vehicle remote control equipment end application program sends audio and video data to a streaming media server through a logical channel based on the push code and a push entry point address, a general computing device deploys streaming media server software and integrates a penetrating service adaptation layer, a user terminal inputs a playing address to establish the session and receives audio and video data, and the user terminal decodes and presents the audio and video data. The invention realizes stable pushing of the audio and video data of the unmanned aerial vehicle through the multilink combination, the self-built streaming media and the penetrating adaptation layer, has low cost investment and flexible configuration, can rapidly dock the existing platform, and meets the real-time transmission requirement of the emergency command scene.
assignees: WUHAN HUANCHENG OPERATION AND MAINTENANCE CONSTRUCTION GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Forest fire alarm system based on remote sensing
abstract_en: Aiming at the problems of incomplete coverage, early warning lag, high false alarm rate, lack of an optimization mechanism and the like in the traditional forest fire monitoring, the invention provides a forest fire alarm system based on remote sensing. The system comprises a perception layer, a decision layer and a verification and feedback layer, wherein the perception layer acquires multi-mode data through the cooperation of a geostationary orbit satellite group, a low orbit satellite constellation and an unmanned aerial vehicle/high altitude pseudolite, the decision layer quantifies original data into abnormal indexes, hierarchical early warning is realized through a fluid mechanics-chemical reaction coupling model and a deep neural network, the verification and feedback layer confirms in situ through the unmanned aerial vehicle to form true value data, model parameters are adjusted for false alarm/missing report backtracking, and a case is used as a sample to update the neural network to form closed loop learning. The system realizes early-stage precursor recognition and accurate early warning of fire, and improves the timeliness and accuracy of prevention and control.

title_en: Flood control early warning decision-making system and method based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood control early warning decision-making system and method based on artificial intelligence, which relate to the technical field of flood control data monitoring and comprise a target monitoring area marking module, a target sensor marking module, a reconstruction sensor group generating module, a priority analysis module and an early warning response switching module; the flood control system comprises a target monitoring area marking module, a target sensor marking module, a reconstruction sensor group generating module, an early warning response switching module and an optimal level redundant sensor function switching module, wherein the target monitoring area marking module is used for marking a flood control monitoring area which is used for storing and recording flood events and is provided with no redundant sensor in all sensor devices, the target sensor marking module is used for outputting and marking a sensor with physical damage as a target sensor, the reconstruction sensor group generating module is used for generating a reconstruction sensor group taking the target sensor as a main sensor, the early warning response switching module is used for carrying out replacement reminding when an isolated sensor responds to damage abnormality in an early warning event, and the optimal level redundant sensor function switching is carried out when a sensor to be updated responds to the damage abnormality in the early warning event.
assignees: Shandong Yellow River Information Center of Shandong Yellow River Bureau

title_en: Local artificial intelligence earthquake sand liquefaction deformation prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a local artificial intelligence earthquake sand liquefaction deformation prediction method and a system, which relate to the technical field of geological disaster prediction and comprise the steps of obtaining multi-source geological data; the method comprises the steps of extracting 3-5Hz soil body frequency domain characteristics through wavelet packet decomposition, fusing DEM and historical liquefaction thermodynamic diagram to divide a deposition phase control unit, adopting a Bayesian constrained improved Kriging algorithm to generate a three-dimensional voxel model, combining real-time vibration main frequency offset to construct four-dimensional space-time tensors, inputting the tensors into a local self-adaptive graph rolling network, dynamically adjusting convolution kernel weights through a space-time attention mechanism, synchronously outputting a prediction result, triggering increment learning based on MEMS acceleration and FBG strain data, correcting unliquefaction area prediction values and feeding back to the voxel model, and finally generating a probability disaster chain scene tree through space pattern matching. The invention solves the technical bottleneck that the traditional model has poor adaptability in complex deposition environment and can not be updated in real time, and provides intelligent early warning support for the engineering safety of the earthquake active region.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Urban waterlogging weather risk monitoring and early warning system and method based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of meteorological monitoring and early warning, and discloses an urban waterlogging meteorological risk monitoring and early warning method based on multi-source data fusion, which comprises the steps of acquiring multi-source data of a set monitoring area and preprocessing the multi-source data; the method comprises the steps of constructing an urban waterlogging risk assessment index system according to the preprocessed multi-source data, calculating the weight of each specific index in the index system by adopting a DEMATEL-ANP combined method, dividing risk grades for each grid unit in a set monitoring area by utilizing fuzzy comprehensive evaluation, setting an early warning threshold grading table, calculating the area occupation ratio of each risk grade, and searching corresponding early warning grades by combining meteorological data. According to the invention, small-scale fine risk identification is realized by deeply fusing multiple types of data and coupling scientific assessment models, real-time data is combined to dynamically update and early-warn, an affected area and a disaster-bearing body are accurately positioned, the accuracy, the early-warn dynamics and the practicability of waterlogging weather risk monitoring are comprehensively improved, and the urban disaster prevention and reduction capability is effectively enhanced.

title_en: Mariculture area risk assessment method and device
abstract_en: The application provides a risk assessment method and a risk assessment device for a mariculture area, which are used for realizing the joint simulation of various power elements such as deep water topography, an atmospheric forced field, a typhoon moving path, a tide boundary, sea water temperature and salt flow and the like by constructing a multi-dimensional power element coupling simulation model, so that more real and fine marine environment characteristic information can be obtained. By carrying out bidirectional data exchange between the wind wave model and the hydrodynamic model, key parameters such as wave radiation stress, tide speed, tide level and the like can be synchronously updated, so that the simulation precision under extreme sea conditions is remarkably improved.
