On the basis, the method combines the differential characteristics of the cultured organisms and the physical disaster-bearing entities to respectively determine the risk levels of the cultured organisms and the physical disaster-bearing entities, and further generates the comprehensive risk assessment result facing the target area, so that the actual risk condition can be reflected more accurately, and the scientificity and reliability of disaster early warning and management decision of the mariculture area are improved.

title_en: Geological disaster prediction and early warning method and system combining monitoring data and numerical simulation
abstract_en: The invention provides a geological disaster prediction and early warning method and system combining monitoring data and numerical simulation, which relate to the technical field of geological disaster early warning, the invention forms a standardized data matrix by laying a plurality of sensors in a geological disaster prone area and preprocessing the data, constructs a catastrophe structure map, calculates the side weight of each variable as a map node, generates a sparse weighted adjacent matrix through threshold screening, updates node characteristics by adopting a neural network, the current catastrophe state is identified through the probability distribution of the full-connection layer output catastrophe stage, the coupling strength index is calculated, similarity matching is carried out, the coupling strength and the structural similarity are comprehensively evaluated, the graph migration weight is obtained, the critical variable threshold value and the time are further predicted, the critical parameter and the neural network identification result are fused to construct a unified risk index model, early warning information and corresponding measures are issued according to the risk grade division, and the structural fusion and dynamic intelligent identification of the multi-source data are realized.
assignees: UNIV CHONGQING THREE GORGES;CHONGQING INST GEOLOGY & MINERAL RESOURCES

title_en: Earthquake early warning analysis system based on intelligent monitoring equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an earthquake early warning analysis system based on intelligent monitoring equipment, relates to the technical field of earthquake monitoring and early warning, and is used for solving the problems of low earthquake focus positioning precision and poor early warning timeliness of a traditional early warning system; the method realizes rapid identification and accurate early warning of the seismic event by constructing a multisource data fusion and intelligent analysis mechanism, the system collects triaxial acceleration data of intelligent monitoring equipment nodes distributed at different geographic positions, generates a standardized acceleration time sequence, calculates a wave field coherence coefficient, constructs a seismic event validity map, positions the primary position of the seismic source and a key propagation path, combines signal-to-noise ratio dynamic weight, geologic structure characteristics and propagation direction angles to generate an early warning decision matrix in a minimum error range, avoids early warning delay caused by global rearrangement, and the system links wave field real-time deduction and risk dynamic evaluation to form a closed-loop early warning release process, so that the stability, self-adaption capability and response efficiency of early warning are improved under a complex geological environment.

title_en: Notification system when changing to a departure signal while stopped at an intersection signal
title_ko: 교차로 신호대기 정차 중 출발신호로 변경시 알림시스템
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 교차로 신호대기 정차 중 출발신호로 변경시 알려주는 시스템에 관한 것으로서,  
교차로에 설치되어 신호를 주관하는 하는 신호제어기(10)를 기반으로,  
상기 신호제어기(10)와 유·무선으로 연결되어 실시간 신호변경 데이터를 전송받는 구획별 신호정보송출기(20)(20-1 내지 20-n)를 구성하되,  
교차로를 중심으로 각 구획별 신호정보송출기(20)는 해당 구획(G)(G-1 내지 G-n)에 신호 대기로 정지된 차량에 대하여 출발신호(직진, 좌회전)로 변경시 해당 구획(G)에 정차된 차량들로 전파을 발생시기키도록 구성하고,  
차량 내에는 단말기(30)를 구비하여 해당 구획(G)에 신호 대기로 정차 중 해당 구획(G)에 설치된 신호정보송출기(20)에서 전송하는 전파를 수신함에 따른 출발신호바뀜을 알려주도록 한 것이다.

title_en: Cable channel fire parameter monitoring and temperature-oxygen-smoke collaborative early warning method
abstract_en: The application relates to a cable channel fire parameter monitoring and temperature-oxygen-smoke collaborative early warning method, a device, computer equipment, a computer readable storage medium and a computer program product, which can be used in the technical field of computers. The method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-parameter monitoring data in a cable channel, carrying out feature recognition processing on the multi-parameter monitoring data to obtain multi-parameter feature information, wherein the multi-parameter feature information comprises temperature field space-time evolution feature information, oxygen consumption feature information, combustion intensity feature information and smoke feature information, inputting the multi-parameter feature information into a fire state recognition model to carry out fire state recognition processing to obtain a fire state recognition result, generating early warning and emergency information of the cable channel according to the fire state recognition result and the multi-parameter feature information, and the early warning and emergency information comprises multi-stage early warning information, fire development trend prediction information and an evacuation path update scheme. By adopting the method, the early warning accuracy of the cable channel fire disaster can be improved.
assignees: SHENZHEN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG

title_en: Urban disaster risk studying and judging method and device
abstract_en: A city disaster risk studying and judging method and device comprises the steps of obtaining a weather early warning area according to weather early warning information, obtaining a flood early warning area according to water condition early warning, carrying out space superposition on the weather early warning area and the flood early warning area to determine a city area to be studied and judged, constructing a city disaster risk keyword library, distinguishing flood caused by heavy rain, geological disasters and secondary disaster risks thereof, constructing a large language model risk studying and judging prompt word, obtaining information about the heavy rain in social media, extracting disaster risk information from the information, obtaining potential extension risk semantic indexes according to the disaster risk information, obtaining and quantifying abnormal information in city mobile phone signaling before and after the heavy rain and traffic speed data of a floating car GPS, obtaining potential extension risk human activity indexes according to the abnormal degree, constructing a city disaster chain semantic association network according to a causal association method, fusing multi-source data to update disaster evolution situation in real time, and outputting disaster information and possibly derived secondary disaster prediction.
assignees: THE NATIONAL NATURAL DISASTER PREVENTION AND CONTROL RES INSTITUTE OF EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT DEPARTMEN

title_en: Cloud-edge cooperation-based intelligent safety monitoring and diagnosis system for water conservancy facilities
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of cloud edge coordination, in particular to an intelligent safety monitoring and diagnosing system for water conservancy facilities based on cloud edge coordination. The system comprises a filtering prediction unit, an early warning risk unit and an error optimization unit. According to the invention, the original water level data is denoised to obtain filtered water level data, adjacent 2-minute speed-up data is calculated and packaged, the LSTM time sequence prediction model feature set is constructed by the packaged data, the phenomenon that the edge end only uploads the original data is avoided, the uploaded data amount is reduced, the data transmission efficiency is improved, meanwhile, the load of cloud processing data is reduced, the cloud can concentrate on the analysis of key data, and when the analysis of the key data is concentrated, the time forgetting gate output, the input gate, the candidate cell state update value, the cell state and the output gate are calculated, so that the cloud processed data is more refined, the unnecessary calculation amount is reduced, the response can be made faster, and the cloud analysis efficiency is improved.
assignees: NINGBO HONGTAI WATER CONSERVANCY INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Rainfall landslide early warning method based on multi-source environment threshold and nonlinear fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rainfall type landslide early warning method based on multi-source environment threshold and nonlinear fusion, which comprises the following steps of constructing a landslide disaster-causing factor set, introducing soil humidity, vegetation index and evapotranspiration, calculating threshold parameters corresponding to rainfall type landslide events to obtain an environment threshold point set, constructing and training a landslide susceptibility model based on progressive learning according to the landslide disaster-causing factor set, adopting a double-layer nonlinear fusion model based on multi-source data fusion and quality perception gating, combining the landslide susceptibility model to obtain comprehensive risk probability distribution, and carrying out grading early warning based on the comprehensive risk probability distribution to finish rainfall type landslide early warning. The method is based on traditional rainfall parameters, introduces early-stage disaster-pregnant environmental factors to form a multi-source environmental threshold, adopts fuzzy logic reasoning to realize nonlinear fusion of threshold information and landslide susceptibility base map, combines with a annual iteration updated susceptibility map layer to dynamically reflect the regional environmental condition evolution process, and realizes more refined and adaptive space grading early warning.
assignees: HUNAN SHUANGPAI PUMPED STORAGE CO LTD;State grid hunan electric power co ltd;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Subway construction period emergency resource management and allocation method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of emergency resource management in an iron construction period, in particular to a method and a system for managing and allocating emergency resources in the subway construction period, which comprises the steps of establishing a route map of an existing subway route, counting the types, the quantity and the coordinates of resources of an emergency resource warehouse, constructing a resource map, setting accident grades according to the accident types, determining required resources under each grade, determining the required resources according to the accident types and the grades when the emergency occurs, formulating a deployment scheme by combining a resource map, and informing a manager of the emergency and the deployment scheme to realize rapid deployment of the resources. According to the invention, accurate matching is realized by presetting an emergency resource list and combining with real-time engineering progress, emergency information is updated regularly to ensure accurate aging, the map realizes visual management, and the response sensitivity is improved by linkage of automatic monitoring and early warning, so that the emergency command and dispatch is more convenient, and the emergency response efficiency is effectively improved.
assignees: DALIAN PUBLIC TRANSP CONSTRUCTION INVESTMENT GROUP CO LTD;DALIAN PUBLIC TRANSP CONSTRUCTION DEVELOPMENT CO LTD;BEIJING AGILETECH ENG CONSULTANTS CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic assignment method for microseism analysis task for multiple coal mines
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic assignment method of microseismic analysis tasks for multiple coal mines, which is used for solving the problems of low distributed processing efficiency and high delay rate of the traditional microseismic analysis tasks. The method generates microseismic analysis tasks based on microseismic events uploaded in real time by each mine, and establishes a heterogeneous parallel machine assignment scheduling model aiming at minimizing the number of delay tasks by combining the available time window and processing capacity of analysts. And generating a scheduling scheme by adopting a scheduling algorithm based on the task sequence, and optimizing the scheduling scheme by adopting a genetic algorithm. After the task is completed, the system updates the analyst load and the time window. The method has the advantages of obviously reducing the task delay rate and improving the calculation efficiency while ensuring the rationality of task scheduling, has good expansibility and practicality, and can be widely applied to the scenes such as coal mine microseism monitoring, disaster early warning and the like.

title_en: Digital twinning-based falling stone slope geological early warning device and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a digital twinning-based falling stone slope geological early warning device and method, and relates to the technical field of slope geological early warning. The digital twin module builds a mechanical twin model, combines standard data to dynamically update to form a digital twin body, accurately re-inscribes the slope state, and the early warning decision module realizes hierarchical early warning through a risk assessment system. The whole closed loop of the full link of perception, transmission, modeling and early warning is formed, the problems of fragmentation, strong artificial dependence and actual pain point of static modeling dislocation of traditional early warning data are solved, the transition from passive response to active prejudgment is realized, the on-site quick response and global accurate analysis are balanced, and the accuracy, instantaneity and actual combat of early warning of a falling rock slope are improved.
assignees: THE 5TH ENG CO LTD OF CHINA RAILWAY 22ND BUREAU GROUP;CHINA RAILWAY 22ND BUREAU GROUP CO LTD;UNIV GUILIN ELECTRONIC TECH;THE FIFTH CIVIL ENG CO LTD OF CREC SHANGHAI GROUP

title_en: system
abstract_en: A system is provided.SOLUTION: A system comprising: means for collecting and storing a daily behavior pattern of a user; means for receiving disaster information in real time; means for specifying a user in a target area based on the received disaster information; means for collecting latest data (position information, last update time, surrounding user information, and radio wave reception status) of the user when a disaster occurs; and means for issuing a safety confirmation alert to a notification destination registered in advance when the degree of risk exceeds a predetermined threshold.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Ecological environment detection method and device based on multi-source data and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, in particular to an ecological environment detection method, device and storage medium based on multi-source data, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting space distribution parameters and environment stress parameters; the method comprises the steps of constructing an intrusion space index based on a target plaque area and a target plaque boundary perimeter, constructing a habitat stress index according to a daily inundation time length and root system soil salinity, constructing a diffusion risk factor according to a plaque area of an associated area of a target plaque, constructing a risk index based on the diffusion risk factor, the intrusion space index and the habitat stress index, constructing a plaque treatment priority, constructing an adjustment coefficient according to a crown temperature daily difference, constructing an update coefficient according to a seed removal rate and the adjustment coefficient, and updating the plaque treatment priority based on the update coefficient and the target plaque area. The invention realizes the accurate diagnosis, risk early warning and scientific sequencing of the treatment priorities of the spartina alterniflora invasion situation.
assignees: ZHEJIANG ZEYI TESTING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Disaster broadcasting terminal firmware update system for enhancing service safety and reliability
title_ko: 서비스 안전성 및 신뢰도를 높인 긴급방송용 단말기의 펌웨어 업데이트 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 각 가정에 설치되어 긴급방송을 출력하는 긴급방송용 단말기에 설치되는 소프트웨어의 펌웨어 업데이트 작업이 무선통신망을 통해 자동으로 이루어지도록 운영됨과 동시에 관제센터서버가 각 긴급방송용 단말기의 로그데이터를 분석하여, 동작 모드를 ‘수동모드’ 또는 ‘능동모드’로 분류한 후, 분류된 동작 모드에 따라 펌웨어 업데이트의 최적시간(t)을 결정하도록 구성됨으로써 펌웨어 업데이트로 인한 방송 서비스의 장애, 에러 및 오류를 현저히 절감시켜, 방송 서비스의 품질을 극대화할 뿐만 아니라 펌웨어 업데이트의 안전성 및 신뢰도를 높일 수 있으며, 사용자의 조작 없이 자동으로 펌웨어 업데이트 및 동작모드 분류 등의 연산처리가 이루어져 사용 편의성을 개선할 수 있는 긴급방송용 단말기의 펌웨어 업데이트 시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Fire fighter fire extinguishing protective clothing identification method and system based on AI artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of protective clothing identification, in particular to a fire-fighting protective clothing identification method and system based on AI artificial intelligence firefighters. The method comprises the steps of S1, collecting body type data of a firefighter and protective clothing data of fire extinguishment equipment of the firefighter, S2, accessing a video monitoring module of a rescue place, then establishing a three-dimensional space model of the rescue place by combining the video monitoring module, collecting video recording data of the firefighter at the rescue place, and sending the video recording data to the three-dimensional space model for supplementing, accurately obtaining key vital sign data such as temperature, humidity and heart rate of the firefighter in the protective clothing through a built-in sensor by monitoring the performance parameters of the protective clothing in real time, and immediately giving an early warning once the data exceeds a safety threshold value, so that the firefighter can know own situation danger in the first time, withdraw replacement equipment in time or take corresponding protective measures, and life safety of the firefighter in fire extinguishment rescue actions is practically ensured.
assignees: U PROTEC SHENZHEN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Its-based tunnel firefighting and communication facilities status inspection and emergency response methods, devices, and systems
title_ko: Its 기반 터널 소방 및 통신 설비의 상태 점검 및 긴급 대응 방법, 장치 및 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 ITS 기반 터널 소방 및 통신 설비의 상태 점검 및 긴급 대응 방법, 장치 및 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 터널을 주행하는 차량의 감지 및 온도를 감지하는 복수의 카메라 장치와, 터널 외부 공기를 흡입하여 터널 내 공기를 환기시키는 복수의 환기 장치와, 터널 내부에서 차량의 진행방향 및 역방향을 향해 광원을 발산하는 조명장치와, 전압을 변환하는 트랜스포머를 통해 축전되는 배터리에 연결된 전력선을 제어 및 상기 배터리로부터 전력을 제공받는 비상용 통화 수화기와 외부에 움직이는 물체의 위치를 검출하는 위치검출센서가 구비된 비상전력장치 및 상기 카메라 장치에서 차량 정보를 제공받아 터널 내부 차량 트래픽에 대한 데이터를 생성하고, 트래픽 데이터에 따라 상기 환기 장치를 터널 내부로 돌출되는 면적을 제어하여 내부 공기를 순환시키며, 상기 카메라 장치에서 제공받은 온도가 기설정된 온도값보다 높고, 차량의 속도가 기설정된 속도값보다 낮으면 기설정된 상기 카메라 장치에 대한 위치를 외부 기관에 제공하여 터널내 비상상황을 통보하되, 터널 내 전력선의 전압차를 감시하여 전압차가 없는 경우 전력선의 전원을 배터리로 연결하여 배터리를 축전시키면서 상기 카메라 장치 및 상기 환기 장치, 조명장치에 전원을 공급하고, 전력선에 전압차가 발생된 경우, 상기 배터리의 전원을 연결하는 전원감시부와, 변환된 전원을 상기 조명장치로 공급하여 점등시키고, 상기 카메라 장치의 감지신호에 따라 메모리에 저장된 안내멘트를 출력하고, 상기 위치검출센서가 상기 비상전력장치에 근접한 구조대상자와의 위치를 측정하여 거리 및 방위를 검출하여 상기 비상전력장치까지의 거리 및 방위를 역산하여 음성으로 출력하여 구조대상자를 대피소로 유도하며, 상기 카메라 장치를 통해 터널 내 영상을 외부 기관으로 전송하는 대피소알림부와, 상기 카메라 장치로부터 획득한 구조대상자의 터널 내 위치, 인원 및 미리 지정된 터널 내 위치를 기반으로 상기 카메라 장치에서 획득한 차량 식별 정보를 기반으로 차량에서 하차하는 운전자 및 동승자를 구조대상자로 식별 정보를 변경하고, 우선 대피소로 안내하는 적어도 하나의 구조대상자별 채널을 확인하여 구조대상자에 대한 구조 채널을 기설정된 채널로 자동으로 선택하는 채널설정부를 포함한 드론 구조부를 포함하는 제어장치;를 포함하여, 전력의 비정상적인 상황에서도 전력 공급을 원활하게 하여 카메라 및 환기, 조명 등의 필수 설비를 안정적으로 운영하여 터널 내에서의 위험을 최소화하여 긴급 대응의 신뢰성과 연속성을 확보할 수 있고, 카메라 및 환기, 조명 장치 등을 사용하여 터널 내에서 화재 또는 사고 발생시에도 통신 및 구조 작업을 외부 관리자에 의해 긴급하게 관여할 수 있어 구조 과정을 효율적으로 관리할 수 있으며, 드론을 우선적으로 출격시켜 구조대상자를 대피소로 안전하게 이동시킬 수 있기 때문에 2차 사고를 방지할 수 있고, 드론으로 구조대상자를 대피소로 이동시키는데 있어서 이동 경로 중 장애물 회피 기동 및 대피소까지의 최소 이동시간을 드론과 관리자가 실시간으로 변경 가능하여 안전한 이동 경로를 제공할 수 있기 때문에 이동 시간 단축 및 최적의 구조 경로를 제공할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Vehicle collision avoidance and mitigation system
abstract_en: A vehicle is configured to be positioned upstream of traffic relative to a scene to protect personnel responding to the scene. The vehicle includes a collision avoidance and mitigation system configured to alert personnel on the scene of a threat caused by an approaching vehicle and/or alert the driver of the approaching vehicle of the scene. The collision avoidance and mitigation system is configured to determine a restricted zone around the vehicle. The restricted zone is determined by detecting scene markers or personnel at the scene or the restricted zone can be entered via a user interface. The restricted zone can be updated as the scene markers are deployed or personnel move around the scene. An alert is generated responsive to a threat score related to the probability of the approaching vehicle entering the restricted zone exceeding a threshold.

title_en: Intelligent management method for self-rescuer
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of safety equipment management, and discloses an intelligent management method of a self-rescuer, which comprises the following steps of firstly, configuring an identification unit; the method comprises the following steps of deploying an intelligent terminal, processing and storing data, managing platform operation and early warning mechanism. The system realizes intelligent management of the self-rescuer, reduces manual operation, improves management efficiency and accuracy, avoids misrecording, can monitor state information such as quantity, distribution, validity and the like of the self-rescuer in real time, has an early warning function, can timely early warn abnormal conditions such as about to expire, realizes full life cycle tracking management, is convenient to trace, and can enable a manager to quickly inquire the position and quantity of the available self-rescuer through a platform under emergency conditions, thereby improving emergency response capability.
assignees: XIAN ZHONGZHUANG WEIKEN ELECTRIC CO LTD

title_en: Distributed multi-agent cooperative scheduling and dynamic trust method based on MCP protocol
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of distributed agent cooperative scheduling and discloses a distributed multi-agent cooperative scheduling and dynamic trust method based on MCP protocol, which comprises the steps of deploying an emergency strategy network for each agent, acquiring a situation state vector containing uncertainty parameters, outputting action probability distribution and randomly sampling to determine a decision; the invention gets scalar rewarding signal after execution, calculates gradient updating vector, broadcasts gradient updating vector through MCP bus, and updates local network weight after federation fusion, gets rid of dependence on static cost assumption, makes agent learn and evolve cooperative strategy independently in interaction with uncertain environment, and internalizes trust into one emerging attribute of strategy network, thus realizing unification of scheduling and reliability.

title_en: Disaster emergency treatment method and system based on large event awareness
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster emergency treatment method and a disaster emergency treatment system based on large event awareness, which relate to the technical field of disaster emergency treatment in the sanitation industry and comprise the steps of collecting multi-source heterogeneous data according to a set collection period; the method comprises the steps of acquiring multi-source heterogeneous data corresponding to historical large disaster events, extracting disaster abnormal characteristics, training a large disaster event perception model based on the disaster abnormal characteristics, constructing a large disaster event knowledge base, obtaining large disaster event early warning information according to the acquired multi-source heterogeneous data, the large disaster event perception model and the large disaster event knowledge base, matching a corresponding emergency treatment plan from a pre-constructed emergency treatment plan base according to the large disaster event early warning information, re-planning an environmental sanitation vehicle route, obtaining a corresponding emergency treatment plan according to the re-planned environmental sanitation vehicle route and the corresponding emergency treatment plan, monitoring the corresponding emergency treatment plan in real time, and generating feedback information to update the corresponding emergency treatment plan.

title_en: Fire-fighting bus response method and system based on dynamic priority and collision avoidance
abstract_en: The invention provides a fire control bus response method and a fire control bus response system based on dynamic priority and collision avoidance, wherein the fire control bus response method and the fire control bus response system comprise the steps that a controller broadcasts an inquiry command through a fire control bus, each detector receives the inquiry command, then determines a priority basic value according to acquired information, a preset address of the detector and a current state, calculates dynamic response delay time, starts timing, monitors the fire control bus while waiting for the dynamic response delay time, if the fire control bus is monitored to be idle before the expiration of the dynamic response delay time, the detector sends a response message to the controller through the fire control bus, if the fire control bus is monitored to be occupied before the expiration of the dynamic response delay time, the detector pauses timing and executes a backoff algorithm, and then sends the response message after waiting for additional waiting time, and the controller monitors the bus, receives and analyzes the response message of the detector to determine the state. The invention has the advantages of high response speed, capability of distinguishing alarm priority and high communication reliability.

title_en: Dynamic discrimination method for rock burst tendency
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of geotechnical engineering and geological disaster monitoring, in particular to a dynamic discrimination method for rock burst tendencies, which aims to solve the limitation caused by the fact that the dynamic evolution process is simplified into quasi-static properties in the traditional rock burst tendencies evaluation. According to the application, rock burst tendency is defined as a hidden state variable evolving along with time, a physical constraint state space model comprising a hidden state dynamics equation and a multi-mode observation equation is constructed, continuous stress strain and discrete acoustic emission data are fused, hidden state probability distribution is estimated in real time through online Bayesian inference, a future state track is predicted and risk probability exceeding a critical threshold is calculated by combining self-adaptive information weight update and physical consistency constraint, and a dynamic rock burst tendency grade is output. Through the scheme, the method and the device realize continuous, dynamic and prospective discrimination of the rock burst tendency, and improve the accuracy and reliability of early warning.
assignees: EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT DEPARTMENT INFORMATION RESEARCH INST COAL INFORMATION INST

title_en: Landslide surge prediction method and system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide surge prediction method based on digital twinning, and relates to the technical field of geological disaster related fields. The method comprises the following steps of 1, realizing a digital model of a physical entity by a physical layer L1, 2, calculating the stability of a landslide and landslide surge by the model layer based on related data of the physical layer, 3, carrying out early warning prediction decision on a calculation result of a decision layer base model layer, and 4, carrying out new prediction calculation to evaluate an updated plan and disaster prevention measure effect. According to the invention, the physical layer is used for sensing the states of the rock mass and the water body of the landslide surge hidden danger point in real time, and the model layer is updated in real time by utilizing the information interaction capability of the digital twin model, so that the calculation model can perform simulation calculation according to the real working condition of the landslide surge hidden danger point, and further, the landslide surge hidden danger point can be more accurately early-warned and predicted. The invention also relates to a landslide surge prediction system based on digital twinning.

title_en: Method, system, equipment and medium for pushing weather forecast of short-coming disasters
abstract_en: The application relates to a method, a system, equipment and a medium for pushing weather forecast of an impending disaster. The method comprises the steps of collecting weather radar echo intensity data and ground observation station weather data, grouping the radar echo intensity data through a Maring Square algorithm to generate longitude and latitude contour lines, carrying out validity filtering on all the groups, calculating a weather signal of the earth, constructing a weather signal time sequence, judging the starting and stopping time of strong weather to generate a strong weather mark signal, carrying out AI prediction, optical flow extrapolation prediction and Kalman filtering fusion processing on the basis of the strong weather mark signal, the radar echo intensity data and an effective group set to obtain a fusion prediction result diagram, calculating a precipitation rate and a maximum accumulated precipitation value through converting precipitation intensity processing on the basis of the diagram and the longitude and latitude contour lines, and generating an early warning instruction by combining a preset grading threshold. The method improves the accuracy and timeliness of the weather forecast of the short-coming disasters by means of AI prediction, optical flow extrapolation processing and the like.

title_en: Data processing method and system of wireless passive temperature sensor
abstract_en: A data processing method and system of a wireless passive temperature sensor comprise four stages of preprocessing of a data acquisition layer, dynamic filtering of edge nodes, cloud self-adaptive calibration and intelligent early warning, wherein multi-dimensional temperature characteristic parameters are extracted through orthogonal demodulation, singular values are removed through double windows, a filtering algorithm is dynamically switched based on noise statistics characteristics to achieve anti-interference and low-delay balance, a multi-dimensional drift compensation model is built, calibration parameters are dynamically updated through a particle swarm optimization algorithm, and a four-level early warning mechanism is built based on absolute temperature, change rate and fluctuation degree. The system comprises a sensing layer, an edge layer, a cloud layer and an application layer, and realizes data acquisition-processing-calibration-early warning full-link coordination. The invention solves the problems of signal distortion, poor filter adaptability, insufficient drift compensation and stiff early warning in the prior art, and is suitable for long-term precise monitoring of special scenes such as high-voltage equipment, rotating machinery and the like.
assignees: UNIV CHINA GEOSCIENCES BEIJING;AVIC BEIJING PRECISION ENGINEERING INST FOR AIRCRAFT INDUSTRY

title_en: Landslide prediction and early warning method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The application belongs to the field of landslide early warning and risk management and control research, and particularly discloses a landslide prediction and early warning method based on deep learning, which comprises the following steps of dividing rainfall events, marking positive events and negative events, and dividing historical landslide data into an initial landslide set and a newly-added landslide set; generating an initial landslide vulnerability map, updating the initial landslide vulnerability map based on a new landslide set, generating an updated landslide vulnerability map, constructing a deep learning sample set, training and predicting a comprehensive sample set by using a deep learning model, wherein the deep learning model comprises a convolutional neural network and a long-short-period memory network, the deep pregnancy disaster environment characteristic in multidimensional static space data of the convolutional neural network is used for extracting dynamic time sequence characteristics, and the long-short-period memory network is used for outputting landslide probability through a classifier after fusing the two characteristics. The application can realize high-precision and dynamically updated rainfall landslide probability prediction and provides direct decision support for landslide early warning.
assignees: UNIV CHINA GEOSCIENCES WUHAN;ZHEJIANG GEOLOGICAL INST

title_en: Data processing method based on three-dimensional geological modeling
abstract_en: The application discloses a data processing method based on three-dimensional geologic modeling, which comprises the steps of forming a multi-scale geologic data pool by constructing a macro-medium-micro three-level geologic data acquisition system and adopting coordinate unification and format standardization, generating a multi-resolution three-dimensional geologic model based on a layered dynamic fusion architecture and combining a weighting algorithm and a cross-scale calibration technology, realizing incremental dynamic update of the model by means of an Internet of things sensor network and edge computing nodes, and finally generating multi-level geologic hazard early warning by means of mechanical parameter threshold analysis and AR visualization technology. The method realizes the whole-flow closed-loop management from data acquisition to early warning generation, effectively solves the problem of fusion of multi-source heterogeneous geological data, remarkably improves the timeliness, accuracy and visualization level of geological disaster early warning, and provides reliable technical support for geological disaster prevention.
assignees: China railway 11th bureau group co ltd;CHINA RAILWAY 11TH BUREAU GROUP XIAN CONSTRUCTION CO LTD

title_en: Bridge water level warning system using LED lighting
title_ko: Led 조명을 통한 교량의 수위 경보 시스템
abstract_ko:
본 발명에 따른  LED 조명을 통한 교량의 수위 경보 시스템은, 교량의 보행자 통행 공간의 일 측에 설치된 LED 조명 장치; 상기 교량이 설치된 하천의 수위를 감지하는 수위 감지 센서; 및, 상기 수위 감지 센서에서 감지한 수위의 고저에 따라 상기 LED 조명 장치의 점등 색상을 변경 제어하는 컨트롤러;를 포함한 것을 특징으로 한다. 
본 발명에 따른 LED 조명을 통한 교량의 수위 경보 시스템에 의하면, 간단한 구조를 기반으로 실시간으로 하천 수위를 감지하고 즉각적인 시각적 경고를 제공하여 보행자와 운전자가 위험 상황에 빠르게 대응할 수 있는 효과를 가진다.
assignees: SEOWON UNIV INSTITUTE OF INDUSTRY ACADEMY COLLABORATION

title_en: (integrated control system for cctv)
title_ko: Cctv 관리감시시스템
abstract_ko: 종래의 CCTV 감시시스템과는 달리 CCTV의 고장유무를 자동적으로 모니터링할 뿐만 아니라, CCTV 녹화기록에의 접근유무를 탐지하여 녹화기록 조작을 감시하며, CCTV 설정변경을 추적하여 관리하는 CCTV를 감시하는 감시시스템이 개시되어 있다. 상기 목적을 달성하기 위해서 본 발명의 바람직한 일 실시 예에 따르면, 본 발명인  CCTV 관리감시시스템은 한 개 이상의 CCTV장치 ; 상기 CCTV장치의 영상을 수신하여 저장하는 녹화부 ; 상기 녹화부의 영상을 모니터로 현시하기 위한 디스플레이부 ; 상기 녹화부의 영상을 IP영상으로 변환하여 PC로 공유하기 위한 영상신호변환장치 ; 상기 영상신호변환장치를 통해 변환된 IP영상을 공유받는 PC ; 상기 PC내에 설치되어, 상기 영상신호변환장치와 연동되어 작동하는 영상분석 프로그램으로 이루어진다. 상술한 구성을 통해서, 본 발명인 CCTV를 감시하는 감시시스템은 종래의 CCTV 감시시스템과는 달리 인력을 배치하지 않고도 실시간 자동적으로 CCTV의 고장유무를 모니터링할 수 있어서 관리비용이 절감되고, CCTV감시 뿐만 아니라, 녹화기록의 삭제 또는 설정변경의 변화를 추적하여 감시할 수 있으며, CCTV고장, 무단 로그인 시도, 및 영상삭제시 관리자에 대한 즉각적인 알림발송이 가능하고, 모니터링을 위한 별도의 상황실, 서버, 인력배치 등이 불필요하게 함으로써 CCTV 모니터링을 저렴한 비용으로 운용할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Forestry environment monitoring method and system based on big data analysis
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of forestry environment monitoring, and discloses a forestry environment monitoring method and system based on big data analysis. The method comprises the steps of collecting multidimensional environmental parameters such as soil moisture content, vegetation coverage, meteorological factors and the like through a distributed sensor network, and generating real-time weight coefficients through a dynamic weight distribution engine. And 3, finishing abnormal detection by using a space-time correlation analysis model, and triggering a self-adaptive sampling strategy to acquire the abnormal region in high density. And integrating the real-time data and the satellite remote sensing data through a multi-source data fusion algorithm to generate a forestry environment state matrix, and dynamically updating the reference threshold value by combining an incremental learning mechanism. And generating a regulation instruction set for soil improvement, vegetation maintenance and disaster early warning according to the updated threshold value, and executing and collecting feedback data by the edge computing nodes. And comparing the feedback data with the expected index through a bidirectional verification mechanism, generating a system optimization parameter, and transmitting the system optimization parameter back to the dynamic weight distribution engine to realize accurate monitoring and efficient regulation of the forestry environment.
assignees: SHANDONG YOUPU INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD;JUXIAN YANZHUANG STREET ZHENXING AND PUBLIC CULTURE CENTER

title_en: Ocean disaster risk assessment method based on multi-parameter observation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of multi-parameter observation disaster early warning, and discloses a multi-parameter observation based marine disaster risk assessment method which is used for solving the problem that a fixed sampling frequency cannot react to an emergency in time, once a weather mutation or a marine environment abnormality occurs, a disaster assessment result is difficult to update in time by a traditional method, so that disaster early warning and emergency response are delayed. The method has high-efficiency disaster early warning and response capability, can maximally improve the data acquisition efficiency, optimize the system performance and reduce the resource waste.
assignees: SECOND INST OF OCEANOGRAPHY MNR;CHINA JILIANG UNIV COLLEGE OF MODERN SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Perception monitoring system and method based on intelligent helmet
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of artificial intelligent perception monitoring of safety helmets, and discloses a perception monitoring system based on an intelligent helmet; the system comprises a data acquisition module, a user behavior baseline modeling module, a perception monitoring module and an early warning response module, wherein user and environment data are acquired in real time through the data acquisition module and standardized pretreatment is carried out, the user behavior baseline modeling module establishes an individual initial behavior template through guided calibration, a baseline is dynamically updated through combination of active state identification and an index weighted moving average algorithm in use, the perception monitoring module carries out multidimensional risk assessment by calculating instantaneous deviation of real-time data and the baseline and fusing persistence and trend indexes to generate a grading early warning signal, the early warning response module carries out grading early warning response according to the grading early warning signal, the transition from passive protection to active self-adaptive monitoring is realized, and monitoring accuracy and emergency rescue efficiency are remarkably improved.
assignees: GUANGZHOU NIUWANG ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Medical consumable management system and method based on intelligent expiration manager
abstract_en: The invention discloses a medical consumable management system and a method based on an intelligent expiration date manager, which belong to the technical field of medical consumable management and comprise the intelligent expiration date manager and a mobile terminal, wherein the intelligent expiration date manager is added between a traditional locker and an electronic form to realize real-time bidirectional association of physical consumables and electronic information, each batch of consumables has independent identifiable marks and active early warning capability, a system can automatically remind near expiration dates of consumables, the current stock quantity of consumables and quickly position target consumables by means of a Bluetooth communication and audible and visual prompting mechanism, manual inspection and searching burden is greatly reduced, and an intelligent consumable management system with low cost, expandability, adaptation to the current situation of a department can be constructed on the premise that a complex WMS system is not required to be deployed, so that the problems of mixed placement of multiple batches, delay of expiration date management, low searching efficiency, asynchronous data and the like are fundamentally solved, and the safety, timeliness and working efficiency of consumable management are remarkably improved.

title_en: Public transportation notification system for the transportation disadvantaged
title_ko: 교통약자를 위한 대중교통 알림 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 교통약자를 위한 대중교통 알림 시스템은 대중교통내에 제어부가 좌석과 근접한 거리에 대상자 뱃지를 인식하여 상기 대상자 뱃지를 통해 교통약자에 대한 정보를 수신하는 A단계, 제어부를 통해 상기 대상자 뱃지의 유효성이 인정되는 경우 상기 대상자 뱃지와 접속하는 B단계, 상기 제어부가 상기 대상자 뱃지와 근접한 위치의 좌석이 알림 신호를 제공하는 C단계, 상기 제어부가 상기 교통약자가 착석한 상태에서 알림 신호를 해제 요청했는지 파악하는 D단계 및 상기 제어부가 기 설정된 시간 또는 거리를 초과한 상기 대상자 뱃지와 접속을 해제하는 E단계를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Landslide hazard early warning method and device based on rainfall typing, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster early warning, in particular to a landslide disaster early warning method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium based on rainfall typing, which are characterized in that characteristics of grid nodes are obtained by collecting multi-source data such as grid connection meshing processing geology, rainfall events are segmented, morphology and statistical characteristics are extracted, machine learning rainfall typing is carried out based on the characteristics to obtain probability vectors of each rainfall type, then a graph structure integrating space and geological relations is constructed, static and dynamic characteristics of the grid nodes are fused, a space-time characteristic graph is input into a graph neural network, attention weight is regulated by taking the probability vectors as condition signals through learning mapping, landslide probability is calculated and early warning is generated based on updated grid node representation, so that the deep coupling of rainfall typing and graph neural network is realized, the spanning from static threshold value to dynamic characteristic modulation is realized, and early warning accuracy, timeliness and space perception capability are improved.

title_en: Mine slope displacement monitoring device and monitoring method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mine safety monitoring, in particular to a mine slope displacement monitoring device and method, which solve the problems of single data dimension, low prediction precision and insufficient early warning pertinence in the prior art. The device comprises units of multi-source data acquisition, historical data adaptation, data preprocessing, machine learning models, early warning output and the like, acquires InSAR, GNSS-RTK, environmental geology and other data, weights and fuses similar mine historical data, predicts the displacement of 1-7 days of slopes through a random forest+LSTM+attention model after preprocessing, and adopts the method of acquisition, processing, prediction, early warning and iteration, sets three-level displacement early warning thresholds and dynamically updates model parameters. The invention realizes the comprehensive fusion of multi-source data, displacement prediction error is less than or equal to 10%, grading early warning is timely and accurate, slope disasters are effectively prevented, and mine production safety is ensured.

title_en: Dynamic ground resistance monitoring method and system based on regional cooperative measurement
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ground resistance dynamic monitoring method and system based on regional cooperative measurement, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a regional power outage plan, selecting a substation set participating in cooperative measurement, planning measurement execution sequences of all substations according to the regional power outage plan provided by power grid dispatching, forming a measurement task sequence and issuing the measurement task sequence to corresponding measurement terminals deployed in all substations, sequentially or parallelly measuring electric parameters and environment parameter data of the corresponding substations by each measurement terminal through a bipolar method in a power outage window period, uploading the measurement data in real time, carrying out iterative calculation and updating on mirror coefficients and ground resistances of related substations according to the data uploaded in real time, carrying out dynamic monitoring on the updated ground resistance values, triggering early warning when the ground resistance values exceed a preset threshold value, and generating overhaul suggestions. The method and the device can improve the accuracy of calculation of the grounding resistance, discover hidden danger of power equipment in time and ensure safety.
assignees: CHANGDE POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LIMITED;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Fire risk dynamic assessment and early warning method based on deep reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire safety monitoring and early warning, in particular to a fire risk dynamic assessment and early warning method based on deep reinforcement learning, which comprises the following steps of obtaining multisource perception data of a target area; the method comprises the steps of constructing a dynamically updated fire risk assessment state space based on multisource perception data, processing real-time states in the state space and generating a risk assessment decision through a deep reinforcement learning agent optimized based on a cumulative reward function with accuracy rewards, false alarm penalties and false alarm penalties, mapping continuous output of the risk assessment decision into discrete dynamic fire risk levels by the deep reinforcement learning agent, and triggering an early warning signal matched with the dynamic fire risk levels according to the dynamic fire risk levels. According to the invention, through multi-source data standardization, dynamic state space, reinforcement learning optimization and hierarchical early warning binding, accurate dynamic assessment, reliable early warning and high-effect emergency response are realized.

title_en: Intelligent judging method for stability of highway slope rock mass
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent judging method for stability of a highway slope rock mass, which comprises the steps of obtaining rock mass displacement and moisture content of the highway slope rock mass, obtaining a rock mass internal mechanical property distribution diagram through finite element simulation, comparing the rock mass internal mechanical property distribution diagram with historical geological data, dividing the rock mass into a high uncertainty area and a low uncertainty area, extracting a deformation monitoring sequence from the high uncertainty area, classifying to obtain a deformation trend classification result, fusing the deformation trend classification result with the mechanical property of the low uncertainty area to generate a slope stability index map, updating rock mass fracture density and permeability, combining the updated fracture density, permeability and deformation trend, obtaining a instability probability distribution curve through probability simulation, generating an early warning signal according to whether a curve peak probability point is located in a safety interval, and outputting a slope stability judging report. The method improves accuracy and instantaneity of slope stability evaluation and obviously reduces geological disaster risks.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY NO 10 ENG GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Earthquake early warning information grading automatic pushing system and method based on region division
abstract_en: The invention discloses a regional division-based earthquake early warning information grading automatic pushing system and a regional division-based earthquake early warning information grading automatic pushing method, which relate to the technical field of intelligent disaster early warning and dynamically divide risk regions according to monitoring data and geographic and population information; the risk is estimated through a decision tree and random forest algorithm, an early warning grade sequence is generated, a personalized early warning information set is generated according to a grade matching template library, coverage is ensured through graded pushing of a broadcasting network and a standby satellite channel, an optimization instruction is generated according to a feedback data comparison standard, and a dividing and estimating model is dynamically updated to form a closed loop. The invention realizes accurate grading, reliable delivery and system self-optimization of the early warning information.

title_en: Method, system, equipment and medium for positioning and monitoring hidden danger of landslide of strip mine
abstract_en: The method, the system, the equipment and the medium for positioning and monitoring the landslide hidden danger of the strip mine belong to the technical field of monitoring geological disasters of the mine, and solve the problems of low accuracy of the existing landslide identification and the positioning precision of the core point of the landslide hidden danger; the method and the device have the advantages that the single monitoring unilateral performance is avoided through integrating multidimensional data such as displacement, stress and inclination angle, the landslide hidden danger characteristics can be comprehensively captured, the spatial correlation and time sequence trend characteristics are extracted through the CNN-LSTM model, the identification accuracy of the landslide hidden danger is improved, sub-meter level positioning of the core point of the landslide hidden danger is achieved through combining feature matching and triangular positioning, accurate targets are provided for treatment, early warning information is pushed according to risk level differentiation, the risk level is updated based on real-time monitoring data, and dynamic change of the landslide hidden danger is adapted.
assignees: HEFEI INST FOR PUBLIC SAFETY RESERCH TSINGHUA UNIVERSITY

title_en: Battery embedded edge-lighting fire extinguisher sign system
abstract_en: To provide a fire extinguisher sign system maintaining stable visibility even at the time of power failure or disaster, and to provide a system having a function of managing the expiration date of a fire extinguisher and notifying it at an appropriate timing.SOLUTION: A structure in which a thin light guide plate using an edge lighting technique and an LED are combined with each other is adopted, the light guide plate is turned on by an AC100V power source at a normal time, and is automatically switched to a blinking mode by a built-in battery at a power failure. Further, by utilizing PWM control by an electronic circuit, the consumption of a battery is suppressed to the minimum while improving visibility in an emergency. The fire extinguisher also has a function of managing the expiration date of the fire extinguisher by incorporating a microcomputer. To promote appropriate maintenance by displaying a warning on an LCD panel when a time limit approaches. The system can be directly mounted on a fire extinguisher installation bracket, and simplification of installation work and stable operation can be achieved.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Systems and methods for enhancing communication abilities of data processing systems using out-of-band components
abstract_en: Methods and systems for managing operation of a data processing system are disclosed. To manage operation of the data processing system, an occurrence of an emergency alert event may be identified by a management controller of the data processing system. Based on the identified emergency alert event, the management controller may initiate an emergency alert process and perform the emergency alert process in cooperation with a management system and emergency services system in order to update a state of the data processing system. By doing so, the likelihood of data processing system being able to communicate with remote entities that are required to cooperatively provide the computer implemented services may be increased.

title_en: Landslide digital twin frame construction method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of landslide simulation, and discloses a landslide digital twin frame construction method, which is used for carrying out simulation on slope instability conditions with different soil properties and different slopes to form a digital twin body construction foundation, constructing a three-dimensional scene substrate, merging a instability threshold value and a rainfall field to form a landslide digital twin body, constructing a landslide three-dimensional scene visualization scene, and carrying out visualization monitoring and early warning on a landslide process. The frame technology constructed by the method supports the dynamic update and response of measured data, and can provide theoretical technical support for the accurate prediction and intelligent early warning of landslide process. The technology has the function of updating the physical properties of the ground surface in real time, can realize the visualization of the whole landslide process, provides theoretical basis for landslide control decision, realizes the real-time monitoring of the landslide easily-occurring area, saves a large amount of manpower and material resources compared with the traditional monitoring, and has important significance for intelligent monitoring and management of landslide.

title_en: Coal mine rock burst danger space-time early warning method and system based on multi-source image data fusion, storage medium and equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal mine rock burst danger space-time early warning method and system based on multi-source image data fusion, storage media and equipment, wherein 1, multi-source heterogeneous data are acquired, 2, data preprocessing, 3, gridding cloud pictures of various data are constructed, 4, a rock burst early warning model based on an MSA-Unet encoder-decoder network structure is constructed, 5, model training and optimization are carried out, 6, early warning areas and data are dynamically updated, 7, end-to-end reasoning is carried out to generate a rock burst danger early warning cloud picture, and 8, a cyclic early warning mechanism taking time or a footage distance as a trigger condition is established. The multi-source heterogeneous data are converted into uniform image representation, so that the problem of multi-source data fusion and utilization of rock burst disaster geological data, microseismic monitoring data and the like is solved, meanwhile, the rock burst danger early warning and evaluation of the advanced area of the mining working face are realized based on the space-time division of the data, and the rock burst danger space-time dynamic early warning of the coal mining working face is realized.
assignees: SHAANXI HUADIAN YUHENG COAL AND ELECTRICITY CO LTD;UNIV CHINA MINING

title_en: Multi-mode agent cluster control system for dynamic evaluation of geological disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-modal intelligent agent cluster control system for dynamic evaluation of geological disasters, in particular relates to the technical field of three-dimensional geological modeling and digital twin, and is used for solving the problem that model expression disaster body states are inaccurate due to inconsistency of multi-modal monitoring data when digital twin models are fused; the multi-dimensional multi-modal monitoring data is collected by the data collection module by utilizing heterogeneous intelligent agent clusters, the cause judgment module judges whether the real disaster evolution is generated or not, the risk identification module identifies a high-risk critical area, the task generation module generates intelligent agent cluster collaborative observation task planning aiming at the high-risk critical area, the planning optimization module re-optimizes the collaborative observation task planning, and the execution updating module controls the heterogeneous intelligent agent cluster to execute the re-optimized task planning and feed back and update the digital twin three-dimensional model in real time, so that the dynamic accurate evaluation and early warning of the geological disaster are realized.
assignees: CHENGXIN ZHILIAN WUHAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Reservoir dam monitoring and early warning device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a reservoir dam monitoring and early warning device which comprises a bottom plate, wherein the top of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with a fixed column, the left side of the fixed column is fixedly connected with a cross rod, the surface of the cross rod is fixedly connected with a positioning block through a mounting sleeve, the bottom of the positioning block is fixedly provided with a first electric telescopic rod, the output end of the first electric telescopic rod is fixedly connected with a radar water level gauge, one side of the fixed column is fixedly connected with a box body, and the inner cavity of the box body is fixedly provided with a second electric telescopic rod. According to the utility model, the alarm lamp and the loudspeaker can be extended out through the second electric telescopic rod in the box body at one side of the fixed column, so that acousto-optic dual early warning is realized when the water level is abnormal. The alarm lamp blinks and the loudspeaker gives out alarm sounds, so that the alarm lamp can quickly draw attention of related personnel. The first reflector plate and the second reflector plate that the second motor drove of box one side strengthen the warning effect through reflection of light when light is darker, enlarge the early warning scope, improve the validity of early warning.
assignees: ANHUI YIFAN WATER CONSERVANCY CONSTRUCTION SUPERVISION CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent substation equipment state sensing and early warning system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a state sensing and early warning system and method for intelligent substation equipment, and relates to the technical field of industrial early warning; the method comprises the steps of fitting a historical state of equipment based on a long-short-term memory neural network model, outputting a reference aging trend item, calculating an event-driven disaster variation item under operation vibration by using a damage model based on a physical mechanism, calculating a difference value between the event-driven disaster variation item and the reference aging trend item to obtain a transient disturbance deviation degree, constructing an orthogonal fusion state vector containing the reference aging trend item and the transient disturbance deviation degree, carrying out state update on a time axis by adopting a recursive algorithm, and calculating a dynamic safety margin index and the residual hidden trouble-free running time of the equipment based on the updated orthogonal fusion state vector. The invention solves the problem of systematic missing report of the vibration hidden danger by the model.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER TRANS AND DISTRIBUTION CO LTD

title_en: Telescopic warning device for aircraft refueling truck
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of warning devices, and discloses a telescopic warning device for an aircraft refueling truck, wherein a cloth layer is adhered to the top of a base, a pulling block is fixed on the top of the cloth layer, a plurality of reflective belts used for warning are sewn on the outer side of the cloth layer, when the warning device is unfolded, the reflective belts are unfolded along with the extension of the cloth layer, the warning device can be conveniently folded, a plurality of support rings are sheathed with one another due to different diameters, the cloth layer can be compactly retracted at the top of the base, so that the volume of the warning device is greatly reduced, the storage and the transportation are convenient, the telescopic warning device adopts a soft cloth and telescopic design, the risk that the hard warning device can scratch an aircraft is fundamentally avoided, the safety of the aircraft is protected, the pulling block is simply pulled or pressed, and workers can easily unfold or fold the warning device, and the warning setting and the withdrawal in the refueling operation process become very rapid and convenient.
assignees: XIAN BRANCH OF CHINA NAT AVIATION FUEL CO LTD

title_en: Apparatus and method for AI-based predictive diagnostic control of air compressor
title_ko: 공기압축기의 ai 기반 예지진단 제어 장치 및 그 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 공기압축기의 AI 기반 예지진단 제어 장치 및 그 방법을 제공하기 위한 것으로, 공기압축기 설비(200)의 진동, 전류, 온도, 습도 신호를 수집하는 센서부(110)와; 센서 신호에 대해 A/D 변환, 동기화, 버퍼링하는 데이터 획득부(120)와; 신경망 추론을 수행하여 상태와 부하율을 산출하고, 드롭아웃 및 온도스케일링으로 예측신뢰도와 불확실도를 산출하는 임베디드 추론부(130)와; 공기압축기 설비(200)에 대한 단계적 감속, 감압, 정지, 경보 릴레이 구동을 수행하는 안전 처리부(140)와; VSD 속도 및 토크, 온/오프 히스테리시스, 애프터쿨러 및 드라이어의 설정값을 동적으로 갱신하는 제어부(150);를 포함하여 구성함으로서, 공기압축기의 운전 상태를 진동·전류·온도·습도 등 복수 센서로 계측하고, 임베디드 시스템 기반의 신경망(CNN)으로 상태·부하율·신뢰도를 산출한 뒤, 그 결과에 따라 공기압축기 내 인버터(VSD)의 속도제어·ON/OFF 히스테리시스 및 애프터쿨러/드라이어에 대한 ON/OFF를 제어하여 예지진단 제어를 수행할 수 있다.

title_en: Method, device, and server for preventing secondary accidents in a child protection zone
title_ko: 어린이 보호구역 내에서 2차 사고를 방지하는 방법, 장치 및 서버
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 데이터 처리 장치에 의해 수행되는 어린이 보호구역 내에서 2차 사고를 방지하는 방법은 어린이 보호구역 내에서 보행자 보호를 위한 제1 가상 펜스에 대한 정보를 결정한다. 여기서, 상기 제1 가상 펜스에 대한 정보는 제1 위치 정보 및 제1 범위 정보를 포함한다. 장치는 어린이 보호구역 내에서 적어도 하나의 센서를 통해 차량 및 보행자의 위치 또는 움직임을 실시간으로 감지하여 돌발 상황 발생 여부를 판단하고, 상기 돌발상황 발생 여부에 따라, 상기 제1 위치 정보 및 상기 제1 범위 정보 중 적어도 하나가 변경된 제2 가상 펜스에 대한 정보를 결정한다. 여기서, 상기 제2 가상 펜스에 대한 정보는 상기 제1 위치 정보가 변경된 제2 위치 정보 및 상기 제1 범위 정보가 변경된 제2 범위 정보를 포함한다. 장치는 상기 제2 위치 정보 및 상기 제2 범위 정보에 보행자가 존재하는지 여부에 따라, 상기 돌발 상황에 따른 2차 사고의 방지를 위한 알림 정보를 제공한다.

title_en: A fire rescue management platform
abstract_en: A fire rescue management platform comprising a network of nodes, each linked to stakeholders including residents, security personnel, civil defense, emergency responders, and tenants. It features a client module executed on stakeholder-associated devices, configured to receive real- time fire safety data from sensors or user inputs and to transmit safety status data, such as location and assistance requests, to a centralized server module. The server module processes this data through a rule engine, generating and disseminating color-coded fire threat alerts reflecting various severity levels to all stakeholders. It consolidates tenant safety information, dynamically updates threat zones in real time, leveraging sensor inputs and tenant feedback within a defined environment. The platform enables multi-agency communication via an external communications module, produces actionable reports to coordinate rescue operations, and outputs notifications reflecting different fire threat levels to client devices and other stakeholders, thereby providing integrated, responsive, and coordinated fire emergency management system.

title_en: Multi-mode data fusion digital intelligent mining pressure monitoring method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of coal mine safety monitoring, and discloses a multi-mode data fusion intelligent mining pressure monitoring method, a multi-mode data fusion intelligent mining pressure monitoring device and electronic equipment. And then, cleaning and feature extraction are completed through a data processing module, the cleaning and feature extraction are input into an intelligent analysis module with a built-in attention mechanism and a long-short-term memory network, the space-time evolution rule of the mine pressure is deeply excavated, and real-time pressure probability is output. The system judges the risk level according to the probability interval and executes graded linkage, namely, low risk maintains normal state monitoring, medium risk prompts to strengthen patrol, high risk directly contacts with sounding and light alarming and automatically interlocks and cuts off equipment power to force people to withdraw. The method effectively overcomes the limitation of single-source monitoring, and remarkably improves the accuracy of roof disaster early warning and the emergency response timeliness through multi-mode deep fusion and automatic interlocking control.
assignees: CCTEG COAL MINING RESEARCH INST CO LTD
